zh.title: 《饮酒者》：勃鲁维尔的客栈与一张脸
zh.summary: 弗兰德斯画家阿德里安·勃鲁维尔的客栈风俗画，以莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆藏《醉酒的农民在客栈》为代表，常被泛称为《饮酒者》。画面里酒、烟草与喧闹让所有人失去清醒；它既是滑稽的观察，也是对人性弱点的冷静注视。

en.title: Brouwer's The Drinker: A Tavern and a Face
en.summary: A tavern genre scene by the Flemish painter Adriaen Brouwer, represented here by the Mauritshuis's Drunken Peasants at an Inn and often discussed under titles such as The Drinker. Drink, tobacco and noise strip everyone of sobriety; the picture is both comic observation and a cool look at human weakness.

zh.title: 《农民婚礼》：勃鲁盖尔把一场乡村婚宴画成一张社会切片
zh.summary: 老彼得·勃鲁盖尔 1568 年的木板油画，现藏维也纳艺术史博物馆。画面是佛兰德斯农民的婚宴：新娘坐在绿布前，新郎按习俗不在席上；两个男人用卸下的门板端来麦糊，仆人把啤酒倒进壶里。它看似抓拍，实则精心构图。

en.title: The Peasant Wedding: Bruegel Paints a Village Feast as a Cross-Section of Society
en.summary: Pieter Bruegel the Elder's 1568 panel in Vienna shows a Flemish peasant wedding. The bride sits before a green cloth; the bridegroom is absent by custom; two men carry porridge on a door taken off its hinges while a servant pours beer. The snapshot look is carefully composed.

zh.title: 《酒神巴克斯》：卡拉瓦乔的一杯酒与一篮水果
zh.summary: 卡拉瓦乔的《酒神巴克斯》约作于 1598 年，现藏佛罗伦萨乌菲齐美术馆。画中年轻酒神举杯朝向观者，旁边是一篮精细描绘的水果；它既像邀请，也像一幅关于醉态与古代形象的谜题。

en.title: Caravaggio's Bacchus: A Glass of Wine and a Basket of Fruit
en.summary: Caravaggio's Bacchus, painted around 1598 and now in the Uffizi Galleries in Florence, shows a young wine god offering a glass to the viewer beside a minutely painted basket of fruit. It reads both as an invitation and as a puzzle about drunkenness and classical models.

zh.title: 《室内：饮酒女子与两位男子》：代尔夫特的一杯酒
zh.summary: 彼得·德·霍赫约 1658 年的室内画，现藏伦敦国家美术馆。一位女子背对观者举杯，两位男子以烟斗作乐器；画面在歌唱、饮酒与暧昧之间保持开放，红外线还显示画家删去过一个人物。

en.title: An Interior with a Woman Drinking and Two Men: A Glass of Wine in Delft
en.summary: Pieter de Hooch's interior, painted around 1658 and now in the National Gallery, London, shows a woman with her back to us holding a glass while two men use pipes as instruments. The picture stays open between singing, drinking and suggestion, and infrared imaging reveals a figure the painter removed.

zh.title: 《苦艾酒》：德加画的是两个人坐在一起，却谁也不看谁
zh.summary: 德加 1875–1876 年的《苦艾酒》原题《在咖啡馆》，现藏奥赛博物馆。画面里一位女演员与一位画家并排坐在巴黎咖啡馆，桌上有一杯苦艾酒；真正的主角不是酒，而是现代城市里的孤独。

en.title: L'Absinthe: Degas Paints Two People Sitting Together and Looking Past Each Other
en.summary: Edgar Degas's canvas of 1875–1876, originally titled In a Café, hangs in the Musée d'Orsay. A actress and a painter share a Paris café table with a glass of absinthe; the subject is not the drink but the solitude of the modern city.

zh.title: 《十八学士图》：唐太宗留下的一组政治肖像，被后人画成了四种文人生活
zh.summary: 台北故宫收藏的一套四幅《十八学士图》，旧题宋人，今多认为明人所作。每幅以琴、棋、书、画为主题，画十八学士在园林中雅集。它源自唐太宗为秦王府十八学士立像的政治工程，后来变成文人理想的图像模板。

en.title: The Eighteen Scholars: A Tang Political Portrait Turned into Four Scenes of Literati Life
en.summary: A set of four hanging scrolls in Taipei, formerly labelled Song but now often dated to the Ming, depicts the Eighteen Scholars of Tang Taizong in garden gatherings organised around the qin, chess, calligraphy and painting. The subject began as political propaganda and became a template for literati life.

zh.title: 《韩熙载夜宴图》：一场被画下来的夜宴
zh.summary: 传为五代南唐顾闳中所作的绢本设色长卷，纵 28.7 厘米、横 335.5 厘米，北京故宫博物院藏，一级甲文物。本文逐段读听乐、观舞、歇息、清吹、送客五幕，说明注子、温碗与杯盏如何组织夜宴节奏，并梳理宋摹本、作者归属与“窥视”叙事的争议。

en.title: The Night Revels of Han Xizai: a banquet turned into a painting
en.summary: A silk handscroll attributed to Gu Hongzhong of the Southern Tang, 28.7 by 335.5 cm, in the Palace Museum, Beijing, graded first class A. The page reads the five scenes of listening, dancing, resting, piping and farewell, explains how wine warmers and cups pace the night, and reviews the Song-copy and surveillance debates.

zh.title: 《静物：酒杯与酒器》：海达的大酒杯与怀表
zh.summary: 荷兰画家威廉·克拉斯·海达的静物画，以莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆藏《大酒杯与怀表》为代表。桌上的大酒杯、银器、食物与怀表被画成近乎单色的光影；它既是酒器研究，也是关于时间与节制的静物传统。

en.title: Heda's Still Life with Drinking Vessels: A Roemer and a Watch
en.summary: A still life by the Dutch painter Willem Claesz. Heda, represented here by the Mauritshuis's Still Life with a Roemer and Watch. A large drinking glass, silver, food and a watch are painted in a near-monochrome light; the picture is both a study of drinking vessels and a still-life tradition about time and moderation.

zh.title: 《兰亭集序》：曲水流觞与一篇序
zh.summary: 永和九年（353）三月三日，王羲之与友人在会稽兰亭修禊、饮酒赋诗，并为诗集作序。真迹不存；北京故宫博物院藏冯承素摹“神龙本”，纸本，纵 24.5 厘米、横 69.9 厘米。本文读文本、书法与酒令，并辨“神龙”印、摹本系统与兰亭论辩。

en.title: The Lantingji Xu: a floating-cup gathering and a preface
en.summary: On the third day of the third month in 353, Wang Xizhi and his companions held a purification gathering at the Orchid Pavilion, drank and wrote poems, and Wang composed a preface. The original is lost; the Shenlong copy, ink on paper, 24.5 by 69.9 cm, is in the Palace Museum, Beijing. The page reads the text, the calligraphy, the floating-cup rule and the copy debate.

zh.title: 《李白醉酒图》：一个被反复画的题材
zh.summary: 从上海博物馆藏苏六朋《太白醉酒图》轴（1844 年，纸本设色，204.8 × 93.9 厘米）入手，说明“李白醉酒”如何成为一个跨时代的画题，并辨析它与梁楷《李白吟行图》、波士顿美术馆《唐明皇招饮李白图卷》的区别，以及题款、断代与图像使用上的误区。

en.title: Li Bai Drunk: a subject painted again and again
en.summary: Starting from Su Liupeng's Li Bai Drunk, a hanging scroll of 1844 in the Shanghai Museum (ink and colour on paper, 204.8 by 93.9 cm), the page traces the subject across centuries and distinguishes it from Liang Kai's Li Bai Walking and Reciting in Tokyo and a Boston scroll of Li Bai drinking with Emperor Minghuang.

zh.title: 《苦艾酒饮者》：马奈把一个边缘人画成了历史画的大小
zh.summary: 马奈约 1859 年的早期油画，现藏哥本哈根新嘉士伯美术馆。画面只有一个披斗篷、戴高帽的男人，脚边一只空瓶，身旁一只小杯。它被 1859 年沙龙拒绝，却成为马奈“现代生活”绘画的起点。

en.title: The Absinthe Drinker: Manet Puts a Marginal Man on a History-Painting Scale
en.summary: Édouard Manet's early canvas of about 1859, now at the Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek, shows a single cloaked man, an empty bottle at his feet and a small glass on a ledge. Rejected by the 1859 Salon, it became a founding image of modern-life painting.

zh.title: 《清明上河图》：汴京酒肆与城市节奏
zh.summary: 北宋张择端绢本设色长卷，纵 24.8 厘米、横 528.7 厘米，北京故宫博物院藏，文物号新00087177。本文以孙羊店、十千脚店与虹桥一段为中心，说明正店、脚店与酒旗如何构成宋代城市的酒业网络，并梳理“清明”含义、季节与残卷诸争议。

en.title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival: taverns and urban rhythm in Bianjing
en.summary: Zhang Zeduan's Northern Song handscroll, 24.8 by 528.7 cm, in the Palace Museum, Beijing, object number 00087177. The page uses the Sun Yang shop, the Shiqian retail outlet and the Rainbow Bridge to explain the hierarchy of breweries and wine shops, and reviews the disputes over the meaning of Qingming, the season and the scroll's completeness.

zh.title: 《竹林七贤与荣启期》：南朝墓中的砖画
zh.summary: 1960 年出土于南京西善桥宫山大墓的南朝模印砖画，两壁各四人；南京博物院藏本一组 78 × 242.5 厘米、一组 78 × 241.5 厘米，人物旁有姓名榜题。本文细读八人姿态、酒在名士图像中的位置，并说明墓主、年代与“顾恺之粉本”诸说。

en.title: The Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove and Rong Qiqi: a brick relief in a Southern Dynasties tomb
en.summary: A moulded brick relief excavated in 1960 from a Southern Dynasties tomb at Xishanqiao, Nanjing. The Nanjing Museum's two groups measure 78 by 242.5 cm and 78 by 241.5 cm, with name labels beside the figures. The page reads the eight poses, the place of wine among them, and the disputes over tomb date, patron and lost model.

zh.title: 《夜间咖啡馆》：凡高把一盏煤气灯画成一场通宵的发烧
zh.summary: 凡高 1888 年 9 月在阿尔勒所作的油画，现藏耶鲁大学美术馆。画面是火车站咖啡馆的通宵内景：红墙、绿台球桌、四盏柠檬黄煤气灯，以及几个趴在桌上的客人。凡高说，他想画“人类可怕的激情”。

en.title: The Night Café: Van Gogh Paints a Gaslit Room as an All-Night Fever
en.summary: Vincent van Gogh's September 1888 canvas, now at the Yale University Art Gallery, shows the interior of an all-night café in Arles: red walls, a green billiard table, four lemon-yellow gas lamps and exhausted patrons. The artist said he wanted to paint "the terrible passions of humanity."

zh.title: 《酒神的胜利》：委拉斯开兹把神话拉进人群
zh.summary: 委拉斯开兹约 1628–1629 年的油画，现藏普拉多博物馆。酒神巴克斯与一群西班牙农民同席，举杯、加冠与饮酒把神话拉进日常；它既是对古典形象的戏仿，也是对酒神文化的重新讲述。

en.title: Velázquez's The Triumph of Bacchus: Bringing Myth into the Crowd
en.summary: Velázquez's painting of about 1628–1629, now in the Museo del Prado, places Bacchus among a group of Spanish peasants. Cups, crowning and drinking bring myth down to everyday life; the picture is at once a parody of the classical figure and a new telling of Bacchic culture.

zh.title: 《葡萄酒杯》：维米尔的一杯酒与一扇窗
zh.summary: 维米尔约 1658–1660 年的室内画，现藏柏林国家博物馆绘画馆。一位女子坐在桌前举杯，一位男子正从酒壶中倒酒；画面把饮酒、待客与荷兰黄金时代的室内生活放在同一束窗光里。

en.title: Vermeer's The Glass of Wine: A Drink and a Window
en.summary: Vermeer's interior, painted around 1658–1660 and now in the Gemäldegalerie in Berlin, shows a woman at a table holding a glass while a man pours from a jug. The picture places drinking, hospitality and Dutch Golden Age domestic life in the same window light.

zh.title: 《加纳的婚礼》：一面墙上的婚宴，和一场被宴席藏起来的奇迹
zh.summary: 委罗内塞 1562–1563 年为威尼斯圣乔治·马焦雷修道院餐厅所作的大型油画，现藏卢浮宫。画面把《约翰福音》的水变酒奇迹放进一场铺张的威尼斯婚宴：基督在中央，酒在侍者手中，真正被放大的却是宴饮的社会秩序。

en.title: The Wedding at Cana: A Wall-Sized Feast with a Miracle at the Edge
en.summary: Paolo Veronese's 1562–1563 canvas for the refectory of San Giorgio Maggiore, now at the Louvre, turns the Gospel miracle of water into wine into a Venetian banquet. Christ sits at the centre, but the wine moves through servants, cupbearers and guests.

zh.title: 《文会图》：宋徽宗把一场文人饭局画成了朝廷的理想秩序
zh.summary: 旧传宋徽宗赵佶所作的《文会图》，绢本设色，现藏台北故宫博物院。画面是一座园林里的文人雅集：大桌上摆着酒盏、茶具与果盘，学士围坐，仆人侍奉。它画的不是某一次真实饭局，而是北宋朝廷对“文治”的想象。

en.title: Literary Gathering: Emperor Huizong Paints a Scholars' Dinner as an Ideal of Civil Order
en.summary: Traditionally attributed to Song emperor Huizong, this ink-and-colour silk scroll in Taipei shows a garden gathering of scholars. A large table holds wine cups, tea ware and fruit; servants attend. It is less a record of one dinner than an imperial image of cultured governance.

zh.title: 《饮中八仙图》：八个人的醉态
zh.summary: 以两件可核查的传世本为中心：台北故宫博物院旧传任仁发本与纽约大都会艺术博物馆藏明或清本；梳理杜甫《饮中八仙歌》的八人名单、诗句如何被转成人物段落，以及题款、断代与酒器解读上的常见误区。

en.title: The Eight Immortals of the Wine Cup: eight drunks in one painting
en.summary: Built around two verifiable versions, one in the National Palace Museum, Taipei, traditionally attributed to Ren Renfa, and one in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, dated Ming or Qing; the page reads Du Fu's poem, the eight drinkers, the colophons and the false signatures that complicate the subject.

zh.title: 本草纲目（酒部）
zh.summary: 明代李时珍《本草纲目》共五十二卷，卷二十五谷部造酿类收酒、烧酒、葡萄酒等条目，兼记制法、性味与药用说法。它是理解明代酒类知识结构与烧酒起源叙述的关键文本，但药性论述不能当作现代医学结论。

en.title: Bencao Gangmu (wine sections)
en.summary: Volume 25 of Li Shizhen’s Ming pharmacopoeia, in the fermented-and-brewed class of the grain section, collects entries on wine, shaojiu and grape wine with methods, properties and medicinal claims. It is a key text for Ming wine knowledge and for the “shaojiu began in the Yuan” account, but its pharmacology is not modern medicine.

zh.title: 《东京梦华录》：文字版的汴京城市地图，酒肆是其中坐标
zh.summary: 孟元老《东京梦华录》成书于南宋绍兴十七年（1147），十卷，追忆北宋徽宗年间汴京的城市生活。酒肆、正店、脚店、夜市与节令酒俗，是这部笔记最重要的物质线索之一。本文梳理版本、作者、酒业内容、史料价值与常见误读。

en.title: Dongjing Menghua Lu: A Written Map of Bianjing, with Wine Houses as Coordinates
en.summary: Meng Yuanlao’s Dongjing Menghua Lu, completed in 1147, is a ten-juan memoir of Northern Song Bianjing. Wine houses, licensed breweries, petty wine shops, night markets and festival drinking customs are among its most important material clues. This article covers editions, author, wine content, historical value and common misreadings.

zh.title: 红楼梦
zh.summary: 曹雪芹的章回小说，约 18 世纪中期成书，1791 年出现 120 回刊本；酒贯穿宴席、节庆与日常待客，黄酒、惠泉酒、烧酒与合欢花浸酒各有场合。读酒要连同人物、礼数与版本一起看。

en.title: Dream of the Red Chamber
en.summary: Cao Xueqin's novel, written in the mid-18th century and printed in a 120-chapter edition in 1791; wine runs through banquets, festivals and everyday hospitality, with yellow wine, Huiquan wine, shaojiu and acacia-flower infusion each belonging to a different occasion. Read the wine passages together with character, ritual and edition.

zh.title: 醉酒的植物学家
zh.summary: 一本从植物出发讲酒的书：麦子、玉米、稻米、甘蔗、龙舌兰、葡萄、杜松与香料如何经过发酵、蒸馏或浸泡变成酒。它把植物学、工艺与饮食史编织在一起，适合当索引与入门读物，而不是商业酿酒手册。

en.title: The Drunken Botanist
en.summary: A book that starts with plants and ends with drinks: wheat, corn, rice, sugarcane, agave, grapes, juniper and spices become spirits and wines through fermentation, distillation or infusion. It combines botany, craft and food history, and works best as an index and an introduction rather than a commercial distilling manual.

zh.title: 《中国酒史》（王赛时）：从史前遗存到晚清的酒业长卷
zh.summary: 王赛时 2010 年由山东大学出版社出版的《中国酒史》，全书约 43 万字，上起史前遗存、下及晚清，是中国第一部系统研究酒史的专著。本文按版本、史料来源与局限逐项核对这部通史。

en.title: A History of Chinese Alcohol (Wang Saishi): From Prehistoric Remains to the Late Qing
en.summary: Wang Saishi’s A History of Chinese Alcohol, published by Shandong University Press in 2010, is a 430,000-character survey from prehistoric remains to the late Qing and is presented as the first systematic history of alcohol in China. This article covers its editions, author, structure, arguments, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 《Imbibe!》：把杰里·托马斯从传说还原成酒吧史
zh.summary: 大卫·旺德里奇 2007 年首版、2015 年修订的《Imbibe!》，以杰里·托马斯 1862 年《How to Mix Drinks》为中心，重建 19 世纪美国酒吧与经典鸡尾酒的形成。本文对照 1862 年原书与 2007/2015 两版，辨清史料与传说。

en.title: Imbibe!: Turning Jerry Thomas from Legend into Bar History
en.summary: David Wondrich’s Imbibe!, first published in 2007 and revised in 2015, uses Jerry Thomas’s 1862 How to Mix Drinks to reconstruct nineteenth-century American bar culture and the making of the classic cocktail. This article covers its editions, author, structure, arguments, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 《金瓶梅》：一部世情小说里的酒桌、商路与明代生活
zh.summary: 《金瓶梅》是明代署名“兰陵笑笑生”的世情长篇小说，以西门庆一家的兴衰写商业、家庭、欲望与城市生活。酒在书中既是宴饮的日常，也是交易、诱惑和权力的道具。本文从酒史与饮食史角度读它，并说明版本、史料边界与常见误读。

en.title: Jin Ping Mei: Wine Tables, Trade Routes and Ming Life in a Novel of Manners
en.summary: Jin Ping Mei, a Ming novel attributed to the pen name Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng, uses the rise and fall of Ximen Qing’s household to portray commerce, family, desire and urban life. Wine is both daily banquet fare and a tool of transaction, seduction and power. This article reads the novel through alcohol and food history, with editions, evidence limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 酒经
zh.summary: 北宋朱肱所撰的三卷酿酒专著，又名《北山酒经》；上卷论酒与酿法，中卷记制曲，下卷述酿酒流程，是理解宋代黄酒工艺的关键文本。

en.title: Beishan Jiujing (Classic of Wine)
en.summary: A three-volume brewing treatise by Zhu Gong of the Northern Song, also known as Beishan Jiujing; the upper volume discusses wine and brewing principles, the middle records qu-making, and the lower sets out the brewing process, making it a key text for understanding Song-era yellow wine.

zh.title: 《调酒之乐》：用家族树和比例，代替死记配方
zh.summary: 加里·里根 2003 年首版、2018 年修订的《The Joy of Mixology》，以“鸡尾酒家族”和比例系统帮助调酒师理解配方结构，而不是死记硬背。本文梳理其版本、作者、方法、影响、局限与常见误读。

en.title: The Joy of Mixology: Families and Ratios Instead of Memorized Recipes
en.summary: Gary Regan’s The Joy of Mixology, first published in 2003 and revised in 2018, teaches cocktail structure through drink families and proportions rather than rote memorisation. This article covers its editions, author, method, influence, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 牛津葡萄酒指南
zh.summary: 一部以字母顺序编排的葡萄酒百科全书，覆盖葡萄栽培、酿造、法规、产区、历史与人物。它适合查阅与交叉检索，而不是从头读到尾；具体条目随版次更新，引用时应注明版本。

en.title: The Oxford Companion to Wine
en.summary: An alphabetical encyclopedia of wine covering viticulture, winemaking, law, regions, history and people. It is built for reference and cross-checking rather than linear reading, and its entries change with each edition, so the edition consulted should be cited.

zh.title: 《Proof：酒的科学》：从酵母到宿醉，一杯酒里的实验室
zh.summary: 亚当·罗杰斯 2014 年出版的《Proof: The Science of Booze》，以发酵、蒸馏、熟成、感官和宿醉为线索，解释酒精的科学。本文按发酵、蒸馏、熟成与感官四章拆解书中的科学论证。

en.title: Proof: The Science of Booze: From Yeast to Hangover, a Laboratory in a Glass
en.summary: Adam Rogers’s Proof: The Science of Booze, published in 2014, explains alcohol through fermentation, distillation, maturation, sensory perception and hangover science. This article covers its edition, author, structure, arguments, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 齐民要术
zh.summary: 北魏贾思勰所撰综合性农书，约 533—544 年间成书，今本十卷九十二篇，约十一万字。卷七集中记录制曲与酿酒，是现存最早系统记载谷物酒工艺的汉语文献之一，本文梳理其作者、体例、酒类篇章与阅读边界。

en.title: Qimin Yaoshu
en.summary: Jia Sixie’s Northern Wei agricultural treatise, completed between 533 and 544 in ten volumes and ninety-two chapters, gives volume seven to qu-making and brewing. This article covers the author, the editions, chapters 63 to 67, the wine-cultural value of the text and its limits.

zh.title: 清酒现代指南
zh.summary: 一本面向英语读者的清酒入门书，从酒米、精米步合、制曲与并行发酵讲起，再进入类型、温度、配餐与购买。它适合建立框架，但 2006 年的具体品牌与市场信息需要以现行资料更新。

en.title: Sake: A Modern Guide
en.summary: An English-language introduction to sake that begins with rice, polishing, koji and multiple parallel fermentation, then moves to types, temperature, pairing and buying. It is useful for building a framework, but its 2006 brands and market details need to be updated from current sources.

zh.title: 《萨伏伊鸡尾酒书》：1930 年的酒吧账本，如何变成经典
zh.summary: 哈里·克拉多克编、1930 年伦敦 Constable 首版的《萨伏伊鸡尾酒书》，以 750 个配方和吉尔伯特·伦博尔德的装饰艺术插图，记录了萨伏伊酒店美国酒吧的调酒体系。本文梳理其版本、结构、核心贡献、史料局限与常见误读。

en.title: The Savoy Cocktail Book: A 1930 Bar Ledger That Became a Classic
en.summary: Harry Craddock’s The Savoy Cocktail Book, first published by Constable in London in 1930, gathered 750 recipes and Gilbert Rumbold’s Art Deco illustrations into a working record of the Savoy Hotel’s American Bar. This article examines its editions, structure, arguments, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 诗经
zh.summary: 中国现存最早的诗歌总集，通行本 305 篇；酒出现在祭祀、宴饮与乡饮酒礼中，“为此春酒”把农事、节令与祝寿连在一起。读酒句要分清礼制语境与文学修辞。

en.title: Classic of Poetry (Shijing)
en.summary: The oldest surviving anthology of Chinese poetry, with 305 poems in the received text; wine appears in sacrifices, banquets and village drinking rites, and “spring wine” links harvest, season and a wish for long life. Read the wine lines with their ritual setting and literary form in view.

zh.title: 随园食单（茶酒单）
zh.summary: 清代袁枚所著饮食名著，乾隆五十七年（1792）初刻，全书十四单、记菜肴饭点三百余种，其中“茶酒单”专论酒与茶。它是理解清代文人饮食审美与餐酒观念的重要文本，但属个人品评，不是系统酿酒手册。

en.title: Suiyuan Shidan (tea and wine list)
en.summary: Yuan Mei’s Qing food classic, first printed in 1792, runs to fourteen lists and some three hundred dishes, including a “tea and wine list” devoted to wine and tea. It is key to literati food aesthetics and pairing ideas, but it is personal criticism rather than a systematic brewing manual.

zh.title: 《品尝啤酒》：把“好喝”拆成可以练习的感官语言
zh.summary: 兰迪·莫舍 2009 年首版、2017 年第二版的《Tasting Beer》，以感官评价、风格、原料、配餐和酒吧服务为核心，教读者把啤酒品鉴从“喜欢”变成可描述、可比较的能力。本文梳理其版本、结构、论点、局限与常见误读。

en.title: Tasting Beer: Turning “I Like It” into a Trainable Sensory Language
en.summary: Randy Mosher’s Tasting Beer, first published in 2009 and revised in 2017, teaches sensory evaluation, styles, ingredients, pairing and draft service, turning beer tasting from preference into describable and comparable skill. This article covers its editions, structure, arguments, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 天工开物（曲糵篇）
zh.summary: 明代宋应星编纂的技术百科，崇祯十年（1637）初刻，三卷十八篇，第十七篇《曲糵》记录酒曲与红曲的制作；这一篇是理解明清制曲工序与酒文化的一手入口，阅读时需区分原文、版本差异与后世解释。

en.title: Tian Gong Kai Wu (chapter on qu and malt)
en.summary: Song Yingxing’s Ming technological compendium, first printed in 1637 in three volumes and eighteen chapters, devotes its seventeenth chapter to the making of wine qu and red qu. This article covers the author, editions, the qu-making process, its value for wine culture and its limits.

zh.title: 《水浒传》：酒是江湖的入场券，也是叙事的机关
zh.summary: 《水浒传》是明代署名施耐庵的长篇章回小说，酒在书中既是江湖义气的仪式，也是计谋、暴力和命运转折的工具。本文从酒史与叙事角度读“三碗不过冈”“醉打蒋门神”“智取生辰纲”等场景，并说明版本、史料边界与常见误读。

en.title: Water Margin: Wine as a Passport to the Jianghu and a Narrative Device
en.summary: Water Margin, a Ming novel attributed to Shi Nai’an, turns wine into a ritual of brotherhood, a tool of trickery and a hinge of fate. This article reads “Three Bowls and You Cannot Cross the Ridge,” “Drunk Beating Jiang the Gate Guard” and “Cleverly Taking the Birthday Gifts” through alcohol history and narrative, with editions, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 葡萄酒与战争
zh.summary: 一部讲述二战法国占领时期酒农、酒商与酒庄如何保住葡萄园、库存与生意的叙事史。葡萄酒在这里既是商品，也是国家身份的一部分，因此成为占领者、维希政府、抵抗者与普通家庭反复争夺的对象。

en.title: Wine and War
en.summary: A narrative history of how French winegrowers, merchants and estates tried to preserve their vineyards, stocks and trade during the Nazi occupation of 1940–1944. Wine appears here as both a commodity and a symbol of national identity, and therefore as an object contested by occupiers, the Vichy regime, resisters and ordinary families.

zh.title: 《葡萄酒圣经》：一本美国葡萄酒书，如何成为考试与餐桌之间的桥梁
zh.summary: 凯伦·麦克尼尔 2001 年首版、2015 年第二版、2022 年第三版的《The Wine Bible》，以产区、葡萄、品鉴与配餐为骨架，是美国最畅销的葡萄酒工具书之一。本文梳理其版本、结构、核心论点、局限与常见误读。

en.title: The Wine Bible: An American Wine Book Between Exam Syllabus and Dinner Table
en.summary: Karen MacNeil’s The Wine Bible, first published in 2001 and revised in 2015 and 2022, connects grape, place, tasting, food and storage in one accessible reference. This article covers its editions, author, structure, arguments, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 《世界啤酒地图》：从修道院到精酿，一张地图上的发酵世界
zh.summary: 蒂姆·韦伯与斯蒂芬·博蒙特合著的《The World Atlas of Beer》，2012 年首版、2021 年出至第三版，以地图、风格、产区与配餐解释全球啤酒。本文对照三版地图、风格分类与产区条目，标出证据边界。

en.title: The World Atlas of Beer: A Map of Fermentation from Abbeys to Craft Breweries
en.summary: Tim Webb and Stephen Beaumont’s The World Atlas of Beer, first published in 2012 and revised to a third edition in 2021, explains global beer through maps, styles, regions and food pairing. This article covers its editions, authors, structure, arguments, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 《世界威士忌地图》：把产区、酒厂与风味画在同一张图上
zh.summary: 戴夫·布鲁姆 2010 年首版、2014 年全面修订的《The World Atlas of Whisky》，以地图、200 多家酒厂和 750 款酒样，建立“产地—工艺—风味”的威士忌认知框架。本文梳理其版本、结构、核心论点、局限与常见误读。

en.title: The World Atlas of Whisky: Distilleries, Places and Flavour on One Map
en.summary: Dave Broom’s The World Atlas of Whisky, first published in 2010 and fully revised in 2014, uses maps, more than 200 distilleries and 750 expressions to build a framework of place, process and flavour. This article covers its editions, author, structure, arguments, limits and common misreadings.

zh.title: 世界葡萄酒地图
zh.summary: 休·约翰逊与杰西斯·罗宾逊合著的世界葡萄酒地理工具书，1971 年首版，2019 年出至第八版，以地图、法规与产区条目解释气候、土壤与风格。本文梳理其作者背景、版本体例、论点和酒文化价值，并说明使用边界。

en.title: The World Atlas of Wine
en.summary: Hugh Johnson and Jancis Robinson’s geographical reference on wine, first published in 1971 and revised to an eighth edition in 2019, explains climate, soil, regulation and style through maps and regional entries. This article covers its authors, editions, arguments, value and limits.

zh.title: 绝对伏特加
zh.summary: 瑞典伏特加品牌，现由保乐力加持有；以单一产地、冬小麦原料与连续蒸馏为卖点，透明瓶身、极简标签与长期艺术合作使其成为全球知名伏特加品牌之一。

en.title: Absolut
en.summary: A Swedish vodka brand now owned by Pernod Ricard, sold on single-origin production, winter wheat and continuous distillation, and known for its clear bottle, minimal label and long-running art collaborations.

zh.title: 白云边
zh.summary: 湖北松滋的兼香型白酒品牌，名称取自李白诗句；以“浓头酱尾”著称，产品分年份、年代、星级三条主线，十五年、二十年与三十年陈酿构成核心价格带。

en.title: Baiyunbian
en.summary: A mixed-aroma baijiu brand from Songzi, Hubei, named after a line by Li Bai; known for a strong-head, sauce-tail style, with vintage, era and star series, and core vintages at fifteen, twenty and thirty years.

zh.title: 张裕
zh.summary: 烟台张裕葡萄酿酒股份有限公司的葡萄酒品牌；企业由张弼士于 1892 年创办，品牌产品覆盖解百纳、酒庄酒、冰酒与白兰地等系列。

en.title: Changyu
en.summary: The wine brand of Yantai Changyu Pioneer Wine Co., Ltd.; the company was founded by Zhang Bishi in 1892, and the brand spans Jiebaina, chateau wines, ice wine and brandy.

zh.title: 芝华士
zh.summary: 苏格兰调和威士忌品牌，由保乐力加旗下的 Chivas Brothers 经营；以 12 年、18 年等年份标识与柔顺的调和风格著称，是高端调和威士忌的代表性名字之一。

en.title: Chivas Regal
en.summary: A Scotch blended whisky brand operated by Chivas Brothers under Pernod Ricard, known for its 12-year and 18-year age statements and a smooth blending style, and one of the representative names in premium blended Scotch.

zh.title: 稻花香
zh.summary: 湖北宜昌的浓香型白酒品牌，隶属稻花香集团；名称取自辛弃疾词句，产品以清样为高端旗舰，活力家族覆盖宴席，珍品系列守传统渠道，手抄件系列尝试酱香风味。

en.title: Daohuaxiang
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu brand from Yichang, Hubei, under Daohuaxiang Group; its name comes from a line by Xin Qiji, with Qingyang as the premium flagship, the Huoli family for banquets, Zhenpin for traditional channels and Shouchaojian as a soy-aroma experiment.

zh.title: 董酒
zh.summary: 贵州遵义董公寺的董香型（药香型）白酒品牌，由贵州董酒股份有限公司持有；以百草入曲、大小曲串蒸与双窖发酵为工艺特征，代表产品包括国密董酒与国密佰草香。

en.title: Dongjiu
en.summary: A Dong-aroma (also called medicinal-aroma) baijiu brand from Donggongsi, Zunyi, Guizhou, held by Guizhou Dongjiu Co., Ltd. Its process uses herbs in the qu, separate large and small qu, and twin cellars, with key products including Guomi Dongjiu and Guomi Baicaoxiang.

zh.title: 汾酒
zh.summary: 山西杏花村汾酒集团体系内的清香型白酒品牌，下有青花、老白汾、玻汾等系列。本页讲品牌结构，不重复产品页的风味细节。

en.title: Fenjiu
en.summary: A light-aroma baijiu brand within the Shanxi Xinghuacun Fenjiu Group system, with series including Qinghua, Laobaifen and Bofen. This brand covers brand structure, not the product page's flavour detail.

zh.title: 长城
zh.summary: 中粮集团旗下、由中粮长城酒业经营的国产葡萄酒品牌，产品以星级系列、酒庄酒与产区系列为主，覆盖日常餐酒到高端礼赠；具体产品的生产商与产区以瓶标为准。

en.title: Greatwall
en.summary: A domestic Chinese wine brand owned within COFCO and operated by COFCO Greatwall Wine Co., Ltd., built around star-rated series, estate wine and regional wines and covering everyday table wine to premium gifting; the producer and origin of a specific bottle should be checked on its label.

zh.title: 健力士
zh.summary: 源自爱尔兰都柏林的啤酒品牌，现由帝亚吉欧持有；以深色世涛、烘焙大麦风味与氮气泡沫口感著称，是世涛品类最具代表性的品牌之一。

en.title: Guinness
en.summary: A beer brand originating in Dublin, Ireland and now owned by Diageo, known for its dark stout, roasted barley flavour and nitrogen-conditioned foam, and one of the defining names in the stout style.

zh.title: 古井贡酒
zh.summary: 产自安徽亳州古井镇的浓香型白酒品牌，以“年份原浆”系列知名；产品覆盖古井贡酒、黄鹤楼等，常见度数从 38 度到 52 度，礼赠与宴席场景都常见。

en.title: Gujing Gongjiu
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu brand from Bozhou, Anhui, known for its "Nianfen Yuanjiang" series and products across several strengths.

zh.title: 轩尼诗
zh.summary: 法国干邑品牌，由路威酩轩旗下的酩悦轩尼诗经营；以 VS、VSOP、XO 等干邑等级与长期陈酿的调和原酒著称，是干邑产区最具代表性的品牌之一。

en.title: Hennessy
en.summary: A French Cognac brand operated by Moët Hennessy under LVMH, known for its VS, VSOP and XO grades and long-matured blended eaux-de-vie, and one of the defining names of the Cognac region.

zh.title: 红星
zh.summary: 北京红星股份有限公司旗下的清香型白酒品牌，以二锅头“掐头去尾取中段”工艺为核心；蓝瓶绵柔系列与绿瓶传统系列构成日常主线，另有红星高照等礼赠与纪念产品。

en.title: Red Star
en.summary: A light-aroma baijiu brand under Beijing Red Star Co., Ltd., built around the er-guotou cut-the-head-and-tail craft; the blue-bottle mellow series and green-bottle traditional series form the everyday core, with Red Star Gaozhao for gifting and commemoration.

zh.title: 黄鹤楼
zh.summary: 武汉白酒品牌，由黄鹤楼酒业持有；以“南派大清香”为主线，同时经营陈香、生态原浆、楼系列与浓香型“更上层楼”，覆盖宴席、礼赠与次高端场景。

en.title: Huanghelou
en.summary: A Wuhan baijiu brand held by Huanghelou Distillery, built around Southern School Great Light Aroma while also offering Chenxiang, Ecological Original Pulp, the Lou series and the strong-aroma Gengshang Cenglou; it covers banquets, gifting and upper-mid-market occasions.

zh.title: 会稽山
zh.summary: 会稽山绍兴酒股份有限公司旗下的绍兴黄酒品牌，源自 1743 年东浦云集酒坊，以糯米、麦曲与鉴湖水酿造；产品覆盖五年陈、兰亭、水香国色等系列，属绍兴酒地理标志产品体系。

en.title: Kuaijishan
en.summary: A Shaoxing huangjiu brand of Kuaijishan Shaoxing Rice Wine Co., Ltd., originating in the 1743 Yunji winery in Dongpu and brewed from glutinous rice, wheat qu and Jian Lake water; the range includes five-year aged wine, Lanting and Shuixiang Guose within the Shaoxing geographical-indication system.

zh.title: 剑南春
zh.summary: 四川绵竹的浓香型白酒品牌，由四川剑南春（集团）有限责任公司持有；以多粮浓香和“天益老号”古窖池群为识别点，代表单品包括水晶剑南春、珍藏级剑南春与东方红1949。

en.title: Jiannanchun
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu brand from Mianzhu, Sichuan, held by Sichuan Jiannanchun (Group) Co., Ltd.; it is known for multi-grain strong aroma and the Tianyi Laohao pit complex, with key items including Crystal Jiannanchun, the Zhencang grade and Dongfanghong 1949.

zh.title: 酒鬼酒
zh.summary: 酒鬼酒股份有限公司旗下的馥郁香型白酒品牌，产于湘西吉首；1987 年由黄永玉命名并设计麻袋瓶，代表产品包括内参、酒鬼与湘泉，以“一口三香”和多粮工艺为识别点。

en.title: Jiugui
en.summary: A fuyu-aroma baijiu brand under Jiugui Liquor Co., Ltd., made in Jishou, Xiangxi; Huang Yongyu named it and designed the sack-shaped bottle in 1987, and the range includes Neican, Jiugui and Xiangquan, known for three aromas in one sip and a multi-grain process.

zh.title: 尊尼获加
zh.summary: 源自苏格兰的调和威士忌品牌，现由帝亚吉欧持有；以方瓶与红、黑、绿、金、蓝等颜色分级产品线著称，覆盖日常调饮到高端礼赠。

en.title: Johnnie Walker
en.summary: A blended Scotch whisky brand originating in Scotland and now owned by Diageo, known for its square bottle and colour-coded Red, Black, Green, Gold and Blue Label range, from everyday mixing to high-end gifting.

zh.title: 口子窖
zh.summary: 安徽淮北濉溪出产的兼香型白酒品牌，以“一步兼香”和多曲多粮工艺为识别点；产品覆盖口子窖年份系列、老口子、口子坊与口子酒，2015 年随安徽口子酒业股份有限公司上市。

en.title: Kouzijiao
en.summary: A Jianxiang-aroma baijiu brand from Suixi, Huaibei, Anhui, known for a one-step Jianxiang process using multiple qu types and grains; the range covers the Kouzijiao vintage series, Lao Kouzi, Kouzifang and Kouzijiu, and the company listed in 2015.

zh.title: 郎酒
zh.summary: 四川古蔺二郎镇赤水河左岸的酱香型白酒品牌，由四川郎酒集团有限责任公司持有；主线包括青花郎、红运郎、红花郎与郎牌郎，另有郎牌特曲、顺品郎与小郎酒等兼香产品。

en.title: Langjiu
en.summary: A sauce-aroma baijiu brand from Erlang, Gulin, Sichuan, on the left bank of the Chishui River, held by Sichuan Langjiu Group Co., Ltd.; its main line includes Qinghua Lang, Hongyun Lang, Honghua Lang and Langpai Lang, with jianxiang products such as Langpai Tequ, Shunpin Lang and Xiaolangjiu.

zh.title: 衡水老白干
zh.summary: 河北衡水老白干酒业股份有限公司旗下的老白干香型白酒品牌；企业源于 1946 年组建的国营衡水制酒厂，2002 年上市。

en.title: Hengshui Laobaigan
en.summary: A Laobaigan-aroma baijiu brand under Hebei Hengshui Laobaigan Liquor Co., Ltd.; the company originates from the state-run Hengshui distillery formed in 1946 and listed in 2002.

zh.title: 泸州老窖
zh.summary: 泸州老窖集团体系内的浓香型白酒品牌，核心产品包括国窖1573与泸州老窖特曲。品牌名与“1573”窖池年代相关，但名称不等于瓶中酒龄。

en.title: Luzhou Laojiao
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu brand within the Luzhou Laojiao Group system, with core products including Guojiao 1573 and Luzhou Laojiao Tequ. The name relates to pit age, but the name is not the age of the liquid.

zh.title: 牛栏山
zh.summary: 北京顺鑫农业股份有限公司牛栏山酒厂的白酒品牌，以二锅头工艺与大众价格带为核心，产品线覆盖清香型二锅头、浓香型牛栏山陈酿与百年牛栏山等系列。

en.title: Niulanshan
en.summary: A baijiu brand of Beijing Shunxin Agriculture's Niulanshan Distillery, centred on er-guotou craft and the mass price band, with lines spanning light-aroma er-guotou, strong-aroma Niulanshan Chenniang and Bainian Niulanshan.

zh.title: 舍得
zh.summary: 舍得酒业旗下的高端浓香型白酒品牌，2001 年 12 月推出；以“舍得”文化理念与老酒储备为定位，代表产品包括品味舍得、智慧舍得、藏品舍得与水晶舍得。

en.title: Shede
en.summary: A high-end strong-aroma baijiu brand under Shede Spirits, launched in December 2001; positioned around the Shede cultural idea and aged-liquor reserves, with Pinwei Shede, Zhihui Shede, collectible Shede and crystal Shede in the range.

zh.title: 三得利
zh.summary: 日本的饮料与酒类企业品牌，酒类业务涵盖日本威士忌、啤酒与烈酒；全球烈酒业务曾以 Beam Suntory（宾三得利）名义运营。

en.title: Suntory
en.summary: A Japanese beverage and alcohol brand whose drinks portfolio covers Japanese whisky, beer and spirits; its global spirits business has operated under the Beam Suntory name.

zh.title: 水井坊
zh.summary: 四川水井坊股份有限公司旗下的高端浓香型白酒品牌，2000 年推出；以水井街酒坊遗址为品牌基础，代表产品包括菁翠、典藏、井台与臻酿八号。

en.title: Swellfun
en.summary: A high-end strong-aroma baijiu brand under Sichuan Swellfun Co., Ltd., launched in 2000. Built on the Shuijingjie distillery site, with products including Jingcui, Diancang, Jingtai and Zhenniang Bahao.

zh.title: 塔牌
zh.summary: 浙江塔牌绍兴酒有限公司旗下的绍兴黄酒品牌，以手工冬酿、年份陈酿与出口系列构成产品线；品牌依托绍兴酒地理标志与非遗工艺叙事，覆盖日常自饮到礼赠的价格带。

en.title: Taipai
en.summary: A Shaoxing huangjiu brand operated by Zhejiang Taipai Shaoxing Rice Wine Co., Ltd., built around handmade winter brewing, aged series and export packaging; it draws on the Shaoxing geographical indication and intangible-heritage narrative and spans everyday drinking to gifting.

zh.title: 青岛啤酒
zh.summary: 源于 1903 年青岛的啤酒品牌，由青岛啤酒股份有限公司持有；主力产品为拉格啤酒，覆盖经典 1903、纯生、白啤与奥古特等系列。

en.title: Tsingtao Beer
en.summary: A beer brand originating in Qingdao in 1903 and held by Tsingtao Brewery Company Limited. Its main products are lagers, spanning the Classic 1903, pure draft, white beer and Augerta series.

zh.title: 五粮液
zh.summary: 四川省宜宾五粮液集团有限公司旗下的浓香型白酒品牌，名称源于高粱、大米、糯米、小麦、玉米五种粮食。本页讲品牌结构，不重复产品页的风味细节。

en.title: Wuliangye
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu brand under Sichuan Yibin Wuliangye Group, named for five grains such as sorghum, rice, glutinous rice, wheat and corn. This brand covers brand structure, not the product page's flavour detail.

zh.title: 西凤酒
zh.summary: 陕西凤翔的凤香型白酒品牌，由陕西西凤酒集团股份有限公司持有；产品线覆盖红西凤、珍藏版、酒海陈藏、老绿瓶、华山论剑与国花瓷等系列，价格从大众民酒延伸到高端礼赠。

en.title: Xifengjiu
en.summary: A feng-aroma baijiu brand from Fengxiang, Shaanxi, held by Shaanxi Xifeng Liquor Group Co., Ltd.; its range covers Hong Xifeng, Zhencang, Jiuhai Chencang, the old green bottle, Huashan Lun Jian and Guohua Ci, from mass-market liquor to premium gifting.

zh.title: 习酒
zh.summary: 贵州习水的酱香型白酒品牌，由贵州习酒股份有限公司持有；厂区位于赤水河中游的二郎滩一带，代表产品包括君品习酒与习酒·窖藏1988。

en.title: Xijiu
en.summary: A sauce-aroma baijiu brand from Xishui, Guizhou, held by Guizhou Xijiu Co., Ltd. Its plant sits by the Erlangtan stretch of the middle Chishui River, and key products include Junpin Xijiu and Xijiu Jiaocang 1988.

zh.title: 洋河
zh.summary: 江苏洋河集团体系内的浓香型白酒品牌，以“绵柔”风格与蓝色经典系列知名，下有海之蓝、天之蓝、梦之蓝等产品线。

en.title: Yanghe
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu brand within the Jiangsu Yanghe Group system, known for its "mellow-soft" style and Blue Classic series, including Hai Zhi Lan, Tian Zhi Lan and Meng Zhi Lan.

zh.title: 迎驾贡酒
zh.summary: 安徽霍山出产的浓香型白酒品牌，以“国人的迎宾酒”为公开口号，主打生态酿造与洞藏贮存；产品覆盖大师版、迎驾洞藏、金银星、百年迎驾与迎驾古坊等系列。

en.title: Yingjia Gongjiu
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu brand from Huoshan, Anhui, publicly positioned as the Chinese people's welcoming liquor, built around ecological brewing and cave storage; the range covers Master Edition, Yingjia Dongcang, Gold and Silver Star, Bainian Yingjia and Yingjia Gufang.

zh.title: 美国佬
zh.summary: 金巴利、甜味美思与苏打水调制的低酒精开胃酒，1860 年代起源于米兰；苦味、甜味与气泡的平衡，使它成为内格罗尼的前身。

en.title: Americano
en.summary: A low-alcohol aperitif of Campari, sweet vermouth and soda water, dating to 1860s Milan. The balance of bitter, sweet and bubbles makes it the direct predecessor of the negroni.

zh.title: 阿佩罗气泡
zh.summary: 以阿佩罗、普罗塞克与苏打水按经典三二一比例调制的低酒精开胃气泡酒，橙皮苦味、甜感与气泡构成主体。

en.title: Aperol Spritz
en.summary: A low-alcohol aperitif of Aperol, Prosecco and soda water in the classic three-two-one ratio, defined by orange peel, gentle bitterness, sweetness and persistent bubbles.

zh.title: 飞行
zh.summary: 1916 年由纽约 Hotel Wallick 的 Hugo Ensslin 记录于《Recipes for Mixed Drinks》，以金酒、Maraschino、柠檬汁与紫罗兰利口酒摇和，呈淡紫到灰蓝色，常以樱桃装饰。

en.title: Aviation
en.summary: Recorded in 1916 by Hugo Ensslin of New York's Hotel Wallick in Recipes for Mixed Drinks, the Aviation combines gin, maraschino, lemon juice and crème de violette; it is pale violet to grey-blue and usually garnished with a cherry.

zh.title: 蜂膝
zh.summary: 禁酒令时期流行的金酒酸酒，以柠檬与蜂蜜糖浆替代砂糖，甜度与质地取决于蜂蜜糖浆的比例。

en.title: Bee's Knees
en.summary: A Prohibition-era gin sour in which honey syrup replaces sugar, with sweetness and texture set by the honey-to-water ratio.

zh.title: 贝里尼
zh.summary: 以普罗塞克与白桃泥调制的威尼斯经典，常引 1948 年 Harry's Bar 的 Giuseppe Cipriani 为起源；比例多为两份普罗塞克对一份桃泥，桃季与温度决定风味。

en.title: Bellini
en.summary: A Venetian classic of Prosecco and white peach purée, usually dated to Harry's Bar in 1948 and credited to Giuseppe Cipriani; the ratio is commonly two parts Prosecco to one part purée, with peach season and temperature deciding the flavour.

zh.title: 床笫之间
zh.summary: 白朗姆、干邑、橙皮利口酒与柠檬汁摇和的经典鸡尾酒，口感介于侧车与玛格丽特之间；名字与巴黎酒吧文化有关，带有明显的暧昧意味。

en.title: Between the Sheets
en.summary: A classic of white rum, cognac, orange liqueur and lemon juice, sitting between the Sidecar and the margarita. The name belongs to Paris bar culture and carries a deliberate ambiguity.

zh.title: 血与沙
zh.summary: 苏格兰威士忌、樱桃利口酒、甜味美思与橙汁等量摇和的经典鸡尾酒，颜色深红；名字来自 1922 年的斗牛电影，风味浓郁而平衡。

en.title: Blood and Sand
en.summary: A classic of equal parts Scotch, cherry liqueur, sweet vermouth and orange juice, shaken and deep red. Named after the 1922 bullfighting film, it is rich and balanced.

zh.title: 血腥玛丽
zh.summary: 以伏特加、番茄汁、柠檬汁、伍斯特酱、辣椒酱、盐与胡椒调制的长饮，芹菜与柠檬作装饰；起源常归于巴黎 Harry's New York Bar，具体人物与年份说法有争议。

en.title: Bloody Mary
en.summary: A long drink of vodka, tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, salt and pepper, garnished with celery; its origin is often traced to Harry's New York Bar in Paris, though the people and dates are disputed.

zh.title: 花花公子
zh.summary: 威士忌、金巴利与甜味美思调制的巴黎经典，1927 年首次见于书面配方，等份与 1.5:1:1 是两种主要比例。

en.title: Boulevardier
en.summary: A Paris classic of whiskey, Campari and sweet vermouth, first printed in 1927, with equal-parts and 1.5:1:1 versions both in use.

zh.title: 白兰地亚历山大
zh.summary: 白兰地、白可可利口酒与奶油等量摇和的甜点型鸡尾酒，表面撒肉豆蔻；名字与起源说法众多，是 20 世纪初美国酒吧文化的代表之一。

en.title: Brandy Alexander
en.summary: A dessert cocktail of equal parts brandy, white crème de cacao and cream, shaken and topped with grated nutmeg. Its name and origin are disputed, but it is a fixture of early-twentieth-century American bar culture.

zh.title: 卡琵莉亚
zh.summary: 以卡莎萨、青柠与糖捣压后加冰调制的巴西国饮，酸甜直接、酒体清爽；IBA 配方为 60 毫升卡莎萨、一个青柠与两茶匙糖，捣压与冰的用量决定成败。

en.title: Caipirinha
en.summary: Brazil's national cocktail, made by muddling cachaça, lime and sugar over ice; the IBA recipe uses 60 ml cachaça, one lime and two teaspoons of sugar, and muddling and ice decide the result.

zh.title: 香槟鸡尾酒
zh.summary: 糖块、安高天娜苦精与香槟构成的古典鸡尾酒，可选少量干邑；气泡从糖块上升，苦精的香料与香槟的酸度形成优雅对比。

en.title: Champagne Cocktail
en.summary: A classical cocktail of a sugar cube, Angostura bitters and Champagne, with optional cognac. Bubbles rise from the cube, and the bitters' spice meets the wine's acidity.

zh.title: 三叶草俱乐部
zh.summary: 以金酒、柠檬汁、覆盆子糖浆与蛋清摇和调制的经典鸡尾酒，泡沫细腻、酸甜柔和，常见装饰为覆盆子；名字来自 20 世纪初美国的一家同名俱乐部。

en.title: Clover Club
en.summary: A classic cocktail of gin, lemon juice, raspberry syrup and egg white, shaken to a fine foam; balanced sour-sweet and usually garnished with a raspberry; the name comes from an American club of the same name in the early 20th century.

zh.title: 还魂酒二号
zh.summary: 以金酒、橙味利口酒、利莱白与柠檬汁等量摇制，并以苦艾酒洗杯的经典酸酒，茴香与柑橘是识别点。

en.title: Corpse Reviver #2
en.summary: A classic sour of equal parts gin, orange liqueur, Lillet Blanc and lemon juice, with a rinse of absinthe and an anise-citrus character.

zh.title: 大都会
zh.summary: 以柠檬伏特加、君度、青柠汁与蔓越莓汁摇和后滤入杯中的经典鸡尾酒，酸甜清爽，颜色粉红，常见装饰为橙皮或青柠片。

en.title: Cosmopolitan
en.summary: A classic cocktail of citron vodka, Cointreau, lime juice and cranberry juice, shaken and strained into a glass; tart and refreshing, pink in colour, commonly garnished with an orange twist or lime slice.

zh.title: 代基里
zh.summary: 白朗姆、青柠汁与细砂糖摇和而成的酸型经典。它结构极简，酸甜、稀释与温度任何一项失衡都会立刻暴露。

en.title: Daiquiri
en.summary: A classic sour of white rum, lime juice and fine sugar, shaken and strained. Its structure is so simple that any imbalance in acidity, dilution or temperature shows at once.

zh.title: 黑色风暴
zh.summary: 深色朗姆与姜汁啤酒加青柠调制的百慕大经典，Gosling's 持有商标；姜的辛辣与朗姆的焦糖形成强烈对比，做法简单却对姜啤品质敏感。

en.title: Dark 'n' Stormy
en.summary: A Bermuda classic of dark rum, ginger beer and lime, with a trademark held by Gosling's. Ginger's heat against the rum's caramel makes a strong contrast, and the simple build is very sensitive to the quality of the ginger beer.

zh.title: 干马天尼
zh.summary: 以金酒和干味美思调制的经典鸡尾酒，搅拌后滤入预冷的杯中，以柠檬皮或橄榄装饰。干度取决于味美思的比例，而不是名字。

en.title: Dry Martini
en.summary: A classic cocktail of gin and dry vermouth, stirred and strained into a chilled glass, garnished with lemon peel or olives. Dryness is a matter of vermouth ratio, not the name.

zh.title: 浓缩咖啡马天尼
zh.summary: 以伏特加、咖啡利口酒、浓缩咖啡与糖浆大力摇和而成的现代经典，表面咖啡泡沫与香气是识别点。

en.title: Espresso Martini
en.summary: A modern classic of vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso and syrup, hard-shaken and served with a dense coffee foam and three coffee beans.

zh.title: 法国 75
zh.summary: 金酒、柠檬、糖与香槟构成的气泡短饮，常被追溯到一战期间巴黎的 Harry's New York Bar，名字来自法国 75 毫米野战炮。

en.title: French 75
en.summary: A sparkling short drink of gin, lemon, sugar and Champagne, commonly traced to Harry's New York Bar in Paris during the First World War and named after a French 75 mm field gun.

zh.title: 吉姆雷特
zh.summary: 金酒与青柠糖浆（或鲜榨青柠汁加糖浆）调制的短饮，酸度、甜度与质地取决于用哪一种青柠。

en.title: Gimlet
en.summary: A short drink of gin and lime cordial, or gin with fresh lime and syrup, whose acidity, sweetness and texture depend on which lime you use.

zh.title: 金菲士
zh.summary: 金酒、柠檬汁、糖浆与苏打水组成的短饮；IBA 版为 45 ml 金酒、30 ml 柠檬汁、10 ml 糖浆，摇和后滤入细长杯、补少量苏打且不加冰；加蛋清即 Silver Fizz，加奶油与橙花水即 Ramos Gin Fizz。

en.title: Gin Fizz
en.summary: A short drink of gin, lemon juice, syrup and soda water; the IBA version uses 45 ml gin, 30 ml lemon juice and 10 ml syrup, shaken and strained into a slim glass, topped with a splash of soda and served without ice; egg white makes a Silver Fizz, cream and orange flower water a Ramos Gin Fizz.

zh.title: 蚱蜢
zh.summary: 绿薄荷利口酒、白可可利口酒与奶油摇和而成的甜点型鸡尾酒，颜色淡绿、口感像薄荷巧克力；起源于新奥尔良的说法流传最广。

en.title: Grasshopper
en.summary: A dessert cocktail of green crème de menthe, white crème de cacao and cream, shaken into a pale green drink that tastes of mint chocolate. The New Orleans origin is the best-known account.

zh.title: 海明威代基里
zh.summary: 白朗姆、西柚、青柠与黑樱桃利口酒，不加糖，干、苦而酒精度高，常与哈瓦那 El Floridita 和“Papa Doble”联系在一起。

en.title: Hemingway Daiquiri
en.summary: White rum, grapefruit, lime and maraschino with no sugar, dry and strong, tied to Havana's El Floridita and the "Papa Doble".

zh.title: 爱尔兰咖啡
zh.summary: 热咖啡、爱尔兰威士忌、红糖与轻微打发的奶油分层而成的热饮，1940 年代起源于爱尔兰福因斯机场；关键是温度、糖与奶油的浮层。

en.title: Irish Coffee
en.summary: A hot drink of coffee, Irish whiskey, brown sugar and lightly whipped cream, layered so the cream floats. It began at Foynes airport in Ireland in the 1940s; temperature, sugar and cream texture decide the result.

zh.title: 皇家基尔
zh.summary: 黑加仑利口酒与香槟调制的法国经典，起源于第戎的基尔酒；颜色深红，气泡细密，甜酸对比强烈，是最简单的香槟鸡尾酒之一。

en.title: Kir Royale
en.summary: A French classic of crème de cassis and Champagne, descended from the Kir of Dijon. Deep red, finely bubbled and sharply balanced between sweet and sour, it is one of the simplest Champagne cocktails.

zh.title: 最后一语
zh.summary: 金酒、绿查特、黑樱桃利口酒与青柠汁等份摇制，草本强度、樱桃核香与酸度并重，是 2000 年代现代经典复兴的代表。

en.title: The Last Word
en.summary: An equal-parts cocktail of gin, green Chartreuse, maraschino liqueur and lime juice, defined by herbal intensity, cherry-pit aroma and acidity, and a symbol of the 2000s modern-classic revival.

zh.title: 长岛冰茶
zh.summary: 五种基酒、柠檬汁、糖浆与可乐组成的高球鸡尾酒，看起来像冰茶，实际酒精度很高；1970 年代长岛酒吧的起源说法存在争议。

en.title: Long Island Iced Tea
en.summary: A highball of five spirits, lemon juice, syrup and cola that looks like iced tea and is far stronger than it appears. The origin story in 1970s Long Island is disputed.

zh.title: 迈泰
zh.summary: 1944 年由奥克兰的 Trader Vic 创制的提基经典；IBA 版以牙买加朗姆与马提尼克糖蜜朗姆各 30 ml，配橙皮利口酒、杏仁糖浆与青柠汁，加冰摇和后连冰倒入双份古典杯，以菠萝角、薄荷与青柠皮装饰。

en.title: Mai Tai
en.summary: The tiki classic created by Trader Vic in Oakland in 1944; the IBA version pairs 30 ml Jamaican rum and 30 ml Martinique molasses rum with orange liqueur, orgeat and lime, shaken and poured unstrained into a double rocks glass with pineapple, mint and lime peel.

zh.title: 曼哈顿
zh.summary: 以黑麦威士忌、甜味美思与苦精调制的经典鸡尾酒，搅拌后滤入杯中，以樱桃装饰。结构简洁，甜味与香料层层展开。

en.title: Manhattan
en.summary: A classic cocktail of rye whiskey, sweet vermouth and bitters, stirred and strained into a glass, garnished with a cherry. The structure is simple, with sweetness and spice unfolding in layers.

zh.title: 玛格丽特
zh.summary: 以龙舌兰、橙皮酒和鲜榨青柠汁摇和而成的经典鸡尾酒。酸甜与盐边是结构的一部分，不是装饰口号。

en.title: Margarita
en.summary: A classic cocktail of tequila, orange liqueur and fresh lime juice, shaken and served with an optional salt rim. Sweetness, sourness and salt are part of the structure.

zh.title: 马天尼兹
zh.summary: 金酒、甜味美思、玛拉斯奇诺与橙味苦精调制的经典鸡尾酒，1880 年代出现于美国；被视为干马天尼与曼哈顿之间的桥梁，甜苦平衡微妙。

en.title: Martinez
en.summary: A classic of gin, sweet vermouth, maraschino and orange bitters, dating to the 1880s in the United States. It bridges the Manhattan and the dry martini, with a delicate bitter-sweet balance.

zh.title: 含羞草
zh.summary: 由等分香槟与橙汁调制的早午餐鸡尾酒，酒精度低、气泡轻盈；名字来自黄色花，配方简单却对温度与比例敏感。

en.title: Mimosa
en.summary: A brunch cocktail of equal parts sparkling wine and orange juice, low in alcohol and light on bubbles; its name comes from a yellow flower, and its simple formula is sensitive to temperature and ratio.

zh.title: 薄荷朱利普
zh.summary: 以波本威士忌、薄荷与糖调制的经典鸡尾酒，碎冰填满杯中，常见装饰为薄荷枝；风格清凉、甜润，是美国南方赛马文化的代表饮品。

en.title: Mint Julep
en.summary: A classic cocktail of bourbon, mint and sugar served over crushed ice in a filled glass, usually garnished with a mint sprig; cool and sweet, and a signature drink of American Southern horse-racing culture.

zh.title: 莫吉托
zh.summary: 以白朗姆、青柠、薄荷、蔗糖和苏打水调制的长饮。薄荷只轻压，冰要足，酸甜与气泡共同决定它是否清爽。

en.title: Mojito
en.summary: A long drink of white rum, lime, mint, cane sugar and soda. Press the mint, use plenty of ice, and let acidity, sweetness and bubbles decide whether it refreshes.

zh.title: 莫斯科骡子
zh.summary: 以伏特加、姜汁啤酒与青柠汁调制的长饮，姜的辛辣、气泡与青柠酸度构成主要平衡，常以铜杯或高球杯加冰饮用。

en.title: Moscow Mule
en.summary: A long drink of vodka, ginger beer and lime, balanced by ginger heat, carbonation and fresh lime acidity, usually served over ice in a copper mug or highball glass.

zh.title: 内格罗尼
zh.summary: 由金酒、苦味开胃酒与甜味美思等量调制的经典鸡尾酒。鸡尾酒身份与配方版本分开记录。

en.title: Negroni
en.summary: A classic cocktail of equal parts gin, bitter aperitif and sweet vermouth. Cocktail identity and recipe versions are recorded separately.

zh.title: 古典
zh.summary: 以威士忌、糖、苦精与水调制的经典鸡尾酒。它用少量糖和水把烈酒打开，结构简单，却能清楚呈现威士忌本身。

en.title: Old Fashioned
en.summary: A classic cocktail of whiskey, sugar, bitters and water. A little sugar and water open up the spirit, and the simple structure lets the whiskey speak for itself.

zh.title: 老广场
zh.summary: 以黑麦威士忌、金巴利与干味美思等比例调制的经典鸡尾酒，搅拌后滤入杯中，常见装饰为柠檬皮，风格偏苦、偏干。

en.title: Old Pal
en.summary: A classic cocktail of equal parts rye whiskey, Campari and dry vermouth, stirred and strained into a chilled glass, usually garnished with lemon peel; bitter and dry in style.

zh.title: 帕洛玛
zh.summary: 以龙舌兰、西柚汁或西柚汽水与青柠调制的清爽长饮，西柚的苦甜、盐边与气泡构成主要特征。

en.title: Paloma
en.summary: A refreshing long drink of tequila, grapefruit and lime, defined by grapefruit bittersweetness, an optional salt rim and lively carbonation.

zh.title: 纸飞机
zh.summary: 以波本、阿佩罗、阿玛罗与柠檬汁等量摇制的现代经典，苦甜与柑橘平衡，呈粉橙色；2008 年由纽约 Milk & Honey 的 Sam Ross 创作，是苦甜鸡尾酒的代表。

en.title: Paper Plane
en.summary: A modern classic of equal parts bourbon, Aperol, amaro and lemon juice, balancing bittersweet herbs with bright citrus.

zh.title: 盘尼西林
zh.summary: 以苏格兰调和威士忌、柠檬、蜂蜜姜糖浆摇制，并浮一层艾雷岛威士忌的现代经典，烟熏与姜辣是识别点。

en.title: Penicillin
en.summary: A modern classic of blended Scotch, lemon, honey-ginger syrup and a float of Islay whisky, recognised by its smoke and ginger heat.

zh.title: 椰林飘香
zh.summary: 白朗姆、椰浆与菠萝汁调制的热带鸡尾酒，1930 年代已有雏形，1954 年在波多黎各 Caribe Hilton 定型；可摇和或打碎，甜度与冰量决定成败。

en.title: Piña Colada
en.summary: A tropical cocktail of white rum, coconut cream and pineapple juice. A version existed in the 1930s, the modern drink was fixed at the Caribe Hilton in Puerto Rico in 1954, and sweetness and ice decide whether it works.

zh.title: 粉红佳人
zh.summary: 以金酒、applejack、柠檬汁、石榴糖浆与蛋白摇和的经典酸酒，粉色来自石榴糖浆，蛋白带来细腻泡沫；名字常与 1911 年百老汇音乐剧《The Pink Lady》联系在一起。

en.title: Pink Lady
en.summary: A classic sour of gin, applejack, lemon juice, grenadine and egg white; the pink comes from grenadine and the egg white gives a fine foam. The name is usually linked to the 1911 Broadway musical The Pink Lady.

zh.title: 皮斯科酸
zh.summary: 以皮斯科、青柠汁、糖浆与蛋清摇制的酸类鸡尾酒，表面泡沫层与安高天娜苦精点缀是识别特征。

en.title: Pisco Sour
en.summary: A sour of pisco, lime juice, syrup and egg white, shaken into a silky foam and finished with a few dashes of Angostura bitters.

zh.title: 拉莫斯金菲士
zh.summary: 金酒、柑橘、奶油、蛋白与橙花水长时间摇和后加苏打的新奥尔良经典，泡沫丰厚如云；1888 年由 Henry C. Ramos 在梅耶餐厅定型。

en.title: Ramos Gin Fizz
en.summary: A New Orleans classic of gin, citrus, cream, egg white and orange flower water, shaken long and topped with soda, with a cloud of foam. Henry C. Ramos fixed it at Meyer's Restaurant in 1888.

zh.title: 萨泽拉克
zh.summary: 起源于美国新奥尔良的经典鸡尾酒，IBA 版以干邑、方糖与佩肖苦精调制，杯中以苦艾酒洗杯；黑麦威士忌版是美国内战后的替代传统。

en.title: Sazerac
en.summary: A classic cocktail originating in New Orleans, made with cognac, a sugar cube and Peychaud's bitters in the IBA version, with an absinthe rinse; the rye whiskey version is the post-Civil War substitution tradition.

zh.title: 边车
zh.summary: 以干邑、橙味利口酒与鲜榨柠檬汁摇和的经典酸酒，比例多为 50:20:20，糖边可选。

en.title: Sidecar
en.summary: A classic sour of cognac, orange liqueur and fresh lemon juice, usually built at 50:20:20, with an optional sugar rim.

zh.title: 新加坡司令
zh.summary: 以金酒、樱桃利口酒、柑橘汁、菠萝汁与少量苦精摇和后滤入飓风杯的经典鸡尾酒；IBA 版本不加苏打水，以菠萝片与马拉斯奇诺樱桃装饰。

en.title: Singapore Sling
en.summary: A classic cocktail of gin, cherry liqueur, citrus juice, pineapple juice and a little bitters, shaken and strained into a hurricane glass; the IBA version contains no soda and is garnished with pineapple and a maraschino cherry.

zh.title: 龙舌兰日出
zh.summary: 龙舌兰、橙汁与石榴糖浆在高球杯中形成的渐变鸡尾酒，颜色从橙黄过渡到红；1970 年代在加州走红，并因摇滚乐队巡演而广为人知。

en.title: Tequila Sunrise
en.summary: A layered highball of tequila, orange juice and grenadine, shading from orange to red. It became popular in 1970s California and reached a wide audience through a rock band's tour.

zh.title: 汤姆柯林斯
zh.summary: 老汤姆金酒、柠檬汁、糖浆与苏打水组成的长饮；IBA 将其列在 John Collins 条目下（45 ml 金酒、30 ml 柠檬汁、15 ml 糖浆、60 ml 苏打水），做 Tom Collins 时改用老汤姆金酒，柯林斯杯加冰，以柠檬片与樱桃装饰。

en.title: Tom Collins
en.summary: A long drink of Old Tom gin, lemon juice, syrup and soda water; the IBA lists it under John Collins (45 ml gin, 30 ml lemon juice, 15 ml syrup, 60 ml soda), notes Old Tom for a true Tom Collins, and serves it over ice in a Collins glass with lemon and cherry.

zh.title: 老广场
zh.summary: 黑麦威士忌、干邑、甜味美思、Bénédictine 与两种苦精调制的新奥尔良经典，双基酒与草本甜是识别点。

en.title: Vieux Carré
en.summary: A New Orleans classic of rye whiskey, Cognac, sweet vermouth, Bénédictine and two bitters, defined by its double base and herbal sweetness.

zh.title: 威士忌酸
zh.summary: 以威士忌、柠檬汁与糖浆摇和后调制的经典鸡尾酒，酸甜平衡，表面可加蛋清泡沫；常见装饰为柠檬片或樱桃。

en.title: Whiskey Sour
en.summary: A classic cocktail of whiskey, lemon juice and sugar syrup, shaken and served, optionally with an egg-white foam; commonly garnished with a lemon slice or cherry.

zh.title: 僵尸
zh.summary: 1934 年 Donn Beach 在好莱坞创作的提基经典，以牙买加、波多黎各与德梅拉拉三种朗姆酒叠加 falernum、Donn's Mix 与石榴糖浆，酒精度高，常以薄荷枝装饰。

en.title: Zombie
en.summary: A tiki classic created by Donn Beach in Hollywood in 1934, built on Jamaican, Puerto Rican and Demerara rums with falernum, Donn's Mix and grenadine; strong and usually garnished with a mint sprig.

zh.title: 白酒香型体系：浓香、清香、酱香与米香怎么读
zh.summary: 香型是白酒行业描述香气风格与工艺传统的一套分类语言，不是质量等级的排行榜。本文说明它从哪来、由哪些工艺与成分共同塑造，以及读标签时该看什么。

en.title: Baijiu aroma systems: how to read strong, light, sauce and rice aromas
en.summary: Aroma type is the baijiu trade's vocabulary for describing a style of aroma and a tradition of craft, not a ranking of quality. This essay explains where the idea came from, which processes and compounds shape it, and what to read on a label.

zh.title: 走出酒馆：把一杯酒追到产地
zh.summary: 酒馆之外还有产地。啤酒厂、蒸馏厂与酒庄的参观，把风味从“好喝”拆成原料、设备、时间与人的选择。本文说明三类参观各能看到什么、该问什么，以及哪些说法不可信。

en.title: Beyond the bar: following a drink to where it is made
en.summary: Beyond the bar lies the place of production. Visits to breweries, distilleries and wine estates break flavour down into raw materials, equipment, time and human choices. This essay explains what each kind of visit shows, what to ask, and which claims not to trust.

zh.title: 酒窖与储存：温度、湿度、光照与时间
zh.summary: 酒窖不是把酒“放老”的魔法房间，储存的目标是让酒以可控的速度变化。本文分葡萄酒、啤酒与烈酒说明储存条件、容器差异与常见误区，并给出可执行的家庭存酒方法。

en.title: Cellars and storage: temperature, humidity, light and time
en.summary: A cellar is not a magic room that ages wine. Storage aims to let a drink change at a controlled pace. This article covers wine, beer and spirits, the differences between closures, common myths and practical home storage.

zh.title: 中国酒史纲：从谷物发酵到国家名酒
zh.summary: 以考古、农书、城市文献与近现代评酒制度为线索，梳理中国酒从早期谷物发酵、唐宋酒肆、元明蒸馏酒到近现代工业化与国家名酒的长期变化；区分证据、传说与后来的叙事。

en.title: A concise history of Chinese alcohol: from grain fermentation to national famous wines
en.summary: Using archaeology, agricultural manuals, urban records and modern evaluation systems as evidence, this article traces Chinese alcohol from early grain fermentation through Tang and Song taverns and Yuan-Ming distilled spirits to modern industry and the national famous-wine system, separating evidence, legend and later narrative.

zh.title: 酒馆史：从酒肆、客栈到酒吧
zh.summary: 酒馆的形态由城市、交通、税收与法规共同塑造。本文以宋代正店与脚店、欧洲 inn 与 tavern、美国 saloon 与禁酒令、英国 pub 为例，说明同一功能的空间为何在不同制度下长成不同样子，并给出观察一间酒馆的四个问题。

en.title: A history of taverns: from wine shops and inns to bars
en.summary: The form of a tavern is shaped by cities, transport, taxation and regulation. Comparing Chinese wine houses, European inns and taverns, 19th-century bars and American saloons, this article explains why the same function took different shapes, and how to read an old tavern.

zh.title: 酒器史：杯子如何改变喝法
zh.summary: 酒器不只装酒，它决定温度、香气、分量与动作。本文按陶器、青铜、漆器、金银器、瓷器、玻璃六个阶段梳理中国酒器，并用建盏、爵的用途、器名错位等反例，说明器型如何反过来塑造饮用方式与礼仪。

en.title: A history of drinking vessels: how the cup changed the drink
en.summary: A vessel does more than hold wine: it shapes temperature, aroma, measure and gesture. This article follows Chinese drinking vessels through pottery, bronze, lacquer, gold and silver, porcelain and glass, and shows how shapes in turn shaped drinking.

zh.title: 世界酒史纲：从发酵饮料到全球产业
zh.summary: 以考古证据、法规文本与产业史料为线索，梳理葡萄酒、啤酒与蒸馏酒的三条路径，以及 19 世纪工业化、20 世纪标准与全球化如何重塑今天的酒类世界；并列起源与分期的争议。

en.title: A concise history of world alcohol: from fermented drinks to a global industry
en.summary: Using archaeological evidence, legal texts and industry records as evidence, this article traces three paths — wine, beer and distilled spirits — and how nineteenth-century industrialisation and twentieth-century standards and globalisation reshaped today's drinks world, while setting disputed origins and periods side by side.

zh.title: 黄酒史：米、曲、水与绍兴
zh.summary: 黄酒是中国谷物发酵酒的主线，从贾湖陶器残留、北魏《齐民要术》的制曲，到绍兴酒行销与 1952 年名酒评选、GB/T 13662-2018，工艺连续而品类断裂。本文说明“黄酒”作为现代分类与古代酒名之间的差别。

en.title: A history of yellow wine: rice, qu, water and Shaoxing
en.summary: Yellow wine is the main line of Chinese grain-fermented wine. From early grain wine and Tang-Song wine policy to the spread of Shaoxing wine and modern standards, craft and local conditions shaped today’s categories. This article marks the key turns and distinguishes a modern category from ancient wine names.

zh.title: 啤酒花与苦度：IBU 能说明什么，不能说明什么
zh.summary: 啤酒花带来苦味、香气与保存性，IBU 是衡量异α-酸浓度的苦度单位。本文说明苦味如何产生、IBU 如何测量，以及为什么“IBU 越高越苦”并不可靠。

en.title: Hops and bitterness: what IBU can and cannot tell you
en.summary: Hops bring bitterness, aroma and keeping quality, and IBU is a measure of iso-alpha-acid concentration. This essay explains how bitterness arises, how IBU is measured, and why “higher IBU means more bitter” is unreliable.

zh.title: 一杯酒，为什么有地方的味道？
zh.summary: 产地通过气候、土壤、品种、微生物与工艺进入酒中；风土是理解产地的线索，不是质量保证。本文以葡萄酒、威士忌、白酒与黄酒为例，拆开“地方味道”的几层来源。

en.title: Why does a drink taste of a place?
en.summary: Place enters a drink through climate, soil, variety, microbes and craft; terroir is a clue to understanding origin, not a guarantee of quality. This article takes wine, whisky, baijiu and yellow wine to unpack the layers behind “a taste of place”.

zh.title: 禁酒令：禁令改变供给，不消灭需求
zh.summary: 以美国 1920 至 1933 年的全国禁酒为主线，兼及俄国、芬兰、冰岛与中国的酒禁经验，说明禁酒法令如何执行、出现哪些漏洞、产生什么后果，以及为什么“禁酒”很少等于“无酒”。

en.title: Prohibition: bans change supply, not demand
en.summary: Taking America’s national prohibition of 1920 to 1933 as the main case, with Russian, Finnish, Icelandic and Chinese experience alongside, this article explains enforcement, loopholes and consequences, and why prohibition rarely means no alcohol.

zh.title: 认识一座城，从一间酒馆开始
zh.summary: 酒馆是城市生活的切片：营业时间、常客、酒单与座位方式，共同透露街区由谁组成、何时热闹、如何待客。本文比较 pub、咖啡馆、bar 与 beer hall 四种空间，并给出观察与阅读历史的方法。

en.title: Reading a city through its bars
en.summary: A bar is a slice of city life: its opening hours, regulars, drinks list and seating together reveal who a neighbourhood is made of, when it comes alive and how it treats guests. This article compares the pub, the café, the bar and the beer hall, and suggests how to observe them and how to read their history.

zh.title: 清酒与烧酎：同为日本酒，工艺完全不同
zh.summary: 清酒是酿造酒，烧酎是蒸馏酒，二者常被中文语境混为一谈。本文从原料、发酵、蒸馏、分类与饮用方式说明它们的差别，并解释酒标上的常见术语。

en.title: Sake and shochu: both Japanese, but different crafts
en.summary: Sake is a brewed drink and shochu is a distilled one, yet Chinese-language readers often treat them as the same. This essay explains their raw materials, fermentation, distillation, categories and drinking styles, and decodes common label terms.

zh.title: 蒸馏技术传播：从炼金术到全球烈酒
zh.summary: 蒸馏不是某一个人或某一个国家的发明。本文按亚历山大里亚、阿拉伯炼金术、欧洲药用蒸馏、加勒比朗姆、东亚烧酒与 19 世纪柱式蒸馏的顺序，说明技术如何在翻译、贸易与殖民中扩散，以及为什么“起源地”问题难以定论。

en.title: The spread of distillation: from alchemy to global spirits
en.summary: Distillation was not invented by one person or one country. Following Alexandria, Arabic alchemy, European medicinal distillation, Caribbean rum, East Asian spirits and 19th-century column stills, this article shows how technique travelled through translation, trade and empire.

zh.title: 一杯酒里的时间
zh.summary: 从《诗经》的春酒到唐诗里的金樽，古人把节令、农事与相聚写进酒中。本文只谈文献能支持的线索，并区分文本、注本与今天的想象。

en.title: Time in a cup
en.summary: From the spring wine of the Book of Songs to the golden goblets of Tang poetry, the ancients wrote seasons, farm work and gatherings into their drinking. This article discusses only what the documents can support, separating text, edition and present-day imagination.

zh.title: 酒与节庆：节令酒里的时间表
zh.summary: 中国传统节令几乎都配一种酒：岁首的屠苏、端午的雄黄、中秋的桂花、重阳的菊花。本文按节令梳理这些酒的原料、文献来源与民俗含义，并说明哪些做法今天已不适合饮用。

en.title: Wine and festivals: the calendar inside seasonal drinks
en.summary: Almost every traditional Chinese festival has its own wine: tusu at New Year, realgar at Dragon Boat, osmanthus at Mid-Autumn, chrysanthemum at Double Ninth. This article traces their ingredients, documentary sources and meanings, and notes which practices are unsafe today.

zh.title: 酒与画：宴饮图像的四种看法
zh.summary: 酒在绘画里很少只是静物：它标出身份、时间与人与人的关系。本文以《清明上河图》《韩熙载夜宴图》、卡拉瓦乔《巴克斯》与荷兰风俗画为例，提出“器物—空间—关系—叙事”四层读法，同时说明图像证据的边界。

en.title: Wine and painting: four ways to look at a drinking scene
en.summary: In painting, wine is rarely just a still life: it marks status, time and human relations. Using Along the River During Qingming, The Night Revels of Han Xizai, Caravaggio’s Bacchus and a Dutch genre scene, this article shows what to look at in a drinking picture.

zh.title: 酒与诗：从《诗经》到宋词的饮酒书写
zh.summary: 酒在中国诗里既是宴饮道具，也是时间、友情与政治处境的标记。本文按先秦、魏晋、唐、宋四段梳理饮酒诗的变化，说明不同时代的酒器、酒令与写作动机，并给出把诗当史料时的边界。

en.title: Wine and poetry: drinking from the Book of Songs to Song lyrics
en.summary: In Chinese poetry, wine is both a banquet prop and a marker of time, friendship and political circumstance. This article follows the shift from pre-Qin ritual, through Wei-Jin self-expression, Tang gatherings and Song lyrics, and sets out the limits of reading poems as historical evidence.

zh.title: 酒与礼：从乡饮酒礼到今天的敬酒
zh.summary: 酒在中国礼制里承担次序与身份的功能。本文从《周礼》的酒官与五齐三酒、《仪礼》的乡饮酒礼、《礼记》的玄酒与《士昏礼》的合卺讲起，说明酒器、座次与敬酒如何把关系写成动作，并区分经典规范、后世实践与当代劝酒。

en.title: Wine and ritual: from village drinking rites to the modern toast
en.summary: In Chinese ritual, wine assigns order and status. Drawing on the Rites of Zhou, the Yili and the Liji, this article explains how wine officials, village drinking rites and sacrificial wine made relationships visible, and separates classical rules from later custom.

zh.title: 葡萄酒分级体系：地理标志、国家等级与酒庄分级
zh.summary: 酒标上的 AOC、AOP、IGP、DOCG 等缩写常被混为一谈。本文把“分级”拆成地理标志保护、国家质量等级与酒庄或地块分级三个层面，并说明它们能证明什么、不能证明什么。

en.title: Wine grading systems: geographical indications, national tiers and estate classifications
en.summary: Abbreviations such as AOC, AOP, IGP and DOCG on a wine label are often confused. This article separates “grading” into geographical indication protection, national quality tiers and estate or plot classification, and explains what each can and cannot prove.

zh.title: 寿酒
zh.summary: 寿酒是生日与整寿宴席上的敬老之酒，兼具祝福、答谢与家族聚会功能。本文说明做九不做十、寿堂与寿桃、千秋节与千叟宴等历史节点，并讨论高龄饮酒与劝酒的边界。

en.title: Birthday wine
en.summary: Birthday wine is the honouring drink at birthday and milestone banquets, combining blessing, thanks and family gathering. This entry covers timing, ritual sequence, documentary sources and modern change, with notes on urging drink and health.

zh.title: 寒食节与酒
zh.summary: 寒食在清明前一二日，以禁火冷食、祭墓踏青为核心；酒在其中多承担奠酒与家宴的角色，而非固定的节令配方。本文梳理时间地域、来源流变、酒器食物与当代实践，并说明冷食与饮酒的健康边界。

en.title: Cold Food Festival and wine
en.summary: The Cold Food Festival falls a day or two before Qingming and centres on a fire ban, cold food and tomb visits; wine plays the role of a libation and a family-meal drink rather than a fixed seasonal recipe. This entry covers timing, origins, vessels, food, modern practice and health limits.

zh.title: 重阳菊花酒
zh.summary: 重阳菊花酒是农历九月初九的节令酒，与登高、佩茱萸、赏菊、敬老连成一套动作。本文梳理文献所记的酿造与浸泡两系做法、地域差异、历史层累，并说明药效说法与自制风险的边界。

en.title: Double Ninth chrysanthemum wine
en.summary: Chrysanthemum wine at Double Ninth goes with climbing heights, wearing zhuyu and honouring elders. This entry covers the two documented methods, regional variation, the layered history, and the limits of health claims and home brewing.

zh.title: 端午雄黄酒
zh.summary: 端午饮雄黄酒、洒雄黄水、以雄黄画额，是汉族地区有文献记载的节令习俗。雄黄含砷，加热还会生成毒性更强的三氧化二砷；本文分开讲习俗来源、象征与安全边界，并给出今天可用的替代做法。

en.title: Dragon Boat realgar wine
en.summary: Drinking realgar wine, sprinkling realgar water and painting a character on children’s foreheads are documented Han festival customs. Realgar contains arsenic and heating produces an even more toxic compound; this entry separates origins and symbolism from the safety boundary and offers safer substitutes.

zh.title: 满月酒
zh.summary: 满月酒是婴儿出生满一个月时的宴请，兼具报喜、答谢、命名与社交功能。本文说明宋代“洗儿会”与近世满月宴的联系、各地流程差异、酒的角色，并提示哺乳期与婴儿安全边界。

en.title: Full-moon feast
en.summary: The full-moon feast marks a baby's first month with announcement, thanks, naming and social exchange. This entry links the Song “baby-washing gathering” to later banquets, compares regional customs, and sets out infant-safety and breastfeeding boundaries.

zh.title: 丰收酒与葡萄收获节酒俗
zh.summary: 丰收酒是秋收之后谢神、尝新与村宴上的酒；在欧洲葡萄产区，采收季又以葡萄收获节的形式延续。本文比较中国与欧洲两种“丰收饮酒”的时间、仪式、酒器与食物，并讨论旅游化与过量饮酒的边界。

en.title: Harvest wine and grape-harvest customs
en.summary: Harvest wine is the drink of thanksgiving, new-taste tasting and village meals after the autumn harvest; in European vineyard regions the same impulse continues as the grape harvest festival. This entry compares Chinese and European forms of harvest drinking, their timing, vessels, food and modern tourist packaging.

zh.title: 乔迁酒
zh.summary: 乔迁酒是新居落成或搬家之后请亲友到家中聚饮的习俗，北方常叫“温锅”“燎锅底”，南方多说“入伙”。它把安家的喜悦、邻里关系和人情往来放在一张桌子上，也带来劝酒、攀比与装修污染等现实问题。

en.title: Housewarming wine
en.summary: Housewarming wine is the meal and drink offered after a new home is finished or a family moves in; in the north it is often called “warming the pot” or “searing the pot bottom”, in the south “entering the household”. It confirms the joy of settling in, the neighbourhood relationship and social obligations, and raises real questions about pressure to drink, display and indoor pollution.

zh.title: 中秋赏月酒
zh.summary: 农历八月十五赏月、祭月与饮酒的组合习俗；酒既是供品与团圆饮品，也是文学意象与节前新酒上市的节点，文献记载与当代实践需分开看。

en.title: Mid-Autumn moon wine
en.summary: The combination of moon gazing, moon worship and drinking on the 15th day of the eighth lunar month; wine is at once an offering, a reunion drink, a literary image and a market event, and documentary records must be kept apart from present-day practice.

zh.title: 年节饮酒：椒柏酒与屠苏酒
zh.summary: 正月初一饮椒柏酒、屠苏酒，是至少可追溯到南北朝的岁时习俗；《荆楚岁时记》还记下“饮酒次第，从小起”的次序。酒在这里是驱疫、祝岁与家族礼序的组合，不只是节庆助兴。

en.title: New Year Drinking: Pepper-and-Cypress Wine and Tusu Wine
en.summary: Drinking pepper-and-cypress wine and tusu wine on the first day of the first lunar month is a seasonal custom recorded at least as early as the Southern Dynasties; the Jingchu Suishi Ji also notes that “the order of drinking begins with the youngest”. Wine here combines plague protection, New Year blessing and family order, not merely festive cheer.

zh.title: 祭酒
zh.summary: 祭酒是祭祀中献给祖先、神灵与先贤的酒，讲究洁净、器物与次序。本文比较家祭、墓祭与公祭的流程差异，解释三献、酹酒等动作，并讨论当代简化、环保与“祭酒”一词的常见误读。

en.title: Sacrificial wine
en.summary: Sacrificial wine is offered to ancestors, spirits and sages, with stress on purity, vessels and order. This entry compares household, grave and public sacrifices, explains the three offerings and libation, and discusses modern disputes and the double meaning of the term.

zh.title: 婚宴酒俗：从合卺到交杯酒
zh.summary: 合卺是先秦婚礼中的共饮仪式，《礼记·昏义》说“合卺而酳”，《仪礼·士昏礼》记“三酳用卺”。后世把它演成交杯酒，但古今仪式、器物与含义并不完全相同。

en.title: Wedding Wine Customs: From Hejin to the Cross-Cup Drink
en.summary: Hejin was a shared-drinking rite in the pre-Qin wedding ceremony. The Liji says “hejin er yin”, and the Yili records “the third ceremonial drink uses a jin”. Later practice developed into the cross-cup drink, but the ancient and modern rites, vessels and meanings are not identical.

zh.title: 中元节与酒
zh.summary: 中元节在农历七月十五，道教称中元、佛教称盂兰盆，民间以祭祖、烧纸、放河灯为核心；酒主要用于奠酒与家宴，是把思念变成动作的媒介。本文同时讨论地域差异、历史来源与当代争议。

en.title: Zhongyuan Festival and wine
en.summary: The Zhongyuan Festival on the fifteenth day of the seventh lunar month is observed as a Taoist festival and as the Buddhist Ullambana; its core is ancestor remembrance, paper offerings and river lanterns. Wine serves mainly as a libation and a family-meal drink, turning grief into a gesture.

zh.title: 修道院啤酒
zh.summary: 由修道院酿造或借用修道院名义与授权的啤酒统称；特拉普斯特啤酒必须在特拉普斯特修道院内、由修士监督酿造，修道院啤酒多为商业授权产品，dubbel、tripel、quadrupel 指强度层级而非独立风格。

en.title: Abbey beer
en.summary: An umbrella term for beers brewed by monasteries or brewed commercially under a monastery name and licence; Trappist beer must be brewed inside a Trappist monastery under monastic supervision, while abbey beer is mostly a licensed commercial product, and dubbel, tripel and quadrupel denote strength tiers rather than separate styles.

zh.title: 苦艾酒
zh.summary: 以苦艾、茴香与茴芹为核心、经浸提蒸馏而成的高酒精度烈酒；欧盟香料法规对侧柏酮设 35 mg/kg 与 10 mg/kg 两档上限，加水乳化是物理现象而非“致幻”证据。

en.title: Absinthe
en.summary: A high-strength spirit built on wormwood, fennel and anise and made by maceration and distillation; EU flavouring law sets 35 mg/kg and 10 mg/kg thujone ceilings, and the clouding on dilution is physics, not proof of hallucination.

zh.title: 马奶酒
zh.summary: 蒙古与中亚以马奶自然发酵的低酒精饮品，带酸味、乳香与轻微气泡；酒精度通常 1–3%，是游牧饮食与节庆的一部分。

en.title: Airag / Kumis
en.summary: A low-alcohol drink of Mongolia and Central Asia made by naturally fermenting mare’s milk, tart and milky with light bubbles; usually 1–3% alcohol, part of nomadic food and festivals.

zh.title: 阿尔特啤酒
zh.summary: 德国杜塞尔多夫的传统顶层发酵啤酒，铜棕色、酒花苦度中高、麦芽干净；发酵后低温熟成，风格介于艾尔与拉格之间。

en.title: Altbier
en.summary: A traditional top-fermented beer of Düsseldorf, copper-brown with medium-high hop bitterness and clean malt; cold-conditioned after fermentation, it sits between ale and lager.

zh.title: 阿玛雷托
zh.summary: 意大利杏仁风味甜利口酒，名字意为“微苦”；常用杏仁、杏核或桃核浸渍，带杏仁、香草、焦糖与花香，酒精度通常 20–28%。

en.title: Amaretto
en.summary: An Italian almond-flavoured sweet liqueur whose name means “slightly bitter”; often infused with almonds, apricot kernels or peach pits, with almond, vanilla, caramel and floral notes, usually 20–28% alcohol.

zh.title: 阿玛罗
zh.summary: 意大利草本苦味利口酒的总称，以酒精浸提或蒸馏草药、根茎、树皮和柑橘，再加糖浆调配；酒精度多在 11% 至 30% vol，苦甜交织，既是餐后消化酒，也是内格罗尼、曼哈顿变体与高球的重要配料。

en.title: Amaro
en.summary: The Italian family of herbal bitter liqueurs, made by macerating or distilling herbs, roots, bark and citrus and blending with syrup; usually 11% to 30% ABV, bittersweet, and used both as a digestif and as a mixing ingredient in Negroni, Manhattan variations and highballs.

zh.title: 开胃酒
zh.summary: 餐前饮用、以苦味或干型风味为主的一类酒饮；它是按场景划分的类别，而不是按原料划分的单一酒种。

en.title: Aperitif
en.summary: A pre-meal drinks category defined by occasion rather than raw material, usually built around bitterness, dryness or freshness.

zh.title: 阿夸维特
zh.summary: 北欧以葛缕子或莳萝调味的烈酒，清澈或经橡木桶陈为琥珀色；它是圣诞餐桌与 snaps 文化的一部分，而不是伏特加的一个香型。

en.title: Aquavit
en.summary: A Nordic spirit flavoured with caraway or dill, clear or amber from oak ageing; it belongs to the Christmas table and snaps culture rather than to the vodka family.

zh.title: 雅文邑
zh.summary: 法国加斯科涅地区的葡萄白兰地，1936 年获原产地命名控制；以连续式蒸馏为主，原酒约 52% 至 60% vol，香气奔放、酒体厚实，并保留单一年份装瓶传统，产区分为下雅文邑、泰纳雷泽与上雅文邑。

en.title: Armagnac
en.summary: A grape brandy from Gascony, protected since 1936, traditionally made in a continuous still that gives roughly 52% to 60% ABV spirit with a broad, weighty aroma; it is divided into Bas-Armagnac, Ténarèze and Haut-Armagnac and keeps a strong vintage tradition.

zh.title: 泡盛
zh.summary: 冲绳县以米与黑曲为原料、全量制曲并单式蒸馏得到的米制蒸馏酒；酒税法上属于单式蒸馏烧酒，常见 30% vol，贮藏三年以上按行业惯例称为古酒，可长期陈年。

en.title: Awamori
en.summary: An Okinawan rice spirit made from rice and black koji, with all the rice turned into koji and distilled once; legally a single-distilled shochu, usually bottled near 30% ABV and aged into kusu for three years or more.

zh.title: 巴卡诺拉
zh.summary: 墨西哥索诺拉州的龙舌兰蒸馏酒，以 Agave angustifolia Haw.（当地称 pacífica / yaquiana）为原料，传统土窑烘烤、壶式蒸馏；列入 1997 年欧盟—墨西哥烈酒相互承认协定，在欧盟受保护。

en.title: Bacanora
en.summary: An agave spirit from Sonora, Mexico, made from Agave angustifolia Haw. (locally pacífica / yaquiana), roasted in earthen pits and pot-distilled; listed in the 1997 EU–Mexico spirit agreement and protected in the EU.

zh.title: 白酒
zh.summary: 以粮谷为主要原料、使用曲或酒母糖化发酵、经蒸馏与陈酿勾调而成的中国传统蒸馏酒；香型是常见分类维度，但不是唯一维度。

en.title: Baijiu
en.summary: A traditional Chinese distilled spirit made mainly from grains, saccharified and fermented with qu or yeast cultures, then distilled, aged and blended; aroma family is a common lens, not the only one.

zh.title: 保健酒
zh.summary: 以蒸馏酒或黄酒为基酒、加入药食同源原料制成的配制酒；它是食品类别，不是药品，功能声称受严格限制。

en.title: Medicinal liquor
en.summary: A Chinese infused liquor made with a distilled or yellow-wine base and food-medicine ingredients; it is food, not medicine.

zh.title: 波罗的海波特
zh.summary: 波罗的海沿岸以拉格酵母酿造的深色高酒精度啤酒，带黑巧克力、焦糖、干果与甘草；与英式波特同源，但工艺更接近帝国世涛。

en.title: Baltic Porter
en.summary: A dark high-gravity beer brewed with lager yeast around the Baltic, with dark chocolate, caramel, dried fruit and liquorice; it shares porter ancestry but is closer to imperial stout in process.

zh.title: 大麦酒
zh.summary: 英国传统中的超浓艾尔，以高麦芽浓度、8%–12% 的酒精度、饱满酒体与瓶陈潜力为特征，分为英式与美式两条路线。

en.title: Barleywine
en.summary: A very strong British ale defined by high malt gravity, 8%–12% alcohol, a full body and bottle-ageing potential, split into English and American approaches.

zh.title: 啤酒
zh.summary: 以谷物糖化、发酵并通常加入啤酒花酿成的低到中等酒精度饮品，按发酵方式、原料和地域形成庞大风格谱系。

en.title: Beer
en.summary: A low-to-moderate-strength drink made by mashing and fermenting cereal, usually with hops, spanning a vast family of styles.

zh.title: 苦精
zh.summary: 以草药、根茎、树皮和柑橘浸提或蒸馏得到的高浓度苦味调味液，通常酒精度 35% 至 45% vol，按滴或几毫升使用；它既是 19 世纪药酒的遗产，也是古典鸡尾酒、曼哈顿和内格罗尼中不可替代的“盐和胡椒”。

en.title: Bitters
en.summary: A concentrated alcoholic flavouring made from bitter herbs, roots, bark and citrus, usually 35% to 45% ABV and used by the dash or a few millilitres; it carries the legacy of nineteenth-century medicine and is the salt-and-pepper seasoning of the Old Fashioned, Manhattan and Negroni.

zh.title: 调和苏格兰威士忌
zh.summary: 以一家或多家酒厂的单一麦芽原酒，与一家或多家酒厂的单一谷物原酒调配而成的苏格兰威士忌；它与调和麦芽、调和谷物共同构成三个不同的法定名称，靠谷物原酒提供骨架、麦芽原酒提供个性。

en.title: Blended Scotch Whisky
en.summary: A Scotch whisky made by combining single malt from one or more distilleries with single grain from one or more distilleries; it sits alongside blended malt and blended grain as three distinct legal names, with grain providing the frame and malt providing the character.

zh.title: 博克啤酒
zh.summary: 源自德国艾因贝克、在慕尼黑被改造为深色烈性拉格的麦芽主导风格，涵盖传统博克、双博克、迈博克与冰博克。

en.title: Bock
en.summary: A malt-driven strong lager from Einbeck that Munich brewers reshaped into a dark Bavarian specialty, spanning traditional bock, doppelbock, maibock and eisbock.

zh.title: 波本威士忌
zh.summary: 美国威士忌中以玉米为主料、在新烧焦橡木桶中熟成的类别；51% 玉米、蒸馏与入桶强度、straight 的陈年与标签规则共同构成它的法定边界。

en.title: Bourbon Whiskey
en.summary: An American whiskey category made mainly from corn and matured in new charred oak; a 51% corn minimum, distillation and barrel-entry limits, and the straight-ageing rules define its legal boundary.

zh.title: 波本威士忌
zh.summary: 从称谓与市场用法切入：bourbon whiskey 如何在同一类别上叠加拼写、地理标志与标签词汇，以及它与田纳西、黑麦、调和波本等相邻名称的边界。

en.title: Bourbon whiskey
en.summary: A page about the name and its market use: how bourbon whiskey layers spelling, geographical indications and label vocabulary on one category, and where it borders Tennessee, rye and blended bourbon.

zh.title: 啤酒蜂蜜酒
zh.summary: 蜂蜜与麦芽共同发酵的混合酒，介于蜂蜜酒与啤酒之间；酒花可加可不加，风格从淡色轻盈到深色高酒精度都有。

en.title: Braggot
en.summary: A hybrid fermented from honey and malt, between mead and beer; hops may or may not be used, with styles from pale and light to dark and strong.

zh.title: 白兰地
zh.summary: 以葡萄酒或其他水果酒蒸馏而成的烈酒；干邑、雅文邑、卡尔瓦多斯与果渣白兰地各有法定工艺与产区。

en.title: Brandy
en.summary: A spirit distilled from wine or other fruit wine, including Cognac, Armagnac, Calvados and grape-pomace brandies.

zh.title: 赫雷斯白兰地
zh.summary: 西班牙赫雷斯地区的白兰地，以葡萄酒蒸馏、在曾装雪莉酒的橡木桶中陈年，采用 solera 系统；带香草、干果、柑橘与雪莉桶风味。

en.title: Brandy de Jerez
en.summary: A brandy from Jerez, Spain, distilled from wine and aged in oak that held Sherry, using a solera system; vanilla, dried fruit, citrus and Sherry-cask notes.

zh.title: 卡莎萨
zh.summary: 巴西以甘蔗汁发酵蒸馏而成的烈酒，法定酒精度 38%–48% vol，与以糖蜜为主的朗姆酒是不同类别；按蒸馏器、陈年木材与酒液颜色分为白色、金色、陈年及 Premium 等等级。

en.title: Cachaça
en.summary: A Brazilian spirit distilled from fermented sugarcane juice at 38–48% ABV, legally distinct from molasses-based rum; its categories run from white and gold to barrel-aged, Premium and Extra Premium.

zh.title: 加州蒸汽啤酒
zh.summary: 美国加州以拉格酵母在较高温度发酵的琥珀色啤酒，带麦芽甜、木质与酒花苦味；Anchor Steam 是唯一沿用“Steam Beer”商业名称的代表。

en.title: California Common
en.summary: An amber beer from California fermented with lager yeast at warmer temperatures, with malt sweetness, woody notes and hop bitterness; Anchor Steam is the commercial benchmark for the “steam beer” name.

zh.title: 卡尔瓦多斯
zh.summary: 法国诺曼底以苹果酒和梨酒蒸馏而成的苹果白兰地，1942 年获原产地命名控制；帕伊多日使用壶式二次蒸馏，其他产区多用柱式蒸馏，橡木桶陈年至少 2 年，风格从青苹果、梨到烤苹果、香草与香料。

en.title: Calvados
en.summary: A Norman apple brandy distilled from cider and perry, protected by appellation since 1942; Pays d'Auge uses double pot distillation while other zones usually use a column, and at least two years in oak take the spirit from green apple to baked apple, vanilla and spice.

zh.title: 加拿大威士忌
zh.summary: 加拿大威士忌以谷物（常用玉米、黑麦、小麦）分别蒸馏、再调和；风格轻柔、带焦糖、香草与黑麦香料，法规允许加入焦糖与调味酒液；“9.09% 规则”用于年龄声明与出口证书，不是普通成分上限。

en.title: Canadian Whisky
en.summary: Canadian whisky distils grains separately—often corn, rye and wheat—then blends them; the style is soft with caramel, vanilla and rye spice, and caramel and flavouring are permitted, with the 9.09% figure used for age claims and export certificates rather than as a compositional cap.

zh.title: 豉香型白酒
zh.summary: 广东珠江三角洲一带以大米、小曲半固态发酵并经肥肉酝浸的白酒香型，风格清甜而带独特脂香；现行质量要求为 GB/T 10781.5-2021。

en.title: Chi aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma style from the Pearl River Delta, made from rice with xiaoqu semi-solid fermentation and fat immersion, giving a clean sweet profile with a distinct fatty note; GB/T 10781.5-2021 applies.

zh.title: 苹果酒
zh.summary: 以苹果汁发酵而成的酒精饮料；苹果的单宁与酸度决定骨架，野生酵母、苹果酸-乳酸发酵与是否保留残糖决定风格，英国税制把 1.2% 至 8.5% vol 的苹果酒单列。

en.title: Cider
en.summary: A fermented apple-juice drink; apple tannin and acidity build the frame, wild yeast, malolactic fermentation and residual sugar decide the style, and UK duty treats cider from 1.2% to 8.5% vol as its own class.

zh.title: 干邑
zh.summary: 法国干邑产区以葡萄蒸馏而成的白兰地，1936 年获原产地命名控制；以白玉霓为主，经夏朗德壶式二次蒸馏与法国橡木桶陈年，VS、VSOP、XO、XXO 各有法定最低酒龄。

en.title: Cognac
en.summary: A grape brandy from the Cognac region of France, protected by appellation rules since 1936: Ugni Blanc dominates, the Charentais pot still distils twice, and VS, VSOP, XO and XXO carry legal minimum ages.

zh.title: 配制酒
zh.summary: 以发酵酒、蒸馏酒或食用酒精为酒基，加入可食用原辅料或食品添加剂，经调配、混合或再加工制成的饮料酒；露酒是其中的重要分支，分类不是质量等级。

en.title: Compounded liquor
en.summary: A beverage made by blending, mixing or reprocessing a base of fermented wine, distilled spirit or food-grade alcohol with edible materials or additives; lujiu is a major branch, and the category is not a quality grade.

zh.title: 玉米威士忌
zh.summary: 美国以玉米为主要原料的威士忌，法规要求至少 80% 玉米；可未经陈年或仅短暂陈年，风味带玉米甜、谷物与轻微辛辣。

en.title: Corn Whiskey
en.summary: American whiskey made mainly from corn, legally at least 80% corn; it may be unaged or only briefly aged, with corn sweetness, grain and light spice.

zh.title: 奶油艾尔
zh.summary: 美国淡色艾尔，常加玉米或大米降低麦芽厚度，口感清爽、泡沫细、苦度低；名字里的“奶油”指质地，不是奶油味。

en.title: Cream Ale
en.summary: A pale American ale, often with corn or rice to lighten the malt body, crisp with fine foam and low bitterness; “cream” refers to texture, not cream flavour.

zh.title: 黑加仑利口酒
zh.summary: 以黑加仑果实在中性烈酒中浸提、加糖制成的深紫色利口酒；第戎是它的历史中心，高糖高酸的结构让它成为 Kir 与 Kir Royale 的灵魂。

en.title: Crème de Cassis
en.summary: A deep purple blackcurrant liqueur made by macerating fruit in neutral spirit and sweetening it; Dijon is its historic centre, and its high sugar and high acid make it the soul of Kir and Kir Royale.

zh.title: 苹果蜂蜜酒
zh.summary: 蜂蜜与苹果汁共同发酵的蜂蜜酒类型，介于苹果酒与蜂蜜酒之间；带苹果、蜂蜜、香料与酸度，风格从干型到甜型。

en.title: Cyser
en.summary: A mead fermented from honey and apple juice, between cider and mead; apple, honey, spice and acidity, with styles from dry to sweet.

zh.title: 大吟酿
zh.summary: 日本清酒中精米步合不超过 50%、采用吟酿造的特定名称类别；可添加不超过白米重量 10% 的酿造酒精，不添加时称纯米大吟酿。高精米带来更集中的酯香，也带来更高的碎米率与成本。

en.title: Daiginjo sake
en.summary: A named sake category with a polishing ratio of 50% or less and ginjo fermentation; brewing alcohol may be added within the legal cap, and the no-alcohol version is junmai daiginjo. High polishing concentrates aroma but raises broken-grain losses and cost.

zh.title: 甜酒
zh.summary: 以残糖而非单一法规界定的葡萄酒大类，涵盖贵腐、晚收、风干、冰酒与加强甜酒；糖的来源、酸的支撑与侍酒温度共同决定它是否平衡。

en.title: Dessert Wine
en.summary: A broad family of wines defined by residual sugar rather than a single regulation, covering botrytised, late-harvest, dried-grape, ice and fortified sweet styles; the source of the sugar, the supporting acidity and the serving temperature decide whether the result is balanced.

zh.title: 董香型白酒
zh.summary: 又称药香型，以贵州董酒为代表；大小曲并用、制曲加入多种草本原料、采用双醅串蒸，贵州省地方标准 DB52/T 550-2013 对其作出规定。

en.title: Dong aroma baijiu
en.summary: Also called medicinal aroma, represented by Dongjiu in Guizhou; it combines large and small qu, adds herbs to qu making and co-distils an aromatic mash with the grain mash, with local standard DB52/T 550-2013.

zh.title: 英式艾尔
zh.summary: 英国传统上层发酵啤酒的统称，涵盖苦啤、淡色艾尔、英式 IPA、波特与世涛；强调麦芽与酒花的平衡、较低的碳酸化，以及桶装真艾尔的侍酒传统。

en.title: English ale
en.summary: An umbrella term for traditional British top-fermented beers, covering bitter, pale ale, English IPA, porter and stout, with an emphasis on malt-hop balance, lower carbonation and cask real ale serving.

zh.title: 凤香型白酒
zh.summary: 以高粱、大麦、豌豆、小麦为原料，用大曲，经黄土泥窖混蒸混烧、固态发酵、固态蒸馏、酒海陈贮与勾调而成；现行标准为 GB/T 10781.6-2025，酒精度 25.0%–68.0% vol。

en.title: Feng-aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma type made from sorghum, barley, peas and wheat with daqu, through mixed steaming and distillation in loess mud pits, solid-state fermentation, solid-state distillation, jiuhai storage and blending; the current standard is GB/T 10781.6-2025, with 25.0%–68.0% ABV.

zh.title: 加强葡萄酒
zh.summary: 在发酵过程中或之后加入葡萄蒸馏酒、提高酒精度并稳定风味的葡萄酒；波特、雪莉、马德拉与味美思各有不同的工艺与法规。

en.title: Fortified wine
en.summary: Wine to which grape spirit is added during or after fermentation, raising strength and stabilising flavour; Port, Sherry, Madeira and Vermouth each have their own processes and rules.

zh.title: 果啤
zh.summary: 以水果或果汁参与发酵、浸泡或调味的啤酒大类；从比利时水果兰比克到德国果味小麦啤、英美果味艾尔，风格跨度极大。

en.title: Fruit Beer
