en.summary: An umbrella for beers fermented, infused or flavoured with fruit; from Belgian fruit lambic to German fruit wheat beer and Anglo-American fruit ales, the range is enormous.

zh.title: 水果白兰地/生命之水
zh.summary: 以水果发酵后蒸馏的透明烈酒，统称 eau-de-vie；从梨、樱桃、李子到覆盆子都有，强调新鲜果香而非木桶陈年。

en.title: Fruit Brandy / Eau-de-vie
en.summary: Clear spirits distilled from fermented fruit, generally called eau-de-vie; made from pear, cherry, plum, raspberry and more, stressing fresh fruit rather than oak ageing.

zh.title: 果酒
zh.summary: 以水果汁或水果浸提液发酵而成的低到中等酒精度饮品；与水果利口酒、水果白兰地属于不同类别。

en.title: Fruit wine
en.summary: A low-to-moderate-strength drink made by fermenting fruit juice, distinct from fruit liqueur and fruit brandy.

zh.title: 馥郁香型白酒
zh.summary: 以粮谷为原料，小曲与大曲并用，经泥窖固态发酵、清蒸混入、陈酿与勾调而成，具有“前浓、中清、后酱”的复合风格；现行标准为 GB/T 10781.11-2021，酒精度 25.0%–68.0% vol。

en.title: Fu-aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma type made from grain with both xiaoqu and daqu, through mud-pit solid-state fermentation, clean steaming and mixing, ageing and blending, with a composite 'strong aroma first, light aroma mid-palate, sauce aroma last' profile; the current standard is GB/T 10781.11-2021, with 25.0%–68.0% ABV.

zh.title: 荷兰杜松子酒
zh.summary: 荷兰、比利时与法国北部边境地区以谷物麦芽酒加杜松子制成的烈酒，2008 年获欧盟地理标志保护；oude 与 jonge 指配方风格而非年份，酒体带麦芽面包感，与干型英式金酒形成鲜明对照。

en.title: Genever
en.summary: A grain spirit flavoured with juniper from the Netherlands, Belgium and the northern French border, protected as an EU geographical indication in 2008; oude and jonge describe recipe styles rather than age, and its malt-wine body contrasts sharply with dry English gin.

zh.title: 金酒
zh.summary: 以杜松子为核心风味的蒸馏烈酒，按蒸馏方式和添加物分为伦敦干金、蒸馏金酒与复合金酒等类别。

en.title: Gin
en.summary: A distilled spirit led by juniper, divided by production method and additives into London dry, distilled and compound gin.

zh.title: 吟酿
zh.summary: 日本清酒的特定名称类别，要求精米步合不超过 60%、采用低温长期发酵的吟酿造，可添加不超过白米重量 10% 的酿造酒精；香气以苹果、香蕉、梨般的酯类为主，与纯米吟酿同属一条工艺路线。

en.title: Ginjo sake
en.summary: A named sake category requiring a polishing ratio of 60% or less and cool, long ginjo fermentation, with brewing alcohol capped at 10% of the polished rice weight; apple, banana and pear esters define the aroma.

zh.title: 格拉帕
zh.summary: 意大利以葡萄果渣蒸馏而成的果渣白兰地，名称受欧盟地理标志保护，原料必须来自意大利种植并酿造的葡萄、在意大利蒸馏；最低酒精度 37.5% vol，年轻酒清冽带葡萄皮与花香，木桶陈年 12 个月以上则转向香草与香料。

en.title: Grappa
en.summary: An Italian pomace brandy whose name is protected as an EU geographical indication; the grapes must be grown and vinified in Italy and the spirit distilled there, with a 37.5% ABV minimum, a clear young style and a wood-aged style after at least 12 months.

zh.title: 贵兹
zh.summary: 以不同年份的兰比克混酿、在瓶中完成二次发酵的布鲁塞尔传统啤酒；年轻酒提供糖与活力，老年酒提供酸度与复杂度，口感干爽、气泡细密，带有谷仓、柑橘与青苹果气息。

en.title: Gueuze
en.summary: A traditional Brussels beer made by blending lambic of different ages and refermenting it in the bottle; young beer supplies sugar and vigour, old beer supplies acidity and complexity, and the result is dry, finely sparkling and marked by barnyard, citrus and green-apple notes.

zh.title: 青稞酒
zh.summary: 青藏高原以青稞为原料的发酵酒与蒸馏酒统称；藏族日常的 chang 低度浑浊，青海互助的蒸馏青稞酒则有地理标志与“清蒸清烧四次清”工艺。

en.title: Highland Barley Wine
en.summary: The Tibetan Plateau's family of drinks made from highland barley; everyday chang is a cloudy low-alcohol ferment, while the distilled qingke liquor of Huzhu in Qinghai has a geographical indication and a "four-times-clear" technique.

zh.title: 蜂蜜酒
zh.summary: 以蜂蜜与水为糖源、经酵母发酵而成的酒精饮料；蜂蜜缺氮、酸度与糖浓度高，发酵管理因此不同于葡萄酒，酒精度可从约 3% 到 18% 以上，甜度由残糖决定。

en.title: Honey Wine
en.summary: An alcoholic drink fermented from honey and water; honey is nitrogen-poor, acidic and very concentrated in sugar, so fermentation differs from wine, with alcohol from about 3% to over 18% and sweetness set by residual sugar.

zh.title: 本酿造
zh.summary: 日本清酒的特定名称类别之一，精米步合上限 70%、麹米使用比例不低于 15%，并允许添加不超过白米重量 10% 的酿造酒精；口感通常比纯米酒更清爽利落，但本酿造不是质量等级。

en.title: Honjozo sake
en.summary: A tokutei meisho sake category with a polishing cap of 70%, a koji-rice share of at least 15%, and permission to add no more than 10% brewing alcohol by weight of white rice; usually cleaner and crisper than junmai, but honjozo is not a quality grade.

zh.title: 冰苹果酒
zh.summary: 加拿大魁北克起源的甜型苹果酒，用自然冷冻或冷冻浓缩的苹果汁发酵，酒精度与甜度都高；带苹果、焦糖、蜂蜜与酸度。

en.title: Ice Cider
en.summary: A sweet cider originating in Quebec, Canada, fermented from naturally frozen or cryo-concentrated apple juice; high in alcohol and sugar, with apple, caramel, honey and acidity.

zh.title: 冰酒
zh.summary: 让葡萄在藤上自然结冰、在冻结状态下压榨的甜酒；德国 Eiswein 与加拿大 Icewine 的采收温度规则不同，Riesling 与 Vidal 是常见品种，产量极低而糖酸高度浓缩。

en.title: Ice Wine
en.summary: A sweet wine made from grapes that freeze naturally on the vine and are pressed while frozen; German Eiswein and Canadian Icewine apply different harvest-temperature rules, Riesling and Vidal are common varieties, and yields are tiny while sugar and acidity are highly concentrated.

zh.title: 帝国世涛
zh.summary: 世涛家族中麦芽浓度与酒精度最高的一支，源于 18 世纪英国向俄国出口的高酒精度、重酒花黑啤；以深度烘焙谷物、厚实酒体、酒精温暖和长期陈年潜力为边界，现代又分化出桶陈版本。

en.title: Imperial Stout
en.summary: The strongest branch of the stout family, descended from the high-alcohol, heavily hopped black beer that Britain exported to Russia in the 18th century; its boundaries are deep roasted grain, a full body, alcohol warmth and long ageing potential, with modern barrel-aged variants.

zh.title: 印度淡色艾尔
zh.summary: 以酒花香气与苦味为突出特征的上面发酵啤酒，源于英国向印度出口的贸易背景，现代已分化出英式、美式与浑浊等分支，苦度是可调参数而非质量等级。

en.title: India pale ale
en.summary: A top-fermented beer family defined by prominent hop aroma and bitterness, rooted in British export trade to India and now split into English, American and hazy branches, where bitterness is a variable rather than a grade.

zh.title: 爱尔兰威士忌
zh.summary: 在爱尔兰岛以谷物为原料、经发酵蒸馏并在木桶中陈年至少三年的威士忌；受欧盟地理标志保护，分为单一麦芽、单一壶式、单一谷物与调和四类，拼写用 whiskey。

en.title: Irish whiskey
en.summary: Whiskey distilled and matured on the island of Ireland from cereal grains, aged at least three years in wooden casks and bottled at no less than 40% ABV; it is a protected EU geographical indication with four main categories.

zh.title: 日本威士忌
zh.summary: 在日本完成糖化、发酵、蒸馏、陈年与装瓶的威士忌；2021 年起日本洋酒酒造组合以自主标识规则界定“日本威士忌”，要求原料、三年木桶陈年与 40% vol 装瓶等条件。

en.title: Japanese whisky
en.summary: Whisky mashed, fermented, distilled, matured and bottled in Japan; since 2021 an industry labelling standard has defined the name through raw materials, three years in wood and a 40% ABV bottling minimum.

zh.title: 纯米酒
zh.summary: 只用米、米曲和水酿成、不添加酿造酒精的清酒类别；纯米吟酿与纯米大吟酿还分别受 60% 与 50% 精米步合上限约束。

en.title: Junmai sake
en.summary: A sake category made only from rice, rice koji and water, with no added brewing alcohol. Junmai ginjo and junmai daiginjo also carry 60% and 50% polishing caps.

zh.title: 科隆啤酒
zh.summary: 德国科隆的淡色上层发酵啤酒，经低温贮酒与过滤，以干净果香、柔和苦味和 0.2 升 Stange 杯侍酒为标志，名称受地理标志保护。

en.title: Kölsch
en.summary: Cologne's pale top-fermented beer, cold-conditioned and filtered, marked by clean fruit, soft bitterness and service in 0.2-litre Stangen, with a geographically protected name.

zh.title: 拉格啤酒
zh.summary: 以低温下层发酵酵母酿成、并在接近冰点的温度下长时间贮酒的一类啤酒的统称；淡色拉格、深色拉格与皮尔森都是其分支，拉格是工艺家族，皮尔森是具体风格。

en.title: Lager
en.summary: An umbrella term for beers made with cool bottom-fermenting yeast and then stored near freezing; pale lager, dark lager and Pilsner all belong to it, and lager is a process family while Pilsner is a specific style.

zh.title: 兰比克
zh.summary: 比利时帕约滕兰与森讷河谷一带依靠野生酵母和细菌自发发酵的传统啤酒；使用浑浊糖化、陈年酒花与橡木桶长期陈放，常以新老酒液混合装瓶成 gueuze，并有樱桃、覆盆子等水果版本。

en.title: Lambic
en.summary: A traditional beer of Belgium's Pajottenland and Senne valley, fermented spontaneously by wild yeast and bacteria; it uses a turbid mash, aged hops and long oak ageing, and is often blended from young and old lambic into gueuze, with cherry and raspberry fruit versions.

zh.title: 老白干香型白酒
zh.summary: 以河北衡水一带为代表的白酒香型；GB/T 10781.10-2024《白酒质量要求 第10部分：老白干香型白酒》自 2025-12-01 实施并全部代替 GB/T 20825-2007，地缸发酵与清蒸清烧是其常见工艺表述。

en.title: Laobaigan-aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma style centred on Hengshui in Hebei; GB/T 10781.10-2024, in force from 2025-12-01, fully replaces GB/T 20825-2007, and ground-jar fermentation with separate steaming of grain and mash is the usual process description.

zh.title: 清香型白酒
zh.summary: 以乙酸乙酯为主体香的白酒香型，采用清蒸清烧与地缸发酵，风格清爽干净；现行质量要求为 GB/T 10781.2-2022，香型不是质量等级。

en.title: Light aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma style led by ethyl acetate, made with separate steaming and earthen-jar fermentation for a clean, crisp profile; GB/T 10781.2-2022 applies, and aroma style is not a quality grade.

zh.title: 柠檬酒
zh.summary: 意大利南部以柠檬皮浸入中性烈酒、再加糖浆制成的亮黄色利口酒；它依靠果皮精油而非果汁取香，冰镇后是典型的餐后酒。

en.title: Limoncello
en.summary: A bright yellow southern Italian liqueur made by steeping lemon peel in neutral spirit and blending it with sugar syrup; it takes its aroma from peel oil rather than juice and is classically served ice-cold after dinner.

zh.title: 利口酒
zh.summary: 以烈酒为基底、加入糖和风味原料制成的甜味酒；按风味可分为水果、草本、坚果、奶油和咖啡等家族。

en.title: Liqueur
en.summary: A sweetened spirit flavoured with fruit, herbs, nuts, cream or coffee; bitters are a separate, less sweet category.

zh.title: 伦敦干金
zh.summary: 金酒最具代表性的干型风格，风味必须来自重新蒸馏，杜松子主导、糖分与着色受限；名称是工艺类别，不是产地证明。

en.title: London dry gin
en.summary: The most representative dry gin style, with flavour required to come from redistribution, juniper dominant and sugar and colouring restricted; the name is a process category, not proof of origin.

zh.title: 无醇/低醇啤酒
zh.summary: 酒精度被限制或去除的啤酒大类；可通过中断发酵、真空蒸馏、反渗透或稀释实现，法规阈值因国家而异，风味常带谷物、麦芽与轻微甜感。

en.title: Low-alcohol / Non-alcoholic Beer
en.summary: An umbrella for beers with limited or removed alcohol, made by halted fermentation, vacuum distillation, reverse osmosis or dilution; legal thresholds vary by country, and flavours often show grain, malt and light sweetness.

zh.title: 露酒
zh.summary: 以蒸馏酒、发酵酒或食用酒精为酒基，加入可食用或药食两用辅料，经调配或再加工制成的饮料酒；GB/T 27588-2011 对其作出规定，露酒不是药酒。

en.title: Lujiu
en.summary: A Chinese beverage made from a base of distilled spirit, fermented wine or food-grade alcohol with edible or medicinal-and-food materials, blended or reprocessed; GB/T 27588-2011 applies, and lujiu is not a medicinal liquor.

zh.title: 马德拉
zh.summary: 葡萄牙马德拉岛的加强葡萄酒，以加热陈酿（estufagem）或自然阁楼陈酿（canteiro）塑造独特的氧化风味；从 Sercial 的极干到 Malmsey 的浓郁，酸度贯穿始终。

en.title: Madeira
en.summary: A fortified wine from the Portuguese island of Madeira, shaped by heat through estufagem or by slow cask ageing in warm attics known as canteiro; styles run from dry Sercial to rich Malmsey, with acidity as the constant.

zh.title: 马克酒
zh.summary: 法国对葡萄果渣蒸馏酒的称呼，勃艮第与香槟最著名；与意大利 grappa 同类，但法规、原料与陈年习惯不同，风格更质朴。

en.title: Marc
en.summary: The French name for pomace brandy, most famous in Burgundy and Champagne; it is the same family as Italian grappa but differs in rules, material and ageing, with a rustic style.

zh.title: 马沙拉
zh.summary: 意大利西西里马沙拉地区的加强葡萄酒，以白葡萄为基酒，加入酒精或熟酒、经氧化陈年；从干型到甜型、从琥珀到宝石红都有。

en.title: Marsala
en.summary: A fortified wine from Marsala in Sicily, based on white grapes, fortified with alcohol or cooked wine and aged oxidatively; it ranges from dry to sweet and amber to ruby.

zh.title: 果蜜酒
zh.summary: 蜂蜜酒中加入水果或果汁的类型，统称 melomel；水果可提供酸度、香气与颜色，风格从干型到甜型、从轻酒体到高酒精度都有。

en.title: Melomel
en.summary: Mead made with fruit or fruit juice, generally called melomel; fruit adds acidity, aroma and colour, with styles from dry to sweet and light to high-alcohol.

zh.title: 梅斯卡尔
zh.summary: 墨西哥以龙舌兰为原料、经地下坑烤与壶式蒸馏得到的烈酒；法定产区、龙舌兰品种与蒸馏设备共同决定风格，35% 至 55% 的酒精度区间与陈年等级由 NOM-070-SCFI-2016 规定。

en.title: Mezcal
en.summary: A Mexican agave spirit made by pit roasting and pot distillation; protected regions, agave variety and still type shape the style, while NOM-070-SCFI-2016 sets a 35% to 55% alcohol range and the ageing classes.

zh.title: 兼香型白酒
zh.summary: 兼具浓香与酱香特征的白酒香型，以白云边、口子窖等为代表；现行标准为 GB/T 23547-2009《浓酱兼香型白酒》，香型不是质量等级。

en.title: Mixed aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma style that combines strong aroma and sauce aroma characters, represented by Baiyunbian and Kouzijiao; GB/T 23547-2009 applies, and aroma style is not a quality grade.

zh.title: 海军朗姆
zh.summary: 英国皇家海军历史配给朗姆的统称，通常为高酒精度、深色、厚重且带焦糖与香料；现代品牌多为多产地调和。

en.title: Navy Rum
en.summary: A name for the rum ration of the British Royal Navy, usually high-proof, dark, heavy with caramel and spice; modern brands are mostly multi-origin blends.

zh.title: 浊酒
zh.summary: 日本清酒中的“粗滤”类型，保留米曲与酒糟，酒液浑浊、带甜味与乳脂感；需冷藏、饮用前摇匀，开瓶后尽快喝完。

en.title: Nigori Sake
en.summary: The coarsely filtered style of Japanese sake, retaining rice solids and lees, cloudy with sweetness and a creamy texture; keep it cold, shake before drinking and finish soon after opening.

zh.title: 老式艾尔/棕色艾尔
zh.summary: 英国传统深色艾尔的两个相邻类型：老式艾尔麦芽厚、带干果与氧化味，常陈年；棕色艾尔更轻、带坚果与焦糖，是日常艾尔。

en.title: Old Ale / Brown Ale
en.summary: Two adjacent British dark ales: old ale is malty with dried fruit and oxidative notes and is often aged; brown ale is lighter with nuts and caramel and is an everyday ale.

zh.title: 老汤姆金酒
zh.summary: 18 至 19 世纪英格兰流行的甜型金酒风格，蒸馏后再加糖或甘草等甜味植物，酒体比伦敦干金更圆润；它不是法定类别，现代复刻通常酒精度在 40% 至 45% vol，是汤姆柯林斯与古典鸡尾酒的历史基酒。

en.title: Old Tom Gin
en.summary: A sweetened gin style popular in eighteenth- and nineteenth-century England, made by adding sugar or sweet botanicals such as liquorice after distillation; it is not a legal category, and modern revivals usually sit at 40% to 45% ABV as the historical base for Tom Collins and Old Fashioned variations.

zh.title: 乌佐
zh.summary: 希腊的茴香烈酒，以茴香籽、蒸馏与加水后变白的浑浊为特征；欧盟以地理标志保护其名称，最低酒精度为 37.5% vol。

en.title: Ouzo
en.summary: Greece's anise spirit, defined by aniseed, distillation and the milky cloud that appears when water is added; the EU protects the name as a geographical indication, with a minimum strength of 37.5% ABV.

zh.title: 高度朗姆
zh.summary: 酒精度显著高于常规朗姆的类别，常见 57.15% ABV 或 75.5% ABV（151 US proof）；风味强烈、易燃，多用于调酒与烹饪。

en.title: Overproof Rum
en.summary: Rum with alcohol well above the standard category, often 57.15% ABV (151 US proof) or higher; intense, flammable and mostly used in mixing and cooking.

zh.title: 淡色艾尔
zh.summary: 以浅色麦芽为主体、上面发酵、酒花表达清晰的啤酒家族；英式版本偏麦芽与花香，美式版本以柑橘松脂型酒花为标志，与苦啤、IPA 构成连续谱而非三个孤立的盒子。

en.title: Pale Ale
en.summary: A family of pale-malt, top-fermented beers with clearly readable hop aroma; English versions lean on malt and floral hops, American versions on citrus and resinous hops, forming a continuum with bitter and IPA rather than three isolated boxes.

zh.title: 梨酒
zh.summary: 以梨汁发酵而成的低度酒，英国三郡的 perry 以高单宁梨品种与苦甜结构著称；它和加了梨味的苹果酒不是一回事。

en.title: Perry
en.summary: A low-alcohol drink fermented from pear juice; English perry from the Three Counties is known for high-tannin pear varieties and a bittersweet structure, and it is not the same as apple cider with pear flavouring.

zh.title: 皮尔森啤酒
zh.summary: 起源于捷克比尔森的淡色拉格，以极软水质、萨兹酒花、浅色麦芽与低温下层发酵为特征，是理解现代淡色拉格的关键风格。

en.title: Pilsner
en.summary: A pale lager born in Plzeň, Czechia, defined by very soft water, Saaz hops, pale malt and cool bottom fermentation, and central to understanding modern pale lagers.

zh.title: 皮斯科
zh.summary: 以新鲜葡萄汁发酵后直接蒸馏而成的葡萄烈酒，秘鲁与智利各有法定产区与工艺规范；秘鲁强调单次蒸馏、不加水、不加糖、不用橡木桶，智利允许橡木桶陈年并设有不同酒精度等级。

en.title: Pisco
en.summary: A grape spirit distilled from freshly fermented juice in Peru and Chile, with separate protected appellations and production rules: Peru requires a single distillation, no added water, sugar or oak, while Chile permits oak maturation and sets strength tiers.

zh.title: 普利茅斯金酒
zh.summary: 以英国普利茅斯为地理标识的金酒风格，生产限于普利茅斯的 Black Friars 酒厂；风格比伦敦干金更柔和、更泥土感，标准瓶酒精度 41.2% vol，海军强度版本为 57% vol，是 Pink Gin 与经典干马天尼的历史基酒之一。

en.title: Plymouth Gin
en.summary: A gin style identified with the English city of Plymouth and produced at the Black Friars distillery; softer and earthier than London Dry, the standard bottle is 41.2% ABV and Navy Strength is 57% ABV, and it is a historical base for Pink Gin and the dry Martini.

zh.title: 波特
zh.summary: 葡萄牙杜罗河谷出产、在发酵中途加入葡萄蒸馏酒的甜型加强酒，酒精度约 19%–20% vol，残糖与单宁共同支撑其陈年潜力；按陈年方式分为宝石红、茶色、年份、LBV、Colheita 与 Crusted 等类别。

en.title: Port
en.summary: A sweet fortified wine from Portugal's Douro Valley, made by adding grape spirit mid-fermentation and bottled at about 19%–20% ABV, with styles ranging from Ruby and Tawny to Vintage, LBV, Colheita and Crusted.

zh.title: 波特啤酒
zh.summary: 18 世纪伦敦兴起的深色上面发酵啤酒，以棕色麦芽与后来的烘焙麦芽带来烘烤、咖啡与可可风味；名称源于搬运工，与世涛有渊源但强度与配方不同，现代分化出烈性波特与波罗的海波特。

en.title: Porter
en.summary: A dark top-fermented beer that arose in 18th-century London, given roast, coffee and cocoa flavours by brown malt and later roasted malt; named after market porters and related to stout, though not the same, with modern robust and Baltic porter branches.

zh.title: 普尔克
zh.summary: 墨西哥中部以龙舌兰汁（aguamiel）自然发酵得到的低度酒，酒精度通常 4% 至 6% vol；不蒸馏、不陈年，口感酸、黏、带酵母与植物气息，在 pulquería 里以白色原味或水果调味的 curado 形式饮用。

en.title: Pulque
en.summary: A low-alcohol drink from central Mexico made by fermenting agave sap (aguamiel), usually 4% to 6% ABV; it is neither distilled nor aged, tastes sour, viscous and yeasty, and is served in pulquerías as white pulque or fruit-flavoured curado.

zh.title: 莱希亚
zh.summary: 墨西哥哈利斯科州沿海与山区的传统龙舌兰蒸馏酒，原料与工艺因村落而异；带烟熏、草本、柑橘与矿物，2019 年获墨西哥原产地保护，2020 年列入欧盟—墨西哥烈酒互认清单。

en.title: Raicilla
en.summary: A traditional agave spirit from coastal and mountain Jalisco, Mexico, with materials and methods varying by village; smoky, herbal, citrus and mineral, protected by Mexican appellation of origin since 2019 and listed in the EU–Mexico spirit-drinks agreement since 2020.

zh.title: 烟熏啤酒
zh.summary: 以榉木明火烘烤的烟熏麦芽为核心风味的德国啤酒，班贝格是其保存最完整的产地，烟熏强度从轻柔到浓烈形成光谱。

en.title: Rauchbier
en.summary: A German beer built on beechwood-smoked malt, best preserved in Bamberg, with smoke intensity running from delicate to intense across a spectrum rather than a fixed recipe.

zh.title: 红葡萄酒
zh.summary: 以深色葡萄带皮发酵、从果皮提取颜色与单宁的葡萄酒；颜色、单宁、酸度与酒精度共同决定风格，而不是年份或产区标签单独决定。

en.title: Red wine
en.summary: Wine made by fermenting dark-skinned grapes with their skins to extract colour and tannin; colour, tannin, acidity and alcohol together shape the style, not a vintage or regional label alone.

zh.title: 农业朗姆
zh.summary: 法属马提尼克、瓜德罗普等地以新鲜甘蔗汁直接发酵蒸馏的朗姆酒，1996 年马提尼克农业朗姆获得 AOC；不经过糖蜜环节，风格青草、橄榄、香蕉与柑橘，白色酒款常用于 Ti' Punch，陈年酒款需在橡木桶中至少 3 年。

en.title: Rhum Agricole
en.summary: A rum distilled from fresh sugarcane juice in Martinique, Guadeloupe and other French Caribbean territories, protected by the Martinique AOC since 1996; it skips molasses, tastes of grass, olive, banana and citrus, and its vieux expression ages at least 3 years in oak.

zh.title: 米香型白酒
zh.summary: 以大米为主要原料、小曲为糖化发酵剂，经半固态法发酵、蒸馏、陈酿与勾调而成，香气以乳酸乙酯与 β-苯乙醇为主体；现行标准为 GB/T 10781.3-2025，统一按 25.0%–68.0% vol 规定。

en.title: Rice-aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma type made mainly from rice with xiaoqu, through semi-solid fermentation, distillation, ageing and blending, with ethyl lactate and beta-phenylethanol as the main aroma compounds; the current standard is GB/T 10781.3-2025, with a unified 25.0%–68.0% ABV.

zh.title: 米酒
zh.summary: 中国以糯米为主料、酒药或甜酒曲糖化发酵而成的低度发酵酒，常以酒酿、醪糟的形态出现；它甜、浊、酒精度低，与黄酒和白酒都不是同一类。

en.title: Rice Wine
en.summary: A low-alcohol fermented drink made in China from glutinous rice with a sweet-rice starter, usually seen as jiuniang or laozao; it is sweet, cloudy and weak, and is neither huangjiu nor baijiu.

zh.title: 桃红葡萄酒
zh.summary: 以红葡萄短暂浸渍或直接压榨取色后发酵的葡萄酒；颜色来自果皮而非甜度，OIV 的残糖阈值把干型到甜型分成四档，普罗旺斯、塔维尔与桃红香槟代表不同方向。

en.title: Rosé Wine
en.summary: A wine made from red grapes with brief skin contact or direct pressing; colour comes from the skins, not sweetness, and OIV residual-sugar thresholds divide dry to sweet into four bands, while Provence, Tavel and rosé Champagne point in different directions.

zh.title: 朗姆酒
zh.summary: 以甘蔗汁或糖蜜发酵蒸馏而成的烈酒，按原料、蒸馏与陈年形成白朗姆、金朗姆、深色朗姆和农业朗姆等类别。

en.title: Rum
en.summary: A spirit distilled from sugarcane juice or molasses, with white, aged, dark and agricole styles.

zh.title: 黑麦威士忌
zh.summary: 以黑麦为主要谷物、在新烧焦橡木桶中熟成的威士忌；美国法要求黑麦不少于 51%，straight 需陈年至少两年，加拿大则把 Canadian Rye Whisky 当作与 Canadian Whisky 同一套标准，并不设黑麦比例下限。

en.title: Rye Whiskey
en.summary: A whiskey built on rye as its main grain and matured in new charred oak; US rules require at least 51% rye and straight rye needs two years, while Canada treats Canadian Rye Whisky as the same standard as Canadian Whisky, with no minimum rye share.

zh.title: 赛松
zh.summary: 比利时瓦隆农庄在凉爽季节酿造、留待夏季饮用的农舍艾尔；以高发酵度、干爽收口、胡椒与柑橘般的酵母香为标志，现代版本从低酒精日常型扩展到 8% 以上的烈性赛松。

en.title: Saison
en.summary: A farmhouse ale brewed in the cool season in Wallonia and kept for summer farm work; it is defined by high attenuation, a dry finish and peppery, citrusy yeast aroma, and modern versions range from low-alcohol everyday beers to strong saisons above 8%.

zh.title: 清酒
zh.summary: 以米、水、米曲和酵母酿成的日本传统酒类，按精米步合、是否添加酿造酒精与处理方法形成不同类别。

en.title: Sake
en.summary: A Japanese fermented rice drink made with rice, water, koji and yeast, classified by polishing ratio and brewing method.

zh.title: 桑布卡
zh.summary: 意大利茴香风味甜利口酒，以八角茴香、糖与中性烈酒为主，经典款透明，另有深蓝或红色配色变体；常配咖啡豆“苍蝇”或加水变浑浊，酒精度通常 38–42%。

en.title: Sambuca
en.summary: An Italian anise-flavoured sweet liqueur based on star anise, sugar and neutral spirit; the classic bottling is clear, with deep-blue or red coloured variants; often served with coffee beans or diluted to cloud, usually 38–42% alcohol.

zh.title: 酱香型白酒
zh.summary: 以高温制曲、高温堆积、石窖泥底和多轮次发酵为特征的酱香型白酒，是白酒风格分类中的一类；香型名称不构成质量等级。

en.title: Sauce-aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu style known for high-temperature qu, high-temperature stacking, stone pits with mud bottoms and multi-round fermentation. Style is not a quality grade.

zh.title: 苏玳
zh.summary: 法国波尔多南部的贵腐甜白，以 Sémillon 为主、Sauvignon Blanc 与 Muscadelle 为辅；Ciron 河的秋雾催生贵腐菌，1855 年分级与 d'Yquem 的独尊地位塑造了它的名声。

en.title: Sauternes
en.summary: The botrytised sweet white of southern Bordeaux, based on Sémillon with Sauvignon Blanc and Muscadelle; autumn fog from the Ciron river feeds noble rot, while the 1855 classification and the unique status of d'Yquem shaped its reputation.

zh.title: 苏格兰威士忌
zh.summary: 在苏格兰按 2009 年《苏格兰威士忌法规》生产的威士忌，分为单一麦芽、单一谷物、调和麦芽、调和谷物与调和苏格兰威士忌五类；须在橡木桶中陈年至少三年，装瓶酒精度不低于 40% vol，蒸馏酒精度低于 94.8% vol。

en.title: Scotch whisky
en.summary: Whisky produced in Scotland under the Scotch Whisky Regulations 2009, in five categories: single malt, single grain, blended malt, blended grain and blended Scotch; it must mature in oak for at least three years, bottle at no less than 40% ABV and distil at below 94.8% ABV.

zh.title: 苏格兰艾尔
zh.summary: 苏格兰传统艾尔，麦芽甜、酒体饱满、酒花苦度低，带焦糖、烤面包与干果；从轻度的 60/- 到厚重的 Wee Heavy 都有。

en.title: Scottish Ale
en.summary: A traditional Scottish ale, malty and full-bodied with low hop bitterness, caramel, toast and dried fruit; it ranges from the light 60/- to the heavy Wee Heavy.

zh.title: 芝麻香型白酒
zh.summary: 以粮谷为主要原料，可配以麸皮，用大曲、麸曲等糖化发酵剂，经堆积、固态发酵、固态蒸馏、陈酿与勾调而成，具有焙炒芝麻般香气；现行标准为 GB/T 10781.9-2021，高度酒酒精度 40%–68% vol。

en.title: Sesame-aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma type made mainly from grain, optionally with wheat bran, using daqu and fuqu as saccharifying and fermenting agents, with stacking, solid-state fermentation, solid-state distillation, ageing and blending; the current standard is GB/T 10781.9-2021, with high-strength spirit at 40%–68% ABV.

zh.title: 雪莉
zh.summary: 西班牙赫雷斯地区的加强葡萄酒，以帕洛米诺为主，经生物陈酿（菲诺、曼萨尼利亚）或氧化陈酿（奥罗索、阿蒙蒂亚多、PX）形成从极干到极甜的风格，并以索莱拉系统调配。

en.title: Sherry
en.summary: A fortified wine from the Jerez region of Spain, based mainly on Palomino and shaped either by biological ageing under flor (Fino, Manzanilla) or oxidative ageing (Oloroso, Amontillado, PX), then blended through the solera system.

zh.title: 日本烧酒
zh.summary: 日本酒税法下的蒸馏酒，按蒸馏方式分为连续式（甲类，低于 36%）与单式（乙类，不超过 45%）；本格烧酒以米、麦、甘薯等为原料，经制曲、二次仕込み与单式蒸馏，常见 25% vol，与韩国烧酒、冲绳泡盛都不是同一类。

en.title: Japanese shochu
en.summary: A Japanese distilled spirit under the liquor tax law, split into continuously distilled class A (under 36%) and single-distilled class B (up to 45%); honkaku shochu is made from rice, barley, sweet potato or other materials through koji, two-stage mashing and pot distillation, commonly 25% ABV, and is distinct from both Korean soju and Okinawan awamori.

zh.title: 单一麦芽苏格兰威士忌
zh.summary: 同一家苏格兰蒸馏厂、以 100% 发芽大麦为原料、经壶式蒸馏并在橡木桶中陈年至少三年的威士忌；蒸馏上限 94.8% vol 与装瓶下限 40% vol 共同划出它与单一桶、单桶原酒的界线。

en.title: Single Malt Scotch Whisky
en.summary: A whisky distilled at one Scottish distillery from 100% malted barley in pot stills and matured in oak for at least three years; the 94.8% distillation ceiling and the 40% bottling floor mark its boundary from single-cask and cask-strength releases.

zh.title: 单一壶式威士忌
zh.summary: 爱尔兰威士忌中以壶式蒸馏器处理“发芽大麦 + 未发芽大麦”混合醪液的类别；单一酒厂、30% 对 30% 的原料结构、3 年最低陈年与 94.8% 蒸馏上限构成其边界。

en.title: Single Pot Still Whiskey
en.summary: An Irish whiskey category distilled in pot stills from a mash of malted and unmalted barley; one distillery, a 30% to 30% raw-material split, a 3-year minimum and a 94.8% distillation ceiling define it.

zh.title: 黑刺李金酒
zh.summary: 英国传统金酒利口酒，将黑刺李果实浸泡在金酒中并加糖；酒色深红、甜中带酸，带杏仁与香料，酒精度通常较低。

en.title: Sloe Gin
en.summary: A traditional British gin liqueur, made by steeping sloe berries in gin with sugar; deep red, sweet-tart with almond and spice, usually lower in alcohol.

zh.title: 烧酒
zh.summary: 朝鲜半岛的传统蒸馏酒，现代大众烧酒多为稀释型；与日本烧酎在原料、法规和风味上并不相同。

en.title: Soju
en.summary: A Korean spirit ranging from traditional distilled soju to modern diluted soju, distinct from Japanese shochu.

zh.title: 索托尔
zh.summary: 墨西哥北部以沙漠勺（Dasylirion）为原料的蒸馏酒，原产地命名覆盖奇瓦瓦、科阿韦拉与杜兰戈三个州；2002 年获得保护，按 NOM-159-SCFI-2004 生产，坑烤、发酵后用壶式蒸馏器蒸馏，酒精度通常在 38% 至 45% vol。

en.title: Sotol
en.summary: A distilled spirit from northern Mexico made from desert spoon (Dasylirion), with a denomination of origin covering Chihuahua, Coahuila and Durango; protected in 2002, made under NOM-159-SCFI-2004 by pit roasting, fermentation and pot distillation, usually at 38% to 45% ABV.

zh.title: 酸啤酒
zh.summary: 以乳酸或醋酸发酵获得明显酸度的一类啤酒；比利时兰比克与红棕色艾尔、德国柏林酸小麦与戈斯各成传统，现代壶式酸化让生产更可控，酸度是风格维度而非缺陷或等级。

en.title: Sour beer
en.summary: A category of beers given marked acidity by lactic or acetic fermentation; Belgian lambic and red-brown ales, German Berliner Weisse and Gose each form a tradition, and modern kettle souring makes production more controllable, with acidity a style axis rather than a defect or a grade.

zh.title: 起泡酒
zh.summary: 含有源自发酵的内源二氧化碳、开瓶后持续冒泡的葡萄酒；按二次发酵方式分为传统法、罐式法与古法，香槟只是其中一种。

en.title: Sparkling wine
en.summary: Wine containing carbon dioxide of fermentative origin that keeps bubbling after opening; traditional method, tank method and ancestral method are distinct, and Champagne is only one example.

zh.title: 香料朗姆
zh.summary: 在朗姆酒基酒中加入香料、糖与焦糖的调味烈酒；常见香草、肉桂、丁香、肉豆蔻与橙皮，风格从清淡到甜厚都有。

en.title: Spiced Rum
en.summary: A flavoured spirit made by adding spices, sugar and caramel to a rum base; common notes are vanilla, cinnamon, clove, nutmeg and orange peel, with styles from light to sweet and rich.

zh.title: 世涛
zh.summary: 以烘焙大麦赋予深色与咖啡可可风味的上面发酵啤酒，名称源自更烈的波特，都柏林干世涛为代表，内部还分化出甜世涛、燕麦世涛与帝国世涛。

en.title: Stout
en.summary: A top-fermented dark beer given colour and coffee-cocoa flavour by roasted barley, named after stronger porter, represented by Dublin dry stout and split into sweet, oatmeal and imperial stout.

zh.title: 浓香型白酒
zh.summary: 以泥窖固态发酵、续糟配料和混蒸混烧等工艺为特征的浓香型白酒，是白酒风格分类中的一类。

en.title: Strong-aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu style associated with mud-pit solid-state fermentation, continuous grain topping and mixed steaming. Style is not a quality score.

zh.title: 特香型白酒
zh.summary: 以大米为主要原料，用面粉、麦麸和酒糟培制的大曲，经红褚条石窖池固态发酵、固态蒸馏、陈酿与勾调而成；现行标准为 GB/T 10781.7-2025，酒精度 25.0%–68.0% vol。

en.title: Te-aroma baijiu
en.summary: A baijiu aroma type made mainly from rice, with daqu cultured from wheat flour, wheat bran and distillers' grains, fermented in red conglomerate stone pits, then solid-state distilled, aged and blended; the current standard is GB/T 10781.7-2025, with 25.0%–68.0% ABV.

zh.title: 田纳西威士忌
zh.summary: 田纳西州生产的美国威士忌，以玉米为主的谷物配方、新烧焦橡木桶陈年，并在入桶前经糖枫木炭过滤；常以 straight 标注，甜润之中带有更柔和的入口。

en.title: Tennessee whiskey
en.summary: A Tennessee-produced American whiskey with a corn-led mash, new charred oak maturation and maple-charcoal filtration before ageing, often labelled straight.

zh.title: 龙舌兰酒
zh.summary: 以蓝色韦伯龙舌兰为原料、在墨西哥法定产区生产的蒸馏酒；100% 龙舌兰与混合型、不同陈年等级差异明显。

en.title: Tequila
en.summary: A Mexican spirit distilled from blue Weber agave, with 100% agave and mixto expressions and several age tiers.

zh.title: 托卡伊
zh.summary: 匈牙利托卡伊产区的贵腐甜酒体系，以 Aszú 为核心；2013 年起改用残糖克/升标注，Furmint 与 Hárslevelű 提供高酸骨架，风格从 Eszencia 到 Szamorodni 层层展开。

en.title: Tokaji
en.summary: The botrytised sweet wine system of Hungary's Tokaj region, built around Aszú; since 2013 it is labelled by grams per litre of residual sugar, Furmint and Hárslevelű supply the high-acid frame, and the range runs from Eszencia to Szamorodni.

zh.title: 特拉普斯特啤酒
zh.summary: 必须在特拉普斯特修道院内、由修士酿造或在其监督下酿造，且收益用于修道院与社会公益的啤酒；目前获准使用 Authentic Trappist Product 标识的酒厂只有六家，风格横跨 dubbel、tripel、quadrupel 与深色烈性艾尔。

en.title: Trappist Beer
en.summary: Beer that must be brewed inside a Trappist monastery by monks or under their supervision, with proceeds going to the monastery and social work; only six breweries may currently use the Authentic Trappist Product mark, and their styles range from dubbel and tripel to quadrupel and dark strong ale.

zh.title: 三重橙酒
zh.summary: 以中性烈酒浸提甜橙与苦橙干皮、经蒸馏和加糖制成的清澈橙味利口酒；它不是商标，而是一类风格，与库拉索的边界在基酒、颜色与甜度。

en.title: Triple Sec
en.summary: A clear orange liqueur made by macerating sweet and bitter orange peels in neutral spirit, distilling and sweetening; it is a style, not a brand, and its border with curaçao lies in base spirit, colour and sweetness.

zh.title: 梅酒
zh.summary: 日本以青梅、糖与酒浸渍而成的甜味利口酒，不经过发酵；「本格梅酒」要求原料只有梅、糖类和酒类，是日本洋酒酒造组合的自主标示基准。

en.title: Umeshu
en.summary: A Japanese sweet liqueur made by steeping green ume plums, sugar and alcohol together without fermentation; "honkaku umeshu" is an industry labelling standard requiring only ume, sugar and alcohol.

zh.title: 味美思
zh.summary: 以葡萄酒为基酒、用苦艾等草本加香并按类别加强的加香葡萄酒；欧盟法规为它设定 14.5% 起、低于 22% 的实际酒精度区间与 17.5% 的总酒精度下限，干型、白型与红型在配方与用途上几乎像三种配料。

en.title: Vermouth
en.summary: An aromatised wine based on wine, flavoured with wormwood and other botanicals and fortified by category; EU rules set an actual-alcohol range from 14.5% up to but below 22% and a total-alcohol floor of 17.5%, and dry, white and red styles work almost like three different ingredients.

zh.title: 圣酒
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳的甜型“圣酒”，用风干葡萄酿制，经长期木桶陈年；带杏干、蜂蜜、坚果与焦糖，常配 cantucci 杏仁饼。

en.title: Vin Santo
en.summary: A sweet Tuscan “holy wine” made from dried grapes and aged in wood for years; dried apricot, honey, nuts and caramel, traditionally served with cantucci almond biscuits.

zh.title: 伏特加
zh.summary: 以谷物、马铃薯、糖蜜等为原料，经发酵蒸馏和过滤得到的中性烈酒；风味差异比“无色无味”的刻板印象更丰富。

en.title: Vodka
en.summary: A neutral spirit distilled from grain, potato, molasses or other agricultural materials, with more flavour variation than the "colourless and tasteless" stereotype suggests.

zh.title: 小麦啤酒
zh.summary: 以较大比例小麦、经上层发酵酿成的啤酒；德国小麦啤酒以丁香与香蕉酯香和瓶内二次发酵为标志，比利时 witbier 以橙皮与芫荽籽调味，美国小麦艾尔更清淡，小麦主要影响酒体、泡沫与浑浊度。

en.title: Wheat beer
en.summary: A top-fermented beer made with a large share of wheat; German wheat beer is marked by clove and banana esters and bottle conditioning, Belgian witbier by orange peel and coriander, and American wheat ale is cleaner, with wheat shaping body, head and haze.

zh.title: 威士忌
zh.summary: 以谷物为原料、经发酵蒸馏并在橡木桶中陈年的烈酒；苏格兰、爱尔兰、美国、日本等地各有法规与传统。

en.title: Whisky
en.summary: A grain spirit distilled, then aged in oak, with Scottish, Irish, American and Japanese traditions and strict labelling rules.

zh.title: 白葡萄酒
zh.summary: 以白葡萄或去皮深色葡萄酿造、通常不经带皮发酵的葡萄酒；酸度、香气、酒泥与橡木处理共同决定风格。

en.title: White wine
en.summary: Wine made from white grapes, or from destemmed dark grapes, usually without skin fermentation; acidity, aroma, lees and oak treatment together shape the style.

zh.title: 葡萄酒
zh.summary: 以新鲜葡萄或葡萄汁发酵而成的酒精饮料，按颜色、甜度、气泡与产地法规形成不同类别；风土与年份只是部分变量。

en.title: Wine
en.summary: An alcoholic drink made by fermenting fresh grapes or grape must; colour, sweetness, bubbles and regional rules define its categories, while terroir and vintage are only some of the variables.

zh.title: 黄酒
zh.summary: 中国传统的谷物发酵酒，以稻米为主料、麦曲或酒药糖化发酵而成；绍兴酒是其中最知名的地理标志产品。

en.title: Yellow wine
en.summary: A traditional Chinese fermented grain wine, mainly rice-based; Shaoxing is its best-known protected origin.

zh.title: 奔富葛兰许
zh.summary: 澳大利亚奔富酒庄的旗舰酒，由马克斯·舒伯特于 1951 年首创，以设拉子为主、常混少量赤霞珠，在美国橡木桶中陈年。

en.title: Penfolds Grange
en.summary: The flagship wine of Penfolds in Australia, first made by Max Schubert in 1951 from mostly Shiraz with a little Cabernet Sauvignon, aged in American oak.

zh.title: 二锅头
zh.summary: 北京传统白酒工艺与产品类别，因取第二锅冷却流出的酒液而得名，风格清香、直接，常见酒精度 43%–56% vol。

en.title: Erguotou
en.summary: A traditional Beijing baijiu process and product category, named for the spirit taken from the second distillation pot; light-aroma and direct, commonly 43% to 56% ABV.

zh.title: 智美蓝帽
zh.summary: 比利时斯库尔蒙修道院出产的深色特拉普斯特艾尔，9% vol，瓶内二次发酵 21 天；以干果、焦糖、可可与香料著称，75 cl 装又称 Grande Réserve。

en.title: Chimay Blue
en.summary: A dark Trappist ale from Scourmont Abbey in Belgium, 9% ABV and refermented in the bottle for about 21 days; known for dried fruit, caramel, cocoa and spice, with the 75 cl bottle also called Grande Réserve.

zh.title: 林德曼树莓兰比克
zh.summary: 比利时帕约滕兰地区林德曼家族酒厂的树莓兰比克，以自然发酵的兰比克为基酒加入树莓，常见 2.5%–4% vol、250 mL 或 750 mL；风格偏甜，与传统干型兰比克属于不同产品取向。

en.title: Lindemans Framboise
en.summary: A raspberry lambic from the Lindemans family brewery in the Pajottenland, Belgium, made on a spontaneously fermented lambic base with raspberries added. Commonly 2.5%–4% ABV in 250 mL or 750 mL bottles; the style is sweet and differs from traditional dry lambic.

zh.title: 奥瓦尔
zh.summary: 比利时奥瓦尔圣母修道院出产的唯一一款修道院艾尔，常见 5.2% vol、330 mL，干投啤酒花并瓶内二次发酵；以花香、柑橘、干爽与轻微酸味著称，风格会随瓶陈变化。

en.title: Orval
en.summary: The single Trappist ale made at Orval Abbey in Belgium, commonly 5.2% ABV in 330 mL bottles, dry-hopped and fermented again in the bottle. Known for floral, citrus and dry notes with a light acidity, its character changes with bottle age.

zh.title: 罗什福尔 10 号
zh.summary: 比利时罗什福尔圣雷米修道院出产的深色特拉普斯特艾尔，11.3% vol、33 cl；编号“10”来自旧比利时麦汁密度单位而非酒精度，风味偏烘焙、咖啡、巧克力与香料。

en.title: Rochefort 10
en.summary: A dark Trappist ale from Abbaye Notre-Dame de Saint-Rémy in Belgium, 11.3% ABV in 33 cl bottles; the number 10 refers to an old Belgian wort-density unit, not alcohol, and the beer is known for roasted, coffee, chocolate and spice notes.

zh.title: 西麦尔三料
zh.summary: 比利时西麦尔修道院出产的浅色三料修道院艾尔，常见 9.5% vol、330 mL，瓶内二次发酵；以香蕉、柑橘、香料与干爽苦味著称，是 tripel 风格的基准款之一。

en.title: Westmalle Tripel
en.summary: A pale Trappist tripel from Westmalle Abbey in Belgium, commonly 9.5% ABV in 330 mL bottles and fermented again in the bottle. Known for banana, citrus, spice and a dry bitterness, it is a benchmark of the tripel style.

zh.title: 西弗莱特伦 12 号
zh.summary: 比利时西弗兰德省弗莱特伦圣西斯笃修道院酿造的四料深色艾尔，常见 10.2% vol、330 mL，瓶内二次发酵；仅在修道院限量出售，以深色果干、焦糖与香料气息著称，是特拉普斯特啤酒中最稀缺的代表之一。

en.title: Westvleteren 12
en.summary: A dark quadrupel brewed by the Sint-Sixtus Abbey in Vleteren, West Flanders, Belgium, usually 10.2% vol in 330 mL and bottle-conditioned; sold only in limited quantities at the abbey, it shows dark fruit, caramel and spice and is one of the scarcest Trappist beers.

zh.title: 张裕解百纳
zh.summary: 张裕旗下的干红葡萄酒系列，1931 年在烟台诞生，常见 750 mL 瓶装、酒精度约 12%-13% vol；解百纳是产品系列名称，不是葡萄品种。

en.title: Changyu Jiebaina
en.summary: A dry red wine series from Changyu, first made in Yantai in 1931, commonly 750 mL with about 12%-13% ABV; Jiebaina is a product-series name, not a grape variety.

zh.title: 活灵魂
zh.summary: 活灵魂是 1997 年由干露集团与菲利普·德·罗斯柴尔德男爵公司在智利合资创立的波尔多风格干红，葡萄园位于迈坡谷 Puente Alto 的 65 公顷安第斯冲积土上；本文从风土、品种、橡木桶与副牌 EPU 拆解其与 Opus One 的差异。

en.title: Almaviva
en.summary: A Bordeaux-style red from Puente Alto in Chile's Maipo Valley, founded in 1997 by Viña Concha y Toro and Baron Philippe de Rothschild SA; sixty-five hectares of Andean alluvium, a Cabernet Sauvignon-led blend and the EPU second wine explain its difference from Opus One.

zh.title: 水晶剑南春
zh.summary: 剑南春的浓香型核心单品，市场常简称“水晶剑”，常见 52% vol、500 mL，产自四川绵竹。本页按酒款层级说明原料、工艺、规格与选购。

en.title: Crystal Jiannanchun
en.summary: The core strong-aroma product of Jiannanchun, commonly called Crystal Sword in the market; usually 52% ABV in 500 mL and made in Mianzhu, Sichuan. This entry covers raw materials, process, specification and buying at product level.

zh.title: 百加得白朗姆
zh.summary: 以糖蜜为原料的白色朗姆酒，经发酵、蒸馏与活性炭过滤，常见酒精度 40% vol，适合调制莫吉托和代基里。

en.title: Bacardí Carta Blanca
en.summary: A white rum made from molasses, fermented, distilled and charcoal-filtered, commonly 40% ABV, and a base for Mojitos and Daiquiris.

zh.title: 哈瓦那俱乐部7年
zh.summary: 古巴朗姆酒品牌，以糖蜜蒸馏的朗姆酒调配并陈年，常见酒精度 40% vol，风味以香草、焦糖与热带水果为主。

en.title: Havana Club 7
en.summary: A Cuban rum brand; molasses-based rums are blended and aged, commonly 40% ABV, with vanilla, caramel and tropical-fruit notes.

zh.title: 皮尔森之源
zh.summary: 捷克皮尔森市的淡色拉格啤酒，1842 年首次酿造，使用软水、萨兹酒花与三重煮出糖化，酒精度约 4.4% vol。

en.title: Pilsner Urquell
en.summary: A pale lager from Plzeň, Czechia, first brewed in 1842 with soft water, Saaz hops and triple decoction, about 4.4% ABV.

zh.title: 董酒·佰草香
zh.summary: 贵州董酒的高端单品，董香型，常见规格为 54% vol、500 mL；以百草入曲、大小曲发酵与双醅串蒸为工艺特征，2008 年贵州地方标准确立董香型。

en.title: Dongjiu Baicaoxiang
en.summary: A high-end Dongjiu product in the Dong aroma type, commonly 54% ABV in 500 mL, made with herbs in qu, dual small and large qu fermentation and double-mash steam distillation; the Dong aroma type was formalised by a Guizhou local standard in 2008.

zh.title: 阿洛斯-科尔通
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第伯恩丘北端的村庄级法定产区，村庄级葡萄园约 118.5 公顷红、1.4 公顷白；村内拥有伯恩丘唯一以红葡萄酒为主的特级园科尔通（Corton），并与佩尔南、拉多瓦共享白特级园科尔通-查理曼。红以结构、泥土与陈年潜力见长，白极为稀少，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Aloxe-Corton
en.summary: A village appellation at the northern end of the Côte de Beaune, Burgundy, France, with about 118.5 hectares of village-level red and only 1.4 hectares of village-level white; the commune also contains part of Corton, the Côte de Beaune's only red-led grand cru, and of the white Corton-Charlemagne. Reds are structured and earthy, whites are scarce and come mostly from grand cru parcels, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 阿尔萨斯琼瑶浆
zh.summary: 法国阿尔萨斯产区的琼瑶浆白葡萄酒，按品种单独标注，可产干型、晚收（VT）与贵腐精选（SGN）；以荔枝、玫瑰、姜与肉桂香气著称，酸度偏低、香气外放，常见 750 mL、干型酒精度约 12.5%–14% vol。

en.title: Alsace Gewürztraminer
en.summary: A Gewürztraminer white wine from the Alsace region of France, labelled by variety and available as dry, late-harvest (VT) and botrytised selection (SGN) styles. Known for lychee, rose, ginger and cinnamon aromas, with low acidity and bold aroma; commonly 750 mL, dry styles about 12.5%–14% vol.

zh.title: 阿尔萨斯雷司令
zh.summary: 法国阿尔萨斯的雷司令白葡萄酒，以干型为主，酸度高、香气清澈，以柑橘、白花、燧石矿物感与陈年后的汽油气息著称；阿尔萨斯以品种名标注酒款，并设有特级园与晚收、贵腐等标注；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Alsace Riesling
en.summary: A Riesling white wine from Alsace, France, mostly dry, with high acidity and clear aromatics of citrus, white flowers and flint, developing a petrol note with age. Alsace labels wines by variety and has Grand Cru, late-harvest and botrytised designations; commonly 750 mL at about 12%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 阿尔布瓦
zh.summary: 法国汝拉最早获得 AOC 的产区之一（1936 年 5 月 15 日），以阿尔布瓦镇为中心、覆盖 12 个村庄约 766 公顷；五种汝拉品种全部可用，红酒约占汝拉红酒七成，并以 Vin Jaune、Vin de Paille 与 ouillé 白葡萄酒并存著称。

en.title: Arbois
en.summary: One of the Jura's earliest appellations, recognised on 15 May 1936 and covering 12 villages and about 766 hectares; all five Jura varieties are permitted, reds account for roughly 70% of Jura red output, and the area is known for the coexistence of vin jaune, vin de paille and ouillé whites.

zh.title: 邦多勒
zh.summary: 法国普罗旺斯地中海沿岸的法定产区，以慕合怀特为主的红葡萄酒著称，法定要求红葡萄酒中慕合怀特至少占 50%，并在橡木桶中陈年不少于 18 个月；风格结构强、香料与深色果味明显，也生产桃红与少量白葡萄酒，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14.5% vol。

en.title: Bandol
en.summary: An appellation on the Mediterranean coast of Provence in France, best known for red wines based on Mourvèdre, with a legal minimum of 50% Mourvèdre and at least 18 months in oak; the reds are structured with dark fruit and spice and also age well, and the appellation makes rosé and a little white wine, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14.5% vol.

zh.title: 布尔格伊
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔河谷都兰地区的品丽珠红葡萄酒法定产区，位于卢瓦尔河右岸、图尔以西，1937 年 7 月 31 日获 AOC；葡萄园约 1,200–1,400 公顷，分砾石台地与黏土-石灰岩坡两类风土，前者柔顺果味、后者结构紧实可久藏，另产约 4% 桃红，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Bourgueil
en.summary: A Cabernet Franc red wine appellation in the Touraine area of the Loire Valley, France, on the right bank of the Loire west of Tours; recognised on 31 July 1937, with roughly 1,200–1,400 hectares divided between gravel terraces and clay-limestone slopes, the former supple and early-drinking, the latter firm and long-lived, plus about 4% rosé, commonly 750 mL at about 12%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 布鲁伊
zh.summary: 法国博若莱南部环绕布鲁伊山的 cru 级红葡萄酒，以佳美酿造；产区覆盖六个村庄、是十个 cru 中面积最大的一支，风格以轻盈果味与较早适饮著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Brouilly
en.summary: A cru-level red wine from southern Beaujolais, France, made from Gamay, with vineyards circling Mont Brouilly across six villages. It is the largest of the ten crus, known for light fruit and relatively early drinking, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 夏布利
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第北部的夏布利法定产区干白，只用霞多丽酿造，以启莫里阶石灰岩土壤与清瘦、矿物感强的风格著称；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12%–13% vol，分小夏布利、夏布利、一级园与特级园。

en.title: Chablis
en.summary: A dry white wine from the Chablis appellation in northern Burgundy, France, made only from Chardonnay and known for Kimmeridgian limestone soils and a lean, mineral style. Commonly 750 mL at about 12%–13% vol, with Petit Chablis, Chablis, Premier Cru and Grand Cru tiers.

zh.title: 香波-米西尼
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第夜丘香波-米西尼的村庄级法定产区，以黑皮诺酿造红葡萄酒；村内有两个特级园米西尼与博纳-马尔，一级园以爱侣园为代表，风格细腻、花香突出，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Chambolle-Musigny
en.summary: A village appellation in the Côte de Nuits of Burgundy, France, making red wine from Pinot Noir; the village holds two grands crus, Musigny and Bonnes-Mares, with premiers crus led by Les Amoureuses, and the style is delicate and floral, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 香槟法定产区
zh.summary: 法国北部香槟地区的起泡酒法定产区，以兰斯与埃佩尔奈为中心；以霞多丽、黑皮诺与莫尼耶皮诺酿造，采用瓶内二次发酵的传统法，风格以高酸度、细腻气泡与柑橘、苹果、烤面包气息著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12%–12.5% vol。

en.title: Champagne
en.summary: A sparkling wine appellation in the Champagne region of northern France, centred on Reims and Épernay; made from Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier by the traditional method of in-bottle second fermentation, known for high acidity, fine bubbles and citrus, apple and brioche notes, commonly 750 mL at about 12%–12.5% vol.

zh.title: 查特酒
zh.summary: 法国加尔都西会修士在瓦龙生产的草本利口酒，以约 130 种植物配方著称；绿查特酒精度 55% vol，黄查特 40% vol。

en.title: Chartreuse
en.summary: A herbal liqueur made by the Carthusian order in Voiron, France, based on a recipe said to contain about 130 plants; green is 55% ABV and yellow 40% ABV.

zh.title: 夏托沙隆
zh.summary: 法国汝拉夏托沙隆法定产区的黄酒，只用萨瓦涅酿造，在旧桶中以 sous voile 方式长期氧化陈年不少于 6 年 3 个月；风格以坚果、蜂蜡、咖喱与咸鲜为主，与 ouillé 补液陈酿的汝拉白葡萄酒形成对照，常见 620 mL 细颈瓶、酒精度约 13.5%–15% vol。

en.title: Château-Chalon
en.summary: The vin jaune of the Château-Chalon appellation in the Jura region of France, made only from Savagnin and aged oxidatively sous voile in old barrels for at least 6 years 3 months; it shows walnut, beeswax, curry and saline notes in contrast with ouillé topped-up Jura whites, commonly in a 620 mL narrow-necked bottle at about 13.5%–15% vol.

zh.title: 白马酒庄
zh.summary: 法国波尔多圣埃美隆产区的红葡萄酒，位于圣埃美隆与波美侯交界，葡萄园约 39 公顷，以品丽珠与梅洛为主；1955 年圣埃美隆分级中列为一级特等 A 级，2021 年退出该分级，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13%–14% vol。

en.title: Château Cheval Blanc
en.summary: A red wine from Saint-Émilion in Bordeaux, France, on the border with Pomerol, with about 39 hectares planted mainly to Cabernet Franc and Merlot. It was ranked Premier Grand Cru Classé A in the 1955 Saint-Émilion classification and withdrew from that classification in 2021; commonly 750 mL at about 13%–14% vol.

zh.title: 滴金酒庄
zh.summary: 波尔多苏玳产区的贵腐甜白葡萄酒，1855 年被评为一级特等酒庄，1999 年起由路威酩轩控股；以赛美蓉与长相思酿造，常见 375 mL 或 750 mL，约 13-14% vol。

en.title: Château d'Yquem
en.summary: A botrytised sweet white wine from Sauternes in Bordeaux, rated Premier Cru Supérieur in the 1855 classification and controlled by LVMH since 1999; made from Sémillon and Sauvignon Blanc, commonly 375 mL or 750 mL at about 13-14% vol.

zh.title: 奥比昂古堡
zh.summary: 法国波尔多佩萨克-雷奥良的列级庄，1855 年分级列为一等，是名单中唯一不在梅多克的酒庄；以赤霞珠与梅洛为主的混酿，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13% vol，具体年份与批次以瓶标为准。

en.title: Château Haut-Brion
en.summary: A classified growth in Pessac-Léognan, Bordeaux, ranked first growth in the 1855 classification and the only estate on that list outside the Médoc; a Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot-led blend, commonly 750 mL at about 13% ABV, with vintage and batch to be checked on the label.

zh.title: 拉图古堡
zh.summary: 波亚克南端的 1855 年一级庄，正牌只取 47 公顷 Enclos 围场内平均约 60 年的老藤，赤霞珠常超过九成；100% 新桶、约 22–25 个月陈年，2012 年起退出期酒体系，正牌常在装瓶后 8–10 年才上市。

en.title: Château Latour
en.summary: A first growth at the southern end of Pauillac whose grand vin comes only from the 47-hectare Enclos, planted with vines averaging about 60 years old and usually over 90% Cabernet Sauvignon; 100% new oak, 22–25 months in barrel, and no en primeur sales since 2012.

zh.title: 玛歌古堡
zh.summary: 玛歌村的 1855 年一级庄，1855 年分级中唯一拿到 20/20；265 公顷庄园内有约 87 公顷红葡萄与 12 公顷白葡萄，正牌赤霞珠常近九成、筛选率约四成，21 个月全新法国橡木桶，年均约 12 万瓶。

en.title: Château Margaux
en.summary: A Margaux first growth and the only estate to score 20/20 in the 1855 classification; 265 hectares with about 87 hectares of red vines and 12 of white, a grand vin near 89% Cabernet Sauvignon and a selection of roughly 40%, aged 21 months in new French oak.

zh.title: 木桐古堡
zh.summary: 波亚克北端的 1855 年二等庄，1973 年由 Jacques Chirac 签署法令升为一等，是名单历史上唯一一次升级；1945 年起每年邀请艺术家设计正标，正牌赤霞珠约 81%、平均树龄约 44 年、新桶陈年约 20 个月。

en.title: Château Mouton Rothschild
en.summary: A Pauillac estate ranked second growth in 1855 and raised to first growth in 1973, the only promotion in the list's history; its grand vin is about 81% Cabernet Sauvignon, averages 44-year-old vines and is aged around 20 months in new oak, with artist-designed labels since 1945.

zh.title: 柏图斯
zh.summary: 法国波尔多波美侯产区的梅洛干红，葡萄园位于波美侯东部高地、面积约 11.4 公顷，几乎全部种植梅洛；波美侯没有官方分级，柏图斯以黏土与铁质底层土壤、低产量与陈年潜力著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13%–14% vol。

en.title: Pétrus
en.summary: A Merlot red wine from Pomerol in Bordeaux, France, with a vineyard of about 11.4 hectares on the eastern plateau of Pomerol planted almost entirely to Merlot. Pomerol has no official classification, and Pétrus is known for clay and iron-rich subsoils, low yields and long ageing potential; commonly 750 mL at about 13%–14% vol.

zh.title: 拉菲古堡红葡萄酒
zh.summary: 法国波尔多波亚克一级庄，以赤霞珠为主的混酿；1855 年分级列为一级庄，1868 年由罗斯柴尔德家族购入。

en.title: Château Lafite Rothschild
en.summary: A Pauillac first growth in Bordeaux, based on Cabernet Sauvignon; classified as a first growth in 1855 and purchased by the Rothschild family in 1868.

zh.title: 教皇新堡
zh.summary: 法国罗讷河谷南部教皇新堡法定产区的红葡萄酒，以歌海娜为主体、常与西拉等品种混酿，酒体饱满、酒精度高，以成熟黑果、普罗旺斯香草与皮革香气著称；产区允许十余个品种，法定最低酒精度 12.5% vol，常见 750 mL、约 14%–15.5% vol。

en.title: Châteauneuf-du-Pape
en.summary: A red wine from the Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation in the southern Rhône, France, based on Grenache and often blended with Syrah and other varieties. Full-bodied and high in alcohol, known for ripe black fruit, Provençal herbs and leather. The appellation permits more than ten varieties and sets a minimum of 12.5% vol; commonly 750 mL at about 14%–15.5% vol.

zh.title: 谢纳
zh.summary: 法国博若莱北部谢纳村的 cru 级红葡萄酒，以佳美酿造；葡萄园由旧橡树林开垦而来，是十个 cru 中面积最小的一支，花岗岩土壤上的风格比弗勒里更紧、比穆兰-阿旺更早适饮，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Chénas
en.summary: A cru-level red wine from the village of Chénas in northern Beaujolais, France, made from Gamay. Its vineyards were cleared from old oak woodland, and the cru is the smallest of the ten; on granite it gives a tighter style than Fleurie and drinks earlier than Moulin-à-Vent, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 希尼安-贝热龙
zh.summary: 法国萨瓦产区内的白葡萄酒地理命名，只使用当地称为贝热龙的胡珊（Roussanne）酿造；葡萄园位于希尼安一带朝南或东南的石灰岩坡地上，风格以白花、杏、蜂蜜与杏仁为主，酸度低于雅克儿，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Chignin-Bergeron
en.summary: A white-wine geographical name in the Savoie region of France, made only from Roussanne, known locally as Bergeron; the vineyards lie on south or south-east facing limestone slopes around Chignin, and the style shows white flowers, apricot, honey and almond with lower acidity than Jacquère, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 希农
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔河谷都兰地区的品丽珠红葡萄酒法定产区，位于维埃纳河两岸、卢瓦尔河汇流处上游；AOC 于 1937 年 7 月 31 日确立，葡萄园约 2,400 公顷、横跨 26 个市镇，土壤分河谷砾石、坡地黏土-石灰岩与高原含燧石黏土，另产桃红与少量白诗南白葡萄酒，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Chinon
en.summary: A Cabernet Franc red wine appellation in the Touraine area of the Loire Valley, France, on both banks of the Vienne upstream of its confluence with the Loire; recognised on 31 July 1937, with about 2,400 hectares across 26 communes, soils ranging from valley gravel to clay-limestone slopes and flint clays, plus rosé and a little Chenin white, commonly 750 mL at about 12%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 希鲁布勒
zh.summary: 博若莱十个 cru 中海拔最高的一支村庄级 cru 红葡萄酒，葡萄园爬到约 400 米高的花岗岩砂坡；酒体最轻、花香最外放，常被视作轻快风格的代表，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13% vol。

en.title: Chiroubles
en.summary: The highest of the ten Beaujolais village crus, with vineyards climbing to about 400 metres on granite sand; the lightest body and the most outward floral scent among the crus, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13% vol.

zh.title: 科尔纳斯
zh.summary: 法国北罗讷河谷的叙拉红葡萄酒法定产区，位于罗讷河西岸、瓦朗斯以北的陡坡地带；产量小、风格紧实，以黑橄榄、黑胡椒、紫罗兰与烟熏气息著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14% vol。

en.title: Cornas
en.summary: A Syrah red wine appellation in the Northern Rhône Valley, France, on steep slopes on the west bank of the Rhône north of Valence; small in output and firm in style, with black olive, black pepper, violet and smoky notes, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14% vol.

zh.title: 科尔通
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第伯恩丘科尔通山上的特级园法定产区，可产黑皮诺红葡萄酒与霞多丽白葡萄酒，是伯恩丘唯一的红葡萄酒特级园；红葡萄酒以结构感、泥土与红果气息著称，白葡萄酒与科尔通-查理曼特级园以坚果、蜂蜜与矿物感著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Corton
en.summary: A grand cru appellation on the hill of Corton in the Côte de Beaune, Burgundy, France, making red wine from Pinot Noir and white wine from Chardonnay and the only red grand cru of the Côte de Beaune; reds are known for structure, earth and red fruit, while the whites and Corton-Charlemagne are known for nut, honey and mineral notes, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 布鲁伊丘
zh.summary: 法国博若莱南部布鲁伊山山坡上的 cru 级红葡萄酒，以佳美酿造；只取山坡、不取山脚，蓝色斑岩与花岗岩带来更清晰的酸度与矿物感，面积远小于相邻的布鲁伊，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Côte de Brouilly
en.summary: A cru-level red wine from the slopes of Mont Brouilly in southern Beaujolais, France, made from Gamay. It takes only the hillside and not the foot of the hill; blue porphyry and granite give clearer acidity and minerality, and the area is far smaller than neighbouring Brouilly, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 夜丘村庄级
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第夜丘南部的村庄级法定产区，葡萄园分布在 Brochon、Comblanchien、Corgoloin 与 Prémeaux-Prissey 等村庄；以黑皮诺红葡萄酒为主，也产少量霞多丽白葡萄酒，风格以红果、泥土与较早适饮著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Côte de Nuits-Villages
en.summary: A village appellation in the southern Côte de Nuits, Burgundy, France, with vineyards in villages including Brochon, Comblanchien, Corgoloin and Prémeaux-Prissey; mainly red wine from Pinot Noir with some white wine from Chardonnay, known for red fruit, earth and earlier drinking, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 罗第丘
zh.summary: 法国罗讷河谷北部罗第丘法定产区的红葡萄酒，以席拉为主体、可混入少量维欧尼，产自阿姆皮斯一带的陡坡梯田，以黑胡椒、紫罗兰、橄榄与烟熏气息著称；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14% vol。

en.title: Côte-Rôtie
en.summary: A red wine from the Côte-Rôtie appellation at the northern end of France's Rhône Valley, based on Syrah with a permitted touch of Viognier, grown on steep terraced slopes around Ampuis and known for black pepper, violet, olive and smoky notes. Commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14% vol.

zh.title: 普罗旺斯桃红
zh.summary: 法国普罗旺斯丘法定产区的桃红葡萄酒，是普罗旺斯产量与知名度最高的酒种；以歌海娜、神索、西拉与慕合怀特等品种混酿，浸皮时间短、颜色浅，风格以红果、柑橘、白花与咸鲜为主，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Côtes de Provence Rosé
en.summary: The rosé of the Côtes de Provence appellation in the Provence region of France, the best-known and largest-volume wine of the region; a blend of Grenache, Cinsault, Syrah and Mourvèdre with short skin contact and pale colour, showing red fruit, citrus, white flowers and saline notes, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 汝拉坡
zh.summary: 法国汝拉覆盖范围最广的法定产区，1937 年 7 月 31 日获 AOC，跨越 105 个市镇但仅约 551 公顷；白酒与起泡酒为主，红白与 Vin Jaune、Vin de Paille 并存，并覆盖 Macvin du Jura 的葡萄来源。

en.title: Côtes du Jura
en.summary: The broadest appellation in the Jura region of France, recognised on 31 July 1937 and spanning 105 communes while covering only about 551 hectares; whites and crémant dominate, with red and white wines plus vin jaune and vin de paille, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14.5% vol.

zh.title: 汝拉起泡酒
zh.summary: 法国汝拉的传统法起泡酒法定产区，以霞多丽、萨瓦涅、黑皮诺、普尔萨与特鲁索等品种酿造，二次发酵在瓶中进行，带酒泥陈年不少于 9 个月；风格清爽、酸度高、气泡细腻，有白与桃红两类，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.0%–12.5% vol。

en.title: Crémant du Jura
en.summary: The traditional-method sparkling wine appellation of the Jura region in France, made from Chardonnay, Savagnin, Pinot Noir, Poulsard and Trousseau, with the second fermentation in bottle and at least 9 months on the lees; the style is fresh with high acidity and fine bubbles, in white and rosé versions, commonly 750 mL at about 12.0%–12.5% vol.

zh.title: 克罗兹-埃米塔日
zh.summary: 法国北罗讷河谷罗讷河东岸的叙拉红葡萄酒法定产区，围绕坦恩-埃米塔日与埃米塔日丘分布，是北罗讷面积最大的法定产区；红葡萄酒以叙拉酿造，也产少量以玛珊与胡珊酿造的白葡萄酒，以黑莓、黑胡椒与紫罗兰气息著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14% vol。

en.title: Crozes-Hermitage
en.summary: A Syrah red wine appellation on the east bank of the Rhône in the Northern Rhône Valley, France, spread around Tain-l'Hermitage and the Hermitage hill and the largest appellation in the northern Rhône; reds are made from Syrah and a small amount of white wine from Marsanne and Roussanne, with blackberry, black pepper and violet notes, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14% vol.

zh.title: 唐·培里侬香槟
zh.summary: 酩悦香槟旗下的年份香槟品牌，只在特定年份生产；首个商业年份为 1921，1936 年上市，常见酒精度 12.5% vol。

en.title: Dom Pérignon
en.summary: A vintage-only Champagne brand owned by Moët & Chandon; the first commercial vintage was 1921, released in 1936, usually bottled at 12.5% ABV.

zh.title: 弗勒里
zh.summary: 法国博若莱北部弗勒里村的 cru 级红葡萄酒，以佳美酿造；葡萄园位于粉红色风化花岗岩坡地，拉马多讷与格里耶-米迪等命名地块常单独标注，风格以花香、轻盈酒体与柔顺口感著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Fleurie
en.summary: A cru-level red wine from the village of Fleurie in northern Beaujolais, France, made from Gamay. Its vineyards sit on pink weathered granite, and named sites such as La Madone and Grille-Midi are often labelled on their own; the style is known for floral aroma, a light body and a supple texture, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 热夫雷-香贝丹
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第夜丘热夫雷-香贝丹村的红葡萄酒，全部以黑皮诺酿造；村内拥有九个特级园，包括香贝丹与香贝丹-贝兹园，风格以结构感、深色果味与陈年潜力著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Gevrey-Chambertin
en.summary: A red wine from the Gevrey-Chambertin commune in Burgundy's Côte de Nuits, France, made entirely from Pinot Noir. The commune holds nine grands crus including Chambertin and Chambertin-Clos de Bèze, and the style is known for structure, dark fruit and ageing potential; commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 吉贡达斯
zh.summary: 法国南罗讷河谷旺度山（Dentelles de Montmirail）山麓的红葡萄酒法定产区，AOC 范围仅限吉贡达斯一村；以歌海娜为主体，常混西拉、慕合怀特与神索，葡萄园从约 100 米台地升至 500 米山麓，风格以石灰岩张力与高海拔清凉感著称；2023 年份起亦获准生产以克莱雷特为主的白葡萄酒，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13%–15% vol。

en.title: Gigondas
en.summary: A red wine appellation in the Southern Rhône Valley, France, whose AOC covers the single village of Gigondas at the foot of the Dentelles de Montmirail; based on Grenache with Syrah, Mourvèdre and Cinsault, with vines from about 100 to 500 metres, a limestone-driven style, and white wine permitted from the 2023 vintage, commonly 750 mL at about 13%–15% vol.

zh.title: 上夜丘
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第夜丘背后丘陵地带的法定产区，葡萄园分布在夜丘各村上方的坡地；红葡萄酒以黑皮诺、白葡萄酒以霞多丽酿造，海拔较高、成熟较晚，风格以清爽酸度与较早适饮著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 11.5%–13% vol。

en.title: Hautes-Côtes de Nuits
en.summary: A Burgundy appellation in the hills behind the Côte de Nuits, France, with vineyards on the slopes above the Côte de Nuits villages; red wine is made from Pinot Noir and white wine from Chardonnay, and the higher altitude and later ripening give a style known for fresh acidity and earlier drinking, commonly 750 mL at about 11.5%–13% vol.

zh.title: 轩尼诗XO
zh.summary: 法国干邑白兰地，由轩尼诗调配百余种生命之水；XO 等级自 2018 年起要求最少 10 年橡木桶陈年，常见酒精度 40% vol。

en.title: Hennessy X.O
en.summary: A Cognac brandy from France, blended from more than a hundred eaux-de-vie; since 2018 the X.O grade has required at least 10 years in oak, with 40% ABV in the standard bottling.

zh.title: 朱利耶纳
zh.summary: 博若莱北部的村庄级 cru 红葡萄酒，名字与尤利乌斯·凯撒的传说相连；花岗岩与片岩交错的坡地给出比希鲁布勒更硬的结构，又比穆兰-阿旺更早适饮，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14% vol。

en.title: Juliénas
en.summary: A village cru from northern Beaujolais whose name is tied to a Julius Caesar legend; granite and schist slopes give it firmer structure than Chiroubles and earlier approachability than Moulin-à-Vent, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14% vol.

zh.title: 库克
zh.summary: 法国兰斯的历史香槟酒庄，1843 年由约瑟夫·库克创立，1999 年加入 LVMH 集团；以多年份调配的 Grande Cuvée 著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5% vol，具体批次与除渣日期以瓶标为准。

en.title: Krug
en.summary: A historic Champagne house in Reims, France, founded in 1843 by Joseph Krug and part of LVMH since 1999; known for the multi-vintage Grande Cuvée, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5% ABV, with batch and disgorgement date to be checked on the label.

zh.title: 莱图瓦勒
zh.summary: 法国汝拉北部的小型白葡萄酒法定产区，只生产白葡萄酒与黄酒、稻草酒；品种以霞多丽与萨瓦涅为主，土壤以石灰岩与泥灰岩为主，风格清爽、酸度高、矿物感明显，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14.5% vol。

en.title: L'Étoile
en.summary: A small white-wine appellation in northern Jura, France, making only white wine as well as vin jaune and vin de paille; the varieties are mainly Chardonnay and Savagnin, the soils mainly limestone and marl, and the style is fresh with high acidity and clear minerality, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14.5% vol.

zh.title: 玛歌产区
zh.summary: 法国波尔多梅多克南部的村级红葡萄酒法定产区，1954 年立法、跨 Arsac、Labarde、Margaux-Cantenac 与 Soussans 四镇，葡萄园约 1,500 公顷、62 家酒庄，1855 年分级中有 21 家列级庄；以砾石阶地上的赤霞珠与梅洛混酿为主，法定基准产量 57 hl/ha、最低天然酒精度 11%。

en.title: Margaux
en.summary: A communal red wine appellation in southern Médoc, Bordeaux, France, recognised in 1954 and spread across Arsac, Labarde, Margaux-Cantenac and Soussans; about 1,500 hectares and 62 estates, with 21 of the 1855 classified growths; Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot on gravel terraces, a 57 hl/ha base yield and 11% minimum natural alcohol.

zh.title: 马爹利蓝带
zh.summary: 马爹利旗下 1912 年创制的干邑，以宝德区原酒为特色，由多个产区、多个年份的调配原酒组合；常见 40% vol、700 mL，具体配比不公开。

en.title: Martell Cordon Bleu
en.summary: A Cognac created by Martell in 1912, known for eaux-de-vie from the Borderies area and blended from several crus and vintages; commonly 40% ABV in 700 mL bottles, with the exact proportions undisclosed.

zh.title: 梅尔居雷
zh.summary: 夏隆内丘的村庄级产区，通常被认为是该子产区面积最大的村庄级产区；红葡萄酒以黑皮诺、白葡萄酒以霞多丽酿造，村内无特级园但一级园众多，红酒风格直接、单宁较明显，常见于日常饮用与餐饮渠道，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Mercurey
en.summary: A village-level appellation in the Côte Chalonnaise, generally regarded as the largest village appellation of that sub-region. Reds come from Pinot Noir and whites from Chardonnay; there is no grand cru but many premiers crus, and the reds are direct with more obvious tannin, often found in everyday drinking and restaurant listings; commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 默尔索
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第伯恩丘默尔索村的干白葡萄酒，以霞多丽酿造，一级园如佩里耶、热内弗里耶与沙尔姆著称；风格比夏布利更饱满，常见榛子、黄油、柑橘与矿物感，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Meursault
en.summary: A dry white wine from the Meursault commune on Burgundy's Côte de Beaune in France, made from Chardonnay and known for premiers crus such as Les Perrières, Les Genevrières and Les Charmes. Fuller than Chablis, with hazelnut, butter, citrus and minerality; commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 酩悦香槟
zh.summary: 酩悦香槟是 1743 年创立于埃佩尔奈的香槟酒庄，以 Brut Impérial 为旗舰无年份款，拥有约 1,300 公顷葡萄园与 28 公里地下酒窖；本文从规模、调配、年份线与价格带拆解其“稳定、易饮、宴会型”的成因。

en.title: Moët & Chandon
en.summary: A Champagne house founded in Épernay in 1743, known for the non-vintage Brut Impérial, about 1,300 hectares of vineyards and more than 28 kilometres of cellars; this entry explains why its style is built for consistency, easy drinking and large-scale hospitality.

zh.title: 莫雷-圣但尼
zh.summary: 夜丘中段的村庄，村名由「莫雷」与「圣但尼园」拼接而成；拥有罗什园、圣但尼园、朗布莱园与塔尔园四座完整特级园，并与邻村分享博纳-马尔与香贝丹-夏尔姆的一部分，风格介于热夫雷的力量与香波的细腻之间，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Morey-Saint-Denis
en.summary: A village in the middle Côte de Nuits whose name joins "Morey" to its Clos Saint-Denis grand cru. It holds four complete grands crus, Clos de la Roche, Clos Saint-Denis, Clos des Lambrays and Clos de Tart, and shares parts of Bonnes-Mares and Charmes-Chambertin, with a style between the power of Gevrey and the finesse of Chambolle; commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 莫尔贡
zh.summary: 法国博若莱北部的村庄级 cru 红葡萄酒，以佳美酿造；葡萄园分布在维利耶-莫尔贡一带的花岗岩坡地，科特迪皮（Côte du Py）是代表性坡面，酒体较厚、单宁较明显、可陈年，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14% vol。

en.title: Morgon
en.summary: A village-level cru red wine from northern Beaujolais in France, made from Gamay, with vineyards on granite slopes around Villié-Morgon and Côte du Py as the signature slope. It is fuller in body with more noticeable tannin and can age, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14% vol.

zh.title: 穆兰-阿旺
zh.summary: 法国博若莱北部村庄级 cru 的红葡萄酒，以佳美酿造；葡萄园分布在罗曼内什-托兰一带的花岗岩坡地，名字来自坡上的老风车，酒体在博若莱 cru 中偏厚、单宁更明显、陈年潜力较强，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14% vol。

en.title: Moulin-à-Vent
en.summary: A village-level cru red wine from northern Beaujolais in France, made from Gamay, with vineyards on granite slopes around Romanèche-Thorins and named after an old windmill on the slope. Among the Beaujolais crus it is fuller with more noticeable tannin and stronger ageing potential, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14% vol.

zh.title: 密斯卡岱
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔河谷南特地区的白葡萄酒法定产区统称，以勃艮第甜瓜（Melon de Bourgogne）酿造；酸度高、香气中性，常经酒泥陈酿，以青苹果、柠檬、白花与咸鲜感著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 11%–12.5% vol。

en.title: Muscadet
en.summary: A group of white wine appellations in the Nantes area of the Loire Valley, France, made from Melon de Bourgogne; high in acidity and neutral in aroma, often lees-aged, with green apple, lemon, white flower and saline notes, commonly 750 mL at about 11%–12.5% vol.

zh.title: 夜圣乔治
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第夜丘产区的黑皮诺红葡萄酒村庄级法定产区，位于第戎以南、博讷以北；以黑樱桃、甘草与泥土气息著称，酒体较坚实，村内有多处一级园但没有特级园，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Nuits-Saint-Georges
en.summary: A village-level Pinot Noir red wine appellation in the Côte de Nuits of Burgundy, France, south of Dijon and north of Beaune; known for black cherry, liquorice and earthy notes with a firmer body, with several premiers crus but no grand cru in the village, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 波亚克产区
zh.summary: 法国波尔多梅多克北部的村级红葡萄酒法定产区，1936 年 11 月 14 日立法，葡萄园约 1,200 公顷，1855 年分级中拥有拉菲、拉图、木桐三家一级庄与共 18 家列级庄；深砾石丘上的赤霞珠占主导，法定基准产量 57 hl/ha、最低天然酒精度 11%。

en.title: Pauillac
en.summary: A communal red wine appellation in northern Médoc, Bordeaux, France, recognised on 14 November 1936, with about 1,200 hectares of vines and 18 classified growths in the 1855 classification, including the first growths Lafite, Latour and Mouton; Cabernet Sauvignon dominates on deep gravel croupes, with a 57 hl/ha base yield and 11% minimum natural alcohol.

zh.title: 佩尔南-韦尔热莱斯
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第伯恩丘科尔通山西侧谷地的村庄级法定产区，2022 年白葡萄 69.7 公顷、红 76.6 公顷，白占近一半；拥有 8 个一级园，Île des Vergelesses 为标志性气候，村内还有科尔通-查理曼的 En Charlemagne 地块。红以花香与较轻单宁见长，白以矿物与酸度见长，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Pernand-Vergelesses
en.summary: A village appellation in the valley on the western side of the hill of Corton in the Côte de Beaune, Burgundy, France, with 69.7 hectares of white and 76.6 hectares of red in 2022, so white makes up nearly half; it has eight premiers crus, including Île des Vergelesses, and contains the En Charlemagne climat of Corton-Charlemagne. Reds are lighter and more floral, whites mineral and fresh, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 佩萨克-雷奥良
zh.summary: 法国波尔多格拉夫北部、波尔多市以南的红白葡萄酒法定产区，1987 年从格拉夫独立；红葡萄酒以赤霞珠与梅洛混酿，白葡萄酒以长相思与赛美蓉酿造，红白都以烟熏、矿物与结构感著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Pessac-Léognan
en.summary: A red and white wine appellation in northern Graves, south of Bordeaux city, France, separated from Graves in 1987; reds blend Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, whites use Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon, and both show smoky, mineral and structured notes, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 波玛
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第伯恩丘波玛村的村庄级法定产区，位于博讷以南；村内有多处一级园但没有特级园，风格以红果、泥土气息与较硬的单宁、较强的结构著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Pommard
en.summary: A village-level Pinot Noir red wine appellation in the Côte de Beaune village of Pommard, Burgundy, France, south of Beaune; the village has several Premier Cru sites but no Grand Cru, and the style is known for red fruit, earth, firmer tannin and stronger structure, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 普伊-富美
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔河谷中央-卢瓦尔地区的长相思干白法定产区，1937 年获 AOC，覆盖卢瓦尔河右岸 7 个村庄约 1,424 公顷；silex 燧石与 Kimmeridgian 泥灰岩并存，以柑橘、青草与"打火石"气息著称。

en.title: Pouilly-Fumé
en.summary: A dry Sauvignon Blanc appellation in the Centre-Loire area of the Loire Valley, France, awarded AOC status in 1937 and covering seven villages on the right bank of the Loire across about 1,424 hectares; silex flint and Kimmeridgian marl give citrus, grass and gunflint notes, commonly 750 mL at about 12%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 雷尼耶
zh.summary: 1988 年才获批成为村庄级 cru 的博若莱红葡萄酒，是十个 cru 中最年轻的一个；雷尼耶-迪雷特一带的花岗岩坡地给出红果与细单宁，价格通常比莫尔贡亲民，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Régnié
en.summary: A Beaujolais village cru approved only in 1988 and the youngest of the ten; granite slopes around Régnié-Durette give red fruit and fine tannin, usually at a more affordable level than Morgon, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 罗曼尼·康帝
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第沃恩-罗曼尼村的特级园，由罗曼尼·康帝酒庄独占，面积 1.8140 公顷，全部种植黑皮诺。

en.title: Romanée-Conti
en.summary: A grand cru monopole in Vosne-Romanée, Burgundy, owned by Domaine de la Romanée-Conti; 1.8140 hectares planted entirely to Pinot Noir.

zh.title: 萨瓦胡塞特
zh.summary: 法国萨瓦以阿尔泰斯（当地称胡塞特）酿造的白葡萄酒法定产区，涵盖马雷斯特尔、蒙图、蒙泰尔米诺与弗朗吉等地理命名；风格以白花、蜂蜜、榛子与矿物感为主，酒体比雅克儿更饱满，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.0%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Roussette de Savoie
en.summary: A white-wine appellation in the Savoie region of France made from Altesse, known locally as Roussette, with geographical names including Marestel, Monthoux, Monterminod and Frangy; the style shows white flowers, honey, hazelnut and minerality with a fuller body than Jacquère, commonly 750 mL at about 12.0%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 圣阿穆尔
zh.summary: 博若莱最北端的村庄级 cru 红葡萄酒，产区横跨索恩-卢瓦尔与罗讷两个省；花岗岩与片岩的坡地让它比南部 cru 更紧、香料感更明显，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Saint-Amour
en.summary: The northernmost village cru of Beaujolais, its appellation spanning the Saône-et-Loire and Rhône departments; granite and schist slopes make it firmer and spicier than the southern crus, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 圣欧班
zh.summary: 伯恩丘山谷高处的村庄级产区，常被默尔索与夏瑟尼-蒙哈榭的山脊遮住；以白葡萄酒为主，也产红葡萄酒，拥有约三十个一级园而无特级园，白酒酸度高、矿物感强，通常被视为伯恩丘白葡萄酒中相对克制的选择，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Saint-Aubin
en.summary: A village-level appellation on the high ground of a Côte de Beaune valley, often hidden behind the ridge from Meursault and Chassagne-Montrachet. White wine dominates and red is also made; there is no grand cru, about thirty premiers crus, and the whites show high acidity and strong minerality, usually a more restrained Côte de Beaune white; commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 圣埃美隆
zh.summary: 法国波尔多右岸圣埃美隆镇及其周边村落的红葡萄酒法定产区，位于多尔多涅河右岸、利布尔讷东北；以梅洛为主体、常与品丽珠混酿，风格圆润，以李子、黑樱桃、巧克力与泥土气息著称，拥有独立的分级体系，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Saint-Émilion
en.summary: A red wine appellation around the town of Saint-Émilion and neighbouring communes on the right bank of the Dordogne in Bordeaux, France, northeast of Libourne; based on Merlot and often blended with Cabernet Franc, rounder in style, with plum, black cherry, chocolate and earth notes, and its own classification system, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 圣约瑟夫
zh.summary: 法国北罗讷河谷的法定产区，沿罗讷河两岸南北延伸数十公里；以叙拉（Syrah）红葡萄酒为主，风格比罗第丘与埃米塔日更轻盈，也产少量白葡萄酒，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–14% vol。

en.title: Saint-Joseph
en.summary: An appellation in the northern Rhône Valley of France, stretching tens of kilometres along both banks of the Rhône; mainly Syrah red wine, lighter in style than Côte-Rôtie and Hermitage, with a small amount of white wine, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–14% vol.

zh.title: 圣朱利安产区
zh.summary: 法国波尔多梅多克中部的村级红葡萄酒法定产区，1936 年 11 月 14 日立法，约 910 公顷葡萄园，11 家 1855 列级庄（5 家二级、2 家三级、4 家四级）且没有一级庄；砾石分布为梅多克最均匀，法定基准产量 57 hl/ha、最低天然酒精度 11%。

en.title: Saint-Julien
en.summary: A communal red wine appellation in central Médoc, Bordeaux, France, recognised on 14 November 1936, with about 910 hectares of vines and 11 classified growths in the 1855 classification (five second, two third and four fourth growths, no first growth); its gravel is the most uniform in the Médoc, with a 57 hl/ha base yield and 11% minimum natural alcohol.

zh.title: 桑塞尔
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔河谷上游的桑塞尔法定产区，白葡萄酒以长相思酿造，以柑橘、青草、醋栗与燧石矿物感著称；也产少量以黑皮诺酿造的红葡萄酒；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Sancerre
en.summary: An appellation in the upper Loire, France, whose white wines are made from Sauvignon Blanc and known for citrus, cut grass, gooseberry and flinty minerality, with a small amount of red wine from Pinot Noir. Commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 桑特奈
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第伯恩丘最南端的村庄级法定产区，AOC 覆盖桑特奈与索恩-卢瓦尔省的雷米尼两村；2022 年红 258.3 公顷、白 72.4 公顷，红占近八成，村内无特级园而有 11 个一级园。红以黑皮诺、白以霞多丽酿造，风格较北邻夏瑟尼更紧实、更早适饮，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Santenay
en.summary: A village-level appellation at the southern edge of the Côte de Beaune, Burgundy, France, whose AOC covers Santenay in the Côte-d'Or and Remigny in Saône-et-Loire; in 2022 it had 258.3 hectares of red and 72.4 hectares of white, red making up nearly 80%, with 11 premiers crus and no grand cru. Reds are firm and saline rather than creamy, whites lean and mineral, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 索米尔-尚皮尼
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔河谷安茹-索米尔地区的品丽珠红葡萄酒法定产区，1957 年 12 月 31 日独立成 AOC，覆盖 Saumur 及周边 7 个市镇；葡萄园建在 tuffeau 石灰岩台地上，以覆盆子、紫罗兰与青椒气息著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Saumur-Champigny
en.summary: A Cabernet Franc red wine appellation in the Anjou-Saumur area of the Loire Valley, France, recognised as its own AOC on 31 December 1957 and covering Saumur plus seven surrounding villages; vineyards sit on tuffeau limestone, giving raspberry, violet and graphite notes, commonly 750 mL at about 12%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 萨韦涅尔
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔河谷安茹地区的白诗南干白法定产区，1952 年 12 月 8 日获 AOC，仅覆盖卢瓦尔河右岸 3 个市镇、约 140 公顷投产；以片岩坡地、低产量与高酸矿物感著称，并包含 Coulée de Serrant 与 Roche aux Moines 两个独立 AOC。

en.title: Savennières
en.summary: A dry Chenin Blanc appellation in the Anjou area of the Loire Valley, France, recognised on 8 December 1952 and covering three communes on the right bank with about 140 hectares in production; schist slopes, very low yields and high-acid minerality define the style, and the area contains the separate AOCs of Coulée de Serrant and Roche aux Moines.

zh.title: 萨维尼-莱博讷
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第伯恩丘的村庄级法定产区，2022 年红 300.1 公顷、白 47.8 公顷，拥有 22 个一级园、无特级园；红以黑皮诺、白以霞多丽与白皮诺酿造。Rhoin 河谷把它分成朝南与朝东两面坡，风格从细腻到圆润并存，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Savigny-lès-Beaune
en.summary: A village appellation in the Côte de Beaune, Burgundy, France, with 300.1 hectares of red and 47.8 hectares of white in 2022, 22 premiers crus and no grand cru; reds come from Pinot Noir, whites from Chardonnay and Pinot Blanc. The Rhoin divides two slopes with distinct soils, giving both rounder and firmer styles, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 瓦给拉斯
zh.summary: 法国南罗讷河谷的法定产区，横跨瓦给拉斯与萨里扬两个市镇，葡萄园位于乌韦兹河 60–160 米的河成阶地上；红葡萄酒以歌海娜至少 50%、西拉与慕合怀特合计至少 20% 为骨架，同时产桃红与少量白葡萄酒，风格比吉贡达斯更宽、更早适饮，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13.5%–15% vol。

en.title: Vacqueyras
en.summary: A Southern Rhône appellation in France spanning the two communes of Vacqueyras and Sarrians, with vineyards on 60–160 metre river terraces of the Ouvèze; reds require at least 50% Grenache and at least 20% Syrah and Mourvèdre combined, with rosé and a little white also made, typically broader and earlier-drinking than Gigondas, commonly 750 mL at about 13.5%–15% vol.

zh.title: 凯歌香槟
zh.summary: 凯歌香槟是 1772 年创立于兰斯的香槟酒庄，1805 年由 27 岁遗孀芭布-妮可·蓬萨丹接手，1816 年完善转瓶台工艺；本文从“寡妇凯歌”、黄标调配、La Grande Dame 与年份差异解释其黑皮诺骨架。

en.title: Veuve Clicquot
en.summary: A Champagne house founded in Reims in 1772, taken over in 1805 by the twenty-seven-year-old widow Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin and known for perfecting the riddling table in 1816; this entry explains the Yellow Label blend, La Grande Dame and the house's Pinot Noir frame.

zh.title: 萨瓦葡萄酒
zh.summary: 法国东南部阿尔卑斯山区的区域级法定产区，覆盖萨瓦与上萨瓦多片山谷坡地；白葡萄酒以雅克儿、阿尔泰斯与霞多丽为主，红葡萄酒以梦杜斯为主，旗下有阿普勒蒙、阿比姆、希尼安等地理命名，风格清爽、酸度高，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 11.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Vin de Savoie
en.summary: A regional appellation in the French Alps of south-east France, covering valley slopes across Savoie and Haute-Savoie; whites are based on Jacquère, Altesse and Chardonnay and reds on Mondeuse, with named places such as Apremont, Abymes and Chignin, in fresh, high-acid styles, commonly 750 mL at about 11.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 沃尔奈
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第伯恩丘沃尔奈村的村庄级法定产区，位于博讷西南；村内有多处一级园但没有特级园，风格以细腻香气、红果与花香著称，通常比波玛更轻盈，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Volnay
en.summary: A village-level Pinot Noir red wine appellation in the Côte de Beaune village of Volnay, Burgundy, France, southwest of Beaune; the village has several Premier Cru sites but no Grand Cru, and the style is known for fine aroma, red fruit and flowers, usually lighter than Pommard, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 沃恩-罗曼尼
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第夜丘沃恩-罗曼尼的村庄级法定产区，以黑皮诺酿造红葡萄酒；村内及产区周边共有八个特级园，包括罗曼尼·康帝 1.81 公顷的单一所有园，风格以香料、红果、丝绒质地与长陈年潜力著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Vosne-Romanée
en.summary: A village appellation in the Côte de Nuits of Burgundy, France, making red wine from Pinot Noir; the village and its appellation hold eight grands crus, including the 1.81-hectare Romanée-Conti monopole, and the style is known for spice, red fruit, velvety texture and long ageing potential, commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 武若
zh.summary: 夜丘中段的小村，全部声望集中于围墙内的武若园特级园；村内没有一级园，村庄级产量很小，红酒以黑皮诺、白酒以霞多丽酿造，园内坡位与土层造成同名酒款的明显分化，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 12.5%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Vougeot
en.summary: A small village in the middle of the Côte de Nuits whose reputation rests almost entirely on the walled Clos de Vougeot grand cru. There is no premier cru, village-level output is tiny, reds come from Pinot Noir and whites from Chardonnay, and slope position and soil depth create marked differences under one grand cru name; commonly 750 mL at about 12.5%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 武弗雷
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔河谷都兰地区的白诗南法定产区，位于卢瓦尔河右岸图尔以东；同一产区内可产干型、半干、甜型与起泡酒，以榅桲、苹果、蜂蜜与燧石矿物感著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 11%–13.5% vol。

en.title: Vouvray
en.summary: A Chenin Blanc appellation in the Touraine area of France's Loire Valley, on the right bank of the Loire east of Tours. One appellation produces dry, off-dry, sweet and sparkling wines, known for quince, apple, honey and flinty minerality; commonly 750 mL at about 11%–13.5% vol.

zh.title: 伊慕沙尔霍夫贝格雷司令
zh.summary: 德国摩泽尔萨尔河谷伊慕家族的雷司令，产自沙尔霍夫贝格园，以板岩土壤、高酸度与低酒精度著称；常见 750 mL，酒精度多在 7.5%–10% vol，具体以瓶标与年份为准。

en.title: Egon Müller Scharzhofberger Riesling
en.summary: A Riesling from the Egon Müller estate in the Saar valley of Germany's Mosel region, grown in the Scharzhofberg site and known for slate soils, high acidity and modest alcohol. Commonly 750 mL, with alcohol usually between 7.5%–10% vol, depending on the vintage and grade.

zh.title: 普朗卫恩日晷园雷司令
zh.summary: 德国摩泽尔中部卫恩村日晷园的雷司令，由普朗家族酒庄（Joh. Jos. Prüm）酿造；园地为陡坡板岩，酒精度低、酸度高，以青柠、白桃、湿板岩与蜂蜜气息著称；常见 750 mL，酒精度多在 7%–9.5% vol。

en.title: Joh. Jos. Prüm Wehlener Sonnenuhr Riesling
en.summary: A Riesling from the Wehlener Sonnenuhr site in Wehlen, Middle Mosel, Germany, made by the Prüm family estate Joh. Jos. Prüm. Steep slate slopes give low alcohol and high acidity, with lime, white peach, wet slate and honey notes; commonly 750 mL, usually 7%–9.5% vol.

zh.title: 罗伯特·威尔基德里希伯爵山雷司令
zh.summary: 德国莱茵高基德里希村伯爵山园的雷司令，由 1867 年创立的罗伯特·威尔酒庄酿造；园地为陡坡板岩与壤土，干型与甜型等级并存，以柑橘、白桃、矿物与蜂蜜气息著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 10%–13% vol。

en.title: Robert Weil Kiedricher Gräfenberg Riesling
en.summary: A Riesling from the Kiedricher Gräfenberg site in Kiedrich, Rheingau, Germany, made by Weingut Robert Weil, founded in 1867. Steep slate and loam soils give both dry and sweet grades, with citrus, white peach, mineral and honey notes; commonly 750 mL at about 10%–13% vol.

zh.title: 唯森小麦白啤
zh.summary: 德国巴伐利亚弗赖辛唯森修道院酒厂的小麦啤酒，酒厂酿造史可追溯至 1040 年；常见 5.4% vol、500 mL，瓶中带酵母，以香蕉、丁香与香草风味著称。

en.title: Weihenstephaner Hefe Weissbier
en.summary: A wheat beer from the Weihenstephan abbey brewery in Freising, Bavaria, with a brewing history traced to 1040; commonly 5.4% ABV in 500 mL bottles, with yeast in the bottle and banana, clove and vanilla notes.

zh.title: 格兰菲迪 18 年
zh.summary: 苏格兰斯佩塞的单一麦芽威士忌，在奥罗索雪莉桶与波本桶中陈年 18 年，再以小批量婚桶调和；常见 40% vol，部分市场为 43% vol。

en.title: Glenfiddich 18 Year Old
en.summary: A Speyside single malt Scotch whisky matured for 18 years in Oloroso sherry and bourbon casks and then married in small batches. Commonly 40% ABV, with 43% ABV in some markets.

zh.title: 长城五星赤霞珠
zh.summary: 长城五星系列中的赤霞珠干红葡萄酒，常见 750 mL 瓶装、酒精度约 12%-13% vol；五星属于企业星级体系，具体产区与生产商以瓶标为准。

en.title: Greatwall Five-Star Cabernet Sauvignon
en.summary: A Cabernet Sauvignon dry red wine in Greatwall's five-star series, commonly 750 mL with about 12%-13% ABV; the stars are a company grading system, and the origin and producer should be checked on the bottle label.

zh.title: 茅台酒
zh.summary: 产自贵州仁怀茅台镇的酱香型白酒代表，以高粱和小麦高温大曲酿造，常见酒精度 53% vol。

en.title: Moutai
en.summary: A sauce-aroma baijiu from Maotai, Guizhou, made from sorghum and wheat qu and commonly bottled at 53% ABV.

zh.title: 古井贡酒古20
zh.summary: 古井贡酒年份原浆系列的高端单品，浓香型，常见 52% vol、500 mL，产自安徽亳州。“古20”是产品名，不是瓶中酒龄。

en.title: Gujing Gongjiu Gu20
en.summary: A high-end product in Gujing Gongjiu's Nianfen Yuanjiang series, strong aroma, commonly 52% ABV in 500 mL, from Bozhou, Anhui. "Gu20" is a product name, not the age of the liquid.

zh.title: 国窖1573
zh.summary: 泸州老窖的高端浓香型单品，名称取自始建于 1573 年的窖池群，常见 52% vol、500 mL。名称不等于瓶中酒龄。

en.title: Guojiao 1573
en.summary: A high-end strong-aroma product from Luzhou Laojiao, named after the pit group begun in 1573, commonly 52% ABV in 500 mL. The name is not the age of the liquid.

zh.title: 红西凤
zh.summary: 陕西西凤酒的高端战略单品，凤香型，常见 52% vol、500 mL，产自陕西凤翔柳林镇；以酒海陈藏与多阶段窖池发酵为工艺特征。

en.title: Hong Xifeng
en.summary: A high-end strategic product of Shaanxi Xifeng, in the feng-aroma category; commonly 52% ABV in 500 mL and made in Liulin Town, Fengxiang, Shaanxi. Its signature process combines multi-stage pit fermentation with ageing in wine-sea containers.

zh.title: 红星二锅头蓝瓶
zh.summary: 北京红星股份有限公司的清香型二锅头产品，常见 43% vol、500 mL；以红高粱为原料、大曲为糖化发酵剂，采用混蒸混烧、老五甑与掐头去尾取中段的工艺。

en.title: Red Star Erguotou Blue Bottle
en.summary: A light-aroma er-guotou product from Beijing Red Star Co., Ltd., commonly 43% ABV in 500 mL, made from red sorghum with a barley and pea qu, using mixed steaming and firing, the five-pot process and the cut of head and tail to keep the middle.

zh.title: 会稽山纯正五年
zh.summary: 会稽山旗下的五年陈绍兴黄酒，常见 500 mL 坛装或瓶装，以糯米、麦曲与鉴湖水酿造；常见酒精度约 15% vol，糖分类型以瓶标标注为准。

en.title: Kuaijishan Chunzheng 5
en.summary: A five-year aged Shaoxing huangjiu from Kuaijishan, commonly 500 mL in jar or bottle, brewed from glutinous rice, wheat qu and Jian Lake water; about 15% ABV, with the sugar type to be confirmed on the bottle label.

zh.title: 会稽山·兰亭
zh.summary: 会稽山旗下的高端绍兴黄酒产品线，含兰亭序、兰亭国潮、兰亭国酒与兰亭大师等价位档；产自绍兴柯桥区湖塘，以糯米、麦曲与鉴湖水酿造，多为半干型、14% vol 上下，年份表达须按 GB/T 17946 的加权平均酒龄规则阅读。

en.title: Kuaijishan Lanting
