en.summary: Kuaijishan's premium Shaoxing yellow-rice wine line, sold as Lanting Xu, Lanting Guochao, Lanting Guoju and Lanting Dashi at different prices; made in Hutong, Keqiao from glutinous rice, wheat qu and Jian Lake water, mostly semi-dry at around 14% ABV, with vintage wording governed by the weighted-average age rule in GB/T 17946.

zh.title: 酒鬼酒
zh.summary: 产自湖南吉首的馥郁香型白酒，融合浓香、清香和酱香工艺特点，常见酒精度 52% vol。

en.title: Jiugui
en.summary: A fuyu-aroma baijiu from Jishou, Hunan, combining strong-, light- and sauce-aroma production features.

zh.title: 健力士世涛啤酒
zh.summary: 爱尔兰都柏林圣詹姆斯门啤酒厂生产的干世涛，代表产品酒精度约 4.2% vol，以烘焙大麦和氮气充填形成的绵密口感著称。

en.title: Guinness Draught
en.summary: A dry stout from the St James's Gate brewery in Dublin, Ireland; the flagship is about 4.2% ABV and known for its roasted barley depth and nitrogen-conditioned texture.

zh.title: 尊美醇爱尔兰威士忌
zh.summary: 爱尔兰调和威士忌品牌，1780 年创立于都柏林，现由科克的 Midleton 蒸馏厂生产；三次蒸馏，常见酒精度 40% vol。

en.title: Jameson Irish Whiskey
en.summary: An Irish blended whiskey brand founded in Dublin in 1780 and now made at Midleton in Cork; triple distilled, usually 40% ABV.

zh.title: 阿玛罗尼
zh.summary: 意大利威尼托瓦坡里切拉产区的红葡萄酒，以科维纳、科维诺内与罗迪内拉等品种风干后酿造，酒体饱满、酒精高、带果干与樱桃气息；DOCG 规则要求风干与较长陈年，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 15%–16% vol。

en.title: Amarone della Valpolicella
en.summary: A red wine from the Valpolicella area of Veneto, Italy, made from Corvina, Corvinone and Rondinella grapes dried before fermentation, giving a full body, high alcohol and notes of dried fruit and cherry. The DOCG rules require drying and extended ageing; commonly 750 mL at about 15%–16% vol.

zh.title: 巴巴莱斯科
zh.summary: 意大利皮埃蒙特巴巴莱斯科法定产区的红葡萄酒，只用内比奥罗酿造，风格比巴罗洛更柔和、更早适饮，以玫瑰、红樱桃与香料香气著称；DOCG 规则要求总陈年不少于 26 个月，其中木桶不少于 9 个月；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13.5%–14.5% vol。

en.title: Barbaresco
en.summary: A red wine from the Barbaresco DOCG in Piedmont, Italy, made only from Nebbiolo and softer and earlier to drink than Barolo, known for aromas of rose, red cherry and spice. The rules require at least 26 months of total ageing with at least 9 months in wood; commonly 750 mL at about 13.5%–14.5% vol.

zh.title: 巴罗洛
zh.summary: 意大利皮埃蒙特朗格丘陵的巴罗洛法定产区红葡萄酒，只用内比奥罗酿造，以高酸度、强单宁与玫瑰、焦油香气著称；DOCG 规则要求总陈年不少于 38 个月，其中木桶不少于 18 个月；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 14%–15% vol。

en.title: Barolo
en.summary: A red wine from the Barolo DOCG in the Langhe hills of Piedmont, Italy, made only from Nebbiolo and known for high acidity, firm tannin and aromas of rose and tar. The rules require at least 38 months of total ageing with at least 18 months in wood; commonly 750 mL at about 14%–15% vol.

zh.title: 布鲁奈罗
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳蒙塔奇诺的布鲁奈罗法定产区红葡萄酒，以桑娇维塞酿成，酒体饱满、酸度高、单宁强；DOCG 规则要求自采收次年起至少陈年 5 年，其中橡木桶不少于 2 年、瓶中不少于 4 个月；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 14.5% vol。

en.title: Brunello di Montalcino
en.summary: A red wine from the Montalcino appellation in Tuscany, Italy, made from Sangiovese and full-bodied with high acidity and firm tannin. The DOCG rules require at least 5 years of ageing from the year after harvest, including at least 2 years in oak and 4 months in bottle; commonly 750 mL at about 14.5% vol.

zh.title: 金巴利
zh.summary: 意大利苦味开胃酒，1860 年由 Gaspare Campari 在米兰创立；酒精度通常 20.5%–25% vol，苦甜平衡，是内格罗尼的核心材料。

en.title: Campari
en.summary: An Italian bitter aperitif created in Milan in 1860 by Gaspare Campari; usually 20.5%–25% ABV, with a bitter-sweet balance, and the core ingredient of the Negroni.

zh.title: 基安蒂经典
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳基安蒂山区的基安蒂经典法定产区红葡萄酒，以桑娇维塞为主体，酸度高、单宁清晰，以酸樱桃、紫罗兰与皮革香气著称；产区要求至少 80% 桑娇维塞，普通款陈年不少于 12 个月，Riserva 不少于 24 个月；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13%–14.5% vol。

en.title: Chianti Classico
en.summary: A red wine from the Chianti Classico DOCG in the Chianti hills of Tuscany, Italy, based on Sangiovese with high acidity and clear tannin, known for aromas of sour cherry, violet and leather. The rules require at least 80% Sangiovese, with at least 12 months of ageing for the standard wine and 24 months for Riserva; commonly 750 mL at about 13%–14.5% vol.

zh.title: 普罗塞克
zh.summary: 意大利威尼托与弗留利的起泡酒，以格莱拉葡萄酿造，多用罐式二次发酵，以青苹果、梨与白花香气和轻盈酒体著称；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 11%–12% vol，分 Prosecco DOC 与两处 DOCG。

en.title: Prosecco
en.summary: A sparkling wine from Veneto and Friuli in Italy, made from Glera and mostly fermented a second time in tank, known for green apple, pear and white flower aromas and a light body. Commonly 750 mL at about 11%–12% vol, with a broad Prosecco DOC and two DOCG areas.

zh.title: 蒙塔希诺罗索
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳蒙塔希诺产区的红葡萄酒，法定级别为 DOC，以桑娇维塞酿造；与布鲁奈罗同产区、同品种，但陈年要求更短、风格更轻盈，通常采收次年即可上市；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13%–14% vol。

en.title: Rosso di Montalcino
en.summary: A red wine from the Montalcino area of Tuscany, Italy, classed as DOC and made from Sangiovese. It shares the area and the variety with Brunello but has shorter ageing rules and a lighter style, usually released the year after harvest; commonly 750 mL at about 13%–14% vol.

zh.title: 西施佳雅
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳保格利产区的葡萄酒，以赤霞珠和品丽珠为主；首个商业年份为 1968，2013 年起拥有独立的 DOC 产区。

en.title: Sassicaia
en.summary: A wine from Bolgheri in Tuscany, Italy, based on Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc; the first commercial vintage was 1968, and since 2013 it has had its own DOC appellation.

zh.title: 山崎单一麦芽威士忌
zh.summary: 日本三得利在大阪府岛本町设立的麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，1923 年投产，常见酒精度 43% vol，以水楢桶与雪莉桶风格著称。

en.title: Yamazaki Single Malt
en.summary: Suntory's malt whisky distillery in Shimamoto, Osaka Prefecture, opened in 1923; commonly 43% ABV, known for mizunara and sherry-cask styles.

zh.title: 山崎12年
zh.summary: 日本山崎蒸馏所出品的单一麦芽威士忌，酒龄标注为 12 年；常见 700 mL、酒精度约 43% vol，具体版本与批次以瓶标为准。

en.title: Yamazaki 12
en.summary: A single malt whisky from the Yamazaki distillery in Japan, with a stated age of 12 years; commonly 700 mL at about 43% ABV, with version and batch to be checked on the label.

zh.title: 洋河酒
zh.summary: 产自江苏宿迁的浓香型白酒品牌，以“绵柔”风格和蓝色经典系列知名，酒精度覆盖 38%–52% vol。

en.title: Yanghe
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu brand from Suqian, Jiangsu, known for a soft, mellow style and strengths from 38% to 52% ABV.

zh.title: 酒鬼酒·内参
zh.summary: 酒鬼酒股份有限公司旗下的高端馥郁香型单品，常见 52% vol、500 mL，产自湖南湘西吉首；内参定位高端与礼赠，是酒鬼酒品牌向上延伸的核心产品。

en.title: Jiugui Neican
en.summary: A high-end fuyu-aroma product from Jiugui Liquor, commonly bottled at 52% ABV in 500 mL and made in Jishou, Xiangxi, Hunan. Neican sits at the top of the brand's price range and is a core product in its move upmarket.

zh.title: 口子窖10年
zh.summary: 安徽口子酒业旗下的兼香型白酒，正式产品名常写作“口子窖十年型”，常见 41% vol 或 46% vol、500 mL；“10年”是产品系列命名，不等于瓶中酒龄。

en.title: Kouzijiao 10 Year
en.summary: A mixed-aroma baijiu from Anhui Kouzi Distillery, formally sold as Kouzijiao Ten-Year Type and commonly bottled at 41% or 46% ABV in 500 mL. The "10 years" in the name is a series designation, not the age of the liquid.

zh.title: 衡水老白干古法20
zh.summary: 河北衡水老白干酒业旗下的老白干香型白酒，常见 67% vol、500 mL；“古法20”是产品系列命名，不等于瓶中酒龄，高度数是这款酒的显著特征。

en.title: Hengshui Laobaigan Gufa 20
en.summary: A laobaigan-aroma baijiu from Hebei Hengshui Laobaigan, commonly bottled at 67% ABV in 500 mL. "Gufa 20" is a series designation rather than the age of the liquid, and the high strength is a defining feature.

zh.title: 梦之蓝M9
zh.summary: 洋河蓝色经典系列的高端单品，绵柔浓香型，常见 38%–52% vol、500 mL。M9 是产品代号，不是酒龄或等级证书。

en.title: Meng Zhi Lan M9
en.summary: A high-end product in Yanghe's Blue Classic series, mellow-soft strong aroma, commonly 38-52% ABV in 500 mL. M9 is a product code, not a vintage or a grade certificate.

zh.title: 茅台1935
zh.summary: 贵州茅台推出的酱香型白酒单品，2022 年上市，常见 53% vol、500 mL，产自贵州仁怀；名称中的 1935 指向品牌叙事中的历史年份，具体含义与批次信息以企业公开表述和瓶标为准。

en.title: Moutai 1935
en.summary: A sauce-aroma baijiu released by Guizhou Moutai in 2022, commonly 53% ABV and 500 mL, produced in Renhuai, Guizhou; the 1935 in the name points to a historical year in the brand narrative, and the exact meaning, batch and packaging should be checked against company statements and the bottle label.

zh.title: 喜力
zh.summary: 荷兰阿姆斯特丹喜力公司自 1873 年起生产的淡色拉格，常见 5.0% vol、330 mL；以自家 A 酵母、标志性绿瓶与清爽略带苦味的风格著称，是全球分布最广的啤酒品牌之一。

en.title: Heineken
en.summary: A pale lager brewed by Heineken of Amsterdam since 1873, usually 5.0% vol in 330 mL; known for its proprietary A-yeast, the signature green bottle and a crisp, lightly bitter style, and one of the most widely distributed beer brands in the world.

zh.title: 云雾之湾长相思
zh.summary: 新西兰马尔堡云雾之湾酒庄的长相思干白，1985 年首次酿造，以柑橘、百香果与青草香气著称；常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13% vol，具体年份与批次以瓶标为准。

en.title: Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc
en.summary: A dry Sauvignon Blanc from Cloudy Bay in Marlborough, New Zealand, first made in 1985 and known for citrus, passion fruit and green-grass aromas. Commonly 750 mL at about 13% ABV; the actual vintage and batch are shown on the label.

zh.title: 牛栏山陈酿
zh.summary: 牛栏山品牌的浓香型白酒，俗称“白牛二”，常见 42% vol、500 mL；按固液法白酒标准生产，“陈酿”是产品名而不是酒龄。

en.title: Niulanshan Chenniang
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu from the Niulanshan brand, nicknamed "Bai Niuer" and commonly 42% ABV in 500 mL. It is made to the solid-liquid baijiu standard, and "chenniang" is a product name rather than an age statement.

zh.title: 奔富 Bin 389
zh.summary: 奔富酒庄以赤霞珠与设拉子混酿的经典红酒，1960 年首次酿造，因使用曾装过葛兰许的橡木桶而被称为“小葛兰许”；Bin 编号来自酒窖储位，不是等级。常见 750 mL，酒精度约 14.5% vol。

en.title: Penfolds Bin 389
en.summary: Penfolds' classic Cabernet and Shiraz red, first made in 1960 and nicknamed Baby Grange because it matures in barrels that held the previous Grange vintage. The Bin number comes from a cellar storage bay, not a grade. Usually 750 mL and about 14.5% vol.

zh.title: 青花汾酒30
zh.summary: 汾酒高端清香型单品，常见 53% vol、500 mL。企业公开表述称以 30 年基酒勾调，名称中的“30”不是瓶中酒龄的统一承诺。

en.title: Qinghua Fenjiu 30
en.summary: A high-end light-aroma product from Fenjiu, commonly 53% ABV in 500 mL. Company material says it is blended with 30-year base spirit; the "30" in the name is not a uniform age promise for every bottle.

zh.title: 青花郎
zh.summary: 四川郎酒旗下的高端酱香型单品，常见规格为 53% vol、500 mL，产自四川古蔺二郎镇赤水河左岸；2021 年起以“庄园酱酒”作为战略定位。

en.title: Qinghualang
en.summary: A high-end sauce-aroma product from Sichuan Langjiu, commonly 53% ABV in 500 mL and made in Erlang town, Gulin, Sichuan, on the left bank of the Chishui River; since 2021 it has been positioned as an estate sauce-aroma spirit.

zh.title: 阿贝 10 年
zh.summary: 苏格兰艾雷岛的重泥煤单一麦芽威士忌，在波本桶中陈年至少 10 年，非冷凝过滤，常见 46% vol、700 mL；以焦油、烟熏与咖啡风味著称。

en.title: Ardbeg 10 Year Old
en.summary: A heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky from Islay, matured for at least 10 years in bourbon casks, non-chill filtered and commonly 46% ABV in 700 mL bottles; known for tar, smoke and coffee notes.

zh.title: 百龄坛 17 年
zh.summary: 百龄坛旗下的 17 年调和苏格兰威士忌，酒液陈年至少 17 年，常见 40% vol；以 Glenburgie、Miltonduff、Glentauchers 三家酒厂的麦芽为风格骨架，呈蜂蜜、香草与柔和烟熏。

en.title: Ballantine's 17 Year Old
en.summary: A 17-year-old blended Scotch from Ballantine's, with all whisky aged at least 17 years and commonly bottled at 40% ABV; Glenburgie, Miltonduff and Glentauchers form the malt backbone, giving honey, vanilla and a soft smoke.

zh.title: 芝华士 18 年
zh.summary: 芝华士旗下的 18 年调和苏格兰威士忌，1997 年由 Colin Scott 推出、2004 年定名 Gold Signature；常见 40% vol，以 Strathisla 麦芽为骨架，呈干果、黑巧克力与肉桂。

en.title: Chivas Regal 18 Year Old
en.summary: An 18-year-old blended Scotch from Chivas Regal, launched in 1997 by Colin Scott and named Gold Signature in 2004; commonly 40% ABV, with Strathisla malt at heart and notes of dried fruit, dark chocolate and cinnamon.

zh.title: 拉弗格 10 年
zh.summary: 苏格兰艾雷岛的单一麦芽威士忌，以泥煤烘麦与海洋气息著称，在波本桶中陈年至少 10 年；常见 40% vol（部分市场为 43% vol），700 mL。

en.title: Laphroaig 10 Year Old
en.summary: A single malt Scotch whisky from the south coast of Islay, known for peat-smoked malt and maritime character and matured for at least 10 years in bourbon casks. Commonly 40% ABV (43% ABV in some markets), 700 mL.

zh.title: 麦卡伦12年
zh.summary: 苏格兰斯佩赛产区的单一麦芽威士忌，以雪莉风味桶陈酿为特色，酒龄标注为 12 年；常见 700 mL 或 750 mL、酒精度约 40% vol，具体版本与批次以瓶标为准。

en.title: The Macallan 12
en.summary: A single malt whisky from Speyside, Scotland, known for sherry-seasoned cask maturation, with a stated age of 12 years; commonly 700 mL or 750 mL at about 40% ABV, with version and batch to be checked on the label.

zh.title: 麦卡伦18年雪莉桶
zh.summary: 苏格兰斯佩塞单一麦芽威士忌，1824 年创立；雪莉调味橡木桶陈年，18 年款常见酒精度 43% vol。

en.title: The Macallan 18 Sherry Oak
en.summary: A Speyside single malt Scotch whisky founded in 1824; aged in sherry-seasoned oak, with the 18-year-old usually bottled at 43% ABV.

zh.title: 西凤酒
zh.summary: 产自陕西凤翔的凤香型白酒代表，以高粱为原料、土暗窖发酵、酒海贮存，常见酒精度 55% vol。

en.title: Xifengjiu
en.summary: A phoenix-aroma baijiu from Fengxiang, Shaanxi, made with sorghum and a barley, wheat and pea qu.

zh.title: 张裕葡萄酒
zh.summary: 山东烟台葡萄酒品牌，张裕公司创建于 1892 年，产品覆盖干红、干白与白兰地，常用蛇龙珠、赤霞珠、霞多丽等品种。

en.title: Changyu Wine
en.summary: A wine brand from Yantai, Shandong; Changyu was founded in 1892 and makes red, white and brandy products from varieties such as Cabernet Gernischt, Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay.

zh.title: 即墨老酒
zh.summary: 山东即墨出产的黄酒，以黍米与麦曲酿制，沿用“古遗六法”的传统工艺；常见 500 mL 瓶装、酒精度约 12% vol，糖分类型与年份以瓶标为准。

en.title: Jimo Laojiu
en.summary: A yellow wine from Jimo, Shandong, made from broomcorn millet and wheat qu in the traditional "six methods handed down from antiquity"; commonly 500 mL at about 12% ABV, with sugar type and vintage to be checked on the label.

zh.title: 青岛啤酒
zh.summary: 产自山东青岛的拉格啤酒品牌，1903 年创办，主力产品酒精度约 4% vol，是中国历史最久的啤酒品牌之一。

en.title: Tsingtao Beer
en.summary: A lager brand from Qingdao, Shandong, founded in 1903; its flagship is about 4% ABV and it is one of China's oldest beer brands.

zh.title: 汾酒
zh.summary: 产自山西汾阳杏花村的清香型白酒代表，以高粱、大麦和豌豆制曲，常见酒精度 53% vol。

en.title: Fenjiu
en.summary: A light-aroma baijiu from Xinghuacun, Fenyang, Shanxi, made with sorghum and a barley-pea qu.

zh.title: 智慧舍得
zh.summary: 舍得酒业旗下的高端浓香型单品，2018 年上市，常见 52% vol、42% vol 或 38% vol、500 mL；企业公开资料称以贮存八年以上基酒并用陈酒调味。

en.title: Shede Zhihui
en.summary: A high-end strong-aroma product from Shede, launched in 2018 and commonly bottled at 52%, 42% or 38% ABV in 500 mL. Company material says it uses base spirit stored for more than eight years, seasoned with older spirit.

zh.title: 剑南春
zh.summary: 产自四川绵竹的浓香型白酒，以五粮为原料、泥窖固态发酵，常见酒精度 52% vol。

en.title: Jiannanchun
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu from Mianzhu, Sichuan, made from five grains and fermented in mud pits.

zh.title: 郎酒
zh.summary: 产自四川古蔺赤水河畔的白酒品牌，兼有酱香与浓香产品；青花郎、红花郎是酱香主线，郎牌特曲等覆盖浓香与宴席场景，产地与茅台镇隔河相望。

en.title: Langjiu
en.summary: A baijiu brand from Erlang, Gulin, on the Chishui River, making both sauce-aroma and strong-aroma products.

zh.title: 泸州老窖
zh.summary: 产自四川泸州的浓香型白酒代表，以老窖池续糟发酵为特色，常见产品酒精度 52% vol。

en.title: Luzhou Laojiao
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu from Luzhou, Sichuan, known for long-used mud pits and continued mash fermentation.

zh.title: 五粮液
zh.summary: 产自四川宜宾的浓香型白酒，以高粱、大米、糯米、小麦、玉米五种粮食为原料，常见酒精度 52% vol。

en.title: Wuliangye
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu from Yibin, Sichuan, made from five grains and commonly bottled at 52% ABV.

zh.title: 贝加西西里亚
zh.summary: 西班牙杜埃罗河岸产区的历史名庄，1864 年创立；以丹魄为主的混酿，旗舰酒款 Único 以长陈年与复杂度著称，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 14% vol，具体年份与批次以瓶标为准。

en.title: Vega Sicilia
en.summary: A historic estate in Spain's Ribera del Duero, founded in 1864; a Tempranillo-led blend whose flagship Único is known for long ageing and complexity, commonly 750 mL at about 14% ABV, with vintage and batch to be checked on the label.

zh.title: 绝对伏特加
zh.summary: 瑞典伏特加品牌，以冬小麦为原料，在 Åhus 连续蒸馏；1979 年推出，常见酒精度 40% vol。

en.title: Absolut Vodka
en.summary: A Swedish vodka made from winter wheat in Åhus with continuous distillation, launched in 1979 and commonly 40% ABV.

zh.title: 水井坊·典藏大师版
zh.summary: 四川水井坊股份有限公司的高端浓香型单品，常见 52% vol 或 38% vol、500 mL；以水井街酒坊遗址与“第一坊”叙事为背景，定位商务与礼赠。

en.title: Swellfun Collection Master Edition
en.summary: A high-end strong-aroma product from Sichuan Swellfun, commonly bottled at 52% or 38% ABV in 500 mL, set against the Shuijing Street distillery site and the "first workshop" narrative and positioned for business and gifting.

zh.title: 塔牌本酒
zh.summary: 塔牌“本系列”的核心产品，500 mL 礼盒、15% vol、半干型，明确不添加焦糖色；产自绍兴柯桥区湖塘，以糯米、麦曲与鉴湖水手工酿造，与同厂本原酒、普通加饭酒是三个不同层级的产品。

en.title: Taipai Benjiu
en.summary: The core bottling of Taipai's Ben series, a 500 mL gift box at 15% ABV, semi-dry and explicitly made without caramel colour; brewed by hand in Hutong, Keqiao from glutinous rice, wheat qu and Jian Lake water, and distinct from the same producer's vintage Ben Yuanjiu and ordinary jiafan.

zh.title: 塔牌手工冬酿
zh.summary: 塔牌以立冬到立春的低温窗口手工酿造的绍兴黄酒系列，按三年、五年、六年、八年、十年分档；产自绍兴柯桥区湖塘，以糯米、麦曲与鉴湖水为原料，落缸 26–30℃、总发酵期约 70–80 天，风格偏醇厚。

en.title: Taipai Handmade Winter Brew
en.summary: Taipai's handmade Shaoxing series brewed in the cold window from Lidong to Lichun, sold in three-, five-, six-, eight- and ten-year tiers; made in Hutong, Keqiao from glutinous rice, wheat qu and Jian Lake water, pitched at 26–30 °C and fermented for about 70–80 days, with a rounder, sweeter house style.

zh.title: 必富达伦敦干金酒
zh.summary: 伦敦干金酒品牌，1863 年由 James Burrough 创立，在伦敦肯宁顿蒸馏；以九种植物原料蒸馏，常见酒精度 40% vol。

en.title: Beefeater London Dry Gin
en.summary: A London dry gin founded in 1863 by James Burrough, distilled in Kennington with about nine botanicals and commonly 40% ABV.

zh.title: 百威
zh.summary: 美国圣路易斯安海斯-布希公司自 1876 年生产的淡色拉格，常见 5.0% vol、355 mL；以大米为辅料、在后熟罐中铺放山毛榉木条陈贮，风格清爽干净，是全球销量最大的啤酒品牌之一。

en.title: Budweiser
en.summary: A pale lager brewed by Anheuser-Busch in St. Louis since 1876, usually 5.0% vol in 355 mL; known for rice as an adjunct and for beechwood ageing in conditioning tanks, with a clean, crisp style, and one of the world's largest-selling beer brands.

zh.title: 水牛足迹
zh.summary: 美国肯塔基州法兰克福的肯塔基直馏波本威士忌，以玉米为主料、加入黑麦与发芽大麦，在新烧焦橡木桶中陈年；常见 45% vol、750 mL，未标注酒龄。

en.title: Buffalo Trace
en.summary: A Kentucky straight bourbon from Frankfort, Kentucky, made mainly from corn with rye and malted barley and aged in new charred oak barrels. Commonly 45% ABV in 750 mL bottles, with no age statement.

zh.title: 杰克丹尼老7号
zh.summary: 美国田纳西威士忌，产自林奇堡；采用林肯县木炭过滤与新烘烤橡木桶陈年，常见酒精度 40% vol。

en.title: Jack Daniel's Old No. 7
en.summary: A Tennessee whiskey from Lynchburg, filtered through maple charcoal and aged in new charred oak, commonly 40% ABV.

zh.title: 作品一号
zh.summary: 作品一号是 1979 年由罗伯特·蒙大维与菲利普·德·罗斯柴尔德男爵在加州纳帕谷 Oakville 合作创立的波尔多风格干红，首个年份 1979、1984 年上市；本文从改名、四个地块、2023 年调配、Overture 与拍卖表现拆解其与 Almaviva 的差异。

en.title: Opus One
en.summary: Opus One is a Bordeaux-style dry red made in Oakville, Napa Valley, founded in 1979 by Robert Mondavi and Baron Philippe de Rothschild; the first vintage was 1979, released in 1984, and this entry explains the 1982 renaming, the four parcels, the 2023 blend, Overture and the auction record.

zh.title: 五粮液普五
zh.summary: 五粮液核心单品的市场俗称，通常指第八代五粮液，浓香型，常见 52% vol、500 mL。本页按酒款层级说明规格、工艺与选购。

en.title: Wuliangye Puwu
en.summary: The market nickname for Wuliangye's core product, usually the eighth-generation Wuliangye. It is strong aroma, commonly 52% ABV in 500 mL; this entry covers specification, process and buying at product level.

zh.title: 习酒·窖藏1988
zh.summary: 贵州习酒的核心酱香型单品，常见规格为 53% vol、500 mL，定位次高端；产品名中的 1988 指向企业当年的获奖节点，正式品名与规格仍以标签为准。

en.title: Xijiu Jiaocang 1988
en.summary: A core sauce-aroma product from Guizhou Xijiu, commonly 53% ABV in 500 mL and positioned in the upper-mid market; the 1988 in the name refers to a company milestone, not to the age of the spirit.

zh.title: 迎驾洞藏16
zh.summary: 安徽迎驾贡酒洞藏系列的代表产品，浓香型白酒，常见 52% vol 或 42% vol、500 mL；以多粮原料与黄岩洞、清潭洞贮存为公开特点。

en.title: Yingjia Dongcang 16
en.summary: A representative product of Anhui Yingjia Gongjiu's cave-storage series, a strong-aroma baijiu commonly bottled at 52% or 42% ABV in 500 mL, with multi-grain raw materials and storage in the Huangyan and Qingtan caves as public features.

zh.title: 敖云
zh.summary: 云南迪庆香格里拉高海拔产区出产的赤霞珠干红，由酩悦·轩尼诗-路易·威登集团投资建设；首个年份为 2013，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 13%-14% vol，具体年份与批次以瓶标为准。

en.title: Ao Yun
en.summary: A Cabernet Sauvignon dry red from the high-altitude Shangri-La area of Diqing, Yunnan, developed with LVMH backing; the first vintage was 2013, commonly 750 mL at about 13%-14% ABV, with vintage and batch to be checked on the label.

zh.title: 古越龙山花雕酒
zh.summary: 浙江绍兴黄酒品牌，以糯米、麦曲和鉴湖水酿造，花雕、加饭等产品常见酒精度 15%–18% vol。

en.title: Guyuelongshan Huadiao
en.summary: A Shaoxing huangjiu brand from Zhejiang, brewed from glutinous rice, wheat qu and Jian Lake water, with huadiao and jiafan products commonly 15% to 18% ABV.

zh.title: 竹叶青酒
zh.summary: 以汾酒为基酒，加入竹叶与多种植物配料、糖等配制而成的露酒，常见酒精度约 38% vol，产自山西汾阳杏花村；风味清甜，带草本香气。

en.title: Zhuyeqing
en.summary: A liqueur-style blended spirit made from Fenjiu as its base, with bamboo leaf, various botanical ingredients and sugar; typically about 38% vol and produced in Xinghua Village, Fenyang, Shanxi; light, sweet and herbal in aroma.

zh.title: 波尔多葡萄酒城的“50 个葡萄酒产区环游”摄影展 2026
zh.summary: 波尔多葡萄酒城（La Cité du Vin）为纪念开馆十周年，于 2026 年 2 月 13 日至 12 月 31 日举办免费摄影展《环游世界：50 个葡萄酒产区》，展出由合作产区挑选的影像，分布在一层与二层公共空间。展览仍在进行，本页记录当届安排、场地与边界。

en.title: Around the World in 50 Wine Regions: A Photo Exhibition at La Cité du Vin, 2026
en.summary: To mark its tenth anniversary, La Cité du Vin in Bordeaux is running a free photo exhibition, “Around the World in 50 Wine Regions”, from 13 February to 31 December 2026 on its ground and first floors, with images chosen by its partner wine regions. The exhibition is still running; this event records the arrangements, venue and limits.

zh.title: 花神咖啡馆的玻璃艺术展：Sogni Veneziani 2026
zh.summary: 2026 年 9 月 12 日至 10 月 18 日，花神咖啡馆历史厅举办 Pierpaolo Seguso 的玻璃雕塑展“Sogni Veneziani”，展览免费、无需预约，开放时间随咖啡馆每日 9:00–23:00。展览已于 2026 年 10 月 18 日结束；页面保留当届开放时间与免费入场规则，供复盘与下一次展期核对。

en.title: Sogni Veneziani: a glass exhibition at Caffè Florian in 2026
en.summary: From 12 September to 18 October 2026 Caffè Florian's historic rooms hosted Pierpaolo Seguso's glass sculpture exhibition “Sogni Veneziani”, free and without reservation, open with the café daily from 9:00 to 23:00. The event has ended; this event records that edition's arrangements and rules.

zh.title: 威尼斯狂欢节期间的花神咖啡馆 2026
zh.summary: 2026 年 1 月 31 日至 2 月 17 日，威尼斯狂欢节以“Olympus – The Origins of the Game”为主题举行；花神咖啡馆在圣马可广场正常营业，供应狂欢节传统甜点并作为观看人流与面具的座位区。狂欢节已于 2026 年 2 月 17 日结束；页面保留当届营业与座位安排，供下一届活动对照。

en.title: Caffè Florian during the Venice Carnival 2026
en.summary: From 31 January to 17 February 2026 the Venice Carnival ran under the theme “Olympus – The Origins of the Game”; Caffè Florian stayed open as usual, served traditional Carnival pastries and used its arcade and terrace as seats for watching the masks and crowds. The event has ended; this event records that edition's arrangements and limits.

zh.title: 埃佩尔奈“光之习惯”香槟节 2026
zh.summary: 第 26 届 Habits de Lumière 于 2026 年 12 月 11 日至 13 日在埃佩尔奈举行，香槟大道在周五、周六两晚变成灯光与影像舞台，周六设美食演示，周日为老车巡游；街头活动免费，酒窖参观与品鉴另行付费。活动尚未举行，本页记录当届安排与边界。

en.title: Habits de Lumière 2026 in Épernay: Champagne's Festival of Light
en.summary: The 26th Habits de Lumière takes place in Épernay from 11 to 13 December 2026, with the Avenue de Champagne turned into a stage for light and video projection on Friday and Saturday evenings, a gastronomy programme on Saturday and a vintage-car parade on Sunday; street events are free, while cellar visits and tastings are paid. The event is still to come.

zh.title: 艾雷岛威士忌节 Fèis Ìle 2026
zh.summary: 第 40 届 Fèis Ìle 于 2026 年 5 月 22 日至 31 日在苏格兰艾雷岛举行，首次扩展到十个整日；乐加维林、拉弗格与阿贝分别在 5 月 23 日、26 日与 30 日举办开放日。活动已结束，本页记录当届日程、场地与参与规则。

en.title: Fèis Ìle 2026: The Islay Festival's 40th Edition
en.summary: The 40th Fèis Ìle ran from 22 to 31 May 2026 on Islay, Scotland, expanded to ten full days for the first time; Lagavulin, Laphroaig and Ardbeg held their open days on 23, 26 and 30 May respectively. The festival has ended; this event records that edition's programme, venues and rules.

zh.title: 沃韦葡萄种植者节：一代人只办一次的葡萄酒节
zh.summary: 沃韦葡萄种植者节（Fête des Vignerons）由沃韦的葡萄种植者兄弟会组织，1797 年首次以“真正的节庆”形式举行，此后大约每一代人办一次，间隔在 14 到 28 年之间。它把葡萄种植、采收、酿酒与地方生活编成一场露天表演，2016 年被 UNESCO 列入人类非物质文化遗产。最近一届于 2019 年 7 月 18 日至 8 月 11 日在沃韦集市广场举行。

en.title: Fête des Vignerons: a wine festival held once in a generation
en.summary: The Fête des Vignerons in Vevey is organised by the Confrérie des Vignerons, first staged in its “true” festival form in 1797 and then held roughly once a generation, with intervals of 14 to 28 years. It turns vine-growing, harvest, winemaking and local life into an open-air spectacle and was inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2016. The most recent edition ran from 18 July to 11 August 2019.

zh.title: 花神咖啡馆的圣马可广场音乐会：波切利 2026
zh.summary: 2026 年 6 月 27 日晚，安德烈·波切利在威尼斯圣马可广场演出，花神咖啡馆开放露台与拱廊座位并收取每位 200 欧元的订位费。演出已结束，本页记录当届安排、取消规则与核验边界。

en.title: Andrea Bocelli in Piazza San Marco: a Caffè Florian concert in 2026
en.summary: On the evening of 27 June 2026 Andrea Bocelli performed in Piazza San Marco in Venice, with Caffè Florian opening its terrace and arcade seats at 200 euros per person. The performance has ended; this event records that edition's arrangements, cancellation rules and verification limits.

zh.title: 美国大啤酒节：从 1982 年的酒店聚会到户外啤酒节
zh.summary: 美国大啤酒节（Great American Beer Festival，GABF）1982 年在科罗拉多博尔德的 Harvest House 首次举行，当时只有 24 家酒厂、47 款啤酒与 800 名观众。它由 Brewers Association 主办，是美国最重要的精酿啤酒节与赛事之一。2026 年一届于 10 月 10 日至 11 日首次移师丹佛 Levitt Pavilion 户外举行，已结束。

en.title: Great American Beer Festival: from a 1982 hotel gathering to an open-air beer festival
en.summary: The Great American Beer Festival (GABF) was first held in 1982 at the Harvest House in Boulder, Colorado, with only 24 breweries, 47 beers and 800 attendees. Organised by the Brewers Association, it is one of the United States' most important craft-beer festivals and competitions. The 2026 edition ran on 10–11 October at Denver's Levitt Pavilion, the first outdoor edition, and is over.

zh.title: 默尔索葡萄酒宴“Paulée de Meursault”2026
zh.summary: 2026 年 11 月 16 日（周一），Paulée de Meursault 在默尔索城堡举行，作为勃艮第“三个光荣日”的收官午餐；宾客自带酒瓶分享，现场颁发 Paulée 文学奖。活动尚未举行，本页记录日期、场地、历史与参与边界。

en.title: The Paulée de Meursault 2026: Burgundy's Harvest Lunch at Château de Meursault
en.summary: On Monday 16 November 2026 the Paulée de Meursault returns to the vat room of Château de Meursault as the closing lunch of Burgundy's Trois Glorieuses, with guests bringing their own bottles to share and the Paulée literary prize awarded at the table. The event is still to come; this event records the date, venue, history and limits.

zh.title: 慕尼黑啤酒节：一场从 1810 年婚礼长出来的民间节日
zh.summary: 慕尼黑啤酒节（Oktoberfest）不是一场单纯的啤酒展，而是每年在特蕾西娅草坪举行的民间节日。它始于 1810 年 10 月 12 日王储路德维希与特蕾西娅公主的婚礼，随后以赛马会的形式延续下来，今天由慕尼黑市与巴伐利亚啤酒厂共同维持。2026 年一届于 9 月 19 日至 10 月 4 日举行，已结束。

en.title: Oktoberfest: a folk festival that grew out of an 1810 wedding
en.summary: Oktoberfest is not a simple beer exhibition but Munich's annual folk festival on the Theresienwiese. It began on 12 October 1810 with the wedding of Crown Prince Ludwig and Princess Therese, continued as a horse race, and is now maintained by the City of Munich and Bavarian breweries. The 2026 edition ran from 19 September to 4 October and is over.

zh.title: ProWein：杜塞尔多夫的三月，葡萄酒与烈酒的交易场
zh.summary: ProWein 1994 年以 ProVins 之名在杜塞尔多夫首次举办，当时只有 321 家展商、1,517 名观众与一个展馆；今天它是欧洲领先的葡萄酒与烈酒专业展会，只对行业观众开放。2027 年一届定于 3 月 7 日至 9 日在杜塞尔多夫展览中心举行。它不是消费者品酒会，也不是产区节庆。

en.title: ProWein: Düsseldorf in March, the trading floor for wine and spirits
en.summary: ProWein was first held in Düsseldorf in 1994 under the name ProVins, with 321 exhibitors, 1,517 visitors and a single hall. It is now Europe's leading trade fair for wine and spirits and is open only to trade visitors. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 7–9 March at Messe Düsseldorf. It is not a consumer tasting or a regional festival.

zh.title: 莱佛士长廊酒吧的新加坡司令日 2026
zh.summary: 2026 年 6 月 27 日，新加坡莱佛士酒店长廊酒吧举办一年一度的新加坡司令日，恰逢国际菠萝日；前 100 位携带一整颗菠萝到店的客人可兑换一杯新加坡司令，无酒精版新加坡司令也在当日上市。活动已于 2026 年 6 月 27 日结束；页面保留当届兑换与无酒精版本规则，供下一届核对。

en.title: Singapore Sling Day 2026 at Raffles Long Bar
en.summary: On 27 June 2026 Raffles Hotel Singapore's Long Bar held its annual Singapore Sling Day, coinciding with International Pineapple Day: the first 100 guests bringing a whole pineapple could exchange it for a complimentary Singapore Sling, and the alcohol-free Singapore Sling Zero was launched the same day. The event has ended; this event records that edition's arrangements and rules.

zh.title: Tales of the Cocktail：从一条酒吧步行路线长成的调酒行业年会
zh.summary: Tales of the Cocktail 2002 年由 Ann Tuennerman 在新奥尔良发起，最初是一条参观历史酒吧的步行路线，后来发展为全球调酒与烈酒行业的年度会议。2026 年第 24 届于 7 月 19 日至 24 日在新奥尔良举行，包含教育课程、品鉴、社交活动与 Spirited Awards。它不是单纯的喝酒大会，也不是政府主办的展会。

en.title: Tales of the Cocktail: from a bar walk to the drinks industry's annual meeting
en.summary: Tales of the Cocktail began in New Orleans in 2002 as Ann Tuennerman's walking tour of historic bars and grew into a global cocktail and spirits conference. The 24th edition ran from 19 to 24 July 2026 in New Orleans, with education, tastings, networking and the Spirited Awards. It is neither a pure drinking party nor a government-run trade show.

zh.title: 青岛国际啤酒节期间的青岛啤酒博物馆 2026
zh.summary: 第 36 届青岛国际啤酒节于 2026 年 7 月 17 日至 8 月 15 日举办；啤酒节期间青岛啤酒博物馆按暑期时段开放，并运行《金色奇妙夜》夜游。活动已结束，本页记录当届开放安排、购票方式与边界。

en.title: Tsingtao Beer Museum during the 2026 Qingdao International Beer Festival
en.summary: The 36th Qingdao International Beer Festival ran from 17 July to 15 August 2026; during that period the Tsingtao Beer Museum followed its summer opening hours and ran the “Golden Wonder Night” night tour. The event has ended; this event records that edition's hours, ticketing and limits.

zh.title: Vinitaly：维罗纳的意大利葡萄酒年度展台
zh.summary: Vinitaly 1967 年 9 月 22 日至 23 日以“意大利葡萄酒日”在维罗纳首次亮相，1971 年成为正式展会，1978 年获得“国际”资格。今天它由 Veronafiere 主办，是意大利葡萄酒与烈酒行业的核心展会。2026 年第 58 届于 4 月 12 日至 15 日在维罗纳展览中心举行，已结束。

en.title: Vinitaly: Verona's annual showcase for Italian wine
en.summary: Vinitaly first appeared in Verona on 22–23 September 1967 as the Italian Wine Days, became a full trade fair in 1971 and gained “international” status in 1978. Today it is organised by Veronafiere and is the central trade event for Italian wine and spirits. The 58th edition ran from 12 to 15 April 2026 at Veronafiere and is over.

zh.title: 皇家啤酒屋的“啤酒馆 Wiesn”2026
zh.summary: 慕尼黑皇家啤酒屋在 2026 年 9 月 19 日至 10 月 4 日配合啤酒节举办“WirtshausWiesn”：供应啤酒节啤酒、每日现场音乐与啤酒节菜式，底层与啤酒花园自由入座，免门票。活动已结束，本页记录当届安排与核验状态。

en.title: WirtshausWiesn 2026 at the Hofbräuhaus
en.summary: From 19 September to 4 October 2026 the Hofbräuhaus in Munich ran a “WirtshausWiesn” alongside Oktoberfest: festival beer, daily live music and Oktoberfest dishes, with free seating on the ground floor and in the beer garden and no admission charge. The event has ended.

zh.title: 白酒送礼 1000 元以上怎么选
zh.summary: 把千元以上的白酒送礼拆成关系、场景、价格带、酒体与渠道五个判断：先定送给谁、什么场合，再把预算放在可核验的酒体与来源上，而不是盒子或“内部酒”说法。

en.title: 白酒送礼 1000 元以上怎么选
en.summary: 把千元以上的白酒送礼拆成关系、场景、价格带、酒体与渠道五个判断：先定送给谁、什么场合，再把预算放在可核验的酒体与来源上，而不是盒子或“内部酒”说法。

zh.title: 白酒送礼 300–800 元怎么选
zh.summary: 把 300–800 元白酒送礼拆成场景、香型、规格、包装与渠道五个判断：先确定收礼人喝不喝、几个人喝、要不要礼盒，再把预算分配到酒体而不是盒子；附常见坑与验真步骤。

en.title: Choosing a 300–800 RMB Baijiu Gift
en.summary: Break a 300–800 RMB baijiu gift into five decisions: occasion, aroma, bottle size, packaging and channel. Decide whether the recipient drinks, how many people will share it and whether a gift box is needed, then put the budget into the liquor rather than the box, with common pitfalls and verification steps.

zh.title: 中国白酒产区地图：从赤水河到黄淮
zh.summary: 把中国白酒的主产区放回地理：赤水河、宜宾—泸州、绵竹—古蔺、习水、宿迁、汾阳、亳州各自的水、粮、气候与工艺，决定了香型与风格的差异；附 8 条产区路线的读图方法。

en.title: A Map of Chinese Baijiu Regions
en.summary: Put China’s main baijiu regions back on the map: the Chishui River, Yibin–Luzhou, Mianzhu–Gulin, Xishui, Suqian, Fenyang and Bozhou each combine water, grain, climate and technique differently, shaping aroma and style. A reading guide to eight regional routes.

zh.title: 啤酒品鉴入门：从香气、酒体到苦度
zh.summary: 从原料、发酵与风格三条线理解啤酒，说明第一杯怎么选、怎么倒与怎么喝、器具与温度、价格与购买，以及常见的品鉴误区。

en.title: Beer Tasting for Beginners: Aroma, Body and Bitterness
en.summary: Understand beer through raw materials, fermentation and style, then learn how to choose a first glass, how to pour and drink it, what glassware and temperature do, what prices and buying involve, and which tasting myths to drop.

zh.title: 换一只杯子，会有什么不同？
zh.summary: 杯型改变香气聚集、入口位置与温度上升速度；先理解目的，再谈仪式。杯子不必昂贵，但要干净、合适、够用。

en.title: A different glass, a different view
en.summary: Glass shape changes how aroma gathers, where the liquid first meets your mouth and how fast it warms. The glass need not be expensive, only clean, suitable and sufficient.

zh.title: 调酒，是另一种认识酒的方式
zh.summary: 从基酒、酸甜、苦味、稀释和冰开始，理解一杯鸡尾酒的结构；先能稳定复现，再谈创作。

en.title: A cocktail is another way in
en.summary: Start with base spirit, sweet, sour, bitter, dilution and ice; be able to reproduce a drink before you start inventing one.

zh.title: 精酿啤酒的新鲜度怎么看
zh.summary: 精酿的新鲜度不是只看“生产日期”：还要看风格、酒花、包装、冷链与货架。按“日期—风格—储存—开瓶—品尝”的顺序判断，比背“三个月黄金期”更可靠。

en.title: How to Judge Craft Beer Freshness
en.summary: Craft-beer freshness is not only a production date: style, hops, packaging, cold chain and shelf matter. Judge in the order date, style, storage, opening and taste; that is more reliable than memorising a “three-month golden rule”.

zh.title: 第一次喝白酒怎么选
zh.summary: 从场景、香型、度数、容量和预算出发，用一张决策表选出第一瓶白酒，并说明小杯慢饮、配餐与避坑要点。

en.title: Choosing your first baijiu
en.summary: A guide to choosing a first bottle of baijiu by occasion, aroma type, strength, volume and budget, with a decision table, serving notes and common mistakes.

zh.title: 第一口，先别急着下结论
zh.summary: 从准备、观察、闻香到入口和余味，用自己的词记录一杯酒；先辨认偏好，再谈术语和评分。

en.title: Give the first sip a moment
en.summary: From preparation and looking to smelling, tasting and the finish, record a glass in your own words; identify preferences before terminology and scores.

zh.title: 第一次喝葡萄酒怎么选
zh.summary: 用场景、颜色、甜度、酒精度与预算五步选出第一瓶葡萄酒，说明标签核对、饮用温度、配餐与常见误区。

en.title: Choosing your first wine
en.summary: Five steps for choosing a first wine by occasion, colour, sweetness, strength and budget, with label checks, serving temperatures, pairing notes and common mistakes.

zh.title: 先看盘子里，再看杯子里
zh.summary: 搭配不是寻找唯一答案，而是平衡浓度、酸度、甜度、脂肪与辛香；先尝一口，再决定下一口喝什么。

en.title: Look at the plate before the glass
en.summary: Pairing is not a single right answer but a balance of weight, acidity, sweetness, fat and heat; taste a bite, then decide the next sip.

zh.title: 加强酒入门：波特、雪利、马德拉怎么喝
zh.summary: 加强酒不是一种酒，而是在发酵中加入酒精、再经氧化或陈年形成的一类酒。先分波特、雪利、马德拉与马沙拉，再看甜度、氧化风格和开瓶后的寿命。

en.title: Fortified wine: Port, Sherry and Madeira
en.summary: An introduction to fortified wine by type, sweetness, oxidation, shelf life and pairing, covering Port, Sherry, Madeira and Marsala.

zh.title: 家庭酒吧最小配置：6 瓶酒、8 件工具、1 套冰
zh.summary: 家庭酒吧不需要整面酒墙。先备 6 瓶基酒与 8 件工具，再补糖浆、苦精、柑橘与冰；按常做的 6 杯酒倒推配置，比按酒单囤货更省钱。

en.title: A minimum home bar: 6 bottles, 8 tools, 1 set of ice
en.summary: A beginner's minimum home bar built from a short menu: six bottles, eight tools, one ice system, citrus and a staged budget.

zh.title: 家庭酒柜怎么搭
zh.summary: 家庭酒柜不是越贵越好，而是按“喝什么、几个人、多久喝完、放哪里”搭：先定用途与容量，再解决温度、湿度、避光与开瓶后管理；最后用一张清单控制品类与预算。

en.title: Building a Home Wine Cabinet
en.summary: A home wine cabinet is not about spending more but about matching what you drink, how many share, how fast you finish and where you store it. Set purpose and capacity first, then solve temperature, humidity, light and opened-bottle management; finish with a list that controls categories and budget.

zh.title: 黄酒送礼与自饮怎么选
zh.summary: 把黄酒的送礼与自饮分开：送礼看类型、年份、规格与包装，自饮看甜度、容量、开瓶后保存与配餐；先弄清干型、半干、半甜、甜型与加饭、花雕、香雪的关系，再决定买哪一瓶。

en.title: Yellow Wine for Gifts and for Yourself
en.summary: Separate yellow-wine gifts from everyday drinking: gifts depend on type, age, size and packaging; self-drinking depends on sweetness, bottle size, storage after opening and food pairing. Understand dry, semi-dry, semi-sweet and sweet, and the relations among Jiafan, Huadiao and Xiangxue before choosing a bottle.

zh.title: 黄酒与江南餐桌
zh.summary: 把黄酒放回江南餐桌：从绍兴、苏州、上海的家常菜与节气，解释干型、半干、半甜、甜型怎么配；再看温饮、杯型、酒馆与产区路线，形成一张“菜—酒—温度”的对照。

en.title: Yellow Wine at the Jiangnan Table
en.summary: Put yellow wine back at the Jiangnan table: from Shaoxing, Suzhou and Shanghai home cooking and seasonal rhythms, explain how dry, semi-dry, semi-sweet and sweet types pair; then cover warming, vessels, wine houses and regional routes in a dish–wine–temperature map.

zh.title: 黄酒怎么温、怎么喝
zh.summary: 把黄酒温饮拆成温度、器皿、类型、配菜与保存五个判断：温到 40–50°C 左右而不是煮沸，按干型、半干、半甜、甜型调整，附水浴做法、加料与开瓶后保存。

en.title: 黄酒怎么温、怎么喝
en.summary: 把黄酒温饮拆成温度、器皿、类型、配菜与保存五个判断：温到 40–50°C 左右而不是煮沸，按干型、半干、半甜、甜型调整，附水浴做法、加料与开瓶后保存。

zh.title: 加冰这件事，没有标准答案
zh.summary: 冰会降温、稀释并改变香气释放；先决定你想保留什么，再决定加不加、加什么冰、加多少。

en.title: Ice is a choice, not a test
en.summary: Ice cools, dilutes and changes aroma release; decide what you want to preserve before choosing whether to add it, what ice and how much.

zh.title: 酒礼盒避坑指南
zh.summary: 酒礼盒的坑集中在“盒子大、酒体小、来源不清、附赠品虚高”。按“酒体—规格—包装—来源—运输”五步检查，先把预算留给能喝的部分，再决定要不要为盒子付费。

en.title: A Practical Guide to Liquor Gift Boxes
en.summary: Liquor gift-box pitfalls cluster around a big box, a small bottle, an unclear source and inflated extras. Check in five steps—liquor, size, packaging, source and shipping—and put the budget into what can be drunk before paying for the box.

zh.title: 低醇与无醇怎么选
zh.summary: 低醇、无醇、脱醇与“0.0”不是同一件事：先看标签上的酒精含量与工艺，再按场景、风味与安全选择；低醇不等于无醇，无醇也不等于可以无限饮用。

en.title: Choosing Low- and No-Alcohol Drinks
en.summary: Low-alcohol, no-alcohol, dealcoholised and “0.0” are not the same thing. Read the label’s alcohol content and process first, then choose by occasion, flavour and safety. Low-alcohol is not no-alcohol, and no-alcohol does not mean unlimited drinking.

zh.title: 酒标很小，线索不少
zh.summary: 酒标先告诉你类别、配料、酒精度和净含量；宣传语不等于事实，法规字段才是可核对的信息。

en.title: A small label, plenty of clues
en.summary: A label first tells you category, ingredients, alcohol content and volume; marketing words are not facts, regulated fields are the checkable information.

zh.title: 在餐厅怎么点葡萄酒
zh.summary: 把餐厅点酒拆成预算、酒单结构、试酒、配餐与结账五步：先定一瓶酒的角色，再按杯或按瓶选择；不必背产区，只要会看酒单、会试温度、会拒绝坏酒。

en.title: How to Order Wine in a Restaurant
en.summary: Break restaurant wine ordering into five steps: budget, wine-list structure, tasting, pairing and the bill. Decide the bottle’s role first, then choose by glass or bottle; you do not need to memorise regions, only to read a list, check temperature and send back a faulty bottle.

zh.title: 朗姆酒分类与选购
zh.summary: 把朗姆酒选购拆成原料、颜色、陈年、糖分与用途五个判断：白朗姆适合调酒，金朗姆与陈年朗姆适合纯饮，农业朗姆看甘蔗汁，海军与高度朗姆看强度与场合。

en.title: 朗姆酒分类与选购
en.summary: 把朗姆酒选购拆成原料、颜色、陈年、糖分与用途五个判断：白朗姆适合调酒，金朗姆与陈年朗姆适合纯饮，农业朗姆看甘蔗汁，海军与高度朗姆看强度与场合。

zh.title: 朗姆入门：从甘蔗到杯中
zh.summary: 从原料、蒸馏、陈年与产区四条线理解朗姆的类型，说明第一瓶怎么选、纯饮与调酒怎么喝，以及价格、购买与常见误区。

en.title: Rum for Beginners: From Sugar Cane to the Glass
en.summary: Understand rum through four lines — raw material, distillation, ageing and region — then learn how to choose a first bottle, how to sip and mix it, what to expect from prices and buying, and which myths to drop.

zh.title: 清酒入门
zh.summary: 从纯米、吟酿、大吟酿与本酿造的区别入手，解释精米步合、日本酒度、温度与喝法，帮第一次买清酒的人做选择。

en.title: Sake for beginners
en.summary: A first-sake guide to junmai, ginjo, daiginjo and honjozo, explaining polishing ratio, sake meter value, serving temperature and how to choose a bottle.

zh.title: 清酒酒藏参观怎么预约
zh.summary: 清酒酒藏参观不是随时能进的景点：先分清博物馆、酒藏见学与品鉴活动，再查预约、交通、语言与试饮安排；按“预约—到达—看什么—买什么—怎么回”的顺序准备，避免白跑。

en.title: Visiting a Sake Brewery: Booking and Etiquette
en.summary: A sake brewery visit is not a walk-in attraction: distinguish a museum, a brewery tour and a tasting event, then check booking, access, language and tasting arrangements. Prepare in the order booking, arrival, what to see, what to buy and how to return, so you do not make a wasted trip.

zh.title: 清酒开瓶后怎么保存
zh.summary: 把清酒开瓶后的保存拆成温度、光线、空气、类型与饮用窗口五个判断：冷藏避光、尽量少空气，纯米与吟酿通常 2–4 周内喝完，生酒与低酒精度更短。

en.title: 清酒开瓶后怎么保存
en.summary: 把清酒开瓶后的保存拆成温度、光线、空气、类型与饮用窗口五个判断：冷藏避光、尽量少空气，纯米与吟酿通常 2–4 周内喝完，生酒与低酒精度更短。

zh.title: 清酒温度指南：冷酒、常温与温酒怎么选
zh.summary: 清酒不是只能冰着喝。温度会改变香气、甜感、酸度与酒精刺激；先看酒型与精米步合，再选冷酒、常温或温酒，别用微波炉加热。

en.title: Sake temperature: from chilled to warm
en.summary: A practical guide to sake temperature bands, style matching, water-bath warming, vessels and food pairing.

zh.title: 单一麦芽还是调和威士忌
zh.summary: 把单一麦芽与调和威士忌放回定义、风味结构、价格与场景里比较：单一麦芽强调一家酒厂的个性，调和强调稳定与平衡；没有高下，只有你想要的体验与预算。

en.title: Single Malt or Blended Whisky
en.summary: Compare single malt and blended whisky through definition, flavour structure, price and occasion. Single malt highlights one distillery’s character; a blend aims for consistency and balance. Neither is inherently better; the choice depends on the experience and budget you want.

zh.title: 起泡酒怎么选：香槟、Cava、Prosecco 与 Crémant
zh.summary: 起泡酒不是一种酒，而是一类工艺。先按场合和预算选产区与方法，再看甜度、年份和除渣日期；香槟、Cava、Prosecco 与 Crémant 各有自己的价格逻辑。

en.title: How to choose sparkling wine: Champagne, Cava, Prosecco and Crémant
en.summary: A buyer's guide to sparkling wine by category, budget, sweetness, vintage and label, with opening, pouring and pairing notes.

zh.title: 龙舌兰与梅斯卡尔入门：两种龙舌兰酒的分野
zh.summary: 从龙舌兰原料、产区与工艺解释特其拉与梅斯卡尔的区别，说明类型、第一瓶怎么选、怎么喝、价格与购买及常见误区。

en.title: Tequila and Mezcal for Beginners: Two Agave Spirits
en.summary: Explain the difference between tequila and mezcal through agave raw material, region and process, then cover types, choosing a first bottle, how to drink, price and buying, and common myths.

zh.title: 旅行带酒与托运怎么查
zh.summary: 带酒旅行先查承运人，再查海关，最后才是包装：随身与托运的液体规则不同，免税限量与申报义务也不同；玻璃瓶要防震、防漏、防压，别让一瓶酒毁掉整段行程。

en.title: Travelling with Bottles: Baggage and Customs Checks
en.summary: For travelling with bottles, check the carrier first, customs second and packaging last: carry-on and checked-liquid rules differ, as do duty-free allowances and declaration duties. Glass needs shock, leak and pressure protection so one bottle does not ruin the trip.

zh.title: 世界威士忌酒厂旅行怎么排
zh.summary: 把威士忌酒厂旅行按“产区—交通—预约—参观—品鉴—买酒”排：苏格兰岛屿与高地、日本山崎与余市、美国与爱尔兰各有节奏；先定一条主线，再排酒厂，不要用地图直线距离做行程。

en.title: Planning a Whisky Distillery Trip
en.summary: Plan a whisky distillery trip in the order region, transport, booking, tour, tasting and buying. Scotland’s islands and Highlands, Japan’s Yamazaki and Yoichi, the US and Ireland each have their own rhythm. Choose one main line, then add distilleries; do not plan from straight-line map distance.

zh.title: 威士忌送礼预算怎么分
zh.summary: 把威士忌送礼拆成预算、类型、年份、包装与渠道五个判断：300 到 3000 元各有合适的选择，先看收礼人怎么喝，再决定单一麦芽、调和、桶强还是礼盒。

en.title: 威士忌送礼预算怎么分
en.summary: 把威士忌送礼拆成预算、类型、年份、包装与渠道五个判断：300 到 3000 元各有合适的选择，先看收礼人怎么喝，再决定单一麦芽、调和、桶强还是礼盒。

zh.title: 威士忌入门
zh.summary: 从苏格兰单一麦芽与调和威士忌的区别入手，用一张决策表选第一瓶，并说明年份、酒精度、喝法与常见误区。

en.title: Whisky for beginners
en.summary: A beginner's route into whisky, starting with single malt versus blended Scotch, a decision table for a first bottle, and notes on age, strength, serving and common myths.

zh.title: 威士忌加水加冰：多少水、什么冰、顺序怎么排
zh.summary: 加水不是稀释，而是打开香气；加冰不是装样子，而是降温与稀释同时发生。先看酒精度与酒体，再决定几滴水、一块冰还是不加。

en.title: Whisky with water and ice: small, staged, comparative
en.summary: How water and ice change whisky aroma, texture and alcohol heat, with strength bands, mizuwari, highball and a tasting order.

zh.title: 葡萄酒送礼预算怎么分
zh.summary: 把葡萄酒送礼拆成收礼人、预算、产区、年份与运输五个判断：200 到 3000 元各有合适的选择，先确认对方喝不喝，再决定红、白、起泡与包装。

en.title: 葡萄酒送礼预算怎么分
en.summary: 把葡萄酒送礼拆成收礼人、预算、产区、年份与运输五个判断：200 到 3000 元各有合适的选择，先确认对方喝不喝，再决定红、白、起泡与包装。

zh.title: 葡萄酒产区旅行预算怎么定
zh.summary: 把葡萄酒产区旅行拆成交通、住宿、品鉴费、餐饮、买酒与保险六块：先定产区与季节，再按“每天 2 家、留半天机动”排；预算要从总花费倒推，不要只算机票。

en.title: Budgeting a Wine-Region Trip
en.summary: Split a wine-region trip into transport, lodging, tasting fees, food, wine purchases and insurance. Choose region and season first, then plan around two visits a day with a half-day buffer; budget backwards from the total, not just airfare.

zh.title: 葡萄酒储存：温度、湿度、光线与震动
zh.summary: 葡萄酒储存的核心是稳定：温度、湿度、光线、震动与空气都会改变酒的状态；从短期存放、开瓶后保存到长期陈放，按酒的类型与原计划分别处理。

en.title: Wine Storage: Temperature, Humidity, Light and Vibration
en.summary: The core of wine storage is stability; temperature, humidity, light, vibration and air all change a wine's condition, and short-term keeping, opened-bottle storage and long-term ageing should be handled differently by wine type and intention.

zh.title: 葡萄酒年份与适饮期：什么时候喝，什么时候别再等
zh.summary: 年份不是质量分数，而是气候与酿造共同留下的年份特征。先分产区、酒种与酒体，再判断适饮窗口；不是所有酒都值得陈年，也不是所有老酒都更好喝。

en.title: Vintage and drinking window: beyond the year on the label
en.summary: How vintage records weather and winemaking choices, and how to judge a drinking window by wine type, structure, condition and storage.

zh.title: 1855年波尔多分级：一张为世博会赶出的名单
zh.summary: 1855年4月18日，波尔多经纪人应商会要求交出一份分级名单，把梅多克与格拉夫的红酒、苏玳与巴萨克的甜酒分成等级。它依据长期市场价格与名声，不是盲品比赛；此后只有两次官方改动。

en.title: The 1855 Bordeaux Classification: A List Produced for a World's Fair
en.summary: On 18 April 1855, Bordeaux brokers delivered a classification requested by the Chamber of Commerce, ranking Médoc and Graves red wines and Sauternes and Barsac sweet wines into growths. It rested on long-term market prices and reputation, not a blind tasting, and has seen only two official changes since.

zh.title: 1952年全国评酒会：八大名酒与评选制度的起点
zh.summary: 1952 年 9 月在北京举行的第一届全国评酒会，从 103 个酒样中评出八种中国名酒；名单包含四种白酒、绍兴加饭酒与三种张裕酒，奠定了此后全国评酒与名酒品牌的基本框架。

en.title: 1952 National Wine Evaluation: the eight famous wines and the start of a system
en.summary: The first national wine evaluation, held in Beijing in September 1952, selected eight Chinese famous wines from 103 samples; the list included four baijiu, Shaoxing jiafan wine and three Zhangyu products, setting the framework for later national evaluations and famous-wine branding.

zh.title: 1963 年第二届全国评酒会
zh.summary: 1963 年 10 月在北京举行的第二届全国评酒会，由轻工业部与商业部共同组织，评出 18 种国家名酒，并首次设立国家优质酒。本文说明其评选方式、名单变化与制度意义，并提示名单在不同资料中的差异。

en.title: The 1963 second national wine evaluation
en.summary: The second national wine evaluation, held in Beijing in October 1963 and organised jointly by the Ministry of Light Industry and the Ministry of Commerce, selected 18 national famous wines and created a separate national quality award for the first time. This essay explains the method, the changes in the list and what the meeting meant institutionally.

zh.title: 1976年巴黎审判：加州酒击败法国名庄
zh.summary: 1976 年 5 月 24 日，英国酒商史蒂文·斯普里尔在巴黎组织盲品，20 款酒中加州与法国各 10 款；加州酒在红、白两组都拿到最高分，这场后来被称为“巴黎审判”的活动改变了加州酒的国际地位，也成为跨产区比较的经典案例。

en.title: 1976 Judgment of Paris: California wine beats French estates
en.summary: On 24 May 1976 the British wine merchant Steven Spurrier organised a blind tasting in Paris; 20 wines were poured, 10 from California and 10 from France, and California wines took the top score in both the red and white groups. The event later called the Judgment of Paris changed the international standing of California wine and became a classic case of cross-region comparison.

zh.title: 1979 年第三届全国评酒会：暗评与香型分组
zh.summary: 1979 年在辽宁大连举行的第三届全国评酒会，首次采用密码编号暗评并对评酒员进行考核，按香型、糖化剂与酒度分组比较，评出 18 种国家名酒。本文说明这次方法上的转折及其对名酒名单的影响。

en.title: The 1979 third national wine evaluation: blind judging and aroma groups
en.summary: The third national wine evaluation, held in Dalian, Liaoning, in 1979, introduced coded blind judging, examiner qualification and comparison by aroma type, saccharifying agent and alcohol strength, and selected 18 national famous wines. This essay explains the methodological turning point and its effect on the famous-wine list.

zh.title: 1984 年第四届全国评酒会：十三大名酒
zh.summary: 1984 年在山西太原举行的第四届全国评酒会，由中国食品工业协会主持，评出 26 种国家名酒，其中白酒 13 种，后世常称“十三大名酒”。本文说明其评选背景、名单扩张与争议。

en.title: The 1984 fourth national wine evaluation: the thirteen famous wines
en.summary: The fourth national wine evaluation, held in Taiyuan, Shanxi, in 1984 and organised by the China Food Industry Association, selected 26 national famous wines, 13 of them baijiu, later known as the thirteen famous wines. This essay explains the background, the expansion of the list and the disputes.

zh.title: 1989 年第五届全国评酒会：十七大名酒与评比的终点
zh.summary: 1989 年 1 月在安徽合肥举行的第五届全国评酒会，由中国食品工业协会主持，评出 17 种国家名酒，全部为白酒；此后全国性评酒会停办。本文说明其名单、背景与制度终结的原因。

en.title: The 1989 fifth national wine evaluation: seventeen famous wines and the end of the system
en.summary: The fifth national wine evaluation, held in Hefei, Anhui, in January 1989 and organised by the China Food Industry Association, selected 17 national famous wines, all baijiu; national evaluations were discontinued afterwards. This essay explains the list, the background and why the system ended.

zh.title: 1915 年法国苦艾酒禁令：一场科学、战争与葡萄酒业的合谋
zh.summary: 法国在第一次世界大战初期先由巴黎警察局禁止苦艾酒销售，1915 年 3 月 16 日又通过法律，禁止苦艾酒及类似利口酒的生产、流通与销售。禁令常被归因于“苦艾致幻”，但现代研究显示，当时对 thujone 的恐惧被夸大；战争、民族主义、葡萄酒业游说与禁酒运动同样关键。

en.title: The French Absinthe Ban of 1915: Science, War and the Wine Industry
en.summary: In the early years of the First World War the Paris police banned the sale of absinthe, and on 16 March 1915 a French law prohibited the production, circulation and sale of absinthe and similar liqueurs. The ban is often blamed on the idea that absinthe caused hallucinations, but modern research shows the fear of thujone was exaggerated; war, nationalism, wine-industry lobbying and the temperance movement were equally important.

zh.title: 法国 AOC 制度（1935）：原产地控制命名的诞生
zh.summary: 1935 年 7 月 30 日，法国以法令设立“原产地控制命名”（Appellation d'Origine Contrôlée, AOC），并成立全国葡萄酒与烈酒原产地命名委员会。此前半个世纪的根瘤蚜危机、产量过剩、掺假与产区划界冲突，促成了这套把地名、品种、产量与工艺绑定起来的制度。它后来扩展为 INAO 体系，并影响欧盟的原产地保护。

en.title: The French AOC System (1935): The Birth of Controlled Appellation of Origin
en.summary: On 30 July 1935 France created the Appellation d'Origine Contrôlée (AOC) by decree and set up a national committee for the appellations of wines and spirits. Half a century of phylloxera, overproduction, adulteration and boundary disputes led to this system, which tied a place name to varieties, yields and methods. It later grew into the INAO system and influenced European origin protection.

zh.title: 2013 年限制三公消费与白酒行业调整
zh.summary: 2012 年底中央八项规定出台后，2013 年对“三公”经费与公务接待从严控制，政务宴请与高端白酒消费明显收缩。本文说明政策背景、行业反应与调整期的结构性变化。

en.title: The 2013 restrictions on official consumption and the baijiu adjustment
en.summary: After the Central Committee's eight-point rules of late 2012, official spending and receptions were tightened in 2013, and official banquets and premium baijiu consumption contracted sharply. This essay explains the policy background, the industry response and the structural changes of the adjustment period.

zh.title: 1982 波尔多年份：一个年份如何成为现代葡萄酒市场的转折点
zh.summary: 1982 年的波尔多经历了温和冬季、早发芽、炎热七月与干燥九月，葡萄成熟度高，酒体丰厚。最初，部分美国评论者认为酒过于成熟、酸度不足；罗伯特·帕克在《The Wine Advocate》上公开看好这个年份，随着时间推移，1982 成为其声誉与波尔多期酒市场的转折点。但它并非全面完美的年份，不同酒庄与产区差异很大。

en.title: The 1982 Bordeaux Vintage: How a Year Became a Turning Point in the Modern Wine Market
en.summary: Bordeaux in 1982 had a mild winter, early budbreak, a hot July and a dry September, producing ripe, rich wines. Some American critics initially thought the wines were too ripe and low in acidity; Robert Parker championed the vintage in The Wine Advocate, and over time 1982 became a turning point for his reputation and for the Bordeaux en primeur market. It was not a uniformly perfect vintage, and differences among estates and appellations were large.

zh.title: 波士顿糖蜜洪水 1919：一场工业酒精原料的灾难
zh.summary: 1919 年 1 月 15 日，波士顿北端一座装有约 230 万加仑糖蜜的储罐爆裂，糖蜜以约 35 英里时速冲入街区，造成 21 人死亡、150 人受伤。储罐属于美国工业酒精公司旗下的 Purity Distilling，糖蜜用于战时工业酒精生产。事故推动了对储罐设计、施工与城市安全的反思。

en.title: The Boston Molasses Flood of 1919: An Industrial-Alcohol Disaster
en.summary: On 15 January 1919 a storage tank holding about 2.3 million gallons of molasses burst in Boston's North End. The molasses moved into the streets at an estimated 35 mph, killing 21 people and injuring 150. The tank belonged to Purity Distilling, a subsidiary of United States Industrial Alcohol, and supplied material for wartime industrial alcohol. The disaster prompted reflection on tank design, construction and urban safety.

zh.title: 香槟区划界（1927）：地名、地块与一场划界战争
zh.summary: 1927 年 7 月 22 日，法国通过法律正式划定香槟葡萄产区：以 1908 年法令确定的马恩省、埃纳省市镇为基础，加上奥布省三镇及 1919 至 1924 年收获申报中主张香槟命名的市镇，共 407 个市镇。划界只认“当时已种或根瘤蚜前种过”的地块，把省界之争转化为地块之争。1928 年过度登记与 1951 年复审，最终把产区收缩到约 3.4 万公顷、302 个市镇。

en.title: The 1927 Champagne Delimitation: Names, Parcels and a Boundary War
en.summary: On 22 July 1927 France passed a law formally delimiting the Champagne vineyard: 407 communes, based on the Marne and Aisne communes fixed by the 1908 decree, plus three communes in the Aube and those that had claimed the Champagne name in harvest declarations from 1919 to 1924. The law recognised only land already planted, or planted before the phylloxera crisis, turning a departmental dispute into a parcel dispute. Over-registration in 1928 and a review from 1951 eventually cut the area to about 34,000 hectares and 302 communes.

zh.title: 香槟暴动 1911：产区边界、葡萄价格与香槟的身份
zh.summary: 1911 年，香槟区因产区边界与葡萄价格爆发大规模抗议。1908 年的行政划界把奥布省排除在“香槟”之外，激怒当地种植者；1911 年 4 月，马恩省的种植者又因商人收购奥布葡萄而袭击酒商。暴动促成“香槟第二区”的临时安排，并最终影响 1927 年的产区划定。

en.title: The Champagne Riots of 1911: Appellation Boundaries, Grape Prices and the Identity of Champagne
en.summary: In 1911 Champagne was shaken by large-scale protest over appellation boundaries and grape prices. The 1908 administrative delimitation excluded most of the Aube from Champagne, angering local growers; in April 1911 growers in the Marne attacked merchants suspected of buying Aube grapes. The riots produced a temporary "second Champagne zone" and helped shape the 1927 delimitation.

zh.title: 张裕创建（1892）：中国近代葡萄酒工业的起点
zh.summary: 1892 年，南洋华侨张弼士投资 300 万两白银，在山东烟台芝罘湾畔创办张裕酿酒公司，被普遍视为中国近代工业化葡萄酒生产的起点。公司经三次引种葡萄、三请酿酒师，于 1894 至 1905 年建成地下大酒窖，1899 年出酒，1914 年产出白兰地，1915 年在巴拿马太平洋博览会获奖。

en.title: The Founding of Changyu (1892): The Start of Modern Chinese Winemaking
en.summary: In 1892 the overseas Chinese businessman Zhang Bishi invested 3 million taels of silver to found the Changyu Winery at Zhifu Bay in Yantai, Shandong, widely regarded as the start of industrial winemaking in China. After three rounds of vine introduction and three attempts to hire a winemaker, the company built an underground cellar between 1894 and 1905, produced wine in 1899 and brandy in 1914, and won a grand prize at the 1915 Panama-Pacific exposition.

zh.title: 鸡尾酒复兴（1980 年代）：从彩虹厅到手工调酒
zh.summary: 1970 年代的鸡尾酒市场被甜味预调与迪斯科文化占据，古典配方退到背景。1987 年，戴尔·德格罗夫在纽约彩虹厅重新开业时回到杰里·托马斯 1862 年的做法：鲜榨果汁、现做糖浆、大块冰与克制的酒单。这场以“把经典做对”为口号的复兴，后来演变为 1990 年代的手工调酒运动。

en.title: The Cocktail Revival (1980s): From the Rainbow Room to Craft Bartending
en.summary: In the 1970s sweet pre-mixes and disco culture pushed classic recipes into the background. In 1987, when the Rainbow Room reopened in New York, Dale DeGroff returned to Jerry Thomas's 1862 approach: fresh juice, house-made syrup, large ice and a restrained menu. That revival, framed as getting the classics right, grew into the craft cocktail movement of the 1990s.

zh.title: 精酿革命（1978）：美国自酿合法化与微型酿酒厂
zh.summary: 1978 年 10 月 14 日，美国总统卡特签署 H.R. 1337 税法案，其中由克兰斯顿与施泰格提出的修正案取消了家庭自酿啤酒的联邦消费税，1979 年 2 月 1 日生效。家庭酿酒由此重新合法，设备店、家庭酿酒协会与小型酒厂相互推动，被后世称为美国“精酿革命”的起点。

en.title: Craft Beer Revolution (1978): US Homebrewing Legalization and the Microbrewery
en.summary: On 14 October 1978 President Jimmy Carter signed the tax bill H.R. 1337, whose Cranston-Steiger amendment removed the federal excise tax on beer brewed at home; the provision took effect on 1 February 1979. Homebrewing became lawful again, and homebrewers, supply shops and small breweries fed one another in what is often called the start of the American craft beer revolution.

zh.title: 2015 年前后的中国精酿啤酒兴起
zh.summary: 2015 年前后，中国精酿啤酒从一线城市的小酒馆与小型酒厂扩展到更多城市，前店后厂、啤酒节与国产厂牌增多。本文说明其背景、形态、监管条件与规模争议。

en.title: The rise of Chinese craft beer around 2015
en.summary: Around 2015 Chinese craft beer expanded from small bars and breweries in first-tier cities to more cities, with taprooms, beer festivals and domestic brands multiplying. This essay explains the background, the forms, the regulatory conditions and the dispute over scale.

zh.title: 古巴朗姆国有化：从阿雷查巴拉家族到两个哈瓦那俱乐部
zh.summary: 1934 年，阿雷查巴拉家族在古巴卡德纳斯创立哈瓦那俱乐部（Havana Club）。1959 年革命后，革命政府于 1960 年将该家族企业收归国有，品牌转由国营的 Cubaexport 经营。1993 年，Cubaexport 与保乐力加成立合资公司，把古巴版哈瓦那俱乐部推向全球；1997 年，流亡家族把美国商标权卖给百加得，由此形成两个同名品牌与延续至今的诉讼。

en.title: The Nationalisation of Cuban Rum: From the Arechabala Family to Two Havana Clubs
en.summary: In 1934 the Arechabala family created Havana Club in Cardenas, Cuba. After the 1959 revolution the new government took over the family firm in 1960, and the brand passed to the state agency Cubaexport. In 1993 Cubaexport and Pernod Ricard formed a joint venture that took the Cuban Havana Club global; in 1997 the exiled family sold the US trademark to Bacardi, producing two brands with the same name and litigation that continues.

zh.title: 杜康造酒传说：一个人名如何变成酒的代称
zh.summary: 东汉《说文解字》记“杜康作秫酒”，又称“少康，杜康也”；曹操《短歌行》的“何以解忧，唯有杜康”让这个名字成了酒的代称。杜康的时代、身份与造酒地点在文献与地方传统中至少有四种说法，本页分别标注史料、观点与传说。

en.title: The Dukang Wine Legend: How a Person Became a Synonym for Wine
en.summary: The Eastern Han Shuowen Jiezi records that 'Dukang made shu wine' and adds that 'Shaokang is Dukang'; Cao Cao's line 'what relieves sorrow? Only Dukang' turned the name into a synonym for wine. At least four accounts of Dukang's era, identity and brewing place circulate in texts and local traditions; this essay separates sources, scholarly views and legend.

zh.title: 1988 年名酒价格放开
zh.summary: 1988 年 7 月，国家放开名烟名酒价格，名酒由计划定价转向市场调节。本文说明放开的范围、背景、涨价与渠道变化，以及它对名酒身份与行业格局的长期影响。

en.title: The 1988 liberalisation of famous-wine prices
en.summary: In July 1988 the state liberalised the prices of famous cigarettes and famous wines, moving famous wines from planned pricing to market pricing. This essay explains the scope, the background, the price surge and the channel changes, and the long-term effect on the identity of famous wines.

zh.title: 金酒热与金酒法：18 世纪英国烈酒危机
zh.summary: 18 世纪前半叶，廉价金酒在伦敦迅速普及，形成所谓“金酒热”。1736 年与 1751 年的多轮立法试图以许可、税负和销售限制抑制消费；1751 年《金酒法》配合霍加斯的《金酒巷》，成为英国烈酒监管史上的转折点。

en.title: The Gin Craze and the Gin Act: Britain's Eighteenth-Century Spirits Crisis
en.summary: In the first half of the eighteenth century cheap gin spread rapidly through London, creating what contemporaries called the Gin Craze. Licensing, taxation and retail restrictions culminated in the 1751 Gin Act, which, together with Hogarth's Gin Lane, became a turning point in British spirits regulation.

zh.title: 汉代酒榷：公元前98年的官营专卖与公元前81年的罢榷
zh.summary: 汉武帝天汉三年“初榷酒酤”，由官府垄断酒的酿造与销售；昭帝始元六年下诏询问贤良文学，同年七月罢榷酤官，改为民间按律申报纳税。前后不足二十年，却留下专卖、税酒与禁酒三种酒政长期交替的样本。

en.title: The Han Wine Monopoly: State Trading in 98 BCE and Its Abolition in 81 BCE
en.summary: In the third year of Tianhan, Emperor Wu 'first established the que wine monopoly', bringing brewing and selling under state control. In the sixth year of Yuanyuan, Emperor Zhao consulted the worthy and learned, and in the seventh month abolished the monopoly officials, replacing direct state trading with licensed private declaration and taxation. Less than twenty years long, it left a model that alternated with monopoly, wine tax and prohibition for centuries.

zh.title: 国际调酒师协会成立（1951）：七个协会的圆桌
zh.summary: 1951 年 2 月 24 日，来自丹麦、法国、意大利、荷兰、瑞典、瑞士与英国的七个调酒师协会，在英格兰托基的格兰德酒店沙龙里决定成立国际调酒师协会（IBA），首任主席为英国调酒师公会的比尔·塔林。协会后来以世界鸡尾酒大赛、调酒教育与官方鸡尾酒名单，把各自为政的各国公会连成一套跨国职业网络。

en.title: Founding of the International Bartenders Association (1951): A Round Table of Seven Guilds
en.summary: On 24 February 1951, seven bartenders' associations from Denmark, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom decided in the saloon of the Grand Hotel in Torquay, England, to found the International Bartenders Association (IBA), with Bill Tarling of the UK Bartenders Guild as its first president. The association later connected separate national guilds into a cross-border professional network through the World Cocktail Championship, bartending education and an official cocktail list.

zh.title: 贾湖酒遗存 7000 BCE：中国最早的发酵饮料证据
zh.summary: 河南舞阳贾湖遗址出土的陶器残留物经化学分析，显示出稻米、蜂蜜与山楂/葡萄类水果混合发酵的特征，年代可早至约公元前 7000 年。它把中国发酵饮料的直接化学证据向前推进，也说明早期酒类并非单一谷物酿造，而是多种原料的混合发酵。

en.title: The Jiahu Alcohol Residues of c. 7000 BCE: The Earliest Chemical Evidence of a Fermented Beverage in China
en.summary: Chemical analysis of residues in pottery from the Jiahu site in Wuyang, Henan, found features of a mixed fermentation of rice, honey and hawthorn or grape-like fruit, dated as early as about 7000 BCE. The finding pushed direct chemical evidence for Chinese fermented drinks back in time and showed that early brewing was not a single-grain process but a combination of sugar sources.

zh.title: 韩国烧酒史：从蒸馏酒到绿色瓶
zh.summary: 韩国烧酒有两条线索：一条是 13 世纪以来经高丽与元朝交流形成的谷物蒸馏酒，安东烧酒是其现存代表；另一条是 1965 年《粮食管理法》禁止用大米酿酒后，以进口淀粉制取高纯度酒精、再兑水而成的稀释式烧酒。后者以绿色瓶、低价与低度占领大众市场，并在 1996 年生产限制全面解除后成为全国性工业品类。

en.title: A History of Korean Soju: From Distilled Spirit to the Green Bottle
en.summary: Korean soju has two lineages: a grain-distilled spirit shaped by exchanges between Goryeo and the Mongol Yuan from the 13th century, still represented by Andong soju, and a diluted soju created after the 1965 Grain Management Act restricted rice in brewing, made by diluting alcohol distilled from imported starch. The latter took the mass market in green bottles at low prices and low strength, and became a nationwide industrial category after production restrictions ended in 1996.

zh.title: 伦敦啤酒洪水 1814：巨桶、波特酒与圣吉尔斯贫民区
zh.summary: 1814 年 10 月 17 日，伦敦托特纳姆法院路的 Meux 马靴啤酒厂一只巨型木桶破裂，约 32.3 万英制加仑波特啤酒冲入圣吉尔斯贫民区，冲毁房屋与酒馆，造成多人死亡。事故通常记为 8 人死亡，Historic England 的档案说明把次日因酒精中毒死亡的一人也计入，合计 9 人。

en.title: The London Beer Flood of 1814: Giant Vats, Porter and the St Giles Slum
en.summary: On 17 October 1814 a giant wooden vat at Meux's Horse Shoe Brewery on Tottenham Court Road burst, sending about 323,000 imperial gallons of porter into the St Giles slum. The wave destroyed houses and a tavern and killed several people. The death toll is usually given as eight; a Historic England archive note counts a ninth person who died the next day of alcohol poisoning.

zh.title: 明代烧酒：从药用到北方日常
zh.summary: 明代的烧酒已不是元代初传时的异域烈酒，但也没有立刻取代黄酒。宴席仍以黄酒为多，烧酒更多见于北方日常、药方与暑月饮用。李时珍《本草纲目》把烧酒单列成条，记录“甑蒸取露”的工艺与“大毒”的警告，成为后世叙述明代烧酒的核心文献。

en.title: Ming Shaojiu: From Medicine to Northern Everyday Drink
en.summary: In the Ming, shaojiu was no longer the foreign strong liquor of its first Yuan appearance, but it had not yet replaced huangjiu. Banquets still favoured huangjiu, while shaojiu appeared more often in northern everyday drinking, in medical formulas and in summer use. Li Shizhen's Bencao Gangmu gave shaojiu its own entry, recording the 'steam and collect the dew' process and warning of its 'great toxicity', and that entry became the core text for later accounts of Ming shaojiu.

zh.title: 自然酒运动：从博若莱的试验到 2020 年标签
zh.summary: 20 世纪 70 年代起，法国博若莱的一批酿酒者在化学家朱尔·沙维的影响下尝试不加硫、只用原生酵母的酿造方式；1980 年前后形成的“四人帮”让这种做法进入市场。2019 年行业协会成立，2020 年章程获法国主管部门认可，“Vin Méthode Nature”成为第一个受国家承认的自然酒标签。

en.title: The Natural Wine Movement: From Beaujolais Experiments to a 2020 Label
en.summary: From the 1970s, a group of winemakers in French Beaujolais, influenced by the chemist Jules Chauvet, experimented with fermentation without added sulphur and with indigenous yeasts; the "Gang of Four", formed around 1980, brought the approach to market. An industry association was founded in 2019, its charter was recognised by the French authorities in 2020, and Vin Méthode Nature became the first state-recognised natural wine label.

zh.title: 1915 年巴拿马太平洋万国博览会
zh.summary: 1915 年在旧金山举办的巴拿马太平洋万国博览会，是中国近代商品走向世界的重要场合，酒类展品与获奖说法也由此进入中国酒史叙事。本文说明会期、背景、参展与获奖争议，并区分“参展事实”与“金奖传说”。

en.title: The 1915 Panama-Pacific International Exposition
en.summary: The Panama-Pacific International Exposition, held in San Francisco in 1915, was a major international showcase for Chinese goods, and its wine exhibits and award claims entered the narrative of Chinese alcohol history. This essay sets out the dates, background, participation and award disputes, separating participation from the later gold-medal legend.

zh.title: 葡萄根瘤蚜大流行：一场重塑欧洲葡萄园的危机
zh.summary: 19 世纪 60 年代前后，原产北美的葡萄根瘤蚜随苗木传入欧洲，法国约在 1863 年确认疫情，1870 至 1880 年代大片葡萄园被毁。以美洲砧木嫁接欧洲品种成为主要解法，危机促成重植、杂交品种（如 Baco 22A）与产区制度重构。

en.title: The Phylloxera Epidemic: A Crisis That Reshaped Europe's Vineyards
en.summary: From the early 1860s, the North American grape phylloxera spread through European vineyards; France confirmed the outbreak around 1863, and the 1870s and 1880s destroyed vast areas. Grafting European vines onto American rootstocks became the main solution, driving replanting, hybrid varieties such as Baco 22A and the reconstruction of wine regions.

zh.title: 2012 年白酒塑化剂事件
zh.summary: 2012 年 11 月，酒鬼酒样品被检出塑化剂邻苯二甲酸二丁酯（DBP）1.08 mg/kg，超过当时参照的 0.3 mg/kg 限量，引发白酒行业信任危机与全国排查。本文说明事件经过、标准空白、企业整改与长期影响。

en.title: The 2012 baijiu plasticiser incident
en.summary: In November 2012 a sample of Jiugui liquor was found to contain 1.08 mg/kg of the plasticiser dibutyl phthalate (DBP), above the 0.3 mg/kg reference limit then applied, triggering a crisis of trust and nationwide checks across the baijiu industry. This essay explains the course, the standards gap, the remediation and the longer effects.

zh.title: 清代黄酒：绍兴酒行天下与名酒格局
zh.summary: 清代（1644—1911）是绍兴黄酒的全盛期。康熙年间的《会稽县志》已有“越酒行天下”之说，道光年间梁章钜称绍兴酒“通行海内，可谓酒之正宗”，贩运远达新疆。酒坊、酒庄与“京庄”“广庄”的分销网络，把黄酒从地方物产变成全国性商品。

en.title: Qing Huangjiu: Shaoxing Wine Reaches the Whole Country
en.summary: The Qing period (1644–1911) was the high point of Shaoxing huangjiu. The Kuaiji county gazetteer of the Kangxi reign already spoke of 'Yue wine travelling the world', and in the Daoguang reign Liang Zhangju called Shaoxing wine 'current throughout the seas, the true orthodox wine', shipped as far as Xinjiang. Breweries, wine houses and the 'Beijing parcel' and 'Guangdong parcel' distribution network turned huangjiu from a local product into a national commodity.

zh.title: 青岛啤酒厂创建（1903）：德英商人与中国第一座持续经营的啤酒厂
zh.summary: 1903 年 8 月 15 日，来自德国与英国的商人在青岛创办日耳曼啤酒公司青岛股份公司，厂址在今登州路 56 号，初期年产约 2000 吨淡色与黑色啤酒。1906 年产品在慕尼黑博览会获奖；1945 年改称青岛啤酒公司，1949 年更名为国营青岛啤酒厂。它是中国第一家持续经营至今的啤酒厂。

en.title: The Founding of the Qingdao Brewery (1903): German and British Merchants and China's First Continuously Operating Brewery
en.summary: On 15 August 1903 German and British merchants founded the Germania Brewery Company, Qingdao, at what is now 56 Dengzhou Road, with initial annual output of about 2000 tonnes of pale and dark beer. In 1906 its beer won an award at the Munich exhibition; in 1945 the plant was renamed Qingdao Brewery and in 1949 became the state-owned Qingdao Brewery. It is the first Chinese brewery still operating today.

zh.title: 德国啤酒纯净法 1516：一部地方条例如何变成国家符号
zh.summary: 1516 年 4 月 23 日，巴伐利亚公爵威廉四世与路德维希十世在因戈尔施塔特颁布《州法》，其中规定啤酒只能使用大麦、啤酒花与水。它最初只是巴伐利亚的地方条例，酵母也未列入；19 世纪后逐渐成为德国啤酒的形象符号，1906 年才在全德适用范围扩大。

en.title: The 1516 Bavarian Reinheitsgebot: How a Local Ordinance Became a National Symbol
en.summary: On 23 April 1516 Duke Wilhelm IV and Duke Ludwig X of Bavaria issued a Landesordnung at Ingolstadt requiring beer to be made from barley, hops and water. It was a Bavarian local ordinance, not a German national law, and yeast was not mentioned. Only in 1906 did its scope extend across Germany; it later became a powerful symbol of German brewing.

zh.title: 禁酒令废除 1933：第 21 条修正案与美国酒类监管的重置
zh.summary: 1933 年 2 月 20 日，美国国会提出第 21 条宪法修正案，废除第 18 条修正案；同年 12 月 5 日，犹他州成为第 36 个批准州，代理国务卿威廉·菲利普斯认证修正案生效。这是美国唯一一条由州制宪会议批准、并完整废除前一条修正案的宪法修正案。禁酒令结束，但酒类监管并未消失，而是转向州与地方许可制度。

en.title: The Repeal of Prohibition in 1933: The Twenty-first Amendment and the Rebuilding of American Alcohol Regulation
en.summary: On 20 February 1933 Congress proposed the Twenty-first Amendment, repealing the Eighteenth. On 5 December 1933 Utah became the thirty-sixth ratifying state, and Acting Secretary of State William Phillips certified the amendment. It is the only U.S. constitutional amendment ratified by state conventions and the only one that fully repeals an earlier amendment. Prohibition ended, but alcohol regulation did not disappear; it shifted to state and local licensing.

zh.title: 日本清酒近代化：酒税、试验所与级別
zh.summary: 明治维新后，日本把清酒纳入统一的酒税体系：1871 年颁布第一套近代酒税规则，1896 年确立酒造年度与免許限石数，1904 年设立醸造试验所，1909 至 1910 年出现山废酛与速酿酛，1911 年开办全国新酒鉴评会。20 世纪后期，级別制度在 1989 至 1992 年间退出，清酒的品质表达转向“特定名称酒”。

en.title: The Modernisation of Japanese Sake: Tax, Research Institute and Grades
en.summary: After the Meiji Restoration Japan brought sake into a unified tax system: the first modern sake tax rules appeared in 1871, the brewing year and licensed volume limits were fixed in 1896, the Brewing Research Institute was founded in 1904, yamahai and sokujo starter methods appeared in 1909 and 1910, and the first national new-sake competition opened in 1911. In the late 20th century the grade system was phased out between 1989 and 1992, and quality labelling shifted to the "special designation" categories.

zh.title: 苏格兰威士忌税史：从 1644 年消费税到 1823 年《消费税法》
zh.summary: 1644 年，苏格兰议会首次对威士忌征税，由此开启了长达 150 余年的私酿与走私时代。到 1820 年代，每年被查获的私酿蒸馏器多达 1.4 万座，超过一半的威士忌未纳税。1823 年 7 月 18 日《消费税法》以 10 英镑执照费与按加仑计税取代禁令，让合法蒸馏变得有利可图，被视为现代苏格兰威士忌产业的起点。

en.title: A Tax History of Scotch Whisky: From the 1644 Excise to the 1823 Excise Act
en.summary: In 1644 the Scottish Parliament first taxed whisky, opening a period of more than 150 years of illicit distilling and smuggling. By the 1820s as many as 14,000 illicit stills were seized each year and more than half the whisky drunk was untaxed. On 18 July 1823 the Excise Act replaced prohibition with a £10 licence and duty per gallon, making legal distilling profitable, and is widely seen as the start of the modern Scotch whisky industry.

zh.title: 商周酒礼：青铜酒器、酒正职官与《酒诰》的饮酒秩序
zh.summary: 商代与西周的饮酒嵌在祭祀、宴飨与等级秩序里。青铜酒器的组合、周代酒正一类职官的分工、《尚书·酒诰》对饮酒场合的限制，共同构成“酒礼”。本页说明这三条线索各自能证明什么，以及《周礼》《酒诰》作为史料需要保留的怀疑。

en.title: Shang and Zhou Wine Ritual: Bronze Vessels, the Wine Officer and the Jiugao
en.summary: Drinking in the Shang and Zhou periods was embedded in sacrifice, banqueting and hierarchy. Bronze wine-vessel sets, the duties of Zhou officials such as the wine officer, and the limits on drinking in the Book of Documents' Jiugao together make up what 'wine ritual' meant. This essay sets out what each line of evidence can prove, and why the Rites of Zhou and the Jiugao need to be read with caution.

zh.title: 宋代酒课：官务、民酿岁课与财政依赖
zh.summary: 宋代把酒类专卖与酒税收入统称“酒课”。诸州城内置“务”酿酒，县镇乡闾允许民酿而核定岁课，三京由官府造曲。酒课从真宗景德三年（1006）的四百二十八万贯增至庆历五年（1045）的一千七百一十万贯，成为工商税收的大宗。

en.title: Song Wine Tax: State Offices, Private Quotas and Fiscal Dependence
en.summary: The Song called its revenue from the wine monopoly and wine taxes 'wine tax' (jiuke). Prefectural cities set up state offices to brew, counties, towns and villages were allowed to brew against a fixed annual quota, and the three capitals had state-made qu. Wine revenue rose from 4.28 million strings in 1006 to 17.1 million strings in 1045, becoming a major part of commercial taxation.

zh.title: 1949 年后的国营酒厂与酒类专卖
zh.summary: 1949 年以后，各地私营酒坊被接管、合并并逐步转为国营或公私合营酒厂，酒类同时纳入专卖管理。本文说明这一转变的时间跨度、制度安排与对酒业格局的影响。

en.title: State-owned distilleries and the alcohol monopoly after 1949
en.summary: After 1949 private distilleries were taken over, merged and gradually converted into state-owned or joint state-private plants, while alcohol was brought under a monopoly system. This essay explains the timing, the institutional arrangements and the effect on the structure of the industry.

zh.title: 唐代酒坊：酒户、官坊与官店
zh.summary: 唐前期的酒业以民营为主，灾年才禁酒；安史之乱后财政紧张，广德二年开始量定酒户，建中三年改为官酿，贞元二年在京城与畿县行榷，元和年间又把榷钱摊入两税。酒坊由此分成纳税酒户、官营酒坊与官店三种形态。

en.title: Tang Wine Workshops: Licensed Houses, State Workshops and State Shops
en.summary: In the early Tang, brewing was mainly private and prohibition came in famine years; after the An Lushan rebellion fiscal pressure rose, licensed wine households were fixed in 764, state brewing was ordered in 782, excise was imposed in the capital region in 786, and in the Yuanhe period the wine levy was folded into the two taxes. Wine-making thus split into taxed households, state workshops and state shops.

zh.title: 美国禁酒令：1920年至1933年的实验与废止
zh.summary: 1920年生效的第十八修正案与《沃尔斯特法案》禁止酒类的制造、销售与运输；执行不力带来走私、地下酒吧与有组织犯罪。1933年第二十一修正案将其废止，并把酒类监管权更多交回各州。

en.title: US Prohibition: The Experiment and Repeal of 1920 to 1933
en.summary: The Eighteenth Amendment and the Volstead Act, in force from 1920, banned the manufacture, sale and transportation of alcoholic beverages; weak enforcement brought bootlegging, speakeasies and organized crime. The Twenty-first Amendment repealed Prohibition in 1933 and returned more alcohol regulation to the states.

zh.title: 威士忌暴乱 1791：美国早期联邦税与边疆政治
zh.summary: 1791 年，美国联邦政府对蒸馏酒开征消费税，西部宾夕法尼亚的农户与蒸馏者以拒税、集会与暴力抗议。1794 年，华盛顿动员约 13,000 名民兵西进，叛乱在军事压力下瓦解。这场“威士忌暴乱”成为美国联邦权威、税收政治与边疆利益冲突的早期试金石。

en.title: The Whiskey Rebellion of 1791: Federal Taxation and Frontier Politics in Early America
en.summary: In 1791 the United States imposed an excise tax on distilled spirits. Farmers and distillers in western Pennsylvania resisted with refusals, assemblies and violence. In 1794 Washington mobilised about 13,000 militia and marched west; the rebellion collapsed under military pressure. The Whiskey Rebellion became an early test of federal authority, tax politics and frontier interests.

zh.title: 仪狄造酒传说：文献里的“始作酒醪”与说不清的时代
zh.summary: 战国至东汉的几种文献把“作酒”或“作酒醪”记在仪狄名下，并附上禹饮而甘之、随后疏远仪狄的故事。这些文本成书远晚于传说所指的时代，仪狄其人、身份与地点都缺少可核验证据，本页把它当作古人对酿酒起源的一种解释。

en.title: The Yi Di Wine Legend: 'First to Make Jiu Lao', in Texts of Uncertain Date
en.summary: Several texts from the Warring States period to the Eastern Han credit Yi Di with 'making wine' or 'making jiu lao', adding the story that Yu drank it, found it sweet, and then distanced himself from Yi Di. These texts were written long after the era the legend describes, and Yi Di's person, identity, and location cannot be verified; this essay treats the story as an ancient explanation of how brewing began.

zh.title: 元代蒸馏酒传入：阿剌吉与烧酒的到来
zh.summary: 元代（1271—1368）从西域传入蒸馏酒，时名“阿剌吉”（亦作哈剌吉等），一般认为是阿拉伯语 'araq 的对音。它以酒醪蒸熬取露，度数远高于发酵酒，先入宫廷贵家，再扩散民间。李时珍“烧酒非古法也，自元时始创其法”的判断，成为后世叙述的主线，但更早器物的性质仍有争论。

en.title: The Yuan Arrival of Distilled Liquor: Araq and Shaojiu
en.summary: In the Yuan period (1271–1368) distilled liquor arrived from the Western Regions under the name araq, also written halaqi and several other ways, generally taken as a transcription of Arabic 'araq. It was made by heating fermented mash and collecting the distillate, giving far higher strength than fermented wine. It entered the court and wealthy households first, then spread more widely. Li Shizhen's judgement that shaojiu was 'not an ancient method, first created in the Yuan' became the main line of later accounts, though the date of earlier artefacts is still disputed.

zh.title: 龙舌兰（龙舌兰属）
zh.summary: 龙舌兰属是多肉植物，其 heart（piña）富含菊粉类果聚糖；蒸煮水解后发酵蒸馏，成为特基拉与梅斯卡尔的核心原料，品种、成熟年限与烘烤方式决定风味。

en.title: Agave
en.summary: Agave is a succulent genus whose heart, or piña, is rich in inulin-type fructans; after cooking and hydrolysis it is fermented and distilled into tequila and mezcal, with species, maturity and roasting method shaping flavour.

zh.title: 苹果
zh.summary: 苹果是蔷薇科苹果属的果实，糖、酸与单宁的组合决定 cider 的风格；专用 cider 苹果按酸度与单宁分为甜、酸、苦甜与苦酸四类，也可蒸馏为苹果白兰地与卡尔瓦多斯。

en.title: Apple
en.summary: The apple is the fruit of Malus domestica in the rose family, and the combination of sugar, acid and tannin defines cider style; cider apples are grouped as sweet, sharp, bittersweet and bittersharp by acidity and tannin, and the fruit can also be distilled into apple brandy and Calvados.

zh.title: 大麦
zh.summary: 禾本科大麦属的一年生谷物，发芽后成为麦芽，是啤酒与威士忌的基础原料；在白酒大曲中，它也常与小麦、豌豆搭配使用。

en.title: Barley
en.summary: An annual cereal of the genus Hordeum; after malting it becomes the base material for beer and whisky, and in baijiu daqu it is often paired with wheat and peas.

zh.title: 荞麦
zh.summary: 荞麦是蓼科荞麦属的假谷物，不含麸质；它用于荞麦啤酒、荞麦烧酒与部分地方白酒，带来泥土、蜂蜜与谷物香气，但蛋白质与淀粉特性使糖化与发酵需要单独调整。

en.title: Buckwheat
en.summary: Buckwheat is a pseudocereal in the Polygonaceae family and contains no gluten; it is used in buckwheat beer, soba shochu and some regional baijiu, bringing earthy, honeyed and grainy notes, while its protein and starch require separate adjustments in saccharification and fermentation.

zh.title: 樱桃
zh.summary: 樱桃是蔷薇科李属果实，甜樱桃与酸樱桃是两大类型；酸樱桃（Prunus cerasus）酸度高、香气强，是黑森林蛋糕、樱桃酒（kirsch）与樱桃白兰地的核心原料。

en.title: Cherry
en.summary: Cherry is a Prunus fruit, with sweet and sour types; sour cherry (Prunus cerasus) is high in acid and aroma and central to Black Forest cake, kirsch and cherry brandy.

zh.title: 糯米
zh.summary: 支链淀粉比例接近全部的稻米类型，蒸煮后黏性强、质地软糯；它是黄酒与部分甜米酒的典型原料，也常出现在多粮白酒配方中。

en.title: Glutinous rice
en.summary: A rice type whose starch is almost entirely amylopectin, becoming very sticky and soft after cooking; it is a typical raw material for yellow wine and some sweet rice drinks, and often appears in multi-grain baijiu recipes.

zh.title: 葡萄
zh.summary: 葡萄科葡萄属的藤本植物果实；酿酒用的欧洲葡萄以糖、酸、色素与单宁的组合决定葡萄酒的潜力，与鲜食葡萄的选育目标不同。

en.title: Grape
en.summary: The fruit of Vitis vines; wine grapes are selected for sugar, acid, pigment and tannin balance, unlike table grapes bred for eating.

zh.title: 青稞
zh.summary: 青藏高原的裸大麦，耐寒、耐旱、早熟，是糌粑、青稞酒与藏区日常饮食的基础；高纤维、β-葡聚糖与低升糖特性使它近年被视为健康谷物。

en.title: Highland Barley
en.summary: Naked barley of the Tibetan Plateau, cold- and drought-tolerant and early-ripening, the base of tsampa, barley wine and everyday diet in Tibetan areas; high fibre, beta-glucan and a low glycaemic profile have made it a health grain in recent years.

zh.title: 蜂蜜
zh.summary: 蜂蜜是蜜蜂采集花蜜酿成的甜味物质，以葡萄糖与果糖为主；它既是蜂蜜酒的唯一糖源，也可为啤酒、利口酒与烈酒提供香气，但低氮、高糖与低 pH 让发酵启动困难。

en.title: Honey
en.summary: Honey is the sweet substance bees make from nectar, dominated by glucose and fructose; it is the sole sugar source of mead and can add aroma to beer, liqueurs and spirits, but low nitrogen, high sugar and low pH make fermentation hard to start.

zh.title: 啤酒花
zh.summary: 啤酒花是大麻科葎草属的多年生藤本植物，雌花球果中的α-酸经煮沸异构化产生苦味，精油带来香气，多酚与抑菌成分影响泡沫、澄清与保质期。

en.title: Hops
en.summary: Hops are the female flower cones of a perennial climbing plant in the Cannabaceae family; alpha acids isomerise during the boil to give bitterness, essential oils give aroma, and polyphenols and antibacterial compounds affect foam, clarity and shelf life.

zh.title: 杜松子
zh.summary: 杜松子是刺柏属杜松的雌球果，富含α-蒎烯、月桂烯等萜类；它是金酒的法定核心风味，蒸馏方式与用量决定杜松子是主导还是与其他植物协同。

en.title: Juniper
en.summary: Juniper berries are the female cones of Juniperus communis and rich in terpenes such as alpha-pinene and myrcene; they are the legally required core flavour of gin, and distillation method and dose decide whether juniper leads or blends with other botanicals.

zh.title: 玉米
zh.summary: 禾本科玉米属的一年生谷物，淀粉含量高、脂肪集中在胚芽；它是多粮白酒的常见配料，也是美国波本威士忌与部分啤酒辅料的核心原料。

en.title: Maize
en.summary: An annual cereal of the genus Zea with high starch content and fat concentrated in the germ; it is a common ingredient in multi-grain baijiu and a core raw material in American bourbon and some beer adjuncts.

zh.title: 小米（粟）
zh.summary: 小米是粟（Setaria italica）脱壳后的籽粒，也是黍、珍珠粟等小粒谷物的统称；在中国它用于黄酒与小米酒，在非洲与亚洲则用于传统浑浊谷物酒，淀粉与蛋白质结构影响糖化与风味。

en.title: Millet
en.summary: Millet is the hulled grain of foxtail millet (Setaria italica) and a general name for small-seeded cereals such as proso and pearl millet; in China it is used in huangjiu and millet wine, and in Africa and Asia for traditional cloudy grain beers, with starch and protein shaping saccharification and flavour.

zh.title: 糖蜜
zh.summary: 糖蜜是制糖结晶后剩下的糖浆，含蔗糖、葡萄糖、果糖与矿物质；它是朗姆酒最主要的糖源，也是工业酵母的常见培养基，等级与成分直接决定发酵速度与风味。

en.title: Molasses
en.summary: Molasses is the syrup left after sugar crystallisation, containing sucrose, glucose, fructose and minerals; it is the main sugar source for rum and a common industrial yeast medium, and its grade and composition shape fermentation speed and flavour.

zh.title: 燕麦
zh.summary: 燕麦是禾本科燕麦属的一年生谷物，脂肪与β-葡聚糖含量高；它在啤酒中带来柔滑酒体与浑浊感，也用于燕麦世涛，但高脂肪与黏性让糖化、过滤和蒸馏都比大麦更麻烦。

en.title: Oats
en.summary: Oats are an annual cereal of the genus Avena with high fat and beta-glucan content; they bring silky body and haze to beer and are traditional in oatmeal stout, but fat and viscosity make saccharification, lautering and distillation harder than with barley.

zh.title: 梨
zh.summary: 梨是梨属水果，既可鲜食，也可酿酒；专门用于酿酒的“perry pear”单宁高、酸度高、香气强，在英国与法国诺曼底酿成 perry（梨酒），风格与苹果酒相近但更轻盈。

en.title: Pear
