en.summary: Pear is the fruit of the genus Pyrus, eaten fresh and also fermented; specialist perry pears have high tannin, acidity and aroma, and are made into perry in England and Normandy, lighter than apple cider but related in style.

zh.title: 梅
zh.summary: 梅是蔷薇科李属果实，东亚的“梅”（Prunus mume）与西方李子不同；青梅酸度高、香气清，常用于腌渍、梅酒（umeshu）与梅醋，是日本、中国与韩国共有的饮食传统。

en.title: Plum
en.summary: Plum is a Prunus fruit; East Asian “ume” (Prunus mume) differs from Western plums, with high acidity and clean aroma, used for pickles, umeshu and plum vinegar, a shared food tradition in Japan, China and Korea.

zh.title: 马铃薯
zh.summary: 马铃薯是茄科块茎作物，富含淀粉与水分，是波兰、德国、瑞典与东欧马铃薯伏特加的核心原料；口感通常比谷物伏特加更圆润、略带甜感，且天然无麸质。

en.title: Potato
en.summary: Potato is a tuber of the nightshade family, rich in starch and water, and the core material for potato vodka in Poland, Germany, Sweden and Eastern Europe; it is usually rounder and slightly sweeter than grain vodka and naturally gluten-free.

zh.title: 大米
zh.summary: 稻谷脱壳碾磨后的籽粒，是白酒、黄酒与清酒的重要淀粉原料；粳米与籼米的淀粉结构、黏性与蒸煮表现不同，直接影响糖化与发酵。

en.title: Rice
en.summary: The grain left after rice is husked and milled, and an important starch source for baijiu, yellow wine and sake; japonica and indica rice differ in starch structure, stickiness and steaming behaviour, which directly affect saccharification and fermentation.

zh.title: 黑麦
zh.summary: 黑麦是禾本科黑麦属的一年生谷物，耐寒耐瘠；它是美国黑麦威士忌的法定主体，也为啤酒带来辛辣干爽的谷物风味，β-葡聚糖与蛋白质使糖化和过滤更难。

en.title: Rye
en.summary: Rye is an annual cereal of the genus Secale, hardy and tolerant of poor soil; it is the required base of American rye whiskey and brings a spicy, dry grain character to beer, while beta-glucans and proteins make saccharification and lautering harder.

zh.title: 高粱
zh.summary: 禾本科高粱属的一年生谷物，是中国白酒最主要的粮谷原料之一；籽粒的淀粉、蛋白质、脂肪与单宁比例共同影响发酵与风味。

en.title: Sorghum
en.summary: An annual cereal of the genus Sorghum and one of the main grain ingredients in Chinese baijiu; the balance of starch, protein, fat and tannin in the grain shapes fermentation and flavour.

zh.title: 甘蔗
zh.summary: 甘蔗是禾本科甘蔗属的高大草本，茎秆富含蔗糖；压汁直接发酵可做甘蔗汁朗姆与巴西甘蔗酒，先制糖再用糖蜜发酵则形成另一条朗姆路线，原料处理方式决定酒的风格。

en.title: Sugarcane
en.summary: Sugarcane is a tall grass of the genus Saccharum whose stems store sucrose; pressing the juice and fermenting it directly yields cane-juice rum and Brazilian cane spirit, while refining sugar first and fermenting the molasses gives the other major rum route.

zh.title: 水
zh.summary: 酿酒中最容易被忽略却无处不在的原料；水的矿物质、硬度与 pH 影响糖化、发酵、微生物活动与最终风味，也决定酒厂选址的传统。

en.title: Water
en.summary: The most easily overlooked yet ubiquitous ingredient in brewing; its minerals, hardness and pH affect saccharification, fermentation, microbial activity and final flavour, and have long shaped where distilleries and breweries are sited.

zh.title: 小麦
zh.summary: 禾本科小麦属的一年生谷物，既是主粮，也是制曲、多粮白酒、啤酒与威士忌的重要原料；蛋白质与淀粉的比例影响曲的质量和酒体走向。

en.title: Wheat
en.summary: An annual cereal of the genus Triticum, used as a staple food and as a key ingredient in qu making, multi-grain baijiu, beer and whisky; the balance of protein and starch shapes both qu quality and the body of the drink.

zh.title: 酵母
zh.summary: 酵母是单细胞真菌，把糖转化为乙醇与二氧化碳，并产生酯类、高级醇等风味物质；菌种、接种方式与温度决定发酵走向，是酿酒中最关键却最常被忽略的变量。

en.title: Yeast
en.summary: Yeast is a single-celled fungus that turns sugar into ethanol and carbon dioxide and produces esters, higher alcohols and other flavour compounds; strain, pitching method and temperature steer fermentation, making yeast the most important and most overlooked variable in brewing.

zh.title: 反酒馆联盟：把禁酒送入宪法的压力集团
zh.summary: 反酒馆联盟 1893 年在俄亥俄以州级团体起步，1895 年成为全国组织，主要依托新教福音派教会，在各级政府对禁酒立法施压。第十八修正案通过后它推动严格执法，1933 年废止后失去政治影响力，1950 年并入全国禁酒联盟。

en.title: The Anti-Saloon League: the pressure group that wrote prohibition into the Constitution
en.summary: The Anti-Saloon League began in 1893 as a state-level body in Ohio and became a national organisation in 1895, drawing mainly on evangelical Protestant churches to press legislators at every level of government. After the Eighteenth Amendment it pushed for strict enforcement; once prohibition was repealed in 1933 it lost its political weight, merging into the National Temperance League in 1950.

zh.title: 美国酿酒师协会：为“小而独立”下定义的行业组织
zh.summary: 美国酿酒师协会（Brewers Association，BA）由 1978 年成立的 American Homebrewers Association 与更早的小啤酒厂组织演变而来，2005 年由 Association of Brewers 与 Brewers’ Association of America 合并而成。它代表美国小型与独立酿酒厂，维护“craft brewer”定义，主办 Great American Beer Festival，并在华盛顿做行业倡导。它不是政府监管机构。

en.title: Brewers Association: the trade body that defines small and independent
en.summary: The Brewers Association (BA) grew out of the American Homebrewers Association founded in 1978 and earlier small-brewer bodies, and took its present form in 2005 when the Association of Brewers merged with the Brewers' Association of America. It represents small and independent US breweries, maintains the craft brewer definition, runs the Great American Beer Festival and advocates in Washington. It is not a government regulator.

zh.title: 加州葡萄酒协会：为加州酒庄做公共政策倡导
zh.summary: 加州葡萄酒协会（Wine Institute）1934 年由两个前身组织合并成立，是加州葡萄酒行业的公共政策倡导组织，代表约 1000 家酒庄与相关企业，总部在萨克拉门托。它在州、联邦与国际层面推动政策，运营出口推广，并与加州酿酒葡萄种植者协会于 2003 年共同创建加州可持续葡萄种植联盟；它本身不是执法机构。

en.title: Wine Institute: public policy advocacy for California wineries
en.summary: Wine Institute, formed in 1934 by the merger of two predecessor bodies, is the public policy advocacy association of the California wine industry. It represents about 1,000 wineries and affiliated businesses, is headquartered in Sacramento, works on policy at state, federal and international level, runs export promotion and in 2003 co-created the California Sustainable Winegrowing Alliance with the California Association of Winegrape Growers. It is not an enforcement body.

zh.title: 欧洲葡萄酒企业委员会
zh.summary: 欧洲葡萄酒企业委员会（CEEV）是总部设在布鲁塞尔的欧洲葡萄酒行业组织，代表葡萄酒企业与各国行业协会，在欧盟层面参与葡萄酒政策、标签、推广与贸易议题的讨论。

en.title: The European Committee of Wine Enterprises (CEEV)
en.summary: The Comité Européen des Entreprises Vins (CEEV) is a Brussels-based European wine trade body representing wine companies and national associations in EU discussions on wine policy, labelling, promotion and trade.

zh.title: 中国酒类流通协会：从商业协会到流通协会
zh.summary: 中国酒类流通协会 1995 年 4 月正式成立，原名中国酒类商业协会，2006 年 4 月经民政部批准更名，是经民政部批准的国家一级协会，住所北京。它服务酒类生产与流通企业，做行业自律、市场信息、培训与厂商关系协调；2014 年启动“国家级放心酒示范店”认定，至 2025 年已认定近 2000 家，覆盖 31 个省级行政区。

en.title: China Alcohol Circulation Association: from commerce to circulation
en.summary: The China Alcohol Circulation Association was formally established in April 1995 as the China Liquor Commerce Association and renamed in April 2006 with the approval of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, which recognises it as a national first-tier association. It is based in Beijing and serves liquor producers and distributors through self-discipline, market information, training and manufacturer-retailer coordination. Its national assured-liquor demonstration store programme began in 2014 and had recognised nearly 2,000 stores by 2025, covering 31 provincial-level regions.

zh.title: 中国酒业协会：从酿酒工业协会到跨酒种行业组织
zh.summary: 中国酒业协会原名中国酿酒工业协会，1992 年 6 月 22 日经原轻工业部审查同意、由民政部登记注册成立。登记管理机关是民政部，业务主管单位是工业和信息化部。它覆盖白酒、啤酒、葡萄酒、黄酒等酒种，做团体标准、展会、行业数据与人才培训，但不是行政机关，也不直接发放生产许可。

en.title: China Alcoholic Drinks Association: from an industrial body to a cross-category trade organisation
en.summary: The China Alcoholic Drinks Association (CADA) was originally the China Brewing Industry Association. It was approved by the former Ministry of Light Industry and registered with the Ministry of Civil Affairs on 22 June 1992. Its registration authority is the Ministry of Civil Affairs and its business guidance comes from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. It covers baijiu, beer, wine and yellow wine, runs group standards, exhibitions and industry data, but it is not an administrative agency and does not issue production licences.

zh.title: 波尔多葡萄酒行业协会：种植者与酒商如何坐在一起
zh.summary: 波尔多葡萄酒行业协会（CIVB）1948 年 8 月 18 日依法设立，是波尔多葡萄酒种植者与酒商的跨行业组织，2014 年获承认为跨行业组织，2016 年经法令调整组织。它做推广、市场研究、技术与经济事务，但不负责 AOC 规则的执法，后者由法国国家原产地与质量管理局（INAO）承担。

en.title: The Bordeaux wine trade council: growers and merchants at one table
en.summary: The CIVB, created by law on 18 August 1948, is the interprofessional body of Bordeaux winegrowers and merchants. It was recognised as an interprofessional organisation in 2014 and reorganised by decree in 2016. It works on promotion, market research and technical and economic matters, but does not enforce AOC rules, which fall to France's INAO.

zh.title: 中国食品工业协会：食品工业的行业组织，也管白酒评委
zh.summary: 中国食品工业协会（CNFIA，简称中国食协）经国务院批准于 1981 年 10 月 29 日成立，是全国食品工业的自律性行业管理组织，职能可概括为统筹、规划、协调、指导、服务。它下设白酒专业委员会，1984 年起组建白酒国家评委队伍；它不是监管机构，食品安全标准与市场执法由政府部门负责。

en.title: CNFIA: a food-industry body that also trains baijiu judges
en.summary: The China National Food Industry Association (CNFIA) was approved by the State Council and founded on 29 October 1981 as the self-regulatory industry body of China's food industry, with the stated functions of coordination, planning, liaison, guidance and service. It has a baijiu professional committee and from 1984 has organised the national baijiu judge corps; it is not a regulator, and food safety standards and market enforcement belong to government.

zh.title: 香槟协会：种植者与酒商如何共同管理一个产区
zh.summary: 香槟协会（Comité Champagne，旧称 CIVC）1941 年成立，是香槟产区种植者与酒商的跨行业组织。它协调产区内部的经济、技术、环境与推广事务，并负责香槟原产地名称的海外保护；AOC 规则的制定与认定仍由法国国家原产地与质量管理局（INAO）负责。

en.title: Comité Champagne: How Growers and Houses Manage a Region Together
en.summary: The Comité Champagne, formerly the CIVC, was founded in 1941 as the interprofessional body of Champagne growers and houses. It coordinates the region's economic, technical, environmental and promotional work and protects the Champagne designation abroad; the rules of the AOC are still set and recognised by INAO, the French national institute for origin and quality.

zh.title: 侍酒大师公会：把餐厅酒水服务变成一套考试
zh.summary: 侍酒大师公会（Court of Master Sommeliers，CMS）不是中世纪骑士团，而是一个从英国餐厅酒水服务需求中长出来的考试机构。第一次侍酒大师考试在 1969 年的伦敦举行，公会在 1977 年正式成立。它用四级资格把侍酒师的经验拆成可考核的知识与服务动作，但证书不等于执业许可，也不等于政府认证。

en.title: Court of Master Sommeliers: turning restaurant wine service into an exam
en.summary: The Court of Master Sommeliers (CMS) is not a medieval order but an examining body that grew out of the needs of British restaurant wine service. The first Master Sommelier examination was held in London in 1969, and the Court was formally established in 1977. Its four levels turn a sommelier's experience into examinable knowledge and service, but the title is neither a licence to practise nor a government certification.

zh.title: 墨西哥龙舌兰监管委员会：谁来证明一瓶龙舌兰酒是真的
zh.summary: 龙舌兰酒监管委员会（CRT）1994 年 5 月 17 日在墨西哥成立，是民间非营利组织，总部位于哈利斯科州萨波潘。它把龙舌兰种植者、龙舌兰酒生产商、装瓶商、经销与政府机构纳入同一架构，负责按 NOM-006-SCFI-2012 检查与认证，并在墨西哥境内外维护龙舌兰酒原产地名称；它获得墨西哥认可机构与联邦主管部门的批准，但不是政府机关。

en.title: Tequila Regulatory Council: Who Certifies That a Bottle of Tequila Is Genuine
en.summary: The Tequila Regulatory Council (CRT) was founded in Mexico on 17 May 1994 as a civil, non-profit organisation based in Zapopan, Jalisco. It brings agave growers, tequila producers, bottlers, distributors and government agencies into one body, inspects and certifies compliance with NOM-006-SCFI-2012, and defends the Tequila appellation in Mexico and abroad. It is accredited and approved by Mexican bodies, but it is not a government department.

zh.title: 美国蒸馏酒协会：酒业在华盛顿的代言人
zh.summary: 美国蒸馏酒协会（DISCUS）1973 年由波本研究所、蒸馏酒研究所与持牌酒类产业公司三家前身合并而成，是全国性行业组织，总部在华盛顿宪法大道。它在联邦、州与地方层面做立法与监管游说，制定自愿性广告自律准则，发布行业经济数据；它不是监管机构，许可、税制与标签审批仍属政府。

en.title: DISCUS: The US Spirits Trade's Voice in Washington
en.summary: The Distilled Spirits Council of the United States (DISCUS) was formed in 1973 by the merger of the Bourbon Institute, the Distilled Spirits Institute and Licensed Beverage Industries. It is a national trade association headquartered at 101 Constitution Avenue NW in Washington, D.C. It lobbies at federal, state and local level, runs a voluntary advertising code and publishes industry data; it is not a regulator, since licensing, tax and label approval remain with government.

zh.title: 西班牙葡萄酒联合会：把酒庄的声音集中起来
zh.summary: 西班牙葡萄酒联合会（FEV）1978 年成立，是西班牙全国性的私营非营利酒庄协会，代表 950 多家酒庄与 17 个协会，成员酒庄合计约占西班牙瓶装葡萄酒价值的 83%。它做政策倡导、行业协调、市场观察与可持续认证，自身不是监管机构；其章程存放于西班牙劳动与社会经济部，最近一次修改备案于 2020 年 11 月 18 日。

en.title: FEV: gathering the voice of Spanish wineries
en.summary: The Federación Española del Vino (FEV), founded in 1978, is Spain's national private non-profit winery association, representing more than 950 wineries and 17 associations whose combined output is about 83% of the value of Spanish bottled wine. It works on policy, industry coordination, market observation and sustainability certification, and is not a regulator; its statutes are deposited with the Spanish Ministry of Labour and Social Economy, with the latest amendment filed on 18 November 2020.

zh.title: 葡萄酒大师协会：一个由考试产生的专业共同体
zh.summary: 葡萄酒大师协会（Institute of Masters of Wine，IMW）起源于 1953 年的一次考试。当年 21 人参加，6 人通过，这 6 位首批葡萄酒大师在 1955 年创办了协会。IMW 以伦敦为总部，会员遍布全球，考试包括理论、盲品与一篇研究论文，通过后还要签署行为准则。它不是监管机构，也不授予执业许可。

en.title: Institute of Masters of Wine: a professional community born from an exam
en.summary: The Institute of Masters of Wine (IMW) began with an examination in 1953. Twenty-one candidates sat it and six passed; those six founded the Institute in 1955. Based in London but international in membership, the IMW examines theory, blind tasting and an individual research paper, and requires members to sign a code of conduct. It is not a regulator and does not grant a licence to practise.

zh.title: 日本酒造组合中央会：清酒、烧酎与味醂的行业组织
zh.summary: 日本酒造组合中央会（JSS）1953 年 12 月依《酒税保全及酒类业组合等法律》成立，是日本清酒、本格烧酎、泡盛与本味醂生产者的全国性行业组织。它做推广、技术研究、统计与行业协调，约有 1600 家会员企业；它不是执法机构，酒类许可与税制由政府部门负责。

en.title: Japan Sake and Shochu Makers Association: The Trade Body for Sake, Shochu and Mirin
en.summary: The Japan Sake and Shochu Makers Association (JSS) was founded in December 1953 under the Act on Securing of Liquor Tax and on Liquor Business Associations. It is the national trade body for producers of sake, honkaku shochu, awamori and hon mirin, with about 1,600 member companies. It promotes, researches and coordinates, but it is not an enforcement agency: licensing and tax matters belong to government.

zh.title: 韩国酒类产业协会：烧酒与酒类企业的行业组织
zh.summary: 韩国酒类产业协会（한국주류산업협회）1980 年 11 月成立，是以烧酒、清酒、威士忌等酒类企业为主的行业组织。它做产业推广、调查研究和面向公众的宣传教育，但不是监管机构；酒类许可、税制与流通规则由政府负责，协会的统计也不能替代官方统计。

en.title: Korea Alcohol Industry Association: The Trade Body for Soju and Other Drinks
en.summary: The Korea Alcohol Industry Association was founded in November 1980 and represents companies making soju, cheongju, whisky and other drinks. It promotes the industry, carries out research and informs the public, but it is not a regulator: licensing, tax and distribution rules belong to government, and its statistics cannot replace official statistics.

zh.title: 新西兰葡萄酒种植者协会：把种植者与酒庄放在同一个组织里
zh.summary: 新西兰葡萄酒种植者协会（NZW）2002 年 3 月成立，是新西兰葡萄与葡萄酒行业的全国性组织，拥有 600 多名种植者会员与 700 多名酒庄会员。它同时代表种植与酿造两端，做推广、研究、行业数据与 SWNZ 可持续认证；它不是政府机构，出口与食品安全规则由政府负责。

en.title: New Zealand Winegrowers: Growers and Wineries in One Organisation
en.summary: New Zealand Winegrowers (NZW), established in March 2002, is the national organisation for the country's grape and wine sector, with more than 600 grower members and 700 winery members. It represents both growing and winemaking, and works on promotion, research, industry data and SWNZ sustainability certification. It is not a government body; export and food-safety rules belong to government.

zh.title: 国际葡萄与葡萄酒组织：从1924年的葡萄酒局到今天
zh.summary: OIV 1924 年以“国际葡萄酒局”之名在巴黎成立，起因是葡萄根瘤蚜危机后的国际协作与假酒贸易治理。2001 年改组后使用现名，总部在法国第戎；它制定协调标准、统计与研究，但标准不自动成为成员国法律。

en.title: The International Organisation of Vine and Wine: from the 1924 wine office to today
en.summary: The OIV was founded in Paris in 1924 as the Office International du Vin, driven by international cooperation after the phylloxera crisis and by the need to govern fraudulent wine trade. Reorganised in 2001 under its present name, it is based in Dijon, France; it sets harmonised standards, statistics and research, but its standards do not automatically become member-state law.

zh.title: 苏格兰威士忌协会：行业如何守住一个名字
zh.summary: 苏格兰威士忌协会（SWA）的历史可追溯至 1912 年，总部在爱丁堡，是苏格兰威士忌行业的贸易协会，代表 90 多家会员公司，按产量计约占苏格兰威士忌的 97%。它维护“Scotch Whisky”的法律保护与技术定义，参与税收、贸易与可持续议题；现行法人实体是 1960 年注册的担保有限公司，协会本身不是监管机构。

en.title: The Scotch Whisky Association: how an industry guards a name
en.summary: The Scotch Whisky Association (SWA) traces its history to 1912 and is based in Edinburgh. It is the trade association of the Scotch whisky industry, representing more than 90 member companies that account for 97% of Scotch whisky by production. It defends the legal protection and technical definition of Scotch Whisky and works on tax, trade and sustainability; the current legal entity is a company limited by guarantee registered in 1960, and the association is not a regulator.

zh.title: 葡萄牙葡萄酒协会：跨行业的推广机构
zh.summary: 葡萄牙葡萄酒协会（ViniPortugal）1996 年 10 月 15 日成立，是私人非营利性质的跨行业组织，成员包括贸易、生产、合作社、蒸馏、农业与法定产区等九个协会。它推广葡萄牙葡萄酒，运营 2010 年创建的“Wines of Portugal”品牌，并于 2015 年获农业部承认为葡萄酒跨行业组织。

en.title: ViniPortugal: an interprofessional promoter of Portuguese wine
en.summary: ViniPortugal was founded on 15 October 1996 as a private, non-profit interprofessional body whose members are nine associations for trade, production, cooperatives, distillation, agriculture and protected appellations. It promotes Portuguese wine, runs the Wines of Portugal brand created in 2010, and in 2015 was recognised by the Ministry of Agriculture as the wine interprofessional organisation.

zh.title: 智利葡萄酒协会：把智利酒整体推向海外
zh.summary: 智利葡萄酒协会（Vinos de Chile / Wines of Chile）2007 年由 Viñas de Chile 与 ChileVid 合并而成，是私人非营利的行业协会，总部位于圣地亚哥维塔库拉区。它做海外推广、市场情报与行业协调，并通过技术联盟运营可持续认证；它不是监管机构。

en.title: Vinos de Chile: presenting Chilean wine as a whole abroad
en.summary: Vinos de Chile, also known as Wines of Chile, was formed in 2007 when Viñas de Chile and ChileVid merged. It is a private non-profit trade association based in Vitacura, Santiago, working on export promotion, market intelligence and industry coordination, and running a sustainability certification through its technology consortium. It is not a regulator.

zh.title: 澳大利亚葡萄酒管理局：研究、推广与出口监管的法定机构
zh.summary: 澳大利亚葡萄酒管理局（Wine Australia）2014 年 7 月 1 日依《2013 年葡萄酒澳大利亚法》成立，是澳大利亚联邦政府的法定机构，职能包括研发与创新、市场推广以及葡萄酒出口监管。它由行业缴纳的法定税费与政府研发配套资金支持，受法定资助协议约束，不能从事行业政治倡导。

en.title: Wine Australia: A Statutory Body for Research, Promotion and Export Control
en.summary: Wine Australia was established on 1 July 2014 under the Wine Australia Act 2013. It is a Commonwealth Government statutory authority whose functions cover research and innovation, market promotion, and the regulation of wine exports. It is funded by statutory industry levies and matched government research funding, and is bound by a statutory funding agreement that bars it from industry political advocacy.

zh.title: 南非葡萄酒协会：把南非葡萄酒推向出口市场
zh.summary: 南非葡萄酒协会（Wines of South Africa，WoSA）是南非葡萄酒行业的非营利组织，由行业所有、以税费运营，专门在海外市场推广南非葡萄酒。总部设在斯泰伦博斯，在伦敦、纽约、香港设点，并通过代理覆盖加拿大、瑞典、荷兰与德国。它不做销售、不负责产地认证，成立年份在公开资料中未见明确记载。

en.title: Wines of South Africa: Taking South African Wine to Export Markets
en.summary: Wines of South Africa (WoSA) is a non-profit organisation owned by the South African wine industry and funded by levies, dedicated to promoting South African wine in international markets. Its head office is in Stellenbosch, with offices in London, New York and Hong Kong and agencies in Canada, Sweden, the Netherlands and Germany. It does not sell wine and does not certify origin; public material does not record a founding year.

zh.title: WSET：把品酒变成可以考试的资格
zh.summary: WSET（Wine & Spirit Education Trust）1969 年在伦敦成立，是英国的葡萄酒与烈酒教育机构，兼具发证机构与注册慈善机构身份，其资格受英国 Ofqual 承认。它提供从入门到四级文凭的分级课程，把品鉴、产区、工艺与法规整理成可考核的内容，但资格证书不等于执业许可。

en.title: WSET: turning tasting into an examinable qualification
en.summary: WSET (Wine & Spirit Education Trust), founded in London in 1969, is a British wine and spirits education body that is both an awarding body and a registered charity, with qualifications recognised by Ofqual. It offers graded courses from beginner to the Level 4 Diploma, turning tasting, regions, production and regulation into examinable content, but a certificate is not a licence to practise.

zh.title: 奶酪配葡萄酒：按质地、咸度与脂肪搭
zh.summary: 奶酪的质地、咸度与脂肪决定配酒方向；从新鲜山羊奶酪到蓝纹奶酪，酸度、甜度与酒体比“红酒配奶酪”的成见更重要。

en.title: Cheese and Wine: Match Texture, Salt and Fat
en.summary: The texture, salt and fat of a cheese decide the direction of the wine; from fresh goat cheese to blue cheese, acidity, sweetness and body matter more than the old rule that red wine goes with every cheese.

zh.title: 甜点配波特：比甜点更甜，才不腻
zh.summary: 甜点与波特的搭配核心是“酒不能比甜点更不甜”；按甜点的甜度、脂肪与风味强度选 Ruby、Tawny 或 White Port，酸度与氧化风味决定收尾是否干净。

en.title: Dessert and Port: Sweeter Than the Dessert
en.summary: The core of dessert and Port pairing is that the wine must not be less sweet than the dessert; choose Ruby, Tawny or White Port by the dessert's sugar, fat and intensity, with acidity and oxidative notes deciding whether the finish stays clean.

zh.title: 法餐配勃艮第：黑皮诺与酱汁的细腻对话
zh.summary: 法餐的黄油、蘑菇、禽肉与酱汁，与勃艮第红葡萄酒的轻酒体、高香与细单宁相合；搭配靠香气与酸度，而不是靠酒体压菜。

en.title: French cuisine with Burgundy: Pinot Noir and the dialogue of sauce
en.summary: The butter, mushrooms, poultry and sauces of French cooking suit the light body, high perfume and fine tannin of red Burgundy; the match relies on aroma and acidity, not on body weight overwhelming the dish.

zh.title: 烧烤配啤酒：烟火气里的平衡
zh.summary: 炭火的焦香、油脂与盐，遇上啤酒的气泡、苦味与低温；搭配的关键是选对类型、控制温度与节奏，而不是把啤酒当成解腻的水。

en.title: Grilled Meat and Beer: Balance in the Smoke
en.summary: Charcoal char, fat and salt meet the bubbles, bitterness and low temperature of beer. The key is choosing the right type and controlling temperature and pace, not treating beer as water that cuts grease.

zh.title: 火锅配白酒：一口热，一口烈
zh.summary: 火锅的油脂、辣度与高温，遇上白酒的高酒精度与香气；搭配的关键不是“越辣越要高度”，而是控制入口强度、温度与节奏。

en.title: Hot Pot and Baijiu: One Hot, One Strong
en.summary: Hot pot brings fat, chill heat and high temperature; baijiu brings high alcohol and concentrated aroma. The key is not "the hotter the dish, the stronger the spirit" but controlling entry strength, temperature and pace.

zh.title: 意大利菜配桑娇维塞：番茄、橄榄油与酸度
zh.summary: 意大利菜的番茄、橄榄油、香草与硬质奶酪，与桑娇维塞的高酸、樱桃果香和干单宁相合；搭配靠的是酸度对齐，而不是单宁越重越好。

en.title: Italian cuisine with Sangiovese: tomato, olive oil and acidity
en.summary: The tomato, olive oil, herbs and hard cheese of Italian cooking suit the high acidity, cherry fruit and dry tannin of Sangiovese; the match is made by aligning acidity, not by seeking the heaviest tannin.

zh.title: 日料配清酒：鲜味与米香的平衡
zh.summary: 日料的生鲜、清淡与酱油鲜味，与清酒的米香、氨基酸鲜味和柔和酸度相合；按菜的油脂与酱汁浓淡，在纯米酒与吟酿之间选择。

en.title: Japanese cuisine with sake: umami and rice aroma in balance
en.summary: The raw freshness, lightness and soy umami of Japanese food suit the rice aroma, amino-acid umami and soft acidity of sake; choose between junmai and ginjo according to fat and sauce.

zh.title: 江浙菜配绍兴黄酒：鲜与醇的同一套语言
zh.summary: 江浙菜的河鲜、酱汁与甜咸平衡，与绍兴黄酒的氨基酸鲜味、醇厚口感同源；搭配按菜的口感浓淡选择元红、加饭、善酿或香雪。

en.title: Jiangzhe cuisine with Shaoxing yellow wine: one language of umami
en.summary: The river fish, sauces and sweet-savoury balance of Jiangzhe cuisine share a language with the umami and mellow body of Shaoxing yellow wine; choose yuanhong, jiafan, shanniang or xiangxue according to the weight of the dish.

zh.title: 韩餐配烧酒：烤肉、泡菜与小杯节奏
zh.summary: 韩餐的发酵辣味、烤肉油脂与共享式用餐，与稀释式烧酒的低度、微甜和小杯文化相合；搭配的关键是节奏、温度与菜序，而不是拼酒量。

en.title: Korean cuisine with soju: grilled meat, kimchi and the small-cup rhythm
en.summary: The fermented heat, grilled fat and shared-table style of Korean food suit the lower strength, slight sweetness and small cups of diluted soju; the key is rhythm, temperature and the order of dishes, not drinking volume.

zh.title: 墨西哥菜配啤酒：玉米、辣椒与青柠的清爽组合
zh.summary: 墨西哥菜的玉米、辣椒、青柠与油脂，和啤酒的气泡、苦度、麦芽甜味形成多层平衡；按菜的做法与辣度选拉格、IPA 或深色麦芽啤酒，比“冰啤酒配一切”更准确。

en.title: Mexican Food and Beer: Maize, Chilli and Lime in Balance
en.summary: The maize, chilli, lime and fat of Mexican food meet the bubbles, bitterness and malt sweetness of beer in several layers; choosing lager, IPA or dark malt beer by cooking method and heat is more accurate than "ice-cold beer with everything".

zh.title: 海鲜配香槟：气泡、酸度与咸鲜的三角
zh.summary: 海鲜的鲜味、咸味与脂肪，与香槟的气泡、酸度和低单宁形成稳定三角；选对甜度、酒体与气泡强度，比“香槟只适合庆祝”的成见更重要。

en.title: Seafood and Champagne: Bubbles, Acidity and Salt
en.summary: The savoury freshness, salt and fat of seafood meet the bubbles, acidity and low tannin of Champagne; choosing the right sweetness, body and bubble intensity matters more than the idea that Champagne is only for celebrations.

zh.title: 鲁菜配酱香白酒：咸鲜浓味与空杯留香
zh.summary: 鲁菜的咸鲜、葱香与浓稠酱汁，遇上酱香白酒的焦香、花果香与持久回味；搭配靠的是味觉厚度相当，而不是把菜做得更咸。

en.title: Shandong cuisine with sauce-aroma baijiu: savoury weight and a long finish
en.summary: The savoury saltiness, scallion aroma and thick sauces of Shandong cooking meet the roast, floral and long finish of sauce-aroma baijiu; the match is made by equal palate weight, not by making the dish saltier.

zh.title: 川菜配浓香白酒：麻辣与窖香的对抗
zh.summary: 川菜的麻辣、油脂与发酵味，遇上浓香型白酒的窖香与粮香；搭配的关键是控制入口强度与节奏，而不是用高度酒去压辣。

en.title: Sichuan cuisine with strong-aroma baijiu: heat against cellar aroma
en.summary: Sichuan heat, fat and fermented seasonings meet the cellar and grain aroma of strong-aroma baijiu; the key is controlling intensity and rhythm, not using high-strength spirit to put out the fire.

zh.title: 西班牙菜配里奥哈：火腿、烤羊与橡木香
zh.summary: 西班牙菜的火腿、橄榄、烤羊与海鲜饭，与里奥哈以丹魄为主的红葡萄酒相合；传统橡木桶带来的香草与香料，能承接咸鲜与油脂。

en.title: Spanish cuisine with Rioja: ham, roast lamb and oak
en.summary: The ham, olives, roast lamb and paella of Spanish cooking suit Rioja reds based on Tempranillo; vanilla and spice from traditional oak carry the savoury weight and fat.

zh.title: 泰餐配雷司令：高酸与香气的解辣组合
zh.summary: 泰餐的酸辣、香茅、鱼露与椰奶，遇上雷司令的高酸与芳香；干型到半干型的选择取决于辣度、甜度与油脂，而不是“越甜越解辣”。点酒时看干型与半干型标注、酒精度与年份，侍酒温度通常控制在 8 至 10 摄氏度。

en.title: Thai cuisine with Riesling: high acid and aroma against heat
en.summary: The sour heat, lemongrass, fish sauce and coconut milk of Thai food meet the high acidity and perfume of Riesling; choose dry to off-dry according to heat, sweetness and fat, not by "the sweeter the better". When ordering, check the dry or off-dry term, the alcohol level and the vintage, and serve at about 8 to 10 degrees Celsius.

zh.title: 素食配葡萄酒：蔬菜、豆类与菌菇的搭配逻辑
zh.summary: 素食不是一种味道，而是一组差异很大的食材；按风味强度、酸度、苦味、鲜味与脂肪选酒，比“素菜配白葡萄酒”的成见更可靠。

en.title: Vegetarian Food and Wine: A Logic of Vegetables, Pulses and Mushrooms
en.summary: Vegetarian food is not one flavour but a group of very different ingredients; choose wine by intensity, acidity, bitterness, umami and fat, which is more reliable than the idea that vegetables only go with white wine.

zh.title: 安德烈·西蒙
zh.summary: 法国出生的英国葡萄酒商人、作家与藏书家（1877–1970），1933 年与 A. J. A. Symons 共同创办葡萄酒与美食协会，写作逾百种酒与饮食书籍，以《英国葡萄酒贸易史》等建立酒史研究的方法。

en.title: André Simon
en.summary: French-born British wine merchant, writer and bibliophile (1877–1970) who co-founded the Wine & Food Society in 1933, wrote more than a hundred books and pamphlets, and used trade archives and bibliography to turn wine history into a verifiable discipline.

zh.title: 安德烈·切列斯切夫
zh.summary: 俄裔美国酿酒师（1901–1994），1938 年起任纳帕谷 Beaulieu Vineyard 首席酿酒师，引入冷发酵、苹果酸-乳酸发酵控制与小法国橡木桶，培养多代纳帕酿酒师，被称为“大师”。

en.title: André Tchelistcheff
en.summary: Russian-born American winemaker (1901–1994) who became chief winemaker at Beaulieu Vineyard in Napa Valley in 1938, brought cold fermentation, malolactic control and small French oak to California, and mentored generations of Napa winemakers.

zh.title: 安杰洛·嘉雅
zh.summary: 意大利酿酒师与酒庄经营者，1940 年生；1961 年接管家族在巴巴莱斯科的嘉雅酒庄，以降低产量、法国小橡木桶、单一园与跨国投资改造皮埃蒙特葡萄酒，1996 年把三款单一园从巴巴莱斯科 DOCG 降为朗格 DOC，引发传统与现代之争。

en.title: Angelo Gaja
en.summary: Italian winemaker and estate owner (born 1940) who took over the family's Barbaresco estate in 1961, used low yields, French barriques, single vineyards and cross-regional investments to transform Piedmontese wine, and in 1996 declassified three single-vineyard wines from Barbaresco DOCG to Langhe DOC, sparking a continuing traditionalist-modernist debate.

zh.title: 阿瑟·健力士
zh.summary: 爱尔兰酿酒师与企业家，1725 至 1803 年在世；1759 年签下都柏林圣詹姆斯门啤酒厂 9000 年租约，从莱克斯利普的小酒坊起步，把健力士做成爱尔兰最具规模的啤酒品牌，并以波特啤酒与慈善事业塑造了现代都柏林的酒业版图。

en.title: Arthur Guinness
en.summary: Irish brewer, entrepreneur and philanthropist (1725–1803) who signed the 9,000-year lease at St James's Gate in Dublin in 1759, scaled a small Leixlip brewery into Ireland's largest beer business and made porter and Guinness stout central to Dublin's brewing identity.

zh.title: 奥贝尔·德维兰
zh.summary: 法国酿酒师与罗曼尼康帝酒庄联合经理，1939 年生于雷恩；1965 年回到勃艮第，1974 至 2021 年代表德维兰家族共同管理 DRC，推动有机与生物动力种植；与妻子帕梅拉在布泽龙创立 Domaine de Villaine，并主持“勃艮第葡萄园气候”申遗，2015 年列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

en.title: Aubert de Villaine
en.summary: French winemaker and co-director of Domaine de la Romanée-Conti (born 1939); returned to Burgundy in 1965, managed DRC with the Leroy family from 1974 to 2021, championed organic and biodynamic farming, founded Domaine de Villaine in Bouzeron with his wife Pamela and led the campaign that made the Climats of Burgundy a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2015.

zh.title: 奥黛丽·桑德斯
zh.summary: 美国调酒师与酒吧经营者，出生年无可靠公开来源；2005 年在纽约苏豪区开设 Pegu Club，以鲜榨原料、精确比例与重复训练确立精调鸡尾酒的操作标准，Gin-Gin Mule 与 Old Cuban 是她的代表创作。

en.title: Audrey Saunders
en.summary: American bartender and bar owner with no reliable public source for her birth year; she opened Pegu Club in SoHo in 2005 and made fresh juice, measured recipes and repeated training the working standard of the craft cocktail, with the Gin-Gin Mule and Old Cuban as her signature drinks.

zh.title: 白居易
zh.summary: 唐代诗人，772—846；自号醉吟先生，酒诗把邀友、送别与晚年闲居写成日常，《问刘十九》《琵琶行》是最常被引用的两首。

en.title: Bai Juyi
en.summary: Tang poet, 772–846; he called himself the Drunken Chanting Gentleman and wrote everyday wine poems about inviting a friend, saying farewell and retiring to the hills.

zh.title: 布克·诺伊
zh.summary: 肯塔基波本酿酒师（1929–2004），Jim Beam 家族第六代首席酿酒师；1960 年接管 Boston 酒厂，1965 年完成第一百万桶，1987/1988 年推出 Booker's，1992 年建立 Small Batch Bourbon Collection，被视为波本小批量复兴的关键人物。

en.title: Booker Noe
en.summary: Kentucky bourbon distiller (1929–2004) and sixth-generation master distiller of the Jim Beam family; he took over the Boston, Kentucky plant in 1960, filled the millionth barrel in 1965, launched Booker's in 1987/1988 and built the Small Batch Bourbon Collection in 1992.

zh.title: 布鲁诺·贾科萨
zh.summary: 意大利皮埃蒙特酿酒师（1929–2018），以 Neive 为基地，1964 年率先在酒标标注 Barbaresco 单一园，坚持传统长陈酿与严格选年份，被称为“Neive 的天才”。

en.title: Bruno Giacosa
en.summary: Italian Piedmont winemaker (1929–2018), based in Neive, who began labelling a single Barbaresco vineyard in 1964 and held to long traditional ageing and strict vintage selection, earning the name "the genius of Neive".

zh.title: 曹操
zh.summary: 东汉末年政治家、军事家与诗人，155—220；《短歌行》以“何以解忧，唯有杜康”写时间与忧思，建安年间的禁酒与孔融的争论又让酒成为政治议题。

en.title: Cao Cao
en.summary: Late Han statesman, general and poet, 155–220; “Short Song” makes wine the entry to time and worry, while his prohibition order and Kong Rong's objection turned drinking into a political question.

zh.title: 戴尔·德格罗夫
zh.summary: 美国调酒师，1948 年生；1987 年起主持纽约彩虹厅酒吧，用鲜榨果汁、规范冰块与复原的古典配方推动“鸡尾酒复兴”，被称为“King Cocktail”。

en.title: Dale DeGroff
en.summary: An American bartender born in 1948; from 1987 he ran the bar at the Rainbow Room in New York, using fresh juice, properly handled ice and restored classic recipes to drive the cocktail revival, and became known as King Cocktail.

zh.title: 大卫·旺德里奇
zh.summary: 美国鸡尾酒史学者与作家，1961 年生；著有《Imbibe!》《Punch》，并主编《牛津烈酒与鸡尾酒指南》，以档案考据重写鸡尾酒的起源叙事。

en.title: David Wondrich
en.summary: An American cocktail historian and writer, born in 1961; author of Imbibe! and Punch and editor-in-chief of The Oxford Companion to Spirits and Cocktails, he used archival research to rewrite the origins of the cocktail.

zh.title: 唐培里侬
zh.summary: 法国本笃会修士，1638 至 1714 年在世；长期管理香槟地区奥特维莱尔修道院的酒窖。后世称他为“香槟之父”，但“发明香槟”主要是 19 世纪的商业建构，他更可靠的影响在混酿、澄清与酒窖管理。

en.title: Dom Pérignon
en.summary: A French Benedictine monk, 1638 to 1714, who long managed the cellars of the abbey of Hautvillers in Champagne. Later ages called him the father of champagne, but the claim that he invented it is largely a nineteenth-century commercial construction; his more defensible influence lies in blending, clarification and cellar management.

zh.title: 杜甫
zh.summary: 唐代诗人，712 至 770 年在世；他的酒诗少写纵饮，多写待客、病中停杯与漂泊处境，酒因此成为观察生活与家国的切口。

en.title: Du Fu
en.summary: Tang poet, 712–770; his drinking poems rarely celebrate excess, dwelling instead on hosting guests, giving up wine in illness and the instability of a wandering life.

zh.title: 杜牧
zh.summary: 晚唐诗人、古文家，803 至 852 年在世；他写秦淮酒家、水村酒旗与杏花村，把酒写成行旅与城市夜色里的坐标，而流传最广的《清明》并不见于他的文集。

en.title: Du Mu
en.summary: Late Tang poet and prose writer, 803–852; he turns wineshops, wine banners and Apricot Blossom Village into landmarks of travel and city nights, while the widely anthologised "Qingming" is absent from his collected works.

zh.title: 埃米尔·佩诺
zh.summary: 法国波尔多酿酒学家，1912 至 2004 年在世，生于马迪朗，卒于塔朗斯。他在波尔多大学任酿酒学教授，推动控温发酵、苹果酸-乳酸发酵的主动管理、酒窖卫生与系统品鉴训练，被视为现代酿酒学的奠基者之一。

en.title: Émile Peynaud
en.summary: A Bordeaux oenologist, 1912 to 2004, born in Madiran and died in Talence. As professor of oenology at the University of Bordeaux he promoted temperature-controlled fermentation, managed malolactic fermentation, cellar hygiene and systematic tasting, and is regarded as a founder of modern oenology.

zh.title: 丰子恺
zh.summary: 中国现代画家、散文家与翻译家，1898 至 1975 年在世；浙江崇德人，师从弘一法师。《沙坪的美酒》《吃酒》《湖畔夜饮》等散文把温酒、小菜与夜谈写成日常生活的证据。

en.title: Feng Zikai
en.summary: A modern Chinese painter, essayist and translator, 1898 to 1975, from Chongde in Zhejiang and a student of Master Hongyi. Essays such as The Fine Wine of Shaping, Drinking and A Night Drink by the Lake turn warmed wine, small dishes and late conversation into evidence of ordinary life.

zh.title: 弗兰克·斯库梅克
zh.summary: 美国葡萄酒作家与评论家，活跃于 20 世纪中叶，以推动美国葡萄酒按葡萄品种与产地标注、反对借用欧洲地名作为通用酒名而知名；生卒年无可靠公开来源，本页留空。

en.title: Frank Schoonmaker
en.summary: An American wine writer and critic active in the mid-twentieth century, known for urging American wines to be labelled by grape variety and place rather than by borrowed European place names; no reliable public source gives his birth or death year, so both are left empty here.

zh.title: 弗里茨·梅塔格
zh.summary: 美国旧金山 Anchor Brewing 的拯救者（1937 年生），1965 年买下濒临倒闭的 Steam Beer 酒厂，以传统工艺、整锥啤酒花与小批量生产重塑 Anchor Steam，被视为美国禁酒令后精酿啤酒运动的第一位微型酿酒者。

en.title: Fritz Maytag
en.summary: American brewer and Anchor Brewing owner (born 1937); in 1965 he bought the failing Steam Beer brewery in San Francisco, rebuilt Anchor Steam with open fermentation, whole-cone hops and small-batch production, and became a founding figure of the post-Prohibition American craft-beer movement.

zh.title: 加里·里根
zh.summary: 英裔美国调酒师与作者，1951—2019；《The Joy of Mixology》把鸡尾酒按“家族”分类，Regan's Orange Bitters No. 6 与“Cocktails in the Country”课程影响了一代调酒师。

en.title: Gary Regan
en.summary: A British-born American bartender and author, 1951–2019; in The Joy of Mixology he grouped cocktails into families, replacing scattered recipes with a teachable structure, and he created Regan's Orange Bitters No. 6.

zh.title: 乔治·加文·布朗
zh.summary: 美国威士忌企业家，1846 至 1917 年在世；1870 年在路易斯维尔创办 J.T.S. Brown & Brother，以密封玻璃瓶销售老福雷斯特波本威士忌，1890 年与会计乔治·福曼合伙后形成 Brown-Forman 之名。

en.title: George Garvin Brown
en.summary: An American whisky entrepreneur, 1846 to 1917; in 1870 in Louisville he founded J.T.S. Brown & Brother and sold Old Forester bourbon in sealed glass bottles, and in 1890 a partnership with the accountant George Forman produced the name Brown-Forman.

zh.title: 乔治·史密斯
zh.summary: 苏格兰斯佩塞利威山谷的蒸馏者（卒于 1871 年），1824 年获 Elgin 执照，成为 Glenlivet 教区首位合法蒸馏者；在私酿者威胁中坚持建厂，为 The Glenlivet 的单一麦芽品牌与产区声誉奠定基础。

en.title: George Smith
en.summary: Distiller in the Livet valley of Speyside (died 1871) who obtained an Elgin licence in 1824 and became the first legal distiller in the Glenlivet parish; he built the plant amid threats from illicit distillers and laid the foundation for The Glenlivet single malt.

zh.title: 吉亚科莫·孔特诺
zh.summary: 意大利皮埃蒙特 Barolo 传统派酿酒师，20 世纪初在 Monforte d'Alba 创立同名酒庄，以长时间浸皮、斯拉沃尼亚大桶陈酿与 Monfortino 储备酒确立“为陈年而造”的 Barolo 风格。

en.title: Giacomo Conterno
en.summary: Traditionalist Barolo producer in Monforte d'Alba, Piedmont, who founded the estate that bears his name and established Monfortino through long maceration and large Slavonian oak, making Barolo built for long ageing.

zh.title: 哈里·克拉多克
zh.summary: 英裔调酒师，1876 至 1963 年在世；1925 年起主持伦敦萨伏伊酒店 American Bar，1930 年出版《萨伏伊鸡尾酒书》，把禁酒令时代的英美调酒经验整理成经典文本。

en.title: Harry Craddock
en.summary: An Anglo-American bartender, 1876-1963; head bartender at the American Bar of the Savoy Hotel in London from 1925 and author of The Savoy Cocktail Book (1930), which preserved Prohibition-era recipes as a classic text.

zh.title: 哈里·约翰逊
zh.summary: 19 世纪美国调酒师与酒吧管理作者，通常记为 1845 年生；1882 年自费出版《New and Improved Bartender's Manual》，系统讨论酒吧经营、器具、排班与操作规范，把调酒从表演推向职业管理。

en.title: Harry Johnson
en.summary: A nineteenth-century American bartender and author on bar management, usually dated to 1845; in 1882 he self-published the New and Improved Bartender's Manual, a systematic treatment of bar operation, equipment, staffing and standards that moved bartending from performance toward professional management.

zh.title: 亨利·雅耶
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第酿酒师，1922 至 2006 年在世；他长期以分成租佃方式耕作沃恩-罗曼尼的地块，以全去梗、低温浸渍、低产与克制的新桶酿黑皮诺，并把荒废的 Cros Parantoux 做成一级园。

en.title: Henri Jayer
en.summary: Burgundy winemaker, 1922–2006; farming Vosne-Romanée parcels as a sharecropper, he used low yields, full destemming, cool maceration and restrained new oak to make precise Pinot Noir, and turned the abandoned Cros Parantoux into a premier cru.

zh.title: 休·约翰逊
zh.summary: 英国葡萄酒作家，1939 年生；1971 年出版《世界葡萄酒地图》，1977 年起编写《袖珍葡萄酒手册》，用地图、年份表与产区叙事影响了数代读者。

en.title: Hugh Johnson
en.summary: A British wine writer born in 1939; he published The World Atlas of Wine in 1971 and has produced Hugh Johnson's Pocket Wine Book since 1977, shaping several generations of readers with maps, vintage tables and regional narrative.

zh.title: 杰克·丹尼
zh.summary: 美国蒸馏酒业者，约 1850 至 1911 年在世；1866 年在田纳西林奇堡登记第 1 号蒸馏所，以糖枫木炭过滤的林肯县工艺定义田纳西威士忌，其品牌在 1904 年圣路易斯世博会后走向全国，成为美国威士忌最具辨识度的名字之一。

en.title: Jack Daniel
en.summary: American distiller (c. 1850–1911) who registered Distillery No. 1 in Lynchburg, Tennessee, in 1866 and standardised the sugar-maple charcoal filtration known as the Lincoln County Process, defining Tennessee whiskey; his brand won gold in St Louis in 1904 and became one of America's most recognisable whiskies.

zh.title: 詹姆斯·布坎南
zh.summary: 苏格兰威士忌调配商与品牌创办人，1849 至 1935 年在世；生于加拿大，长于爱尔兰，1884 年在伦敦自立，以 Buchanan Blend 起家，后以 Black & White 闻名，1925 年并入 Distillers Company。

en.title: James Buchanan
en.summary: Scotch whisky blender and brand builder, 1849–1935; born in Canada and raised in Ireland, he set up on his own in London in 1884, built Buchanan Blend, later Black & White, and joined the Distillers Company in 1925.

zh.title: 杰西斯·罗宾逊
zh.summary: 英国葡萄酒作家与编辑，1950 年生；1984 年通过葡萄酒大师考试，1989 年起任《金融时报》葡萄酒专栏作家，主编《牛津葡萄酒指南》，2001 年起与休·约翰逊合著《世界葡萄酒地图》。

en.title: Jancis Robinson
en.summary: A British wine writer and editor, born in 1950; she passed the Master of Wine examination in 1984, has written a weekly Financial Times column since 1989, edits The Oxford Companion to Wine and has co-authored The World Atlas of Wine with Hugh Johnson since 2001.

zh.title: 杰里·托马斯
zh.summary: 美国调酒师，通常记为 1825 至 1885 年在世（也有 1830 年之说）。1862 年在纽约出版《How to Mix Drinks》，把口耳相传的配方整理成书，人称“教授”；“蓝火”让调酒带上剧场性，但经典鸡尾酒并非都由他发明。

en.title: Jerry Thomas
en.summary: An American bartender, commonly dated 1825 to 1885 (some sources give 1830). In 1862 he published How to Mix Drinks in New York, turning word-of-mouth recipes into a book, and was known as the Professor. The Blue Blazer gave bartending a theatrical side, though he did not invent the classic cocktails.

zh.title: 吉姆·巴雷特
zh.summary: 美国酒庄经营者（1926–2013），1972 年与 Ernie Hahn 买下并复兴纳帕谷 Chateau Montelena；其 1973 年霞多丽在 1976 年巴黎审判白葡萄酒组获第一名。

en.title: Jim Barrett
en.summary: American winery owner (1926–2013) who bought and revived Chateau Montelena in Napa Valley with Ernie Hahn in 1972; the estate's 1973 Chardonnay won the white-wine flight of the 1976 Judgment of Paris.

zh.title: 吉姆·科赫
zh.summary: 美国 Samuel Adams 与 Boston Beer Company 创办人（1949 年生），1984 年用曾祖传下的配方在自家厨房试酿，1985 年让 Boston Lager 在波士顿酒吧上市；以拉格工艺、全国分销与“Brewing the American Dream”计划影响美国精酿产业。

en.title: Jim Koch
en.summary: Founder of Samuel Adams and The Boston Beer Company (born 1949); in 1984 he brewed his great-great-grandfather's lager recipe at home, launched Boston Lager in Boston bars in 1985, and used national distribution and the Brewing the American Dream programme to shape the American craft-beer industry.

zh.title: 吉米·拉塞尔
zh.summary: 肯塔基州 Wild Turkey 酒厂的波本威士忌大师级酿酒师，1954 年 18 岁入职，从扫地做起，1960 年代出任首席酿酒师；以坚持 101 配方、Rare Breed、Kentucky Spirit 与 Russell's Reserve 影响现代波本行业。

en.title: Jimmy Russell
en.summary: Master distiller at Wild Turkey in Kentucky, who joined in 1954 at eighteen, worked from the floor up and became master distiller in the 1960s; he kept the 101 formula through the bourbon downturn and helped shape Rare Breed, Kentucky Spirit and Russell's Reserve.

zh.title: 约翰·詹姆森
zh.summary: 苏格兰出生的爱尔兰酒商与蒸馏业主（1740–1823），1780 年在都柏林 Bow Street 开办蒸馏厂；在麦芽税时代试验发芽与未发芽大麦混合，奠定 Jameson 单一壶式威士忌的三次蒸馏传统。

en.title: John Jameson
en.summary: Scottish-born Irish merchant and distiller (1740–1823) who opened the Bow Street distillery in Dublin in 1780; during the malt-tax era he experimented with mixing malted and unmalted barley, laying the basis for Jameson's triple-distilled single-pot-still whiskey.

zh.title: 约瑟夫·格罗尔
zh.summary: 巴伐利亚酿酒师，1813 至 1887 年在世；1842 年受皮尔森市民之邀，以皮尔森软水、萨兹酒花、摩拉维亚大麦与底部发酵酵母酿出第一款金色清澈的皮尔森拉格，奠定现代淡色拉格的基本范式。

en.title: Josef Groll
en.summary: Bavarian brewer (1813–1887) who was hired by the citizens of Plzeň in 1842 and brewed the first golden, clear Pilsner lager using soft local water, Saaz hops, Moravian barley and bottom-fermenting yeast, establishing the template for the modern pale lager.

zh.title: 肯·格罗斯曼
zh.summary: 美国 Sierra Nevada Brewing 创办人（1955 年生），1976 年在奇科开家庭酿酒用品店，1980 年用废旧乳品设备搭出酒厂；以 Cascade 酒花与 Pale Ale 推动美国精酿啤酒革命，并坚持家族独立所有权。

en.title: Ken Grossman
en.summary: Founder of Sierra Nevada Brewing (born 1955), who opened a homebrew shop in Chico in 1976 and built a brewery from scrap dairy equipment in 1980; Cascade hops and Pale Ale helped drive the American craft-beer revolution, and the company remains family-owned.

zh.title: 拉露·比兹-勒鲁瓦
zh.summary: 法国勃艮第酒商与酒庄主人（1932 年生），1955 年接手 Maison Leroy，1974–1992 年任 Domaine de la Romanée-Conti 联合经理，1988 年创立 Domaine Leroy 并全面转向生物动力法；以极低产量、逐株补植与严格筛选影响现代勃艮第。

en.title: Lalou Bize-Leroy
en.summary: Burgundy merchant and estate owner (born 1932); she took over Maison Leroy in 1955, co-managed Domaine de la Romanée-Conti from 1974 to 1992, founded Domaine Leroy in 1988 and converted it to biodynamics, influencing modern Burgundy through extremely low yields, massal selection and strict sorting.

zh.title: 老舍
zh.summary: 中国现代小说家、剧作家，1899 至 1966 年在世；北京人，满族。作品把茶馆、酒馆与大杂院写成时代切片，《骆驼祥子》与《茶馆》留下可核对的饮酒场景；其本人酒量记载有限，不宜夸大。

en.title: Lao She
en.summary: A modern Chinese novelist and playwright, 1899 to 1966, a Beijinger of Manchu descent. His fiction and drama turn teahouses, wine shops and courtyard compounds into slices of history, and Camel Xiangzi and Teahouse contain verifiable drinking scenes; reliable records of his own drinking are limited and should not be exaggerated.

zh.title: 李白
zh.summary: 盛唐诗人，701 至 762 年在世；酒在他的诗里既是宴饮与送别的场景，也是孤独、时间与抱负的隐喻。读他的酒诗，需要把文学形象与唐代实际饮用的酒分开看。

en.title: Li Bai
en.summary: A poet of the high Tang, 701 to 762; wine in his poetry is both a setting for banquets and farewells and a metaphor for solitude, time and ambition. Reading his wine poems means separating the literary figure from the drink actually consumed in Tang times.

zh.title: 李清照
zh.summary: 宋代词人，1084 年出生，卒年通常记为 1155 年前后；她以“沉醉不知归路”“东篱把酒”“三杯两盏淡酒”写少女、闲居与南渡后的孤寂，酒的温度随人生境遇下降。

en.title: Li Qingzhao
en.summary: Song poet, born 1084 and usually said to have died around 1155; her wine lyrics run from "so drunk I did not know the way home" to "three cups, two cups of thin wine", cooling as her life moves from Shandong to the south.

zh.title: 路易·巴斯德
zh.summary: 法国化学家与微生物学家，1822 至 1895 年在世；他证明发酵由微生物引起，并提出加热杀菌的方法，对葡萄酒、啤酒与食品安全产生了长期影响。

en.title: Louis Pasteur
en.summary: A French chemist and microbiologist, 1822 to 1895; he showed that fermentation is caused by microorganisms and proposed a method of heat treatment that kills them, with a lasting influence on wine, beer and food safety.

zh.title: 鲁迅
zh.summary: 中国现代作家，1881 至 1936 年在世，浙江绍兴人。《孔乙己》与《在酒楼上》把绍兴黄酒、温酒方式与酒馆等级写进小说，1927 年的演讲则把魏晋文人的饮酒放回政治压力中解释。

en.title: Lu Xun
en.summary: A modern Chinese writer, 1881 to 1936, from Shaoxing in Zhejiang. Kong Yiji and Upstairs in the Wine Shop put Shaoxing yellow wine, warming and tavern hierarchy into fiction, while his 1927 lecture explained Wei-Jin drinking through political pressure.

zh.title: 陆游
zh.summary: 南宋诗人，1125—1210；存诗近万首，酒诗贯穿军旅、乡居与旧情，《游山西村》《钗头凤》《剑门道中遇微雨》留下了具体的酒名与场景。

en.title: Lu You
en.summary: Southern Song poet, 1125–1210; his many wine poems span army life, village retirement and old love, with named drinks and precise settings in “Touring West Mountain Village”, “The Phoenix Hairpin” and “Rain at Sword Gate”.

zh.title: 马克斯·舒伯特
zh.summary: 澳大利亚酿酒师，1915 至 1994 年在世；1931 年以信差身份加入奔富，1948 年成为首任首席酿酒师；1950 年赴欧洲考察后，1951 年酿出实验性葛兰许，1957 年被董事会叫停后秘密续酿 1957 至 1959，1960 年正式恢复，奠定澳大利亚精品红酒的国际地位。

en.title: Max Schubert
en.summary: Australian winemaker (1915–1994) who joined Penfolds as a messenger in 1931, became its first chief winemaker in 1948 and created the experimental Grange in 1951; after the board ordered him to stop in 1957, he continued the 1957–1959 vintages in secret, and Grange was officially reinstated for 1960.

zh.title: 梅纳德·阿梅林
zh.summary: 美国酿酒学家与加州大学戴维斯分校教授（1911–1998），与 Winkler 建立热量总和产区分类，推动葡萄酒感官评价的标准化，著有《Wines——Their Sensory Evaluation》等。

en.title: Maynard Amerine
en.summary: American viticulturist and UC Davis professor (1911–1998) who developed the Winkler heat-summation index with Albert Winkler and standardised wine sensory evaluation through trained panels, blind tasting and statistics.

zh.title: 迈克尔·布罗德本特
zh.summary: 英国葡萄酒评论家、拍卖师与作家（1927–2020），1966 年重启佳士得葡萄酒拍卖部门，以红皮笔记本记录数万款酒的品鉴笔记，著有《葡萄酒品鉴口袋指南》与《佳酿》等。

en.title: Michael Broadbent
en.summary: British wine critic, auctioneer and writer (1927–2020) who rebuilt Christie's wine department in 1966 and recorded tens of thousands of wines in red notebooks, author of The Pocket Guide to Wine Tasting and Vintage Wine.

zh.title: 迈克尔·杰克逊（啤酒作家）
zh.summary: 英国啤酒与威士忌作家，1942 至 2007 年在世；1977 年出版《世界啤酒指南》，以风格分类、感官描述与文化脉络把啤酒写成可读、可比较的知识体系，长期推动比利时啤酒、英式艾尔与美国精酿啤酒被世界看见。

en.title: Michael Jackson (beer writer)
en.summary: British beer and whisky writer (1942–2007) whose 1977 World Guide to Beer turned style, sensory description and cultural context into a shared language, and whose books and TV series helped Belgian beer, British ale and American craft brewing reach a global audience.

zh.title: 米歇尔·罗兰
zh.summary: 法国波尔多酿酒顾问，1947—2026；他把成熟度判断、发酵与浸渍控制、橡木桶与微氧技术组成顾问流程，客户遍及多国，也因“国际化风格”成为争议焦点。

en.title: Michel Rolland
en.summary: A Bordeaux wine consultant, 1947–2026; he combined ripeness assessment, fermentation and maceration control, oak and micro-oxygenation into a consulting process, with clients across many regions, and became a focus of the argument over internationalised style.

zh.title: 米格尔·托雷斯
zh.summary: 西班牙酿酒师与家族企业主席，1941 年生；1962 年加入 Familia Torres，1970 年酿出马斯拉普拉纳，1979 年在巴黎“葡萄酒奥林匹克”击败法国名庄；1979 年进入智利、1982 年进入加州，2008 年启动 Torres & Earth，2019 年参与创立国际酒庄气候行动联盟，是把西班牙葡萄酒推向国际的关键人物。

en.title: Miguel A. Torres
en.summary: Spanish winemaker and family-business president (born 1941) who joined Familia Torres in 1962, made Mas La Plana in 1970, won the 1979 Paris Wine Olympics, expanded to Chile in 1979 and California in 1982, launched Torres & Earth in 2008 and co-founded the International Wineries for Climate Action in 2019.

zh.title: 欧阳修
zh.summary: 北宋文学家与政治家，1007 至 1072 年在世；他自号醉翁，以《醉翁亭记》把饮酒写成山水之乐，又以“六一”自述把酒列入晚年生活的五物之一；滁州与颍州是他与酒关系最深的两处地方。

en.title: Ouyang Xiu
en.summary: Northern Song writer and statesman, 1007–1072; he called himself the Old Drunkard and made wine the vehicle of landscape pleasure, later listing it among the five objects of his retirement; Chuzhou and Yingzhou are the two places where his relationship with wine is deepest.

zh.title: 彼得·莱曼
zh.summary: 澳大利亚巴罗萨谷酿酒师（1930–2013），1979 年以 Masterson Barossa Vineyards 起步，在葡萄过剩、种植者面临拔藤的关口承诺收购果实，1982 年公司改名 Peter Lehmann Wines；以 Stonewell Shiraz 等酒款塑造了巴罗萨的现代面貌。

en.title: Peter Lehmann
en.summary: Barossa Valley winemaker (1930–2013) who founded Masterson Barossa Vineyards in 1979 to buy grapes from growers facing a vine-pull scheme, renamed the company Peter Lehmann Wines in 1982, and shaped modern Barossa through Stonewell Shiraz and long-term grower contracts.

zh.title: 菲利普·德·罗斯柴尔德男爵
zh.summary: 法国酒庄经营者、诗人与企业家，1902 至 1988 年在世；1922 年接管木桐酒庄，推动酒庄原瓶灌装、艺术家酒标、木桐嘉棣与 1973 年一级庄升格，1979 年与罗伯特·蒙大维共同创办作品一号，是二十世纪波尔多最有影响力的酒庄主人之一。

en.title: Baron Philippe de Rothschild
en.summary: French estate owner, poet and entrepreneur (1902–1988) who took over Château Mouton Rothschild in 1922, pioneered château bottling, artist labels, Mouton Cadet and the 1973 promotion to First Growth, and co-founded Opus One with Robert Mondavi in 1979.

zh.title: 皮耶罗·安东尼
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳酒业家族 Marchesi Antinori 的第 26 代掌门人（1938 年生），1971 年推出 Tignanello，以桑娇维塞、赤霞珠与小橡木桶改写托斯卡纳红酒的表达。

en.title: Piero Antinori
en.summary: Italian wine producer (born 1938), 26th generation of the Marchesi Antinori family; his Tignanello, first released in 1971, blended Sangiovese with Cabernet and used small oak, rewriting the expression of Tuscan red wine.

zh.title: 秦含章
zh.summary: 中国食品工业与发酵工程专家，1908 至 2019 年在世；曾主持汾酒试点、参与茅台技术研究，并在江南大学任教，被视为中国酿酒工业科学化的奠基者之一。

en.title: Qin Hanzhang
en.summary: A Chinese food-industry and fermentation engineer, 1908 to 2019; he led the Fenjiu technical trial, took part in research on Maotai and taught at Jiangnan University, and is regarded as one of the founders of scientific winemaking in China.

zh.title: 罗伯特·蒙大维
zh.summary: 美国酿酒师与酒庄经营者，1913 至 2008 年在世；1966 年在纳帕谷奥克维尔创立罗伯特·蒙大维酒庄，推动品种标注、法国橡木与酒庄旅游，1979 年与菲利普·德·罗斯柴尔德男爵共同创办作品一号，被视为加州精品葡萄酒走向世界的关键人物。

en.title: Robert Mondavi
en.summary: American winemaker and winery owner (1913–2008) who founded Robert Mondavi Winery in Oakville, Napa Valley, in 1966; championed varietal labelling, French oak and wine tourism, and in 1979 co-founded Opus One with Baron Philippe de Rothschild.

zh.title: 罗伯特·帕克
zh.summary: 美国葡萄酒评论家，1947 年生；1978 年创办独立通讯《The Wine Advocate》，以 100 分制影响全球葡萄酒市场，也因口味趋同的“帕克化”争论成为行业焦点。2019 年退休。

en.title: Robert Parker
en.summary: An American wine critic, born in 1947; in 1978 he founded the independent newsletter The Wine Advocate, and his 100-point scale shaped the global wine market, while the “Parkerization” debate over homogenised taste made him a focus of the industry. He retired in 2019.

zh.title: 史蒂文·斯珀里尔
zh.summary: 英国葡萄酒商人、教育者与作家，1941 至 2021 年在世；1973 年在巴黎创办 Académie du Vin，1976 年与帕特里夏·加拉格尔组织“巴黎审判”盲品，后任 Decanter 顾问编辑，长期影响加州酒与旧世界等级秩序的国际认知。

en.title: Steven Spurrier
en.summary: A British wine merchant, educator and writer, 1941–2021; he founded the Académie du Vin in Paris in 1973, organised the 1976 Judgment of Paris with Patricia Gallagher, and later served as a Decanter consultant editor, shaping international perceptions of California wine and the old hierarchy.

zh.title: 竹鹤政孝
zh.summary: 日本威士忌先驱，1894 至 1979 年在世；1918 年赴苏格兰学习蒸馏与调配，回国后参与山崎酒厂建设，1934 年在北海道余市创立大日本果汁（日果前身），与鸟井信治郎在选址与风味路线上分道扬镳。

en.title: Masataka Taketsuru
en.summary: A pioneer of Japanese whisky, 1894–1979; he studied distilling and blending in Scotland from 1918 to 1920, helped build the Yamazaki distillery, and founded Dai Nippon Kaju, the predecessor of Nikka, in Yoichi, Hokkaido, in 1934 after parting ways with Shinjiro Torii.

zh.title: 唐寅
zh.summary: 明代画家与诗人，1470 至 1524 年在世，苏州吴县人。科场案后绝意仕进，以卖画为生。《桃花庵歌》《把酒对月歌》把花、酒与隐居写成一种生活立场，正史也记下他“佯狂使酒”的一面。

en.title: Tang Yin
en.summary: A Ming dynasty painter and poet, 1470 to 1524, from Wuxian in Suzhou. After an examination scandal he gave up official ambition and sold paintings. The Peach Blossom Cottage Song and Drinking Wine Facing the Moon make flowers, wine and reclusion a position on life, and the official history also records him feigning madness through drink.

zh.title: 陶渊明
zh.summary: 东晋诗人，365 至 427 年在世；他以“性嗜酒”自述，把辞官归田与饮酒写进同一套生活选择，酒因此成为人格与政治态度的表达。

en.title: Tao Yuanming
en.summary: Eastern Jin poet, 365–427; he described himself as “addicted to wine” and made drinking part of the same choice as leaving office and returning to the fields.

zh.title: 鸟井信治郎
zh.summary: 日本企业家，1879 至 1962 年在世；1899 年在大阪创办鸟井商店，1907 年推出赤玉波特酒，1923 年建成山崎蒸馏所并聘请竹鹤政孝，1929 年推出日本第一款商业麦芽威士忌“白札”，以“试试看”的冒险精神奠定三得利的基础。

en.title: Shinjiro Torii
en.summary: Japanese entrepreneur (1879–1962) who founded Torii Shoten in Osaka in 1899, launched Akadama Port Wine in 1907, built the Yamazaki distillery in 1923, hired Masataka Taketsuru and released Japan's first commercial malt whisky, Shirofuda, in 1929.

zh.title: 王维
zh.summary: 唐代诗人与画家，701—761；《送元二使安西》以一杯酒写送别，后世谱为《阳关三叠》；辋川时期的山水诗把酒放进具体的时间与地点。

en.title: Wang Wei
en.summary: Tang poet and painter, 701–761; “A Farewell to Yuan Er on His Mission to Anxi” turns one cup of wine into the definitive Chinese image of farewell, later set to music as the “Three Refrains of Yangguan”.

zh.title: 汪曾祺
zh.summary: 中国当代作家，1920 至 1997 年在世；江苏高邮人，师从沈从文。他的饮食散文把酒写成餐桌的一部分，重视菜、人与地方，而不是酒的价目与排场；《昆明的雨》里“浊酒一杯天过午”是他写酒最集中的一处。

en.title: Wang Zengqi
en.summary: A contemporary Chinese writer, 1920 to 1997, from Gaoyou in Jiangsu and a student of Shen Congwen. His food essays treat wine as part of the table, valuing dishes, people and place over prices and display; “a cup of cloudy wine past midday” in “The Rain of Kunming” is his most concentrated passage on drinking.

zh.title: 沃伦·维尼亚斯基
zh.summary: 美国纳帕谷酿酒师（1928–2024），1973 年创立鹿跃酒庄；其 1973 年 Cabernet Sauvignon 在 1976 年巴黎审判红葡萄酒组中获第一名，推动加州酒进入国际视野。

en.title: Warren Winiarski
en.summary: American Napa Valley winemaker (1928–2024) who founded Stag's Leap Wine Cellars in 1973; his 1973 Cabernet Sauvignon won the red-wine flight of the 1976 Judgment of Paris and helped bring California wine international attention.

zh.title: 威廉·格兰特
zh.summary: 苏格兰威士忌企业家，1839 至 1923 年在世；曾在莫特拉克酒厂任记账员与经理，1886 年起与家人建厂，1887 年圣诞节格兰菲迪首次出酒，1892 年再建百富，公司由家族经营至今。

en.title: William Grant
en.summary: A Scottish whisky entrepreneur, 1839 to 1923; he worked his way up at Mortlach, built Glenfiddich with his family from 1886, ran the first spirit on Christmas Day 1887 and added Balvenie in 1892; the company remains family-owned.

zh.title: 辛弃疾
zh.summary: 南宋词人、将领，1140 至 1207 年在世；他二十余岁自北方义军南归，后半生在两度闲居中写词，酒既是“醉里挑灯看剑”的记忆开关，也是“以手推松曰去”的自嘲。

en.title: Xin Qiji
en.summary: Southern Song poet and soldier, 1140–1207; after crossing south from the Jin-occupied north in his twenties, he spent two long retirements writing ci in which wine opens memory, questions old age and mocks its own consolation.

zh.title: 郁达夫
zh.summary: 中国现代作家，1896 至 1945 年在世；浙江富阳人，创造社发起人之一。旧体诗与散文多写到酒，《钓台题壁》中“曾因酒醉鞭名马”流传最广；1942 年化名赵廉在苏门答腊经营赵豫记酒厂，1945 年遇害。

en.title: Yu Dafu
en.summary: A modern Chinese writer, 1896 to 1945, from Fuyang in Zhejiang and a founding member of the Creation Society. His classical-style poems and prose often mention wine, and in 1942 he ran the Zhao Yuji distillery in Sumatra under the alias Zhao Lian; he was killed in 1945.

zh.title: 张弼士
zh.summary: 中国近代实业家与华侨商人，1841 至 1916 年在世；1892 年在山东烟台投资创办张裕葡萄酿酒公司，引进欧洲葡萄品种、设备与酿酒人才，把现代葡萄酒工业带入中国。

en.title: Zhang Bishi
en.summary: A Chinese industrialist and overseas merchant, 1841 to 1916; in 1892 he invested in the Changyu wine company in Yantai, Shandong, bringing European grape varieties, equipment and winemakers to China and helping to establish a modern wine industry there.

zh.title: 郑板桥
zh.summary: 清代书画家与诗人，1693 至 1766 年在世；曾任范县、潍县知县，罢官后在扬州卖画，为“扬州八怪”之一。他的题画诗与《板桥润格》把酒、画价与生计写在同一条线上。

en.title: Zheng Banqiao
en.summary: A Qing dynasty painter, calligrapher and poet, 1693 to 1766; he served as magistrate of Fan and Wei counties, then sold paintings in Yangzhou as one of the Eight Eccentrics. His inscriptions and his published price list place wine, painting prices and livelihood on the same line.

zh.title: 周恒刚
zh.summary: 中国白酒技术专家，1918 至 2004 年在世；主持 1955 年与 1962 年烟台试点、1964 至 1966 年茅台试点，总结“烟台操作法”，推动麸曲、己酸菌与窖泥微生物研究。

en.title: Zhou Henggang
en.summary: A Chinese baijiu technologist, 1918 to 2004; he led the 1955 and 1962 Yantai trials and the 1964-1966 Maotai trial, summarised the Yantai method, and advanced research on fuqu, caproic-acid bacteria and pit mud.

zh.title: A Ginjinha
zh.summary: 里斯本 Largo de São Domingos 8 号的 A Ginjinha，是酸樱桃利口酒 ginjinha 的百年站立式小酒铺。品牌把根源追到 1840 年 Rua das Portas de Santo Antão 27 的 taverna，1910 年由 Francisco Espiñeira Couziño 改造现址店面；今天仍以一小杯酒、一颗酒渍樱桃和柜台前的几分钟，构成里斯本最短的一次饮酒仪式。

en.title: A Ginjinha
en.summary: A Ginjinha at Largo de São Domingos 8 is Lisbon’s standing-room shrine to ginjinha, the sour-cherry liqueur. The brand traces its roots to an 1840 tavern at Rua das Portas de Santo Antão 27; the present shop was refurbished in 1910 by Francisco Espiñeira Couziño. A small glass, an optional cherry, and a few minutes at the counter are the whole ritual.

zh.title: À la Mort Subite
zh.summary: 布鲁塞尔市中心的经典布鲁塞尔咖啡馆，1928 年底迁入蒙塔涅欧赫布街 7 号现址，并以“猝死”为名。店名来自顾客玩的 pitjesbak／421 骰子游戏：决胜一投定输赢，输家被叫作“死人”。建筑 1902 年由 Joseph François Piscador 设计，1910 年由 Paul Hamesse 改造为新路易十六风格咖啡馆，1998 年列为保护遗产；Vossen 家族已传到第四代。

en.title: À la Mort Subite
en.summary: A classic Brussels café in the city centre, moved to 7 Rue Montagne-aux-Herbes Potagères at the end of 1928 and named after a “sudden death” throw in the pitjesbak/421 dice game. The building dates from 1902 by Joseph François Piscador; Paul Hamesse converted it into a neo-Louis XVI café in 1910, and it was listed as heritage in 1998. The Vossen family is now in its fourth generation.

zh.title: 阿尔比切林咖啡馆
zh.summary: 都灵 Consolata 教堂对面的 Al Bicerin，1763 年由 Giuseppe Dentis 开办，1856 年迁入 Carlo Promis 设计的新楼；以咖啡、巧克力与奶油分层的 bicerin 闻名，是都灵最古老的咖啡馆之一。

en.title: Al Bicerin
en.summary: A café on Piazza della Consolata in Turin since 1763, Al Bicerin is the best-known home of the bicerin, a layered drink of coffee, chocolate and cream; the café is small, old-fashioned and still run as a daily neighborhood business.

zh.title: 阿莱格里尼酒庄
zh.summary: 富马内的瓦坡里切拉家族酒庄，家族历史可追溯到 16 世纪；以科维纳、风干葡萄与阿玛罗尼为核心，酒庄提供 45 分钟到 3 小时不等的预约品鉴与葡萄园体验。

en.title: Allegrini
en.summary: A Valpolicella family winery in Fumane whose history reaches back to the sixteenth century; Corvina, dried grapes and Amarone are the core, and visits range from a 45-minute tasting to a 3-hour vineyard experience, all by appointment.

zh.title: 萨沃伊美式酒吧
zh.summary: 伦敦萨沃伊酒店内的经典美式酒吧，1893 年开业，以《萨沃伊鸡尾酒书》和经典调酒传统闻名。

en.title: American Bar at The Savoy
en.summary: The classic American Bar inside The Savoy in London, opened in 1893 and known for The Savoy Cocktail Book, Ada Coleman's Hanky Panky and its Art Deco room.

zh.title: 罗马希腊咖啡馆
zh.summary: 罗马孔多蒂街 86 号的历史咖啡馆，1760 年开业，曾聚集歌德、拜伦、果戈理等文人艺术家；2025 年 10 月 8 日因租约纠纷停业。

en.title: Antico Caffè Greco
en.summary: A historic café at 86 Via dei Condotti in Rome, opened in 1760 and once frequented by Goethe, Byron and Gogol; it was evicted on 8 October 2025 after a long lease dispute.

zh.title: 安东尼世家经典基安蒂酒庄
zh.summary: 佛罗伦萨以南 Bargino 的安东尼世家酒庄，2012 年 10 月启用，由 Archea Associati 设计，建筑嵌入山坡，以重力酿造、螺旋楼梯、酒窖参观与屋顶餐厅 Rinuccio 1180 闻名。2022 年获 World’s Best Vineyards 第一。

en.title: Antinori nel Chianti Classico
en.summary: The Antinori winery at Bargino, south of Florence, opened in October 2012 and was designed by Archea Associati. Sunk into the hillside, it is known for gravity-flow winemaking, a spiral staircase, cellar tours and the rooftop restaurant Rinuccio 1180; it was ranked first in the World’s Best Vineyards list in 2022.

zh.title: Appleton Estate
zh.summary: 牙买加圣伊丽莎白区 Nassau Valley 的朗姆酒庄，官方称 1670 年由 Francis Dickinson 建立 estate，1749 年出现最早有记录的合法蒸馏。它是牙买加持续运营最久的蒸馏厂，已有 275 年以上历史；以石灰岩过滤泉水、热带陈年与单一庄园风土著称。1981 年 Joy Spence 加入，1997 年成为业界首位女性 Master Blender，同年游客中心开放。现属 Campari Group 旗下的 J. Wray & Nephew。参观项目名为“Joy Spence Appleton Estate Rum Experience”，含导览与品鉴。

en.title: Appleton Estate
en.summary: A rum estate in the Nassau Valley of St. Elizabeth, Jamaica. Official history dates it to Francis Dickinson’s 1670 establishment and the earliest documented legal distillation to 1749. It is Jamaica’s oldest continuously operating distillery, known for limestone-filtered water, tropical ageing and single-estate rum. Joy Spence joined in 1981 and became the industry’s first female Master Blender in 1997, when the visitor centre also opened. It is now part of Campari Group’s J. Wray & Nephew; the “Joy Spence Appleton Estate Rum Experience” includes a guided visit and tasting.

zh.title: 阿贝蒸馏厂
zh.summary: 1815 年由约翰·麦克杜格尔在艾雷岛南岸取得执照并创立的单一麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，以重泥煤风格闻名；访客中心提供导览、品鉴与 Old Kiln Cafe，参观建议提前预约。

en.title: Ardbeg Distillery
en.summary: A single malt Scotch whisky distillery on the south coast of Islay, licensed by John MacDougall in 1815 and known for its heavily peated style. The visitor centre offers tours, tastings and the Old Kiln Cafe; booking ahead is advised.

zh.title: 奥古斯丁啤酒厂
zh.summary: 慕尼黑现存最古老的啤酒厂，源头可追溯到 1328 年奥古斯丁修道院的酿酒活动，现由家族企业 Augustiner-Bräu Wagner KG 经营；Landsberger Straße 厂区为保存完整的 19 世纪酿酒建筑群。

en.title: Augustiner-Bräu
en.summary: Munich's oldest surviving brewery, tracing its origins to the Augustinian monastery of 1328 and now run by the family firm Augustiner-Bräu Wagner KG; its Landsberger Straße site preserves a nineteenth-century brewing complex.

zh.title: 埃佩尔奈香槟大道
zh.summary: 法国埃佩尔奈市中心约 1.5 公里的香槟酒庄大道，两侧集中 Moët & Chandon、Mercier、Perrier-Jouët 等酒庄与 19 世纪宅邸；地下有约 110 公里酒窖与约 2 亿瓶香槟，2015 年作为“香槟丘陵、宅邸与酒窖”的一部分列入世界遗产。

en.title: Avenue de Champagne, Épernay
en.summary: The 1.5 km champagne avenue in Épernay, lined with Moët & Chandon, Mercier, Perrier-Jouët and other houses. Around 110 km of cellars and some 200 million bottles lie beneath it; it forms part of the 2015 UNESCO listing.

zh.title: High Five 酒吧
zh.summary: 东京银座地下一层的经典鸡尾酒吧，2008 年由上野秀嗣（Hidetsugu Ueno）创立，以无固定酒单的定制调酒、手削透明冰与日式酒吧礼仪闻名。

en.title: Bar High Five
en.summary: A classic cocktail bar in a Ginza basement in Tokyo, founded in 2008 by Hidetsugu Ueno and known for its no-menu custom drinks, hand-carved clear ice and Japanese bar etiquette.

zh.title: Bar Lupin
zh.summary: 东京银座 5-5-11 冢本不动产大楼地下一层的文坛酒吧，1928 年 10 月 3 日开业。创始人高崎雪子得到泉镜花、里见弴、菊池宽、久米正雄等人支持；1935 年改造为今日的日本梣木 L 形吧台。永井荷风、川端康成、大佛次郎、林芙美子、太宰治、坂口安吾、织田作之助等作家都是常客；林忠彦拍摄的无赖派作家照片仍挂在店里。它是“文坛酒吧”，也是《文豪野犬》粉丝的圣地，但首先是一间安静、成年人的酒吧。

en.title: Bar Lupin
en.summary: A literary bar on the basement floor of the Tsukamoto Real Estate Building at 5-5-11 Ginza, Tokyo, opened on 3 October 1928. Founder Takasaki Yukiko was supported by Izumi Kyoka, Satomi Ton, Kikuchi Kan and Kume Masao; the present Japanese ash L-shaped counter dates from a 1935 renovation. Regulars included Nagai Kafu, Kawabata Yasunari, Osaragi Jiro, Hayashi Fumiko, Dazai Osamu, Sakaguchi Ango and Oda Sakunosuke; Tadahiko Hayashi’s photographs of the Burai-ha writers still hang inside. It is a bundan bar—and a Bungo Stray Dogs pilgrimage site—but first of all a quiet, adult bar.

zh.title: 钟声酒馆
zh.summary: 波士顿 Union Street 的历史酒馆，1795 年由镇公告员 Jimmy Wilson 创办；店家自称美国最老连续营业酒馆，但公开记录显示它多次迁址并在 1915–1934 年停业，现址建筑也不是 1795 年原屋。

en.title: Bell in Hand Tavern
en.summary: A historic tavern on Union Street in Boston, founded in 1795 by town crier Jimmy Wilson; it calls itself America's oldest tavern, but public records show repeated relocations and a closure from 1915 to 1934, and the present building is not the 1795 original.

zh.title: 贝梅尔曼斯酒吧
zh.summary: 纽约上东区卡莱尔酒店（The Carlyle）底层的经典酒店酒吧，1947 年开业；四周是路德维希·贝梅尔曼斯亲笔绘制的中央公园壁画，以夜间钢琴、爵士三重奏与经典鸡尾酒闻名，有着装要求。

en.title: Bemelmans Bar
en.summary: A classic hotel bar on the ground floor of The Carlyle at 35 East 76th Street, New York. Opened in 1947, it is surrounded by Ludwig Bemelmans' hand-painted Central Park murals and is known for nightly piano, a late jazz trio, classic cocktails and a real dress code.

zh.title: 贝灵哲酒庄
zh.summary: 纳帕谷圣赫勒拿的历史酒庄，1876 年由贝灵哲兄弟创立，以手工开凿的酒窖、1884 年莱茵别墅与 Private Reserve 赤霞珠闻名，2026 年迎来 150 周年。

en.title: Beringer Vineyards
en.summary: A historic winery in St. Helena, Napa Valley, founded in 1876 by the Beringer brothers and known for its hand-dug caves, the 1884 Rhine House and Private Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon.

zh.title: 比昂迪-桑蒂酒庄
zh.summary: 蒙塔希诺东北 Greppo 的历史酒庄，1888 年产出首批正式标为 Brunello di Montalcino 的酒。以 100% Sangiovese Grosso、BBS11 克隆、老藤与大型斯拉沃尼亚橡木桶长期陈年著称；2017 年 EPI 入主，Riserva 在历史上仅生产约 38 次。

en.title: Biondi-Santi Tenuta Greppo
en.summary: A historic estate at Greppo, northeast of Montalcino, which produced the first wine officially labelled Brunello di Montalcino in 1888. It is known for 100% Sangiovese Grosso, the BBS11 clone, old vines and long ageing in large Slavonian oak; EPI took over in 2017, and the Riserva has been made only about 38 times.

zh.title: 比索尔酒庄
zh.summary: 瓦尔多比亚德内的 Bisol1542，家族自 1542 年起在普罗塞克核心坡地种植格雷拉；酒窖开在岩壁里，周一至周六接待参观与品鉴，卡特兹与里韦系列是理解陡坡风土的关键。

en.title: Bisol
en.summary: Bisol1542 in Valdobbiadene, a family that has farmed Glera on the Prosecco heartland slopes since 1542; its cellar is cut into the rock, and visits and tastings run Monday to Saturday, with Cartizze and Rive as the keys to the steep-slope terroir.

zh.title: 布兰迪葡萄酒庄
zh.summary: 位于马德拉丰沙尔市中心的马德拉酒陈年酒窖与参观据点，1811 年由约翰·布兰迪创立，属马德拉葡萄酒公司；以 canteiro 阁楼陈年、制桶作坊与四系马德拉酒闻名，周一至周日有导览。

en.title: Blandy's Wine Lodge
en.summary: A Madeira wine ageing lodge and visitor site in central Funchal, founded by John Blandy in 1811 and run by the Madeira Wine Company; known for canteiro attic ageing, its cooperage and the four Madeira styles, with tours every day.

zh.title: 洛佩兹雷迪亚酒庄
zh.summary: 位于西班牙里奥哈阿罗（Haro）火车站区的历史酒庄，1877 年由拉斐尔·洛佩兹·德·埃雷迪亚创立，以 Viña Tondonia 等长期陈酿酒款、地下石窖与自有制桶车间闻名。

en.title: Bodegas López de Heredia
en.summary: A historic winery in Haro's Barrio de la Estación, Rioja, founded in 1877 by Rafael López de Heredia. It is known for Viña Tondonia, very long barrel ageing, sandstone cellars and its own cooperage.

zh.title: 埃米利奥·卢士涛酒庄
zh.summary: 位于赫雷斯-德拉弗龙特拉阿科斯街 53 号的雪莉酒庄，前身可追溯到 1896 年的 almacenista 家族酒行；以六座 19 世纪大教堂式酒窖、Almacenista 系列与 VORS 圣器室闻名，参观须预约。

en.title: Bodegas Lustau
en.summary: A Sherry house at Calle Arcos 53 in Jerez de la Frontera, tracing its origins to an 1896 almacenista family business; known for six 19th-century cathedral-like cellars, the Almacenista range and the VORS Sacristy, with visits by reservation.

zh.title: 堡林爵香槟
zh.summary: 阿伊（Aÿ）的家族香槟酒庄，1829 年由 Athanase de Villermont、Joseph Bollinger 与 Paul Renaudin 共同创立。拥有约 180 公顷葡萄园，85% 为特级园与一级园，Pinot Noir 占 60% 以上；以橡木桶发酵、4,000 只旧桶、百万瓶 reserve magnum 与 Special Cuvée、La Grande Année、R.D. 著称。

en.title: Champagne Bollinger
en.summary: A family-owned Champagne house in Aÿ, founded in 1829 by Athanase de Villermont, Joseph Bollinger and Paul Renaudin. It farms about 180 hectares, 85% Grand and Premier Cru, with Pinot Noir over 60%; it is known for oak fermentation, 4,000 old barrels, a million reserve magnums and Special Cuvée, La Grande Année and R.D.

zh.title: 博廷餐厅
zh.summary: 马德里刀匠街 17 号的家族餐厅，1725 年开业，常被吉尼斯世界纪录引为“世界最古老餐厅”；以木炉烤乳猪与烤羊闻名，海明威曾是常客。

en.title: Botín
en.summary: A family restaurant at Calle de Cuchilleros 17 in Madrid, opened in 1725 and often cited by Guinness World Records as the world's oldest restaurant; known for wood-fired roast suckling pig and lamb, and for its Hemingway connection.

zh.title: 利普啤酒馆
zh.summary: 巴黎圣日耳曼大道 151 号的 Brasserie Lipp，1880 年由阿尔萨斯人 Léonard Lipp 开办；1920 年 Marcelin Cazes 接手后成为文学与政治人物的会面场，1989 年列入历史建筑，酸菜与 profiteroles 仍是招牌。

en.title: Brasserie Lipp
en.summary: Brasserie Lipp at 151 Boulevard Saint-Germain was opened in 1880 by the Alsatian Léonard Lipp; after Marcelin Cazes took over in 1920 it became a meeting place for writers and politicians, was listed as a historic monument in 1989, and still serves choucroute and profiteroles.

zh.title: 布赫拉迪酒厂
zh.summary: 苏格兰艾雷岛 Loch Indaal 岸边的维多利亚式蒸馏厂，1881 年由 Harvey 兄弟建造。1929 年关闭、1994 年停产后，2001 年由 Mark Reynier、Simon Coughlin 与 Jim McEwan 复活；2012 年归 Rémy Cointreau，2020 年获 B Corp 认证。酒厂同时生产无泥煤的 Bruichladdich、重泥煤的 Port Charlotte、超重泥煤的 Octomore 与 The Botanist 金酒，强调艾雷岛大麦与“在地生产”。

en.title: Bruichladdich Distillery
en.summary: A Victorian distillery on the shore of Loch Indaal, Isle of Islay, built in 1881 by the Harvey brothers. Closed in 1929, mothballed in 1994 and revived in 2001 by Mark Reynier, Simon Coughlin and Jim McEwan; acquired by Rémy Cointreau in 2012 and B Corp certified in 2020. It makes unpeated Bruichladdich, heavily peated Port Charlotte, super-heavily peated Octomore and The Botanist gin, with a strong Islay barley and “made on the island” identity.

zh.title: 美景咖啡馆
zh.summary: 旧金山 Hyde 与 Beach 街角的 Buena Vista Café，1916 年由寄宿公寓一层改为酒吧，1952 年与专栏作家 Stanton Delaplane 一起把爱尔兰咖啡带红美国；紧邻 Powell-Hyde 缆车终点。

en.title: Buena Vista Café
en.summary: A bar at the cable-car terminus in San Francisco's Fisherman's Wharf, Buena Vista Café opened in 1916 and is widely credited with popularizing the Irish coffee in the United States after 1952; its version uses matured cream, a six-ounce glass and a strict assembly routine.

zh.title: 水牛足迹酒厂
zh.summary: 美国肯塔基州法兰克福的波本威士忌蒸馏厂，厂址自 1775 年 Leestown 聚落起延续至今，1870 年由 E.H. Taylor Jr. 扩为 O.F.C.，1999 年改名 Buffalo Trace；现为国家历史地标，导览、品鉴与停车免费，需提前在官网抢约。

en.title: Buffalo Trace Distillery
en.summary: A working bourbon distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky, on a site occupied since the 1775 Leestown settlement and expanded by E.H. Taylor Jr. into the O.F.C. distillery in 1870; renamed Buffalo Trace in 1999, now a National Historic Landmark with free tours, tastings and parking that must be reserved online.

zh.title: 布什米尔斯酒厂
zh.summary: 北爱尔兰安特里姆郡布什米尔斯村的爱尔兰威士忌酒厂，以 1608 年蒸馏执照自称“世界最古老的持照威士忌酒厂”；厂内仍用铜制壶式蒸馏器三次蒸馏，设有预约导览、礼品店与 1608 酒吧。

en.title: Bushmills Distillery
en.summary: An Irish whiskey distillery in the village of Bushmills, County Antrim, Northern Ireland, which dates its licence to 1608 and calls itself the world's oldest licensed whiskey distillery; it still triple distils in copper pot stills and runs booked tours, a gift shop and the 1608 Bar.

zh.title: A Brasileira
zh.summary: 希亚多 Rua Garrett 120–122 号的 A Brasileira，1905 年由 Adriano Telles 创办，最初以销售巴西咖啡豆为业。Manuel Norte Júnior 设计的新艺术风格立面、镜面与木饰内厅，使它成为里斯本知识分子与作家的会客厅；门前费尔南多·佩索阿的青铜坐像，则是 1988 年百年诞辰留下的城市记号。

en.title: A Brasileira
en.summary: A Brasileira at Rua Garrett 120–122 in Chiado opened in 1905, founded by Adriano Telles to sell Brazilian coffee. Its Art Nouveau façade and mirrored, wood-panelled interior, designed by Manuel Norte Júnior, turned it into a Lisbon literary salon; the bronze Fernando Pessoa seated outside was added for the poet’s centenary in 1988.

zh.title: 中央咖啡馆
zh.summary: 维也纳历史悠久的文学咖啡馆，1876 年开业，位于市中心圣斯蒂芬大教堂附近；以咖啡、蛋糕和知识分子顾客闻名，是维也纳咖啡文化的代表场所之一。

en.title: Café Central
en.summary: A historic literary café in Vienna, opened in 1876 and known for its coffee, cakes and intellectual clientele.

zh.title: Café De Dokter
zh.summary: 阿姆斯特丹 Rozenboomsteeg 4 号的 Café De Dokter，1798 年由附近医院的外科医生创办，最初是医生与医学生的会面点。今天它只有约 18 平方米，是阿姆斯特丹最小的酒吧之一；同一家族经营到第七代，由 Maria 与 Henry 管理。古董医疗器械、老钟、鸟笼、吊灯、Dokters Recept jenever 与“只收现金、不接受预订”，共同构成这间微型酒吧的完整性格。

en.title: Café De Dokter
en.summary: Café De Dokter at Rozenboomsteeg 4 was founded in 1798 by a surgeon from a nearby hospital, originally as a meeting place for doctors and medical students. At about 18 square metres it is one of Amsterdam’s smallest bars; the same family runs it into the seventh generation, now under Maria and Henry. Antique medical instruments, clocks, birdcages, chandeliers, Dokters Recept jenever, cash-only payment, and no reservations complete its character.

zh.title: 花神咖啡馆
zh.summary: 巴黎圣日耳曼德佩的文学咖啡馆，19 世纪末开业，以知识分子顾客和经典巴黎咖啡馆氛围闻名。

en.title: Café de Flore
en.summary: A literary café in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Paris, opened in the late 19th century and known for its intellectual clientele.

zh.title: 和平咖啡馆
zh.summary: 巴黎歌剧院对面的 Café de la Paix，1862 年随 Grand Hôtel 开业；拿破仑三世风格的金色护墙板、格顶与露台，使它成为歌剧院街区最典型的“看人与被看”的咖啡馆。

en.title: Café de la Paix
en.summary: Facing the Opéra Garnier, Café de la Paix opened in 1862 with the Grand Hôtel; its Napoleon III gilded panelling, coffered ceiling and terrace made it the theatre district's classic place to see and be seen.

zh.title: 哈维尔卡咖啡馆
zh.summary: 维也纳多罗特街 6 号的家族咖啡馆，1939 年由莱奥波德与约瑟菲娜·哈维尔卡开业，战后成为作家与艺术家的聚会地，以晚间现烤 Buchteln 闻名。

en.title: Café Hawelka
en.summary: A family-run café at Dorotheergasse 6 in Vienna, opened by Leopold and Josefine Hawelka in 1939; it became a postwar meeting place for writers and artists and is known for Buchteln baked in the evening.

zh.title: Café Hoppe
zh.summary: 阿姆斯特丹 Spui 18–20 号的 Café Hoppe，自 1670 年起就在这个街角卖酒。18 号是国家级保护建筑，20 号原为酒店/餐厅，1930 年代 Harry Mustert 把两栋打通并定名 Hoppe，形成“站着喝的 Hoppe”与“坐着喝的 Hoppe”。它不放音乐、以 jenever 与 Amstel 啤酒待客，是荷兰“bruin café”传统最完整的样本之一。

en.title: Café Hoppe
en.summary: Café Hoppe at Spui 18–20 has been selling drinks on this corner since 1670. No. 18 is a listed national monument; No. 20 was a hotel/restaurant, and in the 1930s Harry Mustert joined the two buildings and named the place Hoppe, creating a “standing Hoppe” and a “sitting Hoppe.” No music, jenever, and Amstel beer make it one of the most complete Dutch bruin cafés.

zh.title: 马杰斯蒂克咖啡馆
zh.summary: 波尔图 Rua de Santa Catarina 112 号的 Café Majestic，1922 年 12 月 2 日开业，设计出自 José Pinto de Oliveira；大理石立面、新艺术木饰、佛兰德斯镜与温室使它成为波尔图最完整的新艺术咖啡馆，1983 年列为公共利益建筑，1994 年修复重开。

en.title: Café Majestic
en.summary: Café Majestic at Rua de Santa Catarina 112 in Porto opened on 2 December 1922, designed by José Pinto de Oliveira; its marble facade, Art Nouveau woodwork, Flemish mirrors and conservatory make it Porto's most complete Art Nouveau café, listed as a public-interest building in 1983 and reopened after restoration in 1994.

zh.title: 普罗可布咖啡馆
zh.summary: 巴黎第六区圣日耳曼德佩的咖啡馆兼餐厅，1686 年由西西里人 Francesco Procopio dei Coltelli 开设，常称巴黎最古老咖啡馆；伏尔泰、卢梭、狄德罗等启蒙人物常客，今天仍供应咖啡与法式传统菜。

en.title: Le Procope
en.summary: A café-restaurant in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Paris, opened in 1686 by the Sicilian Francesco Procopio dei Coltelli and often called the oldest café in Paris; Voltaire, Rousseau and Diderot were regulars, and it still serves coffee and traditional French food.

zh.title: Café Pushkin
zh.summary: 莫斯科特维尔林荫道 26A 号的俄式餐厅，1999 年 6 月 4 日由 Andrei Dellos 的 Maison Dellos 开设。它的名字来自法国歌手 Gilbert Bécaud 1964 年歌曲《Nathalie》里虚构的“Café Pouchkine”，并非百年老店；建筑是一座巴洛克式宅邸，室内以“药房”“图书馆”等厅室营造十九世纪俄罗斯贵族宅第的氛围，菜单主打十九世纪俄罗斯贵族菜与法餐。

en.title: Café Pushkin
en.summary: A Russian restaurant at 26A Tverskoy Boulevard in Moscow, opened on 4 June 1999 by Andrei Dellos’s Maison Dellos. Its name comes from the fictional “Café Pouchkine” in Gilbert Bécaud’s 1964 song “Nathalie”; it is not an old institution. The restaurant occupies a Baroque mansion and uses rooms such as the “Apothecary” and “Library” to create a nineteenth-century Russian aristocratic interior, with a menu of Russian noble cuisine and French classics.

zh.title: Café Sacher
zh.summary: 维也纳歌剧旁、Philharmoniker Straße 4 号的 Café Sacher，藏在 Hotel Sacher 一层。1832 年，16 岁的 Franz Sacher 在 Metternich 宫廷做出第一只 Sachertorte；1876 年 Eduard Sacher 开出 Hotel Sacher，1892 年 Eduard 去世后由 Anna Sacher 接手。今天的咖啡馆以红丝绒、深色木饰、镜面与每日 34 道手工步骤的 Original Sacher-Torte 为核心，是维也纳“甜点—咖啡馆—酒店”三位一体的样本。

en.title: Café Sacher
en.summary: Café Sacher occupies the ground floor of Hotel Sacher at Philharmoniker Straße 4, next to the Vienna State Opera. Franz Sacher made the first Sachertorte at Metternich’s court in 1832; Eduard Sacher opened the hotel in 1876, and Anna Sacher ran it after his death in 1892. Red velvet, dark wood, mirrors, and the 34-step Original Sacher-Torte make this Vienna’s clearest “cake—café—hotel” composite.

zh.title: 斯拉维亚咖啡馆
zh.summary: 布拉格民族大街 1 号、国家剧院对面的历史咖啡馆，1884 年开业，1930 年代改造成装饰艺术风格，曾聚集里尔克、卡夫卡、哈维尔等作家与异议人士。

en.title: Café Slavia
en.summary: A historic café at Národní 1012/1 in Prague, opposite the National Theatre, opened in 1884 and remodelled in Art Deco style in the 1930s; it was associated with Rilke, Kafka, Havel and dissident circles.

zh.title: 斯佩尔咖啡馆
zh.summary: 维也纳玛利亚希尔夫区的传统咖啡馆，1880 年开业，以保留至今的 19 世纪内饰、大理石桌、Thonet 椅、台球桌与 Sperltorte 蛋糕闻名。

en.title: Café Sperl
en.summary: A traditional coffee house in Vienna's Mariahilf district, opened in 1880 and known for its preserved 19th-century interior, marble tables, Thonet chairs, billiard tables and Sperltorte.

zh.title: 花神咖啡馆（威尼斯）
zh.summary: 威尼斯圣马可广场的历史咖啡馆，1720 年开业，是欧洲持续经营时间最长的咖啡馆之一。

en.title: Caffè Florian
en.summary: A historic café on Piazza San Marco in Venice, opened in 1720 and one of Europe’s longest-running cafés.

zh.title: 吉利咖啡馆
zh.summary: 佛罗伦萨 Piazza della Repubblica 转角的 Caffè Gilli，1733 年由瑞士 Gilli 家族以“甜面包铺”起家，1893 年迁到新广场、1917 年定于 Palazzo Levi；木饰、老钟与大理石柜台保留着佛罗伦萨历史咖啡馆的日常。

en.title: Caffè Gilli
en.summary: Florence's Caffè Gilli, on the corner of Piazza della Repubblica, began in 1733 as a Swiss family's sweet-bread shop; it moved to the new piazza in 1893 and to Palazzo Levi in 1917, keeping woodwork, an old clock and a marble counter.

zh.title: 圣卡洛咖啡馆
zh.summary: 都灵 Piazza San Carlo 拱廊下的 Caffè San Carlo，1822 年以 Caffè di Piazza d'Armi 开业，1837 年后经 Giuseppe Leoni 改造，是意大利复兴运动与都灵知识界的沙龙；2022 年在 Gallerie d'Italia 内以咖啡馆与 bistrot 形式重启。

en.title: Caffè San Carlo
en.summary: A café on Turin's Piazza San Carlo since 1822, Caffè San Carlo is known for its neoclassical interior, its Risorgimento clientele and its 2022 reopening under the Costardi brothers; it is a historic café that still serves as a civic living room.

zh.title: 坎帕里诺长廊酒吧
zh.summary: 米兰 Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II 北拱廊的 Camparino in Galleria，1915 年由 Davide Campari 开办；以 Campari Seltz、站立式 Bar di Passo 与自由风格马赛克闻名，是米兰 aperitivo 的地标。

en.title: Camparino in Galleria
en.summary: A bar in Milan's Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Camparino was opened by Davide Campari in 1915 above the family's Caffè Campari; it is known for Campari and soda, Liberty-style decoration and a recent restoration that reopened in 2019.

zh.title: 康帝隆酒厂
zh.summary: 布鲁塞尔安德莱赫特的自发发酵兰比克酒厂，1900 年建厂，兼作布鲁塞尔贵兹博物馆；平日自由参观、周六只做预约导览，是理解兰比克与贵兹的核心现场。

en.title: Cantillon Brewery
en.summary: A spontaneous-fermentation lambic brewery in Anderlecht, Brussels, founded in 1900 and home to the Brussels Gueuze Museum; weekdays allow self-guided visits, while Saturdays are tour-only and must be booked online.

zh.title: 嘉士伯酒厂：啤酒、实验室与一座花园
zh.summary: 哥本哈根 Valby 的嘉士伯旧厂区由 J.C. Jacobsen 于 1847 年创立；今天的 Home of Carlsberg（原 Visit Carlsberg）用展览、旧酒窖、马厩与品鉴讲述家族史、科学发现与拉格酿造。

en.title: Carlsberg: Beer, a Laboratory and a Garden
en.summary: The old Carlsberg brewery in Valby, Copenhagen, was founded by J.C. Jacobsen in 1847; today Home of Carlsberg (formerly Visit Carlsberg) uses an exhibition, old cellars, stables and tastings to tell the family story, scientific discoveries and lager brewing.

zh.title: 旋转木马酒吧
zh.summary: 新奥尔良 Hotel Monteleone 内的 1949 年旋转酒吧，25 个座位，约 15 分钟转一圈，以 Vieux Carré、Sazerac 与现场钢琴闻名。

en.title: The Carousel Bar
en.summary: A 1949 revolving bar inside Hotel Monteleone in New Orleans, with 25 seats, a rotation of about 15 minutes, and Vieux Carré, Sazerac and live piano as its signatures.

zh.title: 埃拉杜拉酒厂：阿马蒂坦的马蹄庄园
zh.summary: 位于墨西哥哈利斯科州阿马蒂坦圣何塞德尔雷富希奥庄园的龙舌兰酒厂，历史可追到 1870 年；以砖砌穹顶炉、露天野酵母发酵与自建美国白橡木桶闻名，参观须预约，成人限入。

en.title: Casa Herradura: The Horseshoe Hacienda of Amatitán
