en.summary: A tequila distillery at the Ex-Hacienda San José del Refugio in Amatitán, Jalisco, with roots in 1870; known for clay-dome ovens, open-air wild-yeast fermentation and its own American white oak barrels, with visits by reservation for adults only.

zh.title: 拉布拉之家
zh.summary: 马德里太阳门旁 Calle de Tetuán 12 号的 Casa Labra，1860 年作为 taberna/fonda 开业；1879 年 5 月 2 日西班牙工人社会党在此秘密成立；1947 年 Molina 家族接手，如今以炸鳕鱼条、鳕鱼丸子与锌皮吧台闻名。

en.title: Casa Labra
en.summary: Casa Labra at Calle de Tetuán 12 beside Madrid's Puerta del Sol opened in 1860 as a taberna/fonda; on 2 May 1879 the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party was secretly founded in a back room; the Molina family took over in 1947 and the house is now known for fried cod strips, cod croquettes and its zinc counter.

zh.title: 布罗利奥城堡
zh.summary: 基安蒂 Gaiole in Chianti 的里卡索利家族城堡，文献可追溯到 1141 年；1861 年意大利王国首相贝蒂诺·里卡索利在 1872 年写下基安蒂配方，今天以城堡参观、花园、家族收藏与 Castello di Brolio 旗舰酒闻名。

en.title: Castello di Brolio
en.summary: The Ricasoli family castle at Gaiole in Chianti, documented as family property as early as 1141; Baron Bettino Ricasoli set down the Chianti formula in 1872, and the estate is now known for castle visits, gardens, the Ricasoli Collection and the flagship Castello di Brolio wine.

zh.title: 卡氏家族酒庄
zh.summary: 门多萨卢汉德库约的家族酒庄，1902 年创立，以马尔贝克复兴与安第斯山麓高海拔风土著称；金字塔建筑与 Adrianna 葡萄园是参观核心，项目需预约，官方坐标为南纬 33°10′4.264″、西经 68°54′14.522″。

en.title: Catena Zapata
en.summary: A family winery in Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza, founded in 1902 and known for the revival of Malbec and high-altitude terroirs in the Andean foothills; the pyramid building and Adrianna vineyard anchor the visit, which requires booking, and the official coordinates are 33°10′4.264″ S, 68°54′14.522″ W.

zh.title: 张裕酒文化博物馆
zh.summary: 位于山东烟台芝罘区大马路 56 号的中国首家葡萄酒专业博物馆，1992 年在张裕老厂区启用，为国家一级博物馆、国家 4A 级景区，2002 与 2007 年两次扩建。

en.title: Changyu Wine Culture Museum
en.summary: China's first specialist wine museum, at 56 Dama Road, Zhifu District, Yantai, Shandong. It opened in 1992 on the old Changyu plant, is a national first-class museum and a 4A tourist attraction, and was expanded in 2002 and 2007.

zh.title: 白马酒庄
zh.summary: 法国圣埃美隆（Saint-Émilion）的白马酒庄，1832 年由 Jean-Jacques Ducasse 购入核心地块，20 年内从 Figeac 购地形成约 39 公顷、今天基本未变的庄园。42 公顷、56 个地块，55% Cabernet Franc、40% Merlot、5% Cabernet Sauvignon；1954 年首次列入圣埃美隆一级 A，2021 年 7 月主动退出 2022 年分级。2011 年 Christian de Portzamparc 设计的白色混凝土酒窖落成。

en.title: Château Cheval Blanc
en.summary: A Saint-Émilion estate shaped from 1832, when Jean-Jacques Ducasse bought its core and acquired Figeac plots over 20 years to form a 39-hectare property whose boundaries are almost unchanged. The 42-hectare vineyard has 56 plots and is planted 55% Cabernet Franc, 40% Merlot and 5% Cabernet Sauvignon. It was first ranked Premier Grand Cru Classé A in 1954 and withdrew from the 2022 classification in July 2021. Christian de Portzamparc’s white-concrete winery opened in 2011.

zh.title: 洛巴德酒庄
zh.summary: 热尔省索尔贝的下雅文邑单一庄园，1870 年建庄、80 公顷葡萄园连成一片，以沙质土壤、1974 年定制的连续蒸馏器、约三千只酒桶与年份雅文邑装瓶著称。

en.title: Château de Laubade
en.summary: A single-estate Bas-Armagnac property in Sorbets, Gers, built in 1870 with 80 hectares in one block, known for tawny sand soils, a continuous still built in 1974, some 3,000 casks and estate-bottled vintage Armagnac.

zh.title: 默尔索城堡
zh.summary: 勃艮第默尔索的葡萄酒庄园，历史可追溯到 11 世纪，现址城堡为 18 世纪意大利风格建筑，2024 年完成整修；葡萄园约 67 公顷，酒窖从 12 世纪延续至 19 世纪，提供预约参观与品鉴。

en.title: Château de Meursault
en.summary: A wine estate in Meursault, Burgundy, with a history reaching back to the 11th century. The present Italianate château dates from the 18th century and was renovated in 2024; the estate farms about 67 hectares and its cellars span the 12th to the 19th century. Visits and tastings are available by reservation.

zh.title: 滴金酒庄
zh.summary: 法国索泰尔讷（Sauternes）山顶的甜酒庄园，1855 年分级中唯一的 Premier Cru Supérieur。葡萄园约 100 公顷，以 Sémillon 为主、Sauvignon Blanc 为辅，靠贵腐菌 Botrytis cinerea 浓缩糖分与风味；采收通常分 5–10 次手工挑选。1593 年 Sauvage 家族建园，1785 年归 Lur-Saluces，1999 年由 LVMH 收购，2004 年 Pierre Lurton 接手管理。

en.title: Château d’Yquem
en.summary: A sweet-wine estate on the highest hill in Sauternes, the only Premier Cru Supérieur in the 1855 classification. About 100 hectares are planted mainly to Sémillon with Sauvignon Blanc; Botrytis cinerea concentrates sugar and flavour, and picking usually passes 5–10 times through the vineyard. Jacques Sauvage established the estate in 1593, the Lur-Saluces family held it from 1785, LVMH acquired it in 1999 and Pierre Lurton took over management in 2004.

zh.title: 侯伯王酒庄
zh.summary: 法国波尔多佩萨克-雷奥良（Pessac-Léognan）的格拉夫一级庄，1855 年分级中唯一不在梅多克的一级庄。葡萄园历史可追到公元 1 世纪，1521 年首次以“Haut-Brion”之名出现，1533 年 Pontac 家族购入；1935 年起归 Dillon 家族，2008 年由 Prince Robert of Luxembourg 主持。以砾石土壤、烟熏矿物与雪茄盒风格著称。

en.title: Château Haut-Brion
en.summary: A Graves first growth in Pessac-Léognan, the only 1855 first growth outside the Médoc. Vines have been grown here since the 1st century; the name Haut-Brion appears in 1521 and the Pontac family bought the estate in 1533. Clarence Dillon acquired it in 1935, and Prince Robert of Luxembourg has led it since 2008. Gravel soils and a smoky, mineral, cigar-box style define the wines.

zh.title: 拉菲古堡
zh.summary: 法国波尔多波亚克（Pauillac）的梅多克一级庄，112 公顷葡萄园以赤霞珠为主，1855 年分级列为一级庄，1868 年由罗斯柴尔德家族购入；官网公告因整修暂停开放至 2028 年 1 月。

en.title: Château Lafite Rothschild
en.summary: First-growth Pauillac estate with 112 hectares of vines, classified in 1855 and acquired by Baron James de Rothschild in 1868. The official visit page says visits are suspended until January 2028 for renovation.

zh.title: 拉图酒庄
zh.summary: 法国波尔多波亚克（Pauillac）的梅多克一级庄，文献可追溯到 1331 年的圣莫贝尔塔楼。葡萄园 96.5 公顷，其中 47 公顷 Enclos 环绕城堡、距吉伦特河口仅约 300 米；大比例老藤赤霞珠、砾石与黏土底层构成其力量型风格。1993 年归 François Pinault 的 Artémis，2012 年起不再以期酒方式销售。

en.title: Château Latour
en.summary: A Médoc first growth in Pauillac, documented from 1331 as a fortified tower at Saint-Maubert. The 96.5-hectare vineyard includes the 47-hectare Enclos around the château, only about 300 metres from the Gironde estuary; old-vine Cabernet Sauvignon on gravel over clay gives the wine its structural, long-lived style. François Pinault’s Artémis acquired the estate in 1993, and since 2012 Latour has not sold its wine en primeur.

zh.title: 玛歌酒庄
zh.summary: 法国波尔多玛歌村的梅多克一级庄，1855 年分级四大一级庄之一。庄园约 265 公顷，其中约 87 公顷红葡萄、12 公顷白葡萄；1810–1815 年建成的新帕拉第奥式主楼与 2015 年 Norman Foster 设计的新酒窖并存。1977 年 André Mentzelopoulos 接手，1980 年由 Corinne 管理，2023 年交给 Alexis Leven-Mentzelopoulos。

en.title: Château Margaux
en.summary: A Médoc first growth in the Margaux appellation, one of the four estates ranked Premier Cru Classé in 1855. The 265-hectare property includes about 87 hectares of red vines and 12 of white; the 1810–1815 neo-Palladian château coexists with Norman Foster’s 2015 winery. André Mentzelopoulos took over in 1977, Corinne ran it from 1980, and Alexis Leven-Mentzelopoulos succeeded her in 2023.

zh.title: 米拉沃酒庄
zh.summary: 科朗斯山谷里的普罗旺斯桃红名庄，葡萄园按干石梯田排列，获有机认证；酒庄本身不对公众开放，酒款在佩兰家族的品鉴室与指定渠道出售。

en.title: Château Miraval
en.summary: A Provençal rosé name in the Correns valley, with vineyards laid out on dry-stone terraces and certified organic farming; the estate itself is closed to the public, and the wines are sold through Famille Perrin's tasting room and selected retailers.

zh.title: 蒙特莱纳酒庄
zh.summary: 纳帕谷卡利斯托加的历史酒庄，1882 年由 Alfred L. Tubbs 创建。1973 年霞多丽在 1976 年“巴黎审判”白葡萄酒组中名列第一；酒庄以石砌城堡、 Jade Lake 中式园林与耐陈年的 Estate Cabernet Sauvignon 著称，2008 年起由 Michel Reybier 持有。

en.title: Chateau Montelena
en.summary: A historic Napa Valley estate in Calistoga, founded in 1882 by Alfred L. Tubbs. Its 1973 Chardonnay placed first among whites at the 1976 Judgment of Paris; the property is known for its stone chateau, the Chinese garden and Jade Lake, and age-worthy Estate Cabernet Sauvignon, and has been owned by Michel Reybier since 2008.

zh.title: 木桐酒庄
zh.summary: 位于法国波亚克（Pauillac）的梅多克一级庄，1853 年由纳塔涅·德·罗思柴尔德男爵买下并改现名，1855 年列二级庄、1973 年晋升一级庄；1945 年起每年邀请艺术家设计酒标，1962 年设立葡萄酒艺术博物馆。

en.title: Château Mouton Rothschild
en.summary: A first growth in Pauillac, bought by Baron Nathaniel de Rothschild in 1853 and renamed, classified a second growth in 1855 and promoted to first growth in 1973. Since 1945 every vintage has carried an artist-designed label, and the Museum of Wine in Art opened in 1962.

zh.title: 柏图斯酒庄
zh.summary: 法国波尔多波美侯（Pomerol）的柏图斯，11.4 公顷葡萄园位于产区最高的蓝黏土台地，自 2010 年起 100% Merlot，只产一款正牌酒、没有副牌，年产量约 30,000 瓶。它没有城堡式主楼，也不参加 1855 分级（Pomerol 没有官方分级）；1925 年起 Loubat 夫人逐步购入，1969 年 Moueix 家族买下多数股份并从 Gazin 购得 4.5 公顷。酒庄不开放公众参观与品鉴。

en.title: Château Pétrus
en.summary: Petrus in Pomerol is an 11.4-hectare vineyard on the appellation’s highest blue-clay plateau, planted 100% Merlot since 2010. It makes one grand vin, no second wine, and about 30,000 bottles a year. There is no château-style mansion and no 1855 classification, because Pomerol has no official classification. Madame Loubat began buying shares in 1925; the Moueix family acquired a majority in 1969 and bought 4.5 hectares from Gazin. The estate offers no public visits or tastings.

zh.title: 中国酒文化城
zh.summary: 贵州仁怀茅台镇、茅台集团厂区内的酒文化博览馆，1993—1997 年由茅台集团投资修建；占地约 3 万平方米，设酒源、酒技、酒俗、酒器、茅台等七个展馆，为国家 4A 级旅游景区，2017 年获批贵州茅台酒博物馆。

en.title: China Liquor Culture City
en.summary: A liquor-culture museum in Maotai Town, Renhuai, Guizhou, built by the Moutai Group between 1993 and 1997; it covers about 30,000 square metres, contains seven galleries including the Hall of Wine Origins, the Hall of Brewing Technology, the Hall of Customs and the Moutai Hall, and is a national 4A scenic area and, since 2017, the Guizhou Moutai Wine Museum.

zh.title: 中国黄酒博物馆
zh.summary: 位于绍兴市越城区下大路 557 号、光相桥畔的黄酒专题博物馆，2007 年由古越龙山投资建成开馆；占地约三万平方米，建筑面积约 1.6 万平方米，以酒史、酒俗、酒技、花雕与地下酒窖展示中国黄酒文化。

en.title: China Yellow Wine Museum
en.summary: A museum devoted to Chinese yellow wine at 557 Xia Da Road in Shaoxing's Yuecheng District, beside Guangxiang Bridge. Opened in 2007 with investment from Guyuelongshan, it covers about 30,000 square metres of site and 16,000 square metres of building, with displays on wine history, custom, technique, Huadiao decoration and an underground cellar.

zh.title: Çiçek Pasajı
zh.summary: 伊斯坦布尔贝伊奥卢 İstiklal 大街 176 号的历史拱廊，1876 年建成时叫 Cité de Péra／Hristaki Pasajı，原址是 1870 年佩拉大火烧毁的 Naum 剧院。1908 年归大维齐尔 Sait Paşa 后称 Sait Paşa Pasajı；1917 年俄国革命后流亡贵族女性在此开花店，1940 年代花店集中，得名“花廊”。1978 年 5 月 10 日部分建筑坍塌、12 人死亡，1988 年修复重开，2005 与 2022 年再修。今天它不是单一酒吧，而是一条聚集 meyhane、餐馆与啤酒馆的拱廊。

en.title: Çiçek Pasajı
en.summary: A historic arcade at 176 İstiklal Avenue in Beyoğlu, Istanbul, completed in 1876 as Cité de Péra/Hristaki Pasajı on the Naum Theatre site, destroyed in the 1870 Pera fire. It passed to Grand Vizier Sait Paşa in 1908 and became Sait Paşa Pasajı; after the 1917 Russian Revolution exiled noblewomen opened flower shops here, and by the 1940s it was known as the “Flower Passage.” Part of the building collapsed on 10 May 1978, killing 12 people; it reopened after restoration in 1988 and was repaired in 2005 and 2022. Today it is an arcade of meyhanes, restaurants and beer halls, not a single bar.

zh.title: 波尔多葡萄酒城
zh.summary: 位于法国波尔多巴卡朗码头的葡萄酒主题博物馆，2016 年开馆，由 XTU 建筑事务所设计，常设展约 3000 平方米，以六大主题、18 个展区讲述世界葡萄酒文化。

en.title: La Cité du Vin
en.summary: Wine-themed museum on the Bacalan quays in Bordeaux, opened in 2016 and designed by XTU architects. Its 3,000 m² permanent exhibition uses six themes and 18 modules to tell the global story of wine.

zh.title: 云雾之湾酒庄
zh.summary: 新西兰马尔堡布伦海姆 Jacksons Road 的长相思酒庄，1985 年酿出首个年份；门市每周七天 10:00–17:00 开放，设 Saku 餐厅与预约制品鉴，是理解 Wairau Valley 风格与马尔堡出口叙事的入口。

en.title: Cloudy Bay
en.summary: A Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc estate on Jacksons Road in Blenheim, first vintage 1985; its cellar door opens seven days 10:00–17:00, with the Saku restaurant and booked tastings, and it remains a clear entry point to Wairau Valley style and Marlborough's export story.

zh.title: 干露酒庄
zh.summary: 智利迈坡谷皮尔克的历史酒庄，1883 年由 Melchor Concha y Toro 创立，是智利葡萄酒走向世界最具代表性的名字之一。以 Casillero del Diablo、Marques de Casa Concha 与 Don Melchor 为核心酒款；Centro del Vino 于 140 周年之际开放，包含 22 公顷百年公园、1883 酒库与“魔鬼酒窖”体验。

en.title: Viña Concha y Toro
en.summary: A historic Chilean winery in Pirque, Maipo Valley, founded in 1883 by Melchor Concha y Toro and one of the country’s best-known wine names abroad. Its core labels include Casillero del Diablo, Marques de Casa Concha and Don Melchor; the Centro del Vino opened for the 140th anniversary, with a 22-hectare century-old park, Bodega 1883 and the Casillero del Diablo experience.

zh.title: 塞朗河畔坡地酒庄
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔萨韦尼耶尔的一座 7 公顷独占 AOC 酒庄，葡萄园由西多会修士于 1130 年种植，现由乔利家族经营并自 1984 年起全面采用生物动力法；出产 Coulée de Serrant、Clos de la Bergerie 与 Les Vieux Clos 三款白诗南。

en.title: La Coulée de Serrant
en.summary: A 7-hectare monopole AOC in Savennières, France, planted by Cistercian monks in 1130 and now run by the Joly family, biodynamic since 1984; it produces Coulée de Serrant, Clos de la Bergerie and Les Vieux Clos from Chenin Blanc.

zh.title: CVNE 酒庄
zh.summary: 西班牙里奥哈阿罗火车站区的历史酒庄，1879 年由 Real de Asúa 兄弟创立，全名 Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España；以 Cune、Viña Real 与 Imperial 等品牌、美国橡木桶陈年与老厂区建筑闻名，至今由创始家族经营。

en.title: CVNE
en.summary: A historic winery in Haro's Barrio de la Estación, founded in 1879 by the Real de Asúa brothers as Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España; known for the Cune, Viña Real and Imperial brands, American-oak ageing and a still family-run old winery, with visits by appointment.

zh.title: 达尔维尼酒厂
zh.summary: 苏格兰高地达尔维尼村的单一麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，1897 年以 Strathspey 之名创立，海拔 1,164 英尺（355 米），官方称其为苏格兰最高、最冷的蒸馏厂之一；以石楠蜂蜜、轻柔烟熏与仍在使用的虫管冷凝器闻名。

en.title: Dalwhinnie Distillery
en.summary: A single malt distillery in the village of Dalwhinnie in the Scottish Highlands, founded as Strathspey in 1897 and sitting 1,164 ft (355 m) above sea level; officially described as one of Scotland's highest and coldest distilleries, known for heather honey, gentle smoke and worm tub condensers.

zh.title: 达伦堡酒庄
zh.summary: 麦克拉伦谷的家族酒庄，1912 年由 Joseph Osborn 创立，现由第四代 Chester Osborn 主理；以“Dead Arm”西拉与 2017 年开放的立方体酒窖（d’Arenberg Cube）闻名。

en.title: d’Arenberg
en.summary: A family winery in McLaren Vale founded by Joseph Osborn in 1912 and now led by fourth-generation Chester Osborn; known for “The Dead Arm” Shiraz and the d’Arenberg Cube, opened in 2017.

zh.title: 达罗兹雅文邑
zh.summary: 法国朗德省 Roquefort 的家族雅文邑酒商，1974 年由 Francis Darroze 正式创立。酒庄不自己大规模种植，而是在 Bas-Armagnac 的优质庄园选酒，以“单一庄园、单一年份、不调配、不加水、不加焦糖”的 Collection Unique 闻名；在 Roquefort 与 Labastide-d’Armagnac 的酒窖中陈年，常备大量不同庄园与年份的雅文邑。

en.title: Darroze
en.summary: A family Armagnac house in Roquefort, Landes, formally founded in 1974 by Francis Darroze. Rather than owning a large vineyard, Darroze selects spirits from estates across Bas-Armagnac and ages them in its own cellars. Its Collection Unique is single-estate, single-vintage, unblended, unwatered and uncoloured; the house keeps a deep stock of estate and vintage references in Roquefort and Labastide-d’Armagnac.

zh.title: 半月酒厂
zh.summary: 布鲁日市中心的家族酒厂，1856 年由 Maes 家族接手，六代经营至今；参观可上屋顶俯瞰老城，地下 3.3 公里输酒管道与 Brugse Zot、Straffe Hendrik 是核心看点。

en.title: De Halve Maan Brewery
en.summary: A sixth-generation family brewery in central Bruges, taken over by the Maes family in 1856; its tour climbs to a rooftop view, and the story links Brugse Zot and Straffe Hendrik to a 3.3 km underground beer pipeline.

zh.title: 德尔莫尼科餐厅
zh.summary: 纽约金融区 56 Beaver Street 的传奇餐厅，1837 年开出美国早期高级餐厅，1890–91 年建现楼，以 Delmonico Steak 与多道经典菜肴闻名。

en.title: Delmonico's
en.summary: A legendary restaurant at 56 Beaver Street in Lower Manhattan, opened as an early American fine-dining house in 1837, rebuilt on its present site in 1890–91, and known for Delmonico Steak and several classic dishes.

zh.title: Demel
zh.summary: 维也纳 Kohlmarkt 14 号的 Demel，皇家糖果店（K. u. K. Hofzuckerbäckerei）的百年样本。1786 年 Ludwig Dehne 在 Michaelerplatz 开糖果店，1857 年 Christoph Demel 接手，1888 年因城市改造迁到 Kohlmarkt 14，由 Portois & Fix 打造洛可可式室内。今天它以 Sachertorte、Kaiserschmarrn、紫罗兰冰淇淋与全女性服务的“Demelinerinnen”闻名，不接受预订。

en.title: Demel
en.summary: Demel at Kohlmarkt 14 is Vienna’s great surviving royal confectionery. Ludwig Dehne founded the business at Michaelerplatz in 1786; Christoph Demel took over in 1857; the shop moved to Kohlmarkt 14 in 1888, where Portois & Fix created the Rococo interior. Sachertorte, Kaiserschmarrn, violet ice cream, and the all-female Demelinerinnen keep the theatre of the imperial confectionery alive.

zh.title: 金色和平餐厅
zh.summary: 斯德哥尔摩老城 Österlånggatan 51 号的历史餐厅，按传统 1722 年开业，1919 年由画家安德斯·左恩买下并遗赠瑞典学院，以瑞典家常菜与文学记忆闻名。

en.title: Den Gyldene Freden
en.summary: A historic restaurant at Österlånggatan 51 in Stockholm's Old Town, traditionally opened in 1722; the painter Anders Zorn bought it in 1919 and left it to the Swedish Academy, and it is known for Swedish home cooking and literary memory.

zh.title: 福塔莱萨酒厂：把 1873 年的作坊重新点火
zh.summary: 位于墨西哥哈利斯科州特基拉镇塔巴斯科街 153 号的家族龙舌兰酒厂，沿用 1873 年老厂的砖炉、塔霍纳、木发酵槽与两只原装铜壶；2005 年重新上市，参观须预约，可走地下酒窖品鉴。

en.title: Fortaleza: Relighting the 1873 Workshop
en.summary: A family tequila distillery at Calle Tabasco 153 in the town of Tequila, Jalisco, still using the old brick oven, tahona, wooden fermentation vats and two original copper pots; relaunched in 2005 and open by reservation with a tasting in the underground cellars.

zh.title: 罗曼尼康帝酒庄
zh.summary: 位于沃恩-罗曼尼村的勃艮第特级园酒庄，以 1.81 公顷的 Romanée-Conti 与 6.06 公顷的 La Tâche 两块独占园为核心，葡萄园合计约 28.6 公顷、全部为特级园。1942 年成立民事公司，由 de Villaine 与 Leroy/Roch 两家族共管；不设公众参观，产量极低。

en.title: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti
en.summary: A Burgundy grand cru estate in Vosne-Romanée, centred on the 1.81-hectare Romanée-Conti and 6.06-hectare La Tâche monopoles. Its roughly 28.6 hectares are all grand cru, and the civil company formed in 1942 is co-owned by the de Villaine and Leroy/Roch families. There are no public visits and production is tiny.

zh.title: 约瑟夫杜鲁安酒庄
zh.summary: 1880 年由约瑟夫·杜鲁安在博讷创立的家族酒庄与酒商，总部位于 7 Rue d'Enfer，地下酒窖保留罗马 castrum 基础与中世纪遗迹，葡萄园约 100 公顷；提供每日酒窖导览与品鉴，并设有市集门市 Oenothèque。

en.title: Maison Joseph Drouhin
en.summary: A family-owned Burgundy house founded in Beaune by Joseph Drouhin in 1880. Its headquarters at 7 Rue d'Enfer sit above cellars with Roman castrum foundations and medieval remains; the estate farms about 100 hectares and offers daily cellar tours and tastings, with a retail Oenothèque at Place du Général Leclerc.

zh.title: 杜鲁安俄勒冈酒庄
zh.summary: 勃艮第杜鲁安家族于 1987 年在俄勒冈 Dundee Hills 建立的酒庄，把勃艮第的种植与酿造经验带到威拉米特谷；以黑皮诺与霞多丽著称。

en.title: Domaine Drouhin Oregon
en.summary: Founded in 1987 by the Drouhin family of Burgundy in the Dundee Hills of Oregon, bringing Burgundian growing and winemaking experience to the Willamette Valley; known for Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

zh.title: 休埃酒庄
zh.summary: 法国卢瓦尔武弗雷的一座家族酒庄，1928 年由 Victor Huet 与 Gaston Huet 创立，以 30 公顷白诗南、Haut-Lieu、Le Mont 与 Clos du Bourg 三块地及 1988 年起的生物动力法闻名；参观与品鉴需先确认。

en.title: Domaine Huet
en.summary: A family estate in Vouvray, France, founded in 1928 by Victor Huet and Gaston Huet, known for 30 hectares of Chenin Blanc on the Haut-Lieu, Le Mont and Clos du Bourg parcels and for biodynamics since 1988; visits and tastings must be confirmed first.

zh.title: 奥尼奥阿庄园
zh.summary: 朗德省阿尔泰兹达尔马尼亚克的下雅文邑庄园，领地可追溯到 11 世纪末，1905 年后归朗德省所有；约 650 公顷土地、一台连续蒸馏器、成排酒窖与免费品鉴，让它成为产区内少见的公共庄园样本。

en.title: Domaine d'Ognoas
en.summary: A Bas-Armagnac estate at Arthez-d'Armagnac in the Landes, with a seigneurie dating to the late 11th or early 12th century and departmental ownership since 1905. Some 650 hectares, a continuous still, rows of cellars and free tastings make it an unusually public estate for the appellation.

zh.title: 魏恩巴赫酒庄
zh.summary: 法国阿尔萨斯凯泽斯堡的一座家族酒庄，1612 年由嘉布遣会修士建立，位于施洛斯山特级园脚下，以 Clos des Capucins 地块、生物动力法与雷司令、灰皮诺等贵族品种闻名；参观须预约。

en.title: Domaine Weinbach
en.summary: A family estate in Kaysersberg, Alsace, founded on a Capuchin monastery site in 1612 at the foot of the Schlossberg Grand Cru, known for the Clos des Capucins, biodynamic farming and Riesling and Pinot Gris; visits are by appointment.

zh.title: 奥托酒庄
zh.summary: 普罗旺斯桃红的老牌名号，旗下有 Château de Selle、Clos Mireille 与 Château Romassan 三个庄园；可参观的是塔拉多的 Château de Selle，工作日上午开放酒窖与品鉴，导览约 45 分钟且须预约。

en.title: Domaines Ott
en.summary: A long-established Provence rosé house with three estates — Château de Selle, Clos Mireille and Château Romassan. The visitable cellar is Château de Selle in Taradeau, open on weekday mornings with a 45-minute guided tour that must be booked.

zh.title: 卢森博士酒庄
zh.summary: 德国摩泽尔贝恩卡斯特-库斯圣约翰内斯霍夫的一座家族酒庄，以未嫁接老藤、蓝红灰三色板岩与 Großes Gewächs 雷司令为核心；参观与品鉴需先通过官方渠道预约确认。

en.title: Dr. Loosen
en.summary: A family estate at St. Johannishof in Bernkastel-Kues on the German Mosel, built around ungrafted old vines, blue, red and grey slate and Großes Gewächs Riesling; visits and tastings must be confirmed through official channels first.

zh.title: 杜克斯酒吧
zh.summary: 伦敦圣詹姆斯杜克斯酒店内的小型酒店酒吧，官方以 1908 年为其历史起点，以桌边调制的 Dukes 马天尼、冷冻酒杯与“不加冰”做法闻名。

en.title: Dukes Bar
en.summary: A small hotel bar inside Dukes Hotel in St James's, London, dated by the house to 1908 and known for its tableside Dukes Martini, frozen glasses and no-ice serve.

zh.title: 鹰与孩童酒馆
zh.summary: 牛津圣吉尔斯街的历史酒馆，以“Inklings”文学小组（托尔金、C.S.刘易斯等）的聚会地闻名；2020 年起关闭，2025 年获准修复，现址暂无酒馆服务。

en.title: The Eagle and Child
en.summary: A historic pub on St Giles' in Oxford, famous as a meeting place of the Inklings; closed since 2020, with restoration approved in 2025 and no current pub service.

zh.title: 伊贡·米勒酒庄
zh.summary: 德国萨尔河谷维尔廷根沙兹霍夫的一座家族酒庄，自 1797 年起由同一家族经营，以沙兹霍夫山蓝板岩陡坡的雷司令与极高浓度的贵腐甜酒闻名；官方页面只提供联系渠道，参观须先确认。

en.title: Egon Müller
en.summary: A family estate at the Scharzhof in Wiltingen, in Germany's Saar valley, held by the same family since 1797 and known for Riesling from the blue-slate slopes of the Scharzhofberg and for extremely concentrated botrytised sweet wines; the official page offers only contact details, so visits must be confirmed first.

zh.title: 小佛罗里达酒馆
zh.summary: 哈瓦那老城的传奇酒吧，1817 年创立，以海明威、冷冻代基里和海鲜吧闻名；现为两层空间，吧台与餐厅分开，是古巴莫吉托与代基里文化的标志。

en.title: El Floridita
en.summary: A legendary bar in Old Havana, founded in 1817 and known for Hemingway, the frozen daiquiri and its seafood bar.

zh.title: 四猫咖啡馆
zh.summary: 巴塞罗那 Montsió 街 3 号的 Els Quatre Gats，1897 年 6 月 12 日开幕，由 Ramon Casas、Santiago Rusiñol 与 Miquel Utrillo 发起、Manuel Girona 出资、Pere Romeu 主持；店名来自加泰罗尼亚俗语“你们不过是四只猫”，是加泰罗尼亚现代主义与毕加索早期生涯的关键场所。

en.title: Els Quatre Gats
en.summary: Els Quatre Gats at Carrer de Montsió 3 in Barcelona opened on 12 June 1897, founded by Ramon Casas, Santiago Rusiñol and Miquel Utrillo, financed by Manuel Girona and run by Pere Romeu; its name comes from the Catalan saying "you are only four cats", and it became a key site of Catalan Modernisme and Picasso's early career.

zh.title: 雇员专属酒吧
zh.summary: 纽约西村 2004 年开业的 speakeasy 风格鸡尾酒吧，以白制服调酒师、马天尼与曼哈顿、通宵餐食和“Psychic”门面闻名。

en.title: Employees Only
en.summary: A West Village speakeasy-style cocktail bar opened in 2004, known for white-jacketed bartenders, martinis and Manhattans, late-night food and its "Psychic" storefront.

zh.title: 二郎镇（古蔺）
zh.summary: 四川古蔺县二郎镇，赤水河左岸的酱香酒镇，郎酒庄园与郎酒生产厂区所在；它不是一个独立的“古镇景区”，而是酒厂、河谷、场镇与跨省通道叠在一起的生活空间，适合作为川黔酒旅的中转站。

en.title: Erlang Town (Gulin)
en.summary: Erlang Town in Gulin County, Sichuan, is a sauce-aroma liquor town on the left bank of the Chishui River and the home of Langjiu Estate and the Langjiu plant. It is not a stand-alone “old-town attraction” but a living space of factories, valley, market town and cross-province routes, useful as a stop on a Sichuan–Guizhou liquor trip.

zh.title: 艾瑞酒庄
zh.summary: 威拉米特谷的先锋酒庄，1965 年由 David Lett 创立；1970 年代的黑皮诺让俄勒冈进入国际视野，以老藤、有机种植与轻盈风格著称。

en.title: The Eyrie Vineyards
en.summary: A pioneer winery of the Willamette Valley founded by David Lett in 1965; its 1970s Pinot Noir brought Oregon international attention, and it is known for old vines, organic farming and a light style.

zh.title: 费尔西纳庄园
zh.summary: 锡耶纳以东 Castelnuovo Berardenga 的家族酒庄，1966 年由 Poggiali 家族购入；以桑娇维塞克隆、Rancia 与 Fontalloro、凝灰岩酒窖和橄榄油闻名，是经典基安蒂东南边缘的代表性庄园。

en.title: Fattoria Fèlsina
en.summary: A family estate at Castelnuovo Berardenga, east of Siena, bought by the Poggiali family in 1966; known for Sangiovese clones, Rancia and Fontalloro, tufa cellars and olive oil, and a representative estate on the south-eastern edge of Chianti Classico.

zh.title: 汾酒博物馆
zh.summary: 山西汾阳杏花村的酒文化专题博物馆，前身可追溯到 1984 年，2007 年新馆落成；九个展厅展示汾酒 6000 年叙事、历代酒器与清香型白酒工艺。

en.title: Fenjiu Museum
en.summary: A specialist liquor-culture museum in Xinghuacun, Fenyang, Shanxi, with roots in a 1984 exhibition and a new building completed in 2007; nine galleries present Fenjiu's 6000-year narrative, historical drinking vessels and light-aroma production.

zh.title: 丰塔纳弗雷达酒庄
zh.summary: 塞拉伦加达尔巴的巴罗洛名庄，1858 年由意大利首位国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱二世创立；拥有 120 公顷有机葡萄园与“叙述村”，酒窖参观通过 Villaggio Narrante 预约。

en.title: Fontanafredda
en.summary: A Barolo estate in Serralunga d'Alba, founded in 1858 by Vittorio Emanuele II, the first king of Italy, with 120 hectares of certified organic vines and a "storytelling village"; cellar visits are booked through Villaggio Narrante.

zh.title: 四方朗姆酒厂
zh.summary: 位于巴巴多斯圣菲利普教区四路镇的家族酒厂，1996 年在旧糖厂址重启；工作日开放式参访、无需预约，以壶式与双柱式蒸馏和热带陈年著称。

en.title: Foursquare Rum Distillery
en.summary: A family distillery at Four Roads in Saint Philip, Barbados, restarted in 1996 on an old sugar-factory site; weekday open-house visits need no booking and focus on pot and twin-column distillation and tropical ageing.

zh.title: 弗朗西斯酒馆
zh.summary: 纽约曼哈顿珍珠街 1719 年建成的历史建筑，1762 年改为酒馆，1783 年华盛顿在楼上长厅向军官告别；今天是楼下餐厅酒吧、楼上博物馆的复合场所。

en.title: Fraunces Tavern
en.summary: A historic 1719 building on Pearl Street in Lower Manhattan, converted into a tavern in 1762, where Washington bade farewell to his officers in 1783; today it combines a ground-floor restaurant and bar with an upstairs museum.

zh.title: 嘉雅巴巴莱斯科酒庄
zh.summary: 位于巴巴莱斯科村 Via Torino 5 的家族酒庄，官方页面只公布地址、电话与邮箱；对外参观与品鉴政策未公开确认，出发前须以官方渠道联系，不能默认可以随时进入。

en.title: Gaja Barbaresco
en.summary: A family winery at Via Torino 5 in Barbaresco whose official site publishes only an address, telephone and email. Public visiting and tasting arrangements are not confirmed, so ask through official channels instead of assuming the door is open.

zh.title: 月桂冠大仓纪念馆
zh.summary: 京都伏见濠川沿岸的清酒纪念馆，由月桂冠将 1909 年建造的酒窖改建，1982 年开馆，展示伏见酿酒史与酒造用具，并可试饮三款清酒。

en.title: Gekkeikan Okura Sake Museum
en.summary: A sake museum on the canal in Fushimi, Kyoto, housed in a 1909 brewery converted by Gekkeikan and opened in 1982, with brewing tools, company history and a tasting of three sake.

zh.title: 乔治迪克尔酒厂
zh.summary: 田纳西州塔拉霍马附近 Cascade Hollow 的田纳西威士忌酒厂，品牌可追溯至 1870 年 George A. Dickel 的生意、酒厂 1878 年投产；以冷却后糖枫木炭过滤、无“e”的 whisky 拼写与 No. 8、No. 12 等酒款著称。

en.title: George Dickel Distillery
en.summary: A Tennessee whiskey distillery at Cascade Hollow near Tullahoma, Tennessee, with a brand traced to George A. Dickel's business in 1870 and a distillery that began producing in 1878; it is known for chilled sugar-maple charcoal filtration, whisky without the "e", and No. 8 and No. 12.

zh.title: Gerbeaud
zh.summary: 布达佩斯 Vörösmarty tér 7–8 号的 Gerbeaud，1858 年由 Henrik Kugler 在 József nádor 广场开糖果店，1870 年迁到现址，1880 年代由 Émile Gerbeaud 接手并改成今天这个名字。它以 Dobos、Esterházy 与自家甜点闻名，经历 1948 年国有化改名 Vörösmarty、1984 年恢复旧名、1995 年与 2004 年的所有权变化，是布达佩斯“咖啡馆 + 甜点店 + 餐厅”的综合样本。

en.title: Gerbeaud
en.summary: Gerbeaud at Vörösmarty tér 7–8 began in 1858 as Henrik Kugler’s confectionery on József nádor Square, moved to the present site in 1870, and took the Gerbeaud name in the 1880s under Émile Gerbeaud. Dobos, Esterházy, and the house cakes survived the 1948 Vörösmarty rename, the 1984 name restoration, and the ownership changes of 1995 and 2004.

zh.title: 格兰帝酒厂
zh.summary: 坎贝尔镇 High Street 的维多利亚式单一麦芽酒厂，1832 年以 Scotia 之名创立，现属 Loch Lomond Group；以海洋咸感、油脂感与 Double Cask、Victoriana 等酒款著称，提供 1 小时导览与 Dunnage 仓库品鉴。

en.title: Glen Scotia Distillery
en.summary: Victorian single malt distillery at 12 High Street in Campbeltown, founded as Scotia in 1832 and now part of Loch Lomond Group. Known for maritime, oily whisky and expressions such as Double Cask and Victoriana, with a one-hour tour and dunnage warehouse tastings.

zh.title: 格兰菲迪蒸馏厂
zh.summary: 苏格兰达夫镇（Dufftown）的单一麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，1886 年由 William Grant 动工、1887 年圣诞节首次出酒，至今由 Grant 家族独立持有；以三角瓶、鹿标与 12 年、15 年索莱拉等酒款闻名，设有游客中心与多种预约导览。

en.title: Glenfiddich Distillery
en.summary: A single malt distillery in Dufftown, Speyside, built by William Grant in 1886 with its first spirit run on Christmas Day 1887; still family-owned by William Grant & Sons, known for its triangular bottle, stag emblem and the 12- and 15-year-old core range.

zh.title: 格兰威特蒸馏厂
zh.summary: 苏格兰 Ballindalloch 的单一麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，1824 年由 George Smith 取得执照，是 Glenlivet 教区第一家合法酒厂；以梨、苹果、花香与柔和酒体著称，现属 Pernod Ricard 旗下 Chivas Brothers，游客中心于 2021 年翻新重开。

en.title: The Glenlivet Distillery
en.summary: A single malt distillery at Ballindalloch, licensed in 1824 by George Smith as the first legal distillery in the parish of Glenlivet; known for a fruity, floral style, now owned by Pernod Ricard's Chivas Brothers, with a visitor centre reopened in 2021.

zh.title: 格兰杰酒厂
zh.summary: 苏格兰高地泰恩镇的单一麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，1843 年由 William 与 Anne Matheson 创立；以苏格兰最高的壶式蒸馏器、塔尔洛吉泉与轻柔果香风格闻名，游客中心提供预约导览与品鉴。

en.title: Glenmorangie Distillery
en.summary: A single malt distillery in Tain, in the Scottish Highlands, founded in 1843 by William and Anne Matheson; known for Scotland's tallest pot stills, the Tarlogie Springs and a light, fruity house style, with a visitor centre offering bookable tours and tastings.

zh.title: 冈萨雷斯·比亚斯酒庄
zh.summary: 位于赫雷斯-德拉弗龙特拉市中心的雪莉酒庄建筑群，1835 年由曼努埃尔·玛丽亚·冈萨雷斯·安赫尔创立，以 Tío Pepe Fino 的 solera 与 La Concha 贝壳形酒窖闻名；参观须预约，周二至周日接待。

en.title: Bodegas González Byass
en.summary: A Sherry winery complex in central Jerez de la Frontera, founded in 1835 by Manuel María González Ángel and known for the Tío Pepe Fino solera and the shell-shaped La Concha cellar; visits are by reservation, Tuesday to Sunday.

zh.title: 甘布里努斯咖啡馆
zh.summary: 那不勒斯 Via Chiaia 的 Gran Caffè Gambrinus，1860 年开店、1890 年以现名改造开张；自由风格灰泥、镜面与文学沙龙使它成为意大利统一后那不勒斯资产阶级的“城市客厅”。

en.title: Gran Caffè Gambrinus
en.summary: Naples' Gran Caffè Gambrinus, on Via Chiaia, opened in 1860 and was rebuilt under the Gambrinus name in 1890; its Liberty stuccoes, mirrors and literary salons made it the city's drawing room after Italian unification.

zh.title: 绿磨坊爵士酒吧
zh.summary: 芝加哥 Uptown 区的 Green Mill 爵士酒吧，起源于 1890 年代、通常写作 1907 年，1920 年代与 Al Capone 时代相连，1935 年形成今日空间；以七晚爵士、诗歌 slam、现金支付与禁酒令遗迹闻名。

en.title: Green Mill Cocktail Lounge
en.summary: A jazz bar in Chicago's Uptown, Green Mill traces its origins to the 1890s and is usually dated to 1907, is tied to the Al Capone era, took its present room in 1935, and is known for seven-night jazz, poetry slams, cash-only rules and Prohibition-era traces.

zh.title: 健力士仓库：圣詹姆斯门的黑色啤酒叙事
zh.summary: 都柏林圣詹姆斯门的健力士仓库，建在旧发酵车间里，用七层展线、广告档案与顶层 Gravity Bar 讲述健力士世涛；它是访客中心，不是生产车间导览，真正的酒厂仍在同一片厂区运转。

en.title: Guinness Storehouse: Telling the Black Stuff at St. James's Gate
en.summary: Dublin's Guinness Storehouse occupies an old fermentation building and uses seven floors, an advertising archive and the Gravity Bar to tell the story of Guinness stout; it is a visitor centre, not a working-brewery tour.

zh.title: 古井镇（亳州）
zh.summary: 安徽亳州谯城区古井镇，古井贡酒厂区与古井酒文化博览园所在；它把浓香型白酒、古井水系与药都亳州放在一起，适合与亳州老城、药材市场串成皖北酒旅。

en.title: Gujing Town (Bozhou)
en.summary: Gujing Town in Qiao District, Bozhou, Anhui, is home to the Gujing Gongjiu plant and the Gujing Wine Culture Park. It combines strong-aroma baijiu, the Gujing water system and the medicinal capital of Bozhou, and pairs with Bozhou’s old town and herb markets for northern Anhui liquor travel.

zh.title: 古井酒文化博物馆
zh.summary: 位于安徽省亳州市谯城区古井镇古井酒厂对面的酒文化博物馆，1994 年建成、1996 年开放，是古井酒文化博览园的核心场馆；2008 年园区获评国家 4A 级景区。

en.title: Gujing Wine Culture Museum
en.summary: A wine-culture museum opposite the Gujing distillery in Gujing Town, Qiaocheng District, Bozhou, Anhui. Built in 1994 and opened in 1996, it is the core of the Gujing Wine Culture Park, rated a national 4A attraction in 2008.

zh.title: 古越龙山（中央酒库与绍兴酒参观）
zh.summary: 浙江古越龙山绍兴酒股份有限公司总部在绍兴市北海桥，其中央酒库位于越城区钱陶公路一带，是可供参观的大型陈酿酒库。这里看的是陶坛、年份与企业史，不是葡萄园或完整生产线；开放与预约以官方渠道为准。

en.title: Guyuelongshan: the central cellar and a Shaoxing wine visit
en.summary: Zhejiang Guyuelongshan Shaoxing Wine Co. is headquartered at Beihai Bridge in Shaoxing, while its central cellar stands on Qiantao Road in Yuecheng District. The visit is about clay jars, vintage and company history rather than vineyards or a full production line; check official channels for opening and booking.

zh.title: 白鹿酒纪念馆
zh.summary: 兵库县西宫市滩五乡的清酒博物馆，由白鹿酿造元辰马本家酒造于 1982 年创业 320 年时设立，分为 1869 年建造的酒藏馆与纪念馆，展示滩酒工艺与樱研究资料。

en.title: Hakushika Memorial Museum of Sake
en.summary: A sake museum in Nishinomiya, Hyogo, founded by the Hakushika brewer Tatsuuma-Honke in 1982 for its 320th anniversary, combining an 1869 brewery with a memorial building for brewing history and cherry-blossom research.

zh.title: 白州蒸馏所
zh.summary: 三得利 1973 年在山梨县北杜市白州町建成的麦芽威士忌蒸馏所，位于南阿尔卑斯山脚，以森林环境、花岗岩过滤的软水与多形状蒸馏器著称；参观须提前预约，设有免费导览与收费的“ものづくり”团。

en.title: Hakushu Distillery
en.summary: Suntory malt whisky distillery opened in 1973 in Hakushu, Hokuto, Yamanashi, at the foot of the Southern Alps. Known for its forest setting, granite-filtered soft water and varied still shapes; visits require a reservation and include a free tour and a paid Monozukuri tour.

zh.title: 白鹤酒造资料馆
zh.summary: 神户东滩区住吉南町的免费清酒博物馆，1982 年利用白鹤酒造“本店一号藏”开设。酒藏建于大正初期，一直作为本店一号藏运作到 1969 年 3 月，之后按原样改为资料馆。馆内以约 500 件实际使用过的酒造器具、等身大人偶与影像还原蒸米、制曲、木桶仕込等工序；1 楼有巨大的杉木发酵桶、试饮区与商店，2 楼展示冷却装置、曲室与各阶段工具。1995 年阪神淡路大地震中受损，1997 年复原开馆。

en.title: Hakutsuru Sake Brewery Museum
en.summary: Free sake museum in Sumiyoshi-minamimachi, Higashinada-ku, Kobe, opened in 1982 in Hakutsuru’s “Main Brewery No. 1.” Built in the early Taisho era and operated until March 1969, it was converted in its original form. About 500 used tools, life-size figures and a film reconstruct steaming, koji making and wooden-vat brewing; the ground floor has a huge cedar vat, tasting area and shop, while the upper floor shows cooling equipment, the koji room and tools by process. Damaged in the 1995 earthquake, it reopened in 1997.

zh.title: 哈里酒吧（威尼斯）
zh.summary: 威尼斯圣马可广场附近的传奇酒吧，1931 年由朱塞佩·奇普里亚尼创立，以贝里尼和生牛肉薄片闻名。

en.title: Harry's Bar Venice
en.summary: A legendary bar near Piazza San Marco, founded by Giuseppe Cipriani in 1931 and known for the Bellini and carpaccio.

zh.title: 哈利纽约酒吧
zh.summary: 巴黎第二区 rue Daunou 的百年鸡尾酒吧，1911 年由美国骑师 Tod Sloan 开设、Harry MacElhone 接手经营；以 Bloody Mary、Sidecar 等经典鸡尾酒的起源争议、“Sank Roo Doe Noo”招牌语与楼下钢琴闻名。

en.title: Harry's New York Bar
en.summary: A century-old cocktail bar on rue Daunou in Paris, opened in 1911 by the American jockey Tod Sloan and shaped by Harry MacElhone; known for disputed origins of the Bloody Mary and Sidecar, the "Sank Roo Doe Noo" slogan and a downstairs piano.

zh.title: 天堂山酒厂
zh.summary: 美国肯塔基州巴兹敦的波本威士忌蒸馏厂，1935 年由 Shapira 五兄弟与当地投资人创立；1996 年大火后转往路易斯维尔蒸馏，2025 年以 Springs 新厂回到巴兹敦，参观从 Heaven Hill Bourbon Experience 集合出发。

en.title: Heaven Hill Distillery
en.summary: A bourbon distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky, founded in 1935 by the five Shapira brothers and local investors; after a 1996 fire it distilled in Louisville, and in 2025 the new Springs distillery brought production back to Bardstown, with tours starting at the Heaven Hill Bourbon Experience.

zh.title: 喜力体验馆：老啤酒厂的第二次生命
zh.summary: 阿姆斯特丹 Stadhouderskade 78 的喜力体验馆，由喜力最古老的啤酒厂改造；1988 年生产迁出后，这里以互动展陈、历史酿造空间与品鉴讲述喜力拉格，而不是一条仍在运转的生产线。

en.title: Heineken Experience: A Second Life for an Old Brewery
en.summary: Amsterdam's Heineken Experience occupies Heineken's oldest brewery on Stadhouderskade; after production moved out in 1988, the building became an interactive visitor attraction about Heineken lager rather than a working production line.

zh.title: 丽兹海明威酒吧
zh.summary: 巴黎丽兹酒店内的传奇鸡尾酒吧，1994 年以海明威命名重开，25 个座位，以 Serendipity、Dry Martini 与无音乐的书房式氛围闻名。

en.title: Bar Hemingway
en.summary: A legendary cocktail bar inside the Ritz Paris, reopened under Hemingway's name in 1994, with 25 seats, the Serendipity, the Dry Martini and a music-free, library-like atmosphere.

zh.title: 轩尼诗干邑酒庄
zh.summary: 1765 年由爱尔兰人理查·轩尼诗在干邑创立的酒商，如今在夏朗特河畔的理查·轩尼诗码头设游客中心与全球唯一全系列精品店，以八代调配师世家与从 19 欧元到 550 欧元的参观线路著称。

en.title: Hennessy in Cognac
en.summary: A cognac house founded in 1765 by the Irishman Richard Hennessy, now running a visitor centre and the only boutique carrying the full collection on the Quai Richard Hennessy, with eight generations of blenders and tours priced from 19 to 550 euros.

zh.title: 恩里克斯与恩里克斯酒庄
zh.summary: 位于马德拉卡马拉-德洛布什的家族马德拉酒庄，1850 年由若昂·贡萨尔维斯·恩里克斯创立；官方称其拥有自有葡萄园，酒窖提供三年期酒款品鉴，十人以下无需预约即可在工作日到访。

en.title: Henriques & Henriques
en.summary: A family-founded Madeira house in Câmara de Lobos, established in 1850 by João Gonçalves Henriques; it says it is the only Madeira company with its own vineyards, offers a three-year benchmark tasting, and admits parties under 10 without a booking on weekdays.

zh.title: 亨施克酒庄
zh.summary: 位于南澳伊甸谷基内顿的家族酒庄，1868 年出现首笔售酒记录，已传至第六代；以 Hill of Grace 与 Mount Edelstone 两块老藤西拉葡萄园著称，酒窖门市周一到周六 9:00–16:30 开放、周日关闭，因容量限制必须预约。

en.title: Henschke
en.summary: A family winery at Keyneton in South Australia's Eden Valley, with the first recorded wine sale in 1868 and six generations to date; it is known for the old-vine Shiraz sites Hill of Grace and Mount Edelstone, and its cellar door opens Monday to Saturday 9:00–16:30, closed Sunday, with bookings essential because of capacity limits.

zh.title: 皇家啤酒屋
zh.summary: 慕尼黑历史悠久的啤酒馆，1589 年由巴伐利亚公爵创立，以啤酒大厅和巴伐利亚菜闻名。

en.title: Hofbräuhaus
en.summary: Munich's historic beer hall, founded by a Bavarian duke in 1589 and known for its great hall and Bavarian food.

zh.title: 博讷主宫医院
zh.summary: 博讷市中心的 15 世纪慈善医院（Hôtel-Dieu），1443 年由勃艮第公爵府 chancellor 尼古拉·罗林与妻子吉戈娜·德·萨兰创立，1971 年停止收治病人后作为博物馆开放；以彩色琉璃瓦屋顶、罗希尔·范德魏登《最后的审判》祭坛画和每年 11 月的葡萄酒拍卖闻名。

en.title: Hôtel-Dieu des Hospices de Beaune
en.summary: A 15th-century charitable hospital in central Beaune, founded in 1443 by Nicolas Rolin, chancellor to the Duke of Burgundy, and his wife Guigone de Salins. It stopped taking patients in 1971 and now operates as a museum, known for its polychrome glazed-tile roofs, Rogier van der Weyden's Last Judgment polyptych and the annual November wine auction.

zh.title: 雨格酒庄
zh.summary: 法国阿尔萨斯里屈埃维尔的一座家族酒庄，1639 年起在同一小镇经营，以黄标酒单、中世纪酒窖与 1715 年的 S. Caterine 大桶闻名，也是迟摘与贵腐精选法规的推动者；品鉴室按季开放，酒窖参观须预约。

en.title: Hugel
en.summary: A family estate in Riquewihr, Alsace, working in the same town since 1639, known for its yellow-label range, medieval cellars and the 1715 S. Caterine cask, and a driving force behind the Vendanges Tardives and Sélection de Grains Nobles rules; the tasting room is seasonal and cellar tours need booking.

zh.title: In ’t Aepjen
zh.summary: 阿姆斯特丹 Zeedijk 1 号的棕色咖啡馆，所在木构房屋约建于 1550 年，是阿姆斯特丹仅存的少数木构房屋之一；现店面为 1878 年式样，1986–87 年修复后底层才作咖啡馆使用。“1519 年客栈”和“水手用猴子付账”是流传甚广的传说，并非有档案支持的事实。

en.title: In ’t Aepjen
en.summary: A brown café at Zeedijk 1 in Amsterdam, housed in a timber building of about 1550—one of the few surviving wooden houses in the city. The present shopfront dates from 1878, and the ground floor became a café only after the 1986–87 restoration. The “1519 inn” and “sailors paid in monkeys” stories are popular folklore, not documented fact.

zh.title: 英格努克酒庄
zh.summary: 纳帕谷卢瑟福的历史酒庄，1879 年由芬兰裔船长 Gustave Niebaum 创立。1882 年建成石砌城堡，1941 年 John Daniel Jr. 的赤霞珠成为纳帕传奇；1975 年起 Coppola 家族逐步收回产业，1994 年成为纳帕最早获得有机认证的葡萄园之一。以 Rubicon、RC Reserve Syrah 与 Blancaneaux 著称。

en.title: Inglenook
en.summary: A historic Rutherford estate in Napa Valley, founded in 1879 by Finnish sea captain Gustave Niebaum. The stone chateau was built in 1882, and John Daniel Jr.’s 1941 Cabernet became a Napa legend; from 1975 the Coppola family gradually reassembled the property, whose vineyards were among Napa’s first to be certified organic in 1994. It is known for Rubicon, RC Reserve Syrah and Blancaneaux.

zh.title: 杰克丹尼酒厂
zh.summary: 田纳西州林奇堡的田纳西威士忌酒厂，1866 年由 Jack Daniel 注册，以林肯县工序的糖枫木炭过滤与旧 7 号闻名；所在的摩尔县是禁酒县，参观需预约，品鉴限 21 岁以上。

en.title: Jack Daniel's Distillery
en.summary: A Tennessee whiskey distillery in Lynchburg, Tennessee, registered by Jack Daniel in 1866 and known for the Lincoln County Process of sugar-maple charcoal filtration and Old No. 7; Moore County is dry, tours are booked ahead and tastings are 21+.

zh.title: 尊美醇弓街酒厂
zh.summary: 都柏林 Smithfield 的尊美醇旧酒厂，1780 年由 John Jameson 在弓街创立，1970 年最后一次壶式蒸馏后停产，1997 年改为游客中心；今天以导览、对比品鉴与调酒课程讲述爱尔兰威士忌，但已不再生产。

en.title: Jameson Distillery Bow St.
en.summary: The former Jameson distillery in Smithfield, Dublin, founded on Bow Street in 1780 and closed as a distillery after its last pot still run in 1970; it reopened as a visitor centre in 1997 and now teaches Irish whiskey through tours, comparative tastings and cocktail classes.

zh.title: 剑南春酒坊遗址（天益老号）
zh.summary: 绵竹剑南春厂区内的酒坊遗址与“天益老号”古窖作坊，是理解剑南春与传统浓香型白酒工艺的现场；遗址、生产厂区与展陈空间不是同一个入口，参观要按官方预约和现场边界安排。

en.title: Jiannanchun Workshop Site (Tianyi Laohao)
en.summary: The workshop site and Tianyi Laohao ancient pit workshop inside the Jiannanchun campus in Mianzhu are the place to understand Jiannanchun and traditional strong-aroma baijiu. The heritage site, working plant and exhibition space are not one entrance; visits follow official booking and on-site boundaries.

zh.title: 乔丹酒庄
zh.summary: 索诺马县亚历山大谷的法式风格酒庄，1972 年由 Tom 与 Sally Jordan 创立；以赤霞珠、霞多丽与法式城堡、餐厅体验著称。

en.title: Jordan Vineyard & Winery
en.summary: A French-style estate in Alexander Valley, Sonoma County, founded by Tom and Sally Jordan in 1972; known for Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, the château and dining experiences.

zh.title: 神谷酒吧
zh.summary: 东京浅草 1 丁目 1 番地的老牌酒吧，1880 年创业，以“电气布兰”（Denki Bran）闻名，1921 年建成的本馆是日本登录有形文化财。

en.title: Kamiya Bar
en.summary: A historic bar at 1-1-1 Asakusa in Tokyo, founded in 1880 and known for Denki Bran; its 1921 main building is a registered tangible cultural property of Japan.

zh.title: 贺茂泉酒造
zh.summary: 广岛县东广岛市西条上市町的酒藏，参观入口为延寿藏，平日可预约看片、走藏、讲解与试饮；附设的酒泉馆在周末与节假日营业，可一次比较二十种以上的贺茂泉清酒。官网目前公告参观预约暂停，出发前须电话确认。

en.title: Kamoizumi Sake Brewery
en.summary: A brewery at 2-4 Saijo Kamiiichi-machi in Higashihiroshima, Hiroshima Prefecture, entered through the Enju warehouse, where weekday tours cover film, hall, talk and tasting; its Shusenkan cafe opens at weekends with more than twenty Kamoizumi sakes to compare. The official site currently says tour bookings are suspended, so call before travelling.

zh.title: 贺茂鹤酒造
zh.summary: 广岛县东广岛市西条酒藏通的酒藏，参观入口为西条本町 9 番 7 号的“一号藏”藏元直营店；旧藏建于 1872 年，2019 年改为见学室与直营店，2024 年随西条酒藏群列为国史迹，馆内可免费参观、付费试饮并购买藏元限定酒。

en.title: Kamotsuru Sake Brewery
en.summary: A brewery on Sakagura-dori in Saijo, Higashihiroshima, Hiroshima Prefecture, entered through the No. 1 Brewery shop at 9-7 Saijo Honmachi; the warehouse was built in 1872, reopened in 2019 and listed as a national historic site in 2024, with free admission, paid tastings and brewery-only bottles.

zh.title: 基恩斯牛排馆
zh.summary: 纽约 1885 年开业的传统 chophouse，以 26 盎司羊排、大量陶土烟斗与 Herald Square 剧院区记忆闻名，2013 年获詹姆斯·比尔德“美国经典”奖。

en.title: Keens Steakhouse
en.summary: A New York chophouse opened in 1885, known for its 26-ounce mutton chop, thousands of clay pipes and Herald Square theatre memories, and a 2013 James Beard America's Classic award.

zh.title: 菊正宗酒造纪念馆
zh.summary: 神户东滩区鱼崎西町的免费清酒博物馆，由菊正宗酒造开设。旧馆源自 1659 年在御影本嘉纳家宅邸内建造的酒藏，1960 年移筑至现址并对外开放；1995 年阪神淡路大地震中旧馆倒塌，藏品大多抢救出来，1999 年 1 月 25 日以两层、约 1,400 平方米的新馆复活。馆内以“知道酒造的原点”为主题，展示滩酒的工具、酒母、水、米、风土与工艺；另有需预约的樽酒 Meister Factory 与酒杯展示馆。

en.title: Kiku-Masamune Sake Brewery Museum
en.summary: Free sake museum in Uozaki-nishimachi, Higashinada-ku, Kobe, run by Kiku-Masamune. Its predecessor was a brewery built in 1659 inside the Hon-Kano residence in Mikage, moved here and opened in 1960. The old museum collapsed in the 1995 Great Hanshin-Awaji earthquake; the collection was largely recovered, and a two-storey, earthquake-resistant building of about 1,400 square metres reopened on 25 January 1999. It explains sake brewing from Nada tools, yeast, water, rice and craft; the Taru Sake Meister Factory needs a separate reservation.

zh.title: 基尔伯根酒厂
zh.summary: 爱尔兰 Westmeath 郡基尔伯根镇的老酒厂，1757 年取得执照，官方称为爱尔兰历史最悠久的持照酒厂；1957 年停产后由社区推动修复，2007 年恢复蒸馏，现以 Kilbeggan 调和、单一壶式与小型批次黑麦威士忌闻名。

en.title: Kilbeggan Distillery
en.summary: Old distillery in the town of Kilbeggan, County Westmeath, licensed in 1757 and described by its owner as Ireland's oldest licensed distillery. Production stopped in 1957, the town helped restore the site, and distillation resumed in 2007; the range includes Kilbeggan blend, single pot still and small batch rye.

zh.title: 雾岛酒造雾岛工厂花园
zh.summary: 宫崎县都城市志比田町 5480 番地的烧酒观光设施，正式名称为“烧酎之里 雾岛工厂花园”；KIRISHIMA WALK FACTORY 每日五个时段、约 45 分钟，可看制曲、蒸芋、发酵与蒸馏，并提供免费试饮与甘薯试吃。

en.title: Kirishima Factory Garden
en.summary: A shochu visitor site at 5480 Shibitacho, Miyakonojo, Miyazaki Prefecture, officially Shochu-no-Sato Kirishima Factory Garden; KIRISHIMA WALK FACTORY runs five sessions a day of about 45 minutes through koji, steaming, fermentation and distillation, with free tastings and sweet-potato samples.

zh.title: 库克香槟
zh.summary: 兰斯的香槟酒庄，1843 年由 Joseph Krug 创立，以跨越多个年份的 Krug Grande Cuvée 为核心。Clos du Mesnil 1.84 公顷、Clos d’Ambonnay 0.68 公顷，均为单地块单一年份；现属 LVMH，2024 年在 Ambonnay 启用 Joseph 酒厂。

en.title: Krug
en.summary: A Champagne house in Reims founded in 1843 by Joseph Krug, centred on the multi-vintage Krug Grande Cuvée. Clos du Mesnil is 1.84 hectares and Clos d’Ambonnay 0.68 hectares, both single-plot, single-year champagnes; the house is part of LVMH and opened the Joseph winery in Ambonnay in 2024.

zh.title: 会稽山（黄酒文化园与厂区参观）
zh.summary: 会稽山绍兴酒股份有限公司位于绍兴市柯桥区湖塘街道杨绍路 2579 号，鉴湖河畔。园区把黄酒博物馆、厂区参观与体验中心放在一起，可看到绍兴酒的工艺叙事与部分生产空间；需通过“会稽山黄酒博物馆”公众号预约。

en.title: Kuaijishan: yellow-wine park and brewery visit
en.summary: Kuaijishan Shaoxing Rice Wine Co. is based at 2579 Yangshao Road in Hutang Subdistrict, Keqiao District, beside Jian Lake. Its park combines a yellow-wine museum, a guided factory visit and a tasting centre; book through the Kuaijishan Yellow Wine Museum WeChat account.

zh.title: 半途小酒馆
zh.summary: 哈瓦那老城的著名小酒馆，1942 年开业，以莫吉托和文人顾客的墙面签名闻名；店面狭小、常年拥挤，是游客体验哈瓦那夜生活的地标之一。

en.title: La Bodeguita del Medio
en.summary: A famous bar in Old Havana, opened in 1942 and known for mojitos and the signatures of writers on its walls.

zh.title: 丁香园咖啡馆
zh.summary: 巴黎蒙帕纳斯大道 171 号的 La Closerie des Lilas，1847 年已作为舞厅与客栈出现、1883 年以现名经营；保罗·福尔的周二沙龙、海明威 1925 年的写作与 1922 年达达/超现实主义的争吵，使它成为左岸文学史的一处坐标。

en.title: La Closerie des Lilas
en.summary: At 171 Boulevard du Montparnasse, La Closerie des Lilas was already a dance-hall and inn site in 1847 and took its present name in 1883; Paul Fort's Tuesday salons, Hemingway's 1925 writing and the 1922 Dada quarrel made it a coordinate of Left Bank literary history.

zh.title: 圆顶咖啡馆
zh.summary: 蒙帕纳斯大道 102 号的 La Coupole，1927 年 12 月开业，开业夜备下的 1,500 瓶酒当晚售罄；32 根由 27 位艺术家绘制的柱子、1928 年的地下舞厅与 1988 年的历史建筑认定，使它成为蒙帕纳斯“疯狂年代”的活标本。

en.title: La Coupole
en.summary: La Coupole on Boulevard du Montparnasse opened in December 1927 with 1,500 bottles of wine that sold out on the first night; its 32 columns painted by 27 artists, 1928 basement dance hall and 1988 historic-monument listing make it a living relic of Montparnasse's crazy years.

zh.title: 里奥哈阿尔塔酒庄
zh.summary: 西班牙里奥哈阿罗（Haro）火车站区的历史酒庄，1890 年由五个里奥哈与巴斯克家族共同创立；以美国橡木桶、长时间陈酿与 Viña Ardanza、Gran Reserva 904、890 等酒款闻名，参观须提前预约。

en.title: La Rioja Alta, S.A.
en.summary: A historic winery in Haro's Barrio de la Estación, founded in 1890 by five Riojan and Basque families; known for American-oak ageing, long maturation and wines such as Viña Ardanza, Gran Reserva 904 and Gran Reserva 890, with visits by appointment.

zh.title: 乐加维林蒸馏厂
zh.summary: 苏格兰艾雷岛南岸、Port Ellen 以东的单一麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，1816 年由 John Johnston 创立，以重泥煤、梨形蒸馏器与 16 年单一麦芽闻名，设有导览与 Warehouse No.3 品鉴。

en.title: Lagavulin Distillery
en.summary: Single malt distillery on the south coast of Islay, founded in 1816 by John Johnston. Heavily peated whisky, pear-shaped stills and a 16-year-old core expression; visits include guided tours and Warehouse No.3 tastings.

zh.title: 兰姆与旗
zh.summary: 伦敦科文特花园玫瑰街的历史酒馆，1772 年首次见于记载，19 世纪以赤手拳赛得名“血桶”，也是狄更斯与德莱顿故事的交汇点。

en.title: The Lamb & Flag
en.summary: A historic pub on Rose Street in Covent Garden, first recorded as a tavern in 1772, nicknamed the "Bucket of Blood" for 19th-century bare-knuckle boxing, and linked to Dickens and the Dryden attack.

zh.title: 郎酒庄园（二郎镇）
zh.summary: 古蔺二郎镇赤水河左岸的郎酒庄园，把酱香型白酒的酿造、洞藏、品鉴与住宿放在一片山谷里；庄园、生产厂区与天宝洞等地藏空间不是同一个自由入口，参观、品鉴与住宿要分别预约。

en.title: Langjiu Estate (Erlang Town)
en.summary: Langjiu Estate on the left bank of the Chishui River in Erlang, Gulin, combines sauce-aroma baijiu production, cave storage, tasting and lodging in one valley. The estate, working plant and cave-storage sites such as Tianbao Cave are not one free entrance; visits, tastings and lodging are booked separately.

zh.title: 拉弗格蒸馏厂
zh.summary: 苏格兰艾雷岛南岸的泥煤味单一麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，1815 年由约翰斯顿兄弟创立，厂区紧邻基尔布赖德溪与海，设有游客中心与多种预约制参观。

en.title: Laphroaig Distillery
en.summary: A heavily peated single malt distillery on the south coast of Islay, founded in 1815 by the Johnston brothers, with its visitor centre, floor maltings and dunnage warehouse beside the Kilbride stream and the sea.

zh.title: 露纹酒庄
zh.summary: 玛格丽特河的家族酒庄，1969 年购入农场、1973 年正式建庄；以 Art Series 霞多丽与赤霞珠、以及 1985 年起的露纹音乐会著称。

en.title: Leeuwin Estate
en.summary: A family winery in Margaret River; the Horgans bought the farm in 1969 and established the estate in 1973, known for Art Series Chardonnay and Cabernet and the Leeuwin Concert, held since 1985.

zh.title: 双叟咖啡馆
zh.summary: 巴黎圣日耳曼德佩的文学咖啡馆，1885 年开业，曾与海明威、萨特和波伏娃等名字联系在一起。

en.title: Les Deux Magots
en.summary: A literary café in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Paris, opened in 1885 and associated with Hemingway, Sartre and Beauvoir.

zh.title: 洛卡尔·德洛哈啤酒馆
zh.summary: 布拉格老城 Dlouhá 街的捷克啤酒馆，2009 年开业，以 12 个啤酒罐、69.78 米酒管、Pilsner Urquell 与 Kozel 深色拉格及捷克家常菜闻名。

en.title: Lokál Dlouhááá
en.summary: A Czech pub on Dlouhá street in Prague's Old Town, opened in 2009 and known for its 12 beer tanks, 69.78 metres of beer line, Pilsner Urquell, Kozel dark lager and Czech home cooking.

zh.title: 路易亚都酒庄
zh.summary: 博讷的勃艮第酒商与酒庄，1859 年由 Louis Henry Denis Jadot 创立。自有葡萄园约 528 英亩（214 公顷），其中约 280 英亩为金丘的一级园与特级园；1996 年自建制桶厂，2024 年起酒庄葡萄园获有机认证。

en.title: Maison Louis Jadot
en.summary: A Burgundy négociant and estate in Beaune, founded in 1859 by Louis Henry Denis Jadot. It owns about 528 acres (214 hectares) of vines, including some 280 acres of Premier and Grand Cru plots in the Côte d’Or; it built its own cooperage in 1996 and its estate vineyards became organic certified from the 2024 vintage.

zh.title: 泸州老窖窖池群
zh.summary: 四川泸州国窖广场的活态酿酒遗产，1573 年始建的国宝窖池连续使用 450 余年；连同 1619 口百年以上窖池、16 处明清作坊与三大天然藏酒洞，构成全国重点文物保护单位。

en.title: Luzhou Laojiao Cellars
en.summary: A living brewing heritage site at Guojiao Square in Luzhou, Sichuan; the 1573 National Treasure Cellar group has been in continuous use for more than 450 years, alongside 1619 century-old pits, 16 Ming and Qing workshops and three natural storage caves.

zh.title: 泸州老窖博物馆（国窖广场）
zh.summary: 泸州国窖广场一带集中展示泸州老窖的窖池遗产、浓香型白酒工艺与酒城记忆；它与 1573 国宝窖池群、明清酿酒作坊共同构成参访线路，展馆与生产区、品鉴区要分开安排。

en.title: Luzhou Laojiao Museum (Guojiao Square)
en.summary: The Guojiao Square area in Luzhou presents Luzhou Laojiao’s pit heritage, strong-aroma baijiu craft and the memory of a liquor city. It forms a visiting route with the 1573 national treasure pits and Ming–Qing workshops; museum, production areas and tasting need separate planning.

zh.title: 美格酒厂
zh.summary: 美国肯塔基州洛雷托的波本威士忌蒸馏厂，1952 年由 Bill Samuels Sr. 在 Star Hill Farm 创办，以红冬小麦替代黑麦、手工转桶与红蜡封瓶闻名；1980 年列为国家历史地标，参观需在官网预约。

en.title: Maker's Mark Distillery
en.summary: A bourbon distillery in Loretto, Kentucky, founded in 1952 by Bill Samuels Sr. at Star Hill Farm and known for replacing rye with soft red winter wheat, hand-rotated barrels and hand-dipped red wax; a National Historic Landmark since 1980, with tours booked online.

zh.title: 茅台酒厂（贵州茅台）
zh.summary: 贵州仁怀茅台镇赤水河畔的酱香型白酒核心生产企业，前身为成义、荣和、恒兴三大烧房，1950 年代初整合为国营酒厂；核心产区 15.03 平方公里，以端午制曲、重阳下沙与长期陈贮闻名。

en.title: Maotai Distillery (Kweichow Moutai)
en.summary: The core sauce-aroma baijiu producer at Maotai Town, Renhuai, Guizhou, on the Chishui River; its predecessor was the integration of the Chengyi, Ronghe and Hengxing distilleries in the early 1950s, and its core production area covers 15.03 square kilometres.

zh.title: 瑞格尔侯爵酒庄
zh.summary: 里奥哈阿拉维萨 Elciego 的历史酒庄，1858 年由 Guillermo Hurtado de Amézaga 创立，1862 年推出首批瓶装里奥哈酒。2006 年 Frank Gehry 设计的酒店落成，2024 年获“世界最佳葡萄园”第一；酒庄以 Reserva、Gran Reserva 与 Barón de Chirel 著称。

en.title: Marqués de Riscal
en.summary: A historic Rioja Alavesa estate in Elciego, founded in 1858 by Guillermo Hurtado de Amézaga and among the first to bottle Rioja, in 1862. Frank Gehry’s hotel opened in 2006 and the City of Wine was named World’s Best Vineyard in 2024; the range includes Reserva, Gran Reserva and Barón de Chirel.

zh.title: 麦克索利老麦酒馆
zh.summary: 纽约东村的历史酒馆，1854 年开业，以只供应淡色和深色艾尔、历史陈设闻名；没有酒单、只收现金的传统保留至今，是纽约最老的连续经营酒馆之一。

en.title: McSorley’s Old Ale House
en.summary: A historic East Village tavern in New York City, opened in 1854 and known for serving only light and dark ale.

zh.title: 美人鱼客栈
zh.summary: 英国东萨塞克斯拉伊美人鱼街上的历史客栈，地窖可追溯至 1156 年，1377 年遭法国劫掠者焚毁后于 1420 年重建，18 世纪曾与霍克赫斯特走私团伙有关联。

en.title: The Mermaid Inn
en.summary: A historic inn on Mermaid Street in Rye, East Sussex, with cellars dating from 1156 and a building rebuilt in 1420; it was linked to the Hawkhurst smuggling gang in the 18th century.

zh.title: 梅斯卡尔图书馆：瓦哈卡市中心的一间品鉴档案室
zh.summary: 2010 年在瓦哈卡市 Reforma 街 506 号开门的品鉴室，不生产酒，而是以跨州、跨品种、跨生产者的收藏组织对比品鉴；以预约制为主，是理解传统梅斯卡尔与 NOM-070 关系的城市入口。

en.title: Mezcaloteca: A Tasting Archive in Central Oaxaca
en.summary: A tasting room opened in 2010 at Reforma 506 in Oaxaca de Juárez; it makes no spirit, curating a cross-state, cross-variety collection for comparative tastings and serving as an urban entry point to traditional mezcal and NOM-070.

zh.title: 绵竹年画村（孝德镇）
zh.summary: 绵竹孝德镇的绵竹年画村，以绵竹木版年画的作坊、展陈与体验为核心；它不是一条全是商铺的古镇街，而是“年画生产—展示—体验—销售”叠在一起的乡村文化空间，适合与剑南春酒坊遗址串成绵竹一日。

en.title: Mianzhu New Year Picture Village (Xiaode)
en.summary: Mianzhu New Year Picture Village in Xiaode is centred on workshops, displays and hands-on experiences for Mianzhu woodblock New Year pictures. It is not an old street of shops but a rural cultural space where production, exhibition, experience and sales overlap, and pairs well with the Jiannanchun workshop site for a Mianzhu day.

zh.title: 酩悦香槟
zh.summary: 1743 年由克洛德·酩悦在埃佩尔奈创立的香槟酒庄，位于香槟大道，拥有约 28 公里白垩酒窖，是联合国教科文组织世界遗产的一部分；提供预约制酒窖参观、品鉴与酒吧体验。

en.title: Moët & Chandon
en.summary: A Champagne house founded in Épernay by Claude Moët in 1743, on the Avenue de Champagne. Its network of about 28 kilometres of chalk cellars forms part of a UNESCO World Heritage site; cellar tours, tastings and a bar are available, with visits by reservation.

zh.title: 波布莱修道院
zh.summary: 西班牙加泰罗尼亚 Vimbodí i Poblet 的熙笃会皇家修道院，1151 年由巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世创建，1991 年列入世界遗产；院内的 Abadia de Poblet 是加泰罗尼亚唯一位于修道院内的酒庄。

en.title: Monastery of Poblet
en.summary: Cistercian royal monastery in Vimbodí i Poblet, Catalonia, founded in 1151 by Ramon Berenguer IV and listed by UNESCO in 1991. Abadia de Poblet, inside the complex, is the only winery in Catalonia located within a monastery.

zh.title: 芒特盖酒厂
zh.summary: 位于巴巴多斯圣露西教区北端的原址蒸馏厂，品牌以 1703 年为起点；厂区参观需预约，动线包括大宅、老井、发酵房、蒸馏室与陈年仓库，仅限 18 岁以上。

en.title: Mount Gay Distillery
en.summary: The original distillery in Saint Lucy, northern Barbados, with a brand history dated to 1703; visits are by reservation and cover the great house, old well, fermentation house, still house and ageing bonds, for guests aged 18 and over.

zh.title: 姆加酒庄
zh.summary: 哈罗（Haro）车站区的家族酒庄，1932 年由 Isaac Muga 与 Aurora Caño 创立。酒庄保留 200 年历史的老宅、橡木大槽与自建制桶车间，坚持蛋清澄清、重力倒罐与长期橡木陈年；以 Reserva、Prado Enea、Torre Muga 与 Aro 著称。

en.title: Bodegas Muga
en.summary: A family winery in Haro’s station district, founded in 1932 by Isaac Muga and Aurora Caño. It keeps a 200-year-old house, large oak vats and its own cooperage, and works with egg-white fining, gravity racking and long oak ageing; its wines include Reserva, Prado Enea, Torre Muga and Aro.

zh.title: 哈瓦那朗姆酒博物馆
zh.summary: 位于哈瓦那老城港口大道 262 号的 18 世纪宅邸，2000 年 3 月 31 日开馆；以甘蔗到装瓶的展线、Havana Club 品鉴与酒吧商店构成哈瓦那朗姆入门。

en.title: Museo del Ron Havana Club
en.summary: A museum in an 18th-century mansion at 262 Avenida del Puerto, Old Havana, opened on 31 March 2000; its cane-to-bottle route, Havana Club tastings, bar and shop make it Havana's clearest introduction to Cuban rum.

zh.title: 圣地亚哥朗姆酒博物馆
zh.summary: 位于圣地亚哥-德古巴圣巴西利奥街 358 号 1889 年宅邸的朗姆博物馆，1996 年 6 月 24 日开馆；六个展厅、老装瓶线与酒馆品鉴，讲述东部“轻朗姆摇篮”的历史。

en.title: Museo del Ron Santiago de Cuba
en.summary: A rum museum in an 1889 mansion at 358 San Basilio Street, Santiago de Cuba, opened on 24 June 1996; six rooms, an old bottling line and a tavern tell the story of the eastern "cradle of light rum".

zh.title: 穆索与弗兰克烤肉馆
zh.summary: 好莱坞大道上的 Musso & Frank Grill，1919 年以 Frank's Café 开业，1920 年代改名，1930 年代形成今日空间；红色制服侍者、干马天尼、法兰绒蛋糕与好莱坞作家常客构成它的传奇。

en.title: Musso & Frank Grill
en.summary: A Hollywood Boulevard restaurant and bar open since 1919, Musso & Frank Grill is known for its old-school waiters, back-room literary and film history, and a menu that has changed only carefully; it remains a working restaurant rather than a film set.

zh.title: 拿破仑屋
zh.summary: 新奥尔良法国区 500 Chartres Street 的历史建筑与酒吧，1797 年建成，因 1821 年邀拿破仑避难的传说得名，1914 年起由 Impastato 家族经营。

en.title: Napoleon House
en.summary: A historic building and bar at 500 Chartres Street in the French Quarter, built in 1797, named for the 1821 plan to give Napoleon refuge, and run by the Impastato family from 1914.

zh.title: New York Café
zh.summary: 布达佩斯 Erzsébet körút 9–11 号的 New York Café，1894 年随 New York Palace 开业。它用镀金穹顶、壁画、大理石柱与吊灯，把“世界最美咖啡馆”变成布达佩斯的城市名片；开业时把钥匙扔进多瑙河的传说、Nyugat 作家群的固定桌、战后改名 Hungária 与 2006 年修复，则构成它比装潢更复杂的历史。

en.title: New York Café
en.summary: New York Café at Erzsébet körút 9–11 opened with the New York Palace in 1894. Its gilded ceiling, frescoes, marble columns, and chandeliers turned it into Budapest’s “most beautiful café”; the legend of the key thrown into the Danube, the Nyugat writers’ tables, the postwar Hungária years, and the 2006 restoration make its history more complicated than its décor.

zh.title: 老苦艾酒屋
zh.summary: 新奥尔良 Bourbon 与 Bienville 街角的历史酒吧，建筑完成于 1806 年，1835 年取得酒牌，1874 年 Cayetano Ferrer 在此创作 Absinthe House Frappé。

en.title: The Old Absinthe House
en.summary: A historic bar at the corner of Bourbon and Bienville in New Orleans, in a building completed in 1806, licensed in 1835, and associated with Cayetano Ferrer's 1874 Absinthe House Frappé.

zh.title: 作品一号酒庄
zh.summary: 纳帕谷奥克维尔的预约制酒庄，1979 年由罗伯特·蒙大维与菲利普·德·罗斯柴尔德男爵共同创立，只酿一款波尔多式混酿，1991 年启用现酒庄建筑。

en.title: Opus One Winery
en.summary: An appointment-only Oakville winery founded in 1979 by Robert Mondavi and Baron Philippe de Rothschild, producing a single Bordeaux-style blend and housed in a winery completed in 1991.

zh.title: 奔富玛吉尔庄园
zh.summary: 奔富在阿德莱德山麓的起点，1844 年建园，距市中心约 8 公里，是少见的城市单一葡萄园；门市每周七天 10:00–17:00 开放，提供酒窖参观、品鉴与餐厅体验，Grange 与 Bin 系列的试验传统在此有清晰的历史线索。

en.title: Penfolds Magill Estate
en.summary: Penfolds' founding site in the Adelaide foothills, established in 1844 about 8 km from the city centre and one of the world's few urban single vineyards; the cellar door opens seven days 10:00–17:00 with cellar tours, tastings and restaurant experiences, and the Grange and Bin experimental tradition is clearly traced here.

zh.title: 巴黎之花
zh.summary: 1811 年由皮埃尔—尼古拉·佩里耶与罗丝—阿德莱德·茹埃在埃佩尔奈创立的香槟酒庄，以霞多丽与 1902 年埃米尔·加莱设计的银莲花瓶闻名；访客可在香槟大道的 Cellier Belle Epoque 与 Maison Belle Epoque 体验。

en.title: Perrier-Jouët
en.summary: A Champagne house founded in Épernay in 1811 by Pierre-Nicolas Perrier and Rose-Adélaïde Jouët, known for its Chardonnay-led style and the anemone bottle designed by Émile Gallé in 1902. Visitors can experience the house at Cellier Belle Epoque and Maison Belle Epoque on the Avenue de Champagne.

zh.title: 皮特酒馆
zh.summary: 纽约格拉梅西公园旁的历史酒馆与餐厅，1864 年在 1851 年建成的 Portman Hotel 底层开业，以 1864 House Ale、原始玫瑰木吧台与 O. Henry 写作传说闻名。

en.title: Pete's Tavern
en.summary: A historic tavern and restaurant beside Gramercy Park in New York, opened in 1864 on the ground floor of an 1851 building and known for its 1864 House Ale, original rosewood bar and O. Henry lore.

zh.title: 比尔森啤酒厂：金色拉格的诞生地
zh.summary: 捷克 Plzeň 的比尔森啤酒厂自 1842 年由 Josef Groll 酿出第一锅金色拉格，至今坚持三重煮出糖化、软水与萨兹酒花；参观可进入历史糖化车间与酒窖，喝到未过滤原浆。

en.title: Pilsner Urquell Brewery: Where the Golden Lager Was Born
en.summary: The Pilsner Urquell brewery in Plzeň has brewed the first golden lager in 1842 under Josef Groll and still uses triple decoction, soft water and Saaz hops; tours enter the historic brewhouse and cellars and end with unfiltered beer.

zh.title: Prater Garten
zh.summary: 柏林普伦茨劳贝格 Kastanienallee 7–9 号的 Prater Garten，是柏林最老的啤酒花园之一。官方把起点定在 1837 年，遗产研究则说它“约 1830 年”成形；1852 年 Kalbo 家族把它扩成娱乐场所，1856/1857 年建起带舞厅的餐厅建筑，1867 年以维也纳 Prater 命名。今天栗树下的长桌、自取啤酒与餐厅的柏林菜，仍是东柏林老工人区最松弛的公共客厅。

en.title: Prater Garten
en.summary: Prater Garten at Kastanienallee 7–9 in Prenzlauer Berg is one of Berlin’s oldest beer gardens. Its official starting date is 1837, while heritage research says it took shape “around 1830”; the Kalbo family expanded it in 1852, the ballroom building followed in 1856/1857, and the name Prater was adopted in 1867 after Vienna’s Prater. Chestnut trees, long tables, self-service beer, and Berlin food still make it the neighbourhood’s most relaxed public living room.

zh.title: 克拉斯托酒庄
zh.summary: 位于葡萄牙杜罗河谷萨布罗萨（Sabrosa）Gouvinhas 的家族酒庄，文献可追溯到 1615 年，1918 年起归 Constantino de Almeida 家族，1981 年由 Leonor 与 Jorge Roquette 接手；以杜罗 DOC 葡萄酒、波特酒与酒庄午餐闻名。

en.title: Quinta do Crasto
en.summary: A family-owned Douro estate at Gouvinhas, Sabrosa, recorded as early as 1615 and owned by the Constantino de Almeida family from 1918. Leonor and Jorge Roquette took over in 1981; today it makes Douro DOC wines, Port and olive oil and runs a substantial wine-tourism programme.

zh.title: 诺瓦尔酒庄
zh.summary: 位于葡萄牙杜罗河谷皮尼昂附近 Vale de Mendiz 的历史波特酒庄，1715 年见于土地登记，1894 年由安东尼奥·若泽·达·席尔瓦接手重建，以未嫁接老藤地块 Nacional 与石 lagar 足踩酿造闻名；参观须预约。

en.title: Quinta do Noval
en.summary: A historic Port estate at Vale de Mendiz near Pinhão in Portugal's Douro Valley, recorded in land registers in 1715, rebuilt from 1894 by António José da Silva and known for the ungrafted Nacional plot and foot treading in stone lagares; visits are by reservation.

zh.title: 莱佛士长廊酒吧
zh.summary: 新加坡莱佛士酒店 Raffles Arcade 二层的传奇酒吧，1915 年在此首创新加坡司令，以花生壳落地的传统与 1920 年代马来亚种植园风格的空间闻名。

en.title: Raffles Long Bar
en.summary: The storied bar on the second floor of Raffles Arcade in Singapore, where the Singapore Sling was first mixed in 1915, known for its peanut-shell tradition and 1920s Malayan plantation-inspired interior.

zh.title: 雷亚尔米内罗帕伦克：圣卡塔里娜米纳斯的陶罐与种子
zh.summary: 位于墨西哥瓦哈卡州圣卡塔里娜米纳斯的家族 palenque，以土坑烘烤、木槌手捣与陶罐二次蒸馏著称；1978 年购入 La Concepción 老厂，2005 年后以 Mezcal Joven 装瓶，参观须预约且仅西语讲解。

en.title: Real Minero: Clay Pots and Seeds in Santa Catarina Minas
en.summary: A family palenque in Santa Catarina Minas, Oaxaca, known for earthen-pit roasting, hand crushing with a wooden mallet and double distillation in clay pots; it bought the old La Concepción site in 1978, bottles as Mezcal Joven after 2005, and visits are by reservation in Spanish only.

zh.title: 人头马干邑酒庄
zh.summary: 1724 年由同名葡萄农创立的干邑酒商，只使用大香槟与小香槟区的生命之水，参观分散在干邑老宅、梅尔潘生产基地与瑞亚克勒科克蒸馏厂三处，价格从 25 欧元起。

en.title: Rémy Martin in Cognac
en.summary: A cognac house founded in 1724 that works only with Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne eaux-de-vie, spreading its visits across the historic house in Cognac, the Merpins site and the Juillac-le-Coq distillery, with tours from 25 euros.

zh.title: 罗伯特·蒙大维酒庄
zh.summary: 纳帕谷奥克维尔的标志性酒庄，1966 年由罗伯特·蒙大维创立，以 To Kalon 葡萄园与传教站风格建筑闻名，2026 年完成三年改造后重新开放。

en.title: Robert Mondavi Winery
en.summary: The landmark Oakville winery founded by Robert Mondavi in 1966, known for its To Kalon Vineyard and Cliff May mission-style buildings, reopened in 2026 after a three-year transformation.

zh.title: 萨摩酒造明治藏
zh.summary: 鹿儿岛县枕崎市立神本町的烧酒藏，正式名称为花渡川蒸馏所明治藏；保留明治以来的藏屋与甕仕込，可免费参观制曲、发酵与蒸馏流程，馆内销售 25 度的白波与黑白波及 37 度原酒。

en.title: Satsuma Shochu Meijigura
en.summary: A shochu brewery at 26 Tategamihonmachi, Makurazaki, Kagoshima Prefecture, officially the Hanatogawa Distillery Meijigura; it keeps Meiji-era buildings and jar fermentation, offers free visits through koji, fermentation and distillation, and sells 25-degree Shirohaku and Kurohaku plus a 37-degree genshu.

zh.title: 施伦克拉烟熏啤酒馆
zh.summary: 德国班贝格的历史烟熏啤酒酒馆，以 Rauchbier 和传统法兰肯菜闻名；酒馆建筑可追溯到 17 世纪，自酿烟熏啤酒是班贝格城市味觉的代表。

en.title: Schlenkerla
en.summary: A historic smoked-beer tavern in Bamberg, known for Rauchbier and traditional Franconian food.

zh.title: 苏格兰威士忌体验中心
zh.summary: 爱丁堡城堡旁、皇家一英里顶端的威士忌主题展馆，1988 年由 19 家苏格兰威士忌公司合资设立；以互动展陈、多语种导览与 Diageo Claive Vidiz 藏酒闻名，本身不是生产型酒厂。

en.title: The Scotch Whisky Experience
en.summary: A whisky exhibition at the top of Edinburgh's Royal Mile beside the castle, set up in 1988 by 19 Scotch whisky companies; it uses interactive displays, multilingual tours and the Diageo Claive Vidiz collection to explain Scotch, and is not a working distillery.

zh.title: 双沟酒业（双沟镇）
zh.summary: 江苏泗洪县双沟镇的双沟酒业厂区，位于淮河与洪泽湖之间的湿地水乡；它把浓香型白酒的酿造、老窖与酒镇生活放在一起，适合与洋河、泗洪湿地串成苏北酒旅。

en.title: Shuanggou Distillery (Shuanggou Town)
en.summary: The Shuanggou distillery in Shuanggou Town, Sihong County, Jiangsu, sits in the wetland water country between the Huai River and Hongze Lake. It combines strong-aroma brewing, old pits and liquor-town life, and pairs with Yanghe and Sihong wetlands for northern Jiangsu liquor travel.

zh.title: 水井坊博物馆
zh.summary: 成都锦江区水井街的考古遗址博物馆，原址保存元末明初以来的水井街酒坊遗址；1999 年全国十大考古新发现，2001 年列为全国重点文物保护单位。

en.title: Shuijingfang Museum
en.summary: An archaeological site museum on Shuijing Street in Chengdu, preserving the Shuijing Street distillery site from the late Yuan and early Ming; it was one of China's top ten archaeological discoveries of 1999 and a national key cultural relic from 2001.

zh.title: 西班牙人客栈
zh.summary: 伦敦 Hampstead Heath 北缘的 1585 年历史客栈，曾为收费关卡与驿馆，以狄更斯、济慈、Turpin 传说和大型围墙花园闻名。

en.title: The Spaniards Inn
en.summary: A 1585 inn on the northern edge of Hampstead Heath, once a tollgate and coaching stop, known for Dickens, Keats, the Turpin legend and a large walled garden.

zh.title: Speak Low 酒吧
zh.summary: 上海前法租界复兴中路的隐藏式鸡尾酒吧，2014 年由后闲信吾（Shingo Gokan）创立，入口藏在 OCHO 酒吧器具店内，以禁酒令主题、多层空间与经典/原创鸡尾酒闻名。

en.title: Speak Low
en.summary: A hidden cocktail bar on Fuxing Middle Road in Shanghai's former French Concession, founded in 2014 by Shingo Gokan, with an entrance inside the OCHO bar-tool shop and a Prohibition theme across its multi-level rooms.

zh.title: 云顶酒厂
zh.summary: 苏格兰坎贝尔镇 Well Close 的家族蒸馏厂，1828 年由 Archibald Mitchell 在私蒸旧址上创立，是少数在厂内完成地板发麦、糖化、蒸馏与装瓶的单一麦芽酒厂；Springbank、Longrow、Hazelburn 三种酒名分别对应 2.5 次、2 次与 3 次蒸馏。

en.title: Springbank Distillery
en.summary: Family-owned distillery on Well Close in Campbeltown, founded in 1828 by Archibald Mitchell on the site of an illicit still. One of the few Scotch distilleries that malts, distils and bottles entirely on site; Springbank, Longrow and Hazelburn correspond to 2.5, two and three distillations.

zh.title: 鹿跃酒庄
zh.summary: 纳帕谷鹿跃区的赤霞珠名庄，1970 年由 Warren Winiarski 创立。1973 年 S.L.V. 赤霞珠在 1976 年“巴黎审判”红葡萄酒组中名列第一，使加州酒进入国际视野；酒庄拥有 S.L.V.、FAY 与 CASK 23 三条旗舰线，2023 年起由安东尼世家全资持有。

en.title: Stag's Leap Wine Cellars
en.summary: A Cabernet Sauvignon estate in Napa Valley’s Stags Leap District, founded in 1970 by Warren Winiarski. Its 1973 S.L.V. Cabernet placed first among reds at the 1976 Judgment of Paris, putting California wine on the international map; the estate’s flagships are S.L.V., FAY and CASK 23, and since 2023 it has been wholly owned by Marchesi Antinori.

zh.title: 星光酒吧（银座）
zh.summary: 东京银座一丁目并木通一带的地下一层经典鸡尾酒吧，主理人岸久；以经典配方、三种冰与银座老派吧台为核心，官方标明的座位费为每人 1100 日元。

en.title: Star Bar Ginza
en.summary: A classic cocktail bar in a Ginza 1-chome basement in Tokyo, run by Hisashi Kishi; it centres on classic recipes, three kinds of ice and an old-school Ginza counter, with an official cover charge of 1100 yen per person.

zh.title: 斯泰伦博斯
zh.summary: 南非西开普省的历史葡萄酒小镇与产区，1679 年由开普总督 Simon van der Stel 命名。镇内是橡树成荫的 Dorp Street、荷兰式与乔治式建筑，周边有 150 多家酒庄与五条子路线；1971 年建立南非第一条官方葡萄酒路线，是开普酒乡最完整的葡萄酒目的地之一。

en.title: Stellenbosch
en.summary: A historic wine town and ward in the Western Cape, South Africa, named in 1679 by Cape governor Simon van der Stel. The town has oak-lined Dorp Street and Cape Dutch, Georgian and Victorian buildings, while more than 150 wineries and five sub-routes surround it; in 1971 it established South Africa’s first official wine route and remains one of the Cape Winelands’ most complete wine destinations.

zh.title: 泰亭哲香槟
zh.summary: 兰斯圣尼凯斯（Saint-Nicaise）的家族香槟酒庄，历史可追溯到 1734 年的 Forest-Fourneaux 酒行，1932 年由 Pierre Taittinger 接手。拥有约 288 公顷葡萄园、37 个 crus，地下酒窖深 18 米、属 UNESCO 香槟山丘与酒庄遗产；Comtes de Champagne 首创于 1952 年。

en.title: Champagne Taittinger
en.summary: A family-owned Champagne house at Saint-Nicaise in Reims, tracing its origins to the Forest-Fourneaux firm of 1734 and taken over by Pierre Taittinger in 1932. It farms about 288 hectares across 37 crus; its cellars lie 18 metres underground within the UNESCO Champagne hillsides, houses and cellars; Comtes de Champagne was first made in 1952.

zh.title: 铜头酒馆
zh.summary: 都柏林下桥街的爱尔兰老酒馆，店方称此地自 1198 年即有酒馆、现存建筑为 1754 年所建；以传统音乐、健力士与爱尔兰家常菜闻名，今天仍在营业。

en.title: The Brazen Head
en.summary: A historic Dublin pub on Lower Bridge Street; the house traces a hostelry on the site to 1198 and dates the present building to 1754, and it still serves Irish food, stout and traditional music.

zh.title: 康诺特酒吧
zh.summary: 伦敦梅费尔康诺特酒店内的鸡尾酒吧，2008 年开业，以桌边手推车调制的马天尼、David Collins Studio 设计的空间和 The Connaught Bar Gin 闻名。

en.title: The Connaught Bar
en.summary: The cocktail bar inside The Connaught hotel in Mayfair, London, opened in 2008 and known for its tableside Martini trolley, David Collins Studio interior and house-distilled gin.

zh.title: 乔治客栈
zh.summary: 伦敦南岸 Borough High Street 的历史客栈，国家信托所有、Greene King 经营；现存建筑为 17 世纪火灾后重建，是伦敦仅存的带廊式客栈，狄更斯《小杜丽》曾提及。

en.title: The George Inn
en.summary: A historic inn on Borough High Street in Southwark, owned by the National Trust and run by Greene King; rebuilt after a 1676 fire, it is London's last surviving galleried inn and appears in Dickens's Little Dorrit.

zh.title: 麦卡伦庄园
zh.summary: 苏格兰 Craigellachie 附近 Easter Elchies 的麦卡伦酒厂与游客中心，1824 年取得合法执照，2018 年启用由 Rogers Stirk Harbour + Partners 设计的新酒厂；以雪莉桶熟成、小型蒸馏器与庄园式参观体验闻名，进入庄园须提前预约。

en.title: The Macallan Estate
en.summary: The Macallan distillery and visitor experience at Easter Elchies near Craigellachie, licensed in 1824 and rebuilt in 2018 to a design by Rogers Stirk Harbour + Partners; known for sherry-seasoned casks, small stills and an appointment-only estate visit.

zh.title: 青岛啤酒博物馆
zh.summary: 2003 年 8 月 15 日青岛啤酒百年华诞时开馆，位于 1903 年德资啤酒厂原址，是国内首家专业啤酒博物馆，也是国家一级博物馆与全国重点文物保护单位。

en.title: Tsingtao Beer Museum
en.summary: Opened on 15 August 2003 for Tsingtao Brewery's centenary, on the site of the 1903 German-funded brewery. It is China's first specialist beer museum, a national first-class museum and a nationally protected heritage site.

zh.title: 青岛啤酒街（登州路）
zh.summary: 市北区登州路东起延安二路、西至寿光路的一段商业街，长约 710 米，以啤酒屋、海鲜大排档与夜间消费闻名；青岛啤酒厂与啤酒博物馆就在街上。它是喝酒吃饭的街区，不是博物馆的延伸展厅。

en.title: Qingdao Beer Street (Dengzhou Road)
en.summary: A 710-metre commercial stretch of Dengzhou Road in Shibei District, running from Yan'an 2nd Road to Shouguang Road. It is known for beer houses, seafood stalls and evening crowds; the Tsingtao brewery and beer museum stand on the same street. It is a place to eat and drink, not an extension of the museum.

zh.title: 青岛啤酒厂（登州路厂区）
zh.summary: 青岛啤酒位于市北区登州路 56 号的老厂区，1903 年德资啤酒厂在此建立，至今仍在运转。青岛啤酒博物馆就坐落在厂区内，游客通过博物馆的展线与玻璃廊道观看生产，不能自行进入车间；这里讲的是德式拉格传统与一座仍在工作的老厂。

en.title: Tsingtao Brewery (Dengzhou Road plant)
en.summary: Tsingtao's historic plant at 56 Dengzhou Road in Shibei District was founded by German brewers in 1903 and is still working. The Tsingtao Beer Museum occupies part of the site, and visitors see production through its galleries and glass corridor rather than entering the workshops.

zh.title: 土城古镇（习水）
zh.summary: 贵州习水县土城镇，赤水河畔的古镇与四渡赤水纪念地叠在一起；它既有盐运码头、老街与吊脚楼，也有纪念馆、渡口与长征叙事，适合与习酒镇串成习水两天。

en.title: Tucheng Old Town (Xishui)
en.summary: Tucheng in Xishui County, Guizhou, layers a Chishui River old town with the memory of the Four Crossings of the Chishui. It has salt wharves, old streets and stilt houses as well as a memorial, ferry points and Long March history, and pairs with Xijiu for two days in Xishui.

zh.title: 弗勒克啤酒屋
zh.summary: 布拉格历史悠久的啤酒馆和微型啤酒厂，创立于 1499 年，以自酿黑啤和捷克菜闻名。

en.title: U Fleků
en.summary: A historic Prague beer hall and microbrewery, founded in 1499 and known for its dark lager and Czech food.

zh.title: 小熊酒馆
zh.summary: 布拉格老城 Na Perštýně 街上的历史酒馆、餐厅与微型酒厂，建筑酿酒史可追溯到 1466 年，以 250 升糖化锅、橡木桶后熟与 X-BEER 33 闻名。

en.title: U Medvídků
en.summary: A historic Prague pub, restaurant and microbrewery on Na Perštýně, with a brewing record going back to 1466 and a 250-litre brewhouse known for oak-aged beer and X-BEER 33.

zh.title: 金虎酒馆
zh.summary: 布拉格老城胡索瓦街 17 号的啤酒馆，房屋可追溯至 14 世纪，以皮尔森啤酒、赫拉巴尔常坐的桌位与哈维尔带克林顿来访而闻名。

en.title: U Zlatého tygra
en.summary: A Prague Old Town beer hall at Husova 17, in a house dating from the fourteenth century, known for Pilsner Urquell, Bohumil Hrabal's usual table and Václav Havel bringing Bill Clinton here in 1994.

zh.title: 联合牡蛎屋
zh.summary: 波士顿 Union Street 的联合牡蛎屋，1826 年开业，常被称为美国连续营业最久的餐厅；所在建筑可追到 18 世纪，半圆牡蛎吧台、肯尼迪包间与“美国牙签起源”传说共同构成它的名声。

en.title: Union Oyster House
en.summary: Boston's Union Oyster House opened in 1826 and is often called the longest continuously operating restaurant in the United States; its building reaches back to the 18th century, and its semicircular oyster bar, Kennedy booth and toothpick legend are part of its reputation.

zh.title: 法塞尔酒庄
zh.summary: 玛格丽特河的第一个葡萄园与酒庄，1967 年由 Tom Cullity 创立；以 Heytesbury、Filius 与 Premier 系列著称，酒庄内有美术馆与餐厅。

en.title: Vasse Felix
en.summary: Margaret River’s first vineyard and winery, founded by Tom Cullity in 1967; known for Heytesbury, Filius and Premier, with an art gallery and restaurant on site.

zh.title: 维苏威咖啡馆
zh.summary: 旧金山 North Beach 的 Vesuvio Café，1948 年由 Henri Lenoir 开办，是 Beat Generation 作家与 City Lights 书店之间的酒吧；彩绘玻璃、壁画与 Jack Kerouac Alley 构成它的文学地景。

en.title: Vesuvio Café
en.summary: A bar in San Francisco's North Beach since 1948, Vesuvio Café is tied to the Beat writers, faces City Lights bookstore across Jack Kerouac Alley, and remains a crowded, narrow, literary-minded bar rather than a quiet museum.

zh.title: 王宝和酒家
zh.summary: 上海福州路 603 号的黄酒与蟹宴老字号，1744 年始创，1936 年迁至现址，以王宝和黄酒、大闸蟹与“菊花蟹宴”闻名。

en.title: Wang Bao He
en.summary: A time-honoured yellow-wine and hairy-crab restaurant at 603 Fuzhou Road in Shanghai, founded in 1744 and moved to its present site in 1936; it is known for Wang Bao He yellow wine and the chrysanthemum crab banquet.

zh.title: 唯森啤酒厂
zh.summary: 位于德国弗赖辛 Weihenstephan 山上的巴伐利亚国立酒厂，以 1040 年的酿酒特许为起点，是“世界最古老啤酒厂”说法最常被引用的对象；参观需提前预约，山下的 Bräustüberl 常年营业。

en.title: Weihenstephan Brewery
en.summary: Bavaria's state brewery on the Weihenstephan hill in Freising, tracing its brewing licence to 1040 and the most frequently cited claimant to the title of world's oldest brewery; tours are booked in advance, while the Bräustüberl below stays open daily.

zh.title: 白马酒馆
zh.summary: 纽约格林威治村的历史酒馆，1880 年开业，因诗人迪伦·托马斯等文人顾客闻名；木质内饰与老式酒馆氛围保留至今，是村内代表性的文学地标。

en.title: White Horse Tavern
en.summary: A historic tavern in Greenwich Village, New York, opened in 1880 and associated with Dylan Thomas and other writers.

zh.title: 威廉姆斯-塞莱姆酒庄
zh.summary: 索诺马县俄罗斯河谷的先锋黑皮诺酒庄，1981 年由 Burt Williams 与 Ed Selyem 在车库创立；以低产、老藤与细密风格著称，参观需预约。

en.title: Williams Selyem
en.summary: A pioneer Pinot Noir winery in the Russian River Valley, Sonoma County, founded by Burt Williams and Ed Selyem in a garage in 1981; known for low yields, old vines and a fine style, with visits by appointment.

zh.title: 维拉维拉酒庄
zh.summary: 麦克拉伦谷的历史酒庄，1894 年由 Robert Strangways Wigley 创建，1969 年由 Greg Trott 修复；以 Church Block 混酿、Scrubby Rise 与 R.S.W. 西拉著称。

en.title: Wirra Wirra
en.summary: A historic McLaren Vale winery founded by Robert Strangways Wigley in 1894 and restored by Greg Trott in 1969; known for Church Block, Scrubby Rise and R.S.W. Shiraz.

zh.title: 五粮液酒厂（十里酒城）
zh.summary: 宜宾翠屏区岷江西路 150 号的五粮液生产厂区，常被称作“十里酒城”；它与厂区内的五粮液酒文化博览馆共同构成宜宾白酒参访的核心，但生产区不是自由景区，参观与品鉴要按官方预约和门禁走。

en.title: Wuliangye Distillery (Ten-Li Liquor City)
en.summary: The Wuliangye production plant at 150 Minjiang West Road in Cuiping, Yibin, commonly called “Ten-Li Liquor City”. Together with the Wuliangye Wine Culture Museum on the same campus it forms the core of Yibin baijiu visiting, but the working plant is not a free-access park: visits and tastings follow official booking and gate rules.

zh.title: 五粮液酒文化博物馆
zh.summary: 位于宜宾市翠屏区岷江西路 150 号五粮液厂区内的酒文化博览馆，官方名称为五粮液酒文化博览馆，始建于 1988 年，展陈面积约 2400 平方米；2022 年 7 月提档升级，设品牌、工艺、历史、发展、规划五个展厅，免费开放。

en.title: Wuliangye Wine Museum
en.summary: A liquor-culture museum inside the Wuliangye plant at 150 Minjiang West Road, Cuiping District, Yibin, Sichuan. Officially called the Wuliangye Wine Culture Exhibition Hall, it was founded in 1988, covers about 2,400 square metres and reopened in July 2022 with brand, craft, history, development and planning galleries; admission is free.

zh.title: 咸亨酒店
zh.summary: 绍兴市越城区鲁迅中路 179 号的老字号酒店与餐厅，1894 年（清光绪二十年）开业，因鲁迅《孔乙己》等作品而广为人知；今天的建筑为 1981 年重修、2007 年后扩建，堂吃部仍卖黄酒与茴香豆。

en.title: Xianheng Hotel
en.summary: A historic hotel and restaurant at 179 Lu Xun Middle Road in Shaoxing, opened in 1894 (the twentieth year of the Guangxu reign) and made famous by Lu Xun's stories, especially "Kong Yiji"; the present complex was rebuilt in 1981 and expanded after 2007, and its old-style dining hall still serves yellow wine and fava beans.

zh.title: 习酒厂区（习酒镇）
zh.summary: 贵州习水县习酒镇的贵州习酒生产厂区，位于赤水河中游，是理解酱香型白酒河谷生产与习水酒旅的核心点位；厂区、展陈与习酒镇生活空间不是同一个入口，参观与品鉴按官方预约。

en.title: Xijiu Distillery (Xijiu Town)
en.summary: The Guizhou Xijiu production plant in Xijiu Town, Xishui County, sits on the middle Chishui River and anchors sauce-aroma valley production and Xishui liquor travel. Plant, exhibition and town life are not one entrance; visits and tastings follow official booking.

zh.title: 杏花村镇（汾阳）
zh.summary: 山西汾阳杏花村镇，汾酒厂区、汾酒老作坊与杏花村遗址共同构成清香型白酒的核心参访地；它不是单一“杏花村景区”，而是酒厂、遗址、村镇与酒文化展陈叠在一起，参观要分开预约。

en.title: Xinghua Village (Fenyang)
en.summary: Xinghua Village in Fenyang, Shanxi, brings together the Fenjiu plant, the old Fenjiu workshop and the Xinghua Village site as the core of light-aroma baijiu visiting. It is not a single “Xinghua Village scenic spot” but a stack of plant, heritage site, village and liquor-culture displays, booked separately.

zh.title: 山崎蒸馏所
zh.summary: 日本大阪府岛本町的麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂，1923 年动工、1924 年开始蒸馏，是日本最早的麦芽威士忌蒸馏厂；参观需预约，设有付费蒸馏所导览与免费的威士忌馆。

en.title: Yamazaki Distillery
en.summary: Japan's oldest malt whisky distillery, in Shimamoto, Osaka. Construction began in 1923 and distillation in 1924; visits are by reservation only, with a paid distillery tour and a free whisky museum.

zh.title: 洋河酒厂文化旅游区
zh.summary: 位于江苏宿迁洋河镇中大街 118 号的工业旅游景区，依托洋河酒厂的生产基地，占地约 4.5 平方公里。2006 年评为全国工业旅游示范点，2015 年成为国家 4A 级景区，2019 年入选第三批国家工业遗产，同年“洋河地下酒窖”列为全国重点文物保护单位；2021 年“洋河酒酿造技艺”入选第五批国家级非遗。核心看点包括 31 连跨酿酒车间、9 万吨陶坛库、美人泉景观园、梦之蓝中央酒区与地下酒窖。

en.title: Yanghe Distillery Cultural Tourism Area
en.summary: A 4.5-square-kilometre industrial tourism area at 118 Zhongda Street, Yanghe Town, Suqian, Jiangsu, built around Yanghe Distillery’s working site.
