It became a national industrial tourism demonstration site in 2006, a national 4A scenic area in 2015, and entered the third batch of national industrial heritage in 2019; the underground cellar became a national key cultural relic the same year, and the brewing technique entered the fifth national intangible heritage list in 2021. Highlights include the 31-span workshop, the 90,000-ton pottery-jar store, Meiren Spring and the underground cellar.

zh.title: 柴郡奶酪酒馆
zh.summary: 伦敦舰队街的历史酒馆，现建筑 1667 年重建，以木结构内饰和传统英式菜闻名；据传是伦敦最古老的酒馆之一，也是狄更斯读者常去的文学地标。

en.title: Ye Olde Cheshire Cheese
en.summary: A historic Fleet Street pub rebuilt after the Great Fire of 1666, known for its wood-panelled rooms, Samuel Smith's cask ales and traditional British food.

zh.title: 老主教冠酒馆
zh.summary: 伦敦哈顿花园旁 Ely Court 内的历史酒馆，1546 年已有酒馆，现建筑为 18 世纪，以狭巷入口、木质内饰和传统英式麦酒闻名。

en.title: Ye Olde Mitre
en.summary: A historic pub in Ely Court near Hatton Garden, with a tavern on the site since 1546, an essentially 18th-century building, a hidden alley entrance and traditional British cask ale.

zh.title: 耶路撒冷之旅酒馆
zh.summary: 位于英国诺丁汉城堡岩下的历史酒馆，自称英格兰最古老酒馆、创业于 1189 年；这一说法缺少同时代的确凿证据。现仍正常营业，每日 11:00–23:00。

en.title: Ye Olde Trip to Jerusalem
en.summary: A historic pub below Castle Rock in Nottingham, which claims to be the oldest pub in England and dates its opening to 1189; the claim lacks conclusive contemporary evidence.

zh.title: 伊兰兹酒庄
zh.summary: 新西兰马尔堡塞登 Seaview Road 的沿海酒庄，2008 年 8 月 8 日启用新厂，以从建厂第一天起获得 Toitū 碳中和认证与 White Road 自驾参观著称；品鉴室提供当地奶酪与腌肉，官方网站在部分地区受年龄验证限制，开放状态以官网或现场确认为准。

en.title: Yealands
en.summary: A coastal Marlborough winery on Seaview Road in Seddon, its new winery opened on 8 August 2008 and described as Toitū carbonzero certified from inception; the tasting room offers local cheeses and cured meats, with a self-drive White Road tour. The official site was age-gated during verification, so operating status remains unknown.

zh.title: 苏卡尔迪酒庄
zh.summary: 苏卡尔迪家族 1963 年创立的门多萨酒庄，商业档案地址位于迈普 Ruta Provincial 33, Km 7,5，也是 Santa Julia 产品线的基地；当前对外参观与餐厅体验主要在 Uco Valley 的 Finca Piedra Infinita，迈普基地的接待状态未能由官网确认。

en.title: Zuccardi
en.summary: A Mendoza wine family founded in 1963, with its commercial address at Ruta Provincial 33, Km 7,5 in Maipú and the home of the Santa Julia range; the current visitor and restaurant experience is primarily at Finca Piedra Infinita in the Uco Valley, and the Maipú base's visitor status could not be confirmed on the official site.

zh.title: 最后一审餐厅
zh.summary: 柏林瓦伊森街 14–16 号的历史餐厅，房屋初见于 1561 年，餐饮传统始于 1621 年，1924 年起使用今名，是柏林最老的餐厅之一。

en.title: Zur letzten Instanz
en.summary: A historic restaurant at Waisenstraße 14–16 in Berlin, with a building first documented in 1561, a gastronomic tradition since 1621 and its present name since 1924; it is one of Berlin's oldest restaurants.

zh.title: 问刘十九：白居易的一杯冬夜酒
zh.summary: 白居易《问刘十九》只有四句二十字：新酿的绿蚁酒、红泥小火炉、将雪的傍晚，以及一句“能饮一杯无”。它把请客写成一幅有温度的冬夜小画，分寸感比酒本身更耐读。

en.title: Asking Liu Shijiu: Bai Juyi's Cup of Wine on a Winter Night
en.summary: Bai Juyi's “Asking Liu Shijiu” has only four lines and twenty characters: freshly brewed lüyi wine, a small red clay stove, an evening about to snow, and the question “can you drink a cup?” It turns an invitation into a warm little winter scene, and its sense of measure is more lasting than the wine.

zh.title: 短歌行：曹操把酒写成了求贤的忧思
zh.summary: 《短歌行》是乐府旧题，传统归在曹操名下。诗从“对酒当歌，人生几何”写起，以酒解忧，转入求贤的焦虑，最后以周公吐哺收束。酒在诗里不是享乐，而是把短促人生与未竟事业放在同一张桌上的媒介。

en.title: Duan Ge Xing: Cao Cao Turns Wine into the Anxiety of Seeking Talent
en.summary: Duan Ge Xing is an old yuefu title traditionally assigned to Cao Cao. It begins with “I face the wine and should sing; how long is a life?”, uses wine to dissolve sorrow, moves into the anxiety of seeking talent, and closes with the Duke of Zhou spitting out his food to receive guests. Wine is not pleasure here but the medium that places a short life and an unfinished enterprise on the same table.

zh.title: 登高：杜甫在夔州登台的一杯浊酒
zh.summary: 杜甫《登高》写于大历二年（767）夔州，八句七律，前四句写秋景，后四句写身世，末句落在“新停浊酒杯”。酒没有出现在宴席上，而是以“停”的方式出现，成为年老、多病与漂泊的标记。

en.title: Climbing High: Du Fu and a Cup of Rough Wine at Kuizhou
en.summary: Du Fu wrote Climbing High in the autumn of 767 at Kuizhou. The eight lines of regulated verse give four lines to autumn scenery and four to his own life, ending on the words “I have just stopped the cup of rough wine”. Wine never appears at a banquet here; it appears as a stopping, a mark of age, illness and drift.

zh.title: 客至：杜甫在草堂请客的一顿饭
zh.summary: 杜甫《客至》约作于上元二年（761）春成都草堂，题下自注“喜崔明府相过”。诗从春水群鸥写到扫径开门，再从市远无兼味写到家贫只旧醅，把一顿不丰盛的请客写得诚恳而温暖。

en.title: Arrival of a Guest: Du Fu Entertains at His Thatched Cottage
en.summary: Du Fu wrote “Arrival of a Guest” around the spring of 761 at his thatched cottage in Chengdu; the poem carries his own note that he was delighted by a visit from Magistrate Cui. From spring water and gulls to sweeping the path and opening the gate, from a distant market and plain food to poor wine, it makes a modest meal sincere and warm.

zh.title: 饮中八仙歌：杜甫写的不是酒量排行榜，是一组盛唐群像
zh.summary: 《饮中八仙歌》以贺知章、汝阳王李琎、左相李适之、崔宗之、苏晋、李白、张旭、焦遂八人为对象，用八段速写写酒后的神态与身份。它不是酒量排行榜，也不是单纯的颂歌；酒在这里是让人暂时脱离官场、礼法与日常角色的媒介。杜甫的笔调在欣赏与保留之间，需要逐人读。

en.title: Song of the Eight Immortals of the Wine Cup: Du Fu's portrait gallery of High Tang
en.summary: The Song of the Eight Immortals of the Wine Cup sketches He Zhizhang, Li Jin the Prince of Ruyang, the former chancellor Li Shizhi, Cui Zongzhi, Su Jin, Li Bai, Zhang Xu and Jiao Sui. It is not a ranking of drinking capacity and not a simple hymn to drinkers. Wine is the medium that lets each man step outside his official role. Du Fu's tone moves between affection and reserve, and the poem's order descends from court to street.

zh.title: 清明：一场雨、一个行人和一处酒家
zh.summary: “清明时节雨纷纷”四句二十八字，写雨中的行人与牧童指路，酒家只被问到、没有被走到。这首诗长期署名杜牧，但《樊川文集》未收，最早见于南宋类书，作者归属仍有争议；杏花村也未必是某个确定地名。

en.title: Qingming: Rain, a Traveller and the Direction of a Wine House
en.summary: The four lines of Qingming give us rain, a traveller and a shepherd boy pointing the way; the wine house is asked about but never reached. The poem has long been attributed to Du Mu, yet it is absent from his collected works and first appears in a Southern Song reference book, so authorship remains disputed; Apricot Blossom Village is not necessarily a fixed place name either.

zh.title: 渔家傲·秋思：范仲淹在边城的一杯浊酒
zh.summary: 《渔家傲·秋思》写西北边塞的秋天：雁去无留意，边声四起，孤城紧闭；下片以“浊酒一杯家万里”写乡愁，以“燕然未勒归无计”写功业未成，最后落在“将军白发征夫泪”。一杯酒量出了家与边关的距离。

en.title: Yu Jia Ao: Fan Zhongyan and a Cup of Cloudy Wine at the Frontier
en.summary: Yu Jia Ao describes autumn at the north-western frontier: geese leave without lingering, border sounds rise, the lone city closes. The lower half sets “a cup of cloudy wine, home ten thousand miles away” against “Mount Yanran not yet inscribed, no way to return”, and ends on “the general's white hair, the soldiers' tears”. A single cup measures the distance between home and the frontier.

zh.title: 把酒问月：李白问的不是月亮，是人与时间的关系
zh.summary: 《把酒问月》题下原注“故人贾淳令予问之”，李白从停杯一问写到白兔捣药、嫦娥孤栖，再写到“今人不见古时月，今月曾经照古人”。月亮在诗里是恒常的参照，酒是提问的动作；结尾“月光长照金樽里”把宇宙尺度收回眼前的一杯。

en.title: Holding a Cup and Asking the Moon: Li Bai on people, time and the moon
en.summary: Holding a Cup and Asking the Moon opens from a note that a friend, Jia Chun, told Li Bai to ask the question. The poem moves from the moon's origin and the impossibility of climbing it, through its light and path, to the myth of the white rabbit and Chang'e, then to the line that the people of today cannot see the ancient moon, though this moon once shone on the ancients. The moon is a constant reference; wine is the act of asking. The ending brings the cosmic scale back into the golden cup in front of the poet.

zh.title: 月下独酌：李白的一壶酒与三个影子
zh.summary: 李白《月下独酌》以“举杯邀明月，对影成三人”把孤独写成一场小剧场：月亮与影子不会饮酒，却被诗人拉来作伴。酒在这里不是消愁的工具，而是搭起想象舞台的道具。

en.title: Drinking Alone under the Moon: Li Bai's Pot of Wine and Three Shadows
en.summary: Li Bai's “Drinking Alone under the Moon” turns solitude into a little theatre with the line “I raise my cup to invite the bright moon, and with my shadow we become three”. The moon and shadow cannot drink, yet the poet recruits them as company. Wine here is not a remedy for sorrow but a prop for an imaginative stage.

zh.title: 客中作：李白在兰陵的一碗琥珀酒
zh.summary: 《客中作》只有四句二十八字：兰陵美酒、玉碗、琥珀色的酒光，以及一位让客人忘记身在异乡的主人。诗里的“郁金香”指浸酒用的郁金，不是荷兰郁金香花；酒是低度发酵的谷物酒，不是今天的白酒。

en.title: Written While Travelling: Li Bai's Lanling Wine and a Host Who Makes a Guest Forget Home
en.summary: Li Bai's “Written While Travelling” is a four-line poem about Lanling wine, a jade bowl and the amber glow of the liquor, and a host whose hospitality makes a guest forget he is far from home. “Turmeric” here means the rhizome used to scent wine, not the tulip; the wine is a low-alcohol fermented grain wine, not today's baijiu.

zh.title: 将进酒：李白的劝饮与时间
zh.summary: 《将进酒》是乐府旧题，约作于天宝年间；李白借劝酒写时间的不可逆、才华的自信与失意的排解。通行本与敦煌写本《惜罇空》文字有差异，“三百杯”是文学夸张而非酒量记录。

en.title: Bring in the Wine: Li Bai on drinking and time
en.summary: Bring in the Wine uses an old yuefu title and was probably written around the Tianbao era; Li Bai uses a drinking song to write about irreversible time, confidence in talent and the relief of disappointment. The received text differs from the Dunhuang manuscript Xizun Kong, and three hundred cups is literary exaggeration rather than a record of intake.

zh.title: 如梦令·常记溪亭日暮：一首三十三字的小电影
zh.summary: 李清照《如梦令·常记溪亭日暮》只三十三字，却写了时间、地点、醉意、迷路、惊鸟五个层次。它不是一段完整的游记，而是一次被记忆反复回放的傍晚。“沉醉”既可能是酒，也可能是景；“争渡”既可能是抢着划，也可能是“怎渡”的疑问。小令的妙处，正在这些不确定处。

en.title: Ru Meng Ling: A Thirty-Three-Character Little Film
en.summary: Li Qingzhao's Ru Meng Ling, on often remembering the dusk at the brook pavilion, has only thirty-three characters but layers time, place, drunkenness, losing the way and startled birds. It is not a complete travelogue but an evening replayed by memory. "Deeply drunk" may refer to wine or to the scenery; "zheng du" may mean racing to cross or asking how to cross. The small lyric lives in those uncertainties.

zh.title: 声声慢：三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他晚来风急
zh.summary: 李清照《声声慢》以十四个叠字开篇，写乍暖还寒的秋日、三杯两盏淡酒、满地残花、梧桐细雨。酒在这里既不能暖身，也不能消愁，“淡”与“敌不过”把整首词的无力感定了下来。

en.title: Sheng Sheng Man: Three Cups and Two Cups of Thin Wine against the Evening Wind
en.summary: Li Qingzhao's Sheng Sheng Man opens with fourteen repeated characters, then moves through a warm-cold autumn day, three cups and two cups of thin wine, fallen flowers and fine rain on the paulownia. Wine neither warms the body nor drowns sorrow; “thin” and “could not withstand” set the whole poem's helplessness.

zh.title: 醉花阴：李清照重阳把酒的一天
zh.summary: 李清照《醉花阴》写一个重阳节从白昼到黄昏的过程：薄雾浓云、香炉、玉枕纱帐、东篱把酒，最后落在“人比黄花瘦”。酒只出现一次，却把整日的闲愁与身体的消瘦连在一起。

en.title: Zui Hua Yin: Li Qingzhao and a Cup of Wine on the Double Ninth
en.summary: Li Qingzhao's Zui Hua Yin follows a Double Ninth day from morning to dusk: thin mist and dense clouds, an incense burner, a jade pillow and gauze curtain, then a cup of wine by the eastern fence, ending on “the person is thinner than the yellow flower”. Wine appears once, yet it links the day's idle sorrow to the thinness of a body.

zh.title: 酒德颂：刘伶把饮酒写成一篇政治寓言
zh.summary: 《酒德颂》是西晋刘伶仅存的名篇之一。它借“大人先生”与贵介公子、搢绅处士的对照，把饮酒写成一种不受礼法约束的生活姿态；酒在这里不是享乐道具，而是对魏晋名教与政治高压的消极抵抗。本文梳理文本、层次、竹林七贤语境与常见误读。

en.title: In Praise of the Virtue of Wine: Liu Ling's drinking as political fable
en.summary: In Praise of the Virtue of Wine is one of the few surviving works by Liu Ling, a Western Jin member of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove. Through the contrast between the Great Man and the titled gentlemen who defend ritual law, Liu Ling turns drinking into a way of stepping outside social judgement. Wine here is not a party prop but a quiet refusal of the moralised politics of the Wei-Jin period.

zh.title: 雨霖铃：柳永在都门外喝不下的一杯送别酒
zh.summary: 《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》写一场秋雨初停的送别：都门外设帐饯行，酒摆在面前却“无绪”，船家催着开船，两人执手落泪。下片设想“今宵酒醒何处”，把一杯没喝好的酒变成“杨柳岸，晓风残月”的清醒。酒在词里不是助兴，而是离别的证据。

en.title: Yu Lin Ling: Liu Yong and a Farewell Cup He Could Not Drink
en.summary: Yu Lin Ling describes a farewell after an autumn rain: a tent is set up outside the city gate and wine is laid out, but there is no heart for it; the boatman urges departure; the two hold hands and weep. The lower half imagines where the poet will wake from wine, turning a cup that was never enjoyed into the clear-headed scene of willows, morning wind and a fading moon. Wine here is not entertainment but evidence of parting.

zh.title: 游山西村：陆游在农家喝的一碗腊酒
zh.summary: 陆游《游山西村》写一次山村之行：农家腊酒虽浑，待客的鸡豚却足；山路重重，柳暗花明处又见一村；春社将近，箫鼓相随；临别约好，以后要拄杖乘月随时来叩门。酒是农家自酿的浊酒，不是名酒，却是一顿饭的起点。

en.title: Visiting West Mountain Village: Lu You and a Bowl of Farmhouse Wine
en.summary: Lu You's Visiting West Mountain Village describes a trip to a mountain village: the farmhouse winter wine is cloudy but the chicken and pork for a guest are ample; mountains and waters repeat until the road seems lost, then willows dark and flowers bright reveal another village; the spring sacrifice is near and flutes and drums follow; before leaving, the poet promises to lean on his staff and knock at the door at any hour. Wine is cloudy home brew, not a famous bottle, but it is where the meal begins.

zh.title: 过故人庄：孟浩然在农家喝的一顿便酒
zh.summary: 孟浩然《过故人庄》写一次普通的农家做客：故人备了鸡黍，村边绿树环绕，青山在城外斜立，开窗面对场圃，端起酒杯聊农事，最后约定重阳再来赏菊。酒在诗里不是名酒，而是家常饭桌上的一杯。

en.title: Passing an Old Friend's Farm: Meng Haoran and an Ordinary Cup of Wine
en.summary: Meng Haoran's Passing an Old Friend's Farm describes an ordinary visit to a farmhouse: the friend prepares chicken and millet, green trees ring the village, a blue mountain slopes beyond the wall, the window opens onto a threshing floor and vegetable plot, and wine is raised while farming is discussed, ending with a promise to return for chrysanthemums at the Double Ninth.

zh.title: 醉翁亭记：欧阳修写的不是酒，是一套地方治理的心情
zh.summary: 《醉翁亭记》作于庆历六年（1046）欧阳修知滁州时。文章从琅琊山、酿泉写到醉翁亭，再从山间朝暮四时写到滁人游、太守宴，最后落到“太守谓谁”。它常被当作山水游记，其实也是一篇关于贬谪、宽简政治与“与民同乐”的地方治理文本。

en.title: The Pavilion of the Old Drunkard: Ouyang Xiu on exile, landscape and local government
en.summary: The Pavilion of the Old Drunkard was written in 1046, when Ouyang Xiu was magistrate of Chuzhou after the failure of the Qingli reforms. It moves from Mount Langya and the Brewing Spring to the pavilion, then from the mountain's days and seasons to the people of Chuzhou and the magistrate's banquet. Often read as a landscape essay, it is also a text about exile, light-handed local government and the idea that a magistrate's joy lies in other people's joy.

zh.title: 定风波：一蓑烟雨任平生
zh.summary: 苏轼《定风波》写三月七日沙湖道中遇雨：同行狼狈，他独不觉；雨停之后回望来路，写下“也无风雨也无晴”。酒只出现一次——“料峭春风吹酒醒”——却把全词的感受从雨中转向清醒。

en.title: Ding Feng Bo: A Cloak of Mist and Rain for a Whole Life
en.summary: Su Shi's Ding Feng Bo records a rainstorm on the road to Shahu on the seventh of the third month: companions were wretched, he alone was unbothered; after the rain cleared he looked back and wrote “there is neither wind nor rain, nor clear sky”. Wine appears only once—when the chill spring wind sobers him—and turns the poem from rain toward clarity.

zh.title: 临江仙·夜饮东坡：一扇敲不开的门，一条听得见的江
zh.summary: 《临江仙·夜饮东坡醒复醉》作于苏轼贬谪黄州时期。词从夜饮东坡、醉归临皋写起，家童熟睡、敲门不应，只好倚杖听江声；下片由“长恨此身非我有”转入对营营仕途的厌倦，最后以“小舟从此逝，江海寄余生”作结。它不是一场真的出走，而是一个被门挡住的人在江声里想象出口。

en.title: Linjiang Xian: A Door That Would Not Open, a River That Could Be Heard
en.summary: Linjiang Xian, on drinking at night at Dongpo, comes from Su Shi's years of exile in Huangzhou. The song begins with a night of drinking at Dongpo and a drunken return to Lingao; the servant boy is asleep, the door does not answer, and the poet leans on his staff to listen to the river. The second half turns from the complaint that this body is not mine to a weariness with the bustling official life, and closes with the wish that a small boat might carry him away into the rivers and seas. It is not an actual departure but an imagined exit, heard through a door that will not open.

zh.title: 念奴娇·赤壁怀古：苏轼在黄州把酒酹江月
zh.summary: 《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》作于元丰五年（1082）苏轼贬居黄州时。词从大江东去写到三国周郎，再回到“早生华发”的自己，最后以“一尊还酹江月”收束。酒只在结尾出现，不是痛饮，而是把一杯酒洒向江与月。

en.title: Nian Nu Jiao: Remembering the Red Cliff, Su Shi Pours Wine to the River Moon
en.summary: Nian Nu Jiao was written in 1082, while Su Shi was exiled to Huangzhou. The song moves from the great river flowing east to Zhou Yu of the Three Kingdoms, then back to the poet with white hair, and ends with “I pour a cup of wine as a libation to the river moon”. Wine appears only at the end, not as a deep drink but as a cup poured out to the river and the moon.

zh.title: 水调歌头：苏轼中秋把酒问月
zh.summary: 苏轼《水调歌头》作于熙宁九年（1076）中秋，小序写明“欢饮达旦，大醉”，并“兼怀子由”。词从把酒问青天写到月照无眠，最后以“但愿人长久，千里共婵娟”收束，把一杯酒放进了对兄弟与对人的祝愿里。

en.title: Shui Diao Ge Tou: Su Shi Asks the Moon with a Cup of Wine
en.summary: Su Shi wrote Shui Diao Ge Tou at the Mid-Autumn festival of 1076. The preface says he drank until dawn, was very drunk, and also missed his brother Ziyou. The song moves from raising a cup to ask the blue sky to moonlight on a sleepless person, and closes with the wish that we may live long and share the same moon a thousand miles apart.

zh.title: 桃花庵歌：唐寅用桃花换酒钱
zh.summary: 《桃花庵歌》写一个住在桃花庵里的“桃花仙”：种桃树、摘桃花换酒钱，酒醒花前坐，酒醉花下眠，但愿老死花酒间，不愿鞠躬车马前。它把清贫的自在写得夸张而痛快，也用“五陵豪杰墓”反问富贵的长久。此诗版本差异较大，读时需先说明所用文本。

en.title: Song of the Peach Blossom Hut: Tang Yin Pays for Wine with Peach Blossoms
en.summary: The Song of the Peach Blossom Hut describes a “peach blossom immortal” living in a hut among peach trees: he plants the trees, picks the blossoms and trades them for wine money, sits before the flowers when sober and sleeps beneath them when drunk, and would rather die old among flowers and wine than bow before carriages and horses. It makes honest poverty sound exuberant, then asks what remains of the tombs of the great. The poem survives in widely differing versions, so the text used must be stated.

zh.title: 饮酒·其五：陶渊明在东篱下看见的南山
zh.summary: 《饮酒》其五写结庐人境而无车马之喧，采菊东篱、悠然见山，最后落到“此中有真意，欲辨已忘言”。这首诗本身没有出现“酒”字，酒在组诗的总序与题目里；理解它，需要把饮酒放回陶渊明归田生活的整体。

en.title: Drinking Wine, Number Five: Tao Yuanming Sees the Southern Mountain
en.summary: Number Five of Drinking Wine describes building a hut among men without the noise of carriages and horses, picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence and seeing the southern mountain, and ending on “there is a true meaning in this, but I have forgotten the words to explain it”. The poem itself never uses the word wine; wine belongs to the title and the preface of the sequence, and must be read within Tao Yuanming's return to farm life.

zh.title: 饮酒·其七：秋菊、忘忧物与东轩
zh.summary: 《饮酒·其七》从秋菊带露写起，把菊花浮在酒中，借“忘忧物”推开世俗之情；随后写独饮、日落、归鸟与东轩长啸。它是一首关于自足的田园诗，也是一首把酒写得极安静的诗。

en.title: Drinking Wine, No. 7: Autumn Chrysanthemums, the Care-Forgotten Thing and the Eastern Gallery
en.summary: Tao Yuanming's seventh poem in the Drinking Wine series begins with dew-wet autumn chrysanthemums floated in wine, uses the drink to push worldly feelings away, then moves through a solitary cup, a emptied pot, sunset and returning birds to a long whistle under the eastern gallery. It is a quiet poem about self-sufficiency.

zh.title: 凉州词：王翰把一杯葡萄酒放在战场边上
zh.summary: 王翰《凉州词》只有四句：葡萄美酒、夜光杯、马上琵琶，以及“醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回”。它把最华美的酒器与最残酷的战场放在同一幅画面里，用劝酒的口吻写战争的代价。末句是反问，不是豪言；读它时不宜只取豪迈，而忽略那层悲凉。

en.title: Liangzhou Ci: Wang Han Sets a Cup of Grape Wine Beside the Battlefield
en.summary: Wang Han's Liangzhou Ci has only four lines: grape wine, a luminous cup, a pipa played on horseback, and “do not laugh if I lie drunk on the battlefield; since ancient times how many have come back from war?” It places the most splendid drinking vessel and the cruellest battlefield in one scene and writes the cost of war in the tone of a drinking invitation. The last line is a question, not a boast.

zh.title: 送元二使安西：一杯酒把送别写成了曲子
zh.summary: 王维《送元二使安西》以渭城朝雨、客舍柳色起笔，落到“劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人”。它把一场远行压缩进一杯酒，唐代已入乐歌唱，后世又衍为《阳关三叠》，是流传最广的送别诗之一。

en.title: Seeing Off Yuan the Second on His Mission to Anxi: One Cup Becomes a Song
en.summary: Wang Wei's “Seeing Off Yuan the Second on His Mission to Anxi” opens with morning rain at Weicheng and green willows by the guest house, then lands on “one more cup before you go: west of Yang Pass there are no old friends”. It compresses a farewell into a cup, and was already sung in the Tang before becoming the “Three Refrains on Yang Pass”.

zh.title: 破阵子：辛弃疾醉里挑灯看剑的一场梦
zh.summary: 《破阵子·为陈同甫赋壮词以寄之》从“醉里挑灯看剑”写起，梦回连营、沙场点兵、马快弓响，前九句极壮，最后一句“可怜白发生”把梦戳破。酒是入梦的入口，也是壮志难酬的夜间动作。

en.title: Po Zhen Zi: Xin Qiji Trims the Lamp and Looks at His Sword
en.summary: Po Zhen Zi begins with “drunk, I trim the lamp and look at my sword”, moves into a dream of linked camps, a reviewed army and fast horses, keeps nine lines heroic, and then breaks the dream with “pitiful—white hair has grown”. Wine is the entrance to the dream and the night-time gesture of an ambition that cannot be fulfilled.

zh.title: 西江月·遣兴：醉里推松，是笑话也是脾气
zh.summary: 辛弃疾《西江月·遣兴》写醉后欢笑、醉倒松边、问松“我醉何如”、又推松说“去”。表面是诙谐小词，内里是对“古人书”与南宋政治的愤激。“醉里且贪欢笑”的“且”字，说明笑是勉强的；推松的动作，则把无法推开的现实暂时推开。读这首词，不能只看醉态，要看醉态下面的脾气。

en.title: Xi Jiang Yue: Pushing the Pine Away, a Joke and a Temper
en.summary: Xin Qiji's Xi Jiang Yue, on diverting the mood, describes drunken laughter, falling asleep by a pine, asking the pine how drunk he is, and then pushing it away with a "go." On the surface it is a comic lyric; underneath it is anger at the "books of the ancients" and at Southern Song politics. The word "just" in "just crave laughter while drunk" shows that the laughter is forced, and the push at the pine is a temporary push against a reality he cannot move.

zh.title: 浣溪沙：晏殊在一杯酒里看见时间
zh.summary: 《浣溪沙·一曲新词酒一杯》从听一支新曲、饮一杯酒写起，去年的天气与旧日的亭台还在，夕阳却问“几时回”。下片以“无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来”写消逝与归来，最后落在小园香径里的独自徘徊。酒在这里不是宴饮，而是让人安静下来面对时间的日常动作。

en.title: Huan Xi Sha: Yan Shu Sees Time in a Cup of Wine
en.summary: Huan Xi Sha begins with hearing a new song and drinking a cup of wine; last year's weather and the old pavilion are still there, yet the setting sun is asked when it will return. The lower half sets “no way to stop the falling flowers” against “the returning swallows look familiar”, and ends with the poet pacing alone on a fragrant path. Wine is not a banquet here but a quiet daily act that lets a person face time.

zh.title: 调配
zh.summary: 把不同批次、年份、品种或桶型的酒液按比例组合，以稳定品质、平衡结构或形成固定风格的工序；葡萄酒、香槟、威士忌、白兰地与白酒的法规与调配逻辑各不相同。

en.title: Blending
en.summary: Combining liquids from different batches, vintages, varieties or cask types in set proportions to stabilise quality, balance structure or build a fixed style; wine, Champagne, whisky, brandy and baijiu follow different rules and logics.

zh.title: 蒸馏
zh.summary: 利用乙醇与水等组分沸点不同，将发酵液或酒醅中的乙醇分离并浓缩的工序；设备、回流与切酒方式决定烈酒的风味走向。

en.title: Distillation
en.summary: A process that separates and concentrates ethanol from a fermented liquid or mash by exploiting differences in boiling points; equipment, reflux and cut points shape the spirit's flavour.

zh.title: 发酵
zh.summary: 酵母或细菌在低氧条件下把糖转化为乙醇、二氧化碳与风味物质的代谢过程；菌种、温度、糖浓度、pH 与氧决定发酵速度、酒精度和香气走向。

en.title: Fermentation
en.summary: The metabolic process in which yeast or bacteria convert sugar into ethanol, carbon dioxide and flavour compounds under low oxygen; strain, temperature, sugar concentration, pH and oxygen set speed, strength and aroma.

zh.title: 加强（加度）
zh.summary: 向葡萄酒中加入葡萄蒸馏酒以提高酒精度并稳定酒体的工序；发酵中途加度可保留残糖，发酵后加度则得到干型加强酒，加度时机与比例决定最终风格。

en.title: Fortification
en.summary: The addition of grape spirit to wine to raise alcohol and stabilise the wine; fortifying mid-fermentation retains residual sugar, while fortifying after fermentation gives a dry fortified style, so timing and proportion decide the result.

zh.title: 生酛与山废
zh.summary: 清酒依靠天然乳酸菌培养酒母的两条传统路线；生酛保留山卸，山废省略山卸，二者都区别于直接添加乳酸的速酿酒母，并影响酸度、旨味与生产周期。

en.title: Kimoto and yamahai
en.summary: Two traditional sake-mother routes that rely on natural lactic acid bacteria; kimoto keeps the yamafuri mashing step while yamahai omits it, and both differ from the sokujo route that adds lactic acid, shaping acidity, umami and production time.

zh.title: 拉格低温贮酒
zh.summary: 主发酵之后的低温贮酒工序：酵母回收双乙酰、悬浮物沉降、硫化物逸散并完成自然碳酸化；温度曲线、时间与溶氧共同决定拉格啤酒的干净度与保质期。

en.title: Lagering
en.summary: The cold-storage stage after primary fermentation, in which yeast takes up diacetyl, suspended solids settle, sulfur compounds disperse and natural carbonation settles; the temperature curve, time and dissolved oxygen decide the cleanliness and shelf life of lager.

zh.title: 酒泥陈酿
zh.summary: 让葡萄酒与发酵后沉降的细酒泥保持接触的熟成方式；搅泥频率、温度与时间带来圆润口感、奶油与面包气息，并形成还原保护，但处理不当会产生硫化物与苦涩。

en.title: Lees ageing
en.summary: An ageing method that keeps wine in contact with the fine lees left after fermentation; stirring frequency, temperature and time bring roundness, creamy and bready notes and a reductive barrier, but poor handling produces sulfides and bitterness.

zh.title: 苹果酸-乳酸发酵
zh.summary: 乳酸菌把苹果酸转化为乳酸与二氧化碳的二次发酵；它降低滴定酸度、提高 pH 并软化口感，适量产生奶油气息，失控则带来挥发酸、生物胺与酒体浑浊。

en.title: Malolactic fermentation
en.summary: A secondary fermentation in which lactic acid bacteria convert malic acid into lactic acid and carbon dioxide; it lowers titratable acidity, raises pH and softens texture, adding creamy notes in moderation but volatile acidity, biogenic amines and haze when uncontrolled.

zh.title: 制麦
zh.summary: 把大麦等谷物浸泡、发芽、烘干并除根的预处理工序；发芽程度与烘干曲线决定淀粉酶活力、麦芽溶解度和色度，进而影响糖化效率与成品风味。

en.title: Malting
en.summary: The pre-treatment that steeps, germinates, kilns and de-roots barley and other grains; the degree of germination and the kilning curve set amylase power, modification and colour, and therefore saccharification efficiency and finished flavour.

zh.title: 混蒸混烧
zh.summary: 把新粮与酒醅同甑蒸煮并在同一次蒸馏中接酒的固态法白酒工序，与清蒸清烧相对；它通常与续糟配料配套，决定粮香、酒体饱满度与糟醅循环方式。

en.title: Mixed steaming and distillation
en.summary: A solid-state baijiu arrangement in which fresh grain and fermented mash are steamed in the same vessel and spirit is collected in one pass, as opposed to separate steaming; it usually works with continuous mash replenishment and shapes grain aroma, body and pit cycling.

zh.title: 橡木桶陈酿
zh.summary: 将酒液贮存在橡木桶中，让木材、微量氧气与时间共同改变香气、单宁、颜色与质感的工序；桶种、尺寸、新旧与烘烤程度都是可调变量。

en.title: Oak ageing
en.summary: Storing wine or spirit in oak casks so that wood, trace oxygen and time change aroma, tannin, colour and texture; species, cask size, age and toast level are adjustable variables.

zh.title: 压榨
zh.summary: 压榨是把葡萄汁或酒液从皮渣、种子与梗中分离出来的工序；白葡萄酒多在发酵前压榨，红葡萄酒多在浸渍或发酵后压榨，压力曲线与取酒分段决定产量、单宁与酒体。

en.title: Pressing
en.summary: Pressing separates juice or wine from skins, seeds and stems. White wines are usually pressed before fermentation, red wines after maceration or fermentation, and the pressure curve and fraction cuts decide yield, tannin and body.

zh.title: 制曲
zh.summary: 用谷物培养霉菌、酵母和细菌，制成糖化发酵剂的传统工序；曲的质量与微生物群落直接影响白酒、黄酒的出酒率与风味。

en.title: Qu making
en.summary: A traditional process that cultures moulds, yeasts and bacteria on grain to make a saccharifying and fermenting starter; qu quality and microbial community directly affect yield and flavour in baijiu and yellow wine.

zh.title: 糖化
zh.summary: 把谷物等原料中的淀粉分解为可发酵糖的工序；麦芽酶、曲霉酶与温度、pH、料水比共同决定糖谱，并影响酒体、出酒率与发酵能否顺利收尾。

en.title: Saccharification
en.summary: The process that breaks starch in grains and other raw materials into fermentable sugars; malt enzymes, mould enzymes from qu, temperature, pH and the water-to-grain ratio set the sugar profile and shape body, yield and fermentation.

zh.title: 固态发酵
zh.summary: 以含水率较低的固态粮醅为载体的发酵方式，是中国白酒固态法的基础；与半固态法、液态法相对，容器、曲种与温湿度管理决定风味走向。

en.title: Solid-state fermentation
en.summary: Fermentation carried out on a low-moisture solid grain mash, the basis of solid-state baijiu; unlike semi-solid and liquid routes, vessels, qu and temperature management shape the flavour.

zh.title: 堆积发酵
zh.summary: 把拌曲后的酒醅在入窖前堆放一段时间、借助自然升温扩大培养微生物的开放式工艺环节，常见于酱香型白酒。

en.title: Stacked fermentation
en.summary: An open process step in baijiu production in which qu-inoculated mash is piled for a period before pit loading, allowing natural warming and microbial multiplication. Common in sauce-aroma baijiu.

zh.title: 湖北白云边酒业
zh.summary: 位于湖北荆州松滋的白酒生产企业，1952 年建厂，2005 年完成国有股份退出、民有民营的产权改革；以浓酱兼香型工艺著称，并参与 GB/T 23547 浓酱兼香型白酒标准的起草。

en.title: Hubei Baiyunbian Distillery
en.summary: A baijiu producer in Songzi, Jingzhou, Hubei, built in 1952 and restructured in 2005 through a state-share exit and private ownership reform; it is known for strong-sauce mixed-aroma craft and took part in drafting GB/T 23547.

zh.title: 宾三得利
zh.summary: 日本三得利控股于 2014 年收购美国 Beam Inc 后形成的跨国烈酒企业；它把美国波本、加拿大威士忌、苏格兰威士忌与日本威士忌放在同一集团之下，运营总部设在美国芝加哥，中文名“宾三得利”由 Beam 与 Suntory 两个既有名称合并而来。

en.title: Beam Suntory
en.summary: A multinational spirits company formed when Japan's Suntory Holdings bought the American Beam Inc in 2014; it places American bourbon, Canadian whisky, Scotch and Japanese whisky under one group, runs its operating base from Chicago, and takes its Chinese name from the two existing names Beam and Suntory.

zh.title: 百富门
zh.summary: 1870 年在美国肯塔基路易斯维尔成立的烈酒企业，以 Jack Daniel's、Old Forester 与 Woodford Reserve 为核心；家族通过双类股保持控制，在纽约上市，2024 年完成 Sonoma-Cutrer 出售并退出 Duckhorn 股权。

en.title: Brown-Forman
en.summary: A spirits company founded in Louisville, Kentucky in 1870, centred on Jack Daniel's, Old Forester and Woodford Reserve; the founding family retains control through dual-class shares, and in 2024 the company completed the Sonoma-Cutrer sale and exited its Duckhorn stake.

zh.title: 烟台张裕葡萄酿酒股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于山东烟台的葡萄酒生产企业；1892 年张弼士创办张裕酿酒公司，1997 年以募集方式设立股份公司并在深圳证券交易所上市，2000 年 A 股上市。

en.title: Yantai Changyu Pioneer Wine Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A wine producer in Yantai, Shandong. Zhang Bishi founded the Changyu winemaking company in 1892; in 1997 a joint-stock company was established by public offer and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, followed by an A-share listing in 2000.

zh.title: 湖北稻花香酒业
zh.summary: 湖北宜昌夷陵区龙泉镇的白酒生产企业，注册主体为湖北稻花香酒业股份有限公司；企业类型为非上市、自然人投资或控股，蔡开云任董事长，集团以浓香型白酒为核心并延伸包装、物流等配套产业。

en.title: Hubei Daohuaxiang Distillery
en.summary: A baijiu producer in Longquan, Yiling District, Yichang, Hubei, registered as Hubei Daohuaxiang Distillery Co., Ltd.; it is a non-listed joint-stock company controlled by natural-person shareholders, with Cai Kaiyun as chairman, built around strong-aroma baijiu and extended into packaging and logistics.

zh.title: 帝亚吉欧
zh.summary: 1997 年由健力士与格兰德大都会合并而成的跨国酒类集团，总部位于伦敦，旗下拥有尊尼获加、斯米诺、百利甜酒、添加利与健力士等品牌。

en.title: Diageo
en.summary: A multinational drinks group formed in 1997 by the merger of Guinness and Grand Metropolitan, headquartered in London and owning brands such as Johnnie Walker, Smirnoff, Baileys, Tanqueray and Guinness.

zh.title: 贵州董酒股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于贵州遵义董公寺的白酒企业；董酒属董香型（又称药香型），1957 年恢复生产，1963 年入选中国老八大名酒，2008 年贵州地方标准把董酒确定为董香型代表。

en.title: Guizhou Dongjiu Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu producer in Donggongsi, Zunyi, Guizhou. Dongjiu is a dong-aroma (also called medicinal-aroma) baijiu; production resumed in 1957, it joined China's old eight famous liquors in 1963, and a 2008 Guizhou local standard named it the representative of dong-aroma.

zh.title: 王朝酒业
zh.summary: 1980 年在天津成立的中法合营葡萄酒企业的延续，现为在香港上市的王朝酒业集团，股份代号 828；截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日，天津食品集团持股 42.80%、人头马亚太持股 23.90%。

en.title: Dynasty
en.summary: The continuation of a Sino-French joint-venture winery founded in Tianjin in 1980, now the Hong Kong-listed Dynasty Fine Wines group under stock code 828; as of 30 June 2025 Tianjin Food Group held 42.80% and Rémy Cointreau Asia Pacific 23.90%.

zh.title: 山西杏花村汾酒集团有限责任公司
zh.summary: 位于山西汾阳杏花村的国有独资公司，2002 年 3 月改制组建。旗下上市平台为山西杏花村汾酒厂股份有限公司（600809）。本页区分集团、上市公司与品牌。

en.title: Shanxi Xinghuacun Fenjiu Group Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A wholly state-owned company in Xinghuacun, Fenyang, Shanxi, restructured in March 2002. Its listed arm is Shanxi Xinghuacun Fenjiu Distillery Co., Ltd. (600809). This producer separates group, listed company and brand.

zh.title: 中粮长城酒业有限公司
zh.summary: 由中粮集团管理的国产葡萄酒业务经营平台，以长城品牌经营葡萄酒；生产与原料基地覆盖河北沙城怀涿盆地、宁夏贺兰山东麓与秦皇岛碣石山，具体产品的生产企业以瓶标为准。

en.title: COFCO Greatwall Wine Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A domestic wine platform managed by COFCO and operating under the Greatwall brand, with production and sourcing bases in the Shacheng-Huaizhuo basin of Hebei, the eastern foothills of Helan Mountain in Ningxia and Jieshishan in Qinhuangdao; the producer of a specific bottle should be checked on its label.

zh.title: 安徽古井贡酒股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于安徽省亳州市古井镇的白酒生产企业，古井贡酒品牌的生产主体。本页区分公司身份、品牌与具体产品。

en.title: Anhui Gujing Distillery Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu producer based in Gujing Town, Bozhou, Anhui, and the production entity behind the Gujing Gongjiu brand. This producer separates company identity, brand and specific products.

zh.title: 北京红星股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于北京市怀柔区的白酒生产企业，前身为 1949 年 5 月成立的华北酒业专卖公司实验厂，是北京第一家国营酿酒厂，以红星二锅头与北京二锅头酒传统酿造技艺闻名。

en.title: Beijing Red Star Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu producer in Huairou, Beijing, whose predecessor, the Huabei Liquor Monopoly Experimental Factory, was founded in May 1949; it was the first state-run distillery in Beijing and is known for Red Star Erguotou and the traditional Beijing er-guotou craft.

zh.title: 黄鹤楼酒业
zh.summary: 工商主体为武汉天龙黄鹤楼酒业有限公司，厂区分布于武汉、咸宁、随州；2016 年 5 月古井贡酒以 8.16 亿元收购 51% 股权实现控股，企业以清香型为主并兼有浓香产品。

en.title: Huanghelou Distillery
en.summary: The legal entity is Wuhan Tianlong Huanghelou Distillery Co., Ltd., with sites in Wuhan, Xianning and Suizhou. In May 2016 Gujing Gongjiu acquired 51% for RMB 816 million and took control; the company is mainly a light-aroma producer but also makes strong-aroma products.

zh.title: 会稽山绍兴酒股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于浙江绍兴的黄酒生产企业，前身可追溯至 1743 年创办的云集酒坊，是绍兴酒传统酿造技艺的代表性企业之一，2014 年在上海证券交易所上市。

en.title: Kuaijishan Shaoxing Rice Wine Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A huangjiu producer in Shaoxing, Zhejiang, whose origins trace to the Yunji winery founded in 1743; it is one of the representative producers of traditional Shaoxing wine and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2014.

zh.title: 四川剑南春（集团）有限责任公司
zh.summary: 位于四川绵竹的白酒企业集团，1996 年注册组建；核心品牌剑南春属多粮浓香型白酒，2003 年完成国有资本退出、经营层与员工持股的改制。

en.title: Sichuan Jiannanchun (Group) Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu group based in Mianzhu, Sichuan, registered in 1996. Its core brand Jiannanchun is a multi-grain strong-aroma baijiu, and the group was restructured in 2003 when state capital withdrew and management and employees took shares.

zh.title: 酒鬼酒股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于湖南吉首的馥郁香型白酒生产企业；前身为始建于 1956 年的吉首酒厂，1997 年在深圳证券交易所上市，2016 年成为中粮集团成员企业。

en.title: Jiugui Liquor Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A fuyu-aroma baijiu producer in Jishou, Hunan. Its predecessor, the Jishou distillery, was founded in 1956; the company listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 1997 and became a COFCO group member in 2016.

zh.title: 安徽口子酒业股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于安徽淮北的兼香型白酒生产企业；2015 年 6 月在上海证券交易所上市，是兼香型白酒第一家上市企业，拥有口子窖、老口子等品牌。

en.title: Anhui Kouzi Distillery Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A Jianxiang-aroma baijiu producer in Huaibei, Anhui. It listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in June 2015 and was the first listed Jianxiang-aroma baijiu company, with brands including Kouzijiao and Lao Kouzi.

zh.title: 四川郎酒集团有限责任公司
zh.summary: 位于四川古蔺二郎镇、赤水河左岸的白酒企业集团，1998 年注册成立；核心品牌郎酒属酱香型白酒，2002 年前后由宝光集团取得控制权，企业转为民营。

en.title: Sichuan Langjiu Group Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu group based in Erlang, Gulin, Sichuan, on the left bank of the Chishui River. It was registered in 1998, and its core brand Langjiu is a sauce-aroma baijiu. Around 2002 the Baoguang group acquired control, and the company became privately owned.

zh.title: 河北衡水老白干酒业股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于河北衡水的老白干香型白酒生产企业；源于 1946 年组建的国营衡水制酒厂，2002 年 10 月在上海证券交易所上市，旗下拥有衡水老白干、板城烧锅酒、武陵酒与文王贡酒。

en.title: Hebei Hengshui Laobaigan Liquor Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A Laobaigan-aroma baijiu producer in Hengshui, Hebei. It originates from the state-run Hengshui distillery set up in 1946 and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in October 2002, with brands including Hengshui Laobaigan, Bancheng Shaoguo, Wuling and Wenwang Gongjiu.

zh.title: 泸州老窖集团有限责任公司
zh.summary: 位于四川泸州、成立于 2000 年 12 月的国有全资企业集团，实际控制人为泸州市国资委；截至 2026 年三季度末持有泸州老窖股份有限公司 26.05% 股份，是上市公司 000568 的控股股东。

en.title: Luzhou Laojiao Group Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A wholly state-owned enterprise group in Luzhou, Sichuan, founded in December 2000 and ultimately controlled by the Luzhou municipal SASAC; as of the end of the third quarter of 2026 it held 26.05% of Luzhou Laojiao Co., Ltd. (stock code 000568), whose controlling shareholder it is.

zh.title: 路威酩轩
zh.summary: 1987 年由酩悦轩尼诗与路易威登合并而成的法国奢侈品集团，总部巴黎；酒类业务由酩悦轩尼诗承担，Diageo 持有其 34% 股权，2025 年酒类收入 53.58 亿欧元、有机下降 5%。

en.title: LVMH
en.summary: A French luxury group formed in 1987 by the merger of Moët Hennessy and Louis Vuitton, headquartered in Paris; its drinks business is run by Moët Hennessy, 34% of which is held by Diageo, and in 2025 wines and spirits revenue was EUR 5.358 billion, down 5% organic.

zh.title: 北京顺鑫农业股份有限公司牛栏山酒厂
zh.summary: 位于北京市顺义区牛栏山镇的白酒生产企业，前身为 1952 年成立的国营牛栏山制酒厂，现为顺鑫农业旗下分公司，以二锅头工艺与牛栏山陈酿等产品知名。

en.title: Beijing Shunxin Agriculture Niulanshan Distillery
en.summary: A baijiu producer in Niulanshan town, Shunyi district, Beijing. Its predecessor, the state-run Niulanshan distillery, was founded in 1952; it is now a branch of Shunxin Agriculture and is known for er-guotou craft and products such as Niulanshan Chenniang.

zh.title: 保乐力加
zh.summary: 1975 年由保乐与力加两家法国茴香酒企业合并而成的跨国葡萄酒与烈酒集团，总部位于巴黎，旗下拥有绝对伏特加、芝华士、百龄坛、马爹利等品牌。

en.title: Pernod Ricard
en.summary: A multinational wine and spirits group formed in 1975 by the merger of two French anise-flavoured spirits houses, Pernod and Ricard; headquartered in Paris and owning brands such as Absolut, Chivas Regal, Ballantine's and Martell.

zh.title: 舍得酒业股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于四川射洪沱牌镇的浓香型白酒生产企业；前身可溯至 1940 年泰安作坊，1952 年设国营沱牌曲酒厂，1993 年注册股份公司，1996 年上市。

en.title: Shede Spirits Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu producer in Tuopai, Shehong, Sichuan. Its history traces to the 1940 Tai'an workshop; a state-run Tuopai distillery was set up in 1952, the joint-stock company was registered in 1993 and listed in 1996.

zh.title: 四川水井坊股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于四川成都的浓香型白酒生产企业；1996 年 12 月在上海证券交易所上市，母公司为四川成都水井坊集团有限公司，实际控制人为帝亚吉欧。

en.title: Sichuan Swellfun Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu producer in Chengdu, Sichuan. It listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on 6 December 1996; its parent is Sichuan Chengdu Swellfun Group, and Diageo plc is its actual controller.

zh.title: 浙江塔牌绍兴酒有限公司
zh.summary: 位于浙江绍兴的黄酒生产企业，以塔牌品牌经营绍兴酒，公开资料把手工艺冬酿与出口市场作为主要特色；产品属绍兴酒地理标志体系。

en.title: Zhejiang Taipai Shaoxing Rice Wine Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A huangjiu producer in Shaoxing, Zhejiang, making Shaoxing wine under the Taipai brand; public material presents handmade winter brewing and export markets as its main features, within the Shaoxing geographical-indication system.

zh.title: 青岛啤酒股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于山东青岛的啤酒生产企业；前身为 1903 年德国与英国商人创办的日耳曼啤酒公司青岛股份公司，1993 年注册成立股份公司，同年 H 股与 A 股先后上市。

en.title: Tsingtao Brewery Company Limited
en.summary: A brewery based in Qingdao, Shandong. Its predecessor, the Germania Brewery Company Qingdao, was founded by German and British merchants in 1903; the joint-stock company was registered in 1993 and its H shares and A shares were listed the same year.

zh.title: 四川省宜宾五粮液集团有限公司
zh.summary: 位于四川宜宾的白酒企业集团，1998 年由宜宾五粮液酒厂改制组建，旗下上市平台为宜宾五粮液股份有限公司。本页区分集团、上市公司、品牌与产品层级。

en.title: Sichuan Yibin Wuliangye Group Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu group based in Yibin, Sichuan, formed in 1998 from the Yibin Wuliangye Distillery. Its listed arm is Yibin Wuliangye Co., Ltd. This producer separates group, listed company, brand and product.

zh.title: 陕西西凤酒集团股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于陕西宝鸡的白酒企业，前身是 1956 年创建的国营陕西省西凤酒厂；1999 年改制为股份有限公司，2008 年更名为集团股份有限公司，核心产品西凤酒属凤香型。

en.title: Shaanxi Xifeng Liquor Group Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu producer in Baoji, Shaanxi. Its predecessor, the state-run Shaanxi Xifeng Distillery, was founded in 1956; the company became a joint-stock company in 1999 and was renamed a group company in 2008. Its core product Xifengjiu is a feng-aroma baijiu.

zh.title: 贵州习酒股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于贵州习水县习酒镇、赤水河中游的白酒企业；前身可追溯到明代作坊，1952 年组建国营企业，1998 年加入茅台集团，2022 年整体变更设立股份有限公司。

en.title: Guizhou Xijiu Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu producer in Xijiu town, Xishui county, Guizhou, on the middle Chishui River. Its origins reach back to a Ming workshop; the state enterprise was formed in 1952, it joined the Moutai group in 1998, and it became a joint-stock company through a whole-entity conversion in 2022.

zh.title: 江苏洋河集团有限公司
zh.summary: 位于江苏宿迁的白酒企业集团，公开登记信息显示成立于 1997 年 5 月。旗下上市平台为江苏洋河酒厂股份有限公司（002304），2009 年上市。

en.title: Jiangsu Yanghe Group Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A baijiu group based in Suqian, Jiangsu, with public registration showing a May 1997 founding. Its listed arm is Jiangsu Yanghe Distillery Co., Ltd. (002304), listed in 2009.

zh.title: 安徽迎驾贡酒股份有限公司
zh.summary: 位于安徽霍山的浓香型白酒生产企业；股份公司成立于 2003 年，2015 年 5 月在上海证券交易所上市，以生态酿酒为公开定位。

en.title: Anhui Yingjia Distillery Co., Ltd.
en.summary: A strong-aroma baijiu producer in Huoshan, Anhui. The joint-stock company was founded in 2003 and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in May 2015; its public positioning is ecological brewing.

zh.title: 阿佩罗气泡配方（IBA 认可版）
zh.summary: 普罗塞克 90 毫升、阿佩罗 60 毫升与苏打水 30 毫升，按三比二比一在加冰的高脚广口杯中直调，以橙片装饰；本文说明 1919 年的来历、倒酒次序、苏打水的作用与低酒精饮品的误区。

en.title: Aperol Spritz recipe (IBA-approved version)
en.summary: 90 ml Prosecco, 60 ml Aperol and 30 ml soda water built over ice in a large stemmed glass and garnished with an orange slice; this recipe covers the 1919 origin, the pouring order, what the soda actually does and the low-alcohol trap.

zh.title: 大都会配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 40 毫升柠檬伏特加、15 毫升君度、15 毫升鲜榨青柠汁与 30 毫升蔓越莓汁构成大都会的四段比例；本文从 1980 年代的粉红流行、蔓越莓汁的甜酸、摇和滤冰到柠檬皮香气逐项说明。

en.title: Cosmopolitan recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 40 ml citron vodka, 15 ml Cointreau, 15 ml fresh lime juice and 30 ml cranberry juice make the four-part Cosmopolitan ratio; this recipe explains the 1980s pink vogue, the sweetness and acid of cranberry juice, shaking and straining, and the lemon-peel aroma.

zh.title: 代基里配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 60 毫升古巴白朗姆、20 毫升鲜榨青柠汁与 2 吧勺细砂糖，先搅溶糖再加冰摇和，滤入预冷的鸡尾酒杯，官方配方不加装饰；本文说明极简结构里每一步的作用。

en.title: Daiquiri recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 60 ml Cuban white rum, 20 ml fresh lime juice and two bar spoons of fine sugar, stirred to dissolve the sugar and then shaken with ice, strained into a chilled cocktail glass with no garnish in the IBA version; this recipe explains each step of a very simple structure.

zh.title: 干马天尼配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 60 毫升金酒与 10 毫升干味美思加冰搅拌，滤入预冷的马天尼杯，以柠檬皮或绿橄榄装饰；本文说明干度、搅拌、冰与杯型如何共同决定成品。

en.title: Dry Martini recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 60 ml gin and 10 ml dry vermouth stirred over ice and strained into a chilled martini glass, garnished with lemon peel or a green olive; this recipe explains how dryness, stirring, ice and glass shape decide the result.

zh.title: 金菲士配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 45 毫升金酒、30 毫升鲜榨柠檬汁与 10 毫升糖浆先摇后滤，最后补少量苏打水；本文说明为什么苏打水必须最后加、45:30:10 的偏干结构、蛋白版银菲士与气泡流失的原因。

en.title: Gin Fizz recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 45 ml gin, 30 ml fresh lemon juice and 10 ml sugar syrup are shaken and strained before a splash of soda water goes in; this recipe explains why soda comes last, the dry 45:30:10 frame, the egg-white Silver Fizz and the ways carbonation is lost.

zh.title: 迈泰配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 30 毫升琥珀牙买加朗姆加 30 毫升马提尼克糖蜜朗姆，配 15 毫升橙皮库拉索、15 毫升杏仁糖浆、30 毫升青柠汁与 7.5 毫升糖浆；本文讲两种朗姆的分工、提基背景与连冰倒入。

en.title: Mai Tai recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 30 ml amber Jamaican rum plus 30 ml Martinique molasses rum, with 15 ml orange curaçao, 15 ml orgeat, 30 ml lime juice and 7.5 ml sugar syrup; this recipe covers the two-rum division of labour, the tiki background and the pour-with-ice method.

zh.title: 曼哈顿配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 50 毫升黑麦威士忌、20 毫升甜味美思与 1 滴安高天娜苦精，搅拌后滤入冰镇鸡尾酒杯；本文讲 5:2 的骨架、1 滴苦精的作用、为什么搅拌而不摇和，以及稀释与味美思新鲜度。

en.title: Manhattan recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 50 ml rye whiskey, 20 ml sweet vermouth and 1 dash of Angostura bitters, stirred and strained into a chilled cocktail glass; this recipe covers the 5:2 frame, what a single dash does, why the drink is stirred and how dilution and vermouth freshness decide the result.

zh.title: 玛格丽特配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 50 毫升百分之百龙舌兰酒、20 毫升橙皮酒与 15 毫升鲜榨青柠汁摇和，滤入预冷杯，可选半圈盐边；本文说明酸甜平衡、盐边与摇和稀释如何决定成品。

en.title: Margarita recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 50 ml 100% agave tequila, 20 ml orange liqueur and 15 ml fresh lime juice, shaken and strained into a chilled glass with an optional half salt rim; this recipe explains how the sweet-sour balance, the salt rim and dilution decide the drink.

zh.title: 薄荷朱莉普配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 60 毫升波本、4 枝新鲜薄荷、1 茶匙糖粉与 2 茶匙清水，在杯中轻压后加碎冰搅拌至杯壁结霜；本文讲碎冰为何是主体、薄荷的按压手法、霜杯信号与赛马传统。

en.title: Mint Julep recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 60 ml bourbon, 4 fresh mint sprigs, 1 tsp powdered sugar and 2 tsp water, gently pressed in the cup and stirred with crushed ice until the cup frosts; this recipe covers why crushed ice is the body, the pressing technique, the frost signal and the racing tradition.

zh.title: 莫吉托配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 45 毫升古巴白朗姆、20 毫升鲜榨青柠汁、6 枝薄荷、2 茶匙白蔗糖与适量苏打水，在杯中直调，以薄荷枝与青柠片装饰；本文说明轻压、溶糖、冰与气泡的次序。

en.title: Mojito recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 45 ml Cuban white rum, 20 ml fresh lime juice, six mint sprigs, two teaspoons of white cane sugar and soda water, built in the glass and garnished with mint and lime; this recipe explains the order of pressing, dissolving, ice and bubbles.

zh.title: 内格罗尼配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 金酒、金巴利与甜味美思各 30 毫升，搅拌后滤入装有冰块的古典杯，以橙皮装饰；本文说明比例、技法、器具与替换边界。

en.title: Negroni recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 30 ml each of gin, Campari and sweet vermouth, stirred and strained into a rocks glass over ice, garnished with orange peel; this recipe explains ratio, technique, equipment and substitution limits.

zh.title: 古典配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 45 毫升波本或黑麦威士忌、一块方糖、数滴安高天娜苦精与少量清水，在古典杯中直调，以橙皮或橙片、酒渍樱桃装饰；本文说明比例、手法与替换边界。

en.title: Old Fashioned recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 45 ml bourbon or rye whisky, one sugar cube, a couple of dashes of Angostura bitters and a little water, built in a rocks glass and garnished with orange peel or a slice and a cocktail cherry; this recipe explains the ratio, the method and the limits of substitution.

zh.title: 萨泽拉克配方（IBA 干邑版）
zh.summary: 干邑 50 毫升、苦艾酒 10 毫升涮杯、方糖 1 块与佩肖苦精 2 dash，搅拌后滤入预冷古典杯，以柠檬皮装饰；本文说明涮杯、碾糖、冰杯与苦精选择。

en.title: Sazerac recipe (IBA cognac version)
en.summary: 50 ml cognac, 10 ml absinthe for the rinse, 1 sugar cube and 2 dashes of Peychaud's bitters, stirred and strained into a chilled rocks glass with lemon peel; this recipe explains the rinse, the sugar work, the frozen glass and the choice of bitters.

zh.title: 新加坡司令配方（IBA 比例·直调版）
zh.summary: 金酒 30 毫升、樱桃白兰地 15 毫升、君度与本笃会利口酒各 7.5 毫升、菠萝汁 120 毫升、青柠汁 15 毫升、红石榴糖浆 10 毫升与安高天娜苦精 1 dash，直调入高球杯，以菠萝片与樱桃装饰。

en.title: Singapore Sling recipe (IBA proportions, built)
en.summary: 30 ml gin, 15 ml cherry brandy, 7.5 ml each of Cointreau and Bénédictine, 120 ml pineapple juice, 15 ml lime juice, 10 ml grenadine and 1 dash of Angostura bitters, built in a highball glass and garnished with pineapple and cherry.

zh.title: 威士忌酸配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 威士忌酸以 45 毫升波本、25 毫升鲜榨柠檬汁与 20 毫升糖浆构成酸甜骨架，蛋清可选；本文从蛋清的干摇、鲜榨柠檬的香气、摇和程度、杯型与冰，以及吧台常见的偏离讲起。

en.title: Whiskey Sour recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: The Whiskey Sour is built on 45 ml bourbon, 25 ml fresh lemon juice and 20 ml sugar syrup, with egg white optional; this recipe covers the dry shake, the aroma of fresh lemon, how far to shake, glass and ice, and the departures common at the bar.

zh.title: 僵尸配方（IBA 版本）
zh.summary: 45 毫升牙买加深色朗姆、45 毫升波多黎各金色朗姆与 30 毫升德梅拉拉朗姆，配青柠汁、法勒南、Donn's Mix、石榴糖浆、苦精与茴香酒，加碎冰摇和后连冰倒入高球杯；本文说明三款朗姆的分工、两杯上限的来历与碎冰的取舍。

en.title: Zombie recipe (IBA version)
en.summary: 45 ml Jamaican dark rum, 45 ml gold Puerto Rican rum and 30 ml demerara rum with lime juice, falernum, Donn's Mix, grenadine, bitters and pastis, shaken with crushed ice and poured into a highball; this recipe explains the three-rum split, the two-per-customer legend and the crushed-ice trade-off.

zh.title: 阿空加瓜谷
zh.summary: 智利 Aconcagua 产区内 Valle del Aconcagua 子产区，范围覆盖 San Felipe de Aconcagua、Los Andes 与 Quillota 三省，法定 Áreas 包括 Panquehue、Quillota 与 Hijuelas；按 Wines of Chile 的品种面积口径，主要品种合计约 1,500 公顷，以 Cabernet Sauvignon、Carmenère、Sauvignon Blanc 与 Syrah 为主；Aconcagua 河从安第斯山流向太平洋，内陆谷地温暖、昼夜温差大，近海地带更凉；土壤以冲积与崩积物为主；D.O. 与品种标注有比例规则，Reserva 不是质量等级。

en.title: Aconcagua Valley
en.summary: The Valle del Aconcagua sub-region of Chile's Aconcagua region, covering the provinces of San Felipe de Aconcagua, Los Andes and Quillota, with legal areas including Panquehue, Quillota and Hijuelas. On Wines of Chile's variety figures the main varieties total about 1,500 hectares, led by Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenère, Sauvignon Blanc and Syrah. The Aconcagua River runs from the Andes to the Pacific, with a warm inland valley and a large day-night range, and a cooler coastal fringe. Soils are mainly alluvial and colluvial. Reserva is not a quality grade.

zh.title: 阿连特茹
zh.summary: 葡萄牙中南部的大区，气候炎热干燥、土壤从花岗岩到片岩与黏土；以阿拉戈内斯（丹魄）、特林卡德拉与紫北塞为主，是葡萄牙最容易被忽视、也最有性价比的红酒产区之一。

en.title: Alentejo
en.summary: A large region in south-central Portugal with a hot, dry climate and soils from granite to schist and clay; led by Aragonez (Tempranillo), Trincadeira and Alicante Bouschet, it is one of Portugal’s most overlooked and best-value red regions.

zh.title: 阿尔萨斯
zh.summary: 法国东北部、孚日山脉东侧与莱茵河西岸的葡萄酒产区；以雷司令、琼瑶浆、灰皮诺与麝香四大品种著称，多以品种名标注，并设特级园、晚收（VT）与贵腐精选（SGN）分级。

en.title: Alsace
en.summary: A wine region in north-eastern France, east of the Vosges and on the west bank of the Rhine, known for Riesling, Gewürztraminer, Pinot Gris and Muscat, mostly labelled by variety and with Grand Cru, late-harvest (VT) and botrytised selection (SGN) tiers.

zh.title: 安东
zh.summary: 韩国庆尚北道安东地区的传统烧酒产区，以稻米为原料、传统壶式蒸馏；安东烧酒被列为庆尚北道无形文化遗产第12号，酒精度高、风格浓郁，是韩国传统酒的代表之一。

en.title: Andong
en.summary: A traditional soju region in Andong, North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea, made from rice and distilled in a traditional pot still; Andong Soju is designated Gyeongsangbuk-do Intangible Cultural Heritage No. 12, high in alcohol and rich in style, a representative of Korean traditional drink.

zh.title: 安徽省
zh.summary: 中国东部省份，长江与淮河横贯省境；皖北以浓香、兼香白酒见长，亳州古井镇是古井贡酒的产地。

en.title: Anhui
en.summary: A province in eastern China crossed by the Yangtze and Huai rivers; northern Anhui is known for strong-aroma and mixed-aroma baijiu, and Gujing Town in Bozhou is the home of Gujing Gongjiu.

zh.title: 阿根廷
zh.summary: 南美洲第二大葡萄酒生产国，产区从门多萨的高海拔沙漠到巴塔哥尼亚的冷凉河谷；马尔贝克是国际标志，特浓情、赤霞珠、霞多丽与起泡酒也重要。

en.title: Argentina
en.summary: South America’s second-largest wine producer, with regions from the high-altitude deserts of Mendoza to the cool valleys of Patagonia; Malbec is the international signature, with Torrontés, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and sparkling wine also important.

zh.title: 雅文邑
zh.summary: 法国加斯科涅地区的葡萄白兰地产区，以连续式蒸馏器、单一产区与年份装瓶传统著称；下雅文邑、泰纳雷兹与上雅文邑三个分区的风格各有差异。

en.title: Armagnac
en.summary: A grape brandy region in Gascony, France, known for continuous distillation, single-estate bottlings and vintage releases; Bas-Armagnac, Ténarèze and Haut-Armagnac each show different styles.

zh.title: 澳大利亚
zh.summary: 南半球重要的葡萄酒生产国，以东南部与西南部产区为核心；西拉、雷司令与霞多丽风格鲜明，产区标识采用 GI 体系。

en.title: Australia
en.summary: A major wine-producing country in the southern hemisphere, centred on regions in the south-east and south-west; Shiraz, Riesling and Chardonnay show distinctive styles, and appellations use the GI system.

zh.title: 巴登
zh.summary: 德国西南部的法定产区，从陶伯弗兰肯沿莱茵平原延伸到博登湖，全长约 400 公里、2025 年约 15,100 公顷，是德国面积第三大的产区，分为九个分区；Kaiserstuhl 的火山岩、Breisgau 与 Tuniberg 的石灰岩、Markgräflerland 的片麻岩与博登湖的冰川砾石构成多样土壤，Spätburgunder 是最重要的红葡萄，Gutedel 是 Markgräflerland 的地方特色。

en.title: Baden
en.summary: The appellation of south-west Germany, running about 400 kilometres from Tauberfranken along the Rhine plain to Lake Constance and covering about 15,100 hectares in 2025, the third largest wine region in Germany, in nine sub-zones; volcanic rock in the Kaiserstuhl, limestone in Breisgau and Tuniberg, gneiss in Markgräflerland and glacial gravel by Lake Constance create varied soils, Spätburgunder is the leading red variety and Gutedel is the local speciality of Markgräflerland.

zh.title: 巴巴多斯
zh.summary: 加勒比海岛国与朗姆酒的重要产区，以糖蜜、壶式与柱式蒸馏的调配和热带陈年形成较平衡的风格；产地名称不是质量等级。

en.title: Barbados
en.summary: A Caribbean island country and a major rum region, where molasses, blended pot and column distillation and tropical ageing produce a more balanced style; place names are not a grade.

zh.title: 巴罗洛
zh.summary: 意大利皮埃蒙特库内奥省朗格丘陵的红葡萄酒保证法定产区，1980 年 7 月 1 日由总统令升为 DOCG，法定必须使用 100% 内比奥罗；产区覆盖巴罗洛、卡斯蒂廖内法莱托与塞拉伦加达尔巴三个完整市镇，另含八个市镇的部分地块，共 11 个市镇，葡萄园海拔限 170 至 540 米，种植密度至少 3,500 株/公顷，产量上限 8 吨/公顷，最低自然酒精度 12.5%，木桶陈年至少 18 个月、总陈年 38 个月，Riserva 为 62 个月，普通巴罗洛须到采收后第 4 年的 1 月 1 日才可上市。

en.title: Barolo
en.summary: The Barolo DOCG in the Langhe hills of Cuneo province, Piedmont, promoted to DOCG by presidential decree on 1 July 1980 and made purely from Nebbiolo; its zone spans 11 municipalities including Barolo, Castiglione Falletto and Serralunga d'Alba, with vineyards at 170 to 540 metres, minimum density of 3,500 vines per hectare, maximum yield of 8 tonnes per hectare, minimum natural alcohol of 12.5%, 18 months in wood and 38 months total ageing, 62 for Riserva.

zh.title: 巴罗萨
zh.summary: 南澳阿德莱德东北的葡萄酒产区，GI 层级上 Barossa 为包含 Barossa Valley 与 Eden Valley 两个区的 zone；Barossa Valley GI 578 平方公里、葡萄园 11,609 公顷，海拔 112–596 米，Shiraz 约占种植面积一半；Eden Valley GI 591 平方公里、葡萄园 2,169 公顷，海拔 219–632 米，以 Riesling 与 Shiraz 著称；地中海气候，谷底温暖、周边山地凉爽；1843 年已有 Shiraz 种植，2009 年 Barossa Old Vine Charter 按 35/70/100/125 年划分老藤，但属自愿标识、不是质量等级。

en.title: Barossa
en.summary: Wine region north-east of Adelaide, South Australia, and a GI zone containing the Barossa Valley and Eden Valley regions. Barossa Valley GI covers 578 sq km with 11,609 hectares at 112-596 metres, Shiraz about half the plantings; Eden Valley covers 591 sq km with 2,169 hectares at 219-632 metres, known for Riesling and Shiraz. Mediterranean climate, warm on the valley floor and cooler in the hills. Shiraz was planted by 1843, and the 2009 Barossa Old Vine Charter sets tiers at 35, 70, 100 and 125 years, a voluntary label not a quality grade.

zh.title: 巴伐利亚
zh.summary: 德国南部的联邦州，也是世界上啤酒法规最著名的地区之一；1516 年的《啤酒纯度法》规定下发酵啤酒只能用水、麦芽、啤酒花与酵母，但现代法律对上层发酵与进口啤酒留有例外，巴伐利亚啤酒的实际面貌远比一条法规复杂。

en.title: Bavaria
en.summary: A federal state in southern Germany and one of the world's most famous beer-law territories. The 1516 Reinheitsgebot limited bottom-fermented beer to water, malt, hops and yeast, but modern law leaves room for top-fermented and imported beer, so Bavarian brewing is far more varied than a single rule suggests.

zh.title: 博若莱
zh.summary: 法国东部索恩河以西、里昂以北的葡萄酒产区，位于勃艮第以南、马孔内以南；以佳美酿造的红葡萄酒为主，从大区级、博若莱村庄到十个村庄级 cru 逐级细分，南北土壤与风格差异明显。

en.title: Beaujolais
en.summary: A wine region in eastern France, west of the Saône and north of Lyon, south of Burgundy and the Mâconnais. It is mostly red wine from Gamay, divided from regional and Beaujolais-Villages up to ten village crus, with clear differences in soil and style between north and south.

zh.title: 北京
zh.summary: 中国首都的葡萄酒与白酒产区，房山、密云等地有葡萄园，顺义牛栏山与红星二锅头是清香型白酒的代表；城市边缘的葡萄酒庄与老字号酒厂，构成一种少见的“都市酒乡”。

en.title: Beijing
en.summary: The Chinese capital’s wine and baijiu region, with vineyards in Fangshan and Miyun and the light-aroma baijiu producers Niulanshan and Red Star Erguotou in Shunyi; estate wineries on the urban edge and old distilleries make a rare “urban drinks region”.

zh.title: 比利时
zh.summary: 西欧国家，啤酒文化于 2016 年列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录；以修道院艾尔与兰比克自然发酵两条传统最具代表性，前者集中在瓦隆与佛兰德的修道院，后者以布鲁塞尔周边帕约滕兰为中心。

en.title: Belgium
en.summary: A Western European country whose beer culture was inscribed on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2016. Two traditions stand out — Trappist-style abbey ales, centred on monasteries in Wallonia and Flanders, and lambic, a spontaneous-fermentation tradition around Brussels and the Pajottenland.

zh.title: 比埃尔索
zh.summary: 西班牙莱昂省西部的 DO 红酒产区，1988 年 6 月 3 日获临时承认、1989 年 11 月 11 日正式确立；登记葡萄园 2,300 公顷，981 名种植者、69 家酒庄；Mencía 占葡萄产量的 70.5%，葡萄园平均树龄约 75 年；板岩与石英岩坡地、被山地环绕的盆地气候，使酒款兼具成熟红果与草本、矿物气息；Bierzo Alto 与 Bierzo Bajo 是常用地理称呼，不是法定子区。

en.title: Bierzo
en.summary: Red-wine DO in western León, Spain, provisionally recognised on 3 June 1988 and formally confirmed on 11 November 1989. It has 2,300 hectares registered, 981 growers and 69 wineries. Mencía accounts for 70.5% of grape production and the vineyards average about 75 years old. Slate and quartzite slopes and a sheltered basin give wines with ripe red fruit, herbal notes and minerality. Bierzo Alto and Bierzo Bajo are common geographic terms, not legal sub-zones.

zh.title: 波尔多
zh.summary: 法国西南部吉伦特省的葡萄酒产区与港口城市；吉伦特河口分为左岸与右岸，海洋性气候、砾石与黏土石灰岩土壤塑造了以赤霞珠和梅洛为核心的风格。

en.title: Bordeaux
en.summary: A wine region and port city in the Gironde department of south-west France; the Gironde estuary divides the left and right banks, and an oceanic climate with gravel and clay-limestone soils shapes a style centred on Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot.

zh.title: 亳州市
zh.summary: 安徽省西北部的地级市，涡河穿境而过；谯城区古井镇是古井贡酒的产地与古井酒文化博物馆所在地。

en.title: Bozhou
en.summary: A prefecture-level city in northwestern Anhui on the Guo River; Gujing Town in Qiaocheng District is the home of Gujing Gongjiu and the Gujing Wine Culture Museum.

zh.title: 布尔根兰
zh.summary: 奥地利最东部的联邦州级葡萄酒产区，受潘诺尼亚大陆性气候影响，葡萄园约 11,538 公顷；以 Blaufränkisch 红葡萄酒、Leithaberg 的 Pinot Blanc 与 Chardonnay 白葡萄酒，以及新锡德尔湖东岸 Seewinkel 的贵腐甜酒著称；拥有 Mittelburgenland（2005）、Leithaberg、Eisenberg、Neusiedlersee、Rosalia（2018）与 Ruster Ausbruch（2020）六个 DAC。

en.title: Burgenland
en.summary: The easternmost federal-state wine region of Austria, shaped by the hot continental Pannonian climate and covering about 11,538 hectares; known for Blaufränkisch reds, Pinot Blanc and Chardonnay from the Leitha Range, and botrytis sweet wines from the Seewinkel east of Lake Neusiedl; it holds six DACs, Mittelburgenland from 2005, Leithaberg, Eisenberg, Neusiedlersee, Rosalia from 2018 and Ruster Ausbruch from 2020.

zh.title: 勃艮第
zh.summary: 法国东部索恩河以西的葡萄酒产区，以黑皮诺与霞多丽为核心品种；从北到南分为夏布利、金丘、夏隆内丘与马孔内，分级按大区、村庄、一级园与特级园四层划分。

en.title: Burgundy
en.summary: A wine region in eastern France, west of the Saône, built on Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. From north to south it runs through Chablis, the Côte d'Or, the Côte Chalonnaise and the Mâconnais, with four tiers — regional, village, Premier Cru and Grand Cru.

zh.title: 坎贝尔镇
zh.summary: 苏格兰威士忌五个受保护名称中面积最小的一个，法定范围为阿盖尔-比特郡南金泰尔选区；19 世纪曾有三十多家酒厂，如今只剩云顶、格兰帝与格兰吉尔三家，风格以海风、油脂与轻度泥煤为常见线索。

en.title: Campbeltown
en.summary: The smallest of Scotland's five protected whisky names, legally the South Kintyre ward of Argyll and Bute; more than thirty distilleries operated in the Victorian era, while today only Springbank, Glen Scotia and Glengyle remain, with sea air, oil and light peat as common stylistic clues.

zh.title: 加拿大
zh.summary: 加拿大威士忌的国家级类别，以玉米、黑麦与大麦为原料，经糖化、蒸馏并在木桶中陈年至少三年；法规允许加入焦糖与调味酒液（其他烈酒或葡萄酒），其中 9.09% 是年龄声明与出口证书门槛，不是普通成分上限，风格通常柔和、顺口。

en.title: Canada
en.summary: The national Canadian whisky category, made from corn, rye and barley, mashed, distilled and aged at least three years in wood; caramel and flavouring (other spirits or wine) are permitted, and the 9.09% figure is an age-claim and export-certificate threshold rather than a compositional cap; the style is usually soft and approachable.

zh.title: 卡萨布兰卡谷
zh.summary: 智利 Aconcagua 葡萄酒大区内的法定子区 Valle de Casablanca，位于圣地亚哥西北、瓦尔帕莱索方向；1982 年由 Concha y Toro 的酿酒师 Pablo Morandé 率先种下第一批葡萄，1994 年第 464 号法令正式划定；受太平洋寒流与晨雾影响，是智利最早的冷凉气候产区之一；以 Sauvignon Blanc、Chardonnay 与 Pinot Noir 为主，花岗岩黏土与高处避霜地块构成主要风土差异；酒标产地、品种与年份标注须符合智利酒法。

en.title: Casablanca Valley
en.summary: Legal sub-region of Chile's Aconcagua wine region, north-west of Santiago on the road to Valparaíso. It was first planted in 1982 by Concha y Toro winemaker Pablo Morandé and formally defined by Decree 464 in 1994. Pacific cold current and morning fog make it one of Chile's earliest cool-climate regions. Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir lead, with granite clay and frost-free higher sites as the main terroir differences. Origin, variety and vintage claims follow Chilean wine law.

zh.title: 卡瓦
zh.summary: 西班牙以传统法酿造的起泡酒法定产区，名称覆盖加泰罗尼亚佩内德斯及多处授权区域；主要品种为马卡贝奥、沙雷洛与帕雷亚达，常加入霞多丽与黑皮诺，按瓶中带酒泥陈年时间分为 Cava de Guarda 与 Cava de Guarda Superior，最低分别为 9 个月与 18 个月。

en.title: Cava
en.summary: The Spanish appellation for traditional-method sparkling wine, covering Penedès in Catalonia and several other authorised areas; the main varieties are Macabeo, Xarel·lo and Parellada, often with Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, and bottle ageing on the lees splits into Cava de Guarda and Cava de Guarda Superior at minimums of 9 and 18 months.

zh.title: 中奥塔哥
zh.summary: 新西兰最南端的葡萄酒产区，位于南岛内陆的 Otago 地区，围绕 Queenstown、Cromwell 与 Alexandra；2026 年葡萄种植报告口径为种植 2,116 公顷、产果 2,045 公顷，约占全国 5%；Pinot Noir 占葡萄园约 80%，是产区的旗舰品种；半大陆性气候干燥，夏冬温差与昼夜温差都大，霜冻与山地地形决定地块选择；六个次级产区包括 Gibbston、Bannockburn、Cromwell/Lowburn/Pisa、Bendigo、Wanaka 与 Alexandra；Central Otago GI 于 2018 年 10 月注册，酒标适用 85% 规则。

en.title: Central Otago
en.summary: New Zealand's southernmost wine region, inland Otago around Queenstown, Cromwell and Alexandra. The 2026 vineyard report records 2,116 hectares planted and 2,045 producing, about 5% of the national total. Pinot Noir is about 80% of the vineyard and the flagship variety. A dry semi-continental climate with large summer-winter and day-night ranges, frost risk and site selection driven by mountains and lakes. Six sub-regions are Gibbston, Bannockburn, Cromwell/Lowburn/Pisa, Bendigo, Wanaka and Alexandra. The Central Otago GI was registered on 29 October 2018, and labels follow the 85% rule.

zh.title: 夏布利
zh.summary: 勃艮第最北端的白葡萄酒产区，位于约讷省塞兰河谷，葡萄园约 5800 公顷；启莫里阶石灰岩与泥灰岩富含海洋化石，气候偏凉，只种霞多丽，分为小夏布利、夏布利、一级园与特级园四级，特级园只有 7 个地块。

en.title: Chablis
en.summary: The northernmost white-wine region of Burgundy, in the Serein valley of the Yonne, with about 5800 ha of vines. Kimmeridgian limestone and marl rich in marine fossils, a cool climate and Chardonnay alone define it, across four tiers from Petit Chablis to Grand Cru, the latter with only 7 climats.

zh.title: 香槟
zh.summary: 法国北部的起泡酒法定产区，以兰斯与埃佩尔奈为中心；葡萄园分布在兰斯山、马恩河谷、白丘与南部的奥布河岸，以霞多丽、黑皮诺与莫尼耶皮诺酿造，采用瓶内二次发酵的传统法，经酒泥陈年并标注甜度等级。

en.title: Champagne
en.summary: A sparkling wine appellation in northern France, centred on Reims and Épernay, with vineyards in the Montagne de Reims, the Vallée de la Marne, the Côte des Blancs and the Côte des Bar to the south. It is made from Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier by the traditional method of in-bottle second fermentation, aged on the lees and labelled by sweetness level.

zh.title: 教皇新堡
zh.summary: 罗讷河谷南部、阿维尼翁以北的法定产区，1936 年获得 AOC 地位；拉 Crau 台地的 galets roulés 鹅卵石、密史脱拉风与以歌海娜为主体的混酿构成其骨架，法定许可品种常被概括为 13 种，但名单是允许范围而非固定配方。

en.title: Châteauneuf-du-Pape
en.summary: An appellation in the Southern Rhône north of Avignon, granted AOC status in 1936. Galets roulés on the La Crau plateau, the mistral and Grenache-led blends form its backbone; the permitted list is commonly summarised as 13 varieties, but it is a permitted range rather than a fixed recipe.

zh.title: 基安蒂经典
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳佛罗伦萨与锡耶纳之间的红葡萄酒 DOCG，生产区约 71,800 公顷，包括 Castellina in Chianti、Gaiole in Chianti、Greve in Chianti、Radda in Chianti 四个完整市镇与 Barberino Tavarnelle、Castelnuovo Berardenga、Poggibonsi、San Casciano Val di Pesa 四个市镇的部分地块；1716 年 9 月 24 日科西莫三世法令划定边界，1924 年 5 月 14 日 33 家生产者在 Radda 成立保护协会并采用黑公鸡标志，1996 年 8 月 5 日成为独立 DOCG；桑娇维塞最低 80%，Annata 最低酒精度 12%、陈年 12 个月，Riserva 为 12.5%、24 个月，Gran Selezione 最低 90% 桑娇维塞、30 个月，其中 3 个月瓶陈。

en.title: Chianti Classico
en.summary: A red-wine DOCG between Florence and Siena in Tuscany whose zone of about 71,800 hectares covers Castellina, Gaiole, Greve and Radda in Chianti in full plus parts of four other municipalities; a 1716 decree fixed the boundary, 33 producers founded the consortium in Radda on 14 May 1924 and adopted the Black Rooster, and the appellation became an independent DOCG on 5 August 1996; Sangiovese must be at least 80%, Annata 12% alcohol and 12 months, Riserva 12.5% and 24 months, Gran Selezione 30 months.

zh.title: 智利
zh.summary: 南美洲西海岸的葡萄酒生产国，葡萄园约 126,249 公顷（2024 年 SAG 统计，其中酿酒品种 116,961 公顷、Pisco 用 9,287 公顷），红葡萄占 72.5%；产地制度由 1994 年农业部第 464 号法令划定，按 Región Vitícola、Subregión、Zona 与 Área 四级命名；Maipo 位于首都大区，属地中海气候与安第斯山麓冲积土，Cabernet Sauvignon 约 5,517 公顷，是智利红葡萄酒的核心；Casablanca 位于瓦尔帕莱索大区，受太平洋冷雾影响，1982 年首次商业种植，以 Sauvignon Blanc（约 2,235 公顷）与 Chardonnay（约 1,420 公顷）等白葡萄著称。

en.title: Chile
en.summary: A wine-producing country on the west coast of South America, with about 126,249 hectares of vineyards in the 2024 SAG count, of which 116,961 are wine varieties and 9,287 are for Pisco; reds are 72.5%; the origin system comes from Decree 464 of 1994, with four levels from Región Vitícola to Subregión, Zona and Área; Maipo, in the Metropolitan Region, has a Mediterranean climate, Andean alluvial soils and about 5,517 hectares of Cabernet Sauvignon; Casablanca, in Valparaíso, is cooled by Pacific fog, was first planted in 1982 and is known for Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay.

zh.title: 中国
zh.summary: 地区层级中的国家节点；中国酒类以白酒与黄酒最具本土特色，葡萄酒、啤酒与洋酒也已形成规模化市场。

en.title: China
en.summary: The country-level node in the region hierarchy; Chinese drinks are led by baijiu and huangjiu, alongside large wine, beer and imported-spirits markets.

zh.title: 克莱尔谷
zh.summary: 南澳大利亚中北部的狭长谷地，以雷司令与西拉著称；板岩、石灰岩与红土、昼夜温差与老藤，使它成为澳洲雷司令的核心，1990 年代获 GI。

en.title: Clare Valley
en.summary: A narrow valley in the mid-north of South Australia, known for Riesling and Shiraz; slate, limestone and red soils, a wide diurnal range and old vines make it the core of Australian Riesling, with GI status in the 1990s.

zh.title: 干邑
zh.summary: 法国夏朗德地区的葡萄白兰地产区，以白玉霓为主、二次壶式蒸馏与法国橡木桶陈年，形成 VS、VSOP、XO 等最低酒龄等级。

en.title: Cognac
en.summary: A grape brandy region in the Charente area of France, built on Ugni Blanc, double pot distillation and French oak ageing, with VS, VSOP and XO grades defined by minimum age.

zh.title: 科尔查瓜
zh.summary: 智利中央山谷 Valle del Rapel 子产区内的一个 Zona，范围覆盖 Colchagua 省与 Cardenal Caro 省；按 Wines of Chile 的品种面积口径，主要品种合计约 2.86 万公顷，其中 Cabernet Sauvignon 11,928 公顷、Carmenère 3,657 公顷、Merlot 3,132 公顷；地中海气候，内陆温暖干燥、西部近海较凉；土壤以冲积阶地、安第斯山麓沉积物与沿海花岗岩丘陵为主；法定产区内的 Áreas 包括 San Fernando、Chimbarongo、Nancagua、Santa Cruz 等；D.O. 与品种标注有明确比例规则，Reserva 不是质量等级。

en.title: Colchagua
en.summary: Wine zone within the Rapel sub-region of Chile's Central Valley, covering Colchagua and Cardenal Caro provinces. On Wines of Chile's variety figures the main varieties total about 28,600 hectares, led by Cabernet Sauvignon at 11,928, Carmenère at 3,657 and Merlot at 3,132. A Mediterranean climate, warm and dry inland and cooler near the Pacific in the west. Soils are alluvial terraces, Andean foothill deposits and coastal granitic hills. Legal areas include San Fernando, Chimbarongo, Nancagua and Santa Cruz, and Reserva is not a quality grade.

zh.title: 哥伦比亚谷
zh.summary: 美国华盛顿州中南部与东南部、并延伸至俄勒冈州北部的 AVA，1984 年 11 月 13 日正式划定；总面积约 1,100 万英亩（约 450 万公顷），华盛顿州侧葡萄园 60,079 英亩（24,313 公顷），集中了该州 99% 以上的酿酒葡萄面积；年降水仅 6–8 英寸，依赖灌溉；黄土覆盖砾石与冰川湖沉积物，玄武岩为基岩；Cabernet Sauvignon、Chardonnay、Merlot、Riesling 与 Syrah 是主要品种；AVA 标注须至少 85% 来自该区。

en.title: Columbia Valley
en.summary: AVA covering central and south-central Washington, south-eastern Washington and north-central Oregon, formally designated on 13 November 1984. It totals about 11 million acres (roughly 4.5 million hectares), with 60,079 acres (24,313 hectares) of vineyard on the Washington side and over 99% of the state's vinifera acreage. Annual rainfall is only 6–8 inches, so irrigation is essential. Loess over gravel and slackwater sediment sits on basalt bedrock. Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Merlot, Riesling and Syrah lead. An AVA label requires at least 85% from the named area.

zh.title: 康斯坦提亚
zh.summary: 南非西开普 Cape Town District 内的 Ward，位于桌山南坡与 Constantiaberg 东向坡地，靠近 False Bay；1685 年 Simon van der Stel 获授土地并命名 Constantia，1712 年他去世后，庄园于 1716 年分为 Groot Constantia、Klein Constantia 与 Bergvliet 三部分出售；年降雨约 1,000 毫米、2 月均温 20.6 摄氏度，海风与花岗岩风化土使灌溉并非必需；以 Sauvignon Blanc 等白葡萄与 Muscat de Frontignan 甜酒著称，Vin de Constance 在 18 至 19 世纪闻名欧洲；Constantia 是 Ward 而非 District，SAWIS 2024 年将 Constantia 并入 Cape Town 统计区的 2,511 公顷；Wine of Origin 产地须 100%、品种与年份须 85%。

en.title: Constantia
en.summary: Ward of the Cape Town district in the Western Cape, near False Bay. Simon van der Stel was granted the land in 1685 and named it Constantia; it was divided in 1716 into Groot Constantia, Klein Constantia and Bergvliet. Rainfall is about 1,000 mm and the February mean is 20.6 C, so irrigation is rarely needed. Sauvignon Blanc and other whites are important, and Muscat de Frontignan makes the sweet Vin de Constance. Constantia is a ward, not a district; SAWIS reported the Cape Town statistical area at 2,511 hectares in 2024. Wine of Origin requires 100% origin and 85% for variety and vintage.

zh.title: 库纳瓦拉
zh.summary: 南澳大利亚石灰岩海岸的狭长产区，以“terra rossa”红土覆盖石灰岩著称；约 1.2 公里宽、20 公里长的红土带是赤霞珠的核心，2003 年获 GI。

en.title: Coonawarra
en.summary: A narrow region on the Limestone Coast of South Australia, famous for terra rossa red soil over limestone; a strip about 1.2 km wide and 20 km long is the core of its Cabernet Sauvignon, with GI status in 2003.

zh.title: 博讷丘
zh.summary: 勃艮第金丘南段、从 Ladoix-Serrigny 延伸至 Santenay 的白葡萄酒核心产区，与上博讷丘合计葡萄园约 5,000 公顷，含 25 个 AOC，其中 16 个村庄级、8 个特级园与约 300 个一级园；霞多丽是白葡萄酒的主导品种，8 个特级园中只有 Corton 以红葡萄酒为主，伯恩则是酒商制度与拍卖交易的中心。

en.title: Côte de Beaune
en.summary: The white-wine heart of Burgundy's southern Côte d'Or, running from Ladoix-Serrigny to Santenay, with about 5,000 hectares of vines together with the Hautes-Côtes de Beaune and 25 AOCs, including 16 village appellations, 8 grands crus and around 300 premiers crus; Chardonnay dominates the white wines, Corton is the only grand cru mainly producing red wine, and Beaune is the centre of the négociant trade and the region's auction.

zh.title: 夜丘
zh.summary: 勃艮第金丘北段、第戎以南至科尔戈隆之间的红葡萄酒核心产区，与上夜丘合计葡萄园约 3,000 公顷，含 39 个 AOC，其中 14 个村庄级、24 个特级园与约 120 个一级园；黑皮诺占种植面积约 95%，葡萄园沿约 40 公里长的侏罗纪石灰岩坡展开，特级园以 Clos de Vougeot 等为代表。

en.title: Côte de Nuits
en.summary: The red-wine heart of Burgundy's northern Côte d'Or, running from south of Dijon to Corgoloin, with about 3,000 hectares of vines together with the Hautes-Côtes de Nuits and 39 AOCs, including 14 village appellations, 24 grands crus and around 120 premiers crus; Pinot Noir accounts for about 95% of plantings, the vineyards follow a Jurassic limestone slope about 40 km long, and the grands crus include Clos de Vougeot.

zh.title: 罗第丘
zh.summary: 北罗讷河谷最北的红葡萄酒 AOC，位于昂皮与圣西尔-sur-le-Rhône 之间的陡坡上；以西拉为主、可少量混酿维欧尼，分“金丘”与“棕丘”两条坡带，1940 年获 AOC。

en.title: Côte-Rôtie
en.summary: The northernmost red AOC of the Northern Rhône, on steep slopes between Ampuis and Saint-Cyr-sur-le-Rhône; led by Syrah with a little permitted Viognier, divided between the Côte Blonde and Côte Brune, and granted AOC in 1940.

zh.title: 捷克共和国
zh.summary: 中欧内陆国家，皮尔森淡色拉格的原产地；软水、摩拉维亚麦芽与萨兹酒花共同构成捷克啤酒的干净苦味与麦香，啤酒地理标志与“12°”浓度标示是理解当地啤酒的两把钥匙。

en.title: Czech Republic
en.summary: A landlocked country in Central Europe and the home of Pilsner pale lager; soft water, Moravian malt and Saaz hops give Czech beer its clean bitterness and malt character, while geographical indications and the 12° label are the two keys to local beer.

zh.title: 杜罗
zh.summary: 葡萄牙东北部杜罗河谷的葡萄酒法定产区，1756 年完成边界划定，是世界上最早的划界产区之一；葡萄园沿陡坡石墙梯田分布，以片岩土壤和 Touriga Nacional 等品种著称，既生产波特基酒，也生产结构紧致的干型红白葡萄酒。

en.title: Douro
en.summary: A wine appellation in the Douro valley of north-east Portugal, demarcated in 1756 as one of the world's earliest wine regions; vineyards run along steep stone-walled terraces on schist soils, Touriga Nacional and other varieties dominate, and the region makes both Porto base wine and structured dry reds and whites.

zh.title: 汾阳市
zh.summary: 山西省吕梁市下辖的县级市，杏花村汾酒产地；清香型白酒的核心产区，适合把地缸发酵、杏花村历史与酒厂参访放在一条线上理解。

en.title: Fenyang
en.summary: A county-level city under Lüliang in Shanxi and the home of Xinghuacun Fenjiu; a core area of light-aroma baijiu where earthen-jar fermentation, Fenjiu history and distillery visits can be understood together.

zh.title: 手指湖
zh.summary: 纽约州北部的冰川湖群产区，以雷司令、霞多丽与品丽珠著称；塞内卡、卡尤加与库卡湖的深水调节温度，1982 年获 AVA，是北美冷凉气候葡萄酒的核心之一。

en.title: Finger Lakes
en.summary: A glacial-lake district in upstate New York, known for Riesling, Chardonnay and Cabernet Franc; the deep waters of Seneca, Cayuga and Keuka lakes moderate temperature, and the area became an AVA in 1982, making it a core of North American cool-climate wine.

zh.title: 法国
zh.summary: 欧洲重要的葡萄酒与烈酒生产国；以原产地命名制度、多样气候带与多层产区结构著称，AOC/AOP 保证产地与规则，而不是质量排名。

en.title: France
en.summary: A major European producer of wine and spirits, known for its appellation system, diverse climates and layered regions; AOC/AOP guarantees origin and rules, not a quality ranking.

zh.title: 弗兰谷
zh.summary: 西开普省的山谷产区，1688 年法国胡格诺派移民在此定居；以赤霞珠、皮诺塔吉、霞多丽与餐厅著称，山谷狭长、风景集中，是开普酒乡最容易自驾的产区之一。

en.title: Franschhoek
en.summary: A valley region in the Western Cape where French Huguenot settlers arrived in 1688; known for Cabernet Sauvignon, Pinotage, Chardonnay and restaurants, its narrow, scenic valley makes it one of the easiest Cape Winelands regions to drive.

zh.title: 福建省
zh.summary: 中国东南沿海省份，红曲黄酒的重要产区；糯米、红曲与水构成原料基础，福州福建老酒、龙岩沉缸酒与古田红曲是最具代表性的产地与传统。

en.title: Fujian Province
en.summary: A coastal province in south-east China and an important region for hongqu yellow wine; glutinous rice, red yeast rice and water form the base, with Fuzhou, Longyan and Gutian as representative traditions.

zh.title: 伏见
zh.summary: 京都府京都市伏见区的清酒产地，以桃山丘陵伏流水“伏水”、濠川与十石舟、月桂冠与黄樱的酒藏博物馆著称；1889 年伏见酒造家品评会有 35 社出品，是吟醸技术早期传播的重要现场，水质属中硬水而非纯软水。

en.title: Fushimi
en.summary: A sake region in Kyoto City's Fushimi ward, known for the Fushui spring water, the Horikawa canal and Jikkokubune boats, and the Gekkeikan and Kizakura brewery museums; in 1889 a Fushimi brewers' tasting drew 35 exhibitors, making it an early arena for ginjo technique. Its water is medium-hard, not purely soft.

zh.title: 德国
zh.summary: 欧洲中部的葡萄酒与啤酒生产国，13 个法定葡萄酒产区集中在西部与西南部；雷司令是最具代表性的白葡萄品种，啤酒则以大麦、小麦与水为基础。

en.title: Germany
en.summary: A wine- and beer-producing country in central Europe, with 13 official wine regions concentrated in the west and south-west; Riesling is the signature white variety, and beer relies on barley, wheat and water.

zh.title: 格拉夫
zh.summary: 波尔多左岸南部的历史产区，从波尔多市郊向南延伸到朗贡一带；以砾石土、红白兼产与 1953 年格拉夫分级著称，佩萨克-雷奥良在 1987 年从其中独立为更严格的白葡萄酒与红葡萄酒 AOC。

en.title: Graves
en.summary: A historic left-bank district south of Bordeaux, running from the city outskirts toward Langon; known for gravel soils, both red and white wines and the 1953 Graves classification, with Pessac-Léognan split off in 1987 as a stricter red and white AOC.

zh.title: 广东省
zh.summary: 珠江三角洲与粤东山地共同构成的华南省份，豉香型玉冰烧、米香型九江双蒸与客家娘酒并存，是理解中国米酒与低度酒传统的关键产区。

en.title: Guangdong
en.summary: A rice-based southern province of soy-aroma baijiu, rice-aroma rice wine and Hakka sweet yellow rice wine, with a dense Pearl River Delta food and trade network.

zh.title: 广西壮族自治区
zh.summary: 岭南西部的壮族自治区，桂林三花酒与米香型白酒的核心产区；漓江、稻作与湿热气候共同塑造了清、甜、爽的米酒传统。

en.title: Guangxi
en.summary: A karst-and-rice province centred on rice-aroma baijiu, especially Guilin Sanhua, with everyday rice wine and sweet glutinous rice wine alongside.

zh.title: 贵州省
zh.summary: 中国西南省份，赤水河流域是酱香型白酒的核心产区；高粱、小麦、制曲、发酵与蒸馏构成产业基础，仁怀茅台镇是最具代表性的产地。

en.title: Guizhou
en.summary: A province in south-west China where the Chishui River basin is the core region for sauce-aroma baijiu; sorghum, wheat, qu making, fermentation and distillation form the industrial base, and Maotai town in Renhuai is the best-known origin.

zh.title: 古蔺县
zh.summary: 四川盆地南缘、赤水河左岸的县，郎酒与二郎镇所在；从河谷地形、酱香工艺与跨省边界理解这个“嵌入黔北”的四川产区。

en.title: Gulin County
en.summary: A county on the left bank of the Chishui River at the southern edge of the Sichuan Basin, home to Langjiu and Erlang Town; a production area best understood through river-valley geography, sauce-aroma craft and the provincial border.

zh.title: 上梅多克
zh.summary: 波尔多左岸北部的宽泛 AOC，覆盖从布朗克福到圣瑟兰-德卡杜尔讷的梅多克北部，环绕玛歌、圣朱利安、波亚克、圣埃斯泰夫等六个村庄级 AOC；以砾石脊上的赤霞珠为主，是 1855 分级名庄最密集的地带之一。

en.title: Haut-Médoc
en.summary: A broad AOC in the northern Médoc on Bordeaux’s left bank, running from Blanquefort to Saint-Seurin-de-Cadourne and surrounding six communal AOCs including Margaux, Saint-Julien, Pauillac and Saint-Estèphe; Cabernet Sauvignon on gravel ridges dominates, and the area holds many of the 1855 classed growths.

zh.title: 霍克斯湾
zh.summary: 新西兰北岛东海岸的葡萄酒产区，气候温暖干燥、日照长；以赤霞珠/梅洛混酿、西拉与霞多丽著称，Gimblett Gravels 的砾石土是红葡萄酒核心。

en.title: Hawke's Bay
en.summary: A wine region on the east coast of New Zealand’s North Island, warm, dry and sunny; known for Cabernet/Merlot blends, Syrah and Chardonnay, with the gravels of Gimblett Gravels at the core of its reds.

zh.title: 河北
zh.summary: 中国北方葡萄酒产区，核心包括怀来（沙城）与昌黎；气候冷凉干燥、昼夜温差大，以赤霞珠、霞多丽与长城等品牌著称，是中国现代葡萄酒工业最早成形的地区之一。

en.title: Hebei
en.summary: A wine region in northern China, with Huailai (Shacheng) and Changli as cores; a cool, dry climate with a wide diurnal range, known for Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and brands such as Great Wall, it is one of the earliest areas of China’s modern wine industry.

zh.title: 河南省
zh.summary: 黄河中下游的中原省份，豫酒以浓香为主，也有清香、酱香与地方特色酒；小麦、高粱、玉米与便利的水陆交通，共同塑造了河南白酒的产业底色。

en.title: Henan
en.summary: A Central Plain province on the middle Yellow River where strong-aroma baijiu leads, with light, sauce and local styles, and where wheat, sorghum, maize and water shape the base.

zh.title: 埃米塔日
zh.summary: 北罗讷河谷塔恩-埃米塔日镇背后的花岗岩山丘，13 个 lieux-dits 组成；红葡萄酒以西拉为主，白葡萄酒以玛珊与胡珊为主，产量小、陈年潜力长，是罗讷河谷最著名的“山丘”产区之一。

en.title: Hermitage
en.summary: The granite hill behind Tain-l’Hermitage in the Northern Rhône, made up of 13 lieux-dits; reds are mainly Syrah, whites Marsanne and Roussanne, with small volumes and long ageing potential, one of the Rhône’s most famous hill appellations.

zh.title: 高地
zh.summary: 苏格兰面积最大的威士忌法定产区，涵盖大陆北部、西部与东部以及艾雷岛以外的岛屿；内部风格差异极大，沿海常见咸感与烟熏，内陆更多石南蜂蜜与花果香，高地是宽泛的法律产区而非单一风味。

en.title: Highlands
en.summary: The largest Scotch whisky region by area, covering the northern, western and eastern mainland and the islands outside Islay; styles vary widely, from coastal salt and smoke to inland heather, honey and fruit, so Highland is a broad legal region rather than one flavour.

zh.title: 广岛
zh.summary: 日本濑户内海侧的清酒产区，以西条酒藏群、软水酿造法与吟醸传统著称；西条酒藏群于 2024 年被指定为国史迹，安艺津的三浦仙三郎于 1897 年前后确立软水酿造法，吴与安艺津的沿海酒藏则延续了另一条地方脉络。

en.title: Hiroshima
en.summary: A sake region on Japan's Seto Inland Sea coast, known for the Saijo brewery cluster, soft-water brewing, and ginjo tradition; the Saijo cluster was designated a national historic site in 2024, Miura Senzaburo established soft-water brewing around 1897 in Aki-tsu, and the coastal breweries of Kure and Aki-tsu continue another local strand.

zh.title: 湖北省
zh.summary: 中国中部省份，黄酒产区以十堰房县为代表；糯米与小曲为原料，陶缸发酵、甜度偏高，房县黄酒是当地传统名酒，湖北同时也是重要的白酒与米酒产地。

en.title: Hubei Province
en.summary: A central Chinese province whose yellow wine region is represented by Fangxian in Shiyan; glutinous rice and small qu are fermented in clay jars for a fairly sweet style, and Hubei also makes baijiu and low-alcohol rice wine.

zh.title: 湖南省
zh.summary: 洞庭湖以南的华中省份，湿润多山的地理环境孕育了馥郁香、酱香与米酒并存的湘酒版图；酒鬼酒、武陵酒与湘泉是理解湖南白酒的三条线索。

en.title: Hunan
en.summary: A wet, mountainous province where fuyu and sauce-aroma baijiu coexist with rice wine and yellow rice wine, shaped by the Dongting plain, western valleys and rice farming.

zh.title: 猎人谷
zh.summary: 澳大利亚新南威尔士州的历史葡萄酒产区，悉尼以北约两小时车程；温暖湿润、以年轻赛美蓉与猎人谷西拉著称，1990 年代获 GI，是澳洲最古老的商业酒区之一。

en.title: Hunter Valley
en.summary: A historic wine region in New South Wales, Australia, about two hours north of Sydney; warm and humid, known for young Semillon and Hunter Shiraz, with GI status in the 1990s and one of Australia’s oldest commercial wine districts.

zh.title: 兵库县
zh.summary: 日本近畿地方的县，清酒产量长期居全国首位；滩五乡以宫水、山田锦与冬季寒造り形成辛口风格，2018 年获 GI 灘五郷 指定，县内另有姬路、丹波等产地与吟酿、纯米等不同路线。

en.title: Hyogo Prefecture
