en.summary: A prefecture in Japan's Kansai region and long the country's largest sake producer; the five Nada wards combine miyamizu water, Yamada Nishiki rice and winter brewing for a dry style, and the area was designated GI Nadagogo in 2018, while Himeji and Tanba follow other routes.

zh.title: 印度
zh.summary: 印度威士忌的国家级类别，产量居世界前列；原料包括糖蜜中性酒精、谷物与麦芽，风格从大众调和威士忌到单一麦芽都有，热带气候使陈年速度极快。

en.title: India
en.summary: The national Indian whisky category, among the world’s largest by volume; materials include molasses neutral spirit, grain and malt, with styles from mass-market blends to single malts, and a tropical climate that ages whisky very fast.

zh.title: 内蒙古自治区
zh.summary: 中国北方的草原自治区，河套平原的粮食白酒与草原马奶酒并存；河套王、蒙古王与 airag 构成两条完全不同的饮酒传统。

en.title: Inner Mongolia
en.summary: A northern province of Hetao grain baijiu and grassland fermented mare's-milk wine, with strong aroma on the plain and airag in pastoral life.

zh.title: 爱尔兰
zh.summary: 欧洲西北部岛国，啤酒传统以干型世涛与爱尔兰红色艾尔为代表；都柏林吉尼斯自 1759 年沿用至今，大麦、水与本地酒花构成原料基础，精酿复兴带来新的风格。

en.title: Ireland
en.summary: An island nation in north-west Europe whose beer tradition is led by dry stout and Irish red ale; Guinness has brewed in Dublin since 1759, with barley, water and hops as the base, and craft brewing has added new styles.

zh.title: 岛屿区
zh.summary: 苏格兰威士忌的“岛屿区”并非法定产区，而是除艾莱岛以外的岛屿蒸馏厂集合，包括 Arran、Jura、Skye、Lewis、Orkney 等；风格从轻盈花香到泥煤海风都有，不能用一个味道概括。

en.title: Islands
en.summary: The “Islands” of Scotch whisky are not a legal region but a grouping of island distilleries outside Islay, including Arran, Jura, Skye, Lewis and Orkney; styles range from light and floral to peated and maritime, so no single flavour defines them.

zh.title: 艾雷岛
zh.summary: 苏格兰内赫布里底群岛中的威士忌岛屿产区，面积约 600 平方公里，人口约 3200；泥炭烘麦带来的酚类、海风与长时间陈年构成其常见印象，但岛上也有无泥煤与轻泥煤酒款，不能把艾雷岛简单等同于重泥煤。

en.title: Islay
en.summary: A whisky island in the Inner Hebrides, about 600 square kilometres in area with a population of roughly 3200. Phenols from peat-dried malt, sea air and long maturation shape its image, yet the island also makes unpeated and lightly peated whisky, so Islay is not simply a synonym for heavy peat.

zh.title: 意大利
zh.summary: 南欧重要的葡萄酒生产国，20 个大区几乎都产酒；以本土品种、DOCG/DOC/IGT 分级与从起泡酒到苦味酒的多样风格著称。

en.title: Italy
en.summary: A major wine-producing country in southern Europe, with vineyards in almost all of its 20 regions; known for native grape varieties, the DOCG/DOC/IGT hierarchy and a range of styles from sparkling wine to bitter aperitifs.

zh.title: 伊塔塔谷
zh.summary: 智利 Sur 产区内 Valle del Itata 子产区，范围覆盖 Ñuble 与 Biobío 一带，法定 Áreas 包括 Chillán、Quillón、Portezuelo 与 Coelemu；按 Wines of Chile 的品种面积口径，主要品种合计约 1 万公顷，País 3,877 公顷、Moscatel de Alejandría 3,675 公顷、Cinsault 831 公顷；地中海气候受太平洋影响，冬季多雨、夏季干燥，大量老藤为旱作；土壤以花岗岩、火山沉积与片岩为主；法令另设 Secano Interior 特殊 D.O. 名称，D.O. 与品种标注有比例规则，Reserva 不是质量等级。

en.title: Itata Valley
en.summary: The Valle del Itata sub-region of Chile's Sur region, covering parts of Ñuble and Biobío, with legal areas including Chillán, Quillón, Portezuelo and Coelemu. On Wines of Chile's variety figures the main varieties total about 10,000 hectares, led by País at 3,877, Moscatel de Alejandría at 3,675 and Cinsault at 831. A Mediterranean climate moderated by the Pacific, with wet winters and dry summers, and many old vines are dry-farmed. Soils are granite, volcanic deposits and schist, and the decree also defines the Secano Interior special D.O. Reserva is not a quality grade.

zh.title: 牙买加
zh.summary: 加勒比海岛国与朗姆酒的重要产区；以糖蜜、长时间发酵与壶式蒸馏形成高酯、厚重的“funky”风格，同时也生产轻盈的白朗姆。

en.title: Jamaica
en.summary: A Caribbean island country and a major rum region, known for molasses, long fermentation and pot distillation that produce a high-ester, heavy funky style, alongside lighter white rum.

zh.title: 日本
zh.summary: 东亚岛国，以清酒最具代表性；烧酒、威士忌与啤酒也形成规模，清酒的特定名称酒按精米步合与添加物分类，标签由国税厅管理。

en.title: Japan
en.summary: An island country in East Asia best known for sake; shochu, whisky and beer are also established, and sake's specific-name categories are classified by polishing ratio and additives under National Tax Agency labelling rules.

zh.title: 济州
zh.summary: 韩国济州岛的烧酒与地方酒产区，以火山岩地下水、稻米与柑橘等地方原料著称；济州烧酒风格比本土稀释式烧酒更柔和，火山岛的风土与旅游场景紧密结合。

en.title: Jeju
en.summary: The soju and local-drink region of Jeju Island, South Korea, known for volcanic groundwater, rice and local ingredients such as citrus; Jeju soju is softer than mainland diluted soju, and the island’s volcanic terroir is closely tied to tourism.

zh.title: 赫雷斯
zh.summary: 西班牙安达卢西亚加的斯省南部的加强酒产区，包含赫雷斯-谢雷斯-雪莉与曼萨尼亚-桑卢卡尔-德巴拉梅达两个法定产区；以帕洛米诺为主，用 solera 与 criaderas 的叠桶系统熟成，按酒花生物陈酿与氧化陈酿两条路径分出 Fino、Manzanilla、Amontillado、Oloroso 与 Palo Cortado 等酒种。

en.title: Jerez
en.summary: A fortified-wine region in southern Cádiz, Andalusia, Spain, comprising the Jerez-Xérès-Sherry and Manzanilla-Sanlúcar de Barrameda appellations; based on Palomino and aged in the solera and criaderas system, with biological ageing under flor and oxidative ageing producing Fino, Manzanilla, Amontillado, Oloroso and Palo Cortado.

zh.title: 江苏省
zh.summary: 中国东部沿海省份，黄酒的重要产区之一；丹阳封缸酒以糯米与麦曲酿造、封缸陈酿，甜型风格突出，无锡一带也有惠泉酒等传统名酒。

en.title: Jiangsu Province
en.summary: An eastern coastal province and one of China's important yellow wine regions; Danyang sealed-jar wine uses glutinous rice and wheat qu with sealed ageing for a sweet style, and Wuxi has traditions such as Huiquan wine.

zh.title: 江西省
zh.summary: 鄱阳湖与赣江流域构成的华东省份，四特酒与特香型是江西白酒的识别符号；大米、红壤与湿热气候，塑造了浓清酱兼具的复合风格。

en.title: Jiangxi
en.summary: A rice-based Jiangnan province defined by te-aroma baijiu, red-stone pits and a composite fragrance, with strong and light aroma also present.

zh.title: 即墨
zh.summary: 山东半岛西南部、今属青岛市即墨区的黍米黄酒产区；以黍米、陈伏麦曲与焦糜法形成偏焦香、醇厚的北方黄酒风格。

en.title: Jimo
en.summary: A glutinous-millet huangjiu region in the southwest of the Shandong Peninsula, now part of Qingdao. Millet, summer-made aged wheat qu and the jiaomi method give a toasted, full-bodied northern huangjiu.

zh.title: 汝拉
zh.summary: 法国东部、勃艮第与瑞士之间的葡萄酒产区，以石灰岩与泥灰岩坡地、萨瓦涅与普尔萨、特鲁索等本地品种著称；黄酒（vin jaune）与稻草酒是标志性产品，法定产区包括 Arbois、Château-Chalon、Côtes du Jura、L'Étoile 与 Crémant du Jura。

en.title: Jura
en.summary: A wine region in eastern France between Burgundy and Switzerland, known for limestone and marl slopes and local varieties such as Savagnin, Poulsard and Trousseau; vin jaune and vin de paille are its signatures, and it also has appellations for red, white and sparkling wines.

zh.title: 鹿儿岛
zh.summary: 日本九州南部的本格烧酒核心产区，以萨摩芋烧酒为主，使用白曲、黑曲或黄曲，经两次仕込み与单式蒸馏制成；县内酒藏超过 80 家、本格烧酒铭柄超过 2000 种，常压与减压蒸馏、甕贮藏和 25 度产品惯例构成其风味与市场特征。

en.title: Kagoshima
en.summary: The core honkaku shochu region of southern Kyushu, centred on Satsuma sweet-potato shochu made with white, black, or yellow koji through a two-stage mash and pot-still distillation; the prefecture has more than 80 breweries and over 2000 honkaku shochu labels, with atmospheric and vacuum distillation, kame storage, and a 25-degree product convention shaping its flavour and market.

zh.title: 肯塔基州
zh.summary: 美国中东部州，波本威士忌产量最集中的地区，约占全球波本供应的 95%；以玉米配方、全新烘烤橡木桶与石灰岩水源著称，但波本是全美法定类别，肯塔基并非其法律同义词。

en.title: Kentucky
en.summary: A US state and the dominant production area for bourbon, with about 95% of global bourbon supply; known for corn-based mashbills, new charred oak and limestone water, though bourbon is a nationwide US category and Kentucky is not a legal synonym.

zh.title: 京都
zh.summary: 京都府域的日本清酒产区总称，府内分为洛中、伏见、京都丹波、宫津、福知山与京丹后峰山等酒藏组合；洛中以 1893 年创业的佐佐木酒造等小型藏元为代表，酒风与京都料理、寺院精进料理和渍物文化紧密相连。

en.title: Kyoto
en.summary: A prefecture-wide name for sake in Kyoto, divided into Rakuchu, Fushimi, Kyoto Tanba, Miyazu, Fukuchiyama, and Kyotango-Mineyama brewing associations; Rakuchu is represented by small breweries such as Sasaki Shuzo, founded in 1893, and Kyoto sake is closely tied to Kyoto cuisine, temple vegetarian food, and pickles.

zh.title: 卢瓦尔河谷
zh.summary: 法国西部沿卢瓦尔河分布的葡萄酒产区带；从南特到中央-卢瓦尔跨越不同气候与土壤，以白诗南、长相思、品丽珠与佳美为核心品种，涵盖干白、甜酒、红葡萄酒与起泡酒。

en.title: Loire Valley
en.summary: A wine region band along the Loire river in western France, stretching from Nantes to the Centre-Loire across different climates and soils, with Chenin Blanc, Sauvignon Blanc, Cabernet Franc and Gamay as core varieties and a range of dry whites, sweet wines, reds and sparkling wines.

zh.title: 低地
zh.summary: 苏格兰威士忌五个受保护产区之一，范围在邓迪与格里诺克一线以南；常被概括为青草、柑橘与奶油般的清淡风格，但产区内部既有三次蒸馏的老酒厂，也有农场型新酒厂，清淡只是起点而非规则。

en.title: Lowland
en.summary: One of the five protected Scotch whisky regions, lying south of a line between Dundee and Greenock; often summarised as grassy, citrusy and creamy, yet home both to old triple-distilling sites and to farm-scale newcomers, so lightness is a starting point rather than a rule.

zh.title: 泸州市
zh.summary: 长江与沱江交汇处的川南城市，泸州老窖与浓香型白酒的核心产地；适合观察老窖池、江运与城市酒业如何相互塑造。

en.title: Luzhou
en.summary: A city at the meeting of the Yangtze and Tuo rivers in southern Sichuan and a core area of Luzhou Laojiao and strong-aroma baijiu; a place to see old cellars, river transport and urban liquor production together.

zh.title: 马贡
zh.summary: 勃艮第南部的白葡萄酒产区，以霞多丽为主，覆盖马贡、普伊-富赛、圣韦朗、维雷-克莱塞等 AOC；石灰岩与黏土坡地、合作社传统与较高的产量，使它成为勃艮第白葡萄酒最容易入门的产区之一。

en.title: Mâconnais
en.summary: The southern Burgundy white-wine region, dominated by Chardonnay and covering Mâcon, Pouilly-Fuissé, Saint-Véran and Viré-Clessé; limestone and clay slopes, a cooperative tradition and higher volumes make it one of the most accessible entry points to Burgundy white.

zh.title: 马德拉
zh.summary: 葡萄牙马德拉岛出产的加强酒法定产区，以高酸度、长时间熟成与加热氧化风格著称；贵族品种 Sercial、Verdelho、Bual 与 Malvasia 按甜度从干到甜排列，Tinta Negra 用于多数量产酒，熟成分为 estufagem 加热槽与 canteiro 自然阁楼两条路径，按 3、5、10、15、20 年分级。

en.title: Madeira
en.summary: A fortified-wine appellation from the Portuguese island of Madeira, known for high acidity, long ageing and a heated oxidative style; the noble varieties Sercial, Verdelho, Bual and Malvasia run from dry to sweet, Tinta Negra makes most volume wines, and ageing follows either estufagem heated tanks or canteiro natural lofts, graded at 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20 years.

zh.title: 迈坡
zh.summary: 智利中央山谷（Valle Central）内的法定子区 Valle del Maipo，围绕圣地亚哥，是智利葡萄酒业的传统中心；1851 年 Silvestre Ochagavía 引入法国品种，被视为现代智利葡萄酒的起点；1883 年 Concha y Toro 等酒庄相继建立；按 Peñín 统计葡萄园 12,216 公顷，Cabernet Sauvignon 为主导红品种；地形从安第斯山麓延伸到海岸丘陵，Alto Maipo 海拔更高、更凉爽，沿岸地带受海洋影响；产地与品种标注依第 464 号法令与酒法执行。

en.title: Maipo
en.summary: Legal sub-region of Chile's Valle Central around Santiago, and the traditional centre of the Chilean wine industry. In 1851 Silvestre Ochagavía introduced French varieties, the accepted starting point of modern Chilean wine; Concha y Toro was founded in 1883. Peñín records 12,216 hectares, with Cabernet Sauvignon the leading red. The land runs from Andean foothills to coastal hills, with cooler Alto Maipo and ocean-influenced coastal sites. Origin and variety claims follow Decree 464 and Chilean wine law.

zh.title: 玛格丽特河
zh.summary: 西澳西南角的葡萄酒产区，三面环海、地理上高度孤立；GI 面积 2,137 平方公里、葡萄园 5,725 公顷（行业协会 2024 年口径 5,840 公顷），海拔 0–234 米，生长季降雨约 202 毫米；强海洋性地中海气候，昼夜温差小、热量积累均匀，Wine Australia 形容其干旱年份类似波尔多；土壤为花岗岩与片麻岩上的砾质壤土，保水能力低；Cabernet Sauvignon、Chardonnay、Semillon 与 Sauvignon Blanc 为主，产量约占全国压榨量 2%。

en.title: Margaret River
en.summary: Wine region at the south-west corner of Western Australia, bounded by ocean and highly isolated. The GI covers 2,137 sq km with 5,725 hectares of vineyard (5,840 hectares on the 2024 association basis), from sea level to 234 metres, and 202 mm of growing-season rain. A maritime Mediterranean climate with a small day-night range and even heat accumulation, compared by Wine Australia to Bordeaux in a dry year. Gravelly loam over granite and gneiss has low water-holding capacity. Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Semillon and Sauvignon Blanc lead; the region makes about 2% of the national crush.

zh.title: 玛歌
zh.summary: 吉伦特河口左岸梅多克南段的红葡萄酒法定产区，1954 年 8 月 10 日获 AOC 地位，范围覆盖 Margaux、Cantenac、Labarde、Arsac 与 Soussans 五个公社；1855 年分级中玛歌酒庄（Château Margaux）为一级庄，另有 Rauzan-Ségla、Rauzan-Gassies、Durfort-Vivens、Lascombes 与 Brane-Cantenac 五座二级庄，法定最低自然酒精度 11%，产量上限 57 百升/公顷、封顶 63 百升/公顷。

en.title: Margaux
en.summary: A red-wine AOC on the left bank of the Gironde in the southern Médoc, recognised on 10 August 1954 and covering five communes, Margaux, Cantenac, Labarde, Arsac and Soussans; the 1855 classification lists Château Margaux as a first growth and Rauzan-Ségla, Rauzan-Gassies, Durfort-Vivens, Lascombes and Brane-Cantenac as second growths, and the rules set a minimum natural alcohol of 11%, a yield of 57 hl/ha with a ceiling of 63 hl/ha.

zh.title: 马尔堡
zh.summary: 新西兰南岛东北端的葡萄酒产区，全国最大的葡萄酒产区；2026 年葡萄种植报告口径为种植 32,191 公顷，占全国 73%，产果 31,603 公顷，有 1,134 个葡萄园；气候凉爽但日照充足、降雨少，土壤排水良好而肥力中等；Wairau Valley、Southern Valleys 与 Awatere Valley 三个次级产区在土壤、温度与风力上差异明显；Sauvignon Blanc 为主导品种，1980 年代凭此打开国际市场；Marlborough GI 于 2018 年注册，酒标单一品种、年份与产区标注适用 85% 规则。

en.title: Marlborough
en.summary: Marlborough wine region at the north-east end of New Zealand's South Island, the country's largest. The 2026 report records 32,191 hectares planted, 73% of the national total, and 31,603 hectares producing across 1,134 vineyards. Cool but sunny, low rainfall, free-draining moderately fertile soils. Three sub-regions, Wairau Valley, Southern Valleys and Awatere Valley, differ in soil, temperature and wind. Sauvignon Blanc leads, and it opened New Zealand's export market in the 1980s. The Marlborough GI was registered in 2018, and single variety, vintage or region claims require 85%.

zh.title: 马丁堡
zh.summary: 新西兰北岛怀拉拉帕地区的精品产区，1980 年代由 Ata Rangi、Chateau Martinborough 等先驱建立；以黑皮诺著称，气候冷凉、秋季干燥，产量小、酒庄集中。

en.title: Martinborough
en.summary: A boutique region in the Wairarapa, North Island, New Zealand, established in the 1980s by pioneers such as Ata Rangi and Chateau Martinborough; known for Pinot Noir, with a cool climate, dry autumn, small volumes and a compact cluster of estates.

zh.title: 马提尼克
zh.summary: 加勒比海小安的列斯群岛中的法属岛屿，农业朗姆（rhum agricole）的唯一 AOC 产区；1996 年 11 月 5 日法令确立规则，火山土壤、34 个公社的甘蔗带、120 小时发酵上限与克里奥尔柱蒸馏共同塑造其草本而干爽的风格。

en.title: Martinique
en.summary: A French island in the Lesser Antilles and the only AOC region for rhum agricole; the decree of 5 November 1996 set the rules, and volcanic soils, a 34-commune cane belt, a 120-hour fermentation limit and Creole column stills shape its grassy, dry style.

zh.title: 麦克拉伦谷
zh.summary: 南澳大利亚福勒里厄半岛北部的产区，地中海气候、老藤与多样土壤；以西拉、歌海娜、赤霞珠与霞多丽著称，1997 年获 GI，是澳洲“温暖气候”风格的代表。

en.title: McLaren Vale
en.summary: A region in the northern Fleurieu Peninsula, South Australia, with a Mediterranean climate, old vines and diverse soils; known for Shiraz, Grenache, Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay, it received GI status in 1997 and represents Australia’s warm-climate style.

zh.title: 门多萨
zh.summary: 阿根廷门多萨省的葡萄酒产区，位于安第斯山脉东麓，葡萄园约 146,815 公顷（2021 年 INV 统计），占全国葡萄园面积的 75.8%；气候干旱，年降雨约 220 毫米，依赖安第斯融雪灌溉，葡萄园海拔约 650–1,500 米，Valle de Uco 高处可达 1,500 米；Malbec 约 39,248 公顷，占全省葡萄园的 26.7%、全国 Malbec 面积的 20.2%；分为 Valle de Uco、Primera Zona 与北部、东部、南部绿洲五个子区，设 Luján de Cuyo 与 San Rafael 两个 DOC，另有 Agrelo、Las Compuertas、Paraje Altamira 等 IG。

en.title: Mendoza
en.summary: A wine region in Mendoza Province, Argentina, on the eastern foothills of the Andes, with about 146,815 hectares of vineyards in the 2021 INV count, 75.8% of the national total; a dry climate with about 220 mm of rain and Andean snowmelt irrigation, and vineyards from about 650 to 1,500 metres; Malbec covers about 39,248 hectares, 26.7% of the province and 20.2% of the national Malbec area; five sub-regions, the Valle de Uco, Primera Zona and the northern, eastern and southern oases, with DOCs Luján de Cuyo and San Rafael and IGs such as Agrelo and Paraje Altamira.

zh.title: 绵竹市
zh.summary: 四川盆地西北缘、龙门山前的县级市，剑南春的产地；把“名酒之乡”与年画、山地和震后记忆放在同一条城市线上理解。

en.title: Mianzhu
en.summary: A county-level city at the northwestern edge of the Sichuan Basin and the foothills of the Longmen Mountains, home to Jiannanchun; a place to read the “hometown of famous liquor” alongside New Year prints, mountain geography and the memory of the 2008 earthquake.

zh.title: 蒙塔希诺
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳锡耶纳省蒙塔希诺市镇的红葡萄酒保证法定产区，1980 年 7 月 1 日由总统令升为 DOCG，法定仅用 100% 桑娇维塞（当地称 Brunello）；产量上限每公顷 80 公担（约 52 百升/公顷），出酒率 68%，最低酒精度 12.5%，总酸 5 克/升，净干浸出物 26 克/升，木桶至少 2 年、瓶陈至少 4 个月，须到采收后第 5 年 1 月 1 日上市，Riserva 瓶陈 6 个月并晚一年上市。

en.title: Montalcino
en.summary: A red-wine DOCG of the municipality of Montalcino in Siena province, Tuscany, raised to guaranteed designation of origin by presidential decree on 1 July 1980 and made only from 100% Sangiovese, locally called Brunello; the yield ceiling is 80 quintals per hectare (about 52 hl/ha), the yield in wine is 68%, minimum alcohol is 12.5%, total acidity 5 g/L and net dry extract 26 g/L, with at least 2 years in wood and 4 months in bottle, release on 1 January of the fifth year after harvest, and for Riserva at least 6 months in bottle and one year later on the market.

zh.title: 摩泽尔
zh.summary: 德国摩泽尔河及其支流萨尔、鲁维尔河谷的法定产区，以陡峭板岩坡地上的雷司令著称；按采收时葡萄汁含糖量分为 Kabinett、Spätlese、Auslese、Beerenauslese、Trockenbeerenauslese 与 Eiswein 六级，摩泽尔雷司令的法定下限约为 73、80、88、110、128 与 120 °Oe；酒标另以 trocken 与 halbtrocken 标示干型与半干，Prädikat 等级本身不决定甜度。

en.title: Mosel
en.summary: The German appellation of the Mosel river and its Saar and Ruwer tributaries, known for Riesling on steep slate slopes; Prädikatswein is graded by must weight at harvest into Kabinett, Spätlese, Auslese, Beerenauslese, Trockenbeerenauslese and Eiswein, with Mosel Riesling thresholds of about 73, 80, 88, 110, 128 and 120 °Oe; labels also carry trocken and halbtrocken to mark dry and semi-dry, and the Prädikat level itself does not determine sweetness.

zh.title: 纳帕谷
zh.summary: 加州纳帕县内的葡萄酒产区，1981 年成为加州第一个 AVA，谷地约 30 英里长、最宽 5 英里，葡萄园海拔从海平面到约 800 米；2025 年结实面积 42,937 英亩（约 17,376 公顷），Cabernet Sauvignon 约 25,000 英亩（10,117 公顷，占葡萄园 54%）；属地中海气候，南部受 San Pablo Bay 冷雾影响、北部更暖，有 33 个土壤系列；含 16 个已批准的子产区，如 Carneros、Oakville、Rutherford、Stags Leap District、Howell Mountain 与 Calistoga；葡萄产量仅占加州的 4%。

en.title: Napa Valley
en.summary: A wine region in Napa County, California, the state's first AVA (1981); the valley is about 30 miles long and 5 miles wide, with vineyards from sea level to about 800 metres; the 2025 bearing area was 42,937 acres, about 17,376 hectares, and Cabernet Sauvignon covers about 25,000 acres, 10,117 hectares or 54% of the vineyard; a Mediterranean climate, cooler in the south under San Pablo Bay fog and warmer in the north, with 33 soil series; 16 approved sub-appellations such as Oakville, Rutherford, Stags Leap District and Calistoga; Napa grows only 4% of California's wine grapes.

zh.title: 荷兰
zh.summary: 欧洲西北部的低地国家，莱茵河与马斯河在此入海；皮尔森啤酒主导市场，喜力 1864 年创立于阿姆斯特丹，jenever 是受欧盟保护的传统烈酒，葡萄酒则是气候边缘的小产业。理解荷兰酒类，必须同时看啤酒、烈酒与葡萄酒三条线。

en.title: Netherlands
en.summary: A low-lying country in north-west Europe where the Rhine and Meuse reach the sea. Pilsner dominates the beer market, Heineken was founded in Amsterdam in 1864, jenever is a protected traditional spirit, and wine remains a small, marginal-climate industry. Dutch drinking has to be read across beer, spirits and wine at once.

zh.title: 新西兰
zh.summary: 南太平洋岛国，葡萄酒以马尔堡长相思与中奥塔哥黑皮诺最具国际认知；海洋性气候与较长生长季塑造清爽、酸度清晰的风格。

en.title: New Zealand
en.summary: An island country in the South Pacific whose wines are best known internationally for Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc and Central Otago Pinot Noir; an oceanic climate and a long growing season shape fresh, clear-edged styles.

zh.title: 尼亚加拉
zh.summary: 加拿大安大略省南部的葡萄酒产区，位于尼亚加拉断崖与安大略湖之间；以雷司令、霞多丽、品丽珠与冰酒著称，VQA 体系严格，是加拿大葡萄酒的核心。

en.title: Niagara Peninsula
en.summary: A wine region in southern Ontario, Canada, between the Niagara Escarpment and Lake Ontario; known for Riesling, Chardonnay, Cabernet Franc and icewine, with a strict VQA system, it is the core of Canadian wine.

zh.title: 新潟
zh.summary: 日本海侧的清酒大县，以越后杜氏、雪国低温长期发酵与“淡丽辛口”著称；1957 年诞生的酒造好适米五百万石、1984 年设立的新潟清酒学校，以及南鱼沼、十日町等地的酒藏分布，共同构成新潟清酒的技术与地理基础。

en.title: Niigata
en.summary: A major sake prefecture on the Sea of Japan side, known for Echigo toji, snow-country low-temperature long fermentation, and the tanrei karakuchi style; the sake rice Gohyakumangoku, born in 1957, the Niigata Sake School founded in 1984, and breweries in Minami-Uonuma and Tokamachi form its technical and geographic base.

zh.title: 宁夏
zh.summary: 中国宁夏回族自治区以贺兰山东麓为核心的葡萄酒产区，南北绵延近 200 公里，葡萄园多分布在海拔约 1100 米的洪积扇与砾石坡地，干旱少雨、日照充足；《宁夏回族自治区贺兰山东麓葡萄酒产区保护条例》2012 年制定、2024 年修订，为产区范围、种苗与产品质量提供制度框架。

en.title: Ningxia
en.summary: A wine region in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region of China, centred on the eastern foothills of the Helan Mountains; the corridor runs nearly 200 km north to south, most vineyards sit at about 1100 m on alluvial fans and gravel slopes, and the regional protection regulation was adopted in 2012 and revised in 2024, setting the framework for area, vine material and product quality.

zh.title: 瓦哈卡
zh.summary: 墨西哥南部的州，也是梅斯卡尔产量最大的生产带；中央谷地的 espadín 与野生龙舌兰、土坑烘烤、tahona 石磨、自然发酵与铜制或陶制蒸馏构成其工艺底色。梅斯卡尔是全国性原产地命名，瓦哈卡只是其中最重要的产区，两者不能划等号。

en.title: Oaxaca
en.summary: A southern Mexican state and the largest mezcal-producing belt, where espadín and wild agaves meet earthen pit roasting, tahona milling, spontaneous fermentation and copper or clay distillation. Mezcal is a national designation and Oaxaca is its leading region, not a synonym for the spirit.

zh.title: 欧肯那根
zh.summary: 加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省南部的狭长湖谷，北接沙漠、南接美国边境；湖水调节温度、日照长，以灰皮诺、梅洛、赤霞珠与冰酒著称，是加拿大第二大葡萄酒产区。

en.title: Okanagan Valley
en.summary: A long lake valley in southern British Columbia, Canada, running from desert-like country near the north to the US border in the south; the lake moderates temperature and sunlight is long, and the valley is known for Pinot Gris, Merlot, Cabernet and icewine, Canada’s second-largest wine region.

zh.title: 冲绳
zh.summary: 日本冲绳县的泡盛产区，以稻米与黑曲霉（black koji）为原料，经单式蒸馏与长期陈年；泡盛是日本最古老的蒸馏酒之一，那霸、首里与石垣岛是主要产地。

en.title: Okinawa
en.summary: The awamori region of Okinawa, Japan, made from rice and black koji through single distillation and long ageing; awamori is one of Japan’s oldest distilled drinks, with Naha, Shuri and Ishigaki as main centres.

zh.title: 帕尔
zh.summary: 西开普省伯格河畔的温暖产区，花岗岩山体与河谷构成风土；以皮诺塔吉、白诗南、赤霞珠与历史酒庄著称，Nederburg、KWV 与 Fairview 是常见名字。

en.title: Paarl
en.summary: A warm region on the Berg River in the Western Cape, with granite mountains and river valley terroir; known for Pinotage, Chenin Blanc, Cabernet Sauvignon and historic estates, with Nederburg, KWV and Fairview among familiar names.

zh.title: 帕索罗布尔斯
zh.summary: 加州中央海岸北部的 AVA，白天炎热、夜晚凉爽，以仙粉黛、赤霞珠与西拉著称；1983 年获 AVA，现有 11 个子 AVA，石灰岩与冲积土使风格比一般加州酒更紧。

en.title: Paso Robles
en.summary: An AVA in the northern Central Coast of California with hot days and cool nights, known for Zinfandel, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah; established in 1983, it has been divided into 11 sub-AVAs since the 2010s, and limestone and alluvial soils give a tighter profile than much of California.

zh.title: 巴塔哥尼亚
zh.summary: 阿根廷南部的冷凉葡萄酒产区，核心在 Río Negro 与 Neuquén 河谷；南纬 39–42°、日照长、风大、气候冷凉，以黑皮诺、马尔贝克、霞多丽与起泡酒著称。

en.title: Patagonia
en.summary: A cool-climate wine region in southern Argentina, centred on the Río Negro and Neuquén valleys; at 39–42° south with long sun, strong wind and cool temperatures, it is known for Pinot Noir, Malbec, Chardonnay and sparkling wine.

zh.title: 波亚克
zh.summary: 吉伦特河口左岸梅多克中段的红葡萄酒法定产区，1936 年 11 月 14 日获 AOC 地位，葡萄园约 1,250 公顷，建立在厚约十米的第四纪砾石台地之上；1855 年分级的拉菲、拉图与木桐三座一级庄均在此，法定最低自然酒精度 11%，产量上限 57 百升/公顷、封顶 63 百升/公顷，种植密度至少 7,000 株/公顷。

en.title: Pauillac
en.summary: A red-wine AOC on the left bank of the Gironde in the middle Médoc, recognised on 14 November 1936, with about 1,250 hectares of vines on Quaternary gravel terraces roughly ten metres thick; the 1855 classification lists Lafite Rothschild, Latour and Mouton Rothschild as first growths here, and the rules set a minimum natural alcohol of 11%, a yield of 57 hl/ha with a ceiling of 63 hl/ha, and a minimum planting density of 7,000 vines per hectare.

zh.title: 佩萨克-雷奥良
zh.summary: 1987 年从格拉夫独立出来的波尔多左岸 AOC，覆盖波尔多市郊向南的十个市镇；以砾石丘、红白兼产与侯伯王、美讯等名庄著称，是波尔多最靠近城市、也最容易做“城市酒庄”访问的产区之一。

en.title: Pessac-Léognan
en.summary: A Bordeaux left-bank AOC split from Graves in 1987, covering ten communes south of the city; known for gravel mounds, both red and white wines and estates such as Haut-Brion and La Mission Haut-Brion, it is Bordeaux’s most urban and accessible fine-wine district.

zh.title: 法尔茨
zh.summary: 德国西南部的法定产区，北起博肯海姆、南至与阿尔萨斯接壤的施韦根，沿“德国葡萄酒之路”延伸 85 公里、串联约 130 个村庄，2025 年约 23,700 公顷，是德国第二大产区；分为 Mittelhaardt-Deutsche Weinstraße 与 Südliche Weinstraße 两个分区，雷司令约 5,950 公顷、Dornfelder 约 2,450 公顷，白葡萄约占六成。

en.title: Pfalz
en.summary: The German appellation running 85 kilometres along the German Wine Route from Bockenheim south to Schweigen on the Alsace border and linking about 130 villages, with about 23,700 hectares in 2025, the second largest region in Germany; it is split into Mittelhaardt-Deutsche Weinstraße and Südliche Weinstraße, with about 5,950 hectares of Riesling and about 2,450 hectares of Dornfelder, and whites make up about 60%.

zh.title: 皮埃蒙特
zh.summary: 意大利西北部的葡萄酒产区，被阿尔卑斯山与朗格、蒙费拉托丘陵环绕；以内比奥罗酿造的巴罗洛与巴巴莱斯科、巴贝拉与莫斯卡托阿斯蒂为代表，秋季雾气（nebbia）、坡地土壤与严格的 DOCG 陈年规则共同定义其风格。

en.title: Piedmont
en.summary: A wine region in north-west Italy framed by the Alps and the Langhe and Monferrato hills; represented by Barolo and Barbaresco from Nebbiolo, Barbera and Moscato d'Asti, with autumn fog (nebbia), hillside soils and strict DOCG ageing rules defining its style.

zh.title: 波美侯
zh.summary: 多尔多涅河右岸、利布尔讷以东的红葡萄酒法定产区，1936 年 12 月 8 日获 AOC 地位，核心台地约 4 公里乘 3 公里；表层为砾石与砂黏土，下层为富铁氧化物的黏土-铁质土（crasse de fer），梅洛占种植面积约 80%，法定最低自然酒精度 11%，产量上限 49 百升/公顷、封顶 60 百升/公顷，种植密度至少 5,500 株/公顷；波美侯从未建立官方分级。

en.title: Pomerol
en.summary: A red-wine AOC on the right bank of the Dordogne, east of Libourne, recognised on 8 December 1936, with a core plateau of roughly 4 km by 3 km; gravel and sandy clay overlie an iron-oxide-rich clay subsoil known as crasse de fer, Merlot accounts for about 80% of plantings, the rules set a minimum natural alcohol of 11%, a yield of 49 hl/ha with a ceiling of 60 hl/ha, and a minimum planting density of 5,500 vines per hectare, and Pomerol has never created an official classification.

zh.title: 波特
zh.summary: 葡萄牙杜罗河谷出产、经强化并在加亚新城或杜罗陈年的甜型加强酒法定产区；以 Touriga Nacional 等品种酿造，按“单一年份或混酿”与“木桶氧化或瓶中还原”两条轴分为 Ruby、Tawny、Vintage、LBV、Colheita 与 Crusted，常见 750 mL、酒精度约 19%–20% vol。

en.title: Porto
en.summary: A sweet fortified-wine appellation produced in the Douro valley of Portugal and aged in Vila Nova de Gaia or the Douro; made from Touriga Nacional and other varieties, it is classified along two axes, single harvest or blend and oxidative cask or reductive bottle ageing, into Ruby, Tawny, Vintage, LBV, Colheita and Crusted, commonly 750 mL at about 19%–20% vol.

zh.title: 葡萄牙
zh.summary: 伊比利亚半岛西部的葡萄酒生产国，以波特、马德拉等加强酒与杜罗河红葡萄酒著称；本土品种丰富，产区制度与欧盟框架衔接。

en.title: Portugal
en.summary: A wine-producing country in the west of the Iberian Peninsula, known for fortified wines such as Port and Madeira and for Douro reds; native varieties are abundant and the appellation system is aligned with the EU framework.

zh.title: 普里奥拉托
zh.summary: 西班牙加泰罗尼亚塔拉戈纳省的内陆山区产区，2009 年获得 DOQ 最高等级；llicorella 板岩与石英碎片的陡坡梯田、低产老藤与地中海—大陆性过渡气候，塑造出以歌海娜与佳丽酿为主、酒体饱满且带矿物感的红葡萄酒。

en.title: Priorat
en.summary: An inland mountain region in Tarragona province, Catalonia, Spain, awarded DOQ status in 2009; steep terraces of llicorella slate and quartz, low-yielding old vines and a transitional Mediterranean-continental climate produce Grenache- and Carignan-led reds with full body and a mineral edge.

zh.title: 普罗旺斯
zh.summary: 法国东南部地中海沿岸的葡萄酒产区，从罗讷河口延伸到尼斯以西；以桃红葡萄酒最为著名，也生产红白葡萄酒，品种以歌海娜、神索、西拉与慕合怀特为主，邦多勒等法定产区各有独立规则。

en.title: Provence
en.summary: A wine region on the Mediterranean coast of south-east France, running from the Rhône delta to west of Nice; best known for rosé, it also makes red and white wines, mainly from Grenache, Cinsault, Syrah and Mourvèdre, with Bandol and other appellations under their own rules.

zh.title: 普利亚
zh.summary: 意大利“靴跟”地区，地中海阳光、石灰岩与红土、老藤与 Masseria 农庄构成其形象；以黑曼罗、普里米蒂沃与黑博比诺为主，萨伦托半岛与曼杜里亚是核心。

en.title: Puglia
en.summary: Italy’s heel, shaped by Mediterranean sun, limestone and red soils, old vines and masserie farm estates; Negroamaro, Primitivo and Bombino Nero dominate, with the Salento peninsula and Manduria as the core.

zh.title: 莱茵高
zh.summary: 德国莱茵河右岸、陶努斯山南麓的法定产区，以朝南坡地上的雷司令与阿斯曼斯豪森的 Spätburgunder 著称；1775 年约翰内斯堡的晚收传说常被视为 Spätlese 的起点；产区以干型雷司令传统为核心，同时保留 Kabinett 到 Trockenbeerenauslese 的 Prädikat 体系，trocken 与 halbtrocken 是酒标上的口感标注而非等级。

en.title: Rheingau
en.summary: The German appellation on the right bank of the Rhine below the Taunus hills, known for Riesling on south-facing slopes and for Spätburgunder in Assmannshausen; the 1775 late-harvest story at Johannisberg is often treated as the origin of Spätlese; the region centres on a dry Riesling tradition while retaining the Prädikat ladder from Kabinett to Trockenbeerenauslese, and trocken and halbtrocken are taste indications on the label rather than grades.

zh.title: 罗讷河谷
zh.summary: 法国东南部沿罗讷河分布的葡萄酒产区，从维埃纳延伸到阿维尼翁；北部为狭窄陡坡，红葡萄酒以叙拉单酿为主，南部为宽阔谷地，红葡萄酒以歌海娜混酿为主，密史脱拉风贯穿全境。

en.title: Rhône Valley
en.summary: A wine region along the Rhône in south-eastern France, running from Vienne to Avignon; the north is a narrow band of steep slopes where reds are made from Syrah alone, the south is a broad valley where reds are Grenache-led blends, and the mistral blows through the whole region.

zh.title: 下海湾
zh.summary: 西班牙加利西亚蓬特韦德拉省为主的 DO 产区，1980 年以 Denominación Específica Albariño 起步、1988 年改称 Rías Baixas；由 Val do Salnés、Condado do Tea、O Rosal、Soutomaior 与 Ribeira do Ulla 五个子区组成；法定范围海拔低于 300 米，约 4,320 公顷（10,677 英亩）葡萄园、约 6,500 名种植者、22,800 多个地块、约 180 家注册酒庄，法定最高产量 12,500 公斤/公顷（90 百升/公顷），Albariño 是绝对主导品种。

en.title: Rías Baixas
en.summary: Wine DO in Galicia, north-west Spain, based mainly in Pontevedra. It began in 1980 as the Denominación Específica Albariño and became Rías Baixas in 1988; it has five sub-zones, Val do Salnés, Condado do Tea, O Rosal, Soutomaior and Ribeira do Ulla. The legal area lies below 300 metres, with about 4,320 hectares (10,677 acres), around 6,500 growers, more than 22,800 plots and some 180 registered wineries; maximum yields are 12,500 kg per hectare (90 hectolitres per hectare), and Albariño dominates.

zh.title: 杜埃罗河岸
zh.summary: 西班牙卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区杜埃罗河沿岸的葡萄酒法定产区，以当地称为 Tinto Fino 的丹魄为主；葡萄园位于海拔约 700–1000 米的高原，气候极端大陆性，红葡萄酒以结构、成熟果味与橡木桶陈年见长，按 Crianza、Reserva 与 Gran Reserva 分级。

en.title: Ribera del Duero
en.summary: A wine appellation along the Duero river in Castilla y León, Spain, based on Tempranillo, known locally as Tinto Fino; vineyards sit on a high plateau at about 700–1000 metres in an extreme continental climate, and the reds are known for structure, ripe fruit and oak ageing, classified as Crianza, Reserva and Gran Reserva.

zh.title: 里奥哈
zh.summary: 西班牙北部埃布罗河上游的葡萄酒法定产区，以丹魄为主，分为里奥哈阿尔塔、里奥哈阿拉韦萨与里奥哈东方三个子区；红葡萄酒按 Crianza、Reserva 与 Gran Reserva 分级陈年，风格从清爽红果到长时间桶陈的香料与皮革气息都有。

en.title: Rioja
en.summary: A wine appellation in the upper Ebro valley of northern Spain, based on Tempranillo and divided into Rioja Alta, Rioja Alavesa and Rioja Oriental; reds are classified by Crianza, Reserva and Gran Reserva ageing, and styles range from fresh red fruit to spice and leather from long barrel ageing.

zh.title: 卢埃达
zh.summary: 西班牙卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂的 DO 白葡萄酒产区，1980 年 1 月 12 日获得法定产区资格，是该自治区第一个 DO；范围覆盖巴利亚多利德、塞哥维亚与阿维拉三省的 74 个市镇；葡萄园海拔 700–870 米，年降雨仅 300–500 升/平方米，年日照可达 2,600 小时；Verdejo 是主导品种，2025 年采收中占 88.82%；砾石阶地与昼夜温差塑造了高酸、草本与柑橘香气的风格。

en.title: Rueda
en.summary: White-wine DO in Castilla y León, Spain, granted official status on 12 January 1980 and the autonomous community's first DO. Its area covers 74 municipalities in Valladolid, Segovia and Ávila. Vineyards sit at 700–870 metres, annual rainfall is only 300–500 litres per square metre and sunshine reaches 2,600 hours a year. Verdejo dominates, at 88.82% of the 2025 harvest; gravel terraces and a wide day-night range shape the high-acid, herbal and citrus style.

zh.title: 圣埃美隆
zh.summary: 波尔多右岸利布尔讷东北的葡萄酒产区，5400 公顷葡萄园分布于 9 个公社；梅洛约占 60%，圣埃美隆 AOC 产量上限 46 百升/公顷，特级 AOC 为 40 百升/公顷并要求 12 个月陈年，2022 年分级列出 85 家酒庄。

en.title: Saint-Émilion
en.summary: A wine region north-east of Libourne on Bordeaux's Right Bank, with 5400 hectares across 9 communes; Merlot is about 60%, the Saint-Émilion AOC caps yield at 46 hectolitres per hectare, the Grand Cru AOC at 40 with 12 months' ageing, and the 2022 classification lists 85 estates.

zh.title: 圣埃斯泰夫
zh.summary: 梅多克最北端的村庄级 AOC，以黏土与砾石混合的土壤、较高比例的梅洛与更紧的单宁著称；1855 年分级的二级庄 Cos d’Estournel、Montrose 与三级庄 Calon-Ségur 是产区标志。

en.title: Saint-Estèphe
en.summary: The northernmost communal AOC in the Médoc, known for clay-and-gravel soils, a higher share of Merlot and firmer tannin; the 1855 second growths Cos d’Estournel and Montrose and the third growth Calon-Ségur are its landmarks.

zh.title: 圣朱利安
zh.summary: 位于波亚克与玛歌之间的吉伦特河口左岸红葡萄酒法定产区，1936 年 11 月 14 日获 AOC 地位，法定最低自然酒精度 11%；1855 年分级在本村列出 11 家列级庄，其中二级庄 5 家、三级庄 2 家、四级庄 4 家，没有一级庄，是梅多克四大村庄中唯一缺少一级庄的产区，葡萄园沿一条近乎连续的砾石脊展开。

en.title: Saint-Julien
en.summary: A red-wine AOC on the left bank of the Gironde between Pauillac and Margaux, recognised on 14 November 1936, with a minimum natural alcohol of 11%; the 1855 classification lists 11 classified growths here, 5 second growths, 2 third growths and 4 fourth growths, with no first growth, making it the only one of the four great Médoc communes without a first growth, and its vineyards follow an almost continuous gravel ridge.

zh.title: 萨尔塔
zh.summary: 阿根廷西北部的高海拔葡萄酒产区，核心在萨尔塔省的卡法亚特谷；海拔 1,500–3,100 米、日照强、昼夜温差大，以特浓情白葡萄酒与高海拔马尔贝克著称。

en.title: Salta
en.summary: A high-altitude wine region in northwest Argentina, centred on the Cafayate Valley in Salta; at 1,500–3,100 metres with intense sun and a wide diurnal range, it is known for Torrontés whites and high-altitude Malbec.

zh.title: 桑塞尔
zh.summary: 卢瓦尔河谷东部的丘陵产区，以长相思白葡萄酒与黑皮诺红、桃红著称；石灰岩与燧石土壤、凉爽气候与 1936 年 AOC，使它成为“矿物感长相思”最常被引用的产地。

en.title: Sancerre
en.summary: A hill country in the eastern Loire, known for Sauvignon Blanc whites and Pinot Noir reds and rosés; limestone and flint soils, a cool climate and its 1936 AOC make it the most cited source of “mineral” Sauvignon Blanc.

zh.title: 圣巴巴拉
zh.summary: 加州中央海岸南部的县，东西向的山脉与太平洋 fog 形成多样微气候；圣丽塔山、圣伊内斯谷、巴拉德峡谷等子产区以黑皮诺、霞多丽与西拉著称，1983 年获 AVA。

en.title: Santa Barbara County
en.summary: A county on the southern Central Coast of California, where east-west ranges and Pacific fog create diverse microclimates; sub-AVAs such as Sta. Rita Hills, Santa Ynez Valley and Ballard Canyon are known for Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Syrah, and the county became an AVA in 1983.

zh.title: 圣托里尼
zh.summary: 希腊基克拉泽斯群岛圣托里尼岛（Thira）的 PDO 产区，建于 1971 年；法定干白须含至少 85% Assyrtiko，其余 15% 只能是 Athiri 与 Aidani；葡萄园约 1,200 公顷（12,000 stremmata），自海平面延伸至约 300 米；火山灰与浮石土壤、极度干旱与 meltemia 季风迫使葡萄采用篮式修剪 kouloura；法定最高产量已从 8,000 公斤/公顷下调至 6,500 公斤/公顷；Vinsanto 与 Nykteri 是受保护的传统名称。

en.title: Santorini
en.summary: PDO on the volcanic island of Santorini (Thira) in the Cyclades, Greece, established in 1971. Its dry white must contain at least 85% Assyrtiko, with the remaining 15% limited to Athiri and Aidani. Vineyards cover about 1,200 hectares (12,000 stremmata), from sea level to about 300 metres. Volcanic ash and pumice, extreme drought and the meltemia winds force the kouloura basket system. Maximum yields have been cut from 8,000 to 6,500 kg per hectare; Vinsanto and Nykteri are protected traditional terms.

zh.title: 苏玳
zh.summary: 法国吉伦特省波尔多南部的贵腐甜白产区，覆盖 Sauternes、Barsac、Bommes、Fargues 与 Preignac 五座村庄；Ciron 河的秋雾、砾石台地与 1855 年分级共同定义了它的身份。

en.title: Sauternes
en.summary: The botrytised sweet white appellation of southern Bordeaux, covering the villages of Sauternes, Barsac, Bommes, Fargues and Preignac; autumn fog on the Ciron, gravel terraces and the 1855 classification define its identity.

zh.title: 萨瓦
zh.summary: 法国东南部阿尔卑斯山区的葡萄酒产区，葡萄园分布在海拔 250-600 米的山谷与坡地；以雅克儿、阿尔泰斯等白葡萄品种与梦杜斯红葡萄品种著称，法定产区包括 Vin de Savoie、Roussette de Savoie、Crémant de Savoie 与 Bugey 等。

en.title: Savoie
en.summary: A wine region in the French Alps of south-east France, with vineyards on valleys and slopes at 250-600 metres; known for white varieties such as Jacquère and Altesse and the red Mondeuse, with appellations including Vin de Savoie, Roussette de Savoie, Crémant de Savoie and Bugey.

zh.title: 苏格兰
zh.summary: 英国北部的威士忌法定产区；苏格兰威士忌必须在本土蒸馏、以橡木桶陈年至少三年，装瓶酒精度不低于 40% vol，并受地理标志保护。

en.title: Scotland
en.summary: A legally defined whisky region in the north of the United Kingdom; Scotch whisky must be distilled and matured in Scotland, aged in oak casks for at least three years, bottled at no less than 40% ABV and protected by a geographical indication.

zh.title: 陕西
zh.summary: 中国凤香型白酒的核心产区，以宝鸡凤翔柳林镇为中心；凤香型以高粱、大麦、豌豆、小麦为原料，用中高温大曲、黄土泥窖、混蒸混烧与酒海陈贮，香气介于清香与浓香之间；地理标志产品标准为 GB/T 19508-2007，现行质量要求为 GB/T 10781.6-2025。

en.title: Shaanxi
en.summary: A core region for feng-aroma baijiu in China, centred on Liulin Town in Fengxiang, Baoji; feng aroma uses sorghum, barley, peas and wheat with medium-high-temperature daqu, loess mud pits, mixed steaming and distillation, and jiuhai storage, placing its aroma between light and strong; the geographical indication product standard is GB/T 19508-2007 and the current quality standard is GB/T 10781.6-2025.

zh.title: 山东省
zh.summary: 中国东部沿海省份，北方黄酒的代表产区之一；即墨老酒以黍米、麦曲与焦糜糊化工艺酿造，古遗六法是传统概括而非法定等级，山东同时也是重要的白酒产区。

en.title: Shandong Province
en.summary: A coastal province in eastern China and a leading northern yellow wine region; Jimo laojiu uses broomcorn millet, wheat qu and a scorched-mash step, while the six ancient methods are a traditional summary, not a legal grade.

zh.title: 上海市
zh.summary: 中国东部直辖市，黄酒的重要产销地之一；金山区枫泾一带是黄酒产区核心，上海老酒以糯米与麦曲酿造，多为半干型或甜型，城市消费与品牌化特征明显。

en.title: Shanghai
en.summary: A municipality on China's east coast and one of the country's key yellow wine markets and producers; Fengjing in Jinshan is the production core, and Shanghai laojiu uses glutinous rice and wheat qu, mostly semi-dry or sweet.

zh.title: 山西
zh.summary: 中国北方的清香型白酒核心产区，以吕梁汾阳杏花村为中心；当地用高粱、大麦与豌豆，采用清蒸二次清、地缸分离发酵与固态蒸馏，酒体以乙酸乙酯为主体香；现行质量要求为 GB/T 10781.2-2022，2025 年汾阳又发布大曲清香酒核心产区团体标准与公用标识。

en.title: Shanxi
en.summary: A core region for light-aroma baijiu in northern China, centred on Xinghua Village in Fenyang, Lvliang; local producers use sorghum, barley and peas with twice-steamed clean processing, separated earthen-jar fermentation and solid-state distillation, giving ethyl acetate-led aromas; the current quality standard is GB/T 10781.2-2022, and in 2025 Fenyang released a core-region group standard and public mark for daqu light-aroma baijiu.

zh.title: 绍兴市
zh.summary: 浙江省中北部、杭州湾南岸的黄酒核心产区；绍兴酒以糯米、麦曲和鉴湖水为基本组合，靠摊饭法、开耙与陶坛陈酿形成风格。

en.title: Shaoxing
en.summary: The core huangjiu region in northern Zhejiang, on the south shore of Hangzhou Bay. Shaoxing wine combines glutinous rice, wheat qu and Jian Lake water with the tanfan method, open-mash stirring and jar ageing.

zh.title: 四川省
zh.summary: 中国西南省份，浓香型白酒的核心产区；宜宾、泸州、成都平原与邛崃构成产业带，五粮液、泸州老窖等生产者集中，高粱、小麦与多粮配方是工艺基础。

en.title: Sichuan
en.summary: A province in south-west China and the core region for strong-aroma baijiu; Yibin, Luzhou, the Chengdu Plain and Qionglai form the industrial belt, with Wuliangye and Luzhou Laojiao among the leading producers and sorghum, wheat and multi-grain recipes at the base.

zh.title: 西西里
zh.summary: 地中海最大的岛屿，意大利产量最大的葡萄酒产区之一；从西部的马萨拉加强酒到东部的埃特纳火山，品种与风格跨度极大，黑达沃拉、卡塔拉托、格里洛与弗拉帕托是核心。

en.title: Sicily
en.summary: The largest Mediterranean island and one of Italy’s most productive wine regions; from Marsala fortified wine in the west to Mount Etna in the east, its range is huge, with Nero d’Avola, Catarratto, Grillo and Frappato at the core.

zh.title: 索诺马
zh.summary: 加州索诺马县的葡萄酒产区，葡萄园约 60,000 英亩（约 24,300 公顷），占县面积约 6%，有 19 个 AVA；西侧受太平洋冷雾与海风影响，东侧内陆更暖，葡萄园海拔从海平面到约 800 米，有 11 种主要地质构造与 31 个土壤系列；Russian River Valley 与 Sonoma Coast 以 Chardonnay、Pinot Noir 著称，Alexander Valley 以 Cabernet Sauvignon 为主，Dry Creek Valley 以 Zinfandel 闻名；1817 年已有欧洲葡萄种植记录，99% 葡萄园获可持续认证。

en.title: Sonoma
en.summary: Sonoma County wine region in California, with about 60,000 acres (24,300 hectares) of vineyard, some 6% of the county, and 19 AVAs. Pacific fog and cold current cool the west, inland valleys are warmer, and vineyards run from sea level to about 800 metres across 11 geological formations and 31 soil series. Russian River Valley and Sonoma Coast are known for Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, Alexander Valley for Cabernet Sauvignon, Dry Creek Valley for Zinfandel. European grapes were recorded in 1817 and 99% of vineyard is sustainably certified.

zh.title: 南非
zh.summary: 非洲南端的葡萄酒生产国，酿酒葡萄园约 86,544 公顷（2024 年 SAWIS 统计），白葡萄占 55%、红葡萄占 45%；采用 Wine of Origin 制度，按地理单元、产区、区与分区四级划定，标示产地须 100% 来自该地，品种与年份须达到 85%；Stellenbosch 是 Coastal Region 内的区，约 11,653 公顷、占全国 13.5%，属地中海气候，受 False Bay 与东南风影响，土壤以风化花岗岩为主，下设八个 WO 分区；Chenin Blanc 全国约 15,913 公顷（18.4%，面积最大的白葡萄），Pinotage 约 6,605 公顷（7.6%），后者于 1925 年由 Pinot Noir 与 Cinsaut 杂交育成。

en.title: South Africa
en.summary: A wine-producing country at the southern tip of Africa, with about 86,544 hectares of wine grapes in the 2024 SAWIS count, 55% white and 45% red; Wine of Origin has four levels, requires 100% of the stated origin and 85% for variety and vintage; Stellenbosch, a Coastal Region district, has about 11,653 hectares, 13.5% of the total, a Mediterranean climate moderated by False Bay, decomposed granite soils and eight wards; Chenin Blanc covers about 15,913 hectares nationally, 18.4% and the largest white, and Pinotage about 6,605 hectares, 7.6%, bred in 1925 from Pinot Noir and Cinsaut.

zh.title: 韩国
zh.summary: 朝鲜半岛南部的国家，以烧酒最具代表性；烧酒是蒸馏酒，米酒是发酵酒，啤酒与葡萄酒也有稳定市场，酒类标签由食品药品安全处管理。

en.title: South Korea
en.summary: A country in the southern Korean Peninsula best known for soju; soju is a distilled spirit, rice wine is fermented, and beer and wine have steady markets, with alcohol labelling administered by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

zh.title: 西班牙
zh.summary: 南欧葡萄酒生产大国，以丹魄、歌海娜等品种与 DO 分级体系著称；里奥哈、杜埃罗河岸、卡瓦与赫雷斯构成多样的酒类版图。

en.title: Spain
en.summary: A major wine-producing country in southern Europe, known for Tempranillo, Garnacha and its DO hierarchy; Rioja, Ribera del Duero, Cava and Jerez make up a varied drinks landscape.

zh.title: 斯佩塞
zh.summary: 苏格兰东北部斯佩河流域的威士忌产区，酒厂密度居苏格兰之首，常被概括为花果香与雪莉桶风格；但它是《2009 年苏格兰威士忌条例》下的受保护地方名称，不是可单独注册的欧盟地理标志，内部风格也从清淡花香一直延伸到重雪莉。

en.title: Speyside
en.summary: A whisky region along the River Spey in north-east Scotland with the densest concentration of distilleries in the country, usually summarised as fruity, floral and sherry-influenced. It is a protected locality under the Scotch Whisky Regulations 2009, not a separately registrable EU geographical indication, and its styles run from light and floral to heavily sherried.

zh.title: 斯泰伦博斯
zh.summary: 南非西开普 Coastal Region 内的 Wine of Origin district，位于开普敦以东约 45 公里；1679 年由 Simon van der Stel 建镇，1971 年成立南非第一条葡萄酒之路，1973 年 WO 制度正式实施后成为法定产区之一；葡萄园约占全国 101,957 公顷的 18%，以 Simonsberg、Helderberg 等山地与花岗岩、砂岩坡地构成多样风土；Cabernet Sauvignon 是最重要的红品种，Chenin Blanc 仍是白品种主力；WO 产地标注须 100%、品种与年份须 85%。

en.title: Stellenbosch
en.summary: Wine of Origin district in the Coastal Region of the Western Cape, South Africa, about 45 km east of Cape Town. The town was founded in 1679 by Simon van der Stel, the country's first wine route opened in 1971 and the WO scheme was instituted in 1973, when Stellenbosch became a legal district. Its vineyards are about 18% of the national 101,957 hectares, with Simonsberg, Helderberg and granite or sandstone slopes creating diverse terroirs. Cabernet Sauvignon is the leading red and Chenin Blanc the main white. WO rules require 100% origin and 85% for variety or vintage claims.

zh.title: 施泰尔马克
zh.summary: 奥地利东南部的州级葡萄酒产区，葡萄园约 5,109 公顷；2018 年份起 Südsteiermark、Weststeiermark 与 Vulkanland Steiermark 三个子区全部获得 DAC 地位，以 Sauvignon Blanc、Gelber Muskateller 与 Traminer 的干型白葡萄酒著称，西部以 Blauer Wildbacher 酿造的桃红 Schilcher 为代表；葡萄必须手工采收，DAC 分 Gebietswein、Ortswein 与 Riedenwein 三级，干型酒残糖上限 4.0 g/L。

en.title: Styria
en.summary: A federal-state wine region in south-eastern Austria with about 5,109 hectares of vineyard; from the 2018 vintage the three sub-regions Südsteiermark, Weststeiermark and Vulkanland Steiermark all hold DAC status, with dry white wines from Sauvignon Blanc, Gelber Muskateller and Traminer and the rosé Schilcher from Blauer Wildbacher in the west; grapes must be picked by hand and the DACs run at Gebietswein, Ortswein and Riedenwein level, with a residual-sugar limit of 4.0 g/L for dry styles.

zh.title: 斯沃特兰
zh.summary: 南非西开普 Coastal Region 内的区，位于开普敦以北，传统上是谷物产区；SAWIS 2024 年把 Swartland 与 Darling 合并统计为 11,585 公顷、占全国酿酒葡萄园的 13.39%；葡萄园沿 Piketberg、Porterville、Riebeek、Perdeberg 山麓与 Berg 河两岸分布，以无架式旱作灌木藤（bosstok）著称；地中海气候，夏季炎热干燥，大西洋凉风沿 Berg 河谷进入；土壤以 Malmesbury 页岩为主，Paardeberg 一带为花岗岩；官方划有 Malmesbury、Paardeberg、Paardeberg-South、Piketberg-Bo-Berg、Porseleinberg、Riebeekberg、Riebeeksrivier 与 St Helena Bay 八个 Ward；品种以 Chenin Blanc、Cinsault、Grenache、Syrah 与 Carignan 为主；Wine of Origin 产地须 100%、品种与年份须 85%。

en.title: Swartland
en.summary: District in the Coastal Region of the Western Cape, north of Cape Town. SAWIS groups Swartland with Darling at 11,585 hectares in 2024, 13.39% of the national wine-grape area. Vineyards follow the Berg River and mountain foothills, with dryland bush vines called bosstok. Hot dry Mediterranean climate; soils are mainly Malmesbury shale with granite around Paardeberg. Eight wards include Malmesbury, Paardeberg, Riebeekberg, Riebeeksrivier and St Helena Bay. Chenin Blanc, Cinsault, Grenache, Syrah and Carignan lead. Wine of Origin requires 100% origin and 85% for variety and vintage.

zh.title: 中国台湾地区
zh.summary: 中国台湾地区的威士忌与酒类产区，宜兰、南投等地有蒸馏厂；亚热带气候使陈年速度极快，Kavalan、Omar 等品牌在国际比赛中受到关注。

en.title: Taiwan, China
en.summary: The whisky and drinks region of Taiwan, China, with distilleries in Yilan and Nantou; a subtropical climate ages spirit very fast, and brands such as Kavalan and Omar have drawn international competition attention.

zh.title: 塔斯马尼亚
zh.summary: 澳大利亚南端的岛屿州，纬度相当于南半球冷凉产区；以黑皮诺、霞多丽、雷司令与起泡酒著称，塔玛谷、德文特谷与东海岸是主要子产区，1990 年代获 GI。

en.title: Tasmania
en.summary: The island state at Australia’s southern end, at a latitude comparable to cool-climate regions of the southern hemisphere; known for Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Riesling and sparkling wine, with the Tamar, Derwent and East Coast as main sub-regions and GI status in the 1990s.

zh.title: 田纳西
zh.summary: 美国中南部州，田纳西威士忌的法定产地；州法要求在本州制造、玉米不少于 51%、新烧焦橡木桶陈年并于入桶前经枫木炭过滤，但它在联邦层面并非独立类别，而是受 TTB 标签规则约束的州法名称与地理标识。

en.title: Tennessee
en.summary: A state in the south-central United States and the legal home of Tennessee whiskey; state law requires in-state manufacture, at least 51% corn, new charred oak maturation and maple-charcoal filtration before barrel entry, but at federal level it is a state-law name and geographic label under TTB rules, not a separate class.

zh.title: 龙舌兰酒法定产区
zh.summary: 墨西哥以蓝色韦伯龙舌兰酿造龙舌兰酒的法定产区，核心在哈利斯科，并延伸至瓜纳华托、米却肯、纳亚里特与塔毛利帕斯的部分区域。

en.title: Tequila region
en.summary: The Mexican protected region where blue Weber agave is used to make tequila, centred on Jalisco and extending into parts of Guanajuato, Michoacán, Nayarit and Tamaulipas.

zh.title: 托卡伊
zh.summary: 匈牙利东北部的历史葡萄酒产区，沿博德罗格河与蒂萨河展开；火山土、秋雾与 Furmint 共同支撑 Aszú 贵腐甜酒，1737 年划定的边界与 2002 年的世界遗产身份延续至今。

en.title: Tokaj
en.summary: The historic wine region of north-eastern Hungary, spread along the Bodrog and Tisza rivers; volcanic soils, autumn fog and Furmint support Aszú botrytis wine, within boundaries drawn in 1737 and a landscape inscribed as World Heritage in 2002.

zh.title: 托斯卡纳
zh.summary: 意大利中部的葡萄酒产区，以桑娇维塞为核心，涵盖基安蒂与基安蒂经典、蒙塔奇诺的布鲁奈罗以及海岸的保格利；丘陵地形、galestro 与 alberese 土壤和地中海气候共同塑造高酸、带酸樱桃与泥土气息的红葡萄酒，DOCG 体系是其质量分级框架。

en.title: Tuscany
en.summary: A wine region in central Italy based on Sangiovese, spanning Chianti and Chianti Classico, Brunello di Montalcino and the coastal Bolgheri; hilly terrain, galestro and alberese soils and a Mediterranean climate shape high-acid reds with sour cherry and earthy notes, within the DOCG quality framework.

zh.title: 英国
zh.summary: 由英格兰、威尔士、苏格兰与北爱尔兰组成的岛国；本页聚焦英格兰、威尔士与北爱尔兰的葡萄酒、金酒、啤酒与苹果酒，苏格兰威士忌另见苏格兰页。

en.title: United Kingdom
en.summary: An island country made up of England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland; this region focuses on wine, gin, beer and cider in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, while Scotch whisky is covered on the Scotland page.

zh.title: 美国
zh.summary: 北美重要的葡萄酒、威士忌与啤酒生产国；加州、俄勒冈与华盛顿构成葡萄酒核心，肯塔基以波本威士忌闻名，产区标识以 AVA 体系为特色。

en.title: United States
en.summary: A major wine, whiskey and beer producer in North America; California, Oregon and Washington form the wine core, Kentucky is known for bourbon, and the AVA system is a distinctive feature of appellation labelling.

zh.title: 瓦莱
zh.summary: 瑞士最大的葡萄酒产区，沿罗讷河上游分布，约占全国葡萄园面积的 32%、约 4,600 公顷；阿尔卑斯山谷年降雨约 650 毫米、日照约 2,500 小时，并有焚风，葡萄园可升至 Visperterminen 约 1,100 米；红葡萄占 59%，以 Pinot Noir 为最大品种，Chasselas（本地称 Fendant）、Gamay、Petite Arvine、Cornalin 与 Humagne Rouge 为代表；设 AOC Valais 与十个 AOC Grand Cru。

en.title: Valais
en.summary: The largest wine region in Switzerland, spread along the upper Rhône and covering about 32% of the national vineyard area, or some 4,600 hectares; an Alpine valley with about 650 mm of rain and 2,500 hours of sunshine a year and foehn winds, where vines rise to about 1,100 metres at Visperterminen; reds account for 59% and Pinot Noir is the largest variety, alongside Chasselas, known locally as Fendant, Gamay, Petite Arvine, Cornalin and Humagne Rouge; one AOC Valais and ten AOC Grand Cru.

zh.title: 沃州
zh.summary: 瑞士沃州的葡萄酒产区，葡萄园约 3,782 公顷，是瑞士唯一以白葡萄为主的产区（白葡萄占 65%）；Chasselas 占 59%、约 2,233 公顷，酒标通常不写品种而写地名，如 Yvorne、Féchy 与 Dézaley；分为 Chablais、Lavaux、La Côte、Bonvillars、Côtes de l'Orbe 与 Vully 六个子区，Lavaux 梯田于 2007 年列入联合国教科文组织世界文化遗产，并设 Calamin、Dézaley 与 Dézaley-Marsens 三个 Grand Cru。

en.title: Vaud
en.summary: The wine region of the canton of Vaud in Switzerland, with about 3,782 hectares of vineyard and the only Swiss region where white grapes dominate at 65%; Chasselas covers 59%, or about 2,233 hectares, and labels usually give a place name such as Yvorne, Féchy or Dézaley instead of a variety; divided into six sub-regions, Chablais, Lavaux, La Côte, Bonvillars, Côtes de l'Orbe and Vully, with the Lavaux terraces inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2007 and the three Grand Cru appellations Calamin, Dézaley and Dézaley-Marsens.

zh.title: 威尼托
zh.summary: 意大利东北部的葡萄酒产区，从阿尔卑斯山南麓延伸到亚得里亚海；以瓦坡里切拉的阿玛罗尼与里帕索、苏阿韦的卡尔卡耐卡以及普罗塞克的格莱拉为代表，是意大利 DOC 葡萄酒产量最大的产区之一。

en.title: Veneto
en.summary: A wine region in north-east Italy running from the southern Alps to the Adriatic; represented by Amarone and Ripasso from Valpolicella, Garganega in Soave and Glera in Prosecco, and one of Italy's largest DOC wine-producing regions by volume.

zh.title: 绿酒
zh.summary: 葡萄牙西北部米尼奥地区的法定产区，以大西洋影响下的清新、低酒精度白葡萄酒著称；名称中的“verde”指年轻而非颜色，常规酒款实际酒精度最低 8% vol、标注子产区时 9% vol、标示 Alvarinho 时 11.5% vol，最高总酒精度 14% vol；白葡萄以 Alvarinho、Loureiro、Arinto、Avesso、Trajadura 与 Azal 为主，红葡萄以 Vinhão 为代表。

en.title: Vinho Verde
en.summary: The appellation of the Minho region in north-west Portugal, known for fresh, low-alcohol whites shaped by Atlantic influence; in the name, verde refers to youth rather than colour, with a minimum actual alcohol of 8% vol for regular wines, 9% vol when a sub-zone is named and 11.5% vol when Alvarinho is declared, and a maximum total alcohol of 14% vol; the main white varieties are Alvarinho, Loureiro, Arinto, Avesso, Trajadura and Azal, with Vinhão leading the reds.

zh.title: 武弗雷
zh.summary: 卢瓦尔河谷图尔东侧的产区，全部以白诗南酿造，涵盖干型、半干、甜型与起泡；图弗石灰岩洞穴、凉爽气候与 1936 年 AOC，使它成为理解白诗南多面性的最佳产地。

en.title: Vouvray
en.summary: A district east of Tours in the Loire, made entirely from Chenin Blanc and covering dry, off-dry, sweet and sparkling styles; tuffeau limestone caves, a cool climate and its 1936 AOC make it the best place to understand Chenin’s range.

zh.title: 瓦豪
zh.summary: 奥地利下奥地利州多瑙河峡谷中的法定产区，位于梅尔克与克雷姆斯之间，约 1,340 公顷陡峭阶地，以结晶岩（片麻岩、花岗岩与片岩）与黄土上的 Grüner Veltliner 和 Riesling 干型酒著称；2020 年份起成为 Wachau DAC，另有 Vinea Wachau 协会自 1983 年使用的 Steinfeder、Federspiel 与 Smaragd 三级风格标识，按成酒酒精度划分，分别不超过 11.5%、11.5–12.5% 与不低于 12.5% vol。

en.title: Wachau
en.summary: A designated wine region in the Danube gorge of Lower Austria between Melk and Krems, with about 1,340 hectares of steep terraces and dry Grüner Veltliner and Riesling from crystalline rock and loess; a Wachau DAC since the 2020 vintage, plus the Steinfeder, Federspiel and Smaragd style marks that the Vinea Wachau association has used since 1983 and defines by finished alcohol at up to 11.5% vol, 11.5–12.5% vol and at least 12.5% vol.

zh.title: 沃克湾
zh.summary: 南非西开普 Cape South Coast 产区的 District，环绕海滨城镇 Hermanus，位于开普敦以东；官方分区包括 Hemel-en-Aarde Ridge、Hemel-en-Aarde Valley、Upper Hemel-en-Aarde Valley 与 Bot River 四个 Ward；受大西洋本格拉寒流与海风影响，是南非最冷凉的葡萄酒产区之一；土壤以 Bokkeveld 页岩（Glen Rosa、Klapmuts）与 Table Mountain 砂岩为主；以 Pinot Noir 与 Chardonnay 著称，也有 Sauvignon Blanc、Pinotage 与 Syrah；1975 年 Tim Hamilton Russell 购入 170 公顷未开发土地，1976 年种植、1981 年首个年份；SAWIS 2024 年把整个 Cape South Coast 产区统计为 2,671 公顷，未单列 Walker Bay；Wine of Origin 产地须 100%、品种与年份须 85%。

en.title: Walker Bay
en.summary: District in the Cape South Coast region of the Western Cape, around Hermanus. It has three Hemel-en-Aarde wards and Bot River. Cooled by the Benguela Current and sea breezes. Soils are mainly Bokkeveld shale, with granite and Table Mountain sandstone on higher slopes. Pinot Noir and Chardonnay lead, with Sauvignon Blanc, Pinotage and Syrah also planted. Tim Hamilton Russell bought 170 hectares in 1975 and released the first vintage in 1981. SAWIS reported Cape South Coast at 2,671 hectares in 2024 with no district figure. Wine of Origin requires 100% origin and 85% for variety and vintage.

zh.title: 威拉米特谷
zh.summary: 俄勒冈州 Willamette Valley 的葡萄酒产区，1983 年设立 AVA，总面积约 3,428,800 英亩，葡萄园约 25,450 英亩（10,300 公顷），占俄勒冈葡萄园与酒庄的三分之二；西侧 Coast Range、东侧 Cascades 形成屏障，生长季温和漫长，土壤以海相沉积、火山土与黄土为主；Pinot Noir 为主导品种（1965 年由 David 与 Diana Lett 首次种植），另有 Pinot Gris、Chardonnay 与 Riesling；含 11 个嵌套 AVA，如 Dundee Hills、Yamhill-Carlton、Eola-Amity Hills 与 Van Duzer Corridor；俄勒冈州规定标注品种须达 90%，高于联邦 75%。

en.title: Willamette Valley
en.summary: Willamette Valley wine region in north-west Oregon, established as an AVA in 1983. The AVA covers about 3,428,800 acres (1,387,600 hectares), with 25,450 acres (10,300 hectares) of vineyard and about two-thirds of Oregon's wineries. The Coast Range and Cascades shelter a mild, long growing season; soils are marine sedimentary, volcanic and loess. Pinot Noir dominates, first planted in 1965, alongside Pinot Gris, Chardonnay and Riesling. There are 11 nested AVAs, and Oregon requires 90% for a variety label against the federal 75%.

zh.title: 新疆
zh.summary: 中国西北的葡萄酒产区，以天山北麓、伊犁河谷与焉耆盆地为核心；温带大陆性干旱气候带来强日照与昼夜温差，砂砾质土壤与滴灌、埋土防寒是当地葡萄栽培的基本条件，赤霞珠等国际品种为主，是中国葡萄与葡萄酒的重要原料基地。

en.title: Xinjiang
en.summary: A wine region in north-western China centred on the northern Tianshan foothills, the Ili valley and the Yanqi basin; a temperate continental arid climate brings strong sun and wide day-night swings, and gravelly soils with drip irrigation and winter vine burial define local viticulture, with Cabernet Sauvignon and other international varieties dominant in China's key grape base.

zh.title: 习水县
zh.summary: 贵州遵义西北部、赤水河中游的县，习酒与习酒镇所在；从“四渡赤水”的历史现场、河谷酱香与跨省交通理解这片黔北产区。

en.title: Xishui County
en.summary: A county in northwestern Zunyi, Guizhou, on the middle Chishui River and home to Xijiu and Xijiu Town; a production area to read through the Four Crossings of the Chishui, valley sauce aroma and cross-provincial transport.

zh.title: 山梨
zh.summary: 日本最核心的葡萄酒产区，以甲府盆地与胜沼为中心；甲州（Koshu）是当地标志性白葡萄品种，富士山与秩父山地环绕的扇状地、砂砾质土壤与湿润气候塑造出酸度清晰、香气含蓄的白葡萄酒，胜沼也是日本近代葡萄酒业的起点之一。

en.title: Yamanashi
en.summary: Japan's core wine region, centred on the Kofu basin and Katsunuma; Koshu is the signature local white variety, and alluvial-fan gravel soils amid the mountains around Mount Fuji give taut, restrained whites with clear acidity, while Katsunuma is also one of the birthplaces of the modern Japanese wine industry.

zh.title: 雅拉谷
zh.summary: 维多利亚州墨尔本东北部的冷凉产区，1838 年开始种葡萄，是澳洲最早的葡萄酒产区之一；以黑皮诺、霞多丽与西拉著称，1990 年代获 GI，风格更接近勃艮第与北罗讷。

en.title: Yarra Valley
en.summary: A cool-climate region northeast of Melbourne, Victoria, planted from 1838 and one of Australia’s earliest wine districts; known for Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Shiraz, it received GI status in the 1990s and leans toward Burgundy and the Northern Rhône in style.

zh.title: 宜宾市
zh.summary: 四川省南部、金沙江与岷江汇合处的城市，五粮液的核心产地；适合把浓香型白酒的产业、江河地理与酒厂参访放在同一条线上理解。

en.title: Yibin
en.summary: A city at the confluence of the Jinsha and Min rivers in southern Sichuan and the home of Wuliangye; a useful place to connect strong-aroma baijiu, river geography and distillery visits.

zh.title: 云南
zh.summary: 中国西南省份，葡萄酒以迪庆香格里拉高原产区为主、弥勒低海拔产区为辅；德钦葡萄园分布在金沙江与澜沧江干旱河谷 1800–2800 米之间，高海拔地块可达 2400–2800 米，弥勒葡萄园海拔约 1480 米，两者在日照、温差、紫外线与品种选择上形成鲜明对照。

en.title: Yunnan
en.summary: A province in south-west China whose wine regions range from the Shangri-La highlands of Diqing to the low-altitude Mile basin; Deqin vineyards lie between 1800 and 2800 m in the dry valleys of the Jinsha and Mekong rivers, with high plots reaching 2400–2800 m, while Mile vineyards sit at about 1480 m, creating a sharp contrast in sunshine, temperature range, ultraviolet intensity and variety choice.

zh.title: 浙江省
zh.summary: 中国东部沿海省份，黄酒的核心产区；绍兴酒以糯米、麦曲与鉴湖水为基本组合，摊饭、淋饭与喂饭等投料路线配合加饭等产品类型形成不同风格，金华与湖州也有各自的黄酒传统。

en.title: Zhejiang Province
en.summary: An eastern coastal province and the core yellow wine region of China; Shaoxing wine combines glutinous rice, wheat qu and Jian Lake water, with tanfan, linfan and weifan rice-handling routes and jiafan-style products, while Jinhua and Huzhou keep traditions of their own.

zh.title: 遵义市
zh.summary: 贵州省北部的地级市，赤水河与茅台镇所在；酱香型白酒的核心产区，适合把河谷气候、制曲下沙节律与酒厂参访连起来理解。

en.title: Zunyi
en.summary: A prefecture-level city in northern Guizhou, home to the Chishui River and Maotai Town; a core area of sauce-aroma baijiu where valley climate, qu making and distillery visits can be connected.

zh.title: 阿尔萨斯特级园路线：凯泽斯堡与里屈埃维尔
zh.summary: 从凯泽斯堡的魏恩巴赫酒庄到里屈埃维尔的雨格酒庄，两站都在孚日山脉的雨影之下。路线围绕 51 个特级园、四种高贵品种与迟摘、贵腐精选的标签逻辑展开，车程短，却能把阿尔萨斯的结构讲清楚。

en.title: Alsace Grand Cru trail: Kaysersberg and Riquewihr
en.summary: From Domaine Weinbach in Kaysersberg to Hugel in Riquewihr, both stops sit in the rain shadow of the Vosges. The route links the 51 Grand Cru sites, the four noble grapes and the logic of Vendanges Tardives and Sélection de Grains Nobles; the drive is short, the structure broad.

zh.title: 雅文邑路线：下雅文邑的单一庄园
zh.summary: 从热尔省索尔贝的洛巴德，到朗德省阿尔泰兹达尔马尼亚克的奥尼奥阿，两座单一庄园沿下雅文邑的沙质土排开：一座用 1974 年的连续蒸馏器与三千只酒桶做年份，一座从中世纪领地变成朗德省的产区窗口。路线把连续蒸馏、年份酒标与加斯科涅乡间串成一天半。

en.title: Armagnac trail: single estates of Bas-Armagnac
en.summary: From Château de Laubade in Sorbets, Gers, to Domaine d'Ognoas in Arthez-d'Armagnac, Landes, two single estates line up across the tawny sands of Bas-Armagnac. One uses a 1974 continuous still and three thousand casks for vintage work; the other grew from a medieval seigneurie into a departmental showcase. The route links continuous distillation, vintage labels and the Gascon countryside in a day and a half.

zh.title: 巴巴多斯朗姆路线：圣露西与圣菲利普的双厂车程
zh.summary: 从北端圣露西的芒特盖到东南圣菲利普的四方，两站车程约一小时多，却分别用 1703 年以来的自流井水与壶式、柱式并行讲连续性，用旧糖厂的开放式参访与不添加糖的主张讲透明度。

en.title: Barbados rum trail: Saint Lucy and Saint Philip
en.summary: From Mount Gay in the north of Saint Lucy to Foursquare in the south-east of Saint Philip, about an hour apart. One stop explains continuity through a 1703 well and pot-plus-column distillation; the other explains transparency through an open-house sugar factory and a no-added-sugar position.

zh.title: 巴罗萨葡萄酒路线
zh.summary: 从阿德莱德山麓的奔富玛吉尔庄园出发，沿北东公路进入伊甸谷的亨施克酒庄；一条路线串起 1840 年代移民史、巴罗萨谷底与高海拔带的老藤西拉，以及奔富以试验推动的风格传统。

en.title: Barossa wine trail: Magill Estate to Eden Valley
en.summary: A drive from Penfolds Magill Estate in the Adelaide foothills to Henschke at Keyneton in Eden Valley, linking the immigration history of the 1840s, old-vine Shiraz across two altitude bands, and Penfolds' tradition of experimentation.

zh.title: 巴伐利亚啤酒路线：慕尼黑到班贝格
zh.summary: 从慕尼黑老城的皇家啤酒屋，到西侧厂区一带的奥古斯丁啤酒厂，再乘火车到班贝格老城的施伦克拉烟熏啤酒馆。两站在慕尼黑、一站在班贝格，建议分两天走，用三种空间理解巴伐利亚啤酒文化。

en.title: Bavaria beer trail: Munich to Bamberg
en.summary: From the Hofbräuhaus in Munich's old town to the Augustiner-Bräu brewery quarter in the west of the city, then by train to Schlenkerla in Bamberg's old town. Two stops in Munich and one in Bamberg, best spread over a day and a half or two days.

zh.title: 比利时啤酒路线：兰比克与布鲁日城市艾尔
zh.summary: 先在布鲁塞尔安德莱赫特看康帝隆把发酵交给空气，再乘火车到布鲁日，在半月酒厂看酵母被收进罐里。一天之内用两种发酵逻辑，理解比利时啤酒为什么难以被一句话概括。

en.title: Belgium beer trail: lambic in Brussels, city ale in Bruges
en.summary: See Cantillon hand fermentation to the air in Anderlecht, then take the train to Bruges and watch De Halve Maan keep yeast in the tank. One day and two fermentation logics explain why Belgian beer resists a single sentence.

zh.title: 波尔多左岸路线：从葡萄酒城到波亚克两座一级庄
zh.summary: 先在巴卡朗码头上的葡萄酒城建立世界葡萄酒与波尔多的框架，再乘区域列车北上波亚克，看拉菲与木桐两座一级庄的葡萄园、宅邸与参观边界。三站层层收窄，从“葡萄酒文明”走到“一个村庄的两块砾石坡”。

en.title: Bordeaux left bank: from La Cité du Vin to two Pauillac first growths
en.summary: Build a frame at La Cité du Vin on the Bacalan quays, then take a regional train north to Pauillac for the vineyards, houses and visiting limits of Lafite and Mouton. Three stops narrow from the civilisation of wine to two gravel slopes in one village.

zh.title: 亳州路线：古井与药都
zh.summary: 在亳州用一天把酒镇与药都分开看：上午到古井酒文化博览园与古井镇看浓香型白酒的制曲、窖池与陈放，下午回亳州老城与药材市场；博览园、厂区与药市各有入口，品鉴后不开车。

en.title: Bozhou Route: Gujing and the Medicine Capital
en.summary: One day in Bozhou separating liquor town and medicine capital: morning at the Gujing Wine Culture Park and Gujing Town for strong-aroma starter culture, pits and storage, afternoon in Bozhou’s old town and herb market. Park, plant and herb market have separate entrances, and no driving after tasting.

zh.title: 勃艮第路线：博讷老城、默尔索与酒商文化
zh.summary: 从博讷主宫医院的慈善医院空间出发，开车南下默尔索看城堡与地下酒窖，再回到博讷老城的约瑟夫杜鲁安，走一遍城市、乡村庄园与酒商三种空间。三站都不以“名庄打卡”为重点，而是理解勃艮第如何把地块、建筑与交易绑在一起。

en.title: Burgundy: Beaune, Meursault and the culture of the négociant
en.summary: Start with the charitable hospital space of the Hôtel-Dieu in Beaune, drive south to Meursault for a château and its cellars, then return to the old town and Joseph Drouhin. City, country estate and merchant house, in one loop.

zh.title: 坎贝尔镇威士忌路线：两条街之间的两家酒厂
zh.summary: 在苏格兰最小的法定产区内，用步行把 Well Close 的云顶与 High Street 的格兰帝串起来。两站相距不到一公里，却分别代表“整条生产线留在厂内”与“维多利亚厂房多次易主后仍守着老尺度”两种生存方式，也把坎贝尔镇从繁荣到收缩的历史压缩在半天里。

en.title: Campbeltown: two distilleries, two streets
en.summary: A walking route through Scotland's smallest protected whisky region, linking Springbank in Well Close with Glen Scotia on High Street. Less than a kilometre apart, the two represent a distillery that keeps the whole process on site and a Victorian plant that has changed hands repeatedly but kept its old scale, compressing Campbeltown's boom and retreat into half a day.

zh.title: 香槟路线：埃佩尔奈香槟大道步行
zh.summary: 在埃佩尔奈一条约一公里半的街道上，把香槟的“房子”与“山丘”放在一起看。先沿大道读立面、庭院与地下酒窖入口，再进酩悦的二十八公里画廊，最后走到巴黎之花，看新艺术宅邸、地下酒窖与以霞多丽为骨架的香槟。

en.title: Champagne: a walk along the Avenue de Champagne in Épernay
en.summary: On a street of about a kilometre and a half, read Champagne through its houses and its hills at once. Walk the façades, courtyards and cellar entrances, descend into Moët's 28 kilometres of galleries, then continue to Perrier-Jouët for its Art Nouveau house, cellars and Chardonnay-led cuvées.

zh.title: 干邑路线：干邑镇与雅尔纳克之间的酒庄带
zh.summary: 沿夏朗特河十余公里的酒商带，两站都在干邑镇内：轩尼诗码头游客中心与人头马老宅。一条线看大酒商如何用十条线路经营品牌，另一条线看 Fine Champagne 如何把原料承诺拆到三处参观点；背景是六大 cru、白玉霓、二次蒸馏与 VS/VSOP/XO 分级。

en.title: Cognac trail: the house belt between Cognac and Jarnac
en.summary: A belt of houses along a dozen kilometres of the Charente, with both stops inside Cognac town: the Hennessy quay and the Rémy Martin historic house. One shows a large house running ten tours as a brand flagship; the other breaks a Fine Champagne promise into three visitor sites. The background is six crus, Ugni Blanc, double distillation and the VS/VSOP/XO scale.

zh.title: 古巴朗姆路线：哈瓦那与圣地亚哥的两座朗姆博物馆
zh.summary: 从哈瓦那老城港口大道 262 号的品牌博物馆，到圣地亚哥圣巴西利奥街 358 号的地方产业博物馆。两城相距八百多公里，共用一条从 aguardiente 到 ron、从 1862 年到国有化与出口体系的线索。

en.title: Cuba rum trail: Havana and Santiago de Cuba
en.summary: From the brand museum at Avenida del Puerto 262 in old Havana to the local industry museum at Calle San Basilio 358 in Santiago de Cuba. The cities are more than 800 km apart and share one thread: aguardiente to ron, 1862, nationalisation and the export system.

zh.title: 都柏林酒馆路线：从下桥街走到圣詹姆斯门
zh.summary: 从利菲河南岸的铜头酒馆出发，沿河向西步行到健力士仓库。一站是日常酒馆里的生啤，一站是旧发酵车间改成的品牌展馆，用半天时间看都柏林如何分别经营同一杯黑色啤酒。

en.title: Dublin pub trail: from Lower Bridge Street to St James's Gate
en.summary: Start at the Brazen Head on the south bank of the Liffey and walk west to the Guinness Storehouse. One stop is an everyday pub pouring stout from the tap; the other is a brand exhibition in an old fermentation building. Half a day shows how Dublin sells and explains the same dark beer.

zh.title: 汾阳路线：汾酒与杏花村
zh.summary: 在汾阳用一天读清香型白酒与诗酒杏花村：上午到汾酒博物馆与老作坊看地缸、制曲与蒸馏，下午到杏花村镇看展陈、碑刻与镇区；厂区、老作坊与展陈分别确认，品鉴后不开车。

en.title: Fenyang Route: Fenjiu and Xinghua Village
en.summary: One day in Fenyang for light-aroma baijiu and the poetry of Xinghua Village: morning at the Fenjiu Museum and old workshop for jars, starter culture and distillation, afternoon in Xinghua Village for displays, inscriptions and town. Confirm plant, old workshop and displays separately, and do not drive after tasting.

zh.title: 古蔺二郎路线：郎酒庄园与赤水河谷
zh.summary: 在古蔺二郎镇用一天读酱香型白酒与赤水河左岸：上午进郎酒庄园看酿造、洞藏与品鉴，下午到二郎镇看场镇、河谷与跨省通道；庄园、厂区与洞藏分别预约，山路与住宿要留足时间。

en.title: Gulin Erlang Route: Langjiu Estate and the Chishui Valley
en.summary: One day in Erlang, Gulin, for sauce-aroma baijiu and the left bank of the Chishui: morning at Langjiu Estate for brewing, cave storage and tasting, afternoon in Erlang Town for the market town, valley and cross-province routes. Book estate, plant and caves separately, and allow time for mountain roads and lodging.

zh.title: 爱尔兰威士忌路线：海岸、城市与中部小镇
zh.summary: 从安特里姆海岸的布什米尔斯出发，南下都柏林弓街的旧酒厂，再折向中部基尔伯根的老厂。三站分别代表仍在生产的酒厂、已停产改作展馆的酒厂，以及靠社区修复重新出酒的小镇酒厂，一条自驾线把爱尔兰威士忌的三段时间放在同一趟旅程里。

en.title: Irish whiskey: coast, city and midlands
en.summary: From Bushmills on the Antrim coast, south to the old Jameson distillery at Bow Street in Dublin, then west to the old plant at Kilbeggan. The three stops stand for a working distillery, a distillery that stopped and became a visitor centre, and a small-town plant revived by its community, so one drive holds three different periods of Irish whiskey.

zh.title: 艾雷岛路线：南岸泥煤威士忌三家酒厂
zh.summary: 从 Port Ellen 出发，沿南岸步道依次走到 Lagavulin、Ardbeg 与 Laphroaig。三家酒厂相距不远，风格却从“重泥煤、慢蒸馏”走到“带海水与药味的泥煤”，一条步道就能把艾雷岛南岸的风、海、麦与火串起来。

en.title: Islay: three peat distilleries on the south coast
en.summary: From Port Ellen, follow the south-coast path to Lagavulin, Ardbeg and Laphroaig. The three distilleries sit close together, yet their styles run from slow-distilled heavy peat to a medicinal, sea-driven peat, so one walk connects wind, sea, malt and fire.

zh.title: 日本路线：从山崎蒸馏所到伏见、西宫的清酒酒藏
zh.summary: 先把日本威士忌的起点放在山崎，再沿铁路到京都伏见的月桂冠大仓酒藏，最后到西宫的白鹿酒藏。三站都用“水”把工艺串起来：山崎的泉水、伏见的软水、西宫的滩五乡水运，构成一条从蒸馏到酿造的对照路线。

en.title: Japan: from Yamazaki Distillery to the sake kura of Fushimi and Nishinomiya
en.summary: Begin with the birthplace of Japanese malt whisky at Yamazaki, take the railway to Gekkeikan's Okura Sake Museum in Fushimi, then continue to the Hakushika Sake Museum in Nishinomiya. Water connects all three: the springs of Yamazaki, the soft water of Fushimi and the Nada transport network.

zh.title: 日本威士忌路线：坐铁路从山崎到白州
zh.summary: 山崎与白州同属三得利，却分处大阪府与山梨县，中间隔着大半条本州岛。这条路线不租车，用 JR 与接驳巴士把两座蒸馏所串起来：先在京都西南看日本最早的麦芽威士忌蒸馏所，再到南阿尔卑斯山脚看一座建在森林里的蒸馏所，比较两套水、两种气候与两种原酒策略。

en.title: Japan's whisky trail: from Yamazaki to Hakushu by rail
en.summary: Yamazaki and Hakushu both belong to Suntory, yet they sit in Osaka Prefecture and Yamanashi Prefecture with most of Honshu between them. This route uses no car, linking the two distilleries by JR trains and a shuttle bus to compare two waters, two climates and two approaches to making spirit.

zh.title: 赫雷斯雪莉路线：一座城、两家酒庄与三条陈年路径
zh.summary: 从阿科斯街的卢士涛步行到曼努埃尔·马利亚·冈萨雷斯街的冈萨雷斯·比亚斯，两站都在赫雷斯-德拉弗龙特拉；串起 solera 叠桶、flor 生物陈年与氧化陈年的分岔，写清顺序、步行与短途车程、预约季节、配餐与酒后驾驶边界。

en.title: Jerez sherry route: one city, two houses, three paths of ageing
en.summary: From Lustau on Calle Arcos to González Byass on Calle Manuel María González, both in Jerez de la Frontera, this walk links the solera stack, biological flor ageing and oxidative ageing; it covers the order, the walk and short drives, booking and seasons, pairing, and the drink-drive boundary.

zh.title: 鹿儿岛烧酒路线
zh.summary: 从枕崎的花渡川蒸馏所明治藏，到都城志比田町的雾岛工厂花园；两站以甘薯为原料，串起白曲与黑曲、常压与减压蒸馏、25 度与 20 度的度数分界，以及甕仕込与甕贮藏。

en.title: Kagoshima shochu route: Makurazaki to Miyakonojo
en.summary: From the Hanatogawa Distillery Meijigura in Makurazaki to Kirishima Factory Garden in Miyakonojo, both using sweet potato; the drive connects white and black koji, atmospheric and vacuum distillation, the 25- and 20-degree boundary, and jar fermentation and storage.

zh.title: 肯塔基波本路线：法兰克福、巴兹敦与洛雷托的三座厂区
zh.summary: 从法兰克福的水牛足迹，到巴兹敦的天堂山，再到洛雷托的美格。三站构成一个三角，车程分别约一小时、半小时和一个多小时，分别回答大产能多品牌、家族配方矩阵与小麦农场三条不同的波本路径。

en.title: Kentucky bourbon trail: Frankfort, Bardstown and Loretto
en.summary: From Buffalo Trace in Frankfort to Heaven Hill in Bardstown and Maker's Mark in Loretto. The three stops form a triangle of about an hour, half an hour and a little over an hour, and answer three different questions about large-scale brands, a family recipe matrix and a wheat farm.

zh.title: 卢瓦尔白诗南路线：武弗雷与萨韦尼耶尔
zh.summary: 从武弗雷的休埃酒庄到萨韦尼耶尔的塞朗河畔坡地，两站沿卢瓦尔河中段展开。这条路线用白诗南的干型、半干、贵腐与起泡多面性，以及两座酒庄的生物动力法实践，串起 Vouvray 与 Savennières 两种截然不同的白诗南表达。

en.title: Loire Chenin trail: Vouvray and Savennières
en.summary: From Domaine Huet in Vouvray to La Coulée de Serrant in Savennières, the two stops run through the middle Loire. Dry, off-dry, botrytised and sparkling Chenin, plus two biodynamic estates, connect the very different expressions of Vouvray and Savennières.

zh.title: 伦敦经典酒吧步行路线
zh.summary: 从萨沃伊的美式酒吧出发，经梅费尔的康诺特酒吧与圣詹姆斯的杜克斯酒吧，最后到舰队街的柴郡奶酪酒馆。三间酒店酒吧对照一间历史酒馆，以步行与短程出租车串联，适合傍晚出发、持续到夜间。

en.title: London classic bar walk: three hotel bars and a Fleet Street pub
en.summary: From the American Bar at The Savoy via the Connaught Bar in Mayfair and DUKES Bar in St James's to Ye Olde Cheshire Cheese on Fleet Street. Three hotel bars set against one historic pub, linked on foot and by short taxi rides, for an evening that runs into the night.

zh.title: 伦敦金酒路线
zh.summary: 以梅菲尔与圣詹姆斯的两家经典酒吧为停靠点，读伦敦金酒从 18 世纪蒸馏立法到当代金汤力的变化；重点不是喝多少杯，而是看酒单如何把杜松子、柑橘与香料写成不同风格。

en.title: London Gin Route
en.summary: Two classic bars in Mayfair and St James anchor a reading of London gin from eighteenth-century distillation laws to the modern gin and tonic; the point is not how many glasses, but how menus turn juniper, citrus and spice into different styles.

zh.title: 泸州老窖路线：国窖广场到活态窖池
zh.summary: 在泸州用一天读泸州老窖：上午看国窖广场与博物馆，建立浓香型白酒的窖池、窖泥与作坊框架；下午到 1573 国宝窖池群与明清酿酒作坊看活态遗产，最后回到老城与长江边收尾。

en.title: Luzhou Laojiao Route: Guojiao Square to Living Pits
en.summary: One day of Luzhou Laojiao: spend the morning at Guojiao Square and the museum building a framework of pits, mud and workshops, then visit the 1573 national treasure pits and Ming–Qing workshops in the afternoon, finishing in the old town and by the Yangtze.

zh.title: 马德拉酒路线：丰沙尔市中心的两种酒商面孔
zh.summary: 丰沙尔市中心步行串联布兰迪酒庄与恩里克斯与恩里克斯：一处是修道院改建、面向访客的酒窖，一处是 1850 年创立、仍自营 Quinta Grande 葡萄园的酒商；两站合起来把“马德拉为什么耐放”讲成工艺问题，并给出预约、邮轮人流与配餐建议。

en.title: Madeira wine route: two faces of the wine trade in central Funchal
en.summary: A walk through central Funchal linking Blandy's Wine Lodge with Henriques & Henriques — a convent turned visitor cellar and a house founded in 1850 that still farms Quinta Grande; together they turn the question of why Madeira keeps into one about process, with booking, cruise traffic and pairing notes.

zh.title: 茅台镇白酒路线：从酒文化城到茅台酒厂
zh.summary: 在贵州仁怀茅台镇用一天读酱香型白酒：先到中国酒文化城看酒源、酒技与酒俗，再到赤水河畔的茅台酒厂理解核心产区、生产节律与参观边界；路线同时处理预约、品鉴、购买与镇内交通。

en.title: Maotai Town baijiu route: from the Culture City to the distillery
en.summary: A one-day route through sauce-aroma baijiu at Maotai Town, Renhuai, Guizhou: start at the China Liquor Culture City for the history and craft, then move to the Maotai distillery on the Chishui River to understand the core production area, the annual rhythm and the limits of visiting; includes booking, tasting, buying and local transport.

zh.title: 玛格丽特河葡萄酒路线
zh.summary: 从珀斯南下玛格丽特河，以法塞尔与露纹两座先锋酒庄为锚点；一天里看海洋性气候、1970 年代建园史、Art Series 酒标与露纹音乐会，以及 Bussell Highway 两侧的桉树林与葡萄园。

en.title: Margaret River Wine Route
en.summary: South from Perth to Margaret River, anchored by Vasse Felix and Leeuwin Estate; a day of maritime climate, 1970s planting history, Art Series labels, the Leeuwin Concert and eucalyptus and vines along Bussell Highway.

zh.title: 马尔堡葡萄酒路线
zh.summary: 以布伦海姆的云雾之湾与塞登的伊兰兹为两站的自驾路线，从 Wairau Valley 的老河床砾石走到 Awatere Valley 的沿海风带，用同一天对照马尔堡长相思的两种成熟节奏与两种酒庄叙事。

en.title: Marlborough wine trail: Wairau gravel to Awatere sea wind
en.summary: A self-drive route pairing Cloudy Bay near Blenheim with Yealands at Seddon, moving from the old riverbed gravels of the Wairau Valley to the coastal wind of the Awatere Valley in a single day.

zh.title: 麦克拉伦谷葡萄酒路线
zh.summary: 从阿德莱德南下麦克拉伦谷，以达伦堡与维拉维拉两座历史酒庄为锚点；一天里看地中海气候、百年石造酒窖、西拉与多品种混酿，以及“立方体”式的当代酒庄建筑。

en.title: McLaren Vale Wine Route
en.summary: South from Adelaide into McLaren Vale, anchored by d’Arenberg and Wirra Wirra; a day of Mediterranean climate, century-old stone cellars, Shiraz and multi-variety blends, and the contemporary “Cube” architecture.

zh.title: 门多萨葡萄酒路线
zh.summary: 从卢汉德库约的卡氏家族酒庄到迈普的苏卡尔迪家族基地，一条位于门多萨 Primera Zona 的自驾线；沿路理解 1,500 米高海拔、安第斯融雪滴灌与 Malbec 的三级海拔带。

en.title: Mendoza wine trail: Luján de Cuyo to Maipú
en.summary: A self-drive route from Catena Zapata in Luján de Cuyo to the Zuccardi family base in Maipú, both in Mendoza's Primera Zona, using the drive to explain 1,500-metre altitude, Andean snowmelt drip irrigation and Malbec across the Uco Valley's three altitude bands.

zh.title: 墨西哥龙舌兰路线
zh.summary: 从阿马蒂坦的埃拉杜拉庄园到特基拉镇的福塔莱萨，两站都落在火山低地的蓝色龙舌兰核心带。前者用砖砌穹顶炉、野酵母与现代磨机延续大庄园规模，后者用塔霍纳、木槽与两只老铜壶维持小批量，路线还串起 CRT 与 NOM-006 的判断框架。

en.title: Mexico Tequila Trail
en.summary: From Casa Herradura at Amatitlán to Fortaleza in Tequila town, two stops in the volcanic lowlands and their Blue Weber agave core. The first combines estate scale, brick dome ovens, wild yeast and modern milling; the second keeps a tahona, wooden vats and two old copper stills for small batches. The route also frames the CRT and NOM-006 rules.

zh.title: 绵竹路线：剑南春酒坊与年画村
zh.summary: 在绵竹用一天把酒与年画分开看：上午到剑南春酒坊遗址与天益老号看浓香型窖池与作坊，下午到孝德镇年画村看木版年画的刻版、套印与手绘；两处各有入口与预约规则，品鉴、买酒与买画分开处理。

en.title: Mianzhu Route: Jiannanchun Workshop and New Year Pictures
en.summary: One day in Mianzhu separating liquor and pictures: morning at the Jiannanchun workshop site and Tianyi Laohao for strong-aroma pits and workshops, afternoon at Xiaode’s New Year Picture Village for block carving, printing and hand painting. Each has its own entrance and booking rules; keep tasting, liquor buying and print buying apart.

zh.title: 摩泽尔雷司令路线：中摩泽尔与萨尔的两座陡坡酒庄
zh.summary: 从贝恩卡斯特-库斯的卢森博士酒庄到维尔廷根的伊贡·米勒酒庄，两站沿摩泽尔与萨尔河谷展开。这条路线用板岩坡地、陡坡人工与雷司令的残糖分级，串起中摩泽尔的地块组合与沙兹霍夫山的单一名园。

en.title: Mosel Riesling trail: two steep-slope estates on the Mittelmosel and Saar
en.summary: From Dr. Loosen in Bernkastel-Kues to Egon Müller in Wiltingen, the two stops follow the Mosel and Saar valleys. Slate slopes, hand work and the Riesling ripeness scale connect the Mittelmosel's parcel logic with the single hill of the Scharzhofberg.

zh.title: 纳帕谷路线：1976 年巴黎审判之后的现代酒庄带
zh.summary: 从罗伯特·蒙大维的 To Kalon 葡萄园出发，到蒙大维与菲利普·德·罗思柴尔德男爵合办的 Opus One，最后回到 1876 年创立的贝灵哲。三站都在 St Helena Highway 沿线，却分属“现代纳帕的起点”“跨大西洋合资”与“禁酒令前的老酒庄”三种时间。

en.title: Napa Valley: the modern winery belt after the 1976 Judgment of Paris
en.summary: Start in Robert Mondavi's To Kalon vineyards, continue to Opus One, the joint venture between Mondavi and Baron Philippe de Rothschild, and finish at Beringer, founded in 1876. All three sit along St Helena Highway, yet they belong to three different times.

zh.title: 纽约历史酒馆路线：东村到格拉梅西
zh.summary: 从东村的麦克索利老麦酒馆出发，经西村的白马酒馆，最后到格拉梅西公园旁的皮特酒馆。三间老酒馆各有不同的“老”，以地铁与步行为主，适合下午到傍晚的半日路线。

en.title: New York historic pubs: East Village to Gramercy
en.summary: From McSorley's Old Ale House in the East Village via the White Horse Tavern in the West Village to Pete's Tavern by Gramercy Park. Three old pubs with three different kinds of “old”, linked mainly by subway and on foot, for an afternoon into the evening.

zh.title: 瓦哈卡梅斯卡尔路线
zh.summary: 先在瓦哈卡市中心的梅斯卡尔图书馆建立品种与村子的坐标，再南下圣卡塔里娜米纳斯的雷亚尔米内罗看土坑、木槌与陶罐。两站之间是中央谷地的 Espadín 田、圣地亚哥马塔特兰的 palenque 群，以及 NOM-070 划出的底线。

en.title: Oaxaca Mezcal Trail
en.summary: Start at Mezcaloteca in central Oaxaca city to build coordinates of variety and village, then head south to Real Minero in Santa Catarina Minas for earthen pits, wooden mallets and clay pots. Between them lie the Espadín fields of the central valleys, the palenques of Santiago Matatlán and the floor set by NOM-070.

zh.title: 皮埃蒙特巴巴莱斯科路线
zh.summary: 从巴巴莱斯科村的嘉雅到塞拉伦加达尔巴的丰塔纳弗雷达，两站相距约半小时，串起内比奥罗、巴巴莱斯科与巴罗洛的法定差异、朗格的雾与晚收，以及单园与橡木的争论。嘉雅参观政策未公开确认，出发前须联系官方。

en.title: Piedmont Barbaresco trail: Barbaresco to Serralunga
en.summary: From Gaja in Barbaresco to Fontanafredda in Serralunga d'Alba, two stops about half an hour apart. The drive links Nebbiolo, the legal differences between Barbaresco and Barolo, Langhe fog and late picking, and the single-vineyard and oak arguments. Gaja's visiting policy is not publicly confirmed, so contact the estate before going.

zh.title: 波特与杜罗路线：从萨布罗萨的老藤到皮尼昂的国家园
zh.summary: 沿杜罗河右岸自驾，从萨布罗萨 Gouvinhas 的克拉斯托到皮尼昂的诺瓦尔，两站都在片岩坡地上、都同时做杜罗 DOC 与波特，却分别讲“整片地产的家族接力”和“一块未嫁接地块的连续性”；含地址顺序、车程、预约季节与吐酒驾驶建议。

en.title: Porto and Douro route: old vines at Sabrosa, the Nacional block at Pinhão
en.summary: A drive along the Douro's right bank from Quinta do Crasto at Gouvinhas in Sabrosa to Quinta do Noval near Pinhão; both estates work schist slopes and make Douro DOC and Port, but one tells a story of estate-wide family continuity and the other of a single ungrafted block.

zh.title: 布拉格啤酒路线：从弗勒克到小熊
zh.summary: 从只酿一款深色拉格的弗勒克啤酒屋，步行到把微型酒厂塞进老城的小熊酒馆。两站相距不到一公里，却把布拉格啤酒的两种性格放在同一个下午：一种酒做到熟，和一个小厂做到全。

en.title: Prague beer trail: from U Fleků to U Medvídků
en.summary: Walk from U Fleků, which brews a single dark lager, to U Medvídků, which packs a microbrewery into an old town house. Less than a kilometre apart, the two stops put two Prague attitudes to beer into one afternoon: one beer perfected, or one small brewery doing everything.

zh.title: 普罗旺斯桃红路线
zh.summary: 从塔拉多的 Château de Selle 到科朗斯的米拉沃，两站相隔约一小时，用一天时间对照普罗旺斯桃红的两种路径：一处开放酒窖、按预约接待；一处私家庄园、只通过渠道出售。路线同时解释米斯特拉尔风、石灰岩与片岩，以及浅色桃红的直接压榨工艺。

en.title: Provence rosé trail: Taradeau to Correns
en.summary: From Château de Selle in Taradeau to Miraval in Correns, two stops about an hour apart. One day sets two Provençal rosé paths side by side: a working cellar that receives visitors by appointment, and a private estate that stays closed and sells only through channels. The drive also explains the Mistral, limestone and schist, and the direct-press method behind pale rosé.

zh.title: 青岛啤酒路线：博物馆、老厂区与登州路啤酒街
zh.summary: 从青岛啤酒博物馆的百年厂房与老设备开始，走到同一厂区仍在运转的生产廊道，再出门进入登州路啤酒街，用一扎原浆和一份辣炒蛤蜊收尾。三站相距很近，讲的却是三件事：工业史、仍在工作的工厂、城市夜生活。

en.title: Qingdao Beer Trail: museum, old brewery and Dengzhou Road
