en.summary: Start in the century-old halls and old equipment of the Tsingtao Beer Museum, walk the glass corridor of the still-working plant on the same site, then step onto Dengzhou Road Beer Street for a jug of draft beer and a plate of spicy clams. The stops are close together but tell three different stories: industrial history, a working factory and city nightlife.

zh.title: 里奥哈哈罗车站区酒庄路线：三家百年酒庄与长时间陈年
zh.summary: 从洛佩兹雷迪亚出发，步行到里奥哈阿尔塔，再到 CVNE。三家庄园都挤在阿罗火车站旁的一小片街区里，却分别代表极端传统、经典长陈年与家族品牌三条路径；路线讲清车站区历史、美国桶传统、预约与火车到达。

en.title: Rioja: three century-old bodegas by Haro station
en.summary: From López de Heredia, walk to La Rioja Alta and then CVNE. All three stand in the small Barrio de la Estación beside Haro's railway station, yet represent extreme tradition, classic long ageing and a family brand; the route explains the district's history, the American-oak tradition, booking and arriving by train.

zh.title: 广岛西条酒藏路线
zh.summary: 从贺茂鹤一号藏步行到贺茂泉延寿藏，两站都在西条酒藏通的一公里余范围内；以七家酒藏的产业聚落、软水与山田锦、冬季酿造、吟酿与纯米吟酿的标签区别，以及春季酒藏开窖活动为线索。

en.title: Saijo sake route: Kamotsuru to Kamoizumi on foot
en.summary: A walk from Kamotsuru's No. 1 Brewery to Kamoizumi's Enju warehouse, both within a little over a kilometre on Saijo's Sakagura-dori; the route uses seven breweries as an industrial cluster and follows soft water, Yamada Nishiki, winter brewing, ginjo versus junmai ginjo labels and the spring kurabiraki openings.

zh.title: 圣日耳曼德佩文学咖啡馆半日路线
zh.summary: 以巴黎圣日耳曼德佩广场为中心的两站步行路线：先在双叟咖啡馆坐看广场，再横过街口到花神咖啡馆。两店相距很近，适合半日慢走，不适合赶景点。

en.title: Saint-Germain-des-Prés literary cafés: a half-day walk
en.summary: A two-stop walking route around the Place Saint-Germain-des-Prés in Paris: sit first at Les Deux Magots looking onto the square, then cross the street corner to Café de Flore. The two are very close together, so this suits half a day of slow walking rather than sightseeing on a schedule.

zh.title: 苏格兰高地路线：沿 A9 从泰恩到德拉莫赫特山口
zh.summary: 从多诺赫湾边的格兰杰，沿 A9 向西南到凯恩戈姆边缘的达尔维尼。一站靠海、一站靠山口，车程约两小时，却把“高地”这个大产区分成轻酒体与厚酒体两种答案。

en.title: Highlands whisky trail: Tain to the Drumochter pass
en.summary: From Glenmorangie by the Dornoch Firth to Dalwhinnie at the edge of the Cairngorms, following the A9. One stop sits by the sea, the other by a mountain pass, and two hours of driving split the large Highland region into a light style and a heavier one.

zh.title: 绍兴黄酒路线：从博物馆到咸亨，再到中央酒库
zh.summary: 用一天时间把绍兴黄酒拆成三层：上午在中国黄酒博物馆读历史、工艺与酒俗，中午到鲁迅中路的咸亨酒店用一碟茴香豆和一盏黄酒落到城市生活，下午去古越龙山中央酒库看陶坛与年份。三站分别回答“怎么酿、怎么喝、怎么存”。

en.title: Shaoxing Yellow Wine Trail: museum, Xianheng and the central cellar
en.summary: A one-day route that splits Shaoxing yellow wine into three layers. The China Yellow Wine Museum explains history, craft and custom; Xianheng Hotel on Lu Xun Middle Road brings the wine into a meal; Guyuelongshan's central cellar shows jars, vintage and time. The three stops answer how it is made, how it is drunk and how it is stored.

zh.title: 索诺马县葡萄酒路线
zh.summary: 从希尔兹堡出发，以乔丹与威廉姆斯-塞莱姆两座酒庄为锚点；一天里看亚历山大谷的赤霞珠、俄罗斯河谷的黑皮诺、法式城堡与车库起家的先锋故事，以及索诺马县的海岸雾与内陆热。

en.title: Sonoma County Wine Route
en.summary: From Healdsburg, anchored by Jordan and Williams Selyem; a day of Alexander Valley Cabernet, Russian River Valley Pinot Noir, a French-style château and a garage-founded pioneer story, with Sonoma’s coastal fog and inland heat.

zh.title: 斯佩塞麦芽威士忌路线：达夫镇、Craigellachie 与 Ballindalloch
zh.summary: 从达夫镇的格兰菲迪出发，经 Craigellachie 的麦卡伦庄园，到 Ballindalloch 的格兰威特。三站沿 A941 与 A95 展开，车程都在半小时上下，却分别代表家族独立与大产能、雪莉桶与新厂建筑、果香风格与合法化历史。

en.title: Speyside malt trail: Dufftown, Craigellachie and Ballindalloch
en.summary: From Glenfiddich in Dufftown, via The Macallan Estate at Craigellachie, to Glenlivet at Ballindalloch. The three stops follow the A941 and A95, each within half an hour of the next, and represent family independence and volume, sherry casks and a new distillery, and a fruity style with a legalisation history.

zh.title: 宿迁路线：洋河与双沟
zh.summary: 在宿迁用一天串起洋河与双沟两座酒镇：上午到洋河酒厂文化旅游区看浓香型白酒的窖池、展陈与厂区，下午到双沟酒业与镇区看老窖与水乡湿地；两处分别预约，品鉴后不开车。

en.title: Suqian Route: Yanghe and Shuanggou
en.summary: One day linking Suqian’s two liquor towns: morning at the Yanghe distillery culture tourism area for strong-aroma pits, displays and plant, afternoon at Shuanggou distillery and town for old pits and wetland water country. Book both separately and do not drive after tasting.

zh.title: 田纳西威士忌路线：林奇堡与 Cascade Hollow 的两个山谷
zh.summary: 从林奇堡的杰克丹尼，到塔拉霍马附近 Cascade Hollow 的乔治迪克尔。两站相距约半小时到四十分钟，都在田纳西州境内完成糖枫木炭过滤，却用常温与低温两种做法，把同一道工序拆成两种质地。

en.title: Tennessee whiskey trail: Lynchburg and Cascade Hollow
en.summary: From Jack Daniel's in Lynchburg to George Dickel at Cascade Hollow near Tullahoma. The two stops are half an hour to forty minutes apart, both complete their charcoal filtering in Tennessee, and use ambient and chilled methods to turn one process into two textures.

zh.title: 东京酒吧路线：银座的两位调酒师
zh.summary: 从银座五丁目的 High Five 走到一丁目并木通边的星光酒吧，两站都以步行为交通；一条对照“无酒单定制”与“经典老派吧台”的夜间短路线。

en.title: Tokyo bar route: two bartenders in Ginza
en.summary: From Bar High Five in Ginza 5-chome to Star Bar Ginza by Namiki-dori in 1-chome, both reached on foot; a short evening route contrasting no-menu custom drinks with a classic old-school counter.

zh.title: 经典基安蒂路线：从佛罗伦萨到三座酒庄
zh.summary: 从佛罗伦萨南下，先到 Bargino 的安东尼世家酒庄看当代建筑与重力酿造，再到 Gaiole 的布罗利奥城堡读里卡索利家族与 1872 年配方，最后到 Castelnuovo Berardenga 的费尔西纳庄园比较桑娇维塞的地块差异；三站把经典基安蒂的建筑、历史与品种串成一天。

en.title: Chianti Classico: from Florence to three estates
en.summary: A one-day drive from Florence to the Antinori winery at Bargino for contemporary architecture and gravity-flow winemaking, Castello di Brolio at Gaiole for the Ricasoli family and the 1872 formula, and Fattoria Fèlsina at Castelnuovo Berardenga for Sangiovese clones and plot differences.

zh.title: 威尼托普罗塞克路线
zh.summary: 从瓦尔多比亚德内的比索尔1542到富马内的阿莱格里尼，车程约一个半小时，把格雷拉与陡坡手工采收、卡特兹与 Grave di Stecca、罐式发酵与传统法，同瓦坡里切拉的科维纳与风干工艺放在同一天对照。

en.title: Veneto Prosecco trail: Valdobbiadene to Fumane
en.summary: From Bisol1542 in Valdobbiadene to Allegrini in Fumane, about an hour and a half by car. One day sets Glera and steep-slope hand harvesting, Cartizze and Grave di Stecca, tank fermentation and the traditional method against Valpolicella's Corvina and dried-grape wines.

zh.title: 威尼斯圣马可广场两站酒吧路线
zh.summary: 从圣马可广场的花神咖啡馆走到卡莱瓦拉雷索街的哈里酒吧，两站都在广场周边，步行几分钟可达。一条适合傍晚的短路线，主题是威尼斯咖啡馆到鸡尾酒吧的过渡。

en.title: Venice: two bars around Piazza San Marco
en.summary: From Caffè Florian on Piazza San Marco to Harry's Bar on Calle Vallaresso, both within a few minutes' walk of the square. A short evening route about the transition from the Venetian café to the cocktail bar.

zh.title: 维也纳咖啡馆傍晚路线：中央咖啡馆到斯佩尔
zh.summary: 先在费尔斯特宫拱廊下的中央咖啡馆坐一会儿，再步行或乘地铁到玛利亚希尔夫的斯佩尔咖啡馆。两站都是维也纳传统咖啡馆，适合傍晚出发，用两三个小时比较“拱廊大厅”与“街区咖啡馆”的差别。

en.title: Vienna coffee-house evening: Café Central to Café Sperl
en.summary: Sit first under the arcades of the Palais Ferstel at Café Central, then walk or take the U-Bahn to Café Sperl in Mariahilf. Two traditional Viennese coffee houses, suited to an evening start and two or three hours of comparing the grand hall with the neighbourhood room.

zh.title: 威拉米特谷葡萄酒路线
zh.summary: 从波特兰南下威拉米特谷，以杜鲁安俄勒冈与艾瑞两座 Dundee Hills 酒庄为锚点；一天里看 1960–70 年代的先锋种植、勃艮第式黑皮诺、老藤与有机栽培，以及 Oregon Wine Board 的产区叙事。

en.title: Willamette Valley Wine Route
en.summary: South from Portland into the Willamette Valley, anchored by Domaine Drouhin Oregon and The Eyrie Vineyards in the Dundee Hills; a day of 1960s–70s pioneer planting, Burgundian Pinot Noir, old vines and organic farming, and the Oregon Wine Board’s regional story.

zh.title: 习水路线：习酒厂区与土城古镇
zh.summary: 在贵州习水用一天串起酱香型白酒与赤水河历史：上午到习酒镇看厂区与河谷，理解赤水河中游的酱香生产；下午到土城看四渡赤水纪念馆、老街与渡口；厂区按预约，古镇按单向动线，品鉴后不开车。

en.title: Xishui Route: Xijiu Plant and Tucheng Old Town
en.summary: One day in Xishui, Guizhou, linking sauce-aroma baijiu and Chishui River history: morning in Xijiu Town for the plant and valley, understanding middle-Chishui production; afternoon in Tucheng for the Four Crossings memorial, old street and ferry. Book the plant, walk the old town one way, and do not drive after tasting.

zh.title: 宜宾五粮液路线：从酒文化博览馆到十里酒城
zh.summary: 在宜宾用一天读浓香型白酒：上午到五粮液酒文化博览馆建立原料、窖池、制曲与勾调框架，下午沿十里酒城的公共道路看厂区尺度与江岸空间；生产区只走官方预约线路，品鉴与买酒分开。

en.title: Yibin Wuliangye Route: Museum to Ten-Li Liquor City
en.summary: One day of strong-aroma baijiu in Yibin: spend the morning at the Wuliangye Wine Culture Museum building a framework of grains, pits, starter culture and blending, then follow the public roads of Ten-Li Liquor City in the afternoon for plant scale and riverfront space. Enter production only on official booked routes, and keep tasting separate from buying.

zh.title: 波尔多 AOC 法令
zh.summary: 波尔多是区域级原产地命名，1936 年获得认定，现行规范于 2025 年 9 月批准。它规定红、白、桃红三类酒的品种、产量上限、修剪与标签，其下还叠着数十个更具体的市镇级 AOC。

en.title: Bordeaux AOC Decree
en.summary: Bordeaux is a regional appellation, recognised in 1936, with a specification approved in September 2025. It sets grape varieties, yield ceilings, pruning and labelling for red, white and rosé wines, and sits above dozens of more specific village-level AOCs.

zh.title: 勃艮第 AOC 法令
zh.summary: 勃艮第有 84 个原产地命名，分区域级、村庄级与特级园三层，地块细到名为“climat”的历史单元。2015 年，climats 被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产，让一套葡萄园地名获得了文化身份。

en.title: Burgundy AOC Decree
en.summary: Burgundy has 84 appellations in three tiers — regional, village and grand cru — with parcels traced down to historical units called climats. In 2015 the climats were inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage site, giving a set of vineyard names a cultural identity.

zh.title: 香槟原产地命名法令（Champagne AOC）
zh.summary: 香槟于 1936-06-29 获原产地命名，产区范围由 1927-07-22 法律划定，现由 INAO 管理；现行产区规范规定七个主要品种、瓶内二次发酵、无年份至少陈年 15 个月、年份至少 36 个月，并约束压力、产量与标签。

en.title: Champagne AOC: The Appellation Rules
en.summary: Champagne was recognised as an appellation d'origine contrôlée on 29 June 1936, with its area delimited by the law of 22 July 1927 and supervised today by INAO. The current specification requires seven main varieties, in-bottle second fermentation and at least 15 months' ageing for non-vintage and 36 months for vintage Champagne.

zh.title: 中国地理标志保护制度
zh.summary: 中国地理标志产品保护由《地理标志产品保护办法》（国家知识产权局令第80号）规范，2024-02-01 起施行；它把地理标志产品定义为产自特定地域、质量声誉或其他特性本质上取决于该产地自然与人文因素的产品，并强调真实性、地域性、特异性与关联性。

en.title: China's geographical indication protection
en.summary: China's geographical indication product protection is governed by the Measures for the Protection of Geographical Indication Products (CNIPA Order No. 80), in force from 2024-02-01; the product must originate in a specific region and its quality, reputation or other characteristics must be essentially attributable to that region's natural and human factors, with authenticity, territoriality, specificity and linkage.

zh.title: 干邑 AOC 法令
zh.summary: 干邑是法国最早划定的葡萄酒产地之一，现行规范于 2022 年 10 月批准并公布。它规定六个种植区、允许的葡萄品种、两次铜壶蒸馏与橡木桶陈年，并把 VS、VSOP、XO 等年龄标示写进法律。

en.title: Cognac AOC Decree
en.summary: Cognac was among the first French wine regions to be delimited, and its current product specification was approved and published in October 2022. It fixes six growing crus, permitted varieties, double copper-still distillation and oak ageing, and writes VS, VSOP and XO into law.

zh.title: 欧盟烈酒法规 (EU) 2019/787
zh.summary: 2019-04-17 通过、2021-05-25 起适用的欧盟烈酒基础法规，取代 (EC) 110/2008；统一“烈酒”定义与 15%vol 最低酒精度，Annex I 列出 44 个类别及各自定义与门槛，并规定法定名称、标签、年龄陈述与地理标志保护。

en.title: Regulation (EU) 2019/787 on Spirit Drinks
en.summary: Adopted on 17 April 2019 and applicable from 25 May 2021, this framework regulation replaced Regulation (EC) No 110/2008. It defines spirit drinks, sets a 15% vol floor, lists 44 categories in Annex I, and governs legal names, labelling, age statements and geographical indications.

zh.title: EU 葡萄酒法规 1308/2013
zh.summary: 欧盟葡萄酒共同市场组织的框架法规：2013 年 12 月通过、2014 年 1 月起适用，统一了种植授权、产地命名、标签与贸易规则。它不规定某款酒怎么酿，而是规定一款酒凭什么可以叫某个名字、装进瓶子后必须告诉消费者什么。

en.title: EU Wine Regulation 1308/2013
en.summary: The European Union's framework for the common organisation of the wine market. Adopted in December 2013 and applicable from January 2014, it harmonises planting authorisations, geographical indications, labelling and trade. It does not tell a winemaker how to ferment; it defines when a wine may use a name, and what the bottle must disclose.

zh.title: GB 15037-2006《葡萄酒》
zh.summary: 2006-12-11 发布、2008-01-01 实施的葡萄酒国家标准，代替 GB/T 15037-1994；按色泽、含糖量与二氧化碳分类，规定酒精度不低于 7.0%vol、干浸出物、挥发酸、柠檬酸、甲醇与防腐剂等指标。发布时为部分条款强制的 GB 15037，2017 年第 7 号公告后整体转化为推荐性 GB/T 15037，顺序号与年代号不变。

en.title: GB 15037-2006 Wines
en.summary: Published on 2006-12-11 and effective from 2008-01-01, this wine standard replaced GB/T 15037-1994; it classifies wine by colour, sugar and carbon dioxide, and sets a minimum alcohol of 7.0%vol plus dry extract, volatile acid, citric acid, methanol and preservative limits. It was issued as a partly mandatory GB 15037, but the 2017 No. 7 announcement converted it in full to recommended GB/T 15037 with the number and year unchanged.

zh.title: GB 2757-2012《食品安全国家标准 蒸馏酒及其配制酒》
zh.summary: 2012-08-06 发布、2013-02-01 实施的强制性食品安全国家标准，代替 GB 2757-1981；适用于蒸馏酒及其配制酒，规定甲醇（粮谷类 0.6 g/L、其他 2.0 g/L）与氰化物（以 HCN 计 8.0 mg/L）限量，均按 100% 酒精度折算，并要求标注酒精度与“过量饮酒有害健康”。

en.title: GB 2757-2012 National food safety standard — Distilled spirits and compounded spirits
en.summary: A mandatory national food safety standard published on 2012-08-06 and effective from 2013-02-01, replacing GB 2757-1981; it covers distilled spirits and compounded spirits and limits methanol to 0.6 g/L for grain-based products and 2.0 g/L for other raw materials, and cyanide as HCN to 8.0 mg/L, both calculated on a 100% alcohol basis. It also requires alcohol content and the warning about excessive drinking on labels. Lead is not set here; it falls under GB 2762.

zh.title: GB/T 10781.1-2021《白酒质量要求 第1部分：浓香型白酒》
zh.summary: 中国现行浓香型白酒国家标准，2021-03-09 发布，2022-04-01 实施，全部代替 GB/T 10781.1-2006；它是“白酒质量要求”系列标准的第 1 部分。

en.title: GB/T 10781.1-2021 Quality requirements for baijiu — Part 1: Nongxiangxing baijiu
en.summary: The current Chinese national standard for Nongxiangxing (strong-aroma) baijiu, published on 2021-03-09 and effective from 2022-04-01; it fully replaces GB/T 10781.1-2006 and forms Part 1 of the "Quality requirements for baijiu" series.

zh.title: GB/T 10781.2-2022《白酒质量要求 第2部分：清香型白酒》
zh.summary: 2022-07-11 发布、2023-02-01 实施的清香型白酒质量要求，代替 GB/T 10781.2-2006；删除高度酒与低度酒的产品分类，改设特级、优级、一级，酒精度统一为 21.0%vol 至 69.0%vol，并按自生产日期一年内、一年后分别考核酸酯指标。

en.title: GB/T 10781.2-2022 Product quality requirements for baijiu — Part 2: Light-aroma baijiu
en.summary: Published on 2022-07-11 and effective from 2023-02-01, this quality requirement replaces GB/T 10781.2-2006; it removes the high-strength and low-strength product classification, introduces special, premium and first grades, sets alcohol at 21.0%vol to 69.0%vol, and applies different acid and ester indices within one year and after one year of production.

zh.title: GB/T 10781.4-2024《白酒质量要求 第4部分：酱香型白酒》
zh.summary: 2024-05-28 发布、2025-06-01 实施的酱香型白酒质量要求，全部代替 GB/T 26760-2011；它首次把高温制曲、两次投料、多轮次堆积与窖内发酵等生产过程控制写入标准，理化指标按 53.0%vol 折算，并按产品自生产日期一年内、一年后分别设限。

en.title: GB/T 10781.4-2024 Product quality requirements for baijiu — Part 4: Sauce-aroma baijiu
en.summary: Published on 2024-05-28 and effective from 2025-06-01, this quality requirement fully replaces GB/T 26760-2011; it writes high-temperature qu production, two rounds of grain feeding and multi-round stacking and pit fermentation into the standard, converts acidity and ester indices to a 53.0%vol basis, and sets separate limits for the first year after production and for later storage.

en.title: GB/T 13662-2018 Huangjiu
en.summary: The current Chinese national standard for Huangjiu (yellow wine), published on 2018-09-17 and effective from 2019-04-01; it fully replaces GB/T 13662-2008.

zh.title: GB/T 14867-2007《凤香型白酒》
zh.summary: 2007-01-19 发布、2007-07-01 实施的凤香型白酒国家标准，代替 GB/T 14867-1994；以乙酸乙酯为主、己酸乙酯为辅的复合香，土窖池发酵与酒海陈酿是其工艺标志。该标准已于 2026-08-01 废止，全部由 GB/T 10781.6-2025 代替。

en.title: GB/T 14867-2007 Feng-flavour baijiu
en.summary: A 2007 national standard for Feng-flavour baijiu replacing GB/T 14867-1994; its compound aroma is led by ethyl acetate with ethyl hexanoate as support, earthen pit fermentation and jiu-hai storage are process markers, and Shaanxi Xifeng is the representative product. The standard was replaced in full by GB/T 10781.6-2025 with effect from 2026-08-01.

zh.title: GB/T 15109-2021《白酒工业术语》
zh.summary: 中国现行白酒工业术语国家标准，2021-05-21 发布，2022-06-01 实施，全部代替 GB/T 15109-2008。

en.title: GB/T 15109-2021 Terminology of baijiu industry
en.summary: The current Chinese national standard for baijiu industry terminology, published on 2021-05-21 and effective from 2022-06-01; it fully replaces GB/T 15109-2008.

zh.title: GB/T 17204-2021《饮料酒术语和分类》
zh.summary: 中国现行饮料酒术语和分类国家标准，2021-05-21 发布，2022-06-01 实施，全部代替 GB/T 17204-2008。

en.title: GB/T 17204-2021 Terminology and classification of alcoholic beverages
en.summary: The current Chinese national standard for alcoholic-beverage terminology and classification, published on 2021-05-21 and effective from 2022-06-01; it fully replaces GB/T 17204-2008.

zh.title: GB/T 23547-2009《浓酱兼香型白酒》
zh.summary: 2009-04-14 发布、2009-12-01 实施的浓酱兼香型白酒国家标准，以浓香与酱香谐调为风格标志，按酒精度分高度酒与低度酒并设优级、一级。该标准已于 2022-06-01 废止，全部由 GB/T 10781.8-2021 代替。

en.title: GB/T 23547-2009 Strong-sauce mixed-aroma baijiu
en.summary: Published on 2009-04-14 and effective from 2009-12-01, this standard defines strong-sauce mixed-aroma baijiu by a harmonious combination of strong and sauce character, classifies it by alcohol content into high-strength and low-strength liquor with premium and first grades, and lists Hubei Baiyunbian and Anhui Kouzijiao among representative products. It was fully replaced by GB/T 10781.8-2021 with effect from 2022-06-01.

en.title: GB/T 26760-2011 Jiang-flavour Chinese spirits
en.summary: The 2011 Chinese national standard for Jiang-flavour (sauce-aroma) baijiu, published on 2011-07-20 and effective from 2011-12-01; it was withdrawn on 2025-06-01 and fully replaced by GB/T 10781.4-2024.

zh.title: GB/T 4927-2008《啤酒》
zh.summary: 2008-12-29 发布、2009-10-01 实施的啤酒产品标准，代替 GB 4927-2001；它把啤酒定义为以麦芽、水为主要原料、加啤酒花并经酵母发酵的低酒精度起泡发酵酒，按色度分为淡色、浓色、黑色并另设特种啤酒，规定酒精度、原麦汁浓度、总酸、二氧化碳与双乙酰等指标。原标准部分条款强制，2017 年整体转化为推荐性 GB/T。

en.title: GB/T 4927-2008 Beer
en.summary: The Chinese beer product standard, published on 2008-12-29 and effective from 2009-10-01, replacing GB 4927-2001; it defines beer as a low-alcohol carbonated fermented drink made mainly from malt and water with hops and yeast, classifies it by colour and special styles, and sets alcohol, original wort extract, total acid, carbon dioxide and diacetyl limits. Only clauses 3.1 and 8.1 were originally mandatory, and the whole standard became recommended GB/T in 2017.

zh.title: 德国葡萄酒法
zh.summary: 德国葡萄酒法在 2021 年完成最近一次大修，新的产地分级从 2026 年采收起适用。它保留四个质量等级与六级 Prädikat，同时把重心从“糖度”转向“产地层级”，并用 13 个 Anbaugebiete 组织全国产区。

en.title: German Wine Law
en.summary: Germany's wine law was last overhauled in 2021, with a new origin hierarchy applying from the 2026 harvest. It keeps four quality tiers and six Prädikat levels while shifting emphasis from ripeness to place, organised around 13 Anbaugebiete.

zh.title: 意大利 DOCG 制度
zh.summary: DOCG 是意大利葡萄酒金字塔的顶端，1963 年随 DOC 体系建立，1980 年授予第一个 DOCG。它要求产区先以 DOC 存在至少 7 年，装瓶容量不超过 6 升，并通过逐批化学与感官检验、加贴国家封条。

en.title: Italian DOCG System
en.summary: DOCG is the top tier of the Italian wine pyramid. Created with the DOC system in 1963 and first awarded in 1980, it requires at least 7 years as a DOC, bottles of no more than 6 litres, batch-by-batch chemical and sensory testing, and a state seal.

zh.title: 日本《酒税法》
zh.summary: 日本《酒税法》（昭和28年法律第6号）是规定酒类定义、分类、制造许可与酒税征收的国会立法；酒税按酒类品目与酒精分从量计征，2026-10-01 起适用国税厅公布的新税率表。它不是标签法，也不等同于清酒评级制度。

en.title: Japan's Liquor Tax Law
en.summary: Japan's Liquor Tax Law (Law No. 6 of 1953) is the national statute that defines liquor, classifies it, requires manufacturing licences and imposes liquor tax; tax is levied by volume on each category and alcohol strength, and a new National Tax Agency rate table applies from 2026-10-01. It is not a labelling law and not the sake grading system.

zh.title: 日本清酒标识
zh.summary: 日本国税厅 1989 年以告示第 8 号制定《清酒制法品质表示基准》，用八个“特定名称”区分纯米、吟酿、本酿造等类型，并规定精米步合、麹米比例与酿造酒精上限。它不是等级表，而是一套标签与工艺的对应规则。

en.title: Japanese Sake Labelling
en.summary: Japan's National Tax Agency set the standards for sake quality labelling in 1989 by Notification No. 8. Eight specific names separate junmai, ginjo and honjozo styles, tied to polishing ratios, koji share and a cap on added brewing alcohol. The names are process claims, not a ladder of quality.

zh.title: 龙舌兰 NOM-006
zh.summary: 墨西哥官方标准 NOM-006-SCFI-2012 规定了“tequila”这个名字的使用条件：只能用蓝色龙舌兰、只能在产地命名保护的市镇内生产、必须经龙舌兰监管委员会认证。它把植物学、地理与标签三件事绑在同一个名字上。

en.title: Tequila NOM-006
en.summary: Mexican Official Standard NOM-006-SCFI-2012 sets the conditions for using the name tequila: one agave species, a protected territory of 181 municipalities, and certification by the Tequila Regulatory Council. Botany, geography and labelling are welded onto a single word.

zh.title: 梅斯卡尔 NOM-070
zh.summary: 墨西哥官方标准 NOM-070-SCFI-2016 把 mezcal 限定为 100% 龙舌兰蒸馏酒，并按蒸煮、粉碎、发酵、蒸馏的设备组合分成 Mezcal、Artesanal、Ancestral 三类。它让“手工”不再是形容词，而是可以逐项核查的工艺清单。

en.title: Mezcal NOM-070
en.summary: Mexican Official Standard NOM-070-SCFI-2016 defines mezcal as a 100% agave distillate and splits it into Mezcal, Artesanal and Ancestral according to the equipment used for cooking, crushing, fermentation and distillation. Craft stops being an adjective and becomes a checklist.

zh.title: 德国啤酒纯净法
zh.summary: 1516 年 4 月 23 日，巴伐利亚公爵在因戈尔施塔特颁布法令，规定啤酒只能使用大麦、啤酒花与水。今天它的原则写在德国《临时啤酒法》第 9 条里，成为世界上少数仍在执行的古老食品原料规则。

en.title: German Beer Purity Law
en.summary: On 23 April 1516 the Dukes of Bavaria issued an edict at Ingolstadt limiting beer to barley, hops and water. Its principle now sits in section 9 of the German Provisional Beer Law, making it one of the few early-modern ingredient rules still enforced.

zh.title: 苏格兰威士忌法规 2009（SI 2009/2890）
zh.summary: 英国 2009 年法定文书，2009-11-23 生效；以“在苏格兰蒸馏、橡木桶陈年至少三年、装瓶不低于 40%vol、蒸馏低于 94.8%vol”定义苏格兰威士忌，划出五个类别与五个受保护产区名称，并规定类别名称、年份与产区标注规则。

en.title: The Scotch Whisky Regulations 2009 (SI 2009/2890)
en.summary: UK statutory instrument in force from 23 November 2009. It defines Scotch Whisky as distilled in Scotland, matured in oak casks for at least three years, distilled below 94.8% vol and bottled at no less than 40% vol, and lays down five categories and five protected area names.

zh.title: 西班牙 DO 制度
zh.summary: 西班牙的 DO 制度由 2003 年《葡萄与葡萄酒法》确立，分 DO、DOCa、VP 与 IGP 等级。一个产区要先作为地理指示葡萄酒存在 5 年才能申请 DO；DOCa 则需 DO 满 10 年，且必须在区内注册酒庄装瓶。

en.title: Spanish DO System
en.summary: Spain's Denominación de Origen system was set by the 2003 vine and wine law, with DO, DOCa, VP and IGP tiers. A region must first exist for 5 years as a geographical-indication wine before applying for DO; DOCa requires 10 years as a DO and bottling inside the zone.

zh.title: 美国蒸馏酒标识 27 CFR 5
zh.summary: 美国联邦法规第 27 编第 5 部分，由烟酒税务与贸易局（TTB）执行。它用“身份标准”规定威士忌、波本、金酒、伏特加等品类必须具备的原料与工艺条件，并规定标签上必须出现哪些信息。理解它，才能看懂一瓶美国烈酒为什么叫这个名字。

en.title: US Distilled Spirits Labeling: 27 CFR 5
en.summary: Title 27, Part 5 of the US Code of Federal Regulations, enforced by the Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau. It uses standards of identity to define what whisky, bourbon, gin and vodka must be made from, and then dictates what the label has to say. Read it and a bottle's name stops being a marketing choice.

zh.title: 美国 AVA 制度
zh.summary: AVA 是美国葡萄酒的地理标签制度，1978 年建立，1980 年出现第一个 AVA。它只划定地理边界，不规定品种、产量或工艺；酒标上标注 AVA 名称，至少 85% 的葡萄必须来自该区域。

en.title: US AVA System
en.summary: American Viticultural Areas are the US geographical label system for wine, created in 1978 with the first AVA approved in 1980. An AVA only draws a boundary; it does not regulate varieties, yields or winemaking. To name an AVA, at least 85% of the grapes must come from it.

zh.title: 盲品
zh.summary: 在不看标签的情况下，通过香气、口感、结构与余味推断酒的类型、产区、年份与品质；关键是系统方法，而不是“猜对”。

en.title: Blind Tasting
en.summary: Judging a drink without seeing its label, using aroma, palate, structure and finish to infer type, origin, age and quality. Method matters more than guessing right.

zh.title: 醒酒
zh.summary: 把酒液与沉淀分离、并让酒与空气接触的侍酒技法；是否需要醒酒取决于酒种、酒龄与状态，不是所有酒都适合长时间醒酒。

en.title: Decanting
en.summary: A serving technique that separates wine from sediment and exposes it to air; whether to decant depends on the drink type, age and condition, and not every wine benefits from long decanting.

zh.title: 双重过滤
zh.summary: 先用主滤器挡住冰块与大块固体，再经细滤网滤除果肉、碎叶与冰屑的技法；换来更干净的口感与外观，但速度更慢。

en.title: Double straining
en.summary: A technique that passes a drink through a primary strainer to block ice and large solids, then through a fine mesh to remove pulp, herb fragments and ice shards; it gives a cleaner texture and appearance at the cost of speed.

zh.title: 干摇
zh.summary: 不加冰先摇、再加冰湿摇的两段式技法；常用于含蛋清、奶油或植物蛋白的配方，目的是先形成稳定泡沫再冷却稀释。

en.title: Dry shaking
en.summary: A two-stage technique of shaking without ice first and then with ice; it is used for recipes with egg white, cream or plant protein to build a stable foam before chilling and diluting.

zh.title: 烧皮
zh.summary: 把柑橘皮油挤过火焰、让油雾短暂燃烧并落入杯中的技法；带来烘烤香气与戏剧性，但属于明火操作，安全优先。

en.title: Flaming zest
en.summary: A technique in which citrus peel oil is squeezed through a flame and falls into the glass; it adds toasted aroma and drama, but it is an open-flame operation where safety comes first.

zh.title: 分层
zh.summary: 利用液体密度差异，让不同原料在杯中形成可见层次的调酒技法；依靠缓慢倾倒与配方顺序，而不是靠搅拌。

en.title: Layering
en.summary: A technique that uses differences in liquid density to build visible layers in a glass; it depends on slow pouring and the order given by the recipe rather than on stirring.

zh.title: 捣压
zh.summary: 用捣棒在杯中轻压香草、水果或糖块，使香气与汁液释放的调酒技法；关键在“压开而不撕碎”，过度用力会带来苦涩与浑浊。

en.title: Muddling
en.summary: A bartending technique in which herbs, fruit or sugar are gently pressed in the glass with a muddler to release aroma and juice; the key is to press without shredding, since force brings bitterness and cloudiness.

zh.title: 闻香
zh.summary: 借助杯口聚集的香气判断酒的状态、层次与强度的品鉴技法；应先静后动、由远及近，并记录具体气味，而不是只留下“好闻”或“不好闻”的印象。

en.title: Nosing
en.summary: A tasting technique for judging condition, layers and intensity through aroma gathered at the rim of the glass; nose still first, then swirl, approach from a distance and record specific smells rather than "good" or "bad".

zh.title: 观察颜色
zh.summary: 在统一背景与光线下观察酒液的澄清度、色调与浓度，为酒龄、品种与工艺提供线索的品鉴技法；颜色只能作为线索，不能单独用来判断质量。

en.title: Observing colour
en.summary: A tasting technique for judging clarity, hue and depth under consistent light and background; colour is a clue to age, variety and method, never a verdict on quality on its own.

zh.title: 开瓶（软木塞）
zh.summary: 用开瓶器完整取出软木塞、避免碎屑落入酒液并检查瓶塞状态的侍酒技法；关键是螺旋居中、提拉稳定、老酒用专门工具。

en.title: Opening a cork-sealed bottle
en.summary: A serving technique for removing a cork intact, keeping crumbs out of the liquid and checking the stopper; the keys are a centred auger, a steady pull and the right tool for older bottles.

zh.title: 开瓶（起泡酒）
zh.summary: 安全打开带压起泡酒的侍酒技法；核心是充分降温、保持瓶身稳定、用手控制瓶塞，让气体轻声释放而不是把塞子冲飞。

en.title: Opening sparkling wine
en.summary: A serving technique for safely opening a pressurised sparkling wine; the essentials are thorough chilling, a steady bottle and hand control over the cork so gas escapes with a whisper rather than firing the cork across the room.

zh.title: 倒酒
zh.summary: 把酒液从瓶中定量倒入杯中的侍酒技法；目标是控制酒量、减少沉淀搅动、保留气泡并保持卫生，而不是把杯子倒满。

en.title: Pouring
en.summary: A serving technique for measuring wine from bottle to glass; the aims are controlling volume, limiting disturbance of sediment, preserving bubbles and keeping the rim clean, not filling the glass to the top.

zh.title: 滚酒
zh.summary: 把酒液在两个容器之间反复来回倾倒的混合技法；比摇和温和、比搅拌充气更多，适合配方明确要求滚酒的酒款。

en.title: Rolling
en.summary: A mixing technique that pours a drink back and forth between two vessels; it is gentler than shaking and aerates more than stirring, and suits recipes that specifically call for rolling.

zh.title: 军刀开香槟
zh.summary: 用军刀沿香槟瓶颈的接缝快速滑开瓶口，利用瓶内压力让瓶口与瓶塞一起飞出；需要冰镇、稳瓶与安全距离。

en.title: Sabrage
en.summary: Opening a Champagne bottle by sliding a sabre along the bottle's seam so the neck ring and cork fly off under pressure. It needs a cold bottle, a steady hold and a safe direction.

zh.title: 摇酒
zh.summary: 把原料与冰块放入摇酒壶中快速摇晃，使酒液冷却、稀释并均匀混合的调酒技法；与搅拌相比，摇和带来更多充气与稀释。

en.title: Shaking
en.summary: A bartending technique in which ingredients and ice are shaken hard in a shaker to chill, dilute and mix the drink; compared with stirring, shaking adds more aeration and dilution.

zh.title: 入口
zh.summary: 用少量酒液覆盖口腔、在数秒内评估甜度、酸度、酒体、单宁、酒精与余味的品鉴技法；入口量小、停留短、条件固定，才便于比较。

en.title: Sipping
en.summary: A tasting technique in which a small amount of liquid covers the mouth for a few seconds to assess sweetness, acidity, body, tannin, alcohol and finish; small sips, short contact and fixed conditions make comparison possible.

zh.title: 吐酒
zh.summary: 专业品鉴中把酒液在口中充分接触后吐出的技法；目的是保持清醒、控制酒精摄入并连续品评多款酒，而不是表示厌恶或浪费。

en.title: Spitting
en.summary: A professional tasting technique in which liquid is held in the mouth and then spat out; the aim is to stay clear-headed, limit alcohol intake and taste many drinks in sequence, not to express dislike or waste the product.

zh.title: 搅拌
zh.summary: 把原料与冰块放入调酒杯，用吧勺沿杯壁稳定搅拌，使酒液冷却、适度稀释并均匀混合的调酒技法；与摇和相比，搅拌充气少、成品更清澈。

en.title: Stirring
en.summary: A bartending technique in which ingredients and ice go into a mixing glass and are stirred steadily with a bar spoon, chilling, lightly diluting and mixing the drink; compared with shaking, stirring adds less air and keeps the drink clearer.

zh.title: 温度控制
zh.summary: 通过冷藏、冰桶、室温回温与储存管理，让酒液在合适温度饮用；温度影响香气、气泡、口感与发酵，稳定比绝对数值更重要。

en.title: Temperature Control
en.summary: Using refrigeration, ice buckets, room warming and storage management to bring a drink to its serving temperature. Temperature shapes aroma, bubbles, texture and fermentation, and stability matters more than a single number.

zh.title: 酸度（acidity）
zh.summary: 酸度描述酒中酸类物质的总量与强度，常用总酸（g/L）与 pH 两个不同指标；它支撑清爽感、平衡与陈年潜力，也影响二氧化硫的有效性。

en.title: Acidity
en.summary: Acidity describes the amount and strength of acids in a drink, commonly through total acidity in g/L and pH, two different measures; it supports freshness, balance and ageing potential, and affects sulfur dioxide effectiveness.

zh.title: 酒精度（ABV）
zh.summary: 酒精度指 20°C 时酒中乙醇的体积分数，通常写作 % vol；它是标签与配方的基础参数，但不是品质评分。

en.title: Alcohol by volume (ABV)
en.summary: ABV is the volume fraction of ethanol in a drink measured at 20 °C, usually written as % vol; it is a basic labelling and formulation parameter, not a quality score.

zh.title: 天使分享（angel's share）
zh.summary: 天使分享指烈酒在橡木桶陈年期间通过桶壁蒸发损失的酒液；苏格兰行业常引每年约 2%，但实际速率受温度、湿度、桶容与仓库类型影响，并非精确常数或品质指标。

en.title: Angel's share
en.summary: The angel's share is the portion of a spirit lost through the cask wall during maturation; the Scotch whisky trade often cites about 2% a year, but the real rate depends on temperature, humidity, cask size and warehouse type, and is neither a precise constant nor a quality grade.

zh.title: 原产地命名（appellation）
zh.summary: 原产地命名是把地理范围与生产规范绑定起来的法定标识，如法国 AOC/AOP、意大利 DOC/DOCG、西班牙 DO 与欧盟 PDO/PGI；它说明产地与规则，不等于质量排名。

en.title: Appellation
en.summary: An appellation is a legal designation that binds a geographical area to production rules, such as French AOC/AOP, Italian DOC/DOCG, Spanish DO and EU PDO/PGI; it states origin and rules, not a quality ranking.

zh.title: 香气（aroma）
zh.summary: 香气是鼻子感知到的挥发性气味，可按来源分为品种、发酵与陈年三层；它与入口后的风味不同，aroma 与 bouquet 也不是同义词。

en.title: Aroma
en.summary: Aroma is the volatile smell perceived by the nose, layered by origin into varietal, fermentation and maturation notes; it is not the same as flavour, and aroma is not a synonym for bouquet.

zh.title: 过桶（barrel finishing）
zh.summary: 过桶指主要陈年结束后把酒液转入另一种桶继续存放一段时间，以增加或调整风味；它是二次陈年，不等于全程使用该桶，也不等于桶强。

en.title: Barrel finishing
en.summary: Barrel finishing moves a drink from its main maturation container into a different cask for a further period to add or adjust flavour; it is secondary maturation, not full-term use of that cask, and not cask strength.

zh.title: 混酿（blend）
zh.summary: 混酿指把不同品种、年份、地块或基酒组合成最终产品，用于平衡结构、稳定风格或满足法规；它是常规工艺，不等于低质量，也不等于“掺假”。

en.title: Blend
en.summary: A blend combines different varieties, vintages, sites or base wines into a final product to balance structure, stabilise style or meet regulations; it is a normal craft, not a synonym for low quality or adulteration.

zh.title: 酒体（body）
zh.summary: 酒体是入口时对酒液“重量”与“饱满度”的感官描述，常分为轻、中、重；酒精、甘油、残糖、单宁、酸度与温度都会影响它，不能只用酒精度判断。

en.title: Body
en.summary: Body is the sensory impression of a drink's weight and fullness in the mouth, often described as light, medium or full; alcohol, glycerol, residual sugar, tannin, acidity and temperature all shape it.

zh.title: 白利度（Brix）
zh.summary: 白利度（°Brix）表示 20°C 时溶液中蔗糖的质量分数，1 °Brix 即每 100 克溶液含 1 克蔗糖；它用于葡萄成熟度与发酵监控，不等于酒精度或甜度。

en.title: Brix
en.summary: Degrees Brix (°Brix) express the mass fraction of sucrose in a solution at 20 °C, where 1 °Brix is 1 g of sucrose per 100 g of solution; they measure sugar and soluble solids, not alcohol or sweetness.

zh.title: 桶强（cask strength）
zh.summary: 桶强指装瓶时几乎不加水、保留桶中自然酒精度，常见约 50%–65% vol；它是装瓶方式，不等于单一桶，也不等于更高品质。

en.title: Cask strength
en.summary: Cask strength means whisky bottled with little or no added water, retaining its natural strength from the cask, commonly around 50–65% vol; it is a bottling choice, not single cask or a quality grade.

zh.title: 冷凝过滤（chill filtration）
zh.summary: 冷凝过滤是把威士忌或其他烈酒降温到接近冰点，使长链脂肪酸酯、蛋白质等析出，再通过滤材除去，目的是防止装瓶后在低温或加水时出现浑浊。它是可选工艺，不是法定等级，也不等于‘过滤掉所有风味’。

en.title: Chill filtration
en.summary: Chill filtration cools whisky or another spirit close to freezing so that long-chain fatty-acid esters, proteins and similar compounds precipitate and can be filtered out, mainly to prevent haze at low temperature or after dilution. It is an optional process, not a legal grade, and not the same as stripping all flavour.

zh.title: 围墙园（clos）
zh.summary: clos 指以围墙、篱笆或自然边界围合的葡萄园地块，常见于勃艮第、卢瓦尔与阿尔萨斯；它标识地块边界，不是法定分级，也不等于单一所有者。

en.title: Clos
en.summary: A clos is a vineyard plot enclosed by a wall, fence or natural boundary, common in Burgundy, the Loire and Alsace; it identifies a bounded site, is not a legal classification, and does not imply single ownership.

zh.title: 塔式蒸馏器（column still）
zh.summary: 塔式蒸馏器是连续蒸馏设备，通过多层塔板实现反复气液交换，可产出高纯度酒精；塔板数、回流比与进料位置决定馏出物的纯度与风味保留。

en.title: Column still
en.summary: A column still is a continuous distillation device that uses multiple plates or packing to create repeated vapour-liquid exchange and produce high-purity alcohol; plate count, reflux ratio and feed position decide purity and flavour retention.

zh.title: 软木塞污染（cork taint）
zh.summary: 软木塞污染主要由 TCA 等卤代苯甲醚造成，表现为潮湿纸板、霉味并压制果香；它在每升数纳克即可被察觉，但不影响饮用安全，也不等于木塞碎屑。

en.title: Cork taint
en.summary: Cork taint is caused mainly by TCA and related haloanisoles, showing as damp cardboard and mustiness that mask fruit; it is perceptible at a few nanograms per litre but is not a safety issue and is not the same as cork crumbs.

zh.title: 精酿啤酒
zh.summary: 20 世纪后期在美国兴起的小型、独立、重传统与创新的啤酒生产与消费现象；它是行业与市场概念，不是法定等级，也不等于高质量。

en.title: Craft beer
en.summary: A small-scale, independent and tradition-minded beer production and consumption movement that emerged in the United States in the late 20th century; an industry and market concept, not a legal grade or a guarantee of quality.

zh.title: 调配（cuvée）
zh.summary: cuvée 在起泡酒里可指压榨时最先流出的轻柔汁液，也可指由多个基酒调配成的一批酒；在多数产区它不是法定等级，标签上常只是产品名。

en.title: Cuvée
en.summary: Cuvée can mean the earliest, gentlest juice from sparkling-wine pressing, or a batch blended from several base wines; in most regions it is not a legal grade and often serves as a product name.

zh.title: 醒酒与换瓶（decanting）
zh.summary: 醒酒（换瓶、滗酒）把酒液从原瓶转移到另一容器，目的有二：分离沉淀与增加氧气接触；老红葡萄酒与年轻单宁酒的目标不同，并非所有酒都适合醒酒，时间长短需按酒龄与状态判断。

en.title: Decanting
en.summary: Decanting moves wine from its bottle into another vessel for two purposes — separating sediment and exposing the wine to air; old reds and young tannic wines have different goals, not every wine benefits, and timing depends on age and condition.

zh.title: 除渣（disgorgement）
zh.summary: 除渣是传统法起泡酒在转瓶后排出瓶口酵母沉淀的工序，分手工与冷冻瓶颈两种方式；除渣后通常补液（dosage），再封口完成成品。

en.title: Disgorgement
en.summary: Disgorgement removes the yeast sediment from the neck of a traditional-method sparkling wine after riddling, by hand or with a frozen neck; dosage usually follows before the final closure.

zh.title: 补液（dosage）
zh.summary: 补液是传统法起泡酒除渣后补入瓶中的调味液，通常由基酒与糖组成；它既补回除渣损失的体积，也决定成品甜度等级，欧盟规则以糖分区间区分 brut nature 到 doux。

en.title: Dosage
en.summary: Dosage is the topping liquid added after disgorging traditional-method sparkling wine, usually a blend of base wine and sugar; it replaces the volume lost at disgorging and sets the finished sweetness class, from brut nature to doux under EU rules.

zh.title: 干型（dry）
zh.summary: 干型是葡萄酒标签上的残糖分级，欧盟通常为不超过 4 g/L，总酸达标时可放宽到 9 g/L；它不描述果味强弱，也不等于质量等级。

en.title: Dry
en.summary: Dry is a residual-sugar category on wine labels, usually no more than 4 g/L under EU rules and up to 9 g/L when acidity is high; it says nothing about fruit intensity or quality.

zh.title: 窖池
zh.summary: 固态法白酒的发酵容器，多以黄泥、条石、砖、水泥或木材建成，形状多呈长方体；窖池类型与窖泥状态直接影响酒醅的发酵环境。

en.title: Fermentation pit
en.summary: A solid-state fermentation vessel for baijiu, usually built from yellow mud, stone, brick, concrete or wood and often rectangular. Pit type and pit-mud condition shape the microbial environment.

zh.title: 过滤（filtration）
zh.summary: 过滤是让酒液通过滤材、物理截留悬浮颗粒与微生物的工序，按结构分为深层过滤与膜过滤；它影响澄清度、稳定性与风味保留，且不等于下胶。

en.title: Filtration
en.summary: Filtration passes wine through a medium that physically retains particles and microorganisms; depth and surface filtration differ in structure, and filtration affects clarity, stability and flavour but is not the same as fining.

zh.title: 下胶（fining）
zh.summary: 下胶是向酒中加入膨润土、蛋清、明胶或合成聚合物等助剂，使其吸附悬浮或溶解的目标物质并沉降，以去除蛋白质、单宁、色素或异味；它是澄清与稳定手段，不等于过滤，也涉及素食与过敏原问题。

en.title: Fining
en.summary: Fining adds bentonite, egg white, gelatin or synthetic polymers to wine so that they adsorb suspended or dissolved targets and settle out, removing protein, tannin, colour or off-flavours; it is a clarification and stabilisation step, not filtration, and raises vegan and allergen questions.

zh.title: 余味（finish）
zh.summary: 余味是酒液咽下或吐出后，口腔与鼻腔中仍然延续的味觉、香气与触感；长度、层次与干净度共同决定它的质量，长余味不等于质量保证。

en.title: Finish
en.summary: Finish is the taste, aroma and mouthfeel that persist after a drink is swallowed or spat out; length, layers and cleanliness determine its quality, and a long finish is not a quality guarantee.

zh.title: 酒花（flor）
zh.summary: 酒花（flor）是雪莉酒生物陈年时在酒液表面形成的酵母膜，它隔绝氧气并代谢酒精与甘油，改变香气；Fino 与 Manzanilla 依赖酒花，Oloroso 则走氧化陈酿路线。

en.title: Flor
en.summary: Flor is the yeast film that forms on the surface of Sherry during biological ageing, shielding the wine from oxygen and metabolising alcohol and glycerol; Fino and Manzanilla depend on flor, while Oloroso follows an oxidative route.

zh.title: 酒头、酒心、酒尾（heads, hearts, tails）
zh.summary: 一次蒸馏的馏出液按挥发性分为酒头、酒心与酒尾；酒心是乙醇与香气最平衡的中段，是成品主体，酒头与酒尾因杂质多通常回收再蒸，切酒点决定风格。

en.title: Heads, hearts and tails
en.summary: A distillation run is split by volatility into heads, hearts and tails; hearts are the balanced middle cut and the body of the spirit, while heads and tails carry more impurities and are usually recycled, with cut points shaping style.

zh.title: 红曲
zh.summary: 以大米为原料、接种红曲霉后培养制成的紫红色曲；既是黄酒的糖化发酵剂，也是红曲酒、红糟与食品着色的原料，其桔霉素风险需要过程控制。

en.title: Hongqu
en.summary: A purple-red qu made by culturing Monascus on rice; it is a saccharifying starter for huangjiu, a colouring material and a base for red-qu wine and foods, with citrinin risk requiring process control.

zh.title: IBU（国际苦味单位）
zh.summary: IBU 是啤酒苦度的计量单位，1 IBU 约等于每升 1 毫克异α-酸；它测的是酒花苦味物质，不等于入口感受到的苦味强度，也不等于酒花香气。

en.title: IBU (International Bitterness Units)
en.summary: IBU is the unit for beer bitterness, with 1 IBU roughly equal to 1 milligram of iso-alpha acids per litre; it measures hop-derived bitterness, not the bitterness felt on the palate, and not hop aroma.

zh.title: 晚收（late harvest）
zh.summary: 晚收指葡萄在常规成熟期后继续留在藤上、延后采收，通过失水浓缩糖与风味；它可做甜酒，也可能只是高酒精度的干型酒，且不等于贵腐。

en.title: Late harvest
en.summary: Late harvest is the practice of leaving grapes on the vine beyond normal ripeness so that water loss concentrates sugar and flavour; it can make sweet wine, but it is not the same as noble rot and not always sweet.

zh.title: 酒泥（lees）
zh.summary: 酒泥是发酵结束后沉降在容器底部的酵母细胞、果肉残渣与酒石酸盐等固体；保留细酒泥并搅动会改变口感、香气与稳定性。

en.title: Lees
en.summary: Lees are the solids, mostly spent yeast plus pulp residue and tartrates, that settle after fermentation; keeping fine lees and stirring them changes texture, aroma and stability.

zh.title: 浸渍（maceration）
zh.summary: 浸渍是果汁与果皮、果肉、种子或果梗保持接触的过程，用于提取颜色、单宁与香气；时间、温度与酒精浓度决定提取的强度与方向。

en.title: Maceration
en.summary: Maceration is the contact of juice with skins, pulp, seeds or stems to extract colour, tannin and aroma; time, temperature and alcohol level decide how much, and in which direction, extraction happens.

zh.title: 苹果酸-乳酸发酵（malolactic fermentation）
zh.summary: 乳酸菌把苹果酸转化为乳酸与二氧化碳的二次发酵，会降低酸度、柔化口感；它不同于酒精发酵，也并非所有酒款都需要。

en.title: Malolactic fermentation
en.summary: A secondary fermentation in which lactic acid bacteria convert malic acid into lactic acid and carbon dioxide, softening acidity; it differs from alcoholic fermentation and is not needed in every wine.

zh.title: 糖化醪（mash）
zh.summary: 糖化醪是麦粉与热水在糖化槽中形成的混合物，淀粉在此被酶分解为可发酵糖；它是麦芽汁的前体，不是麦芽汁本身，料水比、温度与 pH 共同决定糖谱与出糖率。

en.title: Mash
en.summary: A mash is the mixture of milled malt and hot water in a mash tun, where enzymes convert starch into fermentable sugar. It is the precursor of wort, not wort itself, and its water-to-grist ratio, temperature and pH shape the sugar profile and the extract yield.

zh.title: 气泡质地（mousse）
zh.summary: 气泡质地（mousse）指起泡酒入杯后泡沫的生成、颗粒粗细与持续时间；瓶内二氧化碳压力通常约 5–6 bar，温度、杯型、酒液成分与带泥陈年共同决定气泡表现，气泡粗细并非质量高低的直接指标。

en.title: Mousse
en.summary: Mousse is the formation, bubble size and persistence of the foam in a glass of sparkling wine; bottle pressure is typically about 5–6 bar, and temperature, glassware, wine composition and lees ageing together shape the bubbles, which are not a direct quality score.

zh.title: 葡萄醪（must）
zh.summary: 葡萄醪指葡萄破碎压榨后得到的汁液及悬浮固体，是葡萄酒发酵的起点；其糖度、酸度、含固量与澄清度决定发酵进程和酒款风格。

en.title: Must
en.summary: Must is the juice, pulp, skins and solids obtained from crushed or pressed grapes and the starting point of wine fermentation; its sugar, acid, solid content and clarity shape fermentation and style.

zh.title: 贵腐（noble rot）
zh.summary: 贵腐是灰葡萄孢菌在夜间潮湿、白天干燥的交替条件下侵染成熟葡萄，使果实失水、糖酸与风味浓缩的现象；它用于苏玳、托卡伊等甜酒，与持续潮湿造成的灰腐病不同。

en.title: Noble rot
en.summary: Noble rot is infection of ripe grapes by Botrytis cinerea under humid nights and dry, sunny days, which shrinks the fruit and concentrates sugar, acid and flavour; it makes Sauternes and Tokaji-style sweet wines but differs from grey rot in persistently wet conditions.

zh.title: 原麦汁浓度（original gravity）
zh.summary: 原麦汁浓度指发酵前麦汁中可溶性固形物的浓度，常用 °P（柏拉图度）表示；它反映原料浸出物，不等于酒精度，需与终点密度一起估算酒精。

en.title: Original gravity
en.summary: Original gravity is the concentration of soluble solids, mainly sugars and other extract, in wort before fermentation, usually expressed in °P (degrees Plato); it reflects raw-material extract and is not alcohol content.

zh.title: 氧化（oxidation）
zh.summary: 氧化是酒液中的成分与氧气发生反应，改变香气、颜色与单宁结构；少量受控氧化可以塑造雪利、马德拉、汝拉黄酒等风格，过量则导致果香流失、褐变与乙醛累积。

en.title: Oxidation
en.summary: Oxidation is the reaction of compounds in wine with oxygen, altering aroma, colour and tannin structure; a small controlled amount builds styles such as Oloroso, Madeira and vin jaune, while excess brings loss of fruit, browning and acetaldehyde.

zh.title: 泥煤（peat）
zh.summary: 泥煤是缺氧沼泽中部分分解的植物残体，燃烧产生的酚类会附着在烘烤麦芽上；泥煤味是威士忌的可选风格，不是所有苏格兰威士忌的必备特征。

en.title: Peat
en.summary: Peat is partially decomposed plant matter formed in oxygen-poor bogs, and its smoke deposits phenols on kilned malt; peatiness is an optional whisky style, not a required feature of all Scotch whisky.

zh.title: 泥煤酚值（PPM）
zh.summary: 泥煤酚值（phenol ppm）通常指麦芽中总酚的含量，1 ppm 等于 1 mg/kg；它描述麦芽被泥煤烟熏后携带的酚类数量，不是瓶中酒液的浓度，也不是一个法定的‘泥煤味等级’。

en.title: Peat phenol value (PPM)
en.summary: Peat phenol value (phenol ppm) usually means the total phenol content of malted barley, where 1 ppm equals 1 mg/kg; it describes the phenols carried by peat-smoked malt, not the concentration in the bottled spirit, and it is not a legal peatiness grade.

zh.title: 精米步合（polishing ratio）
zh.summary: 精米步合指清酒米经研磨后剩余的比例，50% 表示磨去一半、剩下 50%；它与大吟酿、吟酿、本酿造等特定名称等级相关，但不直接等同于质量高低。

en.title: Polishing ratio
en.summary: The polishing ratio is the percentage of sake rice remaining after milling, so 50% means half has been removed and half remains; it is tied to daiginjo, ginjo and honjozo grades but is not a direct quality score.

zh.title: 葡萄渣（pomace）
zh.summary: 葡萄渣是压榨后剩下的果皮、果肉、种子与果梗等固体，区别于酒泥；它可蒸馏成 grappa、marc 等渣酿烈酒，也可提取酒石酸，但必须尽快处理以防醋化腐败。

en.title: Pomace
en.summary: Pomace is the solid residue of skins, pulp, seeds and stems left after pressing grapes, distinct from lees; it can be distilled into grappa or marc and used to recover tartaric acid, but must be handled quickly to avoid acetification.

zh.title: 壶式蒸馏器（pot still）
zh.summary: 壶式蒸馏器是分批蒸馏的铜制设备，由加热壶、塔颈与冷凝器构成；壶形、加热方式与切酒点决定酒液的风格走向，并与连续蒸馏形成效率与风味的取舍。

en.title: Pot still
en.summary: A pot still is a batch-distillation copper vessel made of a heated pot, a neck and a condenser; pot shape, heating method and cut points decide the style of the spirit, trading efficiency for flavour retention against continuous distillation.

zh.title: 标准酒度与 Proof
zh.summary: 标准酒度通常指 20°C 时乙醇的体积分数（% vol）；美制 proof 则是在 60°F 下把体积百分数乘以 2，因此 100 proof 等于 50% ABV。两者使用不同温度基准与历史口径，不能直接混用。

en.title: Standard strength and proof
en.summary: Standard strength usually means the volume fraction of ethanol at 20°C (% vol); US proof doubles that volume percentage at 60°F, so 100 proof equals 50% ABV. The two use different temperature bases and historical conventions and cannot be mixed without a conversion.

zh.title: 还原（reduction）
zh.summary: 还原既指尽量隔绝氧气的还原型酿造，也指缺氧条件下生成的硫化氢、硫醇等还原性气味；前者是工艺选择，后者是否构成缺陷取决于浓度与化合物种类。

en.title: Reduction
en.summary: Reduction covers both reductive winemaking that keeps oxygen out and the hydrogen sulfide, thiols and disulfides formed in oxygen-poor conditions; the first is a style choice, the second a fault only at certain levels.

zh.title: 残糖（residual sugar）
zh.summary: 残糖是发酵结束后酒液中未被酵母转化的糖分，通常以 g/L 计；它决定甜度标签，但甜感还受酸度、酒精、温度与气泡影响。

en.title: Residual sugar
en.summary: Residual sugar is the sugar left after fermentation, usually measured in g/L; it sets sweetness labels, while perceived sweetness also depends on acidity, alcohol, temperature and bubbles.

zh.title: 转瓶（riddling）
zh.summary: 转瓶（riddling，法语 remuage）是传统法起泡酒把二次发酵后的酵母沉淀逐步聚集到瓶口的工序；手工转瓶约需 26–30 天，机械转瓶可缩短到数天，二者在一致性、成本与逐瓶判断上各有取舍。

en.title: Riddling
en.summary: Riddling (French remuage) gathers the yeast sediment of traditional-method sparkling wine at the bottle neck; hand riddling takes about 26–30 days, while a gyropalette can finish in a few days, with different trade-offs in consistency, cost and bottle-by-bottle judgement.

zh.title: 半干（semi-dry）
zh.summary: 半干指残糖高于干型、又未达到半甜或甜型的中间档；具体克数因品类与法规而异，不能只凭口感判断。

en.title: Semi-dry
en.summary: Semi-dry sits between dry and semi-sweet or sweet; the exact residual sugar varies by category and regulation, and sweetness cannot be judged by taste alone.

zh.title: 单一麦芽威士忌（single malt）
zh.summary: 单一麦芽指同一酒厂、以 100% 发芽大麦为原料、用壶式蒸馏器生产的威士忌；它与单一谷物、调和麦芽在原料与来源范围上不同，苏格兰对其有法定定义，其他市场多为行业用法。

en.title: Single malt
en.summary: Single malt means whisky from one distillery, made from 100% malted barley and distilled in pot stills; it differs from single grain and blended malt in raw material and scope, and while Scotland defines it in law, other markets mostly use the term as trade language.

zh.title: 单一品种（single varietal）
zh.summary: 单一品种指以一种葡萄为主体的葡萄酒；标签能否写品种名取决于各国法规，欧盟与澳大利亚多为 85%，美国为 75%，它不是“100% 该品种”的同义词。

en.title: Single varietal
en.summary: Single varietal describes a wine made mainly from one grape variety; whether the variety may appear on the label depends on national rules, with the EU and Australia usually requiring 85% and the United States 75%, so it is not a synonym for 100% of that variety.

zh.title: 索莱拉系统（solera）
zh.summary: 索莱拉是分级叠放、逐级取补的陈年体系，底层存放最老的酒，上层逐级补入较年轻的酒；成品没有单一年份，风格长期稳定，不等于“勾兑劣酒”。

en.title: Solera
en.summary: A solera is a stacked system of fractional blending and ageing in which the oldest wine sits at the bottom and younger wine replenishes each level above; the finished wine has no single vintage and keeps a stable style, and it is not "padding with cheap wine".

zh.title: 甜型（sweet）
zh.summary: 甜型是葡萄酒标签中残糖最高的分级，欧盟规则下非起泡酒为 45 g/L 及以上；甜味可来自晚收、贵腐、冰酒、加强或调味液，平衡取决于酸度与酒精。

en.title: Sweet
en.summary: Sweet is the highest residual-sugar category on wine labels, at 45 g/L or more for still wine under EU rules; sweetness can come from late harvest, noble rot, ice wine, fortification or dosage, and balance depends on acidity and alcohol.

zh.title: 单宁（tannin）
zh.summary: 单宁是一类多酚化合物，能与蛋白质结合并带来涩感；在葡萄酒中主要来自果皮、种子、果梗与橡木桶。

en.title: Tannin
en.summary: Tannins are a group of polyphenolic compounds that bind proteins and create astringency; in wine they come mainly from skins, seeds, stems and oak.

zh.title: 风土（terroir）
zh.summary: 风土指一个特定地方的自然条件与人的长期实践共同作用，使农产品及其制品呈现地域特征；它不是单一土壤指标。

en.title: Terroir
en.summary: Terroir is the combined effect of a place's natural conditions and long-standing human practice on the character of its produce; it is not a single soil measurement.

zh.title: 年份（vintage）
zh.summary: 年份指葡萄采收的那一年，反映当年的天气与成熟条件；它不是酒龄或装瓶日期，无年份（NV）也不是低质的代名词。

en.title: Vintage
en.summary: Vintage is the year the grapes were harvested and reflects that year's weather and ripening conditions; it is not age or bottling date, and non-vintage (NV) is not a sign of low quality.

zh.title: 整串发酵（whole bunch）
zh.summary: 整串发酵把未破碎的整串葡萄连同果梗送入发酵容器；果梗带来结构、香料与新鲜感，也会抬高 pH、带入草本味，比例取决于品种、成熟度与年份。

en.title: Whole bunch
en.summary: Whole-bunch fermentation puts intact grape clusters, stems included, into the fermenter; stems bring structure, spice and freshness but also raise pH and can add herbal notes, so the proportion depends on variety, ripeness and vintage.

zh.title: 麦芽汁（wort）
zh.summary: 麦芽汁是糖化后从麦糟中分离出的含糖液体，是啤酒发酵的起点；它还不是啤酒，成分由谷物、糖化温度、过滤方式与是否加花煮沸共同决定。

en.title: Wort
en.summary: Wort is the sugar-rich liquid separated from spent grain after mashing. It is the starting point of beer fermentation, not beer itself, and its composition depends on the grain, the mash schedule, the lautering and whether it is boiled with hops.

zh.title: 吧勺
zh.summary: 用于搅拌鸡尾酒、引导倾倒与量取少量液体的长柄吧台工具；长度、勺头容量与螺旋杆设计影响搅拌效率与操作手感。

en.title: Bar spoon
en.summary: A long-handled bar tool for stirring cocktails, guiding pours and measuring small volumes; length, bowl capacity and spiral shaft affect stirring efficiency and handling.

zh.title: 啤酒开瓶器
zh.summary: 用于开启皇冠盖啤酒瓶的简易工具，常见酒吧刀、墙挂式与钥匙形；卡住瓶盖下缘，向上撬开，动作要稳。

en.title: Bottle Opener
en.summary: A simple tool for crown-cap beer bottles, common as a bar blade, wall-mounted opener or key shape. It grips the cap's lower edge and lifts steadily.

zh.title: 刻槽刀
zh.summary: 刀头带一个小 V 形或 U 形缺口的吧台刀，用来在柑橘皮上拉出细长均匀的皮条；缺口宽度、锋利度与下刀深度决定香气释放和装饰能否立住。

en.title: Channel knife
en.summary: A bar knife with a small V- or U-shaped notch that pulls long, even strips of citrus peel; notch width, sharpness and cutting depth determine aroma release and whether the garnish holds its shape.

zh.title: 压榨器
zh.summary: 通过杠杆或螺旋结构压榨半个柑橘的手动工具；杯口尺寸、稳定性与耐酸材料决定出汁效率、清洁难度与使用寿命。

en.title: Citrus press
en.summary: A manual tool that uses a lever or screw mechanism to press half a citrus fruit; cup size, stability and acid-resistant materials determine juice yield, cleaning and service life.

zh.title: 鸡尾酒签
zh.summary: 用来固定橄榄、樱桃、柑橘皮或洋葱等装饰的细签，常见长度 10–15 厘米；材质、长度、尖端处理与耐腐蚀性决定它能否稳住装饰又不干扰饮用。

en.title: Cocktail pick
en.summary: A thin pin used to hold olives, cherries, citrus peel or onions; common lengths run 10–15 cm, and material, length, point treatment and corrosion resistance decide whether it holds the garnish without getting in the way.

zh.title: 摇酒壶
zh.summary: 用于摇和鸡尾酒的吧台工具，常见三段式与两段式两种结构；壶身、密封与滤冰方式影响冷却、稀释与操作效率。

en.title: Cocktail shaker
en.summary: A bar tool for shaking cocktails, commonly in three-piece and two-piece forms; body, seal and straining method affect chilling, dilution and working efficiency.

zh.title: 开瓶器
zh.summary: 用螺旋与杠杆拔出软木塞的工具，常见侍酒刀、蝶形与杠杆式；螺旋要居中，拔出要慢，断塞要处理。

en.title: Corkscrew
en.summary: A tool that uses a helix and a lever to pull a cork. The screw must be centred, the pull vertical and slow, and a broken cork needs care.

zh.title: 细滤网
zh.summary: 双重过滤中的第二道滤器，用于拦下果肉纤维、碎叶与冰屑；网面精度、框架稳定性与清洁方式影响成品清澈度与速度。

en.title: Fine strainer
en.summary: The second strainer in double straining, used to catch fruit fibre, herb fragments and ice shards; mesh fineness, frame stability and cleaning affect clarity and speed.

zh.title: 比重计（hydrometer）
zh.summary: 比重计是利用浮力读取液体密度的玻璃仪器，常见刻度有密度、比重、酒精分与糖度；它必须与温度修正一起使用，测量的是密度而不是直接的酒精度或糖度。

en.title: Hydrometer
en.summary: A hydrometer is a glass instrument that reads liquid density by buoyancy; common scales show density, specific gravity, alcohol strength or sugar content, and it must be used with temperature correction because it measures density, not alcohol or sugar directly.

zh.title: 冰桶
zh.summary: 用于给酒瓶降温的桶形容器，常为金属或玻璃；冰水混合比纯冰更快，水位要没过酒液，时间要看酒的类型。

en.title: Ice Bucket
en.summary: A bucket-shaped vessel for chilling bottles, usually metal or glass. An ice-water mix chills faster than ice alone, the water should cover the wine and the time depends on the drink.

zh.title: 量酒器
zh.summary: 用于快速、重复量取少量液体的吧台量具；双头容量、刻度清晰度与倒口设计影响出品的稳定性与速度。

en.title: Jigger
en.summary: A small bar measure for fast, repeated doses of liquid; dual-ended capacity, clear markings and a controlled lip affect consistency and speed in service.

zh.title: 搅拌杯
zh.summary: 与吧勺配合、用于搅拌型鸡尾酒的杯具；杯壁厚度、容量与杯口形状影响搅拌效率、稀释速度与成品温度。

en.title: Mixing glass
en.summary: A vessel used with a bar spoon for stirred cocktails; wall thickness, capacity and rim shape affect stirring efficiency, dilution and the final temperature.

zh.title: 捣棒
zh.summary: 在杯中轻压香草、水果与糖块的棒状工具；长度、头部形状与材质决定力度控制、清洁难度与杯具安全。

en.title: Muddler
en.summary: A rod-shaped bar tool for gently pressing herbs, fruit and sugar in the glass; length, head shape and material affect force control, cleaning and glass safety.

zh.title: 倒酒嘴
zh.summary: 装在烈酒瓶口的出酒嘴，用固定口径控制流速、让单手连续倒酒成为可能；它提高的是速度与一致性，精确计量仍要靠量酒器。

en.title: Speed pourer
en.summary: A spout fitted to a spirit bottle that restricts flow and allows one-handed, continuous pouring; it buys speed and consistency, not accuracy, which still belongs to the jigger.

zh.title: 滤冰器
zh.summary: 把冰块、碎冰与固体残渣拦在杯外的吧台工具；常见霍桑滤冰器与朱利普滤冰器，细网滤器用于二次过滤。

en.title: Strainer
en.summary: A bar tool that keeps ice, crushed ice and solid residue out of the glass; Hawthorne and julep strainers are the common types, with a fine-mesh strainer used for a second pass.

zh.title: 温度计
zh.summary: 测量酒液、酒瓶或酒窖温度的工具，常见探针式、红外式与贴片式；读数要稳定，校准要定期，测量位置要代表整体。

en.title: Thermometer
en.summary: A tool for measuring liquid, bottle or cellar temperature, common as a probe, infrared or stick-on model. Readings must settle, calibration must be checked and the probe placed where it represents the whole.

zh.title: Y 形削皮器
zh.summary: 手柄与刀片呈 Y 形或 T 形、双手操作的削皮器，可削出宽而薄的柑橘皮片或蔬菜皮；刀片是否可转、刃口间隙和下刀深度决定皮片厚度与带白瓤的多少。

en.title: Y-peeler
en.summary: A two-handed peeler with a Y- or T-shaped handle that cuts wide, thin ribbons of citrus peel or vegetable skin; blade type, cutting gap and pressure decide thickness and how much pith comes along.

zh.title: 艾格尼科
zh.summary: 意大利南部（巴斯利卡塔与坎帕尼亚）的红葡萄，晚熟、色深、单宁与酸度都很高；图拉斯与 Vulture 火山土是它的两个标志性产区，酒需要陈年才能舒展。

en.title: Aglianico
en.summary: A late-ripening red grape of southern Italy with deep colour and high tannin and acidity, best known from Taurasi in Campania and the volcanic Vulture zone in Basilicata, and built for long ageing.

zh.title: 阿尔巴利诺
zh.summary: 西班牙西北部加利西亚的白葡萄，在葡萄牙称 Alvarinho；果皮较厚、酸度高，带柑橘、白花与海风般的咸鲜感，适合搭配海鲜。里亚斯·拜萨斯与绿酒产区的蒙桑-梅尔加苏是核心产地。

en.title: Albariño
en.summary: A white grape of Spain's Atlantic northwest, known as Alvarinho in Portugal, with thick skins, high acidity and aromas of citrus, white flowers and sea air, centred on Rías Baixas and Monção e Melgaço.

zh.title: 阿斯蒂科
zh.summary: 希腊圣托里尼的白葡萄，耐旱抗风，在火山土与海风中保持高酸；干白带柠檬、火石与海盐气息，Vinsanto 则是它的甜型分支。

en.title: Assyrtiko
en.summary: A white grape from Santorini in Greece that keeps high acidity in wind, drought and volcanic soil, giving dry wines of lemon, flint and sea salt, with Vinsanto as its sweet counterpart.

zh.title: 巴贝拉
zh.summary: 意大利皮埃蒙特的红葡萄品种，酸度高、单宁中等、颜色深，耐热且产量稳定；常与内比奥罗形成“高酸配高单宁”的对照。阿斯蒂巴贝拉于 2008 年升为 DOCG，规定至少 90% 巴贝拉。

en.title: Barbera
en.summary: A red grape of Piedmont in Italy with high acidity, medium tannin and deep colour, heat-tolerant and steady in yield, often contrasted with Nebbiolo as high acid against high tannin. Barbera d'Asti became a DOCG in 2008 with a minimum of 90% Barbera.

zh.title: 蓝弗兰克
zh.summary: 奥地利布尔根兰的红葡萄，也在匈牙利称 Kékfrankos、捷克称 Frankovka；带深色、黑樱桃、胡椒与香料，酸度高、单宁中高，陈年潜力好。

en.title: Blaufränkisch
en.summary: A red grape of Burgenland, Austria, also called Kékfrankos in Hungary and Frankovka in Czechia; deep in colour with black cherry, pepper and spice, high acidity, medium-high tannin and good ageing potential.

zh.title: 品丽珠
zh.summary: 法国波尔多与卢瓦尔河谷的红葡萄品种，果皮较薄、成熟早于赤霞珠，单宁中等、香气外放，以覆盆子、紫罗兰、石墨与青椒气息著称；它是赤霞珠的亲本之一，在波尔多右岸与卢瓦尔河谷常用于单一品种或混酿。

en.title: Cabernet Franc
en.summary: A red grape variety from Bordeaux and the Loire Valley in France, with thinner skins than Cabernet Sauvignon and earlier ripening, moderate tannin and expressive aroma, known for raspberry, violet, graphite and green pepper notes. It is one of the parents of Cabernet Sauvignon and is used both as a varietal wine and in blends on Bordeaux's Right Bank and in the Loire.

zh.title: 赤霞珠
zh.summary: 重要的红葡萄品种，果粒小、皮厚、晚熟，单宁与色素潜力高；原产于波尔多，现广泛种植于世界主要葡萄酒产区。

en.title: Cabernet Sauvignon
en.summary: A major red grape variety with small berries, thick skins and late ripening; it has high tannin and colour potential and originated in Bordeaux, now planted across the world's main wine regions.

zh.title: 佳丽酿
zh.summary: 地中海西部的红葡萄，原产西班牙阿拉贡一带，在法国朗格多克、西班牙加泰罗尼亚与意大利撒丁岛广泛种植；老藤低产时酸度高、单宁强、带香料与泥土。

en.title: Carignan
en.summary: A western Mediterranean red grape from Aragon in Spain, widely planted in Languedoc, Catalonia and Sardinia; old low-yielding vines give high acidity, firm tannin, spice and earth.

zh.title: 佳美娜
zh.summary: 原产法国波尔多的红色品种，19 世纪传入智利后长期被误认作梅洛；1994 年重新鉴定，成为智利标志性品种。晚熟、色深，带黑李子、黑莓与青椒气息，常经橡木陈年。

en.title: Carménère
en.summary: A red grape from Bordeaux that was long mistaken for Merlot in Chile, where it was identified again in 1994 and became the country's signature variety, with deep colour, late ripening and notes of black plum, blackberry and green pepper.

zh.title: 霞多丽
zh.summary: 重要的白葡萄品种，香气中性、适应性强；从勃艮第干白到香槟起泡酒都有广泛使用，风格很大程度上由产区与酿造处理决定。

en.title: Chardonnay
en.summary: A major white grape variety with a neutral aroma and high adaptability; used from Burgundy dry whites to Champagne sparkling wines, with style largely determined by region and winemaking.

zh.title: 白诗南
zh.summary: 原产于法国卢瓦尔河谷的白葡萄品种，果皮薄、酸度高、成熟较晚，易受贵腐菌侵染；可酿干白、半干、甜白与起泡酒，以榅桲、苹果、蜂蜜与洋甘菊香气著称。DNA 研究显示它是萨瓦涅与未知品种的杂交后代，在南非被称为 Steen。

en.title: Chenin Blanc
en.summary: A white grape native to the Loire Valley, thin-skinned, high in acidity and late-ripening, prone to botrytis and able to make dry, off-dry, sweet and sparkling wine. It shows quince, apple, honey and chamomile, and DNA work indicates it is a cross of Savagnin and an unknown variety; in South Africa it is called Steen.

zh.title: 神索
zh.summary: 法国南部的红葡萄，耐旱、产量高，酒色浅、单宁低、酸度中高；常用于桃红、混酿与南罗讷的“神索-歌海娜”组合，也在南非与黎巴嫩种植。

en.title: Cinsault
en.summary: A southern French red grape, drought-tolerant and high-yielding, light in colour, low in tannin and medium-high in acidity; used in rosé, blends and the Southern Rhône’s Cinsault-Grenache combination, and planted in South Africa and Lebanon.

zh.title: 科维纳
zh.summary: 意大利威尼托的红葡萄品种，果皮较薄、颜色中等，以酸樱桃、杏仁与草本香气著称；是瓦坡里切拉与阿玛罗尼的核心品种，常与科维诺内、罗迪内拉同组混酿。

en.title: Corvina
en.summary: A red grape variety from Veneto, Italy, with relatively thin skins and moderate colour, known for sour cherry, almond and herbal aromas. It is the core variety of Valpolicella and Amarone, usually blended with Corvinone and Rondinella.

zh.title: 多切托
zh.summary: 意大利皮埃蒙特的红葡萄，名字意为“小甜”，但酒通常干型、酸度偏低、单宁经柔和萃取后圆润，带黑樱桃、李子、甘草与苦杏仁余味；适合年轻时饮用，是内比奥罗与巴贝拉之外的日常对照。

en.title: Dolcetto
en.summary: A red grape of Piedmont, Italy, whose name means “little sweet”, though the wine is usually dry with low acidity and rounded, gently extracted tannin; black cherry, plum, liquorice and an almond finish, drunk young as an everyday contrast to Nebbiolo and Barbera.

zh.title: 黑姑娘
zh.summary: 罗马尼亚与摩尔多瓦的原生红葡萄，名字意为“黑姑娘”；酒色深、单宁中高，带黑樱桃、李子、香料与泥土，常被比作黑皮诺与西拉的混合。

en.title: Fetească Neagră
en.summary: A native red grape of Romania and Moldova, whose name means “black girl”; deep in colour with medium-high tannin, black cherry, plum, spice and earth, often compared to a mix of Pinot Noir and Syrah.

zh.title: 富尔民特
zh.summary: 富尔民特是匈牙利托卡伊的核心白葡萄，酸度高、皮厚、易感染贵腐菌；既酿出以阿苏为代表的贵腐甜酒，也酿出日益重要的干型富尔民特，风格从蜂蜜杏脯到柑橘与烟熏。

en.title: Furmint
en.summary: Furmint is the white grape behind Tokaj, high in acidity with thick skins and a strong affinity for noble rot, producing both botrytised sweet wines such as Aszú and a growing range of dry whites with citrus, smoke and saline mineral character.

zh.title: 佳美
zh.summary: 皮薄、早熟、酸度高的红葡萄品种，是博若莱红葡萄酒的核心品种；以整串发酵与花岗岩土壤上的果味著称，风格从轻盈易饮到可陈年的村庄级 cru 都有。

en.title: Gamay
en.summary: A thin-skinned, early-ripening red grape with high acidity and the core variety of Beaujolais reds; known for whole-cluster fermentation and fruit from granite soils, with styles from light and easy to ageworthy village crus.

zh.title: 加尔加内加
zh.summary: 意大利威尼托索阿韦产区的白葡萄，晚熟、产量高，带柠檬、杏仁、白花与矿物；可酿干型 Soave、甜型 Recioto di Soave 与起泡酒。

en.title: Garganega
en.summary: A white grape of Soave in Veneto, Italy, late-ripening and high-yielding, with lemon, almond, white flowers and mineral; it makes dry Soave, sweet Recioto di Soave and sparkling wine.

zh.title: 琼瑶浆
zh.summary: 果皮呈粉红色的芳香型白葡萄品种，名称源自意大利南蒂罗尔的特拉明（Tramin）；它是萨瓦宁（Savagnin）的芳香变异，酸度偏低、糖分积累快，以荔枝、玫瑰、姜与肉桂香气著称，主要种植于阿尔萨斯、德国、奥地利与意大利北部。

en.title: Gewürztraminer
en.summary: An aromatic white grape with pink skins, named after Tramin in South Tyrol. An aromatic mutation of Savagnin, it is low in acidity and quick to accumulate sugar, known for lychee, rose, ginger and cinnamon, and grown mainly in Alsace, Germany, Austria and northern Italy.

zh.title: 格莱拉
zh.summary: 意大利威尼托与弗留利的白葡萄品种，2009 年前品种名与酒名同称 Prosecco，后改用格莱拉以保护产区名称；果皮薄、酸度中等，以青苹果、梨与白花香气著称，是普罗塞克的核心品种，在尤加内山一带又称 Serprino。

en.title: Glera
en.summary: A white grape of Veneto and Friuli in Italy, known as Prosecco for both grape and wine until 2009, when the variety was renamed Glera to protect the place name. Thin-skinned with moderate acidity, it shows green apple, pear and white flowers and is the core of Prosecco, called Serprino around the Euganean Hills.

zh.title: 格德约
zh.summary: 西班牙西北部 Valdeorras、Ribeiro 与 Monterrei 的白葡萄，带柑橘、白花、矿物与坚果，酸度中高、质地饱满；可酿清爽型或橡木桶型。

en.title: Godello
en.summary: A white grape of Valdeorras, Ribeiro and Monterrei in northwest Spain, with citrus, white flowers, mineral and nuts, medium-high acidity and a full texture; it can be made crisp or oaked.

zh.title: 歌海娜
zh.summary: 耐热、耐旱的红葡萄品种，果皮较薄、糖分积累快、酸度偏低；它在罗讷河谷混酿与西班牙 Priorat 等产区中承担果味与酒精度的支撑。DNA 研究确认西班牙的 Garnacha 与撒丁岛的 Cannonau 都是同一品种。

en.title: Grenache
en.summary: A heat- and drought-tolerant red grape with thin skins, fast sugar accumulation and low acidity, supporting fruit and alcohol in Rhône blends and in Spanish Priorat. DNA work confirms that Spain's Garnacha and Sardinia's Cannonau are the same variety.

zh.title: 绿维特利纳
zh.summary: 奥地利的代表性白葡萄品种，晚熟、酸度高，典型香气为柑橘、青豌豆与白胡椒；DNA 研究显示它是特拉明与奥地利古老品种 St. Georgen 的自然杂交后代，在瓦豪按酒精度分为 Steinfeder、Federspiel 与 Smaragd 三级。

en.title: Grüner Veltliner
en.summary: Austria's signature white grape, late-ripening and high in acidity, with citrus, green pea and white pepper aromas. DNA work shows it is a natural cross of Traminer and the old Austrian variety St. Georgen, and in the Wachau it is graded by alcohol into Steinfeder, Federspiel and Smaragd.

zh.title: 卡达卡
zh.summary: 匈牙利与巴尔干的红葡萄，酒色浅、酸度高、单宁低，带红樱桃、香料与胡椒；曾是匈牙利最重要的红葡萄，现为 Szekszárd 与 Eger 的传统品种。

en.title: Kadarka
en.summary: A red grape of Hungary and the Balkans, pale in colour, high in acidity and low in tannin, with red cherry, spice and pepper; once Hungary’s most important red grape, it survives as a traditional variety in Szekszárd and Eger.

zh.title: 马卡贝奥
zh.summary: 西班牙北部的白葡萄，在里奥哈称 Viura、在加泰罗尼亚称 Macabeo；酸度中等、带青苹果、白花与柑橘，是卡瓦与里奥哈白葡萄酒的基础。

en.title: Macabeo
en.summary: A white grape of northern Spain, called Viura in Rioja and Macabeo in Catalonia; medium acidity with green apple, white flowers and citrus, it is the base of Cava and Rioja whites.

zh.title: 马尔贝克
zh.summary: 原产于法国西南部的红葡萄品种，果皮深色、单宁充沛，对霜冻与坐果不良敏感；在阿根廷门多萨的高海拔环境下成为标志性品种。

en.title: Malbec
en.summary: A red grape native to south-west France with deep-coloured skins and generous tannin, sensitive to frost and poor fruit set; it became a flagship variety in the high-altitude vineyards of Mendoza, Argentina.

zh.title: 玛尔维萨
zh.summary: 地中海与伊比利亚的白色品种家族，包含多个克隆与变种；香气从白花、杏、蜂蜜到香料，可酿干白、甜酒与加强酒，不能当作单一品种。

en.title: Malvasia
en.summary: A white variety family across the Mediterranean and Iberia, with many clones and types; aromas range from white flowers, apricot and honey to spice, and it makes dry, sweet and fortified wines, so it is not one single variety.

zh.title: 玛珊
zh.summary: 北罗讷河谷的白葡萄，常与胡珊混酿；酒体饱满、酸度低、带蜂蜜、蜂蜡、坚果与白花，陈年后更显圆润，是埃米塔日白葡萄酒的主要品种。

en.title: Marsanne
en.summary: A white grape of the Northern Rhône, usually blended with Roussanne; full-bodied, low in acidity, with honey, beeswax, nuts and white flowers, rounder with age, and the main variety of Hermitage white.

zh.title: 勃艮第甜瓜
zh.summary: 白葡萄品种，原产法国勃艮第，现主要种植于卢瓦尔河谷南特一带，用于酿制密斯卡岱；与霞多丽同为 Gouais Blanc 与黑皮诺的后代，酸度高、香气中性，常经酒泥陈酿获得圆润质地。

en.title: Melon de Bourgogne
en.summary: A white grape native to Burgundy, now grown mainly around Nantes in the Loire Valley for Muscadet. A cross of Gouais Blanc and Pinot like Chardonnay, it is high in acidity and neutral in aroma, and often gains roundness from lees ageing.

zh.title: 门西亚
zh.summary: 西班牙西北部 Bierzo 与 Ribeira Sacra 的红葡萄，带黑樱桃、草药、香料与板岩矿物，酸度明亮、单宁细致中等；历史上曾被误认成品丽珠，市场上有时类比黑皮诺或佳美。

en.title: Mencía
en.summary: A red grape of Bierzo and Ribeira Sacra in northwest Spain, with black cherry, herbs, spice and slate mineral, bright acidity and fine moderate tannin; historically mistaken for Cabernet Franc, sometimes compared with Pinot Noir or Gamay.

zh.title: 梅洛
zh.summary: 波尔多右岸常见的红葡萄品种，果粒中等、皮较薄、成熟较早，单宁与酸度中等；它既能单独酿酒，也常与赤霞珠等品种混酿。

en.title: Merlot
en.summary: A red grape common on Bordeaux's Right Bank, with medium berries, relatively thin skins and early ripening; its tannin and acidity are moderate, and it is used both as a varietal wine and in blends with Cabernet Sauvignon.

zh.title: 蒙特普尔恰诺
zh.summary: 意大利阿布鲁佐的红葡萄，与托斯卡纳的蒙特普尔恰诺小镇无关；酒色深、单宁中低、酸度中高，带黑樱桃、李子与香料，是意大利南部最常见的红葡萄酒之一。

en.title: Montepulciano
en.summary: A red grape of Abruzzo, Italy, unrelated to the Tuscan town of Montepulciano; deep in colour with medium-low tannin, medium-high acidity, black cherry, plum and spice, it is one of southern Italy’s most common red wines.

zh.title: 慕合怀特
zh.summary: 原产于西班牙与地中海沿岸的晚熟红葡萄品种，皮厚、单宁强、耐热耐旱；在法国普罗旺斯与罗讷河谷常与歌海娜、西拉混酿。

en.title: Mourvèdre
en.summary: A late-ripening red grape from Spain and the Mediterranean coast with thick skins, firm tannin and good heat and drought tolerance; in Provence and the Rhône it is usually blended with Grenache and Syrah.

zh.title: 米勒-图高
zh.summary: 德国培育的白葡萄，由雷司令与马德雷尔（Madeleine Royale）杂交而来；早熟、产量高，带花香、柑橘与轻微麝香，是德国种植面积最大的白葡萄之一。

en.title: Müller-Thurgau
en.summary: A German-bred white grape, a cross of Riesling and Madeleine Royale; early-ripening and high-yielding, with flowers, citrus and a light Muscat note, it is one of Germany’s most planted whites.

zh.title: 麝香
zh.summary: 麝香是一个古老而庞大的葡萄家族，小粒麝香香气最浓，亚历山大麝香果粒更大；从阿尔萨斯干白、意大利莫斯卡托微起泡到法国与澳洲的加强甜酒，风格跨度极大，核心是浓郁的花香与葡萄香。

en.title: Muscat
en.summary: Muscat is not one grape but a large, ancient family whose members share a striking floral and grapey aroma, ranging from dry Alsace white and lightly sparkling Italian Moscato to French and Australian fortified sweet wines.

zh.title: 内比奥罗
zh.summary: 意大利皮埃蒙特的代表性红葡萄品种，晚熟、皮厚，颜色偏浅但酸度与单宁很高，带玫瑰、焦油与红樱桃气息；巴罗洛与巴巴莱斯科都以它为核心品种。

en.title: Nebbiolo
en.summary: The signature red grape of Piedmont in Italy; it ripens late and has thick skins, giving wines that are pale in colour yet high in acidity and tannin, with aromas of rose, tar and red cherry. Barolo and Barbaresco are built on it.

zh.title: 黑达沃拉
zh.summary: 西西里最重要的红葡萄，颜色深、单宁中高，带黑莓、黑樱桃、李子与香料；在 Noto、Vittoria 与 Etna 周边表现不同，常与弗拉帕托混酿。

en.title: Nero d’Avola
en.summary: Sicily’s most important red grape, deep in colour with medium-high tannin, blackberry, black cherry, plum and spice; it performs differently around Noto, Vittoria and Etna and is often blended with Frappato.

zh.title: 派斯
zh.summary: 智利的老藤红葡萄，源自西班牙的 Listán Negro/Gros Collet，在 Itata 与 Maule 的干旱老园中保留；酒色浅、酸度高、单宁低，带红樱桃、干草与香料。

en.title: País
en.summary: A Chilean old-vine red grape descended from Spain’s Listán Negro/Gros Collet, preserved in dry old vineyards of Itata and Maule; light in colour, high in acidity, low in tannin, with red cherry, dried herbs and spice.

zh.title: 帕洛米诺
zh.summary: 西班牙安达卢西亚的白葡萄，雪莉的主要品种；本身风味中性、酸度低，风格几乎全部来自生物陈酿（flor）或氧化陈酿与索莱拉系统。

en.title: Palomino
en.summary: A white grape of Andalusia and the main variety of Sherry, neutral and low in acidity, whose style comes from biological ageing under flor or oxidative ageing in a solera.

zh.title: 帕雷亚达
zh.summary: 加泰罗尼亚佩内德斯的白葡萄，卡瓦三大品种之一；酸度高、酒体轻、带青苹果、柑橘与白花，常与沙雷洛、马卡贝奥混酿增加清爽感。

en.title: Parellada
en.summary: A white grape of Penedès, Catalonia, one of Cava’s three main varieties; high in acidity, light in body, with green apple, citrus and white flowers, often blended with Xarel·lo and Macabeo for freshness.

zh.title: 小芒森
zh.summary: 法国西南部 Jurançon 的白葡萄，果粒小、皮厚、晚熟，带热带水果、柑橘、蜂蜜与高酸；可酿甜型、半干与干型，是法国最耐陈年的白葡萄之一。

en.title: Petit Manseng
en.summary: A white grape of Jurançon in southwest France, with small thick-skinned berries, late ripening, tropical fruit, citrus, honey and high acidity; it makes sweet, off-dry and dry wines and is one of France’s longest-lived whites.

zh.title: 小维多
zh.summary: 波尔多混酿中的“少数派”红葡萄，晚熟、皮厚、颜色深、单宁强；在凉爽的波尔多常难完全成熟，但在澳大利亚、西班牙与美国常被用来增加结构与颜色。

en.title: Petit Verdot
en.summary: A minority red grape in Bordeaux blends, late-ripening with thick skins, deep colour and firm tannin; it struggles to ripen fully in cool Bordeaux but is used in Australia, Spain and the US to add structure and colour.

zh.title: 白皮诺
zh.summary: 白皮诺是黑皮诺的白色变异，酸度中等偏高、风格温和；在阿尔萨斯常与欧塞瓦混酿，在德国称魏斯堡格，在意大利上阿迪杰称皮诺比安科，既可酿静止干白，也可用于起泡酒。

en.title: Pinot Blanc
en.summary: Pinot Blanc is a white mutation of Pinot Noir with moderate to high acidity and a gentle, rounded style, grown in Alsace (often blended with Auxerrois), Germany as Weissburgunder and northern Italy as Pinot Bianco, for still whites and sparkling wine.

zh.title: 灰皮诺
zh.summary: 黑皮诺的灰色果皮变种，早熟、皮薄、酸度偏低；在阿尔萨斯可酿出饱满浓郁的风格，在意大利则以清爽轻盈的灰皮诺（Pinot Grigio）为主流。意大利于 2017 年设立 delle Venezie DOC，进一步扩大了这一风格的产量。

en.title: Pinot Gris
en.summary: A grey-skinned colour mutation of Pinot Noir, early-ripening, thin-skinned and low in acidity. Alsace can make it full and rich, while Italy makes it light and crisp as Pinot Grigio; the Italian delle Venezie DOC, created in 2017, expanded that style further.

zh.title: 莫尼耶皮诺
zh.summary: 莫尼耶皮诺是黑皮诺的深色变异，发芽早、成熟早，在香槟的黏土坡地上表现稳定；它为混酿提供红色果味与圆润口感，近年单酿与黑中白香槟越来越受关注。

en.title: Pinot Meunier
en.summary: Pinot Meunier is the dark-skinned Pinot mutation that buds and ripens early, performs well on the clay slopes of the Marne Valley and gives Champagne red-fruit richness and roundness, whether in blends or in increasingly popular single-varietal and Blanc de Noirs bottlings.

zh.title: 黑皮诺
zh.summary: 皮薄、色浅、酸度高的红葡萄品种，对气候与栽培极为敏感；它是勃艮第红酒与香槟的重要原料，风格从轻盈果味到复杂陈年都有可能。

en.title: Pinot Noir
en.summary: A thin-skinned, pale-coloured red grape with high acidity that is highly sensitive to climate and viticulture; it is the basis of red Burgundy and an important component of Champagne, spanning light fruit to complex aged styles.

zh.title: 皮诺塔吉
zh.summary: 1925 年由南非斯泰伦博斯大学的 Perold 将黑皮诺与神索杂交而成；果色深、单宁结实，风格从鲜亮果味到咖啡、烟熏不等，是南非最具代表性的红葡萄品种，也是 20 世纪人工育种成功的少数红葡萄之一。

en.title: Pinotage
en.summary: A South African red grape created in 1925 by crossing Pinot Noir with Cinsaut at Stellenbosch, known for deep colour, firm tannin and a style that ranges from fresh fruit to coffee and smoke.

zh.title: 匹格普勒
zh.summary: 法国朗格多克的白葡萄，核心是 Picpoul de Pinet；高酸、柠檬、海盐与白花，适合配牡蛎与海鲜，是地中海“海水感”白葡萄酒的代表。

en.title: Piquepoul
en.summary: A white grape of Languedoc, France, centred on Picpoul de Pinet; high acidity, lemon, sea salt and white flowers, it suits oysters and seafood and represents the Mediterranean “sea-air” white.

zh.title: 普拉瓦茨马里
zh.summary: 克罗地亚达尔马提亚海岸的红葡萄，由 Tribidrag（即仙粉黛）与 Dobričić 杂交而来；高单宁、高酒精、带黑莓、干果与香料，Dingač 是核心产区。

en.title: Plavac Mali
en.summary: A red grape of the Dalmatian coast, Croatia, a cross of Tribidrag (Zinfandel) and Dobričić; high in tannin and alcohol, with blackberry, dried fruit and spice, with Dingač as the core appellation.

zh.title: 雷司令
zh.summary: 高酸度、香气清晰的白色葡萄品种，以青柠、青苹果与陈年后的矿物、汽油气息著称；德国、阿尔萨斯与奥地利是核心产区，甜度跨度极大。

en.title: Riesling
en.summary: A high-acid, clearly aromatic white grape known for lime, green apple and, with age, mineral and petrol notes; Germany, Alsace and Austria are core regions, and sweetness ranges widely.

zh.title: 白羽
zh.summary: 格鲁吉亚最古老的白葡萄之一，酸度高、带青苹果、白花与香料；可酿清爽干白，也可用陶罐带皮发酵成琥珀色葡萄酒，是格鲁吉亚陶罐传统的核心品种。

en.title: Rkatsiteli
en.summary: One of Georgia’s oldest white grapes, high in acidity with green apple, white flowers and spice; it makes crisp dry whites and amber wines through qvevri skin contact, and is central to Georgia’s clay-vessel tradition.

zh.title: 胡珊
zh.summary: 北罗讷河谷的白葡萄，带白花、杏仁、蜂蜜与草药香气，酸度比玛珊高、产量低；常与玛珊混酿，也在萨伏依与朗格多克种植。

en.title: Roussanne
en.summary: A white grape of the Northern Rhône, with white flowers, almond, honey and herbal notes, higher acidity and lower yields than Marsanne; usually blended with Marsanne, and also planted in Savoie and Languedoc.

zh.title: 桑娇维塞
zh.summary: 意大利托斯卡纳的代表性红葡萄品种，酸度高、单宁中等，带酸樱桃、番茄叶与泥土气息；它是基安蒂与布鲁奈罗的核心品种。

en.title: Sangiovese
en.summary: Tuscany's signature red grape, with high acidity and medium tannin and notes of sour cherry, tomato leaf and earth; it is the core variety of Chianti and Brunello.

zh.title: 萨佩拉维
zh.summary: 格鲁吉亚卡赫季的红葡萄，以红肉果皮（teinturier）带来的深色与高酸著称；可酿干红、半甜、甜型与加强酒，是格鲁吉亚葡萄酒的国家标志。

en.title: Saperavi
en.summary: A red grape from Kakheti, Georgia, known for the deep colour and high acidity that come from its red-fleshed (teinturier) skins; it makes dry, semi-sweet, sweet and fortified wines and is Georgia’s national wine symbol.

zh.title: 长相思
zh.summary: 香气外放的白葡萄品种，以柑橘、青草、醋栗与热带水果气息著称；酸度高、适合凉爽产区，在卢瓦尔、波尔多与新西兰表现各异。

en.title: Sauvignon Blanc
en.summary: An aromatic white grape known for citrus, grass, gooseberry and tropical notes; it has high acidity and suits cool regions, showing different faces in the Loire, Bordeaux and New Zealand.

zh.title: 赛美蓉
zh.summary: 法国波尔多的白葡萄品种，果皮薄、酸度偏低，易受贵腐菌侵染，是苏玳与巴萨克甜白的主体品种，也用于格拉夫的干白；以柠檬、蜂蜡、蜂蜜与杏子香气著称。1855 年分级中，滴金酒庄是唯一获得 Premier Cru Supérieur 的酒庄。

en.title: Sémillon
en.summary: A Bordeaux white grape with thin skins and low acidity, prone to botrytis, the main variety of Sauternes and Barsac and also used for dry Graves white. It shows lemon, beeswax, honey and apricot, and in the 1855 classification Château d'Yquem was the only estate rated Premier Cru Supérieur.

zh.title: 圣劳伦特
zh.summary: 中欧的红葡萄，与黑皮诺同属 Pinot 家族；酒色深、酸度明亮、单宁中等偏上，年轻时紧涩、陈年后圆润，带黑樱桃、黑莓、香料与泥土，风格介于黑皮诺与蓝弗兰克之间。

en.title: St. Laurent
en.summary: A Central European red grape in the Pinot family; deep in colour with bright acidity and medium-plus tannin, firm young and velvety with age, black cherry, blackberry, spice and earth, between Pinot Noir and Blaufränkisch in style.

zh.title: 西万尼
zh.summary: 原产中欧的白葡萄，在阿尔萨斯、德国与奥地利种植；酒体中等、酸度中高，带青苹果、白花、草药与矿物，常被低估。

en.title: Sylvaner
en.summary: A Central European white grape planted in Alsace, Germany and Austria; medium-bodied with medium-high acidity, green apple, white flowers, herbs and mineral, often underrated.

zh.title: 西拉
zh.summary: 深色、单宁充沛的红葡萄品种，带黑胡椒、黑莓与紫罗兰气息；原产于法国罗讷河谷，在澳大利亚以 Shiraz 之名广泛种植。

en.title: Syrah
en.summary: A deeply coloured red grape with generous tannin and notes of black pepper, blackberry and violet; it originated in the Rhône Valley and is widely planted in Australia under the name Shiraz.

zh.title: 丹娜
zh.summary: 原产法国西南部马迪朗一带的红葡萄，以高单宁、深色与强陈年潜力著称；在乌拉圭成为国家标志品种，常与梅洛、品丽珠混酿以柔化结构。

en.title: Tannat
en.summary: A red variety from Madiran in southwest France, known for high tannin, deep colour and long ageing; in Uruguay it became a national signature, often blended with Merlot or Cabernet Franc to soften structure.

zh.title: 丹魄
zh.summary: 西班牙的代表性红葡萄品种，果皮较厚、成熟较早，带樱桃、皮革与烟草气息；里奥哈与杜埃罗河岸常用橡木桶陈酿塑造其结构。

en.title: Tempranillo
en.summary: Spain's signature red grape, with relatively thick skins and early ripening and notes of cherry, leather and tobacco; Rioja and Ribera del Duero often use oak ageing to shape its structure.

zh.title: 特浓情
zh.summary: 阿根廷的原生白葡萄，以玫瑰、柑橘、荔枝与香料香气著称；高海拔萨尔塔版本酸度更高、香气更集中，常被误认为麝香家族。

en.title: Torrontés
en.summary: A native Argentine white grape, known for rose, citrus, lychee and spice; high-altitude Salta versions have higher acidity and more concentrated perfume, and it is often mistaken for the Muscat family.

zh.title: 特雷比奥罗（白玉霓）
zh.summary: 意大利与法国广泛种植的白葡萄，高酸、低酒精、风味中性；在意大利叫特雷比奥罗，在干邑与雅文邑则是蒸馏用的白玉霓（Ugni Blanc）。

en.title: Trebbiano
en.summary: A high-acid, low-alcohol white grape widely grown in Italy as Trebbiano and in France as Ugni Blanc, where it is the base of Cognac and Armagnac.

zh.title: 特鲁索
zh.summary: 法国汝拉的红葡萄，酒色浅、酸度高、单宁低，带红樱桃、香料与泥土；可酿轻红、桃红与起泡，是汝拉“轻酒体”传统的核心。

en.title: Trousseau
en.summary: A red grape of the Jura, France, pale in colour, high in acidity and low in tannin, with red cherry, spice and earth; it makes light reds, rosés and sparkling wine and is central to the Jura’s light-body tradition.

zh.title: 弗德乔
zh.summary: 西班牙卢埃达产区的白葡萄，带茴香、柑橘、白花与草本香气，酸度清爽；常与长相思、维欧尼混酿，是西班牙现代白葡萄酒的核心品种。

en.title: Verdejo
en.summary: A white grape of Rueda in Spain, with fennel, citrus, white flowers and herbal notes and crisp acidity; often blended with Sauvignon Blanc or Viognier, it is the core of modern Spanish white wine.

zh.title: 维蒙蒂诺
zh.summary: 地中海沿岸的白葡萄，在撒丁岛、利古里亚、托斯卡纳与法国普罗旺斯（称 Rolle）种植；带柑橘、白花、海盐与草药，酸度中高，适合海鲜。

en.title: Vermentino
en.summary: A Mediterranean coastal white grape planted in Sardinia, Liguria, Tuscany and Provence (as Rolle); citrus, white flowers, sea salt and herbs, medium-high acidity, suited to seafood.

zh.title: 维欧尼
zh.summary: 原产于法国北罗讷的白葡萄品种，果皮较厚、酸度偏低、香气浓郁；在孔德里约可酿出饱满的杏与金银花风格，也常少量混入西拉以增添香气与颜色稳定。20 世纪中期一度濒临消失，1965 年前后孔德里约仅剩约 30 公顷。

en.title: Viognier
en.summary: A white grape native to the Northern Rhône, with thicker skins, low acidity and intense aroma. In Condrieu it gives full-bodied apricot and honeysuckle wines, and it is often blended in small amounts with Syrah for aroma and colour stability. It nearly disappeared in the mid-20th century, with only about 30 ha left in Condrieu around 1965.

zh.title: 沙雷洛
zh.summary: 西班牙佩内德斯与卡瓦起泡酒的核心白葡萄，酸度高、带青苹果、柑橘、白花与矿物；与马卡贝奥、帕雷亚达构成卡瓦经典三元组合。

en.title: Xarel·lo
