en.summary: A core white grape of Penedès and Cava sparkling wine in Spain, high in acidity with green apple, citrus, white flowers and mineral; with Macabeo and Parellada it forms the classic Cava trio.

zh.title: 希诺马罗
zh.summary: 希腊北部纳乌萨的红葡萄，以高酸、高单宁、番茄与橄榄气息著称，常被称为“希腊的內比奥罗”；陈年后带皮革、干果与香料。

en.title: Xinomavro
en.summary: A red grape from Naoussa in northern Greece, known for high acidity, firm tannin and tomato-olive notes, often called “the Greek Nebbiolo”; with age it gains leather, dried fruit and spice.

zh.title: 仙粉黛
zh.summary: 原产于克罗地亚达尔马提亚的红色品种，与意大利普里米蒂沃为同一基因型；19 世纪传入美国，成为加州老藤与高酒精风格的代表。果粒成熟不均，常带黑莓果酱、黑胡椒与干草气息。

en.title: Zinfandel
en.summary: A red grape native to Dalmatia in Croatia and genetically identical to Italy's Primitivo, brought to the United States in the 19th century and now the signature grape of California old vines and high-alcohol reds.

zh.title: 茨威格
zh.summary: 奥地利最重要的红葡萄，由蓝弗兰克与圣劳伦特杂交而来；早熟、产量高，酒色深、单宁低，带黑樱桃、香料与紫罗兰，适合年轻时饮用。

en.title: Zweigelt
en.summary: Austria’s most important red grape, a cross of Blaufränkisch and St. Laurent; early-ripening and high-yielding, deep in colour with low tannin, black cherry, spice and violet, best drunk young.

zh.title: 苦艾酒杯
zh.summary: 杯腹宽、杯口收的玻璃杯，常配雕花糖匙；用于苦艾酒的“加水稀释”仪式，让酒液从翠绿变为乳白。

en.title: Absinthe Glass
en.summary: A glass with a wide bowl and a narrow rim, usually paired with a carved sugar spoon. It is used for the absinthe water ritual, where the drink turns from green to milky white.

zh.title: 啤酒马克杯
zh.summary: 带把手、杯壁较厚的大容量啤酒杯，常见于德国啤酒文化；厚壁保冷，把手隔热，宽口便于大口饮用。

en.title: Beer Mug
en.summary: A large beer vessel with a handle and thick walls, common in German beer culture. Thick walls hold the cold, the handle insulates the hand and the wide mouth invites a big draught.

zh.title: 香槟笛杯
zh.summary: 杯身细长、杯口略收的带梗杯，常用于香槟与气泡酒；窄杯身有利于保持气泡，但香气展开较弱。

en.title: Champagne flute
en.summary: A tall, narrow, slightly tapered stemmed glass used for Champagne and sparkling wine; the narrow body helps retain bubbles but opens aroma less than wider shapes.

zh.title: 雪莉小杯
zh.summary: 西班牙雪莉品鉴用的小型带梗郁金香杯，杯腹收拢、杯口略外扩，常见容量约 100–150 ml；也用于部分烈酒的闻香品鉴。

en.title: Copita
en.summary: A small stemmed tulip-shaped glass used for tasting Sherry in Spain, with a gathered bowl and a slightly flared rim, typically holding about 100–150 ml; also used for nosing some spirits.

zh.title: 碟形杯
zh.summary: 带杯梗的浅碗形杯，常用于香槟、气泡酒与滤冰后直接饮用的短饮；杯口宽、杯身浅，香气开放但气泡消散较快。

en.title: Coupe glass
en.summary: A stemmed, shallow bowl-shaped glass used for Champagne, sparkling wine and short drinks served without ice; the wide rim opens the aroma but lets bubbles fade quickly.

zh.title: 醒酒器
zh.summary: 用于分离沉淀、让酒液接触空气的玻璃容器，常见宽底、长颈、带塞；醒酒时间要看酒龄、酒体与香气。

en.title: Decanter
en.summary: A glass vessel for separating sediment and letting wine meet air, usually with a wide base, a long neck and a stopper. Decanting time depends on age, body and aroma.

zh.title: 高脚广口杯
zh.summary: 带梗、杯腹宽、杯口开放的杯型，常用于比利时修道院啤酒、部分葡萄酒与餐桌水；容量常见 250–500 毫升，以具体产品为准。

en.title: Goblet
en.summary: A stemmed glass with a wide bowl and an open rim, used for Belgian abbey and Trappist ales, some wines and table water; capacities commonly run from 250 to 500 ml.

zh.title: 高球杯
zh.summary: 直身、细长、容量较大的长饮杯，常用于加冰长饮与气泡类鸡尾酒；容量没有统一标准，冰量与苏打水应按自己的杯子调整。

en.title: Highball glass
en.summary: A straight-sided, tall, fairly large long-drink glass used for drinks over ice and sparkling cocktails; capacity has no single standard, so adjust ice and soda to your own glass.

zh.title: 飓风杯
zh.summary: 杯身细长、中部鼓起、杯口外翻的高杯，形似老式飓风灯罩；常用于热带鸡尾酒与大量碎冰的饮品。

en.title: Hurricane Glass
en.summary: A tall glass with a slender body, a bulging middle and a flared rim, shaped like an old hurricane lamp. It is used for tropical cocktails and crushed-ice drinks.

zh.title: 朱利普杯
zh.summary: 银制或锡制的小型金属杯，常用于薄荷朱利普；金属导热快，杯壁会结霜，碎冰与薄荷让酒液保持低温。

en.title: Julep Cup
en.summary: A small metal cup, usually silver or pewter, used for the mint julep. Metal conducts cold quickly, frosts the wall and keeps the drink icy with crushed ice and mint.

zh.title: 马天尼杯
zh.summary: 锥形、有梗、杯口略收的短饮杯，也常称鸡尾酒杯，用于干马天尼、玛格丽特与代基里等短饮；容量没有统一标准，预冷比杯型更影响体验。

en.title: Martini glass
en.summary: A conical, stemmed short-drink glass with a slightly narrowed rim, also called a cocktail glass, used for the Dry Martini, Margarita and Daiquiri; capacity has no single standard and pre-chilling matters more than shape.

zh.title: 尼克与诺拉杯
zh.summary: 名字来自 1934 年电影《瘦人》里的一对侦探夫妻；浅碗、宽口、细梗的小型带梗杯，常见容量约 150–200 ml，适合不加冰的短饮。

en.title: Nick and Nora glass
en.summary: Named after the detective couple in the 1934 film The Thin Man; a small stemmed glass with a shallow bowl and wide rim, typically holding about 150–200 ml and suited to short drinks served without ice.

zh.title: 品脱杯
zh.summary: 英国 568 毫升、美国 473 毫升的直身啤酒杯；锥形、nonic 与带柄 jug 是常见形制，容量随国家与产品而变。

en.title: Pint glass
en.summary: A straight-sided beer glass holding 568 ml in the UK and 473 ml in the US; conical, nonic and handled jug versions are common, and capacity varies by market and product.

zh.title: 红酒杯
zh.summary: 杯身宽大、杯口略收的带梗酒杯，用于红葡萄酒；较大的杯腹帮助香气展开，收口则让香气集中于杯口。

en.title: Red Wine Glass
en.summary: A stemmed glass with a wide bowl and a slightly narrowed rim, used for red wine. The wide bowl opens the aroma and the narrowed rim gathers it at the nose.

zh.title: 古典杯
zh.summary: 杯身较矮、杯口较宽的短饮杯，常用于加冰纯饮与搅拌类鸡尾酒；容量没有统一标准，冰量应按自己的杯子调整。

en.title: Rocks glass
en.summary: A short, wide-mouthed short-drink glass used for spirits over ice and stirred cocktails; capacity has no single standard, so adjust ice to your own glass.

zh.title: 烈酒杯
zh.summary: 容量很小、杯壁较厚的小杯，常用于一口饮用的烈酒、量酒与分层鸡尾酒；它追求的是方便与强度，不是香气层次。

en.title: Shot Glass
en.summary: A small, thick-walled glass used for one-swallow servings of spirits, for measuring and for layered cocktails. It is built for convenience and intensity, not aroma.

zh.title: 白兰地杯
zh.summary: 短梗、大肚、收口的杯型，传统用于干邑与白兰地；常见容量 300–800 ml，但实际倒酒量远小于容量。

en.title: Snifter
en.summary: A short-stemmed glass with a large bowl and a narrowed rim, traditionally used for Cognac and brandy; typical capacity is 300–800 ml, while the actual pour is far smaller.

zh.title: 品鉴杯
zh.summary: 以 ISO 3591 标准品鉴杯（常称 INAO 杯）为代表的郁金香形小杯，标准容量 215 毫升，用于葡萄酒、烈酒与清酒的对照品评。

en.title: Tasting glass
en.summary: The small tulip-shaped glass defined by ISO 3591, commonly called the INAO glass, with a nominal capacity of 215 ml; used for comparative tasting of wine, spirits and sake.

zh.title: Tiki 杯
zh.summary: 以陶瓷或玻璃制成的异形杯，常雕刻成提基神像、面具或图腾；它是热带鸡尾酒文化的一部分，容量与造型都比普通杯更夸张。

en.title: Tiki Mug
en.summary: A shaped ceramic or glass mug carved as a tiki god, mask or totem. It belongs to tropical cocktail culture, and its capacity and form are more theatrical than an ordinary glass.

zh.title: 郁金香杯
zh.summary: 杯腹较宽、杯口收窄的带梗杯，常用于香槟、啤酒与部分短饮；在香气聚集与气泡保持之间取得折中。

en.title: Tulip glass
en.summary: A stemmed glass with a wide bowl that narrows towards the rim, used for Champagne, beer and some short drinks; it balances aroma concentration and bubble retention.

zh.title: 威士忌闻香杯
zh.summary: 杯腹呈郁金香形、杯口收窄的小型品鉴杯，用于威士忌闻香与少量品饮；收口聚香，短底座便于掌心托杯。

en.title: Whisky Nosing Glass
en.summary: A small tasting glass with a tulip-shaped bowl and a narrowed rim, used for nosing and sipping whisky. The rim gathers aroma and the short base fits the palm.

zh.title: 白葡萄酒杯
zh.summary: 杯腹较小、杯口收窄的带梗酒杯，用于白葡萄酒；较小的杯腹限制氧化，收口保留花香与酸度，适合低温饮用。

en.title: White Wine Glass
en.summary: A stemmed glass with a smaller bowl and a narrower rim, used for white wine. The smaller bowl limits oxidation and the narrowed rim holds the floral and acidic freshness.
